notes.title: Black Ops 7 Zombies: Meet the Expanded Team. And a New Greater Evil.
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5f8a5506365f035eb35b4334d9567c4ea0b3a9f8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]“Welcome to the Party…”[/h3][p] [/p][p]After a tumultuous battle high atop of Janus Towers, celebrations are abruptly short-lived as Grigori Weaver, Dr. Elizabeth Grey, Major Mackenzie ‘Mac’ Carver, and Maya Aguinaldo are thrust into the Dark Aether dimension.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="v2UkhuWSFkw;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p]The crew don’t even have the time to pick themselves up from the ground before they’re startled by the arrival of a welcoming committee.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c8d976d8471906c939504540e88447eaccdb145f.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]“It is a party. And y’all are the guests of honor…”[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/248603e3da17e81b159618fc39bb06190f7d0a0c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A Southern drawl echoes across the lobby. All eight turn as a mysterious figure slowly descends the lobby steps, his face hidden by a wide-brimmed hat. The man’s polite turn of phrase is unnerving, but it’s the caged totem skulls he carries in each hand that suggests a much more terrifying entity has entered the fray.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eb24c2bd390e237063cede5b932c32530a360b98.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A skull detaches its jaw and violently expunges life force from the assembled crew, sucking essence into its maw while sharing its meal with its master, seemingly granting the mysterious figure more than a taste of their souls. Satiated, he slowly turns and leaves, but not before summoning some immediate, reanimated threats for the team to deal with.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/79cd2cb64c72bb0574fcf52af3d086879621d30d.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The drained crew scrambles into action, forced into a ballet of blood and guts as they slowly tear apart the undead. It’s only after the eight of them step out into what was once the Janus Towers Plaza, that a full realization becomes apparent:[/p][p] [/p][p]We’re not in West Virginia anymore.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Meet the Expanded Crew[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e2c19e4836b6f18f1a5e79f9f0897b742310bb91.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]How and why are the crew transported to the Dark Aether? Who are these never-before-seen incarnations of the original Zombies crew and how did they get here? Who can be trusted?[/p][p] [/p][p]Find out in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Zombies on November 14! Until then, let’s get to know all eight dedicated crew members, all over again as well as for the first time:[/p][p] [/p][p]Grigori Weaver[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f48a3209cbffd56b2a6b3875df605026e0629062.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][i]A Ranger-trained CIA operative, Grigori Weaver’s combat acumen and espionage know-how have carried him through countless engagements. After his mother defected from the former Soviet Union, Weaver dedicated his life to exceptional military service in clandestine operations. Haunted by tactical errors and driven by a desire to fight for something he believes in, Weaver stands strong with those who fight beside him.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Weaver has been transformed by the fall of Janus Towers — no longer a shadowy spy master, he has become a hardened leader forged by sacrifice. With Requiem shattered, he gathers the broken pieces in the fight against the Dark Aether, determined to ensure his friends survive.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Dr. Elizabeth Grey[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7ed5de907c23145cbfbe0797a07c0a199d1eab6e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]A highly educated and brilliant scientist, Dr. Elizabeth Grey is renowned for her groundbreaking discoveries in the study of Aetherium. However, turbulent events and sinister uses of her discoveries led her down a dark path. Transformed by years of imprisonment at the hand of the former Director of Requiem, she uses her genius and scientific mind to ensure her team maintains every tactical advantage.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Grey walks away from Janus Towers with her victories tempered by a growing unease: the gnawing doubt that science may not be able to truly mend the damage it has wrought. Once a steadfast believer in reason, she now is starting to suspect that survival may demand something beyond the equations and experiments that once brought her comfort.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Major Mackenzie ‘Mac’ Carver[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/275dd2cb4b165faead1bfd74b049921e23ecc881.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Major Mackenzie Carver comes from a family line of military excellence and distinguished himself with exceptional skill and commitment to his country and brothers-in-arms. Despite being stripped of his rank, he maintained his mental and physical discipline throughout his incarceration, determined to restore his reputation.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Carver leaves Janus Towers with his fury at the Dark Aether sharpened, reforged into a burning clarity of purpose. No longer content to follow orders, he embraces the role of protector, seeking to carve out a future where humanity can stand on its own, free of masters either mortal or cosmic in nature.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Maya Aguinaldo[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a7472c35fd0fe492a2741b1f1e2b53def0f11008.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Trained in the family business of smuggling since she was a child, Maya Aguinaldo brings stealth, covert tactics, and a sharp mind to every engagement.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Street smart and deadly, her effectiveness in combat comes from long years of honing her skills in infiltration, evasion, and misdirection. Her knowledge of the criminal underworld and its unorthodox tactics often comes in handy, but unfiltered opinions and acid tongue can make it hard for her to win friends.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Her pursuit of the Syndicate that abducted her brother threw her into Requiem’s path when she helped free their leaders on Terminus Island. Though out of her depth in the science and machinations of the Dark Aether, her grit, grief, and hard-earned street instincts made her an essential ally in a fight far larger than her own.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Uncertain of her role within her newfound "family," the events at Janus Towers removed her luxury of choice, as once again she has to throw in with allies old and new if she is to have any chance of survival.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Tank Dempsey[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1092054cacf8b13d1b18798164bc2f3aff33a9ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]This incarnation of Tank Dempsey is a battle-hardened U.S. Marine who most recently fought through the jungles of 1968 Vietnam with grit, sarcasm, and a relentless will to survive.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]In this fractured reality, his distrust of his new companions and the unfamiliar surroundings have turned this otherwise dependable soldier into the unpredictable wild card of the group.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Takeo Masaki[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bbd5f2bb4ff0bacb41dcab706c61b671744561e0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Takeo Masaki is a disgraced ronin who wandered 1591 Feudal Japan without master or honor, carrying the weight of his exile as a yoke he cannot cast off.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Bound by a code he only still barely believes in, he seeks redemption in the chaos of battle — his blade both a burden he must bear, and a judgment on his enemies.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Nikolai Belinski[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fc028e18a4bc84c83aa8eb1655418af941cc2728.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Soviet tank commander Nikolai Belinski arrives in the Dark Aether from the brutal, mountainous landscape of 1984 Afghanistan, where duty, disillusionment, and misfortune collided.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Scarred by war and haunted both by betrayal and his own decisions, he masks his bitterness with dark humor yet remains a steadfast warrior when the shells begin to fall.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Dr. Edward Richtofen[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/03fc66500a35cbc912c6658a8ba492466f20b9c2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Dr. Edward Richtofen, a brilliant but unhinged scientist and hero of the Reich, finds himself torn from 1945 in a world where the axis powers triumphed over the allied nations.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Shaped by ambition and tainted by corruption, he masks his innate sadism and considerable ego behind quick wit and a charming smile. He vows that reality itself will ultimately bow to his designs.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Ripped from their respective timelines, our expanded crew finds themselves thrown together in an alien dimension, accompanied by old friends, uncertain allies… and something far, far worse...[/p][p] [/p][h3]Incoming Intel Blast: Full Zombies Reveal Next Week![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f2109884f0a7e38b57019e4d979e119d7f2dffda.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Head back here to the Call of Duty® Blog next week and prepare for a massive intel blast detailing extensive gameplay, systems, enemies, and feature content coming to [i]Black Ops 7[/i], direct from the Treyarch Zombies Team![/p][h2] [/h2][h3]Black Ops 7 Beta Dates Confirmed[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/93dffe44af4de0d363d28a846b54154f56751196.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Beta — divided into the Early Access and Open Beta periods — runs from October 2 to October 8. [/p][p] [/p][p] Early Access Beta[/p][p] [/p][p]Available to players who have pre-ordered the game, the initial part of the Beta is planned to launch on Thursday October 2 at 10AM PT, and concludes 72 hours later when the main Open Beta begins on Sunday October 5 at 10AM PT. The Beta is available at the same time. [/p][p] [/p][p]Open Beta[/p][p] [/p][p]The second part of the Beta is open and free for all players, and is planned to begin on Sunday October 5 at 10AM PT. The [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Beta is scheduled to conclude 72 hours later, on Wednesday October 8 at 10AM PT. [/p][p] [/p][p]Internet access is required for participation.  [/p][p] [/p][p]Accessing the Beta and Beta Codes [/p][p]  [/p][p]If you [b]preordered any Digital Edition version[/b], you do not need a “Beta Code”, as you’ll be automatically allowed entry into Beta Early Access (and subsequently, the Open Beta). [/p][p]  [/p][p]If you don’t preorder [i]Black Ops 7[/i], you can still access the Open Beta period. [/p][p] [/p][h2]Preorder Black Ops 7 Now! Additional Intel to Come![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ec2dcceca51ff119cb9f94412eb9b119c44ca266.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Be sure to stay danger close with the latest official [i]Black Ops 7[/i] information by checking the Call of Duty Blog as further communications are scheduled, including the massive intel blast on Round-Based Zombies incoming before Call of Duty: NEXT, the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Open Beta, and the countdown to launch.[/p][p][/p][p]Prepurchase is available now.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][i]©/TM/® 2025 Activision Publishing, Inc.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Game features described above are based on current in-development features that are subject to change based on final development changes and/or game tuning or updates that may remove or modify some or all of the above features. [/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i](* Actual launch date(s) and platform availability of MP Beta subject to change. See [/i][/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com/beta"]www.callofduty.com/beta[/url][/p][p][i] for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only. Internet connection required.)[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Warzone Season 05 Reloaded
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/008aaec9c4f004693265bbe99976a1cdcb0276c4.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Season 05 Reloaded: Incoming Intel[/u][/h2][p] [/p][h3]Bring the Heat[/h3][p][/p][p]The race to hunt down the last of the Pantheon moles is in full swing as the Rogue Black Ops team uses their renewed support by the CIA to access top-tier intel and weaponry. With Operators Troy Marshall, Frank Woods, and Russell Adler welcomed back into the halls at Langley, it’s only a matter of time before the job is finished.[/p][p] [/p][p]The action never dies as the mid-season update arrives in [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], bringing a new Multiplayer map, new and returning modes, new armaments, events, Reckoning Directed Mode in Zombies, and more.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] Season 05 Reloaded arrives on Thursday, September 4 at 9AM PT.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: Season 05 Reloaded[/u][/h2][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9500b8e66e701f5af210bad69e78c27881fbcc7c.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Map:[/b] Compete to win it all in Jackpot, a new 6v6 map dropping Operators into the Casino Luttazzi. Fight in and around the ornate locale nestled in the hills of Avalon, battling on the main floor, backstage, and outside spanning vistas worth a million bucks.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New and Returning Modes:[/b] Keep slaying or risk an explosive death in the Cranked Demolition LTM! Call up your squad and get ready to re-deploy to Ransack and Blueprint Gunfight.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Scorestreak:[/b] Set the enemy aflame with the new Combat Bow, a low-cost Scorestreak that detonates on impact leaving a pool of flames in its wake.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bbc2abddca1f7bec64751cc54be5bc8843a71e45.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3]New Multiplayer Map[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Jackpot[/p][p][i]Inspired by Black Ops 4, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]Step into the Casino Luttazzi, where luxury meets chaos. Inspired by the “High Rollers” Campaign mission from [i]Black Ops 6[/i] and the “Casino” Multiplayer map from [i]Black Ops 4[/i], Jackpot sets the stage for incredible action as Operators battle over the casino floor, the dazzling Stage, and the outer Terrace and Gazebo, dripping with opulence at every turn.[/p][p] [/p][p]The stakes are sky-high, but the potential payoff is well worth the effort. Hold the central Bar for map control, trade shots between the Slots, or flank targets through the wings. Combining open combat, risky chokepoints, and multiple routes to victory, every match is a gamble, so double down, play the odds, and go all in for the win.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p] [/p][p]Turn up the heat with the explosive Cranked Demolition mode arriving alongside two returning favorites: Ransack and Blueprint Gunfight.[/p][p] [/p][p]Cranked Demolition[/p][p][i]New Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0254ca79459ecd66d7958355dd365ef27727b484.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Turn up the explosive energy in this bomb-based mode as teams alternate between attacking and defending two bomb sites while managing a Cranked timer. Plant, defuse, or eliminate enemies to earn speed Perks and activate a bomb countdown on your Operator. Chain eliminations and play the objective to refresh the bomb timer and earn twice the score for your team.[/p][p] [/p][p]You can only accrue up to a max of 30 seconds on your Cranked timer at a time, so stay active in the match to refresh it as often as possible. Just don’t let that timer distract you from the ticking match clock; planting and defusing bombs are still the main objective in play![/p][p] [/p][p]Ransack[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0e4ec0c3ca4bb2a8f7a453dfac6787c5e5d36a34.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Put it all on the line in this returning mode where teams attempt to strike it rich by looting and stashing the noblest metal of them all. Score points by looting gold bars from designated piles around the map and off fallen enemies who drop their acquired gold when eliminated.[/p][p] [/p][p]Each gold pile is activated for a limited time before moving to the next area marked on your HUD and minimap. Fill your pockets and safely return to your team’s deposit zone to score for each delivered bar; but remember that even deposited gold is up for the taking. If a player enters the opposing team’s drop site, they’ll secure gold bars directly from their stash while adding them to their own team’s score if they can get the delivery back to base in one piece.[/p][p] [/p][p]Blueprint Gunfight[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f291635aff4b0eff1b731d68dcb569edaf8e218e.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Add some style to your Gunfight matches by taking on enemy duos using a variety of curated Weapon Blueprints. In each round, all four players are given the same pre-determined class. There are no respawns, so play smart, communicate with your teammate, and clutch up round after round on the way to six wins to cinch the match.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Additional Gameplay Content[/h3][p] [/p][p]Unleash chaos with the new low-cost Combat Bow Scorestreak. Last seen in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War[/i], this lightweight bow comes equipped with fiery arrows that ignite on impact and create a patch of flames.[/p][p] [/p][p]New Scorestreak (MP, ZM)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/311260fdde2b3fbea156204ebff1a12e81bdb2ca.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Scorestreak: Combat Bow[/b][/p][p][b]Type: [/b]Lethal[/p][p][b]Score: [/b]500[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: [/b]Yes[/p][p] [/p][p]Heat up the competition with the Combat Bow, providing five explosive-tipped arrows that fire fast and leave a patch of flame at the impact site. Shoot from the hip or down the sight, eliminating enemies with a direct hit while providing momentary area control within the arrow’s flaming remains.[/p][p] [/p][p]Plus, hit up the Crafting Table in Zombies to singe undead flesh with the Combat Bow![/p][p] [/p][h2]Zombies: Season 05 Reloaded Content[/h2][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1b998a89186b352b58aa14a01e3d7fc016de6e6d.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Reckoning – Directed Mode: [/b]Get extra guidance on the Main Quest in Reckoning as the crew travels to Project Janus Headquarters in the final chapter of [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Zombies.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Team Cranked LTM: [/b]Get the crew pumped up with the return of Team Cranked, offering powerful abilities to keep you on the move and hunting the undead. Keep slaying to prevent the Cranked timer from running out![/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Leaderboard Events:[/b] Compete for the top spot in two new Leaderboard Events![/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Reckoning: Directed Mode[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ba85fab656d44c139c8ccfe2dfe8297b2ccdd737.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Following the crew’s harrowing adventure in Shattered Veil, the team must decide to choose to help Richtofen in restoring his family, thus stopping S.A.M.’s plan or aid S.A.M. in gaining a body and place themselves in the wrath of Richtofen.[/p][p] [/p][p]With the mid-season arrival of Directed Mode for Reckoning, players can now benefit from a maximum round cap of 15 plus added guidance when pursuing the Main Quest as they breach Janus Towers, which are on the verge of perilous collapse.[/p][p] [/p][p]Face off against new enemies like Uber Klaus and a battalion of automated robots alongside undead Project Janus security personnel, scientists, hazmat crews, and other terrifying mutations. Wield the new Gorgofex Wonder Weapon, a living armament loaded with Aether-based energy slugs that can be charged for maximum destructive power. When in a bind, activate and upgrade the new C.A.S.T.E.R. Turret trap to help eliminate surrounding threats.[/p][p] [/p][p]Players who complete Reckoning on Directed Mode will earn a unique Calling Card variant upon completion along with the “Keepsake” Weapon Charm and an XP payout.[/p][p] [/p][p]Keep an eye on the Zombies section of our [url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/blackops6"][i]Black Ops 6 [/i][/url][url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/blackops6"]Guides[/url] for the official walkthrough of Reckoning Directed Mode, coming soon![/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Returning LTM: Team Cranked[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3a07a00b9e7cb4889678c4c70e70cf4585ad246e.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Power up and slay zombie after zombie to keep the clock ticking as Team Cranked returns in the mid-season![/p][p] [/p][p]In this exhilarating game mode, the Cranked Timer is activated for the whole team after the first undead enemy is eliminated. Once active, you’ll have to work together to keep the timer ticking by chaining eliminations; if the seconds count down to zero, it’s game over.[/p][p] [/p][p]Eliminate enemies to add more time to the countdown, up to a maximum of 30 seconds at the start of the match. With every round, however, the max allotted time is reduced by one second. Thankfully, the team benefits from some significant advantages encouraging players to remain on the offensive:[/p][p] [/p][p]1.     The Cranked state amps up all Operators, conferring incredible speed bonuses including faster movement and rapid reloads.[/p][p]2.     The amount of Essence earned by eliminating zombies is increased compared to Standard/Directed matches.[/p][p]3.     All Operators are automatically equipped with the Time Stopper Field Upgrade. Activate it to pause the Cranked timer for the whole team.[/p][p]4.     Grab the rare Time Extended power-up to increase the maximum allowed time; in this mode, every second counts.[/p][p] [/p][p]There are no Wall Buys in Team Cranked; the Mystery Box is your key to greater power. Players earn more Essence while Cranked, however, giving you ample opportunities to spin the box in search of the best tools for the job.[/p][p] [/p][p]Season 05 Reloaded brings fresh rewards to players who complete the Main Quest after Round 30, with each map awarding a five pack of GobbleGums, and a whopping 15,000 XP payout.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Leaderboard Events: No Cranked, No Glory & Undead Ascension[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5359947521f876bd1ea8293b3637b1708c5dc2ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Look for two new Zombies Leaderboard Events arriving in the mid-season. Climb the ladder and earn rewards starting with No Cranked, No Glory, followed by Undead Ascension coming later in the mid-season.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Call of Duty: Warzone: Season 05 Reloaded Content[/u][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3925d44bda0ea6acfd311ec887aec052af9dbbb5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Deadline LTM: [/b]Battle against enemy players as well as enemy combatants known as Hostile Soldiers in this new respawn-enabled LTM where the lowest scoring squads are eliminated throughout the match.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Bowl VI, WSOW: [/b]Two highly anticipated [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] tournaments are just on the horizon! Catch all the action live as C.O.D.E. Bowl VI presented by USAA airs on September 30, followed by the World Series of Warzone Global Final on October 1.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Lasting Impact[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/24e224bff2ec23954dfe527347cb0228eccfdc92.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Following the epic breach into Stadium, Verdansk is forever changed. The roof is now permanently blown off the structure, the interior accessible to all squads. All future deployments to Verdansk will feature the newly revealed area, including within the new Deadline limited-time mode arriving in the mid-season.[/p][p] [/p][p]New LTM: Deadline[/p][p][i]Quads, 100 Players, Players and Hostile Soldiers, Verdansk[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ce811ae8e69c1bddf889e1cdb5c96fdaf1071531.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]There’s no room for stragglers in the new Deadline LTM, so get to work the moment you land in the field. It pays to take risks, as all players are provided with unlimited respawns, but beware overextending and falling behind. With each Circle Collapse, the lowest scoring squads are eliminated from the match, and a wave of enemy combatants called Hostile Soldiers will appear to increase the pressure on the remaining teams.[/p][p] [/p][p]You’ll have to keep proving yourself throughout the match, as each new circle resets earned score for all squads. To scrape back up from the bottom, focus on eliminating enemies, completing Contracts, looting supplies, and spending cash at Buy Stations to keep that score rolling in.[/p][p] [/p][p]In Deadline, every action counts. Work with your teammates, keep your cool, and prepare to rebuild from scratch after each reset.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Bowl VI, WSOW[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dbb07f99acd843212eb05c03bab1237d1bb6357c.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Bowl VI[url="#_msocom_1"]\[CA1][/url] [/p][p] [/p][p]In case you [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/08/call-of-duty-black-ops-7-reveal-campaign-multiplayer-zombies"]missed it[/url], the epic matchup between pro players and military service members returns in the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Bowl VI, presented by USAA. The sixth annual tournament will feature 10 esports teams from military branches of the U.S., U.K., and Canada, competing alongside the most competitive players in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].[/p][p] [/p][p]This year’s event will feature epic viewer rewards courtesy of USAA, and for the first time ever, you can grab [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Beta codes while you watch. And tune in to see who will take home the third annual Monster Energy MVP and second-ever Corsair Solo Yolo![/p][p] [/p][p]Catch all the action on the official Call of Duty Twitch® Channel and Call of Duty YouTube® Channel on Tuesday, September 30, directly following Call of Duty: NEXT, the worldwide Multiplayer reveal event for [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i].[/p][p] [/p][p]Follow the Call of Duty Endowment on [url="https://www.instagram.com/callofdutyendowment/?hl=en"]Instagram[/url] and [url="https://x.com/CODE4Vets"]X[/url] for C.O.D.E. Bowl VI updates. [/p][p] [/p][p]World Series of Warzone[/p][p] [/p][p]Don’t miss the finale for the World Series of Warzone™, the biggest [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] competition of the year. The Global Final brings together 150 of the world’s best players back to the arena where it all began: Verdansk. Taking place on October 1 and streaming on the official Call of Duty Twitch® Channel and Call of Duty YouTube® Channel, the Global Final will crown a top Trio in the world, granting them eternal bragging rights and the lion’s share of the $1 million prize pool.[/p][p] [/p][p]For the most up to date tournament info, follow Call of Duty Esports on [url="https://www.instagram.com/cod_esports/"]Instagram[/url] and [url="https://x.com/cod_esports?lang=en"]X[/url].[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: General Content (MP, ZM, WZ)[/u][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e1ec1ae812a6889dcfa85bc09bee166b23e3b54d.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Weapon Detail:[/b] Keep the undertaker in business with the Gravemark .357 Revolver, a high-powered Secondary Weapon that drops enemy targets in the dust.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Events:[/b] Celebrate all things Nuketown in the Nuketown Block Party event and show off your action hero chops in Operation: Hell Ride. Earn new rewards including the Combat Bow Scorestreak, Gravemark .357 Revolver, PPSh-41 Helical Magazine, and more.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Store Offerings:[/b] Access new Ultra Skins, Reactive content, and Mastercraft Weapon Blueprints across new Bundles arriving in the mid-season Store![/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Take aim and send ‘em underground with the powerful Gravemark .357 Revolver, a new earnable Secondary Weapon in the Operation: Hell Ride Event.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Secondary Weapon: Gravemark .357 Revolver[/p][p][i]Pistol, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b016e285d17041c71121b1c62e2e85c9e020a6f7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Levels: 26[/b][/p][p][b]MAGS: 3[/b][/p][p][b]MAG SIZE: 8[/b][/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options: [/b]Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (2).[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][i]Single-action revolver. High power and considerable range, limited by lower ammo count and segmented reload.[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Knock foes flat with the heavy-hitting Gravemark .357 Revolver, a devastating weapon that forgoes modern trappings for tried-and-true lethality. Each round must be manually reloaded into the cylinder’s chambers, so make your shots count and get behind cover or swap to your Primary Weapon when it’s time to reload.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]New: Special Weapon Attachments[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b18ebc17f5e2954252459a2f4d18390743915fb1.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]PPSh-41 Helical Magazine[/p][p][i]PPSh-41 SMG, Event Reward[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Say goodbye to reloads with the PPSh-41 Helical Magazine providing the PPSh-41 with a massive amount of ammo. Sustained fire fills an overheat meter, so take intermittent breaks from the onslaught of lead to keep your weapon at the ready.[/p][p] [/p][p]In addition, benefit from improved range, recoil control, and mobility. It also drastically improves hip spread, but adds some ADS spread. Pairs well with the Scavenger Perk and Assault Pack Field Upgrade.[/p][p][/p][h3]Season 05 Reloaded Events[/h3][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f06e131357e85900ff97fee2a564e2c57e938ace.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Earn XP and unlock rewards including new Season 05 Reloaded weaponry like the Combat Bow Scorestreak, PPSh-41 Helical Magazine Attachment, and the Gravemark .357 Revolver.[/p][p] [/p][p]Event: Nuketown Block Party (MP, ZM, WZ)[/p][p][i]Rewards Include: Combat Bow, PPSh-41 Helical Magazine Attachment[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Celebrate Nuketown in explosive fashion with this mid-season event packed with themed rewards honoring this timeless classic map.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Free Track[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Take charge with the “Nuketown Mayor” mannequin Operator Skin and add some spice to your matches with the Combat Bow Scorestreak and PPSh-41 Helical Magazine Attachment, plus an animated Weapon Camo, Calling Card, and more.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Free Track Mastery Reward: “Armed and Dangerous” Pickaxe Blueprint[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Complete the Free Track to unlock the “Armed and Dangerous” Pickaxe Weapon Blueprint. Give the enemy a hand with this wild armament pulled straight off a mannequin’s torso.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Up the Chaos with the Premium Track[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Purchase the Premium Track to progress along a second track of themed rewards including the “Lady-quinn” mannequin Operator Skin, “Nuke Proof” Weapon Blueprint and “Nuketown Special” Mastercraft, “Durable Gizmo” Gunscreen, “Nuked Town” Calling Card, Emote, Finishing Move, and more.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Premium Track Mastery Reward: “Merc Test” Operator Skin[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Ready for combat, this mannequin dons a sleeveless tactical vest, black pants, and enough gear to stay in the fight all the way until the nuke lands.[/p][p] [/p][p]Event: Operation: Hell Ride (MP, ZM, WZ)[/p][p][i]Rewards Include: Gravemark .357 Revolver[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]The clock is ticking and only the most daring action heroes can hope to save the day before everything goes ka-boom! Gear up and face the danger head-on with rewards including the new Gravemark .357 Revolver plus the “Pro for Hire” Operator Skin, “Cannon Toss” Finishing Move, a Weapon Charm, Calling Card, the GPR 91 Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint, and more.[/p][p] [/p][p]Season 05 BlackCell owners can unlock two additional BlackCell Weapon Blueprints. One for the GPR 91 Assault Rifle and one for the Gravemark .357 Revolver.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]New Store Offerings[/h3][p] [/p][p]Look forward to new content arriving in the Store throughout the mid-season including a variety of Ultra Skins, Reactives, and Mastercraft Weapon Blueprints across multiple Bundles.[/p][p] [/p][p]Tracer Pack: Desperado Mastercraft Bundle[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fe0305ff2bc8834322b09b306430ba8a602178d7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Become an urban legend with the “Cunning Thievery” Operator Skin, armed to the teeth with three Weapon Blueprints: the intricate gold and silver “Sin Ley” Saug SMG Mastercraft Weapon Blueprint, “Audacious” Essex Model 07 Marksman Rifle Blueprint, and the “Partner” Gravemark .357 Revolver Blueprint for the new Season 05 Reloaded Pistol. All three feature Gold Rush Tracers and Gold Nugget Death FX. Or just make ‘em dance with “Deep-Sixed” Finishing Move.[/p][p] [/p][p]Further establish your fearsome reputation with the “Slick Draw” Emote, “Spiral Load” animated Calling Card, “Gold Seeker” Loading Screen, and the “Bone Cackle” Sticker.[/p][p] [/p][p]Tracer Pack: Chaos Trader Ultra Skin Bundle[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4c50c5430f69df157e37a43fce12f0661bfdd58a.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Get your kit, some cargo needs a special smuggler and if you’re going to smuggle with the best, you should look the part. Put on the rugged but tactical “Maya’s Runner” Ultra Skin. Then equip the “Undead Deal” Assault Rifle or “Unfair Trade” LMG, both deadly Legendary weapons that come equipped with special zombie limb death FX. To really bring the chaos, break out the “No Refunds” Ray Gun Legendary Ray Gun Wonder Weapon Blueprint to send zombies flying.[/p][p] [/p][p]Make sure to give a “Thumbs Up” to the competition with the zombified. “Dying Ember” Reticle, “Dead Taker” Loading Screen, “Among Friends” Calling Card, “Cagey” Emblem, and “Wonderbar!” Ultra GobbleGum.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Tracer Pack: Flightless Bundle[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b4b4c4ec077dddd614dcfc7ac53125eb022c36a8.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Suit up for your next aerial deployment with the “Sky Traveler” Operator Skin, paired with two hard-hitting Legendary Weapon Blueprints, the “Ice King” FFAR1 Assault Rifle and the “Rockhopper” LW3A1 Frostline Sniper Rifle, both equipped with Frozen Fish Tracers and Penguin Breach Death FX.[/p][p] [/p][p]Let loose a victory waddle with the “Waddle Waddle” Emote and equip the “Flying Fish” Weapon Charm to keep your food source close at hand. Defy the laws of gravity and take flight with the “Unfazed” animated Emblem and “Flight Dream” Large Decal and leave your mark with the “The Skies Await” Loading Screen and “Ice Breaker” Spray.[/p][p] [/p][p]Tracer Pack: Iron Scale Hunter Mastercraft Bundle[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4023bad5a46dea326ad46086c246b7010e90c2d6.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]No beast is safe from your hunt when wielding Iron Scale weaponry. Push through the blazing inferno with the “Plated Drake” LC10 SMG Ultra Mastercraft Weapon Blueprint with red metal scales and dragon’s teeth lining the barrel. Sizzle foes with the “Sinister Scald” Goblin Mk2 Assault Rifle, both Weapon Blueprints including Red Scale Tracers and Scale Pierce Death FX. Slice up your enemies with the “Decrown” Finishing Move.[/p][p] [/p][p]Let your prey know you’re on the prowl by equipping the “Watchful Eye” Weapon Charm, “Face the Foe” animated Calling Card, “Blind Snarl” animated Emblem, “Dragon Made” Loading Screen, and the “Chibi Challenger” Weapon Sticker.[/p][p] [/p][p]Plus, look for other Bundles coming to the mid-season Store, including the[b] Tracer Pack: Juggernog Justice Ultra Skin Bundle[/b], [b]Tracer Pack: Angels and Demons II Bundle[/b], and more.[/p][p] [/p][h3]BO6 S05 Battle Pass Tier Skips Free Bonus Offer[/h3][p] [/p][p]In celebration of the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] reveal, for a limited time, when you log in to [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] from now through September 16, you will be granted 20 free Battle Pass Tier Skips.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Thank You for Downloading the Season 05 Reloaded Update[/h3][p][/p][p]The Season 5 Reloaded download will be larger on some platforms — we are reorganizing [i]Call of Duty[/i] content to prepare for the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Beta on October 2. As a thank you to the community for downloading the Season 5 Reloaded update, we're gifting players a pack of 2XP Tokens across all platforms. Players who complete the download and log into [i]Call of Duty[/i] from 10AM PT on September 4 until October 1 will receive:[/p][p] [/p][p]·        Five 1-Hour Double Player XP Tokens (5 hours total)[/p][p]·        Five 1-Hour Double Weapon XP Tokens (5 hours total)[/p][p]·        Five 1-Hour Double Battle Pass XP Tokens (5 hours total)[/p][p][/p][p]The Truth Lies.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][i]©/TM/® 2025 Activision Publishing, Inc.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]For more information, please visit [/i][/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com"]www.callofduty.com[/url][/p][p][i] and [/i][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/callofduty"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][i], and follow [url="https://twitter.com/activision"]@Activision[/url] and [url="https://twitter.com/CallofDuty"]@CallofDuty[/url] on X, Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow [url="https://twitter.com/CODUpdates"]@CODUpdates[/url] on X.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Worldwide Reveal: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7: Initial Briefing
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/926e9c9debab014a73b1eeccd818d112f13c2bb2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p][/p][h2]BLACK OPS 7 CO-OP CAMPAIGN: CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]An Unprecedented Campaign[/b] in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] dives deeper into the madness, playable solo or with up to four players.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Returning Fan Favorite Characters[/b], including David Mason and Raul Menendez, along with the introduction of new icons like Emma Kagan adds to the Campaign’s narrative intrigue.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]A Wide Spectrum of Environments:[/b] Take on high-stakes missions set in locations as varied as the neon-lit rooftops of Japan to the Mediterranean coast, and even into the deepest corners of the human psyche. Players will also experience Avalon, an expansive city whose secrets ripple across the Campaign.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Endgame Unleashed: [/b]In the culmination of the story, Treyarch and Raven are unleashing Endgame as part of the Co-Op Campaign, where Avalon opens up for players as they wield personalized abilities and face unexpected challenges, putting everything they’ve mastered throughout the story to the test.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p]In [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7[/i], Treyarch and Raven Software are bringing players the most mind-bending [i]Black Ops[/i] ever.[/p][p] [/p][p]The year is 2035 and the world is on the brink of chaos, ravaged by violent conflict and psychological warfare following the events of [i]Black Ops 2[/i] and [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. The calculating and dangerous Raul Menendez has returned with a chilling televised threat. As his message rings out across the world, The Guild, a global tech giant, vows to step in and protect humanity. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="9txkGBj_trg;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p]Seeking his own answers, David “Section” Mason leads an elite Joint Special Operations Command (JSOC) team on a covert mission to the sprawling Mediterranean city of Avalon. While there, they uncover a weapon engineered to turn fear into an instrument of war, threatening to erode global order if released. The sophisticated plot they discover won’t just plunge the world into chaos; it will pull David Mason and his team into their own haunting pasts.[/p][p] [/p][p]As The Guild's philosophy on how to confront this crisis puts them at odds with David, he and his team must uncover the truth behind Menendez’s return and how this horrific weapon will be used to incite global terror… before losing themselves to madness.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Co-Op Campaign: Full Debrief[/h3][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5aee217ac7d6b97c6c15a1d4b24bb0a45eafbea2.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]In [i]Black Ops 7[/i], you can go solo or squad up with up to three other players in this innovative Co-Op Campaign that redefines the [i]Black Ops[/i] experience. This is a story that developers at Treyarch and Raven Software have been building together, designed to deepen the [i]Black Ops[/i] universe. The world of 2035 is shaped by the consequences of choices made long before. This is a future forged by fear, where the past is never really gone.[/p][p] [/p][p]One overriding goal with the story of [i]Black Ops 7[/i] was to tell a story that could stand on its own while honoring the legacy of the series. Throughout development, there were meaningful opportunities allowing the reconnection of characters and storylines from earlier [i]Black Ops[/i] titles, bringing them into this near-future setting where their presence could elevate the experience. However, it was important to ensure that even players without knowledge of [i]Black Ops[/i] lore should expect a deeply immersive and connected story and world.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Covert Missions and a Mind-Bending Narrative[/h3][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ca1f6d22184cff75ecd02949aa3938ba156c6ea8.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]In 2035, [i]Black Ops 2 [/i]villain Raul Menendez is back with a mysterious video, threatening to burn the world down in three days. In response, The Guild, a global tech conglomerate known for its consumer innovations and military applications, has stepped into the fray to offer protection where governments and nations have failed.[/p][p] [/p][p]David Mason — call sign Section — is deployed to investigate the new danger. What he believes is a tactical operation quickly unravels into something far more dangerous and disturbing, as Mason and his “Specter One” JSOC team of elite Operators uncovers a weapon engineered to turn fear into an instrument of havoc and destruction.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ebca6443c8e6c652d462608765e8f732848adfd3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]After the team is exposed to the weapon, their grip on reality fractures. Missions shift into surreal landscapes, with twisted versions of each team member’s memories coming vividly into focus, and terrifying paranoia threatens to envelope them all. The line between memory and madness begins to blur.[/p][p] [/p][p]Alongside David Mason and his JSOC team comprised of Mike Harper, Eric Samuels, and Leilani "50/50" Tupuola, you’ll meet Emma Kagan, CEO of The Guild, and deploy with Operatives such as Slade “Razor” Barrick who heads up “Specter Two”, the secondary JSOC team supporting the overall mission. Also integral to the narrative is the enduring shadow of Raul Menendez, and as the world spirals toward chaos once more, one of the main questions of the story isn’t whether Menendez is back. It’s whether Mason is ready to face what that truly means.[/p][p] [/p][h3]An Introduction to JSOC: Meet the Team[/h3][p] [/p][p]David Mason[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4ab51825e7cfd597eeb5169b49df48cbac3126d9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]The son of legendary Black Ops operative Alex Mason, David spent his early childhood in Alaska under the shadow of his father’s extended absences and classified CIA work. This childhood was abruptly shattered in 1989, when the drug lord Raul Menendez engineered Alex Mason's death in Panama. Afterward, David was taken in and raised by his father's best friend, CIA operative Frank Woods.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Determined to serve in the footsteps of his father, David joined the U.S. Navy, earning a commission through the Naval Academy. With an innate tactical mind and combat proficiency, he pursued the Navy’s elite ranks and by the mid-2000s, he was operating at the highest levels of Special Operations, proving himself in counterterrorism missions across the Middle East and beyond.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]By the 2020s, Mason had risen to Commander within Joint Special Operations Command (JSOC), leading an elite counterterrorism unit specializing in high-risk threats. In 2025, he played a central role in hunting down Raul Menendez, who had spent the last several decades building a global terrorist network hellbent on tearing down the existing world order.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Ten years later, the shocking reappearance of Raul Menendez forces David to finally come to terms with his past.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Mike Harper[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9162b14399598b2de6966ca690e85df1f51c1111.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][i]Mike Harper was born in Arkansas, raised in poverty by his mother and uncle after his father was killed in a farming accident. His uncle Finn, a Vietnam war veteran, became his mentor, teaching him to shoot and fostering his love of boxing. Harper spent his youth in the ring and seeking escape from home, drawn to his uncle’s war stories and the allure of military life.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]At 18, he joined the U.S. Navy, eager to see the world. While traveling the globe, he accumulated a sleeve of tribal tattoos down his right arm: a reminder of his past and the warrior’s path he walked. Eventually his thirst for danger led him to Special Operations, where he transitioned from conventional deployments to high-risk missions. His unpolished demeanor, devil-may-care attitude, and playful sarcasm endeared him to many of his teammates, but also occasionally landed him in hot water.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]He pursued the path to an elite Navy operative with relentless determination. Years of excelling in dangerous operations earned him a place in an elite squad, where he formed a close bond with David Mason, a man who, in time, would become like a brother to him, not least because of Harper’s brutal honesty. Harper played both supporting and pivotal roles in classified operations and steadily rose to the rank of Senior Chief Petty Officer.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]By 2021, Harper joined JSOC where his expertise was crucial in global counterterrorism operations. In 2025, after the Menendez attacks, he remained in active duty, later transitioning into a JSOC mentorship role. But retirement didn’t suit him. Missing the adrenaline of combat, Harper pushed back against age and expectations, proving he could still operate at the highest level — no matter the odds.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Eric Samuels[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bfbb4baab82a499c1d05a1b0faef41542f35e58e.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][i]Samuels was born in York, Pennsylvania, in 1991. Restless and directionless, he drifted through a brief stint in college before enlisting in the Army in 2010. Military life provided the discipline he lacked, and he quickly excelled in marksmanship, achieving Expert level. In 2015, he considered joining the Rangers but instead left to become a bounty hunter, drawn to its solitary nature. The work was lucrative, but after a failed relationship that left him heartbroken, he sought a more meaningful path. In 2018, he joined the Secret Service after passing its rigorous selection process.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Samuels' professionalism earned him high-profile assignments, eventually placing him on President Bosworth’s security detail. Alongside David Mason, he successfully protected the President during a devastating attack on Los Angeles in 2025. The attack exposed critical security failures, leaving Samuels disillusioned with the agency and his own role in it. He resigned from the Secret Service shortly afterward, determined to apply his skills in a more decisive role.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]In 2026, he joined the Secret Service’s Special Operations Division (SOD).[/i][/p][p][i]After proving himself in SOD, he tested into other elite teams before realizing he could make a greater impact being by David’s side, transferring to Mason’s JSOC team in 2031. Known as a quiet professional, Samuels is analytical with a no-nonsense attitude, observing and engaging the world with precision. He works well with Mason, though his dynamic with teammates Harper and 50/50 is more contentious. While he doesn’t always agree with their methods, he acknowledges that sometimes a touch of chaos is necessary for mission success.[/i][/p][p]50/50[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d4de1320741418413728e1662e0a29e0109b576a.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][i]Leilani "50/50" Tupuola is a fierce, relentless warfighter living on borrowed time. A degenerative disease threatens to take her out, but she stays ahead of it with advanced bionics — most notably, a cybernetic arm and leg.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Hailing from Gisborne, New Zealand, Leilani grew up surfing and sailing before[/i][/p][p][i]following her older brother into the military, choosing the Navy over the Army.[/i][/p][p][i]She thrived until her diagnosis made swimming difficult, prompting a shift to[/i][/p][p][i]Intelligence. After years of proving herself, she joined an experimental bionics[/i][/p][p][i]program to stay in the fight. The grueling procedures nearly killed her, but the[/i][/p][p][i]results were undeniable — enhanced reflexes, precision, and endurance.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Recognizing her potential, elite New Zealand special forces recruited her, but with a catch: to fully overcome her condition, she had to amputate her left leg for another bionic upgrade. She accepted without hesitation. Two years later, her actions caught the attention of U.S. Special Forces, impressing Harper and earning a recommendation for David Mason’s elite unit. She is currently on her third operation under Mason’s command, trusted for her skills but still proving herself in his inner circle.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][h3]The Guardian and the Guild Leader[/h3][p][i] [/i][/p][p]Troy Marshall[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f342e2342a1549c3cf50fd053c56139cee2df3c3.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][i]Troy Marshall was born in 1960 and enlisted in the U.S. Marine Corps at 22 after graduating from college. In 1983, as a member of the Marines, he survived a devastating barracks bombing, an event that shaped his pragmatic yet deeply moral outlook. Seeking more direct action, he transitioned into Force Recon, excelling in covert operations before being recruited into the CIA’s Special Activities Division.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]By 1991, Marshall had built a reputation as an unrelenting, if impulsive, force in the field. After suspension from the CIA for insubordination, Marshall assembled a rogue team to pursue rumors of CIA infiltration by a paramilitary group known as Pantheon. Despite a deeply personal betrayal that nearly destroyed his team, Marshall managed to defeat Pantheon and expose its plans. Months later, he was reinstated into the CIA with newfound respect.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Marshall remained with the CIA’s Special Activities Division throughout the decade, operating in the shadows of America’s growing post-Cold War conflicts. In 2004, he sustained a debilitating leg injury while on mission in Afghanistan. Transitioning back into direct military command, he rejoined the Special Operations Command of the Marines before earning a commission as an officer. By the 2010s, he became an architect of classified counterinsurgency programs, gaining a reputation as a hard-edged but pragmatic commander. Attaining the rank of Colonel in 2028, Marshall oversees Tier 1 special operations under JSOC. In 2035, Marshall remains a legend in the Black Ops world.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Emma Kagan[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/66313810c9f5c837a32528050458d0f8545e0bdc.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][i]Born in 2005 in Chicago, Emma Kagan was raised in a world where power dictated survival. Her father, a hedge fund manager, and her mother, a former Department of Defense analyst, instilled in her an early understanding of leverage — financial, technological, and human. Morality, she learned, was a flexible concept, shaped by those who held the most influence.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]A prodigy in finance and engineering, she entered MIT at 16, quickly making a name for herself in computational economics and applied robotics. Her brief stint with a top defense contractor opened her eyes to the mechanics of the war economy, and by graduation, she had no interest in working for someone else. Instead, she sought control.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Kagan’s entry into The Guild came in her early 20s, when she brokered a deal between a struggling drone startup and one of Avalon’s many shell companies. The move caught the attention of Sevati Dumas — the unseen force behind The Guild’s transformation into a corporate giant. Dumas made Kagan her protégé, teaching her the finer points of corporate warfare. By 28, Kagan had maneuvered her way into the CEO position, but true power remained in Dumas’ hands. Instead of resisting, she adapted. Now, at 30, she is the face of Guild — a brilliant, charismatic executive who ensures the company’s continued interests are served.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][h3]Co-Op Campaign: A Wide Spectrum of Environments[/h3][p][i] [/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c04839c2ddfdad7d8c408aa7c1068cabc7b95dcc.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Mission variety is at the core of the [i]Black Ops 7 [/i]Campaign, and though the action starts grounded in covert operations and infiltrations, subsequent deployments take place in both reality and the edge of consciousness. Take on high-stakes missions across a wide spectrum of environments, from the neon-lit rooftops of Japan to the Mediterranean coast, and even into the deepest corners of the human psyche. Prepare to return to Nicaragua, Angola, and Los Angeles, sometimes in the blink of an eye. With the JSOC team seemingly trapped in this mindscape, there are no limitations to where you might end up.[/p][p] [/p][p]Players will also experience Avalon, an expansive city whose secrets ripple across the Campaign.[/p][p] [/p][p]Avalon is where The Guild is based, and their presence here is no accident. It’s a city layered with history, power, and hidden agendas, and designed from the ground up to serve both the narrative and gameplay. Integrating seamlessly into the Campaign, Avalon adds another dimension to the Campaign experience. This isn’t just where the story begins, but where it unfolds, and could be the key to unlocking the mystery at the heart of [i]Black Ops 7[/i].[/p][p] [/p][h2]Co-Op Campaign: Unleashing the Endgame[/h2][p][i] [/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3a88bce1b9741707ee7e7b72236ae538baf50ee8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]With a Campaign of this scale, Treyarch and Raven are ensuring players are rewarded in fresh new ways as they explore the Campaign narrative. As you push deeper into the story, you'll master new abilities to deploy in the Campaign's epic Endgame, where you’ll reach new levels of power to survive overwhelming odds in a brand-new replayable experience at the culmination of the Campaign.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2da578a60f715dd19fda5f8b7e475afef7bfb2b1.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Global Progression in Campaign: [/b]For the first time ever, Global Progression will be coming to the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Co-Op Campaign. Simply put, this means you’ll be earning XP, leveling up your weapons, unlocking Weapon Camos, and completing Challenges during the Co-Op Campaign that can be brought into Multiplayer and Zombies, or to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]™ starting in Season 1. Keep reading for further details in the “Global Systems” section of this Blog.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Avalon Endgame:[/b] In the culmination of the Co-Op campaign, the developers are unleashing something bold: Endgame. This isn’t just a final mission.[/p][p] [/p][p]Endgame the last part of the Campaign — a brand-new, replayable experience where you and your squad will need to survive overwhelming odds, adapt under pressure, and break the rules of what you thought a [i]Black Ops[/i] Campaign could be.[/p][p] [/p][p]Each run is a new step in your power journey as you wield the personalized abilities you’ve unlocked and face unexpected challenges. And here, all of Avalon opens up. This is your chance to explore the world beyond the mission.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Operator Combat Rating: [/b]Once you reach Endgame, you’ll be able to play as any unlocked Operator and access the C.O.M.B.A.T. Operating System to fully realize your Operator's power and effectiveness. Every Operator you take into Co-Op Campaign’s Endgame has their own Combat Rating that you progress by completing Activities, Assignments, and defeating enemies.[/p][p] [/p][p]When your power increases you can choose new [b]Power Upgrades[/b] or [b]Skills [/b]that increase your Combat Rating. Power Upgrades increase stats such as Health, Armor, Mobility, and Damage. Skills are Perk-like upgrades that specialize your Operator into tracks built around a defined combat role. Each choice will allow the player to advance their Combat Rating, which is a direct reflection of the acquired skills and power. Successfully escape to keep them all with the ultimate goal of reaching Combat Rating 60 – that is 60 player-selected Operator upgrades, a deep system of player choice and power unlike anything ever seen in Campaign.[/p][p] [/p][p]Additionally, you may select and equip two powerful Abilities to customize your Operator's role for battle. Many Abilities are exclusive to Co-Op Campaign such as the Ability to leap several stories to traverse distances or warp in the direction you're aiming to redirect the battle.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Endgame Loadouts: [/b]In Endgame, Campaign Loadouts and Operator selection become available, allowing you to bring in unlocked abilities from the Campaign along with any Primary or Secondary and Melee weapon into Endgame, as well as keeping Equipment and Weapons you’ve successfully escaped with in a special “Field Acquisition” section of your Loadout. But if your squad goes down, you’re back to square one… including your Combat Rating.[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Black Ops 7[/i]’s Co-Op Campaign delivers a bold, mind-bending story centered on David Mason and his team, and a deeply personal journey into fear, control, and consequence.  Built for solo or co-op play, this Campaign pulls you into a threat that demands your attention, twists your expectations, and reminds you exactly why [i]Black Ops[/i] stories are so unique.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Multiplayer: A Massive Offering[/h2][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]BLACK OPS 7 MULTIPLAYER: CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]A Massive Offering:[/b] 16 signature 6v6 multiplayer maps at launch (13 all new maps and three returning [i]Black Ops 2[/i] classics) plus two new large-scale maps, all combining a new level of visual fidelity along with refined Multiplayer design for the most engaging [i]Black Ops[/i] MP ever.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Near-Future Weaponry: [/b]Set in 2035, Multiplayer delivers an arsenal of new, near-future weaponry and gear, where all weapon systems have been overhauled down to the smallest detail to match the era.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Overclocked Gear: [/b]In [i]Black Ops 7[/i], your loadout is alive with possibility. For the first time, Scorestreaks, Field Upgrades, and Equipment can be upgraded with the new Overclock system, growing more versatile the more you use them. Every match becomes a step toward unlocking their full potential.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Perks and Hybrid Combat Specialties: [/b]On the Perks side, Hybrid Combat Specialties let you mix and match different Perks to unlock exciting and powerful Hybrid gameplay bonuses.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Next-level Omnimovement[/b], including Wall Jumps and more, open-up creative possibilities and fresh dynamics to gameplay.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Skirmish[/b] is an all-new, 20v20 adrenaline-charged MP mode that blends a variety of objectives with new abilities like wingsuiting and grappling hooks, and intense vehicle warfare into a massive experience. Set across two launch maps, this is [i]Black Ops[/i] large-scale combat, redefined.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/38636b955bcdf66417f2fd752bc936b3913e0975.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Multiplayer in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] explodes out of the gate with 16 electrifying 6v6 maps and two 20v20 maps at launch, all beginning with a unified vision based on the 2035 setting, reimagining the world of [i]Black Ops 2[/i] 10 years on.[/p][p] [/p][p]This near future is rooted in modern-day realism, allowing the Multiplayer team at Treyarch to push the boundaries across Multiplayer, and ensuring the most balanced and entertaining game possible. It begins with the technology on offer to Operators dropping into combat:[/p][p] [/p][h3]Near-Future Weaponry and Live-Wire Loadouts[/h3][p][/p][p]Expect in-world technological improvements to all the weapons available across Multiplayer — and therefore available in Co-Op Campaign and Zombies — with 30 new weapons at launch, including 16 that players will see in a [i]Call of Duty[/i] for the very first time. The [i]Black Ops 7[/i] arsenal strikes a balance between brand-new armaments and homages to fan-favorites, along with gameplay mechanics never seen before in the franchise. In [i]Black Ops 7[/i], your loadout is alive with possibility.[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Black Ops 7[/i] will also mark the return of Weapon Prestige, bringing depth of progression, mastery, and rewards to the Weapon Progression journey not seen since 2018. Additionally, players will be able to share their created Weapon Builds for the first time ever via [i]Black Ops 7[/i]’s new Weapon Build Sharing and Build Code features. Check out the Global Systems section of this blog (below) for more details.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2314b69c2b3980a46323129e76599cb58a680631.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]With the game taking place ten years after [i]Black Ops 2[/i], Treyarch’s Multiplayer team has unleashed its creativity to deliver a variety of exciting new Perks, weapon attachments, Equipment, Field Upgrades, and of course, a huge selection of Scorestreaks to utilize.[/p][p] [/p][p]One of these new Scorestreaks is the Rhino, a bipedal death machine that drops from the sky, slams into the ground with enough force to crater the pavement and unleashes its heavy weapons in a player-controlled third-person rampage of precision and destruction.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Overclocking Your Equipment[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2734bcf1efcf76b6202ec99be5078b6b35d36096.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]For the first time in [i]Black Ops[/i], Scorestreaks, Field Upgrades, and Equipment can be upgraded using the brand-new Overclock System, meaning more than just your weapons will grow more versatile the more you use them. Every successful use of your Scorestreaks, Field Upgrade, and Equipment becomes a step toward unlocking their full potential as you enhance your arsenal over time, earning gameplay improvements and enhanced functionality. This is part of an overarching goal of deep Progression for gameplay content, but without needless or confusing complexity. The Overclock System puts even more agency and power into the hands of the player, allowing for more customization of your gameplay experience than ever before.[/p][p] [/p][p]Let’s look at a few examples:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Lethal Equipment: Cluster Grenade: [/b]Last seen in [i]Black Ops 4[/i], the Cluster Grenade is a Lethal that scatters a group of smaller explosives when the main projectile detonates. Overclock it and you’re awarded the following upgrades:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]First Overclock: Controllable Fuse:[/b] Adds the ability to cook the fuse over time.[/p][p][b]Second Overclock: Tighter Packing:[/b] Adds one additional mini grenade to the projectile.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Field Upgrade: Drone Pod: [/b]Launch a Drone Pod and it deploys to the skies, expelling autonomous aerial drones which seek out enemies. Overclock it and you’re awarded the following upgrades:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]First Overclock: Quick Launcher:[/b] This rapidly increases the speed at which drones are launched.[/p][p][b]Second Overclock: Radar Link:[/b] Leaves a minimap icon at each drone’s detonation point.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/56d1affa1dab2ee1ce3ef790ba0a77e1aab639f8.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Scorestreak: Rhino.[/b] Returning to the Rhino, a remotely controlled armored robotic soldier equipped with a deadly burst rifle Increase this Scorestreak’s potential still further with the following Overclocks:[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]First Overclock: Power Module:[/b] This extends the runtime for the Rhino, allowing for even more mayhem.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]             Second Overclock: Sonar Pulse:[/b] This reveals nearby enemy locations on the Rhino’s minimap and enhances both radar length and duration.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ef4e6d378fb0ab180d6e9d3715dc8f325bb6fe59.jpg"][/img] [/p][p][/p][p][b]Scorestreak: D.A.W.G.:[/b] Introducing the Deployable Armored Weaponized Groundcraft: a quadrupedal Scorestreak featuring a large caliber turret and rocket pod designed to neutralize infantry targets. Overclock it for further devastating possibilities:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]First Overclock: Large Battery: [/b]Enhances the active duration.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]            Second Overclock: Sentry Mode: [/b]Allows D.A.W.G. to hunker down, guarding an area and deploying a supply pack and integrated Trophy System.[/p][p]           [/p][h3]Perks and Hybrid Combat Specialties[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4efd8b0153548150f9d82db93c1f0d8a3363768d.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Experiment with your Perk builds like never before with the all-new Hybrid Combat Specialties. To activate a Hybrid bonus, you’re able to mix and match Perks from two different Combat Specialties (colors). Get ready to try out different combinations to find your favorites, whether you’re a stealthy slayer or an offensive support player.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Next-Level Omnimovement, Adjusting Tactical Sprint[/h3][p][/p][p]Outmaneuver your enemies with a next-level Omnimovement system to gain the upper hand in combat. Execute swift Wall Jumps to evade or out-style your pursuers while increasing your traversal capabilities, and mantle high ledges for tactical advances. And in Skirmish, drop into action with Combat Rolls from steep falls to reduce fall damage. These new features open creative possibilities in the game space and on the frontline, adding fresh dynamics to gameplay.[/p][p] [/p][p]Treyarch has also taken a close look at feedback and has made tuning adjustments across the board for a more controlled experience, including the removal of Tactical Sprint — a limited-duration boost of speed allowing faster movement than standard sprint — as a default movement option. Instead, expect this ability to be granted through an optional Perk in Multiplayer.[/p][p] [/p][h3]16 Signature Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p] [/p][p]From the futuristic Tokyo vistas to the frozen, unforgiving wilds of Alaska, every environment is brimming with danger and opportunity, and many are deeply connected to the narrative. You’ll fight through covert guild facilities in Japan, revisit David Mason’s childhood cabin, infiltrate a remote tundra installation where weapons of war are being secretly 3D printed, and even clash across a high-tech solar array in the Australian Outback.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6ffb7da66a7a9a407d97ec311dd987a87785c240.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]This is a diverse slate of new maps at launch, with 13 all-new 6v6 maps, along with three legendary returning maps from [i]Black Ops 2[/i], including the infamous Raid, now reimagined as a once-tranquil Tokyo setting in near-future Japan.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c6793ee4c3b6219255479bbd262c5f143b3c956f.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]From the start of development, player feedback has been infused into every angle of the game and building maps that reflect this in meaningful ways has been a key part of the process. Pushing the boundaries of design and combat flow, the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Multiplayer maps are designed to breathe more, with enough space for players to fully explore the expanded Omnimovement system while still delivering the tight, cover-to-combat combat that defines [i]Black Ops[/i]. Each map layout emphasizes clear lane definition, controlled sightlines, and tactical opportunities for creative flanking and positioning.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8ff472fdda15b7e9d6c58b62ea7dcc211c730e61.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Whether your preference is to run-and-gun, tactically defend, or you thrive on movement and momentum, the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Multiplayer maps are arenas built for you to learn, adapt to, and dominate. Maps are built with intention, designed to surprise you, and shaped by decades of collective design experience. The team is also committed to meticulously crafting a wide variety of unique and entertaining post-launch maps, often leaning into the themes of the Campaign.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Skirmish: Large-scale Combat, Redefined[/h3][p] [/p][p]In addition to the 16 6v6 Multiplayer Maps, [i]Black Ops 7[/i] launches with new large-scale maps paired with an all-new mode to the series called Skirmish: a 20v20 objective-focused experience where two teams clash across expansive environments.[/p][p] [/p][p]What sets Skirmish apart compared to a 6v6 mode isn’t just its size, but the addition of the Wingsuit to Multiplayer. This gliding gear allows you to soar across terrain with fast, controlled aerial movement, and completely shifts how you approach combat and objectives. With the extra verticality and mobility, squads have the option to capture a zone, then launch across the map to contest the next — creating fast, fluid, and sometimes unpredictable momentum from objective to objective, where no two matches feel the same. Expect more information, including the vehicles you’re set to control, and the introduction of the legendary grappling hook to the mode, in the coming weeks.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Round-Based Zombies Returns![/h2][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]BLACK OPS 7 ZOMBIES: CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Round-Based Zombies returns[/b] with all-new vehicle gameplay that takes players across a massive set of new locations.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]When Crews Collide: [/b]Continuing the Dark Aether story, the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] crew collides with alternate versions of the original heroes: Richtofen, Nikolai, Takeo, and Dempsey. In a never-before-seen incarnation, these legends return to face a new kind of nightmare... though in the Dark Aether, nothing is ever what it seems.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]A Fight for Survival: [/b]Survival maps return for the first time since [i]Black Ops 2[/i], focused entirely on outlasting the undead. [/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Dead Ops Arcade 4[/b] blasts into [i]Black Ops 7 [/i]with a wild new mode, deadly weapons, and new arenas in over-the-top chaos. Whether you’re solo or with the squad, DOA 4 is absolute mayhem.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a57581839018068d1b42e1bc1212603b672494a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]In Treyarch’s legendary Round-Based Zombies mode, the nightmare begins where reality ends. Following the shocking revelations at the conclusion of [i]Black Ops 6[/i], the crew now appears to be trapped in the Dark Aether. This imprisonment in a Bermuda Triangle-like hellscape — where the fog never lifts, the shadows breathe, and the dead don’t rest — has given Treyarch’s Zombies developers freedom to explore across time and space. [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Zombies ventures into bold and uncharted territory, where the team’s creativity can absolutely run wild.[/p][p] [/p][p]This isn’t just survival. It’s a descent into madness.[/p][p] [/p][h3]When Crews Collide: Familiar Faces from the Darkness[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e3ef29bfbdcaa6dbe91fac79d51a8b804d912fcc.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]With Weaver, Maya, Carver and Grey damned to exist in this new nightmarish purgatory, their world is rocked still further: Mind-bending realities collide as they come face-to-face with an alternate incarnation of the original Zombies crew. From the darkness, familiar faces appear once more: Edward Richtofen, Takeo Masaki, Nikolai Belinski, and Tank Dempsey, with no idea who the others are, or how they got here.[/p][p] [/p][p]While new alliances may (or may not) be formed, these legends return alongside the crew from [i]Black Ops 6[/i] to face a new kind of nightmare... though in the Dark Aether, nothing is ever what it seems.[/p][p] [/p][p]First of all though, there’s a terrifying new world to explore.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Trapped in the Dark Aether[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bc2164bd898bba92c0dcdbeb5b2ace23bc406599.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Explore a vast and foreboding landscape and visit a series of eerie and forgotten locations offering a multitude of threats, secrets, and storylines with horrors around almost every corner. Face down the undead hordes, unearth secrets, and dig in the shadows of a forgotten world for discoveries sometimes best left undisturbed.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cdeaa46c2c690f745aab30ab6d3f71b41904f1a0.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]As you travel through this haunted hellscape, the roads between locations can be dangerous and unforgiving. Fortunately, there’s a fifth member of the crew to rely on for all your transportation needs. Players with previous experience using transportation in their travels should be pleased to learn [i]Black Ops 7[/i]’s launch map will allow access to a well-weathered, fully drivable Wonder Vehicle to forge a path into the unknown.[/p][p] [/p][h3]The Return of Survival, Core Movement Updates, Dead Ops Arcade 4![/h3][p][/p][p][b]Survival Maps: [/b]Survival Maps are coming back for the first time since [i]Black Ops 2[/i], delivering a focused, unfiltered round-based Zombies experience at individual locations throughout the launch map. There are no quests, other than you and your squad surviving against the relentless undead for as long as you can.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Core movement changes[/b] also make an appearance in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Zombies — with Omnimovement innovations and combat roll present — as well as a disappearance as Tactical Sprint has also been removed from Zombies by default.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Dead Ops Arcade 4[/b] is confirmed! This top-down, twin-stick Zombies shooter provides plenty of frantic, arcade-style action along with XP progression. Packed with power-ups, traps, and relentless waves of enemies, this is pure over-the-top co-op chaos for up to four players. Expect more details soon![/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Full Zombies Reveal Only Weeks Away![/p][p] [/p][p][i]Black Ops 7[/i] Zombies is shaping up to be one hell of a ride, and you won’t have to wait long to uncover more intel: The official [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Zombies reveal is only weeks away![/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2]Global Systems and Progression[/h2][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]BLACK OPS 7 GAMEPLAY SYSTEMS: CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Connected Progression: [/b]The most player-rewarding experience ever in [i]Black Ops[/i], featuring connected player and weapon progression across Campaign, Multiplayer, and Zombies — rewarding players no matter what mode you choose to play.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Weapon Build Sharing: [/b]Share your created Weapon Builds directly with friends or import a Weapon Build found online into your Loadouts via its Weapon Build Code.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Weapon Prestige Returns: [/b]For the first time since [i]Black Ops 4[/i], players who reach Max Level with a Weapon will be able to enter Weapon Prestige. Each Weapon will feature two Weapon Prestiges, along with a build-changing Prestige Attachment, unique Weapon Camos, and additional rewards. This is the deepest Weapon Prestige system yet.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Camos, Camos, and more Camos:[/b] [i]Black Ops 7[/i] features more ways to unlock Weapon Camos than ever before, with 16 Mastery Camos to unlock across Multiplayer, Zombies, and Co-Op Campaign at launch, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] at the start of Season 1.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Cerebral-Link (C-Link) Online:[/b] A unified User Interface and HUD display across all of [i]Black Ops 7[/i]’s Campaign and Multiplayer systems, bridging the gap with cohesion between visuals, audio, equipment screens and gear. Plus, our commitment to accessibility for all players continues.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]A Technology Toolbox:[/b] The latest in current-generation graphical effects have allowed Treyarch’s tech teams to furnish players with some incredible new rendering features and effects.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Connected Progression, including Co-Op Campaign[/h3][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/60cd1567992db1568db997306e3f67522c599766.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]As revealed earlier in the blog, for the first time ever in a [i]Call of Duty[/i] game, [i]Black Ops 7[/i] will feature a connected Campaign. This means all the great XP and progression challenge systems you’re familiar with from Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] — including Prestige, Weapon Progression, Camo Challenges, Calling Card Challenges, Daily Challenges, and more will be available to progress and unlock in the Co-Op Campaign.[/p][p] [/p][p]To reiterate: Your Campaign experience is connected to the global progression system across the entire game, including a Weapon Camo journey unique to the mode. Every Elimination, every objective, every breakthrough in the Co-Op Campaign fuels your growth, contributing directly to Global XP, Weapon Progression, Challenge systems, and Battle Pass. These are the progression challenge systems you’re familiar with from Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].[/p][p] [/p][p]And that’s just the beginning.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Weapon Build Codes and Sharing[/h3][p] [/p][p]Another brand-new innovation to [i]Call of Duty[/i] is coming to your Gunsmith, in the form of Weapon Build Sharing. You can send a build of your favorite weapon loadout directly to a friend, so they don’t have to recreate it themselves.
