Treyarch is also adding a Weapon Build Code to the Gunsmith, so whenever you see a shared screenshot of another player’s Gunsmith Build you can enter that Build Code in your game to import a copy of their Weapon directly into your Loadout.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Classic Prestige Updates, Weapon Prestige Evolved[/h3][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/917ffc31ff91bd12afba93fc82185f2869fbb38e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]There will be a Classic Prestige journey in [i]Black Ops 7[/i], and Treyarch will share more about the improvements and updates to this system later in the year, along with a peek at the Operator Skins, Blueprints, and additional rewards available via the system. However, there’s a second stage of Prestige planned as the evolution in progression continues: Weapon Prestige.[/p][p] [/p][p]Working alongside Classic Prestige, Weapon Prestige brings deep progression, mastery, and rewards to the Weapon Progression journey as follows:[/p][p] [/p][p]·         You level up your chosen weapon as normal, unlocking attachments as you progress.[/p][p]·         If you decide to enter Weapon Prestige, you unlock a unique Camo you can equip to any Weapon while relocking all but the Weapon’s available Optic Attachments as you begin a fresh leveling journey on that weapon over again.[/p][p]·         Entering Weapon Prestige also unlocks a unique, build-changing Prestige Attachment that is different with every Weapon and can only be unlocked by entering Weapon Prestige.[/p][p]·         Reaching Max Weapon Level again will give players the choice to continue the journey by entering Weapon Prestige 2, which unlocks another unique Camo and a Weapon-specific Weapon Charm.[/p][p]·         Complete two Weapon Prestiges and you’ll automatically graduate into Weapon Prestige Master with 250 levels to climb through and a chase-worthy unique Camo at the end of the journey.[/p][p] [/p][p]Weapon Prestige opens up the opportunity for deep engagement, mastery, and rewards with your favorite weapons as you return to them throughout your time with [i]Black Ops 7[/i].[/p][p] [/p][p]And speaking of Camos:[/p][p] [/p][h3]Incoming Camo Journey, Weekly Challenges, and More[/h3][p] [/p][p]Treyarch’s weapons team is hard at work raising the bar on innovations to Weapon Camo visuals and design, and what the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Mastery Camos will look like. Not only will there now be four Camo tracks across [i]Black Ops 7[/i]’s modes — Co-Op Campaign, Multiplayer, Zombies, along with [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] at Season 1 — there are more ways than ever to earn Camos.[/p][p] [/p][p]Looking ahead to the post-launch seasons of content, we’re excited to confirm that Treyarch is bringing Weekly Challenges to [i]Black Ops 7[/i], with unlockable Attachments, Weapons, and Scorestreaks to earn during the live seasons, as well as Challenges for all modes, and two completion Weapon Camos to chase during every season.[/p][p] [/p][p]Expect a thorough overview of all aspects of [i]Black Ops 7[/i]’s Global and Progression Systems later this year.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Cerebral Link Online: User Interface Experience[/h3][p] [/p][p]With a game set in 2035, Treyarch took inspiration from the latest advancements in AR technology to imagine a truly networked battle interface that provides [i]Black Ops 7[/i]’s Operators with the information they need to stay lethal in the field. The result is the Cerebral-Link, or C-Link.[/p][p] [/p][p]This distributed network of high-impact visuals links an Operator’s gear: Whether it’s a message, the mini-map, or an ammo widget, there’s a consistent look and feel, as Treyarch seeks a cohesive and immersive experience for all players set in a near-future world.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Continued Commitment to Accessibility Options[/h3][p] [/p][p]Accessibility for all players has been a priority for the series, and with [i]Black Ops 7[/i], expect current innovations to continue alongside even more accessibility-focused features on the way.[/p][p] [/p][p]One of these is research into motion sickness mitigation. The team has prototyped several visual aids to assist those who find it difficult to play first-person action games for an extended period.[/p][p] [/p][p]Expect more details about this and other new features in the coming months, as well as more information on the different HUD choices you can make.[/p][p] [/p][h3]The Black Ops 7 Technology Toolbox[/h3][p] [/p][p]A toolbox of impressive technological elements is set to enhance [i]Black Ops 7[/i] in new and innovative ways. The latest in current-generation graphical effects have allowed Treyarch’s tech teams to furnish players with some incredible new rendering features and dynamic game effects. Here’s just a few of them:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Next-level GPU particles and vector fields:[/b] GPU particles leverage the power of your graphics card to render thousands of tiny effects — like sparks, embers, or debris — guided by vector fields that shape their motion into realistic swirls, trails, or explosions. Pair that with volumetric fluid simulations, and you get reactive smoke, fire, or fog that shifts and curls around your Operator as you move through it. Vector fields control how the particles move.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Volumetric fluid simulations:[/b] This brings smoke, fire, and fog to life by rendering them as fully 3D, physics-driven volumes that react to light and motion in real time. Picture creeping through a low valley as dense fog curls around your Operator’s boots, parting as you move and closing in behind you. Volumetric fields simulate the fluid itself.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Dynamic surface deformation[/b] lets a surface react in real time to pressure, impact, or movement — think snow compacting underfoot as you move through the tundra on a frozen Multiplayer map.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Improved local volumetrics:[/b] Local volumetrics focus high-fidelity fog, smoke, or light effects in specific areas, bringing cinematic atmosphere without dragging down performance. Think a smoke grenade in a tight hallway, where the fog rolls out, catches the light, and clings to the walls as you move through.[/p][h2] [/h2][h2]Additional Comms: Carry Forward, Call of Duty: NEXT, Beta Dates, and More![/h2][p][/p][h3]Black Ops 6 and Black Ops 7 Carry Forward Intel[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d04bee5206d3bb272012fdd0e7ba3ef94d7dc01.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3]What is Carry Forward?[/h3][p]Carry Forward is a system that allows select content like weapons, Operators, and cosmetic items from a previous [i]Call of Duty[/i] title to transfer into the next, when supported. It is designed to preserve your loadouts and personalization across connected experiences.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Carry Forward Confirmed[/h3][p] [/p][p][i]Black Ops 7[/i] will feature the ability to utilize a wide variety of content from [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i]. This mostly begins a few weeks after launch at the start of Season 1. Prior to more in-depth comms on this subject, here’s what to expect:[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Black Ops[/i] [i]6[/i]: XP Tokens and GobbleGums will carry forward at the launch of [i]Black Ops 7[/i].[/p][p][i]Black Ops 6[/i] Weapons, Operators, and Operator Skins will carry forward at the start of Season 1 with some exceptions:[/p][p] [/p][p]·        Equipment and Scorestreak Skins for content unavailable in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] will not carry forward.[/p][p]·        Equipment and Scorestreak Skins for content updated for [i]Black Ops 7[/i] (for example, a Scorestreak that performs similarly, but has a different look and feel in BO7 compared to BO6) will not carry forward.[/p][p]·        [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Weapon Camos will not be transferable to [i]Black Ops 7[/i] weapons, but still usable on [i]Black Ops 6[/i] weapons.[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Call of Duty®: Warzone[/i] integration will also begin at Season 1. All current content, including Operators, Weapons, and Weapon[u] [/u]Blueprints from [i]Modern Warfare® II[/i], [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], and [i]Black Ops 6[/i] will carry forward with some caveats and exceptions:[/p][p] [/p][p]·        Weapons will continue to be tuned for [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].[/p][p]·        [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] players should expect a Rank Reset at Season 1, with your progression synchronized to [i]Black Ops 7[/i]’s Progression Systems.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Call of Duty: Next, Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Bowl VI, and Open Beta Dates Confirmed![/h3][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/519242d4d281989ec38e0b1725c72a01b905ca08.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p]Mark your calendars for the worldwide Multiplayer reveal at Call of Duty: NEXT on Tuesday, September 30th. We’ll have live Multiplayer and Zombies gameplay with your favorite creators from around the world. After Call of Duty: NEXT concludes, you’ll be able to play [i]Black Ops 7[/i] yourself when the Beta starts on all platforms on October 2nd![/p][p] [/p][h2]Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Bowl VI presented by USAA[/h2][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/73b550029d31686788457ee0cad9201f9ccf69d9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Directly following Call of Duty: NEXT on the Official Call of Duty Twitch® Channel or Call of Duty YouTube® Channel, tune into the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Bowl VI, presented by USAA. The sixth annual C.O.D.E. Bowl presented by USAA will feature 10 esports teams from military branches of the U.S., U.K., and Canada, competing alongside the most competitive players in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. This year’s event has epic viewer rewards courtesy of USAA, and for the first-time ever, you can score [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Beta codes while you watch the event. And keep an eye out for who will take home the third annual Monster Energy MVP and second-ever Corsair Solo Yolo![/h2][p] [/p][p]Follow the Call of Duty Endowment on [url="https://www.instagram.com/callofdutyendowment/?hl=en"]Instagram[/url] and [url="https://x.com/CODE4Vets"]X[/url] for C.O.D.E. Bowl VI updates.[/p][p] [/p][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p]Black Ops 7 Beta Dates Confirmed[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c56340047a6940c223e25d087a8fdab99c9a605e.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Beta — divided into the Early Access and Open Beta periods — runs from October 2 to October 8. [/p][p] [/p][p]The [b]Early Access Beta [/b]launches at [b]10AM PT on Thursday, October 2[/b] for those who pre-purchase the game, and runs for a period of 72 hours. [/p][p] [/p][p]The [b]Open Beta [/b]launches at [b]10AM PT[u] [/u]on Sunday, October 5[/b] for all players on all platforms, and [b]runs consecutively[/b] after the Early Access period, for another 72 hours. The [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Beta is scheduled to conclude at 10AM PT on Wednesday, October 8. [/p][p] [/p][p]Early Access Beta* [/p][p] [/p][p]Available to players who have pre-ordered the game on any platform, the initial part of the Beta is planned to launch on Thursday October 2 at 10AM PT, and concludes 72 hours later when the main Open Beta begins on Sunday October 5 at 10AM PT. The Beta is available on all platforms at the same time. [/p][p] [/p][p]Open Beta* [/p][p] [/p][p]The second part of the Beta is open and free for all players on all platforms, and is planned to begin on Sunday October 5 at 10AM PT. The [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Beta is scheduled to conclude 72 hours later, on Wednesday October 8 at 10AM PT. [/p][p] [/p][p]Internet access is required for participation.  [/p][p] [/p][p]Accessing the Beta and Beta Codes [/p][p] [/p][p]Your path to access to the Beta Early Access period depends on the version of the game you pre-purchased: [/p][p] [/p][p]If you [b]pre-purchased any Digital Edition version[/b], you do not need a “Beta Code”, as you’ll be automatically allowed entry into Beta Early Access (and subsequently, the Open Beta). [/p][p] [/p][p]If you [b]pre-purchased a Physical Edition[/b] (consoles only), you should have received a “Beta Code” at the point of sale (at select retailer locations), enabling entry into the Beta Early Access.  [/p][p] [/p][p]If you don’t pre-purchase [i]Black Ops 7[/i], you can still access the Open Beta period. [/p][h2][/h2][h2]Pre-purchase Black Ops 7 Now! Additional Intel to Come![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4cc899cf033e13fdb0bfe0e3080e73d5825644ba.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to stay danger close with the latest official [i]Black Ops 7[/i] information by checking the Call of Duty Blog as further communications are scheduled, including a massive intel drop on Round-Based Zombies in the weeks leading up to Call of Duty: NEXT, the [i]Black Ops 7[/i] Open Beta, and the countdown to launch.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]Pre-purchase is available now.[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h2]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 Development Credits[/h2][p] [/p][p][i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i] is published by Activision. Development is led by Treyarch, in partnership with Raven Software.[/p][p] [/p][p]Additional development by — in alphabetical order — Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, Digital Legends, High Moon Studios, Infinity Ward, and Sledgehammer Games.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Embrace the Madness.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][i]©/TM/® 2025 Activision Publishing, Inc.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Game features described above are based on current in-development features that are subject to change based on final development changes and/or game tuning or updates that may remove or modify some or all of the above features. [/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i](* Actual launch date(s) and platform availability of MP Beta subject to change. See [/i][/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com/beta"]www.callofduty.com/beta[/url][/p][p][i] for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only. Internet connection required.)[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][i]For more information, please visit [/i][/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com"]www.callofduty.com[/url][/p][p][i] and [/i][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/callofduty"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][i], and follow [url="https://twitter.com/activision"]@Activision[/url] and [url="https://twitter.com/CallofDuty"]@CallofDuty[/url] on X, Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow [url="https://twitter.com/CODUpdates"]@CODUpdates[/url] on X.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p] [/p]

notes.title: RICOCHET Anti-Cheat™ Update – Season 05
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/64b1d78ed2758330516836426927223ed2480332.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Protecting the Call of Duty experience is #TeamRICOCHET’s highest priority. Cheating and hacking are challenges affecting all major games, and we’re fully engaged in the industry-wide fight against unfair play. Our goal is clear: to be best-in-class in anti-cheat innovation and effectiveness. It's an ongoing battle, but we’re in it for the long haul – and we’re not backing down.[/p][p]Thank you to every player who continues to speak up and stand against cheating. We know how deeply cheating disrupts the integrity of the game. Even when the feedback is tough, we’re listening.[/p][p]As part of our continued mission, we’re introducing new systems and security updates alongside Season 05 in Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Warzone that lay the groundwork for our future. These updates are targeted to strengthen our anti-cheat systems and keep your matches fun.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p]Season 05 Spotlight:[/p][p]·         [b]TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot:[/b] Strengthening game security with built-in Windows PC features[/p][p]·         [b]Securing Your Account:[/b] Protect against account hijacking with email verification and 2FA features[/p][p]·         [b]Game Pass Free Trial on PC:[/b] Updated policy to support fair competition in Ranked Play[/p][p]·         [b]Detections Targeting Boosting and Teaming:[/b] Removing boosters and teamers from the game and leaderboards with a focus on Ranked Play integrity[/p][p]·         [b]Advancing Cheat Prevention:[/b] Targeting 22 additional individuals with legal action; nearly 40 cheat vendors shutdown since launch[/p][p]·         [b]Community Questions: [/b]Additional details around two new security features, TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot[/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]Call of Duty Activates TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot[/b][/u][/p][p]With Season 05, Call of Duty will begin a phased rollout of two PC-based security features: TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot.[/p][p] [/p][p]TPM 2.0 (Trusted Platform Module) is an industry-standard, hardware-based security feature built onto CPUs or motherboards that verifies the PC’s boot process has not been tampered with. Secure Boot makes sure a PC can only load trusted software when Windows starts.[/p][p]Together, these features help #TeamRICOCHET ensure that players are starting the game from a secure, cheat-free foundation.[/p][p]RICOCHET Anti-Cheat will focus on activating both features in the background with the upcoming season launch. We won’t be enforcing against or requiring the use of either setting during Season 05, but these features will be foundational for even stronger protections in the future.[/p][p] [/p][p]When Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 releases later this year, TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot will be required to play on PC. These hardware-level protections are a key part of our anti-cheat efforts, and we’re asking all players to get compliant now.[/p][p] [/p][p]This upcoming update will let us test our implementation of both features and gives you time to enable these settings. If your system isn’t ready, you’ll start seeing in-game notifications beginning this season.[/p][p] [/p][p]We’ve published a Player Support article to walk you through setup. This is your chance to stay ahead. Stronger PC security means a fairer game for everyone.[/p][p] [/p][p][url="https://support.activision.com/tpm"][b]Get Ready for Black Ops 7: Activate TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot Today[/b][/url][/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]Why TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot Matter:[/b][/u][/p][p]You’re here to play. Fairly. Competitively. RICOCHET Anti-Cheat is here to keep matches clean. TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot give us a better, more trustworthy arena to operate in.[/p][p] [/p][p]What these features do:[/p][p]·         [i]Validate your PC is launching in a trusted state[/i][/p][p]·         [i]Give us the ability to verify that trusted state in a secure way[/i][/p][p]·         [i]Allow us to confirm required security features are enabled [/i] [/p][p]·         [i]Certify only trusted software can load during Windows boot up[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]When you play multiplayer, your PC connects to our servers to enable online play. If TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot are on, Windows runs a security check at startup. The results of that check are passed to us when you connect, confirming your system hasn’t been tampered with.[/p][p]The final check happens on our servers, making it harder to spoof and ensuring the process is secure from start to finish. We know privacy is important to everyone, and we want to be clear: this process doesn’t give us access to your personal files or information. It only verifies that your system booted cleanly.[/p][p]As for performance, TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot will not impact in-game quality. These features perform checks during system and game startup but remain inactive while you play.[/p][p]We’re rolling this out carefully and monitoring everything closely. We want to strengthen security and protect the experience, without impacting performance.[/p][p]#TeamRICOCHET will share more details on additional protection measures we’ll be putting in place for Call of Duty as we get closer to the Black Ops 7 launch.[/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]PC Security Features of Secure Boot and TPM 2.0:[/b][/u][/p][p][b]Secure Boot: [/b]One of the cornerstones of PC cheating is unsigned or modified code loading during system startup. Secure Boot blocks that method. Windows will only start if it sees trusted software and drivers.[/p][p]·         [i]What this means for you: Makes cheating at a hardware level much more difficult, ensuring cleaner PCs at start and allowing for more trusted environments for RICOCHET Anti-Cheat to operate in.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]There are several elements at play with TPM 2.0, but here are details on a few that will help in our ongoing effort to deliver fair and fun gameplay:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Platform Configuration Registers (PCRs):[/b] Special slots in the TPM that record key details about your system’s startup, helping to detect if anything has been altered. If any security setting is turned off or changed, the system will notice the difference from the original startup record and flag the computer as untrusted.[/p][p]·         [i]What this means for you: Makes it more difficult for cheats that rely on bypassing operating system security to be activated.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Sealing and Binding:[/b] These functions lock specific data – like login credentials and encryption keys – to your device and its current system state. If the system changes, the data becomes inaccessible.[/p][p]·         [i]What this means to you: Makes it more difficult for cheaters to use evasion tactics, like spoofing.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Remote Attestation:[/b] In Call of Duty, your PC (client) needs to communicate with us (server) to play online. TPM 2.0 can prove, or attest, to our servers that your system is in a known and trusted state.[/p][p]·         [i]What this means to you: Faster, more reliable evaluations and more clarity for fair enforcement.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][u][b]Secure Your Account with Email Verification and 2FA[/b][/u][/p][p]Account security is essential. The Account Link Verification system we launched during Season 03 has already protected tens of thousands of accounts from potential hijacking.[/p][p] [/p][p]Doing your part to optimize your own account security starts with ensuring your Activision account is linked to an email address you have access to. We will ask you to verify your email when playing Call of Duty on a new platform or whenever you perform sensitive account modifications.[/p][p] [/p][p][url="https://support.activision.com/articles/activision-account-email-verification"]Learn more about email verification on your Activision account[/url][/p][p] [/p][p]Keeping your email up to date also helps you recover your account and prove your identity whenever you need support.[/p][p] [/p][p]Players should also enable two-factor authentication (2FA) on their Activision accounts to further protect their game. Two-Factor Authentication may become a requirement for all users in the future, so now is the best time to update your account and turn 2FA on.[/p][p] [/p][p][url="https://support.activision.com/articles/using-two-factor-authentication-with-an-activision-account"]Learn how to activate Two-Factor Authentication[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]Game Pass Free Trial on PC Policy Update[/b][/u][/p][p]When Season 05 launches, Game Pass Free Trial accounts on PC will still have access to the Campaign, Multiplayer, and Zombies modes in Black Ops 6. But to ensure a fair competitive environment and gameplay experience, Game Pass Free Trial accounts on PC will not be able to participate in Multiplayer Ranked Play. Access will be limited to players with an active Game Pass subscription, or Black Ops 6 owners. This change helps us maintain integrity in our most competitive mode.[/p][p][b] [/b] [/p][p][u][b]Detections Targeting Boosting and Teaming[/b][/u][/p][p]To protect the integrity of Ranked Play, we launched new, dedicated detection tools for Boosting and Teaming. We’re also conducting deeper analyses of the leaderboards across Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Warzone. All users that have climbed the leaderboard through illegitimate means have been removed, and this new process will continue to monitor and remove users that use Boosting and Teaming as a tactic.[/p][p] [/p][p]Boosting services often flood lobbies with low-effort accounts used to illegitimately farm XP and complete challenges. These accounts are later sold as Ranked Play-ready, directly feeding the cheating marketplace. Additionally, methods like continuously idling to farm XP without playing the game – and using tactics to bypass idle detections – can create a negative experience for entire lobbies, especially for players that are matched on the same team as the account that is Boosting.  [/p][p] [/p][p]As outlined in the Activision [url="https://www.activision.com/legal/terms-of-use"]Terms of Use[/url], [i]any form of Boosting[/i] is against policy. Boosting and Teaming are cheating. Language in the Security and Enforcement [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/call-of-duty-security-and-enforcement-policy"]Policy[/url] will undergo adjustments to better reflect the details listed in the Activision Terms of Use.[/p][p] [/p][p]Recently, we permanently banned accounts where Boosting made up the majority of their recent in-game activity. These were not random, one-off cases but extreme and repeated patterns of abuse.[/p][p] [/p][p]We focus our enforcement on deliberate cheating behavior and Boosting is no exception. It undermines fair competition, and like all cheating, it won’t be ignored.[/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]Disrupting Cheating Networks[/b][/u][/p][p]RICOCHET Anti-Cheat escalated its campaign against the cheat marketplace by targeting 22 additional individuals responsible for developing and selling cheats. Each received a formal cease and desist demand letter, while we simultaneously dismantled their advertised services to cut off both cheat makers / resellers and customers in a coordinated strike.[/p][p] [/p][p]The majority of those targeted have already sent us notices that they will comply, with several vendors announcing the closure of their illicit services. Those who remain non-compliant or resurface under new aliases will face further action. This dual-pronged approach, hitting both supply and demand, sends an unmistakable message: we’re not only disrupting the market; we’re working to dismantle it.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thanks to legal and technical efforts, we have now directly contributed to the closure of nearly 40 cheat developers and resellers since Black Ops 6 launched.[/p][p] [/p][p]The industry’s battle against cheaters and hackers requires constant innovation. RICOCHET Anti-Cheat is a live, evolving system that’s built to stay ahead of new threats and respond to in-game behavior in real-time.[/p][p] [/p][p]There is no magic bullet to stop cheating; it is a challenge the entire industry is facing. #TeamRICOCHET continues to fight, and we remain committed to delivering the fair and fun experience you deserve.[/p][p] [/p][p][u][b]COMMUNITY QUESTIONS[/b][/u][/p][p] [/p][p][b]When Black Ops 7 is released, will Call of Duty: Warzone adopt the TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot requirements?[/b][/p][p][i]We’re currently focused on implementation and testing for Season 05 as we prepare for the launch of Black Ops 7 later this year. As security protocols evolve, we’ll continue to evaluate requirements like TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot in other experiences. Players will be informed of any changes ahead of time to deliver a smooth experience.[/i][/p][p][b]Does TPM 2.0 or Secure Boot give Call of Duty access to data like my login credentials or private files?[/b][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]This process does not access your personal files or information, only Windows diagnostic data.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot are security features built into Windows. They run before the operating system loads, checking that your system hasn’t been tampered with. When you launch Call of Duty, Windows tells us whether your system passed those checks.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]If your system fails, you won’t be able to play until Windows confirms everything is secure. This is strictly about system integrity and protecting the game environment from cheats or tampering.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Is TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot support replacing existing systems like the RICOCHET Anti-Cheat kernel-level driver on PC?[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][i]These systems are complementary, not redundant.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]While all are protection measures, they serve different purposes. TPM 2.0 is hardware-based security that’s embedded on a PC’s CPU or motherboard and enforced by Windows. TPM 2.0 enhances system trust at Windows boot up, but it is not a real-time monitoring or enforcement anti-cheat system. Secure Boot certifies only validated software launches when Windows boots up.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Our kernel-level driver monitors systems during gameplay and blocks tampering attempts. This operates alongside the game and allows for real-time enforcement of cheaters.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]As a reminder, the RICOCHET Anti-Cheat kernel-level driver does not operate unless Call of Duty is running.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][b]Will TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot end cheating?[/b][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot help combat cheating, but do not stop it in all its forms. They can verify a machine’s integrity against the many cheats that are injected into Windows as it loads – a tactic hackers use to hide cheats on a machine.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot do, however, raise the barrier of entry for many forms of cheating. Alongside the systems developed by RICOCHET Anti-Cheat, TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot will make it more difficult to cheat in our games.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Why is now the right time for Call of Duty to implement TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot?[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][i]We believe TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot are key components to delivering a high-integrity experience at scale for Call of Duty players on PC.  We’re committed to providing a fun, fair and secure environment to our community.  This will allow for maximum impact and minimal disruption to PC players.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Follow @CODUpdates on X for real-time updates, information from upcoming Progress Reports, and more.[/p][p] [/p][p][i]© 2025 Activision Publishing, Inc. ACTIVISION, CALL OF DUTY, BLACK OPS, CALL OF DUTY WARZONE, and RICOCHET ANTI-CHEAT are trademarks of Activision Publishing, Inc. All other trademarks and trade names are the property of their respective owner.  [/i]   [/p][p][i]For more information on Activision games, follow @Activision on X, Facebook, and Instagram.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 05 Battle Pass, BlackCell, and Bundles
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fd8f90eae548966302a2cb5ecc22d100bc4036f3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Unleash the Arsenal with the Season 05 Battle Pass![/h2][p][/p][p]With Rogue Black Ops reactivated inside the CIA, legendary tactician Lawrence Sims returns from the [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]Campaign, bringing his field-tested expertise to the hunt for the final moles and taking point on this season’s Battle Pass and BlackCell content. Expect an action-packed offering, along with Store content arriving in Season 05 of [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], launching Thursday, August 7.[/p][p] [/p][p]The Season 05 Battle Pass delivers over 100 rewards, including new free base weapons, new Operators and Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Calling Cards, Finishing Moves, and more.[/p][p] [/p][p]Unlock free content like base weapons and some cosmetic items, or upgrade to the premium Battle Pass to earn up to 1,100 COD Points as you progress through the Battle Pass Pages. For the full seasonal experience, pick up BlackCell to access exclusive animated Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, and additional high-tier rewards.[/p][p][/p][h2]BlackCell Season 05: Solace Operator[/h2][p][i]BlackCell Instant Rewards Page, HVT[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c261c7d140ed46a71ad723d5ea55a3d5d389d94e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Seek Solace as part of Season 05’s seminal BlackCell offering! Clad in refined, golden armor with ethereal wisps and a glowing halo resplendent with shards of light, Solace remains the calm in an increasingly chaotic storm, alongside a host of other unlockable BlackCell content including additional Operator Skins and Weapon Blueprints sporting animated celestial ribboning.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Additional BlackCell Instant Rewards Content[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Get the full Battle Pass experience with BlackCell, unlocking access to every reward available in the Season 05 Battle Pass. Your purchase also grants immediate access to the BlackCell Instant Rewards page, delivering the following items right away:[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/89096c997813c98a7f17f3af1fa169e298429a97.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]20 Battle Pass Tier Skips[/p][/*][*][p]1,100 COD Points[/p][/*][*][p]The “Solace” BlackCell Operator[/p][/*][*][p]The “Herald” Mastercraft Blueprint for the Krig C Assault Rifle with Golden Aura Tracers and Golden Spirit Death FX[/p][/*][*][p]The “Griffin Nabbed” Companion Finishing Move[/p][/*][*][p]The “Iris Rise” Animated Weapon Charm[/p][/*][*][p]The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and Winner’s Circles)[/p][/*][*][p]BlackCell Daily Challenge (see below)[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]BlackCell owners can also earn even more rewards throughout the Season 05 Battle Pass, unlocking bonus content across multiple pages, including:[/p][list][*][p]Up to seven BlackCell-exclusive Operator skins for Sims (two skins), Stone, Toro, Maya, Niran, and Carver.[/p][/*][*][p]Up to seven additional BlackCell-exclusive Weapon Blueprints; for the Krig C (Assault Rifle), KSV (SMG), AMES 85 (Assault Rifle), AMR Mod 4 (Sniper Rifle), ASG-89 (Shotgun), PML 5.56 (LMG), DM-10 (Marksman Rifle), and ABR A1 (Assault Rifle).[/p][/*][*][p]Over 130 item rewards (Battle Pass and BlackCell related) for those who fully complete the Season 05 BlackCell Battle Pass.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/55a565432a69493289cd4e6231734512e2300154.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]BlackCell Loyalty Bonus: [/b]Players who purchased BlackCell in a previous [i]Black Ops 6[/i] season and go on to purchase Season 05 BlackCell will earn a permanent 10% Player and Weapon XP Loyalty Bonus, up to 40% for players who purchased Seasons 01, 02, 03, and 04 BlackCell. This continues to a 50% bonus for purchasing BlackCell in every Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 season![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Extra Daily Challenges: [/b]BlackCell players gain access to an additional Daily Challenge in Multiplayer, Zombies, and Call of Duty: Warzone throughout Season 05. Stack your XP as well as your wins![/p][p] [/p][h2]Purchase the Battle Pass: Instantly Unlock Sims Operator[/h2][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d778f995678289ea61b424928ae55f283713b283.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Players who purchase the premium Season 05 Battle Pass or BlackCell will immediately gain full access to the Battle Pass Instant Rewards Page, which includes the following items:[/p][p] [/p][p]·         The new “Sims” Operator clad in his “Stogie” Skin, and “Stogie BlackCell” Sims Operator Skin for BlackCell owners.[/p][list][*][p]10% Battle Pass XP Boost.[/p][/*][/list][p]·         The “Free Fire” Emote.[/p][p]·         The “Venom Eye” Weapon Charm.[/p][p]·         The “Infernous” Legendary Weapon Blueprint for the Kilo 141 AR.[/p][p] [/p][h3]New Operator: Sims (Rogue Black Ops)[/h3][p][i]Battle Pass Instant Reward Page, HVT[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6cdfe2e5013636d53f4666aafec1e8ddef89667d.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]A decorated CIA operative with Army roots and tech expertise, Lawrence Sims was instrumental in Vietnam-era covert ops and the pursuit of Perseus before returning to the military and rejoining his old team to hunt down the final Pantheon moles.[/p][h3] [/h3][h2]Additional Battle Pass Operator Skins[/h2][p] [/p][p]Progress through the Battle Pass to unlock additional content including a variety of Operator Skins, many paired with BlackCell variants with golden body armor and attire, and animated celestial ornamentation floating through their bodies.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Stone “5h4dow” Skins[/h3][p][i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 2[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/10da3ba63cae82fc46f6ead0089a196dccf8b9ee.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Remaining on the run from Rogue agents, a digital smash-and-grab is your MO when donning this tactical leather cloak with faction iconography, cosmetic sledgehammer, and fully sealed combat helm. The BlackCell variant ditches the cloak for a pair of “golden guns” (Stone’s ripped and reflective arms), a carapace tactical vest, and more rounded helmet and goggles.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Toro: “TKO” Skins[/h3][p][i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 4[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c1738e40d448cd88859d742e45ab2ae934deff7c.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Toro is ready to test his opponent’s glass jaw as he steps into the ring clad in some ostentatious neck jewelry, sunglasses, a bare torso bearing bad-ass tattoos, and long combat pants with a flame motif. The BlackCell variant offers a black and gold semi-transparent torso with animated elements, and full gold and black attire.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Westpoint: “Paramedic” Skin[/h3][p][i]Operator Skin, Battle Pass Page 6[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d15bfe089b2df056410cfc9fc6a327f49864254.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Apply some pressure to the wound by unlocking this medical practitioner for Tamira “Westpoint” Chambers. Hair tied in a ponytail, Westpoint has emerged from impromptu surgery on the enemy, rocking a tool belt and a stained blue medical overshirt with reflective patches.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Maya: “Asphalt” Skins[/h3][p][i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 7[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/910f82a1d52c41389d86324e925f3a042a9d0255.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Clad in agent attire with comms earpiece, hair in a bun belt with ammo holster, black leather jacket and ammo clip in her boots, Maya comes ready to uncover the truth. Her BlackCell variant encases her in golden filigree, an air-tight helm, and cosmic breastplate.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Niran: “Detective” Skins[/h3][p][i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 9[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c6c07ea062b45ed2e94334d235ca8518b96dcb85.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Niran comes ready to get to the bottom of the case donning round-rimmed sunglasses, open shirt with impressive collars, baggy pinstripe pants and a detective badge on the belt. His BlackCell variant slicks back the hair, adds filigree-embossed gold pauldrons, a bio-mechanical torso and arms, ornate belt and pantaloons, but keeping that wide-collared skirt open.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Payne: “Hotshot” Skin[/h3][p][i]Operator Skin, Battle Pass, Page 10[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ff82183304cb5c8c5b689f61985f169fb6033c60.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Payne goes undercover and spices up the work force with his trucker hat and shades, blue denim overshirt, and sleeveless quilted vest with padded ribbing that offers both practical warmth and a tactically obtuse silhouette.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Carver: “The Monk” Skins[/h3][p][i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 12[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2665e62e5da8b79f6ffcda174133d6d004cd7817.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Carver comes down from the mountaintop, focusing his blind rage on those that seek to desecrate his kingdom. Featuring ornate teal pauldrons and a gauntlet strapped to his blocking arm, Carver is mainly covered in robes with sash, with opaque vision. His BlackCell variant features a shaved head and impressively solid gold-plated arms.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Rossi “Hardtop” Skin[/h3][p][i]Operator Skin, Battle Pass, Page 13[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5116924ee91280d73e2befb285170ab7a5f29133.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Rossi gets full coverage with full tactical Patrol gear designed for both air and ground infiltrations, copious straps and pockets to hold a variety of devices, and a sleek helmet allowing for easy command of the streets.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Alvarez: “Wilder” Skin[/h3][p][i]Operator Skin, Battle Pass, Page 14[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e6c624050adffdd64c32e71929d70aa66ee226c7.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Alvarez deploys to search through ancient structures and dense jungle with black-platted hair, a fur mantle draped across both shoulders featuring hide skulls of forest critters, along with a tactical vest and camo pants.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Season 05: Battle Pass Base Weapons and Attachment[/h2][p] [/p][p]Get to grips with  two new Base Weapons within the Season 05 Battle Pass, a seminal AR and a devastating LMG. All players can unlock these weapons for free by progressing through their listed Battle Pass Pages. Then turn your smallest pistol into a headshot machine with the 9mm PM Skull Splitter Attachment.[/p][p] [/p][p]PML 5.56 (Light Machine Gun)[/p][p][i]Battle Pass, HVT, Page 3[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7563b03673e18198c8e51e2c64ccb13cb02ef7ea.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Levels: [/b]39[/p][p][b]MAGS: [/b]3[/p][p][b]MAG SIZE: [/b]100[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: [/b]Yes[/p][p][b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Full auto light machine gun. Fast rate of fire and high lethality offset by low mobility and hefty recoil.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]When a rival Operator is holding the trigger down on the PML 5.56, you’ll know, mainly due to the damage and huge ammunition reserves, mitigated somewhat by a lengthy reload. You’d be wise to use the incoming fire from the PML 5.56 as a sure sign to get down and stay down — and usually for longer than normal — unless you’re the one doing the firing.[/p][p] [/p][p]With a damage output that’s among the highest compared to all available full-auto weapons, it’s the PML 5.56’s prodigious rate of fire, spitting out rounds with rapid severity, that really proves its worth. With a heavy body and disadvantageous recoil (strong upward recoil with a slight drift to the right), you’ll need to utilize attachments or your Operator’s strength to focus the firing.[/p][p] [/p][p]ABR A1 Assault Rifle[/p][p][i]Battle Pass, HVT, Page 6[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f3c9541328e8d51e34693f65bb58098b5f0a5e4e.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Levels: [/b]43[/p][p][b]MAGS: [/b]3[/p][p][b]MAG SIZE: [/b]30[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: [/b]Yes[/p][p][b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options: [/b]Skins, Camos and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][i]Three-round burst assault rifle.  Good handling and power. Moderate recoil and range. Configurable to full auto.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]The iconic Assault Rifle returns! With a similar weapon being a fan-favorite staple of the Black Ops series, the ABR A1 combines a high damage output with a fire rate that can drop enemies in tight three-round bursts with a brief pause in-between, almost fast enough to be called automatic. If an even faster firing output is called for, unlock one of the Fire Mods that converts the weapon to Full Auto.[/p][p] [/p][p]This is a highly versatile weapon capable of winning skirmishes, though not at the furthest of ranges. Its recoil requires some getting used to, but the upward kick can be easily managed, and the handling is more than acceptable. The integrated sight is already available with the base weapon along with the right attachments that can help mitigate any weaknesses in these areas.[/p][p] [/p][p]9mm PM Skull Splitter Barrel[/p][p][i]Premium Battle Pass, Page 7[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/46dea8b910677670c793b9a74c3afb6cf6859efe.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Bring the power and precision of a marksman rifle to your favorite pistol with the 9mm PM Skull Splitter Barrel. The Barrel greatly increases damage, especially to the head, at the expense of reducing the rate of fire. Pair with an extended magazine that gives the Operator additional ammo for this weapon at the expense of handling.[/p][h3] [/h3][h2]New Unlockable Weapon Blueprints[/h2][p] [/p][p]The Season 05 Battle Pass and BlackCell feature over 20 earnable Weapon Blueprints. Here’s a robust selection of those contained in the Battle Pass, shown in the order they appear throughout the Battle Pass Pages. Those marked with an “*” indicate they have a BlackCell variant, shown later in this blog.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Battle Pass Blueprints[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1e4d08505e58bf97824474ccce5e10af3dd7cdac.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p](Above) “Infernous” Kilo 141 Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Instant Reward[/p][p]“Spyway” TR2 Marksman Rifle, Page 1[/p][p]“Tripwire” KSV Submachine Gun, HVT, Page 1*[/p][p]“Lethal Array” LW3A1 Frostline Sniper Rifle, Page 2[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e5b6801b85983bee2e59f173726a44110e97690f.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p](Above) “Lost Signal” HE-1 Launcher, Page 3[/p][p]“1v1” Jackal PDW Submachine Gun, Page 4[/p][p]“Hard Left” XMG Light Machine Gun, Page 5[/p][p]“Octane” AMES 85 Assault Rifle, HVT Page 5*[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ff9984252e586c8becaaf27c85f13b076596277d.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p](Above) “Lead Poisoning” Baseball Bat Melee, Page 6[/p][p]“Structure Elegance” Sirin 9mm Special, Page 7[/p][p]“Executive Action” Maelstrom Shotgun, Page 8[/p][p]“Skewer Key” Power Drill Melee, Page 8[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/271066536199b3bd2350ac3ec91278b1dfe854a6.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p](Above) “Vainglory” AMR Mod 4 Sniper Rifle, HVT, Page 8*[/p][p]“Wiretap” PU-21 Light Machine Gun, Page 9[/p][p]“Backup” Grekhova Pistol, Page 9[/p][p]“Six Feet Under” ASG-89 Shotgun, HVT, Page 10*[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2503e7c02f8349cc4c5c9d3c2186c9879cb41a9d.png"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p](Above) “Heat Death” AEK-973 Marksman Rifle, Page 11[/p][p]“Overclock” PML 5.56 Light Machine Gun, HVT, Page 11*[/p][p]“Raging Serpent” Stryder .22 Pistol, Page 12[/p][p]“Cloud Breaker” GPR 91 Assault Rifle, Page 12[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c52f0faccf34b07751dada55e90b390dd49edbec.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p](Above) “Compact Frisk” D1.3 Sector Special, Page 13[/p][p]“Long Arm” DM-10 Marksman Rifle, HVT, Page 13*[/p][p]“Wyrmscale” PP-919 Submachine Gun, Page 14[/p][p]“Dragon King” ABR A1 Assault Rifle, HVT, Page 14*[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]BlackCell Blueprints[/h3][p] [/p][p]Next, let’s look at the seven Weapon Blueprints paired with animated BlackCell variants, some featuring animated gold ethereal ribbons, as well as Golden Aura Tracers and Golden Spirit Death FX.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img Page 4[/p][p]“Tango Secured” Reticle (Optic Attachment), Page 8[/p][p]“XXXRETICLE_S5SENSEI” Reticle (Optic Attachment), Page 12[/p][p] [/p][h2]New Finishing Moves, Emotes, and Sprays[/h2][p] [/p][p]Aside from the “Griffin Nabbed” Finishing Move featuring BlackCell Operator Solace’s vicious mythical beast, there’s a host of Operator-ending maneuvers, Emotes, and Sprays you can equip, across the Battle Pass:[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f64fa219e864fb5a9d32938c1104e3bfae5844e2.png"][/img][/p][p]CAPTION: A selection of Emotes and Finishing Moves (listed below) available across the Battle Pass.[/p][p] [/p][p]“Free Fire” Emote, Battle Pass Instant Reward[/p][p]“High Stakes” Finishing Move, Page 1[/p][p]“Rack Check” Emote, Page 2 (shown above)[/p][p]“Doing Donuts” Emote, Page 5 (shown above)[/p][p]“Quick Tumble” Finishing Move, Page 7 (shown above)[/p][p]“Ridiculous Recoil” Emote, Page 9[/p][p]“Melee Masher” Finishing Move, Page 10[/p][p]“Ground Superiority” Emote, Battle Pass Completion Page (shown above)[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7db26bae4ad947ffb689f2b8257181385a6c7631.png"][/img][/p][p]CAPTION: Examples of Sprays you can equip and daub on any wall you like, available across the Battle Pass[/p][p] [/p][p]“Cracked Diamond” Spray, Page 1[/p][p]“Ticking Bomb” Spray, Page 3[/p][p]“Flame Out” Spray, Page 5[/p][p]“Job Done” Spray, Page 7[/p][p]“Look Close” Spray, Page 9[/p][p]“Devil Rock” Spray, Page 10[/p][p]“Shield” Spray, Page 13[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2]Additional Battle Pass Content[/h2][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2e57c333c9952738edee5825c400f4f933635cd8.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The Season 05 Battle Pass offers dozens more items of content, including items from the following categories:[/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]COD Points[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Charms[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Large Decals[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon Stickers[/p][/*][*][p]GobbleGums[/p][/*][*][p]Emblems (some animated)[/p][/*][*][p]Calling Cards (some animated)[/p][/*][*][p]Loading Screens[/p][/*][*][p]Clan Tag (BlackCell only)[/p][/*][*][p]Consumable 2XP & 2WXP Tokens[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Battle Pass Completion Page: Rewards[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5569f2961b558da5dd3b20e944aaae1e7edba163.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Reach the Completion Page on the Season 05 Battle Pass and prepare to gather up the following rewards, unlocked once the final Page is finished:[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]200 COD Points[/p][/*][*][p]“Envenomate” Ultra Skin, and “Envenomate BlackCell” Skin for Sims[/p][/*][*][p]“Ground Superiority” Emote[/p][/*][*][p]“Forward Thinking” Emblem[/p][/*][*][p]“Power Body” Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]“Hidden Power” GobbleGums (x2)[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2]Sims: “Envenomate” and “ Envenomate BlackCell” Skins[/h2][p][i]Operator Skins, Premium Battle Pass and BlackCell, Completion Page[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/258d91a57c5708ca7e8331dd4c4edecf8bbf894f.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Stepping out of the jungle and ready to strike with precision, Lawrence Sims arrives tatted up and down his right side, with an exposed torso, jungle camo, and a thick gray viper wrapped around him. The BlackCell variant increases the sinewy embedded gold across both arms and side torso, adds face markings, and comes with an iridescent King Cobra.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Store Highlights: New Reactive and Mastercraft Bundles[/h2][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Tracer Pack: The Replacer Commander Battleman[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6d2f1b3f849bd609fb9c0f3f2cac4bd41306462e.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Two warriors. One Replacer. Crawl out of the jungle in an olive-green combat jacket with strong bandana accessorizing with the “Strike Force” Operator Skin and crush the puny primitive enemies with the “Replacement Warrior” Skin. With 11 total items, replace vital organs with bullets courtesy of the “Pinpoint” AS VAL AR Blueprint and “Maximum Doom” Ladra SMG Blueprint, each with Burning Tracers and Violent Explosion Death FX. Then slash through the tall brush with the “Underbrush” Cleaver Blueprint, also with Violent Explosion Death FX.[/p][p] [/p][p]Take your fight to the front line with the hand-to-hand beatdown of the “Elbow Room” Finishing Move, fire up your opponents with the “Relaxing Burn” Emote, as well as the “Replaceable Dynamite” Weapon Charm, “Muscles Free” animated Calling Card, “Replacement Time” Loading Screen, and “Warrior’s Poise” animated Emblem.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Tracer Pack: I Know What You Did Last Summer [/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/64f789feb92704b63d081e042f1ced6b8e4dfb6b.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Hunt down the perpetrators that dare to stay silent with The Fisherman Operator Skin, with ten separate bundle items. Don the slicker and rain terror on your enemies with the new “The Fisherman” Operator , reel in the eliminations with the “Dreaded Harpoon” XM4 AR Blueprint, catch yourself a live one with the “Curved Culler” C9 SMG Blueprint, both with Bloody Hook Tracers and Fish Chum Death FX.[/p][p] [/p][p]Make them remember their crimes with the “Lethal Hook” Melee Weapon Blueprint (with Fish Chum Death FX). Plus, stay salty with the “Inevitable Demise” Emote, “Got a Live One” Finishing Move, “Get Hooked” Calling Card, “Good Cleaning” Emblem, “I Know What You Did” Loading Screen, and “You’re Next” Spray.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Tracer Pack: IDEAD 2 Mastercraft Ultra Skin[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/76117b30f7297dba17e6a64fef19928611ba1faa.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Master the elements to do your bidding and attempt interdimensional exploration as Carver dons the “Elementalist” Ultra Skin with three weapon options: Disintegrate any barrier that stands in your way with the “Bio-Scrambler” Mastercraft Blueprint for the new ABR A1 Assault Rifle. Existence is futile in the face of “The Unmaker” Blueprint for the LC10 Submachine Gun, both with Green Runic Tracers and Mystery Box Death FX. Remember to feed the hungry earth using the broken down remains of your targets with the “Reclamator” Mastercraft Blueprint for the Wunderwaffe DG-2 Wonder Weapon, too![/p][p] [/p][p]Diagnose interdimensional anomalies with the “Excruciate” Finishing Move, the “Suck or Punch” Weapon Charm, the “Mystic Crafter” Calling Card, “Wyvern’s Gift” Large Decal, “Forbidden Knowledge” Loading Screen, before popping a “Perkaholic” Ultra GobbleGum.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Tracer Pack: Behemoth Ultra Skin[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0a296ff018a32e437f9587bebe5c8617c292d37c.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Crown yourself the new ruler of the wastelands with the “Armored Wreck” future-dustbowl attire for Bayan. Eliminate rival gangs with the “Thundermaul” Cypher 091 Assault Rifle Blueprint, adeptly thin the mobs with the “Swift Blockade” C9 Submachine Gun Blueprint and bulldoze your way into a rival compound with the “Obstructor” ASG-89 Shotgun Blueprint. All three Blueprints come with Teal Spike Tracers and Spike Growth Death FX.[/p][p] [/p][p]Be the battering ram and smash barricades with the “World Crumbles” Emote, not to mention the “Bulwark” Weapon Charm, “Burning Shield” Emblem, “Scalding” Loading Screen, and “Everything Ends” Spray.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Tracer Pack: Dogs of War[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/831044ee46747088947439305af3977bf824d293.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Dare to win and set an example for others to follow with Tracer Pack: Dogs of War, with skins for both British Operators of the Rogue Black Ops Faction. Payne gets tactical in the “SAS Directive” skin, alongside Park’s “Leftenant” dark combat fatigues and beret uniform. Stand at the frontlines and protect with the “Noble Shield” Blueprint for the PPSH-41 Submachine Gun and earn the accolades with the “Airborne Defender” Blueprint for the AEK-973 Marksman Rifle, both weapons come with Red Tracers and Severance Death FX.[/p][p] [/p][p]Strike back and lay on the pressure with the “Sword Insight” Reticle, the “Back-to-Back” Calling Card, “Honorable Duo” Loading Screen, and “Intimidating Service” Large Decal.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Tracer Pack: Scream Park Mastercraft[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3fd94afc44d795f6a4f001886babc3adb7cf9a09.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Ensure safety and show the newbies the ropes when operating the theme park with the “Thrill Guide” Operator Skin for Woods. Then craft the most wicked, diabolical, blood pumping thrill ride ever seen with the “Adrenaline Rush” Mastercraft Blueprint for the Kilo 141 Assault Rifle and let the undead have their fun with the “Ghoulish Frenzy” Blueprint for the SWAT 5.56 Marksman Rifle. Both weapons feature Acid Yellow Tracers and Coaster Cart Crush Death FX.[/p][p] [/p][p]Throw your hands up and scream as you inflict mayhem on your foes, courtesy of the “Deadly Ride” Finishing Move, along with the “Expedition Ghoul” Weapon Charm, “Ride to Die For” Loading Screen, “Undeadly Photo” Large Decal, “Keep Heads Down” Calling Card, and “Dead Totem” Spray.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Tracer Pack: Skybreaker Mastercraft Ultra Skin[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b31d656c4c5ecaddc115b56036ee873052bdc848.png"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Take to the skies under the watchful gaze of the gods, slaying the mighty beast and seeking praise for your prowess with the “Bellerophon” Ultra Skin for Woods. Behead a serpent and forge its remains into a fist of might with the “Drakone Bane” Mastercraft Blueprint for the new Boxing Gloves Melee complete with Spearhead Death FX. Empower yourself with confidence with the “Hero’s Hubris” Blueprint for the KSV Submachine Gun, and rain down an inferno with the “Wingfire” Blueprint for the Maelstrom Shotgun. Both weapons come with Blue Arrow Tracers and Spearhead Death FX.[/p][p] [/p][p]Prove your mettle with the “Mount Up” Emote, “Guard Break” Sticky Grenade Skin (Lethal), “Flexing Power” Calling Card, “Warrior’s Reign” Loading Screen, “Serrated Skull” Weapon Sticker, and “Hubris” Spray.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Tracer Pack: Grease Monkey Reactive Ultra Skin[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5b054c636da7078e291632e3ab1acfe7d1424bff.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Throw a wrench into the gears with this motor-savvy, anime-inspired bundle. Motor oil and grease are just makeup for Sev’s “Gear Jockey” Ultra Skin. Fix the impossible with the “Workshop Flow” Reactive Blueprint for the LC10 Submachine Gun, and tool up for a fight with the “Toolkit” Blueprint for the FFAR 1 Assault Rifle. Both Blueprints come with Cel-Shaded Tools Tracers and Tools Explosion Death FX.[/p][p] [/p][p]Gear up for battle and drop enemies with tough love courtesy of the “Kawaii Knockout” Finishing Move, “Engineering Love” Emote, “Steeplejack” Calling Card, “Fixer” Emblem, “Meow-ky Wrench” Large Decal, and “Pretty Fix” Loading Screen.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Tracer Pack: Bacterium[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8cc25e262ea5377238af89d13dd5f8cc0469363a.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]If you’re feeling queasy, there’s a perfect cure for feeling ill. Live and breathe in all the toxins you like with Grey’s “Quarantine Officer” skin. Flood the infirmaries with the “Sickening” Blueprint for the Ladra Submachine Gun and spread a little pestilence with the “Contaminate” Blueprint for the Maelstrom Shotgun, both arriving with Lime Green Tracers. Treat the undead as lab rats with the “Affliction” Blueprint for the DRI-11 Beamsmasher Wonder Weapon.[/p][p] [/p][p]Follow doctor’s orders and seek to equip the “Viral” Reticle, the “Poison Trail” Calling Card, “Diseased” Weapon Sticker, “Source” Spray, and hospitalize yourself with a broken haw, courtesy of the “On The House” GobbleGum.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Upgrade to Black Ops 6 Today![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/29404c4ecfabb3c9614508b51e497a03bbf527d0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Black Ops 6 is available now: Dive into a gripping spy-thriller Campaign, dominate across deeply tactical Multiplayer, and survive the undead in a round-based Zombies experience built for gore and glory. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]The Truth Lies.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]©/TM/® 2025 Activision Publishing, Inc.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]For more information, please visit [/i][/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com"]www.callofduty.com[/url][/p][p][i] and [/i][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/callofduty"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][i], and follow [url="https://twitter.com/activision"]@Activision[/url] and [url="https://twitter.com/CallofDuty"]@CallofDuty[/url] on X, Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow [url="https://twitter.com/CODUpdates"]@CODUpdates[/url] on X.[/i][/p][p][u][b] [/b][/u][/p][p] [/p][p][u][i]I Know What You Did Last Summer TM & © 2025 Columbia Pictures Industries, Inc. notes.title: Call of Duty: Season 05: Heroes Hold the Line
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/75fb1c3c8a48e8f09068a264674671af720c0868.jpg"][/img][/p][h2][u]Unleash the Arsenal: Black Ops 6 Season 05 is Here![/u][/h2][p] [/p][h3]Season 05 Overview: Ignite the Action[/h3][p] [/p][p]The Rogue Black Ops team is finally back in the good graces of the CIA, and that means access to all the weapons and firepower they could ask for. It’s time to finish the job they started and crush the final Pantheon moles, putting their betrayal to rest once and for all.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/684d28c36439be386824631e5d0fe7c44187351d.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Season 05 brings heart-pounding Multiplayer Maps, new and returning action-packed modes, and the thrilling conclusion of the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Zombies storyline as the crew infiltrates Janus Towers to confront S.A.M.’s quest for ultimate power. Then look to the skies in Verdansk as an ominous, destructive force is set to bring the heat, ripping open a major point of interest while Operators seek to discover high-tech secrets hiding within. Time to make an impact.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ycs4D-Menoo;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [/p][p]It’s high-octane action all the way through Season 05 when this massive offering of free and premium content comes to [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i]. Season 05 launches on August 7 at 9AM PST.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Content Timing Note:[/b] Throughout the blog, you’ll see references to when gameplay content launches. Here are what they mean:[/p][p][b]“Launch”:[/b] Expect to access this content immediately at the launch of Season 05.[/p][p][b]“Launch Window”:[/b] Expect to access this content between launch and up to 72 hours after launch.[/p][p][b]“In Season”:[/b] Expect to access this content during the season, usually before the mid-season update.[/p][p][b]“Mid-Season”:[/b] Expect to access this content at Mid-Season (also known as “Season 05: Reloaded”) or later.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: Season 05[/u][/h2][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8414a41c0f9509f6db29b4b51935c4b0a215aa51.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Four Maps:[/b] Corner the final Pantheon moles across three added maps at launch, including Runway, Exchange, and World Motor Dynasty (W.M.D.). For the mid-season update, bet big on Jackpot.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New and Returning Modes:[/b] It’s headshots or bust in the new Aim High mode alongside the return of Snipers Only and Cranked Moshpit throughout the first half of the season. In the mid-season, get explosive in the Cranked Demolition LTE and wield top-of-the-line weapons in Blueprint Gunfight.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Scorestreak:[/b] Blast the competition with explosive-tipped arrows using the Combat Bow Scorestreak arriving in the mid-season.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Season 05 Ranked Play: [/b]Stack your skills up against the best in a new season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, offering new Rank Camo seasonal rewards as you climb the Ranks.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ba57750f343ce0aedbca73733279840d1dce3d34.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Runway (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3d09f8708e58cd315167637915756586f3188225.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]A Pantheon mole attempts their escape via the Arzak Provincial Airport. All hell breaks loose as the Rogue Black Ops team pursues one of their final targets. Wreckage and luggage litter the tarmac, flames licking the sides of the terminal and black smoke rising from the fire in the airport control tower.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c9db465038b0a6c66547397dd3177fae60f83610.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Traverse the destroyed aircraft, its fuselage blasted to bits, the Plane’s nose poking through the Food Court inside. The damage extends into shipping and receiving, a parked Tank threatening movement on the ground. In the center, battle erupts around the Baggage Claim. Watch out for enemies coming in through the moving conveyor belt.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Exchange (Launch)[/p][p][i]Brand-New, Strike, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f9d9a93be516e16149d4227bb0d1fbb644a43f92.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Rogue Black Ops pursues a mole attempting to strike a deal in a vibrant Avalon marketplace. Crash the party and unleash havoc on this small-sized three-lane map centered around the Deli, its roof adorned with a marble statue of a mythic sea god.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a26b249d4126cc276dd38fea56d7724858349f0d.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Get behind the counters of the Deli, Bar, and Fruit Stall for added defense when engaging enemies down the middle. To avoid the center, take the south path through the Seafood market and Butcher or step up to the northern Terrace. Both paths feature a shortcut to the middle at their halfway point, keeping the action moving fast throughout the match.[/p][p] [/p][p]World Motor Dynasty (W.M.D.) (Launch)[/p][p][i]Remaster, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1a719fc6f70993d4ae0cce078f37d45c50a4073a.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]From its inception as a Nova 6 processing laboratory first introduced in the original [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops[/i], W.M.D. returns in a reimagined form as an Italian luxury car manufacturer in Avalon. Trade the snow of the original map for an overcast day around the Autofiorno plant, using your memories of the prior map to help navigate the larger area of operations.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/68940e3102030269dd6074a462d5ce9e5c125823.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The grounds include the Paint Shop, Administration, Car Parts, Showroom, Design, and Assembly, with the wide outer Road circling around the buildings. Seek out upper vantage points to get above the action, including the infamous Silos where sharpshooters vie for their view over the east side of the map.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Jackpot (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Inspired by Black Ops 4, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f5482027fddd25d0631d47da3b83e4f358cefa3f.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Deploy to the Casino Luttazzi and slot yourself into a power position for a chance to win big. Using elements of the original “Casino” map from [i]Black Ops 4[/i], Beenox has extensively reworked the map with new layout sections and artistic direction, partially inspired by the “High Rollers” mission from the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Campaign.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/94ca72d895f10d48734eddf33ca759c6556f2a67.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The central Bar offers refreshments and cover plus a prime view of the Stage. Get some fresh air on the Gazebo with views over the water or bask in the shade of the Terrace. With opulence at every turn, this newly reopened Avalon Casino is sure to attract a huge amount of wealth. Bet on the win with all you’ve got when the map arrives at mid-season.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/302554f252c6c327a285fc7564aa4db82856c893.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Compete across a variety of new and returning modes, including the new Aim High game mode, Snipers Only, and Cranked Moshpit throughout the season’s first half, followed by Cranked Demolition, Ransack, and Blueprint Gunfight mid-season.[/p][p] [/p][p]Aim High (Launch)[/p][p][i]New Mode (Modifier)[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3933f0a641a7dc2320bcb41a06e7076c39f4b198.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Aim high to survive across a variety of game modes—including Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint, and Kill Confirmed— where headshots land instant eliminations while full body armor minimizes damage dealt anywhere below the neck. As a bonus, this headshot training is likely to hone your talents when unlocking Weapon Camos, as well as increasing the damage output against the undead when you jump over to Zombies. [/p][p] [/p][p]Snipers Only (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/abb3b60ab17f89dbb445bb9e8125ba2fdb3920c2.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Hardscope? Quickscope? Lucky shot? Take your pick in the Snipers Only playlist. Regardless of the game mode, all Operators spawn with a Sniper Rifle and only a Sniper Rifle. Equipment, Secondary Weapons, Field Upgrades, Scorestreaks, and your Dedicated Melee Weapon are restricted. You still get your pick of Perks, so choose wisely and hone your marksman skills to perfection.[/p][p] [/p][p]Cranked Moshpit (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7f66fb577004e0290094d16ca27146d5126bb2df.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p]Crank up the adrenaline in this Moshpit where eliminations give you speed Perks and activate a bomb countdown on your Operator. Chain eliminations to refresh the bomb timer and earn twice the score for your team. If you do get taken out, start the process again and keep slaying to maintain your momentum.[/p][p] [/p][p]Cranked Demolition (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]New Mode (LTM)[/i][/p][p]Make Demolition even more explosive with Cranked mechanics thrown into the mix! Alternate between attacking and defending two bomb sites while managing your Cranked timer and chaining eliminations to stay alive.[/p][p] [/p][p]Ransack (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p]Get rich quick or die trying as Ransack returns in the mid-season. Score points by looting gold bars from piles around the map and off fallen enemies. Fill your inventory and then deposit the gold in your team’s deposit box before the enemy can take you out and nab your riches.[/p][p] [/p][p]Blueprint Gunfight (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Returning Mode[/i][/p][p]Bring some style to your Gunfight matches in the mid-season Blueprint Gunfight playlist, giving players the chance to try out a variety of new Weapon Blueprints while gunning for victory.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Additional Gameplay Content[/h3][p] [/p][p]The Combat Bow makes an explosive appearance, a low-cost Scorestreak last seen in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War[/i], capable of inflicting rapid and accurate high damage projectile hits.[/p][p] [/p][p]New Scorestreak (MP, ZM, Mid-Season)[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Scorestreak: Combat Bow (Launch)[/b][/p][p][b]Type: [/b]Lethal[/p][p][b]Score: [/b]500[/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p] [/p][p]Step out of the jungle and become a lone action hero, firing single-shot, explosive-tipped arrows that explode on impact, dealing incendiary damage to all enemies caught in its trajectory and leaving a trail of fire in its wake.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Multiplayer Ranked Play + Rank Camos (Launch Window)[/h3][p] [/p][h3]Season 05 Ranked Play Overview[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e8d2d1fc7c21c8d4de12e27bb7d244c08b42ea50.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Prove you’ve got what it takes to fight with the best by dropping into Season 05 Multiplayer Ranked Play, using the same settings used by the Call of Duty League™.
