SUMMARY[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]The Reckoning Arrives:[/b] Avoid an Appalachian apocalypse as the assault on Janus Towers begins and the long-brewing conflict between Richtofen and S.A.M. reaches a turning point.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Flexing the Gorgofex: [/b]Pistol-sized and punching well above its weight, this bio-mechanical device melds mycelial and insectile properties into a Wonder Weapon that inflicts direct damage, as well as anti-gravity incapacitations.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Additional Gameplay Content: [/b]Battle rival squads in new Grief Arenas in Reckoning, then return mid-season for Directed Mode in a full objective-driven experience. Team Cranked also returns mid-season, linking squadmates to a shared timer that speeds up the chaos with every round![/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Bunny Beatdowns:[/b] The Mister Peeks Field Upgrade arrives to savage the hordes of undead in new and entertaining ways. Then bring incendiary ammunition to a zombie fight with the Combat Bow Support Weapon at mid-season.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2]New Round-Based Zombies Map: Reckoning (Launch)[/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1e8ebbc4630586348957fbf9e62b0edf1de741fb.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Looming over the once-sleepy settlement of Liberty Falls, the Project Janus Headquarters—three edifices known locally as Janus Towers— now teeters on the verge of collapse. Constructed between \[\[REDACTED]] and \[\[REDACTED]], this vast and vertical facility is separated into \[\[REDACTED]], with Aetherium slowly being released into \[\[REDACTED]], enormous reactors \[\[REDACTED]] limitless power, but at a price.[/p][p] [/p][p]The towers’ systems appear to be critically damaged, and total failure is imminent. Stabilizing the Aether Reactors seems to be the initial overriding goal, before even greater threats must be faced.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Prepare to confront cosmic chaos in the last chapter of the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Zombies narrative, launching at the start of Season 05 on August 7 at 9AM PST.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Day of Reckoning: Your Comms Team Handlers[/h3][p] [/p][p]Assuming no comms interference, expect Peck, Ravenov, and Strauss to provide valuable support, with Raptor One always skybound to exfil should the situation go even more sideways. But what of Dr. Pericles Panos, who sacrificed Alpha Team to return himself from the Dark Aether? And Security Chief John Blanchard, last seen pursuing Panos into the Towers? Then there’s both S.A.M. and Director Richtofen…[/p][p] [/p][h3]Reckoning: Initial Recon Tour[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c77ccf8a0f292bc0abd158c533584475d68f5ccb.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]From the moment you step into the now debris-strewn lobby, it soon becomes clear that the towers have seen better days. Laboratories, computing and research, offices, and more secretive chambers may be accessed by more novel means of transportation, \[\[REDACTED]] parachutes, \[\[REDACTED]] anti-gravity personnel launchers to \[\[REDACTED]] Aether vents \[\[REDACTED]] with low gravity \[\[REDACTED]] robot assembly \[\[REDACTED]] attunement accelerator \[\[REDACTED]][/p][p] [/p][p]\[\[FURTHER EXPLORATORY CONTENTS HAVE BEEN LOST VIA AN UNANTICIPATED DATA INTRUSION, AND ALL TOWER BLUEPRINT RECORDS EXPUNGED]][/p][p] [/p][h3]Automaton Alert: New Elite Enemy: Uber Klaus[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fffc9548ebe389bc471b39aafb1e23afaa212b43.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The secret Research and Development program of Project Janus appears to have been more evolved than originally thought, developing many more robots in the Klaus Assembly Lab than first anticipated. The greatest of these threats is the Uber Klaus – a murderous automaton encased in a toughened, bulky exoskeleton – that maintains a cocky attitude, lethal efficiency, and super strength, all directed at newly-programmed threats.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/985f1fb69ffed06ae08d1de4885e1108499ea0e8.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Enemy takedown tactics are unknown at this point, though combat is likely to be focused on disrupting the Uber Klaus form’s heavy shielding and avoiding its melee attacks. Once the exoskeleton is broken, the Uber Klaus Core will eject, revealing its second deadly form.[/p][p] [/p][p]The Uber Klaus Core increases in agility, sacrificing defenses for less lumbering locomotion and flying capabilities thanks to rocket-powered hover boots. It continues to employ energy-based, arm-mounted launchers (avoid at all costs), while its defensive, tesla-coil shield can prevent your incoming attacks.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Other Entities: Red Mist Descends, Robots Dispatched[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/58d53d6a6873c1cdd4d9cfbd2aafc44e69077493.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Emergency enforcement protocols may have already been triggered across all three towers, resulting in periodic robot battalions—known as Kommando Klaus— homing in on perceived intruders. Preceded by a strange red mist, these automated enemies have had their higher functions disconnected and self-destruct sequences activated and should be dispatched with swift and focused aggression.[/p][p] [/p][p]Mechanical threats are only one of the expected adversaries; reports of zombified Project Janus security and administrative personnel, the remains of scientists, hazmat crews, and even experimental mutations are confirmed to be active within the towers.[/p][p] [/p][h3]New Wonder Weapon: Gorgofex[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f1bb44590922985c8a84032a5c12060ccb8228f1.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Latest intel all but confirms Janus Towers may be hiding a new and grotesquely potent Wonder Weapon known as the Gorgofex. Partly charred experimentation notes discovered on microfiche indicate the existence of a “bio-aetheric” armament.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Combining fungal, floral, and insectile traits to deliver precise impact damage and gravity-defying disruption in close quarters, glowing membranes on the weapon show hints of motion and circulation under the surface. The weapon seems to pulse and breathe, with a beating central heart-like organ that “pumps” energy through the weapon. Due to the saturation of Dark Aether and other unknown energies, the weapon is said to emit faint psychic vibrations.[/p][p] [/p][p]But how does it work?[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7b87fab60b148714e945a9ed49fbc303fc75a040.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The Gorgofex fires what appears to be a slug of Aether-based energy.[/p][p]·         On impact, this inflicts a dense area of direct damage with a tight area of effect. The damage of the impact varies depending on whether the user charges the attack before release.[/p][p]·         Shortly after impact, energy from a fully charged blast dissipates outward, inflicting damage in a wide area.[/p][p]·         The dissipation seems to cause a focused temporary gravitational anomaly, catching and incapacitating enemies to float at just above head height.[/p][p]·         More research is required, but it appears two additional variations have been uncovered...[/p][p] [/p][h2]Reckoning: Additional Content[/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9af5d08bc54a73f57a231ee662d5237ce6c00f74.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Main Quest and Quest Rewards:[/b] The assault on Janus Towers and the Reckoning Main Quest go live at the start of Season 05 on Thursday, August 7 at 9AM PST. Ensure you complete the Main Quest to obtain the “Blood, Sweat, an’ Gears” Operator Skin for Grey (shown above), an intriguing Weapon Charm, multiple Calling Cards, and sizable XP rewards. Players who complete the Main Quest prior to the mid-season Directed Mode will earn a unique Calling Card variant.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9f664970717b185868d6b51dbb429442ae13a2df.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]Unstable Gravity: [/b]Due to experiments conducted in the \[\[REDACTED]], this chamber may experience fluctuating gravity, with projectile weaponry and movement affected during these intermittent gravitic anomalies.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Rapid Transportation: Teleporters: [/b]Using failsafe experimentation with Aetheric energy, Project Janus scientists have developed a means of instantly transporting organic and inorganic material between points with almost no fatalities reported. These devices work in attuned pairs, one acting as a transmitter and the other a receiver.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Rapid Transportation: Anti-Gravity Personnel Launchers: [/b]A novel and likely completely safe means of transport. Used in pairs, the launchers create a focused tunnel of gravity allowing the user the illusion of flight, and the ability to “jump” from one location (such as a tower balcony or overlook) to another.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/de3288edb56109439c2768c6c05cc7c7ca386582.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][b]C.A.S.T.E.R. Turret: [/b]The Cognitive (and) Adaptive System (for) Target Elimination (and) Reinforcement Turret with armament and control panel components is a joint venture between the Project Janus Cognitive Science and Security Technology divisions. This wall-mounted automated cannon unleashes devastatingly powerful barrages of aetheric energy in quick bursts to neutralize threats. Update the turret with \[\[REDACTED]] nano-energy technology and \[\[REDACTED]].[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Lore and Intel:[/b] Now in the epicenter of what could be a cataclysmic Dark Aether event, there’s no time like the present to gather lore related to Reckoning in the form of Audio Logs, Documents, and Artifacts discovered throughout the map.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Additional Gameplay Content[/h2][p] [/p][p]Returning Modes and access to LTMs across the final Zombies map become available as Season 05 progresses. Also be sure to equip the new Mister Peeks Field Upgrade in your pre-game Loadout for use in Reckoning as well as Shattered Veil, The Tomb, Citadelle des Morts, Terminus, and Liberty Falls.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Grief Mode: Reckoning (In-Season)[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/192717177aaa3bac18711132b1ab52056c065936.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Outlast the undead... and your rivals as new Grief Arenas arrive in Reckoning. It’s the 4v4 Zombies combat you know: two teams face the same zombified threat, but only one walks away.[/p][p] [/p][h3] [/h3][h3]Reckoning: Directed Mode (Mid-Season)[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6389e5a0aec799bd1b2ca9c9f8ea06d585b0f711.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Let the in-game objectives guide you as Directed Mode arrives mid-season for Reckoning. As before, this version features guided progression with visible objectives to help you stay focused on the Main Quest with a unique Calling Card variant to earn! An official walkthrough of Reckoning Directed Mode – — made by the same crew as [url="https://www.callofduty.com/guides/zombies/call-of-duty-guides-black-ops-6-zombies-gobblegums"]our exhaustive GobbleGum Guide[/url]— will be available at mid-season to help you dig deeper into the culmination of the story and complete every objective, whether you're exploring solo or as a squad.[/p][h3] [/h3][h3]Returning LTM: Team Cranked (Mid-Season)[/h3][p] [/p][p]The fan-favorite Team Cranked mode returns in Season 05 with refreshed rewards! Your entire squad is tied to a single shared timer, and the moment any player takes down a zombie, the team enters the Cranked state, boosting abilities and starting a 30-second countdown that only zombie eliminations can refill. Survive a round, and that max time drops by one second, pushing the pace faster with every wave. Wall weapons? Gone. The Mystery Box is your sole supplier, but boosted Essence earnings while Cranked mean you’ll have plenty of chances to swap Essence for random gear.[/p][p] [/p][p]Every player is loaded out with the Time Stopper Field Upgrade, capable of pausing the team timer in a pinch, and there’s a rare Time Extended Power-Up that increases the timer. Main Quests and Easter Eggs are active, offering deeper objectives alongside the relentless timer countdown.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]New Support Scorestreak: Combat Bow (MP, ZM, Mid-Season)[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Step away from the workbench and become a lone survivor, firing single-shot, explosive-tipped arrows that erupt on contact, scorching rotting flesh and igniting a blaze that immolates any stragglers too slow to shamble clear of its fiery trail.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2]Additional Field Upgrade: Mister Peeks (In-Season)[/h2][p][i]Available: Event Reward[/i][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/163e8a04261588aaab39f4a64fb811a5b5951bda.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Summon Mister Peeks to our reality to create chaos, as the deadly and distracting bunny busts out the moves and bashes undead brains to a raving disco beat.[/p][p] [/p][p]Once Mister Peeks arrives in your hands, throw this hairy helper into the fray, and he gleefully attracts normal and Special enemies and attacks any undead within his wandering radius, savaging foes until they explode in a shower of bright confetti.[/p][p] [/p][p]Mister Peeks: Major Augments[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/332f298c02767e683610a8d7e026206282406140.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Research the following Augments to further customize this Field Upgrade.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Dance Party[/b][/p][p]Mister Peeks becomes the life of the party, attracting nearby zombies to him, before he detonates an Aether Pulse to thin out the crowd considerably.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Arcane Fury[/b][/p][p]Mister Peeks has become a master of the elements, enhancing his regular damage with a random Ammo Mod (with an Augment from that Ammo Mod).[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Apex Hunter[/b][/p][p]Mister Peeks focuses all attacks on the strongest nearby enemy other than bosses. For example, Uber Klaus would be targeted over regular foes, with increased damage inflicted.[/p][p] [/p][p]Mister Peeks: Minor Augments[/p][p][b]Social Butterfly[/b][/p][p]Increase Mister Peeks’ attraction radius.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Peeks’ Favor[/b][/p][p]Mister Peeks is good to have around Mystery Box locations. Get a free box spin if you’re near one during activation![/p][p] [/p][p][b]Party Animal[/b][/p][p]Increase Mister Peeks dance duration.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Zombies Leaderboard Events[/h3][h3] [/h3][p]Reckoning (In-Season)[/p][p][/p][p]Compete for top placement in the Reckoning Leaderboard Event! Play a Zombies match to enter the Leaderboard and rack up Eliminations to earn Leaderboard Points, helping you to climb to a higher position. Special, Elite, and Boss enemies earn more Points so seek out the toughest enemies and take them out.[/p][p] [/p][p]The higher your placement on the Reckoning Leaderboard, the greater the rewards at the end of the event. Keep slaying to earn Leaderboard Points and complete Event Challenges to unlock rewards when completed.[/p][p][/p][h2][u]Call of Duty: Warzone: Season 05 Content[/u][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9faf57d51b3a0836ca5a3bcaa30dc1e12356a0fd.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Raze the Roof:[/b] Drop into Verdansk and take on a multi-step contract to discover the high-tech secrets hiding within Verdansk Stadium.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Limited Time Modes:[/b] Buy back your fallen squadmates and fight to the finish in Stadium Resurgence and claw your way up from the lowest-scoring squad to avoid being eliminated in Deadline.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Features:[/b] Experience the exciting buildup toward a major \[\[REDACTED]] by completing the Satellite Highjack Contract.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Season 05 Ranked Play: [/b]Prove your mettle and become the best of the best in Battle Royale and Resurgence Ranked Play and claim all-new seasonal rewards.[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h3]Eyes on the Skies: Abyss Protocol Activated: Stadium Compromised[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f4cb4273b2c208276eb976234989fdac32ee2be9.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Recent intelligence indicates a massive disruption across Verdansk is imminent, as recon teams have confirmed the existence of a clandestine military base hidden within the sealed walls of the National Acropolis Arena. The extent of the threat remains unclear, though a weapon capable of large-scale destruction is expected to be unearthed within the vicinity.[/p][p] [/p][p]All squads are recommended to assemble and begin explorations in preparation for a possible Stadium breach![/p][p] [/p][h3]New Contract: Satellite Hijack (Launch Window, Week One)[/h3][p][i]Battle Royale, Battle Royale Casual Modes[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c99f105606a912bd3d0e79ca44444c22c534546f.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Breach the stadium in possibly the most impressively explosive way possible as you and other enemy squads attempt race to complete the multi-step Satellite Hijack Contract. Infiltrate the Stadium by any means necessary, confirming the nefarious operations and hidden compound within.[/p][p] [/p][p]This contract is only available during the first full week of the season, so don’t miss your chance to engage in this important event! Secure the \[\[REDACTED]] to obtain a special reward; the \[\[REDACTED]], available to every member of your squad and usable during the rest of the match as well as permanently placed in your Gunsmith. Further Comms to follow.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]Additional reports appear to indicate further and increasingly alarming \[\[REDACTED]], recommending additional attention to \[\[REDACTED]] as the \[\[REDACTED]] progresses.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Stadium Resurgence LTM (In-Season, Week Two)[/h3][p][i]36 players, 12-minute matches[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/67cde8839a2b22618aae1a69f074c60da2225ff6.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Should Operators visit Verdansk during the second full week of Season 05, they may find entry to the Stadium is now viable, thanks to some light orbital remodeling, along with unlocked ground level entrances allowing full exploration into the clandestine compound. With all the recent explosive activity, the action is heating up again and the Stadium receives a focused Resurgence battle with a seven-circle collapse, along with Public Events and loot assembled for this rapid action mode.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cd9c392ec5d56bbdf22a8cbab7498b44a470c6ca.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Normal Resurgence rules apply: Maintain pressure, secure objectives, and gather resources — every action contributes to squad redeployment. Prioritize Contracts, eliminate hostiles, and stay mobile to accelerate the return of downed teammates.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Deadline LTM (Mid-Season)[/h3][p][i]Quads, 100 players, Players and AI[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c4fe5ef29879ef041cd4945c438ce4d1861ede03.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A deadline looms in this new Limited Time Mode where more than just eliminations keep you in the match! Jump in with your squad and amass as many points as you can between each Circle Collapse. Naturally, racking up eliminations—by dispatching both human and Bot Hostile Agents— is a key method of increasing your points total, but you’re also rewarded with points by completing Contracts, looting supplies, and spending cash at Buy Stations.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1f13f8e0240c9ae5b80fedad6fa53561b830ba59.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Keep those points flowing: Though there are unlimited respawns for you and your team, as each Circle Collapse occurs, the lowest scoring squads are eliminated from the match, and there’s an increase in the presence of Hostile Agents. Be prepared to fight for your spot! With each new gas circle, all scores are reset, so there’s no resting on your early match laurels here; you need to constantly prove yourself by staying active and climbing up the score ranks again![/p][p] [/p][p]Remember in Deadline, it’s not only about getting eliminations; every player can contribute to victory.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Ranked Play: Battle Royale, Resurgence (Launch Window)[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c70d3635173739a52fedd818af64619432f0c145.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The action is heating up across Verdansk and Rebirth Island, requiring Operators to stay focused on the mission if they hope to survive. Improve your skills by competing against the best in Battle Royale and Resurgence Ranked Play, earning the following seasonal rewards as you push further into the Skill Divisions:[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Season 05 BR Ranked Play Rewards[/b][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fa411de178ecc2c8865e79540fb82e2016a7d4de.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][list][*][p]First Season Win: Weapon Charm[/p][/*][*][p]Get 25 Eliminations: Elimination Sticker[/p][/*][*][p]Get 100 Eliminations: Elimination Weapon Camo[/p][/*][*][p]Get 250 Eliminations: Elimination SWAT 5.56 Weapon Blueprint[/p][/*][*][p]Silver: “Ranked Season 5 – Silver” Emblem[/p][/*][*][p]Gold: “Ranked Season 5 – Gold” Emblem and Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]Platinum: “Ranked Season 5 – Platinum” Emblem and Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]Diamond: “Ranked Season 5 – Diamond” Emblem and Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]Crimson: “Ranked Season 5 – Crimson” Emblem and Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]Iridescent: “Ranked Season 5 – Iridescent” Emblem and Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]Top 250: “Ranked Season 5 – Top 250” Emblem and Calling Card[/p][/*][*][p]Season 05 Champion: “Ranked Season 5 – Top 250 Champion” Emblem[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3]Playlist Update: Solos Moving into Season 05[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/466d8283f0b4742a1798daf6ad32ec68289af4a8.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]In the Season 04 Reloaded [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/06/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-warzone-zombies-season-four-reloaded#solos"]blog[/url], we shared initial results from our Call of Duty: Warzone Battle Royale Solos playlist test – where Casual Solos replaced Core Solos – to better understand how players engage with each experience. Our initial test was conducted to identify if Casual Solos could increase the waning popularity of the Core Solos experience. The test showed Casual Solos outperformed Core Solos by more than 3 to 1, with improvements in matchmaking quality, ping stability, and overall match health.  [/p][p]We have since completed a second phase of testing, running both Casual Solos and Core Solos side-by-side, which has allowed us to gather deeper regional data and assess how playlists affect the player experience across a global population. [/p][p]Our second test showed similar results, with Casual Solos receiving 3X the number of daily users than Core Solos. The data also reveals that players who heavily favored the Core Solos playlist in Season 03 (before Casual Solos was added) significantly reduced their time in the mode when it returned in Season 04 Reloaded – spending just 25% of their total playtime in Core Solos. [/p][p]Our teams continue to examine how playlist offerings work regionally. Here’s how playlists will shift when Season 05 launches, in consideration of the data we’ve seen: [/p][p]·         Both Core Solos and Casual Solos will be available globally on day one of the season [/p][p]·         Within 48 hours playlists will be updated: [/p][p]o   Core Solos will remain active in North America (NA) and Europe (EU) only [/p][p]o   Casual Solos will continue to be available in all regions [/p][p] [/p][p]In North America and Europe, Core Solos was marginally more sustainable than other regions in both phases of testing; however, the mode still suffered from match quality concerns (connection, match times) due to players preferring other available playlists. In other regions, Core Solos was unable to deliver acceptable match quality. [/p][p]Casual Solos has proven itself to be the more approachable and globally sustainable mode. Keeping this mode live worldwide ensures that solo players everywhere have a healthy, high-quality match experience.  [/p][p]By tailoring playlists based on regional data, we’re ensuring that every Call of Duty: Warzone player gets the best possible experience, regardless of location. This is the next step in refining how we build playlists that serve all Call of Duty: Warzone players. We’ll continue to evaluate performance and feedback as Season 05 rolls out. [/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: General Content (MP, ZM, WZ)[/u][/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/082676a7d7b24db38dbbfecd4b22902135316d44.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][td][p]Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Weapons Detail:[/b] Wield four new weapons in Season 05, including the ABR A1 Assault Rifle, PML 5.56 LMG, and Boxing Gloves Melee in-season, followed by a new Gravemark .357 Revolver at the mid-season mark. Then unlock the two-Attachment 9mm PM Skull Splitter at launch, and the Helical SMG Magazine at mid-season.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]New Events and Rewards: [/b]Participate in several exciting Events throughout the season and earn new rewards along the way like the new Combat Bow Scorestreak and Boxing Gloves Melee Weapon.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Battle Pass and BlackCell: [/b]Tactical mastermind Lawrence Sims, last seen in the [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]Campaign, is set to lead the Season 05 Battle Pass featuring new Weapon Blueprints, Operator Skins, Calling Cards, Finishing Moves, Emotes, and more in a mix of free and premium tiers. Free tiers include two new base weapons and the 9mm PM Skull Splitter Attachment.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b]Season 05 Operators: [/b]Sims headlines the new Battle Pass while Solace, the living embodiment of good, leads BlackCell, bringing justice and order to the chaos. Suit up and become the hero of the lobby as The Replacer and strike fear in your enemies with The Fisherman from [i]I Know What You Did Last Summer[/i].[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p][b] [/b][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p] [/p][p][/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][p] [/p][p]Primary Weapon: PML 5.56 (Launch)[/p][p][i]LMG[/i][/p][p][i]Battle Pass Page 3 HVT (Free, Base Weapon)[/i][/p][p][i]Battle Pass Page 11 HVT (“Overclock”, “Overclock BlackCell” Blueprints)[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/acd0583f9ff38890634b61ce9704505026f75f74.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Levels: 39[/b][/p][p][b]MAGS: 3[/b][/p][p][b]MAG SIZE: 100[/b][/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Full-auto light machine gun. Fast rate of fire and high lethality offset by low mobility and hefty recoil.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]When a rival Operator is holding the trigger down on the PML 5.56, you’ll know, mainly due to the damage and huge ammunition reserves, mitigated somewhat by a lengthy reload. You’d be wise to use the incoming fire from the PML 5.56 as a sure sign to get down and stay down — and usually for longer than normal — unless you’re the one doing the firing.[/p][p] [/p][p]With a damage output that’s among the highest compared to all available full-auto weapons, it’s the PML 5.56’s prodigious rate of fire, spitting out rounds with rapid severity, that really proves its worth. With a heavy body and disadvantageous recoil (strong upward recoil with a slight drift to the right), you’ll need to utilize attachments or your Operator’s strength to focus on the firing.[/p][p] [/p][p]Primary Weapon: ABR A1 (Launch)[/p][p][i]Assault Rifle[/i][/p][p][i]Battle Pass Page 6 HVT (Free, Base Weapon)[/i][/p][p][i]Battle Pass Page 14 HVT (“Dragon King”, “Dragon King BlackCell” Blueprints)[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4ea0982a95d2019513385c9a230b06c01b79ec38.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Levels: 43[/b][/p][p][b]MAGS: 3[/b][/p][p][b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b][/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camos and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).[/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p][i]Three-round burst assault rifle.  Good handling and power. Moderate recoil and range. Configurable to full auto.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]The iconic Assault Rifle returns! With a similar weapon being a fan-favorite staple of the [i]Black Ops[/i] series, the ABR A1 combines a high damage output that can drop enemies in tight three-round bursts with a brief pause in-between, almost fast enough to be called automatic. If an even faster firing output is called for, unlock one of the Fire Mods that coverts the weapon to Full Auto.[/p][p] [/p][p]This is a highly versatile weapon capable of winning skirmishes, though not at the furthest of ranges. Its recoil requires some getting used to, but the upward kick can be easily managed, and the handling is more than acceptable. The integrated sight is already available with the base weapon along with the right attachments that can help mitigate any weaknesses in these areas.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Melee Weapon: Boxing Gloves (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Melee, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/927ece0321080fd9eec4cf38ff6d5044e92a2aae.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Levels: 30[/b][/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][b]Attachments: [/b]None[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins.[/p][p] [/p][p][i] Moderate damage. Fast attack speed. Long range.[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Slip on the Boxing Gloves and knock out foes with a swift barrage of jabs and uppercuts. Though their range is short and multiple hits are needed to down a foe, these pack a tremendous lunge distance along with formidable speed, , so get up close and start swinging. For a KO they won’t recover from, hit ‘em where it hurts with a devastating heavy attack.[/p][p] [/p][p]Secondary Weapon: Gravemark .357 Revolver (Mid-Season)[/p][p][i]Pistol, Event Reward[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a5688647622322b35f27948bc6adf11507a846cc.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]Levels: 26[/b][/p][p][b]MAGS: 3[/b][/p][p][b]MAG SIZE: 8[/b][/p][p][b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b][/p][p][b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Fire Mods[/p][p][b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (2).[/p][p] [/p][p][i]Single-action revolver. High power and considerable range, limited by lower ammo count and segmented reload.[/i][/p][p][i] [/i][/p][p]Showdown at high noon, no rifles. The Gravemark .357 Revolver harkens back to a simpler time, forgoing fancy mechanisms for a classic eight-shooter capable of dealing high damage at a respectable range. Due to the weapon’s moderate fire rate, you’ll need to make your shots count, so line up the target and hit that bullseye.[/p][p] [/p][p]Equip the Rapid Fire attachment to improve the Revolver’s rate of fire or dampen its heavy kick with Recoil Springs. For pure power, accuracy is forfeited in favor of Akimbo to dual wield the lethal weapon. Whether wielding one or two Revolvers, don’t miss the weapon inspection, a truly dazzling feat of dexterity.[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][h3]New: Special Weapon Attachments[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/13652d924e5638079604a5ce2d4152d047fbb5a7.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p]9mm PM Skull Splitter (Two Attachments, Launch)[/p][p][i]9mm PM Pistol, Battle Pass Page 7 Reward[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Bring the power and precision of a marksman rifle to your favorite pistol with the 9mm PM Skull Splitter Barrel. The Barrel greatly increases damage, especially to the head, reducing rate of fire. Pair with an extended magazine that gives the Operator additional ammo for this weapon at the expense of handling.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/253fac4ee0958bc11a81abe2f2c5f9910467509c.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]PPSh-41 Helical Magazine (In-Season)[/p][p][i]PPSh-41, Event Reward[/i][/p][p] [/p][p]Fire to the beat of your own drum with this SMG attachment that puts other magazines to shame. Manage heat on this high-ammo count magazine that excels at spraying bullets in close and medium ranges.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]Season 05 Events[/h3][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/489b21c64b307d2f8d1c6044ccd2bdced55f1d9c.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The action ramps up significantly with a full-tilt schedule of Events across Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i]. Earn rewards like a new Secondary Weapon, a Melee Weapon, a new attachment, and more. Get a preview of season’s upcoming Events below, with more announcements in the mid-season Season 05 Reloaded blog: [/p][p] [/p][p]Event: ’90s Action Heroes (MP, ZM, WZ) (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Total Rewards: [/i]13, including the Boxing Gloves Melee Weapon and the Mister Peeks Zombies Field Upgrade[/p][p] [/p][p]Take it over the top and be the leading hero you’re meant to be in this Event that pays homage to action flicks. Earn the new Boxing Gloves melee weapon, a BlackCell Boxing Gloves weapon variant if you own BlackCell, plus other great rewards.[/p][p]
Event: Operation: Hell Ride (MP, ZM, WZ) (Mid-Season)[/p][p]Rewards Include: Gravemark .357 Revolver[/p][p]Don’t get your wires crossed in this Event challenging Operators to save the day from a ticking timebomb.[/p][p] [/p][p]Event: Atomic Block Party (MP, ZM, WZ) (Mid-Season)[/p][p]Rewards Include: Combat Bow Scorestreak and PPSh-41 Helical Magazine Attachment[/p][p]It’s time to commemorate everyone’s favorite chaotic battleground! Engage in a Nuketown-inspired event full of rewards.[/p][p] [/p][p]Event: The Reckoning Leaderboard Event (ZM)[/p][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p]Play a Zombies match to get entered into Season 05’s The Reckoning Leaderboard Event. Eliminate the undead on the Reckoning Zombies map to earn Leaderboard Points, with Special, Elite, and Boss enemies awarding the most Points. Complete Event Challenges along the way to unlock rewards when completed and reach the highest placement you can for a bigger payout at the end of the event.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Season 05 Battle Pass and BlackCell[/h3][p] [/p][p]Lawrence Sims Brings the Heat in the Season 05 Battle Pass[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/be64142f13cd4440a2e4c13402e648382b12499d.jpg"][/img] [/p][p]With Rogue Black Ops back in the fold at the CIA, tactician Lawrence Sims is back from the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Campaign, lending his expertise to the pursuit of the final moles, leading this season’s Battle Pass content in the process. Purchase the Season 05 Battle Pass for 1,100 COD Points or the Season 05 Battle Pass Bundle for 2,400 COD Points to immediately unlock the Instant Rewards Page of the Battle Pass, including the following items:[/p][p] [/p][p]·        10% Battle Pass XP Boost[/p][p]·        The new “Stogie” Sims Operator and “Stogie BlackCell” Sims Operator Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/p][p]·        The “Infernous” Legendary Blueprint for the Kilo 141 Assault Rifle[/p][p]·        The “Free Fire” Emote[/p][p]·        The “Venom Eye” Weapon Charm[/p][p] [/p][p]The Season 05 Battle Pass features over 110 pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including two new (and free) Base Weapons, the 9mm PM Skull Splitter Barrel Attachment, and more. Stay tuned for the BlackCell, Battle Pass and Store Bundles blog prior to Season 05 launch for more details.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]BlackCell Offerings[/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a5d044206bb64610ab48124a76e8e2ab9218e8ab.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Bring justice and order to the chaos with the new Solace Operator, exclusive to BlackCell. Solace is the living embodiment of Good and he intends to stamp out evil and adversaries alike with both divine strength and a summoned Griffin familiar for a ferocious Finishing Move. The celestial Operator is joined by a cast of celestially tormented Operator Skins and Weapon Blueprints earned exclusively through BlackCell.[/p][p] [/p][p]BlackCell owners can access the Season 05 Battle Pass via the exclusive BlackCell Page, instantly unlocking the following items:[/p][p] [/p][p]·        The “Solace” BlackCell Operator[/p][p]·        10% XP Boost[/p][p]·        1,100 COD Points[/p][p]·        The “Griffin Nabbed” Finishing Move[/p][p]·        The “Herald” Mastercraft Blueprint for the Krig C Assault Rifle with Golden Aura Tracers and Golden Spirit Death FX[/p][p]·        The “Iris Rise” Animated Weapon Charm[/p][p]·        The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and Winner’s Circles)[/p][p] [/p][p]BlackCell owners get access to page after page of additional exclusive rewards within the Season 05 Battle Pass, including:[/p][p]·        Seven BlackCell-exclusive skins for Sims (two skins), Stone, Toro, Maya, Niran, and Carver. [/p][p]·        Seven BlackCell-exclusive Weapon Blueprints for the KSV SMG, AMES 85 Assault Rifle, AMR Mod 4 Sniper Rifle, ASG-89 Shotgun, PML 5.56, DM-10 Marksman Rifle, and the ABR A1 Assault Rifle.[/p][p]·        Over 130 item rewards (Battle Pass and BlackCell related) for those who fully complete the Season 05 BlackCell Battle Pass.[/p][p] [/p][p]As usual, players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]BlackCell Stackable XP Boost: [/b]Players who purchased BlackCell in a previous [i]Black Ops 6[/i] season and go on to purchase Season 05 BlackCell will earn a permanent 10% Player and Weapon XP Loyalty Bonus, up to 40% for players who purchased BlackCell for Black Ops 6 Seasons 01, 02, 03, and 04![/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h3]Operators[/h3][p] [/p][p]Lawrence Sims and the backing of the CIA provide the Rogue Black Ops team with access to a full armament of weapons and tech to track down the remaining Pantheon moles. For the final blow, call in Solace leading BlackCell, joined by Sims as the leader of the Battle Pass with special appearances by The Replacer plus The Fisherman of [i]I Know What You Did Last Summer[/i].[/p][p] [/p][p]Solace (BlackCell, Crimson One, Launch)[/p][p][i]“Solace” New Operator: BlackCell Instant Reward Page[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/06646f29a909a2de2bc8751ed8fad1248e92999c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p]Clad in refined, golden armor with ethereal wisps and a glowing halo resplendent with shards of light, Solace remains calm in an increasingly chaotic storm.[/p][p] [/p][p]Sims (Battle Pass, Rogue Black Ops, Launch)[/p][p][i]“Stogie”, “Stogie BlackCell”, “Envenomate” and “Envenomate BlackCell” Skins: Battle Pass Instant Reward Page, Battle Pass Completion Page[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6d48354e321e96950cbe5d782a8b8ae93b4ddf47.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p]A brilliant and reliable CIA operative with a tech background and a storied Army combat record, Lawrence Sims played an instrumental role in covert ops throughout the Vietnam War, and in pursuit of Perseus. His time in the clandestine service eventually took its toll, and Sims returned to the Army. A few years later, he briefly reunited with his CIA teammates on a mission to capture a Pantheon scientist.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]The Replacer: Commander Battleman (In-Season)[/p][p][i]Store Bundle[/i][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f68a268b3f2183c578c5d6d6192af5e6afcf1b54.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]The Replacer brings his Action Hero game to Season 05 with two new Operator skins, taking the place of a jungle warfare survivalist (clad in olive green gear, complete with the necessary sleeveless jacket and bare toro and tattoo work) as well as a horn-helmed barbarian, with bulging biceps, fur gauntlets, a loincloth that won’t quit, and a rather dashing tooth neckless. Obtain the “Strike Force” and “Replacement Warrior.”[/p][p] [/p][p]The Fisherman (Bundle, In-Season)[/p][p][i]Store Bundle[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dbcb14bc5a8b501ce7747f1f066add7af7693b6e.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Dressed in black and armed with his signature hook, The Fisherman is here to reign terror on your enemies. The menacing character, available as part of the Tracer Pack: I Know What You Did Last Summer Store Bundle, joins Call of Duty as the newest Operator ready to haunt the combat zone.[/p][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][h3]New Store Offerings[/h3][p] [/p][p]Season 05 adds an incredible lineup of Bundles to the Store, including the return of The Replacer and a crossover event with [i]I Know What You Did Last Summer[/i]. Get more intel in the Season 05 BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Bundles blog arriving before launch.[/p][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p]Tracer Pack: The Replacer Commander Battleman[/p][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5e8e9cf0b9f1019f73822dbec5bc75c5927a1fcf.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Two warriors. One Replacer. Crawl out of the jungle in an olive-green combat jacket with strong bandana accessorizing with the “Strike Force” Operator Skin and crush the puny primitive enemies with the “Replacement Warrior” Skin. With 11 total items, replace vital organs with bullets courtesy of the “Pinpoint” AS VAL AR Blueprint and “Maximum Doom” Ladra SMG Blueprint, each with Burning Tracers and Violent Explosion Death FX. Then slash through the tall brush with the “Underbrush” Cleaver Blueprint, also with Violent Explosion Death FX.[/p][p] [/p][p]Take your fight to the front line with the hand-to-hand beatdown of the “Elbow Room” Finishing Move, fire up your opponents with the “Relaxing Burn” Emote, as well as the “Replaceable Dynamite” Weapon Charm, “Muscles Free” animated Calling Card, “Replacement Time” Loading Screen, and “Barbaric Gaze” animated Emblem.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p]Tracer Pack: I Know What You Did Last Summer[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1cdf5c2185035641554e1efdd5c36671744d0890.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Hunt down the perpetrators that dare to stay silent with The Fisherman Operator Skin, featuring 10 separate bundle items. Don the slicker and rain terror on your enemies with “The Fisherman” Operator, reel in the eliminations with the “Dreaded Harpoon” XM4 AR Blueprint, catch yourself a live one with the “Curved Culler” C9 SMG Blueprint, both with Bloody Hook Tracers and Fish Chum Death FX.[/p][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/169c0441aba560d320cded8a2a08bfa3ae82346e.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Make them remember their crimes with the “Lethal Hook” Melee Weapon Blueprint (with Fish Chum Death FX). Plus, stay salty with the “Angry Angler” Emote, “Got a Live One” Finishing Move, “Get Hooked” Calling Card, “Good Cleaning” Emblem, “I Know What You Did” Loading Screen, and “You’re Next” Spray.[/p][p] [/p][h3]Other Incoming Bundles[/h3][p][b] [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6cf7d41e0b0331ef7c15e395765efaf7cff8380f.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p]Expect more finely crafted content to arrive in the Season 05 Store, including the [b]“Tracer Pack: IDEAD 2 Mastercraft” [/b]Bundle, [b]“Tracer Pack: Dogs of War” [/b]Bundle, and the[b] “Tracer Pack: Behemoth Ultra Skin” [/b]Bundle. Discover additional upcoming Bundles and more in the Season 05 BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Store Bundle blog.[/p][p] [/p][h2]Call of Duty League Championship Recap[/h2][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f265999d5e726afef2dc614901c504ee7f66c374.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Late last month, the 2025 Call of Duty League™ Championship Weekend broke the Call of Duty Esports peak viewership record during the season’s Grand Final showdown between OpTic Texas and Vancouver Surge. More than 353K viewers witnessed[b] [/b]OpTic Texas take home the CDL’s most coveted trophy for the second year in a row! Relive the Grand Finals action and [url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ho4yMYHbPIA"]watch the match VOD[/url] today.[/p][p] [/p][p]Call of Duty Esports action continues, with the World Series of Warzone currently ongoing. Learn more at [/p][p][url="https://WorldSeriesofWarzone.com"]WorldSeriesofWarzone.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p] [/p][h2]MWII and MWIII Now Available as Standalone Installs[/h2][p] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2226eb434af4a92b3f1e19215c9ac8f40bea5649.jpg"][/img][/p][p] [/p][p]Starting today (July 29), Modern Warfare II and Modern Warfare III are now available as standalone downloads across all platforms. This update gives owners of each title more flexibility over how they access and manage their titles – both MWII and MWIII can be launched directly from your platform games library. On August 7, older files for MWII and MWIII currently installed within the main Call of Duty experience will be automatically removed to help free up storage space. Players who redownload MWII or MWIII can also manually remove legacy content before August 7 to avoid data duplication.[/p][p] [/p][p]Call of Duty: Warzone content such as MWII/MWIII operators and weapons will not be impacted by this change.[/p][p] [/p][p]If you already own MWII or MWIII, everything you’ve unlocked stays with you. Achievements and trophies earned in the main Call of Duty experience will carry over into the standalone versions. Players can also sync achievements and trophies they earn within the separate titles back to the main Call of Duty install. PlayStation players can also earn a Platinum trophy for MWIII.  [/p][p] [/p][p]The DMZ Beta remains free-to-play, now hosted within the MWII install. Players can download a “free” version of MWII to access the DMZ Beta, while Campaign, Multiplayer, and other premium modes will be gated for MWII owners.[/p][p] [/p][p]The main Call of Duty install continues to serve as your central hub – enabling seamless switching between the latest premium title and Call of Duty: Warzone, promoting data efficiencies across shared content, and keeping all your friends, parties, and cross-title features in one place.[/p][p] [/p][p]Learn More:[/p][p]·        [url="https://support.activision.com/modern-warfare-ii/articles/modern-warfare-ii-installation-and-setup"]MWII Installation Article[/url][/p][p]·        [url="https://support.activision.com/modern-warfare-iii/articles/modern-warfare-iii-installation-and-setup"]MWIII Installation Article[/url][/p][p]·        [url="https://support.activision.com/articles/achievements-for-modern-warfare-iii-and-modern-warfare-ii"]Achievement FAQ[/url][/p][p] [/p][p][/p][h2]Call of Duty Shop: Gear Up![/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d53a705e0ea7c174e2dc3ed10767bb71fc11f3b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d53a705e0ea7c174e2dc3ed10767bb71fc11f3b9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b][u] [/u][/b][/p][p]Whether you're building out your game room or hunting down [i]Call of Duty[/i] collectibles with history, the latest drop from [url="https://shop.callofduty.com/collections/zombies?utm_source=Partner&utm_medium=Blog&utm_campaign=CODBlog_Zombies&utm_id=CODBlog_Zombies"]the Call of Duty Shop[/url] delivers. From plush reinforcements to eerie desk gear, here are some highlights:[/p][p] [/p][p]·        [b]Riley 9" Youtooz Plush (with “Happy Pup” Weapon Charm): [/b]The most loyal companion in Call of Duty history is reporting for cuddle duty — and he's packing a tactical vest, alert expression, and bonus Weapon Charm.[/p][p]·        [b]Mister Peeks Controller and Phone Holder: [/b]Straight from rampaging through Janus Towers, Mister Peeks is here to secure your gear and keep watch (with his one good eye) over your set up.[/p][p]·        [b]Mystery Box 3D Lamp:[/b] Touch-activated, this USB-C rechargeable lamp casts an eerie yellow glow. Light up your space with a glowing tribute to the most iconic Zombies loot drop.[/p][p][/p][h2]Upgrade to Black Ops 6 Today![/h2][p][b] [/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/423317ba0e11cfd9dfbf99ec29d954ab323939ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/423317ba0e11cfd9dfbf99ec29d954ab323939ac.jpg"][/img][/p][p][u] [/u][/p][p][i]Black Ops 6[/i] is available now, and there’s never been a better time to experience the spy action thriller Campaign, the in-depth tactical chaos of best-in-class Multiplayer, and soak in the gory glory of an incredible round-based Zombies experience![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]The Truth Lies.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][i]©/TM/®2025 Activision Publishing, Inc. [/i][/p][p][i]For more information, please visit [/i][/p][p][url="https://www.callofduty.com"]www.callofduty.com[/url][/p][p][i] and [/i][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/callofduty"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][i], and follow [url="https://twitter.com/activision"]@Activision[/url] and [url="https://twitter.com/CallofDuty"]@CallofDuty[/url] on X, Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow [url="https://twitter.com/CODUpdates"]@CODUpdates[/url] on X.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][i]I Know What You Did Last Summer TM & © 2025 Columbia Pictures Industries, Inc. notes.title: Call of Duty Install Update
notes.notes: [p]On July 29 at 9am PT, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare II and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III will be moved from the main Call of Duty install and become standalone downloads. Beginning tomorrow, MWII or MWIII owners can access them directly after redownloading each title. Legacy content related to MWII and MWIII modes within the main Call of Duty install will be automatically removed on August 7 to free up storage space[i].[/i] [/p]

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 04 Reloaded: Full Intel
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Season 04 Reloaded: Incoming Intel[/u][/h2][h3]Stitch on the Loose[/h3]
The jailbreak was successful, and Stitch is finally free. Joining his old nemesis, Russell Adler, the two remain focused on the objective at hand: revealing the true identities of the Pantheon moles once and for all.

The chase continues as new content arrives in the mid-season update coming to [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], adding new maps, modes, weapons, events, and more, including cel-shaded map playlists across all three game modes and new Battle Royale features like the Door Barricade Field Upgrade and Loot Master Perk.

[i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] Season 04 Reloaded arrives on Wednesday, July 2 at 9AM PT.
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: Season 04 Reloaded[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6a866abb4fa56fe23bfeb0fe920a6d44f6d84ef1.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Two New Maps:[/b] Attend the grand opening of the Rolling Hills distillery in Fringe, a reimagined version of the map first seen in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 3[/i]. Slip into the shadows of the new Eclipse Strike map, an Avalon nightclub featuring pulsing dance music and neon-lit tables where nefarious deals are made.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Cel-Shaded Map Playlists:[/b] Play cel-shaded variants of Nuketown, Babylon, Skyline, Stakeout, and Grind across the 6v6 respawn game modes in CODtoons Moshpit. Then gatecrash your way into Party Ops, featuring all maps, except for Stakeout, for a different kind of game.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Party Ops LTM:[/b] Flex your cool in this limited time Free for All party mode! Compete across a variety of minigames testing your ability to adapt to the changing rules, from a game of tag with the Bo Staff to a dance off and a tactical twist on musical chairs.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][h3]Fringe[/h3]
[i]Remaster, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1edc232b08bfdbe4ecc9aede77e400c3d62f1915.jpg[/img]

First seen in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 3[/i], Fringe returns in a reimagined form for Season 04 Reloaded. Deploy to the Rolling Hills distillery during the grand opening ceremony. Test your gunslinging skills in the Bar or announce your presence more loudly along the central Road. Upper windows in the Barn and House offer mighty power positions, the Loading zone retaining its reputation as the map’s riskiest traversal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fc524cca499526690e05e8c883e2dc7c36e65b5d.jpg[/img]
[h3]Eclipse[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Strike, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/19e11779b38d09702aa58a26ddb4cde4479bcb0a.jpg[/img]

Battle to the beat in this underground nightclub in Avalon where neon lights illuminate the halls and dance floor. Head straight to the middle to duke it out center stage or engage enemies down the sides, remaining watchful for enemy movement while passing the dining tables set along the way. Get a view over the action from the DJ Booth or set up in the corner Coat Check and tag passing targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e9559f789ce0b7eca6e2e071b215a7dc593143dc.jpg[/img]
[h3]Cel-Shaded Map Variants[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/33e97b3378db7d963064442775c3090dbab2b1e9.jpg[/img]

Play cel-shaded variants of Nuketown, Babylon, Skyline, Stakeout, and Grind in CODtoons Moshpit, while Party Ops features the same lineup (minus Stakeout).
[h3]Party Ops Limited Time Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/98adcd7d99ce5e8e6eb137e48978565b1a8a210b.jpg[/img]

Party all night in this Free for All party mode challenging players to finish a randomized set of minigames with the highest score!

The clock’s ticking, each minigame occurring in a short time frame. There’s no score limit and Scorestreaks are disabled. Matches take place across Babylon, Grind, Nuketown, and Skyline, with the top three scoring Operators winning the competition. Success means adapting to each new challenge on the fly, as the type and order of minigames is randomized at the start of each match.

Minigames include condensed versions of some classic Party Modes alongside wild challenges like the Dance Off, tasking Operators to get down and funky in the designated dance zones, as well as Musical Zones later in the season, featuring multiple capture points that dwindle down to a final location when the music stops. Better move fast!
[h2]Zombies: Season 04 Reloaded Content[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6d64e1fba8cde86d6a6cd3e7c3e2924de1813f14.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Cel-Shaded Liberty Falls, Abomination Challenge LTM: [/b]Tackle a battle-hardened Elite enemy in a vicious fight across a special Cel-Shaded version of Liberty Falls.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Starting Room LTM:[/b] Hold firm as you fight against wave after wave of the undead in a cel-shaded Starting Room zone across all maps!
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Introducing Leaderboard Events:[/b] Become the King of the Dead in a new way to battle to the top in Zombies!
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Good Grief: Gameplay Updates[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d32eaeae3297750ab87acf4e75be865a331bbcf8.jpg[/img]

Treyarch is bringing a new round of gameplay updates to Grief to Season 04 Reloaded, including more punishing Grief effects against enemy players, bans for certain revive-related GobbleGums, faster zombie spawns after Capture Zone completions, Whimsical GobbleGum rewards for players who finish their matches, and more.

Watch for Patch Notes from Treyarch prior to the start of Season 04 Reloaded for all the details!
[h3]Abomination Challenge (LTM)[/h3]
[i]During Beavis and Butt-Head Event[/i]

[i]Summon Mo by opening the doors to the Aether Church. Then defeat Mo. Mo has some unique abilities as an Abomination HVT. He will gain resistance, then immunity, to a weapon repeatedly used on him. Mo’s charge attack also holds a secret.[/i]

[i]Available: Flow Mode, Cel-Shaded Map[/i]

[i]Restricted: Quests, Easter Eggs, Exit Strategy (GobbleGum)[/i]

[i]Available Maps: Liberty Falls[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/62ac5486edf7fd78d9805f0379b46b4a8ab0505a.jpg[/img]

Enter a cel-shaded version of Liberty Falls in this chaotic and seriously challenging Limited Time Mode! Your match begins with a baseline of classic RBZ:
[list]	[*]Available for crews of one to four players versus Zombies[/*]	[*]The match ends when all players are eliminated[/*]	[*]Mystery Boxes can contain Wonder Weapons[/*]	[*]Takes place on the entirety of the Liberty Falls map[/*][/list]
However, there’s a twist. Or in this case, a vicious, drooling red-mouthed Abomination called Mo. This HVT is in a permanent state of fury, summoned from the Dark Aether when the Church is opened. Your main and overriding goal is:
[list]	[*]Defeat Mo, the HVT Abomination[/*]	[*]Exfil is disabled until the HVT is defeated[/*][/list][h3]Additional Modifiers[/h3]
[b]Modified Features: [/b]Expect a variety of Snacks and enemy-based modifiers as you desperately try to gain the upper hand against the undead onslaught:
[list]	[*]Rounds turn faster (expect Cranked or Rampage Inducer rates of enemy spawning)[/*]	[*]Additional enemies are added to Liberty Falls including:	[list]		[*]Amalgams[/*]		[*]Doppelghasts[/*]		[*]Elder Disciples[/*]		[*]Shock Mimics[/*]		[*]Toxic Zombies[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Additional Features: [/b]The Abomination Challenge LTM utilizes a modified version of the “Zombies Snacks” ruleset for Health—meaning you need to secure Snacks dropped as ground loot to increase your Health once you’ve taken damage—though players do not lose energy by moving.
[list]	[*]There is no Refrigerator Power-up[/*]	[*]Flow State is available, assuming you can slay enough of the undead without taking damage to activate it![/*][/list]
[b]Disabled Features:[/b] The following gameplay features are disabled in this Mode:
[list]	[*]Save and Quit[/*]	[*]Main Quest[/*]	[*]Easter Eggs[/*]	[*]Rampage Inducer[/*]	[*]Exit Strategy (GobbleGum)[/*]	[*]Idle Eyes (GobbleGum)[/*][/list][h3]Mo Problems[/h3]
Mo the HVT Abomination is a force to be reckoned with. He has an extremely mean disposition, inflicts the maximum damage at all times, has an impressive constitution, loves to sprint at foes as often as possible, doesn’t like the taste of equipment, and it’s said he headbutts you with such force that your Perks are knocked out of you, landing on the ground. Which begs the question: How exactly do you mow Mo down?

[b]Rewards: [/b]15,000 XP, A Hidden Power GobbleGum, and a special Calling Card for completing the Abomination Challenge.
[h3]Starting Room (LTM)[/h3]
[i]Available In-Season[/i]

[i]“Locked in. How long can you last?”[/i]

[i]Starting Room locks all the doors confining you to the start area of the map. You must make do with the resources available in the area. Check each map for the Round Milestone required for Rewards.[/i]

[i]Restricted: Door Buys, Exfil, Exit Strategy (GobbleGum)[/i]

[i]Available Maps: Liberty Falls, Terminus, Citadelle des Morts, The Tomb, Shattered Veil[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0b0da85ae01a30fd277393aa2cf3269166869ae2.jpg[/img]

Inspired by the initial chamber within the original Black Ops Zombies map “Moon,” Starting Room brings down the complexities of a full RBZ experience, while ramping up the combat and terror. You’re essentially doomed to battle through increasingly vicious waves of undead within the first area of a map. Raptor One has been grounded. All the doors are sealed shut and can’t be opened. Survive to the highest round you can [i]and[/i] die trying!
[h3]Additional Modifiers[/h3]
[b]Classic Features: [/b]The classic Round-Based Zombies baseline rules are in effect:
[list]	[*]Available for crews of one to four players versus zombies[/*]	[*]The match ends when all players are eliminated[/*][/list]
[b]Modified Features: [/b]There are various modifications within a Starting Room match: If the power in the map was off during a normal match, it is already switched to “on”.
[list]	[*]If a machine or feature, like a Perk Machine, Pack-A-Punch and/or Der Wunderfizz (at Round 25) are in the starting zone, they will appear. If not, they aren’t available.[/*]	[*]Fire Sale Power-up no longer drops randomly from fallen zombies.[/*]	[*]Random Perk Power-up has been added to randomly drop from fallen zombies.[/*]	[*]Door Buys and Exfil are disabled. There’s no way out![/*][/list][h3]Available Maps[/h3]
Starting Room LTM takes place in a cel-shaded version of the starting area within each Zombies map. Here’s a quick tactical overview of the named areas and the expected machines you can interact with:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/772d69e0c9d074fd10cd3d926ef3048e5f95e977.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/922322eb07d85ea9f07b07c36fbe84790a8cedd6.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Gameplay Features: [/b]Call in a Care Package for extra support with the possibility to earn two new gameplay items, the Hand Cannon and Door Barricade. Plus, amp up your scavenging abilities with the Loot Master Perk and take on the Search & Destroy Contract.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Cel-Shaded Rebirth Island: [/b]Arriving later in the mid-season, Rebirth Island gets the cel-shaded treatment. Battle across POIs like Harbor, Prison Block, and Living Quarters designed in a cool, animated style.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Modes, Resurgence Ranked Play: [/b]Warm up in Resurgence Casual and get amped in Havoc Royale. Plus, Resurgence returns to Ranked Play! Compete on Rebirth Island in Trios using the competitive ruleset and rise through the ranks.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Modes, Resurgence Ranked Play, and BR Solos Update: [/b]World Series of Warzone™ 2025 is here! Get info on expansion regions and broadcast qualifiers as Trios compete for their share of the $1M prize pool. Plus, an update regarding BR Solos.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h2]Gameplay Features[/h2]
Need a little edge in the fight? Call in the Care Package, originally in Clash at the start of Season 04, and now coming to multiple modes, featuring two new gameplay items: the Hand Cannon and Door Barricade. Get rewards by completing the Search & Destroy Contract and stock up faster using the new Loot Master Perk.
[h3]Care Packing Incoming[/h3]
[i]Battle Royale, Battle Royale Casual, Resurgence, Plunder[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6ef571a7102573b21c490a945a8186af4945b27c.jpg[/img]

The Care Package expands outside of Clash to multiple game modes. Get the throwable Killstreak as a rare reward found in ground loot caches. Toss it to expel a trail of smoke designating the drop site for a loadout-sized crate with the chance of containing rare loot including rare equipment, the Specialist Perk, and the following:

[b]Field Upgrade — Door Barricade: [/b]Lock down coveted positions by fitting a barricade to a closed single or double door. Heavy-duty locks secure the barricade in place, holding steady except under the most severe bombardment.

[b]Killstreak — Hand Cannon: [/b]Wield the high-powered Hand Cannon, delivering devastating shots with a slow rate of fire complimented with good handling, improved hip fire accuracy, and a faster hip-fire shooting speed.
[h3]Search & Destroy Contract[/h3]
[i]Battle Royale, Resurgence, Plunder[/i]

Why spend hard-earned cash on acquiring new gear from a Buy Station when you can blast your way in instead? Activate the Search & Destroy Contract to task your squad by planting a bomb on a Buy Station. Defend the site while the bomb timer ticks, as other squads can attempt to defuse the bomb, earning a Fire Sale discount from Buy Stations if successful.

[b]New Gameplay Content[/b]

The more resources at your disposal, the better. Gear up faster with assistance from the new Loot Master Perk.

[b]New Perk: Loot Master[/b]

[i]Resurgence, Plunder[/i]

Get more loot from supply caches. Simple and very effective. Found as ground loot in Resurgence and Plunder. This spawns additional items and gives a higher chance to find Tacticals and Lethals, cash, Field Upgrades, Killstreaks, and other high-tier gear.
[h2]Cel-Shaded Rebirth Island[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e05c9ced56296cef7b00a754463d349253fabd9e.jpg[/img]

Not to be outdone by Multiplayer’s cel-shaded playlists launching in the mid-season, [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] is joining in on the fun with a cel-shaded variant of Rebirth Island arriving later in the season. Group up in a Quad and start slaying.
[h2]New Modes[/h2]
[b]New LTM: Havoc Royale[/b]

[i]44 Players (Quads), 15-minute matches[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8d1d38b77c1482eaac8bf2230dde5a57df293216.jpg[/img]

Change up the normal gameplay flow with modifiers that disturb the fabric of reality.

Havoc Royale drops Operators into specific areas of Verdansk—Downtown, Airport, or Train Station—with their Loadout in hand. These modifiers can affect the player, environment, or the gameplay rules with origins in the Modern Warfare® II and III Havoc modes but bringing the high-stakes environment and gameplay from [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Adapt and survive through it all to claim victory as the last team standing!

[b]Buy Stations: [/b]These have been adjusted to sell the following items (Havoc Royale Mode only):

Squad Buyback

Armor Plate

Gasmask

Door Barricade

Munitions Box

Redeploy Drone

Hand Cannon

UAV

Within the six diminishing circle collapses, expect a modifier as each new gas zone coalesces on the map. Only one modifier will be active at a time, with one of two modifiers occurring towards the end of a match (known as “Finale Modifiers”), and each occurs randomly from the following selection:
[list]	[*][b]Charge Jump:[/b] Perform super-human leaps and reach previously unimaginable distances. Holding your button before a Charge Jump provides higher leaping and your velocity dictates how horizontal your jump will be.[/*]	[*][b]Cranked: [/b]Outlines of enemy players periodically flash red, Operators have a HUD indicating where foes are nearby, as well as Tracker footsteps, and quicker weapon switching, armor plate insertions, and reloads. There’s also a timer on the screen. When it reaches zero, the Operator explodes. Open a cache to increase your time. Defeat an enemy to fully refresh the timer.[/*]	[*][b]Crouch Potato:[/b] When crouched, Operators transform into a sack of potatoes. Movement and jumping are still possible, and health as well as armor slowly regenerates while crouched, which only stops if the Operator is struck by enemy fire.[/*]	[*][b]Eye See You:[/b] All Operators always have an Advanced UAV active for them, as well as googly eyes.[/*]	[*][b]Melon Heads:[/b] Operators appear with watermelon heads, with an impressive watermelon-based explosion if hit. Damage to the body is reduced. Damage to heads is multiplied.[/*]	[*][b]Make it Rain:[/b] More ammo and cash become available, to such an extent that it isn’t likely you’ll need to reload, as bullets are removed from your reserves rather than your chamber or magazine. Fire Sale also activates.[/*]	[*][b]Unregulated Airspace:[/b] The airspace is no longer overcrowded, allowing for more Killstreaks to be used at the same time. Expect more of them to be available as ground loot.[/*]	[*][b]Showdown (Finale Modifier):[/b] All Operators are given an identical Loadout. Nearby weapons are removed.[/*]	[*][b]Rising Gas (Finale Modifier):[/b] Operators are warned that gas will be rising vertically throughout the combat zone, forcing you to ascend to higher ground. Fortunately, you’re more likely to obtain Gas Masks and Personal Redeploy Drones (Havoc Royale Mode only) during this modifier’s lifespan.[/*][/list]
Drop in, loot up, and prepare to cause havoc across Verdansk!

[b]Resurgence Casual[/b]

[i]44 Players, Players & Bots[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/32748541fbed2795b0258afd70d2f35f1c07dead.jpg[/img]

The Casual experience comes to Resurgence in the mid-season, mixing humans and bots in a fight to the finish. The main Resurgence ruleset applies, so do what it takes to stay alive and keep your squad redeploying. Drop in to warm up, teach a new player about the game, or just for a more relaxed Resurgence experience.

As with Battle Royale Casual or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] Bootcamp, game progression is limited in this mode and results will not count towards or against your stats. This mode also doesn’t count towards your eligibility for Resurgence Ranked Play.
[h2]Ranked Play: Resurgence[/h2]
[i]Trios, Rebirth Island[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1ded06f249da51189e06427a1c32ad62159a0bc5.jpg[/img]

Squad up in trios and compete for top placement with the return of Resurgence Ranked Play. Use your knowledge of Rebirth Island and face off against [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]’s top-performing players, using every advantage you can over the competing trios. For a list of rewards, [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/05/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-warzone-zombies-season-four-full-intel-revealed#wz-br]check out the Season 04 Announcement blog here[/url].
[h2]World Series of Warzone: Qualifier Broadcasts[/h2]
[i]Trios, Verdansk[/i]

World Series of Warzone™ 2025 is finally here, challenging Trios around the globe to compete where it all began as teams drop into Verdansk for a chance at their share of the $1M prize pool.

[b]Expansion Regions [/b](Not Broadcast)[b]:[/b] Qualifying trios from APAC, LATAM North and LATAM South will head to the Global Final later this year! The top eight performing Trios from these areas will secure their placement at the WSOW Global Final.

[b]EMEA & NA Qualifier Broadcasts: [/b]Tune in this July to the EMEA and NA qualifier broadcasts, as follows:

July 22 – NA Lower Round 2 (Eliminations Finals)

July 23 – EMEA Lower Round 2 (Elimination Finals)

July 29 – NA Regional Final

July 30 – EMEA Regional Final

The Regional Finals will decide the majority of the qualifying Trios for the Global Final, with 21 WSOW Global Final Trio spots open in each region. Catch all the action at [url=https://twitch.tv/callofduty]Twitch.tv/callofduty[/url].
[h3]Call of Duty: Warzone Solo Playlist Update[/h3]
At the start of Season 04, we launched a new playlist test by introducing Battle Royale Casual Solos. This was driven by the overwhelming success of Battle Royale Casual Quads, introduced in Season 03, which quickly became one of the most popular modes in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].

We are always reviewing engagement data to make sure we're continuing to deliver optimal gameplay experiences to as many players as possible. Over time, the data has shown that standard Solos has underperformed compared to other playlist options. This trend has become even more pronounced following the launch of [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i], with standard Solos consistently ranking at the bottom across over 20 available playlist options.

In an effort to solve this, we introduced a “Casual” version of Solos where players face off against a pool of real players in combination with a fixed number of bots, creating a lighter, more welcoming experience. Given the success of the Casual Quads format, we felt that Casual Solos could offer a more approachable way to play Solos—especially for returning or brand-new players jumping into [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].

To accurately test the appeal of Casual Solos, we removed standard Solos from the live playlist. This allowed us to isolate and better evaluate the impact of Casual Solos without overlapping between the two modes.

Here’s what we’ve learned so far:
[list]	[*]Three times more players jumped into Casual Solos compared to standard Solos[/*]	[*]Queue times, ping stability, and other matchmaking metrics saw notable improvements[/*]	[*]The mode was popular with both existing and returning players[/*][/list]
This test not only gave us deeper insight into the viability of a Casual Solos experience but also reaffirmed existing data around the low engagement of standard Solos. The results show that Casual Solos fills a gap in our playlist that many players are interested in.

The next step in our test—which launches today—is to make both modes available to further observe player preference. This side-by-side test is an important part of our ongoing effort to refine our playlist experience. We’ll share more results from this test at a later date.

While we want players to have the freedom to choose the experience that’s most enjoyable for them, it’s vital that we maintain a healthy and balanced ecosystem for our players.

Thank you to everyone who jumped into Casual Solos thus far. Your continued feedback and playtime are part of what helps shape the future of Call of Duty: Warzone.

As always, have fun and keep that feedback coming!

notes.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 7 confirmed
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Embrace the Madness[/u][/h2][p]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 7 has been confirmed.

In [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 7[/i], Treyarch and Raven Software are bringing players the most mind-bending [i]Black Ops[/i] ever. Developed as the next evolution of [i]Black Ops[/i], this is the first-ever consecutive release within the series, set more than 40 years after the events of [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. The year is 2035 and the world is on the brink of chaos, ravaged by violent conflict and psychological warfare following the events of [i][url="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JE9AIzPQbNw"]Black Ops 2[/url][/i] and [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. Wielding cutting-edge technology, David Mason and his team must fight back against a manipulative enemy who weaponizes fear above all else.

[/p][previewyoutube="uUo5gnaYB_w;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
Matt Cox, General Manager of Call of Duty, talks more about the planning behind [i]Black Ops 7’s[/i] full package of content: “The Black Ops universe is amazing. The creativity and imagination that goes into the storytelling, the rich character depth, and the incredible moment-to-moment gameplay across all modes is really exceptional. As a team, our vision from the start was to create a back-to-back series experience for our players that embraced the uniqueness of the Black Ops sub-franchise.”

Prepare to squad up with friends or play solo in a thrilling and innovative Co-op Campaign, harness near-future weaponry in a signature Multiplayer experience packed with brand-new maps and descend into the next twisted chapter of Round-Based Zombies in the heart of the Dark Aether. 

Players have a lot to look forward to later this year when [i]Black Ops 7[/i] releases, Matt Cox continues: “It delivers the full Call of Duty package for our players, and we can't wait to show the community more of what the studio teams have been working on when we reveal later this summer.”
[/p][h2][u]Official Teaser Release[/u][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c760fc9922045fe7e5a166fdd6d34b3b9a141458.jpg"][/img]
The road to [i]Black Ops 7[/i]’s reveal starts today with the Official Teaser Cinematic (shown above). Tyler Bahl, Head of Activision Publishing Marketing, provides more details: “The team is looking to build on the incredible community enthusiasm and excitement we’ve seen within the Black Ops universe. This is the first time we’re staying within the Black Ops series with back-to-back releases, so we’re excited to give players a bit more time to enjoy all the live seasons and provide players more of what they want across [i]Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i] before we turn the page to [i]Black Ops 7[/i].

“Our official teaser sets the tone for players to embrace the madness that’s incoming with [i]Black Ops 7’s[/i] story,” Bahl continues. “Delivering consecutive Black Ops games also allows our teams the tremendous opportunity to tap not only into our own creativity but also embrace the shift from a ’90s setting to the new 2035 future setting within our marketing.

“Today is only the beginning with this first teaser. The full reveal of [i]Black Ops 7[/i] is coming later this summer, so the community should be on the lookout for teases, clues and the surprises that the Black Ops series is known for. It’s an exciting time as we prepare for a new Call of Duty reveal, and the next great experience to come.”
