notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 04 Free Trial
notes.notes:
In celebration of Season 04 of [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i], get full access to Multiplayer and Zombies — including new Season 04 content — for a limited time from May 30 until June 3.

Experience the latest content, including the new Shutdown, Fugitive, and Blitz Multiplayer maps, plus the new Team Elimination game mode. In Zombies, play all available maps in either Standard or Directed Mode, and get competitive with the return of fan-favorite mode, Grief, where teams compete to be the last squad standing.
[h2][u]New Season 04 Multiplayer Maps[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b7de0e71ba281b84fed520b9a3eb544668f91c1a.jpg[/img]

[b]Shutdown (6v6):[/b] Travel to a hydroelectric plant in the rugged terrain of Iceland, the smoking remains of its central Turbine showing evidence of sabotage. Battle in and out of the facility and take a swim with passage from the Sluice down into the Lake bordering the plant’s Transformers. Move out to the north side of the map to get away from the water and bring the fight to the Yard, attacking enemies around a huge rock formation flanked by the Canteen and Pumphouse.

Get more intel on this map with our in-depth [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides/blackops6/multiplayer-maps/call-of-duty-guides-black-ops-6-multiplayer-map-guide-shutdown]Shutdown map guide[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/93c7a2a2c39248164d2ab7b0a9df22ba0991a893.jpg[/img]

[b]Fugitive (6v6): [/b]Descend on a secretive CIA black site where series villain Vikhor “Stitch” Kuzmin has been imprisoned since his confrontation with Special Agent Russell Adler in Verdansk. Flashing lights and blaring alarms signal an ongoing jailbreak, exacerbated by the roar of inmates in the background.

Traverse the large compound on foot and with the help of some strategically placed ziplines, perfect for ambushing enemy targets. Skirmish around the Entrance and Recreation Yard and keep your head on a swivel through the Checkpoint. When it’s time to get down to business, move into the compound itself, fighting through the Cell Block, Lobby, and Administration.

Get more intel on this map with our in-depth [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides/blackops6/multiplayer-maps/call-of-duty-guides-black-ops-6-multiplayer-map-guide-fugitive]Fugitive map guide[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9f3a9a808656afba6941d01316caef67c24f874f.jpg[/img]

[b]Blitz (6v6/2v2): [/b]Traffic comes to a dramatic halt as Pantheon and Rogue Team agents collide on the road. Take the fight straight to the enemy by moving up the Bridge or drop down to the Cliffside or Waterfall to battle it out over natural terrain. Maneuver underneath the Bridge to flank enemy players or pivot to the other side. Despite the map’s small size, the environment provides long sightlines across, giving a chance for all weapon classes to slay.

Get more intel on this map with our in-depth [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides/blackops6/multiplayer-maps/call-of-duty-guides-black-ops-6-multiplayer-map-guide-blitz]Blitz map guide[/url].
[h2][u]Play the New Team Elimination Mode[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dde077734ec91eadef1343ba287beb5fd5d12bd1.jpg[/img]

[i]Eliminate hostiles and pick up dog tags to drain the enemies’ lives[/i].

Team Elimination turns Kill Confirmed on its head in this high-octane variant where each team is given a limited number of lives every round as they battle to be the last team standing. Eliminated Operators drop a dog tag on death; if an enemy nabs it first, the kill is confirmed, and that team loses ones of their lives. If the fallen Operator’s teammate picks it up, that kill is denied. Survive longer than the other team or hold the most remaining lives at the end of the match to win the round.

If your team loses all their remaining lives, don’t give up hope! You can revive fallen teammates at this stage, bringing them back into the fight for a final attempt to seize the win.
[h2][u]Zombies: Outlast the Enemy in Grief[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9e9c27130e941142040ab1363f63e3faec49df49.jpg[/img]
[h3]Grief[/h3]
[i]4v4 competitive mode where two teams outwit and outlast each other. Capture zones to debuff enemies. No damage against other players. Respawns every third round.[/i]

[b]Available Maps: [/b]Liberty Falls, Terminus, Citadelle des Morts, The Tomb, Shattered Veil

[b]Restricted: [/b]Wonder Weapons, GobbleGums: Exit Strategy, Idle Eyes, Wonderbar!, Time Out, and Flavor Hex

First debuted in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 2[/i], Grief returns to Zombies in Season 04! In this competitive mode, two teams fight to be the last squad standing in a battle between S.A.M. and Director Richtofen.

Each team fights the undead horde in a sub-section of the chosen map. While opposing players can’t directly damage each other, you can slow down the enemy team through body-blocking or attacking with melee weapons and projectiles.

Rounds progress faster than usual, and you’ll be facing an increased number of zombies per round, given the eight-player nature of the mode. To really make things tough for your living opponents, move into Capture Zones that appear throughout the match; earn specific types of kills while inside the zone to trigger a Grief on the other team, including a variety of temporary debuffs like reduced damage, an ammo drain, a zombie ambush, and slowed movement speed.

The action is constant and frantic, so think fast, survive, and do everything in your power to put the enemy team through the wringer.
[h2][u]All Supported Maps and Modes[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8caf718390d6f5e2b3db4f39d6718d8d2ba733b6.jpg[/img]

[b]Multiplayer Maps and Modes: [/b]Full access to all Multiplayer maps, modes, and playlists available during the Free Trial period, including the new Season 04 maps and Team Elimination game mode. Multiplayer Ranked Play not included.

[b]Zombies Playlists: [/b]Full access to all Zombies maps, including Standard + Directed Mode for Liberty Falls, Terminus, Citadelle des Morts, The Tomb, and Shattered Veil, plus access to the returning fan-favorite competitive mode, Grief.
[h2]Upgrade to Black Ops 6 Today![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dfe1d6c0117670358a1ae7520ac817fd22b691c1.jpg[/img]

Black Ops 6 is available now, and there’s never been a better time to experience the spy action thriller Campaign, the in-depth tactical chaos of best-in-class Multiplayer, and soak in the gory glory of an incredible round-based Zombies experience! [url=https://www.callofduty.com/playnow/blackops6]Click here to Purchase Black Ops 6[/url].

The Truth Lies.

For Call of Duty Updates, follow @CODUpdates on X (formerly Twitter).[/i]

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 04 Battle Pass, BlackCell, and bundles
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Power Up with the Season 04 Battle Pass![/u][/h2]
Desperate to crack the Pantheon codenames, Russell Adler is forced to reunite with his nemesis Vikhor “Stitch” Kuzmin. Following the epic jailbreak leading to Stitch’s escape, it’s time to finally discover the identity of these traitors. Luckily, help is on the way. Get a preview of the BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Store content arriving in Season 04 of [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], launching May 29.

The Season 04 Battle Pass introduces 100+ rewards including new free base weapons plus new Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Calling Cards, Finishing Moves, and more.

Access free rewards including new cosmetic content and base weapons or purchase the premium Battle Pass and earn a 10% Battle Pass XP Boost and up to 1,100 COD Points as you progress through the Battle Pass Pages. For the optimal seasonal experience, purchase BlackCell, including exclusive Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, and other rewards.
[h2][u]BlackCell Season 04: Omen Operator (Crimson One)[/u][/h2]
[i]BlackCell Instant Rewards Page, HVT[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2d8a170a4ff89f054f49e7f4470b43204d708f26.jpg[/img]

Where the fog of war lays thickest on the battlefield, Omen prowls. Those unlucky enough to hear the rattle of his footsteps face a life sentence for their crimes. Each link of his ethereal chain is forged from a soul condemned to eternal imprisonment — a reminder that for those who deserve judgment, death is not the end. Omen leads the charge in Season 04 BlackCell content, including additional Operator Skins and Weapon Blueprints arriving straight from the netherworld.
[h3]Additional BlackCell Instant Rewards Content[/h3]
Get the ultimate Battle Pass experience by purchasing BlackCell, offering complete access to all the rewards available in the Season 04 Battle Pass. A purchase grants immediate access to the BlackCell Instant Rewards page, giving the following items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b324293774bab937f28f98486806877305f90977.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*]1,100 COD Points[/*]	[*]20 Battle Pass Tier Skips[/*]	[*]The “Omen” BlackCell Operator and Skin[/*]	[*]10% XP Boost[/*]	[*]The “Hellblock” Mastercraft Blueprint for the Ladra SMG[/*]	[*]The “Guard Dog” Companion Finishing Move[/*]	[*]The “Kill Tally” Gun Screen[/*]	[*]The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and Winner’s Circles)[/*]	[*]BlackCell Loyalty Bonus[/*][/list]


BlackCell owners can additionally unlock page after page of additional rewards throughout the Season 04 Battle Pass, including:
[list]	[*]Seven BlackCell-exclusive skins: Stitch (two skins), Bailey, Payne, Caine, Brutus, and Adler.[/*][/list][list]	[*]Seven BlackCell-exclusive Weapon Blueprints: Krig C (Assault Rifle), XMG (LMG), SWAT 5.56 (Marksman Rifle), ASG-98 (Shotgun), FFAR 1 (Assault Rifle), Model L (Assault Rifle), LC10 (SMG)[/*][/list][list]	[*]Over 130 item rewards (Battle Pass and BlackCell related) for those who fully complete the Season 04 BlackCell Battle Pass.[/*][/list]
Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.

[b]BlackCell Daily Challenges: [/b]Players with BlackCell will receive additional Daily Challenges throughout Season 04 for Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], giving even more chances to rake in the XP during your play sessions!

[b]BlackCell Loyalty Bonus:[/b] 10% XP and Weapon XP Loyalty Bonus for purchases of subsequent BlackCell seasons (up to 50% for BO6 seasons only).
[h2][u]Purchase the Battle Pass: Instantly Unlock Stitch Operator[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7d72d84b546c81e9d885f1bcae5cadac5440de82.jpg[/img]

Players who purchase the premium Season 04 Battle Pass or BlackCell will immediately unlock the Battle Pass Instant Rewards Page with the following items:
[list]	[*]The new Stitch Operator with “Supermax” Operator Skin and “Supermax BlackCell” Operator Skin for BlackCell owners.[/*]	[*]10% Battle Pass XP Boost.[/*]	[*]The “Lock Up” Legendary Weapon Blueprint for the Feng 82 LMG.[/*]	[*]The “Try Me!” Legendary Emote.[/*]	[*]The “Untamable” Large Decal.[/*][/list][h3]New Operator: Stitch (Rogue Black Ops)[/h3]
[i]Battle Pass Instant Reward Page, HVT[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cfdd56af6cab345f1d37671668546efa727f9cf7.jpg[/img]

Vikhor Kuzmin is an ex-KGB chemical weapons expert who headed the Nova 6 program at Rebirth Island until a CIA raid ended it in 1968. He reemerged as the head of the covert Soviet-based spy ring known as “Perseus,” causing widespread chaos during the Cold War. Stitch harbors a personal grudge against Russel Adler, the CIA agent who took his eye during the Rebirth operation. After the bombing of Verdansk, Stitch was wounded and taken into custody by Adler. He was remanded to a secure facility in Iceland to live out his days… until now.
[h3]Additional Battle Pass Operator Skins[/h3]
Progress through the Battle Pass to unlock additional content including a variety of Operator Skins, many paired with BlackCell variants featuring animated vapors rising from exposed muscle fibers and fragments of bone.
[h3]Bailey: “Nocturnal Scout” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 2[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0e5fc0605595a8627915298421b16ccedd959029.jpg[/img]

Outfitted in night-vision goggles and head to toe tactical gear, Bailey prepares for night operations prepped with the tools to overcome a variety of obstacles. In the BlackCell variant, half of her skull becomes visible for a menacing skeletal look, purple vapors rising from the exposed muscle fibers in her arms.
[h3]Payne: “Uniform” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 4[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/03e14d5de32d970d0c4105c44ba44348ef418c77.jpg[/img]

The F might stand for “fake,” but the disguise is on point as Payne dons the look of a field agent hoping that nobody looks too closely at his stitching. His plans seem to have backfired in the BlackCell variant, the Operator’s jaw loosened with gold chains around his arms and neck.
[h3]Grey: “Bounty” Skin[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass, Page 6[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0e9beb4b2b6c57d18a45f2f1c592170ea6b5c303.jpg[/img]

Grey slips on a Project Janus jacket with body armor over the top, paired with beige cargo pants and a backwards cap.
[h3]Caine: “Chow Time” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 7[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9e4532dd47c4f04c7d7de9dc27fc9c1b26d78c6f.jpg[/img]

Dressed as a line cook, Caine improvises with what’s on hand, strapping metal serving trays over his torso and taping magazines into a makeshift gauntlet. Serve up some pain in the undead BlackCell variant, an apple in his mouth and vapors rising from his broken skin.
[h3]Brutus: “Dreadwarden” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 9[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d2996a804e84f0dc0262a37da798be14aaf7f450.jpg[/img]

Suit up and squash any resistance as Brutus gears up in full tactical gear with heavy armor plating, a baton, and a helmet. In the BlackCell version, his armor is compromised, vapors rising from his exposed ribcage, the helmet deformed at the face.
[h3]Toro: “Early Release” Skin[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass Page 10[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/805afd9a627bbb3238fb6b797ebf7f0a80c66423.jpg[/img]

Official release or not, it’s time to leave the prison. With the escape plans marked into his skin, Toro gathers a gas mask, rope, zip ties, and flares intent on breaking free once and for all.
[h3]Adler: “Truth Chaser” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 12[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0173744b8d0acfcfaf65659022c2e8f195df5720.jpg[/img]

Get to the truth by any means necessary as Adler deploys in his iconic shades, blood splattered over his clothes as if he has just removed Stitch’s eye during that fateful scene in Rebirth Island. The tables are turned in the BlackCell variant, a dagger stuck in one eye, confined to chains.
[h3]Nazir: “Shrub Wise” Skin[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass, Page 13[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eef94f774c71b82b3e198376d028ef200f0e5392.jpg[/img]

Concealment and recon are Nazir’s top priorities in this Skin featuring cold weather fatigues, a helmet, gloves, and plentiful gear to help fight back against the elements.
[h3]Marshall: “Deadtide” Skin[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass, Page 14[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/323dd05ff82d0ee38620267486824b365d27231c.jpg[/img]

Dive into the abyss as Marshall climbs into full diving gear including a diving helmet, oxygen tank, camera, and monitoring tools to aid in the underwater mission at hand.
[h3]Season 04: Battle Pass Base Weapons[/h3]
Unlock two new Base Weapons in the Season 04 Battle Pass. All players can unlock these weapons for free at the start of the new season by progressing through their listed Battle Pass Pages.
[h3]LC10[/h3]
[i]SMG, Battle Pass Page 3, Page 14 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fd69f5875cc927ce48c0e3400b2ca61ddea2247d.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 42[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[b]Military Camos: [/b]27 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[b]Special Camos: [/b]6 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[b]Mastery Camos: [/b]12 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[i]Full-auto submachine gun. Excellent accuracy and range, with a moderate rate of fire. Average mobility and very slow handling for its class.[/i]

Players first got their hands on the LC10 SMG in [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops Cold War[/i], and now the iconic weapon returns in [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. An incredibly versatile SMG, its strong accuracy and range keep you competitive in longer ranged fights without sacrificing performance up close. The weapon handles slowly for an SMG, so keep your eyes sharp and stay one step ahead of the enemy.
[h3]FFAR 1[/h3]
[i]Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Page 6, Page 11 HVT Tier Battle Pass Blueprint [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7caf26d517ab5ecc68b09a03e81eb30833b54b74.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 42[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[b]Military Camos: [/b]27 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[b]Special Camos: [/b]6 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[b]Mastery Camos: [/b]12 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[i]Full-auto assault rifle. Very high rate of fire and excellent CQB power, but slower handling and mobility.[/i]

The fan-favorite FFAR 1 Assault Rifle returns in Season 04, favored and feared for its blazing fast fire rate. While each round inflicts only moderate damage, the shots add up quickly if you can stay on target. Its predictable upward kick isn’t difficult to manage and can be further mitigated via attachments. Consider Extended Mag or Fast Mag to minimize your downtime reloading, a constant companion with this ammo hungry gun.
[h3]New Weapon Attachment[/h3]
For locking on and staying on target, the G-Grip’s got your back.
[h3]G-Grip (Launch)[/h3]
[i]SMGs (except PP-19), Assault Rifles, Battle Pass Page 7 Reward [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0fede7c5c4c2d37934e230d4fc786ed2b0c0978b.jpg[/img]

Lock on and stay on target by equipping this vertical foregrip with integrated laser for improved firing stability, horizontal recoil control, and tightened spread when transitioning between hipfire and aiming down sights. Beam: Blue. Blocks Laser attachments.

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 04: Full intel revealed, part 1
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Old Enemies, New Alliances: Black Ops 6 Season 04 is Here![/u][/h2][h3]Season 04 Overview: Keep Your Enemies Close…[/h3]
Though he once had the chance to end Vikhor “Stitch” Kuzmin’s reign of terror, Adler spared his nemesis after they met at the culmination of [i]Black Ops Cold War[/i]. Latest intel reveals Kuzmin was later captured and locked up in an Icelandic CIA black site until he might prove useful. Following the events and evidence uncovered by the deceased CIA Agent Jason Hudson, that day has come, and in an unlikely team up, Adler and team have broken Stitch out from his confinement, seeking his help to crack the codenames needed to find the Pantheon moles.

[previewyoutube=I65a4O5U_5k;full][b][u][[TRAILER VIDEO]][/u][/b][/previewyoutube]

With Verdansk once again an area of operations for deployment, what other plans might Stitch have in store? For now, Adler needs him to complete the mission at hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1895b567e5715092444c7fe4cd086c597ac41770.jpg[/img]

To succeed, the two must put their past behind them in pursuit of a new goal. Get in on the action when this stacked offering of free and premium content comes to [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6,[/i] launching in Season 04 on Thursday, May 29 at 9AM PT.

[b]Nomenclature Note:[/b] Throughout the blog, you’ll see references to when gameplay content launches. Here are what these various suffixes mean:

[b]“Launch”:[/b] Expect to access this content immediately at the Season launch.

[b]“Launch Window”: [/b]Expect to access this content between launch and up to 72 hours after launch.

[b]“In Season”:[/b] Expect to access this content during the season, but before either the mid-season or next season arrives.

[b]“Mid-Season”:[/b] Expect to access this content at Mid-Season or later.

All content timing may be subject to change.
[h2][u]Season 04 Multiplayer Content[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bcdae49c6ee79411d5b84f7f7c2b236741cfc897.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Five MP Maps:[/b] Drop into Icelandic AOs with three new maps at launch including the Shutdown and Fugitive 6v6 Core maps and the Blitz Strike map. In the mid-season, party it up in Eclipse and play a reimagined Fringe.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New and Returning Modes:[/b] Pick up dog tags to drain the enemy’s reserves in Team Elimination, a fun new twist on the Kill Confirmed formula. Make every bullet count with the return of One in the Chamber and get festive in the Party Ops Limited-Time Mode.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Additional Equipment: [/b]The Grim Reaper Scorestreak returns from the original [i]Black Ops[/i], offering an explosive payload that’s guaranteed to blow the competition sky high.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Season 04 Ranked Play: [/b]Challenge the best of the best, get those wins, and climb the Ranks in a new season of Multiplayer Ranked Play, with all-new rewards and bragging rights.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][h3]Shutdown (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/076012c818a7bc29ab5e930b5cb896e4c48caaa7.jpg[/img]

Before breaking out Stitch, Adler and team first need to cut off the power to the black site prison, bringing them to a hydroelectric plant built on the rugged volcanic terrain of Iceland. Fight in and around the central building housing the now wrecked Turbine or dive down the Sluice into the Lake, its waters hugging the plant’s south end by the Transformers. Jump up by the red container to target enemies from far out or swim back onshore to reach the Atrium and Parking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5629934fb7da67e1d0aa63c115b4b3ee9d08a071.jpg[/img]

Head to the north side to fight in the rugged Yard, away from the shoreline and bookended by the Pumphouse and Canteen. It’s a quick run to the Turbine from here, giving you good map coverage down the middle. If things get too hot, you can always drop down the Chute and swim your way to safety.
[h3]Fugitive (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a43b6cebb76fac4eca289ed2e52f3c4948087b68.jpg[/img]

Deploy to a secret CIA black site in a remote part of Iceland, the very location where Stitch has been imprisoned until Adler brings him in as an unlikely ally for an urgent operation. With the power out, Adler and his crew seize their chance to infiltrate the prison, climbing, zipping, and battling their way through the frozen compound.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e8d9320d86116b8b9a724aacfcf693ae593eb42f.jpg[/img]

Upon reaching their target, Adler and Stitch strike a deal. Following the jailbreak, the alarms are blaring and warnings of a power failure light up the Cell Block.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ec4d6428f1ae665d3131941b660c16ce55ce9dfd.jpg[/img]

Though the area may appear smaller than expected when first glancing at the minimap, the prison’s intricate layout presents multiple levels and shortcuts to the various outside areas including the Checkpoint, Courtyard, and Recreation Yard. In the upper Cell Block, newly opened cells present the danger of ambush. Be on guard and look for ziplines for quick access to your next target.
[h3]Blitz (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Strike, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/002860f0b1824ecce768ffd5eecbc6b9f45350c8.jpg[/img]

Traffic comes to a halt as Pantheon reinforcements race toward the prison but get ambushed by the Rogue team. Leave the road and seek out targets over the rugged terrain of the Cliffside or move inland, ambushing enemies at the Waterfall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e2650251f4aedf0ddd848e7a488e7d2fe74882ad.jpg[/img]

To approach the battle head on, move down the central Bridge, using the scattered convoy for cover. Jump down from the center to move underneath the Bridge, a great means of pivoting to a new location. Though a small map overall, Blitz’s long lanes leave room for marksmen to shine.
[h3]Eclipse (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Strike, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/49703d312f6ed4e24569ed17c1a12e225a95e809.jpg[/img]

Stitch and the team arrive in Avalon, slipping into the shadows of an underground nightclub to discuss business. The neon lights flicker as they form a plan to break the Pantheon codenames, but the meeting is cut short when Pantheon agents storm in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5e4b316821055e46636b3ef97266572dc6aaf2ab.jpg[/img]

Show off your best moves on the dance floor, dodging shots and flanking targets down the sides where seating offers party goers a chance to rest and order a drink from the bar. Ambush passing enemies from the DJ booth and then break through the broken façades on the walls, escaping into the halls.
[h3]Fringe (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]Remaster, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/21e674268fbaac3aced4a2de363c8ccee132d54c.jpg[/img]

Revisit Fringe from [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 3[/i], reimagined for the first time ever in [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. Attend the grand opening of the Rolling Hills distillery, established in an idyllic setting with several navigable buildings and the surrounding grounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cd101858748d6ec8a8eedfa2d21f84fc2dedba30.jpg[/img]

Battle along the main Road or dive into the Bar for a closer fight. Watch for sharpshooters in the upper Barn and along the Bridge and relive the thrill of trying to make it out alive through the narrow Loading route.
[h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3]
The first half of Season 04 brings two exciting Multiplayer modes: Team Elimination and One in the Chamber. In the mid-season, loosen up in the Party Ops Limited Time Mode.
[h3]Team Elimination (Launch)  [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/56ef1484594d82d17e44bf266946a0131e8112a0.jpg[/img]

In this twist on Kill Confirmed, two teams are given a limited amount of lives each round as they fight to be the last surviving team. Players drop a dog tag on death that can be picked up by the enemy to confirm the kill or by a teammate to deny the opposing team. Survive longer than the other team or hold the most remaining lives when the timer ends to win the round.

Balance aggression and defense as you seek out enemy dog tags while preserving your life. Dig in with your teammates to counter enemy attacks and then ask for cover while you collect the droppings. Picking up tags is a great way to earn your next Scorestreak, so stay aggressive and keep up the momentum. Once your team’s life pool is drained, your remaining teammates can still revive you where you were last killed in a last-ditch effort to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat.
[h3]One in the Chamber (In-Season)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/62a342e46a3b78253846286f6bfc8482bc53d776.jpg[/img]

Another [i]Black Ops [/i]fan-favorite mode returns as One in the Chamber shows up in Season 04! In this free-for-all mode, each Operator is given one pistol, one bullet, a knife, and three lives. Precision is king, as bullets always eliminate on impact and the only way to earn another bullet is to get an elimination.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/766b05e078f06bbf1951074c4f476ab8f250bba4.jpg[/img]

Stay cool, aim true, and preserve your lives while aiming for the highest score. UAV scans keep the action moving, so don’t try to hide. At the end of the match, the top three scoring Operators will step up to the Winner’s Circle.
[h3]Party Ops (Mid-Season)[/h3]
Get the party started with a new Limited-Time Mode arriving later in the season: Compete in a randomized set of party themed minigames. The player with the highest score at the end of the match wins it all.
[h3]Additional Gameplay Content[/h3]
The devastating Grim Reaper Scorestreak is back from the original [i]Black Ops[/i], unleashing massive hits on other Operators and Scorestreaks alike.
[h3]New Scorestreak[/h3]
[b]Scorestreak: Grim Reaper (In-Season)[/b]

[b]Type: [/b]Lethal

[b]Score: [/b]725

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5024508d1990296765047a24c309421df5b220e5.jpg[/img]

[i]Powerful semi-automatic launcher that can fire up to four rockets in one load.[/i]

Wield the Grim Reaper, a quad tube loaded Launcher capable of inflicting heavy damage on enemies. Whether targeting Operators or locking on to enemy Scorestreaks, the Grim Reaper’s payload delivers a huge explosion. The weapon is lost if you’re taken out, so save it for the right moment and bring backup to ensure you have the protection needed to unleash havoc.
[h3]Multiplayer Ranked Play (Launch Window)[/h3][h3]Season 04 Ranked Play Overview[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/82ca77fee0eada09c89e0f89df3e7c821b5f840d.jpg[/img]

Prove you’re the very best by dedicating your Multiplayer match time to Ranked Play, using the same settings, maps, modes, and weapon restrictions used by the Call of Duty League™. Win matches to earn SR (Skill Rating) and progress through the Ranks while earning career rewards like Rank Skins and Win Challenge rewards.

As usual, match wins ensure you progress through the Ranks throughout Season 04 to earn new seasonal rewards like a new Pro Issue Weapon Blueprint, Rank-themed Calling Cards, Ranked Charms, and more:
[h3]Season 04 Ranked Play Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2644c7ad7de06947efc9411b42e0e8ca6bcd5d5d.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*]Get 10 Wins: “Pro Reissue AMES 85” AMES 85 Weapon Blueprint[/*]	[*]Get 100 Wins: “Ranked Season 4 – 100 Wins” Large Decal[/*]	[*]Silver: “Ranked Season 4 – Silver” Calling Card[/*]	[*]Gold: “Ranked Season 4 – Gold” Calling Card and Charm[/*]	[*]Platinum: “Ranked Season 4 – Platinum” Calling Card and Charm[/*]	[*]Diamond: “Ranked Season 4 – Diamond” Calling Card and Charm[/*]	[*]Crimson: “Ranked Season 4 – Crimson” Calling Card and Charm[/*]	[*]Iridescent: “Ranked Season 4 – Iridescent” Calling Card and Charm[/*]	[*]Top 250: “Ranked Season 4 – Top 250” Calling Card and Charm[/*]	[*]Season 04 Champion: “Ranked Season 4 – Top 250 Champion” Calling Card[/*][/list]
[b]Note: Multiplayer Events:[/b] Check the General section later in this blog to uncover the full complement of events for this mode across Season 04.

[b]Season 04 Zombies Content[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0069b92bf74b2f6f1ad27caf83114c784f04b91d.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			
[b]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/b]
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Grief Returns![/b] Drop into this epic 4v4 competitive battle on all maps, outlasting the opposition while securing Capture Zones to debuff and Grief your opponents. The last team still standing wins!
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Additional Gameplay Content:[/b] Crack open the armored undead and create area-of-effect explosions with the Shatter Blast Ammo Mod, chew over the impressive effects of three new GobbleGums, and create even bigger explosions with the Grim Reaper Support launcher.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Modes and More: [/b]Unlock hidden rewards with more Dark Ops Challenges, then prepare to face down a powered-up Abomination, survive as long as you can in the Starting Room LTM, and prove your Leaderboard worth by zombie slaying for bragging rights and rewards!
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Grief (Mode, Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/35545dc475267e1590fceab6822fb549e7f243d2.jpg[/img]

[i]4v4 competitive mode where two teams outwit and outlast each other. Capture zones to debuff enemies. No damage against other players. Respawns every third round.[/i]

[b]Available Maps:[/b] Liberty Falls, Terminus, Citadelle des Morts, The Tomb, Shattered Veil.

[b]Restricted: [/b]Wonder Weapons, GobbleGums: Exit Strategy, Idle Eyes, Wonderbar!, Time Out, and Flavor Hex (Season 04 GobbleGum).

Not seen since [i]Black Ops 2[/i], Grief returns to Zombies! This fan-favorite mode pits two teams of four against each other, with both sides vying to out-survive the other. As the battlelines are drawn between S.A.M. and Director Richtofen, each team pledges their support to one of these rivals at the start of a match, subsequently receiving handler comms support from one of them throughout the ensuing chaos.
[h3]Indirect PvP Combat[/h3]
The action is almost immediate as both teams drop into either side of the same Grief Arena within the chosen Zombies map, and indirect PvP combat comes into effect: The two teams of four players can’t outright kill members of the enemy team, but [i]can[/i] interact with them by body-blocking, or slowing them by using melee, bullet-based weapons, or projectiles.

[b]Victory Conditions: [/b]The winning team is the one that manages to “Grief” their rivals into being killed or entering a downed state. As long as one or more team members are upright, the match continues!
[h3]Grief Arena Features[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/483843e303a4e6c767b154a3119c5f92d61abb36.jpg[/img]

The action is constant and can get incredibly chaotic, due in part to your proximity to your opponents and the hordes of undead encroaching on your team, thanks to the Arena being a sub-section of the main Zombies map. These are known as “Grief Arenas.” Within a Grief Arena are a variety of features:

[b]An Open Environment: [/b]Grief Arenas are clearly defined areas where any critical doors have already been opened, and the power will already have been turned on. All other Door Buys are inactive. Both teams spawn on opposite sides of the Arena, each in a group of four.

[b]Player Respawning: [/b]Any team members that are downed – provided one or more of their team are still alive – can be revived at any time, though rival teams, undead enemies, and Shock Charges can hamper this action! Additionally, a Wave Respawner triggers every third round, automatically reviving any eliminated teammates from both teams.

[b]Join In Progress:[/b] Any player not in the game can join up until Round 10 has been completed and has a small grace period to orient themselves before they’re swarmed by zombies. Additionally, if a team has won back-to-back Capture Zones (see below), join-in-progress is not available.

[b]Essence and Salvage:[/b] Unlike in Standard playlists, Salvage pickups in Grief are worth 100 Salvage, visible to all players, and can only be picked up by the first player to grab it.

[b]Zombies:[/b] Rounds will progress faster than usual and the amount of zombies per round has been increased to account for 8 players! All undead entities – except for bosses – are to be expected. If players fail to kill zombies, the round will turn.

[b]Core Mechanics:[/b] The Arsenal, Pack-a-Punch, Mystery Box, Crafting Tables, Perk machines, GobbleGum machine (with Exit Strategy, Idle Eyes, Wonderbar!, Time Out, and Flavor Hex restricted), Armor Wall Buys, and Der Wunderfizz machine are available in a Grief Arena where they normally reside, or in a new location if they don’t normally exist in this portion of their respective maps. [b]Note: [/b]While the current GobbleGum restrictions are in place to keep matches dynamic yet balanced, additional restrictions may be made in the future as the developers keep an eye on game balance, similar to Ranked Play.

[b]Capture Zones:[/b] Appearing at a regular cadence during a match, these are smaller areas within a Grief Arena where players are required to stand and earn specific types of kills to trigger a Grief on the opposing team.
[h3]Plan A: Survive! Plan B: Capture Zones![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9f7a4630f009b66f3ad186c34b83ac5659280065.jpg[/img]

Keeping your team upright and focused on undead slaying for longer than your rivals is the main plan in this mode. However, there’s an important secondary focus you need to plan for: Capturing zones and “Griefing” your rival team!

Capture Zones appear at regular intervals throughout a match, and after stepping through the glowing perimeter, you and your team can secure the Zone by staying inside it and dispatching zombies. Beckon your crew into a Zone to quicken the zombie slaying, and once your kill count meets the requirement, a Grief is triggered on the opposition. Note that if neither team reaches this requirement within the countdown inside a Capture Zone, the Grief is applied to both teams.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d05a413edf8017e053a797352fde309bb98e1970.jpg[/img]

[b]What is a Grief?[/b] It’s a temporary debuff, penalty, or negative gameplay mechanic that you can inflict on your rival team at a Capture Zone.

The type of Grief is shown at the objective tracker within a Capture Zone. Here are the possible Griefs you’re aiming to inflict on your foes:

[b]Weapon Nerf:[/b] The affected players inflict considerably reduced damage to zombie enemies.

[b]Ammo Drain:[/b] All ammo-based weapons, including those stowed, receive an ammo drain with bullets or shells being removed constantly while the Grief is active.

[b]Zombie Ambush:[/b] An Elite zombie is summoned, and it solely focuses its killing power on the enemy team until either the Elite or the team are defeated, or the timer runs out.

[b]Weapon Carousel:[/b] The rival players’ weapons are randomly swapped every few seconds.

[b]Frozen:[/b] This Grief reduces the enemy players’ movement, along with frost and ice coating the characters.

Griefs and Capture Zones also introduce new score types, including:

[b]Capture Zone Kill: [/b]Awarded to a player who defeated a zombie type during a successful Capture Zone completion.

[b]Capture Zone Win: [/b]Awarded to all players on a team who successfully commandeer a Capture Zone.

[b]Capture Zone Elite Kill: [/b]Awarded to a player who slays an Elite spawned in a Capture Zone.
[h3]Available Grief Arenas (11 Arenas, Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9673a5a8d3dc4d277277db7b7393c17f7be691da.jpg[/img]

A total of 11 different Grief Arenas are available in this mode. Here’s a list along with a brief description of the points of interest within each one:

[b]Liberty Falls Arena 1: [/b]Pump & Pay, Motor Lodge, and Fuller’s Liberty Lanes

[b]Liberty Falls Arena 2: [/b]Dark Aether Church, Cemetery, Hilltop

[b]Terminus Arena 1: [/b]Bio Lab

[b]Terminus Arena 2: [/b]Crab Island

[b]Citadelle des Morts Arena: [/b]Courtyard, Ramparts, and Entrance Hall

[b]The Tomb Arena 1: [/b]Dig Site, Mausoleum

[b]The Tomb Arena 2: [/b]Dark Aether Nexus

[b]Shattered Veil Arena 1: [/b]Garden Pond, Lower Terrace

[b]Shattered Veil Arena 2: [/b]Upper Terrace, Shem’s Henge, Motor Court

[b]Shattered Veil Arena 3: [/b]Mansion Foyer, Overlook, East Foyer, Library

[b]Shattered Veil Arena 4: [/b]West Hallways, Southwest Balcony, Bottlery
[h3]New Challenges and Limited Time Modes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f103c9d5f0b2e88172bf7b2483fe4dc340b3b4e0.jpg[/img]

Access the following new content within all five Zombies Maps (unless otherwise stated) throughout Season 04:
[h3]Dark Ops Challenges (Launch)[/h3]
A mysterious new set of hidden Calling Cards and bounteous amounts of XP are available at the start of Season 04, thanks to a fresh drop of Zombies Dark Ops Challenges. Who knows... maybe there’s even one for Grief. All further information is [[REDACTED]].
[h3]New LTM: Starting Room (Mid-Season)[/h3]
Inspired by the starting room in the classic “Moon” Zombies map, drop in with up to three of your Zombies crew into a more straightforward but challenging experience where you’re locked into the first zone of a map. Raptor One is gone, and those undead hordes are only getting stronger, but all doors in the initial zone are locked. Survive to the highest round you can!
[h3]New LTM: Abomination Challenge (Mid-Season)[/h3]
Enter a warped version of Liberty Falls during this new Mid-Season Event, and hunt down an ultra-powered-up Abomination. Perhaps it’s wise to bring backup.
[h3]New Gameplay Content and GobbleGums[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fe4adcdea0849a9ed33f7980ca91fd6a600d7873.jpg[/img]

Wreck even the most battle-hardened undead threat with the explosive power of the Shatter Blast Ammo Mod, then drop even more devastating firepower on the hordes with the Grim Reaper Support launcher. There’s three new chewables, too!
[h3]Ammo Mod: Shatter Blast (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Available: Augments Menu, and In-Game (Pause Menu)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7de6d94dc154a214b4cef83dd1d326260ceadc62.jpg[/img]

[i]“Bullets deal explosive damage. Each bullet has a chance to create an explosion that destroys armor.”[/i]

Modify your ammunition to explode the toughened armor of certain normal and Special undead enemies. This mod also has a second benefit, creating an area-of-effect blast radius at the same time, whether any armor is shattered or not.

Due to the somewhat chaotic nature of this modification, there is a random chance of the Shatter Blast effect triggering, and it won’t happen every time you fire. Also expect a cooldown period after the effect. Note that Shatter Blast doesn’t directly affect Elite enemies (pending some Augment research!), but area-of-effect explosions can still damage them.

You are wise to wrangle your undead into hordes so they’re near each other, to really inflict some damage!
[h3]Shatter Blast: Major Augments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/97af3d2946e725fffcade64c00cc4d34d6075070.jpg[/img]

Research the following Augments to further customize this Ammo Mod.

[b]Big Game[/b]

Shatter Blast can be used against Elite enemies. Expect an impressively sized explosion.

[b]Blast Chain[/b]

On explosion, three additional explosions occur in rapid succession.

[b]Blast Repair[/b]

For every enemy that has its armor destroyed by Shatter Blast, armor health will be restored for the player.
[h3]Shatter Blast: Minor Augments[/h3]
[b]Blast Zone[/b]

Increase the size of the explosion.

[b]Blast Boost[/b]

Increase the explosion damage.

[b]Blast Wave[/b]

Normal enemies are knocked down by the explosion.
[h3]New GobbleGums (Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fe8c0e36a28c68a89e508a4a2ba05a47a5e0016d.jpg[/img]

Crack your teeth on three new GobbleGums, available across all maps once you earn or unlock them and equip them in your GobbleGum Loadout Pack.

[b]Explosive Flourish (Epic): [/b]Reloading your weapon creates an explosion around you. GobbleGum lasts 2 minutes.

[b]Flavor Hex (Legendary): [/b]Activates a random Ultra GobbleGum.

[b]Rainburps (Whimsical): [/b]Zombies killed belch sparkly rainbow bubbles. Lasts 3 minutes.
[h3]Additional Support Weapon : Grim Reaper (In-Season)[/h3]
[i]Available: Rivals Event reward[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/230a24996a647b2aabfc0876f098f314d66ac7b6.jpg[/img]

[b]Salvage: 2000[/b]

Hammer away at the Crafting Table and assemble a powerful semi-automatic launcher known as the Grim Reaper, which deals out lethal damage to the undead with up to a quartet of missiles fired in one load. With a capacity to carry up to a dozen rockets, and the ability to fire them individually or as a quartet of devastation, this can level a courtyard of undead with a single launch! Unlock this Support weapon once you’ve earned it via the Rivals Event.

[b]Note: Zombies Events:[/b] Check the General section later in this blog to uncover the full complement of events for this mode across Season 04, including the King of the Dead Leaderboard challenge!

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 04: Full intel revealed, part 2
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Warzone: Season 04 Content [/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cef07443dbd047ef0229f8e8ccbb25a1b9866dc5.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE™ SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Point of Interest:[/b] The towering skyscraper known as The Overlook comes to Downtown Verdansk, with ziplines, cranes, and an impressive interior to explore.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New and Limited Time Modes:[/b] Clash mode – the massive 52v52 Verdansk Deathmatch – is back! Join 51 other Operators in a chaotic firefight to claim domination points and defeat foes. Then compete in a specially themed area of Verdansk in a match with rule-bending modifiers in Havoc Royale. And drop into Rebirth Island for a spot of Resurgence Casual human and bot combat.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Doubling Down on Ranked Play: [/b]Call of Duty: Warzone doubles down – literally – with two separate Ranked Play modes; Battle Royale: Ranked (Verdansk) at launch running throughout the entire season, and the return of Ranked Play to Rebirth Island at Mid-season.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Features:[/b] Cranes and horizontal ziplines Downtown. Lobby Lockdown in The Overlook.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]New Point of Interest: The Overlook (Verdansk, Downtown, Launch)[/h3]
Look up and look out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6c50e430b025098e93a3373982900f854422698a.jpg[/img]

Dominate foes with a gigantic new skyscraper point of interest, available to Operators within the vicinity of Downtown! The old tenement blocks, Burger Town, and SKN Comm tower have been demolished, and construction crews are finalizing a sprawling skyscraper that dominates the landscape! Look for a full recon tour below.
[h3]Recon Tour: The Overlook[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2d06ba6f290ab6e354f68a6a30ccc02abab4faf9.jpg[/img]

As construction nears completion on this behemoth of a skyscraper (more than twice the height of any previous building within the Verdansk conurbation), it’s worth gaining a tactical advantage on this monolithic new point of interest.
[h3]The Overlook Footprint: The “Diamond” and Perimeter Security Checkpoints[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/87234e96b4e56380b19cf02b8d09145cc2fb14cd.jpg[/img]

Drop into the grounds of The Overlook, and you’ll immediately see the grounds of the new skyscraper under construction stretch in a rough diamond shape around the location of the old SKN Comm Tower. Flanked by two massive cranes, the building plot perimeter runs from the corner of the main bank, clockwise past the Post Office, passing the Rothwynn Donna building, northeast to the Museum/Art Gallery, and follows the road around to City Hall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1705883750d4f49bc16e311bfa68f36bbe95e018.jpg[/img]

All the older structures (the Burger Town, low-rise tenement blocks, the building site, and the small coffee shop and bar across from the Museum) have been bulldozed in the name of progress!
[h3]Perimeter Security Checkpoints[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e706e8492c32543bd840ce3b75b4a1fea8426682.jpg[/img]

Military-style security checkpoints have been set up on the corners and roads of the plot of land within the footprint of the structure. Most aren’t secure enough to impede vehicular progress, and some have ramps to allow airborne access. These serve as helpful visual cues that you’re entering the new POI, The Overlook.
[h3]Ground Level: Construction Sites[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/df4a6a95b6c8da678a2dd4135cb9f0ec68be093c.jpg[/img]

Most of the groundwork around the skyscraper is in its final stages of completion, but there are plenty of barriers, fencing, canopies, and containers to use as cover in the area below each of the two giant cranes north and south of the structure.
[h3]Ground Level: Restaurants[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6a1395b97e2d94ffd1747d4ffbd93f645348a4e.jpg[/img]

[b]Burger Town: [/b]Fans of the famous Burger Town Double Cheeseburger will be thrilled to know the fast-food chain has relocated a few meters further down the road from its previous location and is contained within the massive footprint of The Overlook. This outlet also serves as a lower entrance into the grand foyer interior of the building.

[b]Sushi Bar: [/b]Diagonally opposite the Burger Town, on the northwest side of the POI, is a small Sushi bar, within the footprint of the tower itself. Nestled in the stepped courtyard, you can quickly advance to the north crane or main lobby entrance. It’s also worth pointing out that the sight lines around this POI have significantly changed since Season 03, with much greater visibility across familiar POIs within Downtown and the surrounding districts.
[h3]North and South Cranes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8a06bd964a479b00da64a67d4233a3af852f4b36.jpg[/img]

Two huge cranes flank the north and south side of the monolith and are another way to traverse into The Overlook at great height. With five separate platforms attached to the mast to land on (two at ground, and three at height), use the vertical Ascender built into the crane’s mast and take an eight-second ascent to a platform just below the jib that extends out to the main winch, and the hoist allowing a jump to The Overlook roof. Operators who aren’t challenged by vertigo will have wild and panoramic views that extend to all of Verdansk’s POIs (except Quarry)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2ba9a17b6f0493dc0e27da1f2bbe17471204a88a.jpg[/img]

Both cranes are also functional, and providing you’ve found the necessary controls in the vicinity (both on and off the cranes’ superstructures), cargo on the hook block and hoist can be summoned and moved to various locations around the tower and nearby Downtown buildings, in case you or your team needs a daring lift!
[h3]Zip Lines and Additional Rooftop Cover[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/737b89a69a9a9f0987a23b75b65fc57f2cd3accf.jpg[/img]

Increasing the ways you can quickly traverse and gain (or lose) great height in your tactical positioning near The Overlook exterior, zip-lines provide a diagonal route to and from the surrounding Downtown building rooftops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ceb764557db74e590d591256a934decd45eba1f7.jpg[/img]

Each also has a small billboard or other protective cover as you reach the zipline mechanism. Access to and from Overlook at the following locations:
[list]	[*][b]South:[/b] Post Office rooftop to Skydeck.[/*]	[*][b]West:[/b] Rothwynn Donna building rooftop to Skydeck.[/*]	[*][b]Northeast:[/b] Art Gallery/Museum rooftop to Skydeck.[/*]	[*][b]East: [/b]City Hall dome rooftop to Skydeck.[/*][/list][h3]The Overlook: Entrance and Lobby Lockdown[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/220bd55e1ad549bd0e262639ef0ec710b7de5846.jpg[/img]

The Overlook has a substantial exterior and interior presence, mainly tiered fountains, planting, and stairs up to forecourts and shuttered entrances to the north, east, south, and west, all leading to a central interior lobby. If you find the main entrances shuttered, it means the lobby is experiencing a lockdown. Perhaps there’s a way to breach this security? Are there other ways to get in?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e47260b91255f32f87c2573c85989a66209d7d43.jpg[/img]

The interior lobby has a coffee shop, mezzanine office, stairs, a variety of cover options, and other areas to investigate, not least the marginally terrifying 18-storey elevator ascenders to the northeast and southwest, and even those only get you halfway up the inside of the tower.
[h3]The Overlook: Atrium and Skydeck (Interior, Exterior)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0e6a2ab2b8fbf7ee4411d0320bd92f6378937d18.jpg[/img]

Just above the midway point within The Overlook tower is a five-floor interior with exterior Skydeck. Depending on your use of ziplines, you’re able to access a large Atrium with concrete tile and planters and an abundance of plant life. Around the perimeter are rooms, stairwells, and two new elevator shafts, all enabling you to reach the exterior Skydeck.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d70f70dd01ecd02c78ab967ae9a37ec06eb7aeab.jpg[/img]

Known by some locals as the “cyclops” tower, due to this large central upper opening you can fly a helicopter through, the Skydeck features a small glass pyramid, some windswept seating, and infiltration to the floors above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a912c5d13c92a5e4c63da9c75c03ce0b5fd017be.jpg[/img]

The large, rectangular holes on all four sides provide zipline access around Downtown, as well as daring helicopter maneuvers through the gaps. The ascent doesn’t end here; enter any of the four pillars holding up the roof of the skyscraper for another elevator ascender ride.
[h3]The Overlook: Penthouse (Interior), Roof (Exterior)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ca48c28a1fcc6c2a98a6662328960b3794969ed3.jpg[/img]

The remaining upper floors of The Overlook are nearing completion, meaning health and safety rules aren’t being observed as stringently as you’d like. Top floors up from the Skydeck is the roof. Missing windows, exterior gantries without railings, and exposed exterior ladders mean you’ll be thankful for your parachute.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9e7986b72f1d37f84405fbabeb31848bb96162b4.jpg[/img]

Depending on which of the tower corners you’re fighting through, this offers another five floors to investigate, including rooms that are fully furnished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/27b7319c738bd9bfe6fe99ceb5ac7996a350daf0.jpg[/img]

These include a security and server room, a two-floor penthouse level with opulent bedroom, kitchen, and games area, and that’s before the more perturbed of Operators learn the secrets of the [[REDACTED]] room!
[h3]Season 04 Modes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2c6698561ba25dd4f5e39a01ae734dc8f9812886.jpg[/img]

As well as the usual Battle Royale and Resurgence playlists across Verdansk and Rebirth Island, major modes – Clash and Battle Royale: Ranked Play – return to the game, with the intriguing Havoc Royale and the arrival of Resurgence: Ranked Play on Rebirth Island at mid-season!
[h3]Clash LTM (Launch)[/h3]
[i]104 players (52v52), 15-minute matches[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ddbf794b6da47263f925b154f36089f0202e72fe.jpg[/img]

52v52 Team Deathmatch chaos is back in Call of Duty: Warzone!

First introduced into Call of Duty: Warzone during Season Five of Black Ops Cold War back in September 2021 as a revamped version of the original “Rumble” mode, Clash is back, bigger than ever, and now includes some impressive, game-changing equipment and power-ups only available in this mode. But what is Clash Mode?

This is Team Deathmatch and Domination on a massive scale!
[h3]Overview, Win Conditions, and Scoring[/h3]
This action-packed team-based mode takes place in and around a specific POI within Verdansk, and pits two teams of 52 players (divided into 13 Quad Squads per side) against each other. With no Circle Collapse, no last stand benefit for the Survivor Perk, and your Loadouts available immediately, the plan is simple; your side needs to acquire 500 points by the end of the 15-minute time limit. These are mainly gained by slaying enemies (sometimes aided with power ups you can acquire within a match), completing contracts, and participating in the in-game Public Events, as well as the following:

Scoring:
[list]	[*]1 point per enemy elimination[/*]	[*]2 points per enemy elimination with Double Down Power Up[/*]	[*]5 points per Contract completed[/*]	[*]10 points for capturing a Domination Point (Flag)[/*]	[*]10 points for capturing a Bonus Crate or a Cash Crate[/*][/list][h3]Clash: Available Locations[/h3]
Expect Clash matches to occur across a sub-section of the main Verdansk map, incorporating several adjacent areas around the following POIs:
[list]	[*]Quarry[/*]	[*]Boneyard[/*]	[*]Farmland[/*]	[*]Promenade (East)[/*][/list][h3]Clash: Available Vehicles[/h3]
With the impetus to reach the enemy forces never more important, expect heavy use of vehicles throughout a Clash Match. The full complement of currently available ground and air vehicles are as follows:
[list]	[*]Heli[/*]	[*]Cargo Truck[/*]	[*]LTV (Light Tactical Vehicle)[/*]	[*]Polaris RZR Pro R 4[/*][/list][h3]Available Contracts[/h3]
There are three available Contracts to complete in Clash Mode:
[list]	[*]Scavenger[/*]	[*]Search and Destroy[/*]	[*]Recon[/*][/list]
The Scavenger and Recon Contracts work in the same way as they do in Battle Royale Matches. In addition to the usual rewards and in-game cash, you receive five team points for each Contract completed.

[b]Search and Destroy Contracts (Clash Mode Only): [/b]Everything must go with this new contract, where one team plants a bomb on a Buy Station, and on detonation, they can earn impressive rarity weapons and items from the Buy Stations’ inventory. The other teams can defuse the bomb to earn a Fire Sale for a major discount from the Buy Stations.

Expect the Search and Destroy Contract to be available in Battle Royale, Resurgence, and Plunder Modes, at Mid-Season.
[h3]In-Match Events and Domination Points[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/861acad9bf755c9745c787faf4f899b2a972bc22.jpg[/img]

During a Clash match, expect several in-match Events to occur. These are like those in Battle Royale Matches, though Clash Events are timed throughout the match rather than related to the Circle Collapse. The available Events are:
[list]	[*]Domination Points[/*]	[*]Bonus Points Crates[/*]	[*]Clash Firesale[/*]	[*]Cash Crates[/*]	[*]Power Surge[/*][/list]
[b]Domination Points Event[/b][b] [/b][b]:[/b] Up to three single capture Dom Points (flags) appear on the map, and these respawn throughout the match. Much like the Multiplayer Mode of the same name, a team that reaches and captures one of the Dom Points receives a reward; in this case, 10 team points.

[b]Bonus Points Crates Event: [/b]A cargo plane flies across the center of the map, and up to four crates are dropped. Teams are likely to head to the crates as they float to the ground, as capturing a crate awards you with 10 team points.

[b]Clash Firesale Event: [/b]For the next two minutes, all players can take advantage of a Firesale as two Portable Buy Stations are dropped into the backfield of each team (a total of four). Additionally, all loot crates are restocked and cash found in crates is also increased.

[b]Cash Crates: [/b]Capture one (or more) of the three Cash Crates that drop during this event also nets you 10 team points.

[b]Power Surge Event: [/b]For the next two minutes, there’s an increased drop rate of Power Ups when you dispatch an enemy player or loot any ground caches.
[h3]Clash Mode Gameplay Features[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/078d1f47d10c97d091745de4db76d0193e4b684d.jpg[/img]

As well as the previously mentioned new Search and Destroy Contract, Clash comes loaded with features unique to the mode. Here’s the full run-down of what to expect:

[b]Buy Stations (Clash Mode only): [/b]Expect Buy Stations to be scattered across a Clash map and roughly split between each team’s area of operations. Portable Buy Stations are also available during the Firesale In-Match Event. Here’s what you can purchase:
[list]	[*]Armor Plate: $500[/*]	[*]Munitions Box: $1,000[/*]	[*]Trophy System: $1,500[/*]	[*]Counter UAV: $3,000[/*]	[*]Sentry Turret: $3,000[/*]	[*]Hand Cannon: $4,000[/*]	[*]Bunker Buster: $4,000[/*]	[*]Cluster Strike: $4,000[/*]	[*]Precision Airstrike: $6,000[/*]	[*]Specialist Perk: $10,000[/*][/list]
[b]New Field Upgrade: Door Barricade (Clash Mode at Season Launch): [/b]Control access points more easily during mid or close-quarter combat scenarios and delay enemy incursions with the Door Barricade.

Fit a barricade to a close single or double door, and a heavy-duty lock attaches to (and is visible on) both sides, preventing the opening or access through the door. This is until the barricade is either removed (only by the Operator or squadmates who fitted it), or destroyed, usually by using explosives, though gunfire and melee equipment is also an option.

Expect the Door Barricade to be loot in Battle Royale and Battle Royale Casual Modes, via the new Care Package Killstreak, all coming at Mid-Season.

[b]New Killstreak: Hand Cannon (Clash Mode at Season Launch): [/b]This high-powered pistol Killstreak, originally available in Multiplayer during Season 01, is available in ground cache as rare loot. Expect a slow rate of fire and finite ammunition, but good handling, and improved hip fire accuracy with faster hip-fire shooting speed.

Expect the Hand Cannon to be rare loot in Battle Royale, Battle Royale Casual, Resurgence, and Plunder Modes, via the new Care Package Killstreak, all coming at Mid-Season.

[b]Feature: SAM Turrets (Clash Mode only): [/b]Chopper and drone pilots take note; Clash mode maps feature SAM Turrets in various tactical positions across the environment. Spend $1,500 of in-match cash to activate these anti-air missile batteries and use them up to four times to target any aircraft and drones in the area. If you’re flying in the Heli on the receiving end of a SAM barrage, now’s the time to utilize flares to counter the incoming missiles!

[b]Train (Clash Mode only): [/b]If a Clash map features a portion of the large, circular railroad track that the train travels along, then this hulking engine and loot-filled carriages are parked and available to use as added cover and looting opportunities.

[b]UAV Towers (Clash Mode only): [/b]Providing you have the $2,000 in-match cash to activate them, teams can head to and capture a few scattered UAV Towers, allowing pinging of enemy movement across the local area.
[h3]Clash Mode Powerups[/h3]
Clash Mode features five differently hued in-match Powerups that are automatically used when found. Available as a possible loot drop or sometimes appearing as dropped loot near the body of an eliminated enemy Operator, these Powerups are color-coded and offer temporary benefits to the Operator who grabs them. All five can be obtained in a single match and expect the frequency of available Powerups to be significantly increased if the in-match Power Surge Event activates (usually in the final stages of a match). Here’s what each of the five Clash Powerups grant you:
[list]	[*][b]Hunter (Red Aura): [/b]Highlights enemies and allies in red and blue respectively. Allies are visible through walls. Applies Tracker and High Alert Perks.[/*]	[*][b]Speed Boost (Yellow Aura): [/b]Prevents fall damage and provides approximately 20 percent speed boost to your movement.[/*]	[*][b]Regeneration Aura (Green Aura): [/b]Refills your health and armor at roughly 20 percent per second. Allies within a small radius around you also receive this benefit. The effect does not stack.[/*]	[*][b]Double Down (Blue Aura): [/b]Grants you two points per enemy Operator elimination instead of one.[/*]	[*][b]Kill Mag (Purple Aura): [/b]Refills your active weapon magazine after a kill and quickens your reload.[/*][/list][h3]Havoc Royale LTM (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]44 players (Quads), 15-minute matches[/i]

Compete in a Call of Duty: Warzone match like no other, where rule bending modifiers twist the realities of the usual Resurgence gameplay in chaotic and game-changing ways.

Drop into a specially themed area of Verdansk with your Loadout. Every new gas circle activates a different modifier. Adapt fast to sudden changes as Havoc modifiers may impact you, the environment, and even the gameplay rules. Survive the Havoc, be the last team standing, and claim victory!

Expect a full rundown of this game mode in the Season 04 Reloaded blog, just prior to Mid-season.
[h3]Resurgence Casual (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]44 Players, Players & Bots[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9be55e31760ee974ca38e6e67646cde5be6511c9.jpg[/img]

Infil into Rebirth Island with your squad and commit to winning using the regular Resurgence ruleset, but with one important twist; some of your adversaries aren’t human! Whether facing down a bot or not, Resurgence Casual is a great mode to drop into whether you’re warming up, teaching a new player about the game, or you’re wanting a Resurgence match that isn’t quite as extreme as normal.

As with Battle Royale Casual or Call of Duty: Warzone Bootcamp, game progression is limited in this mode and results will not count towards or against your stats. This mode also doesn’t count towards your eligibility to accessing Resurgence Ranked Play when it arrives at Mid-Season.
[h3]Ranked Play: Battle Royale (Launch Window)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f9d238869eecd3aeee4c9316880190b5c1b9b402.jpg[/img]

Grind your way towards a coveted position in the Top 250 as Battle Royale: Ranked Play becomes the first of two Ranked Play variants to drop in Season 04 within Call of Duty: Warzone. Harness the competitive spirit and earn new rewards for ranking up and advancing through the Skill Divisions, unlocking the following rewards as you go:
[h3]Season 04 BR Ranked Play Rewards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/36fc68d6fb84faa081138f81855bfe23328ab203.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*]First Season Win: Weapon Charm[/*]	[*]Get 25 Eliminations: Elimination Sticker[/*]	[*]Get 100 Eliminations: Elimination Weapon Camo[/*]	[*]Get 250 Eliminations: Elimination LR 7.62 Weapon Blueprint[/*]	[*]Silver: “Ranked Season 4 – Silver” Emblem[/*]	[*]Gold: “Ranked Season 4 – Gold” Emblem and Decal[/*]	[*]Platinum: “Ranked Season 4 – Platinum” Emblem and Decal[/*]	[*]Diamond: “Ranked Season 4 – Diamond” Emblem and Decal[/*]	[*]Crimson: “Ranked Season 4 – Crimson” Emblem and Decal[/*]	[*]Iridescent: “Ranked Season 4 – Iridescent” Emblem and Decal[/*]	[*]Top 250: “Ranked Season 4 – Top 250” Emblem and Decal[/*][/list]
Season 04 Champion: “Ranked Season 4 – Top 250 Champion” Emblem 
[h3]Ranked Play: Resurgence (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]Trios, Rebirth Island[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0a2c4fed9abe711b596c07c10966767fec874926.jpg[/img]

Craving some real competition on Rebirth Island? Then squad up with your winning Trio, and attempt dominance over the very best players as Resurgence Ranked Play makes its triumphant return! Expect the same rules set you remember during the [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare® III[/i] era, and an expanded look at this returning, fan-favorite mode in the Season 04 Reloaded blog, just prior to Mid-season.

[b]Ranked Play Notes: [/b]Battle Royale: Ranked Play (Verdansk) runs from Launch Window throughout the entirety of Season 04. Resurgence: Ranked Play (Rebirth Island) begins at Mid-Season, and runs alongside Battle Royale: Ranked Play, meaning you can play one or both Modes when they are active. The ranking is separate from Battle Royale: Ranked Play.
[h3]New Gameplay Features[/h3]
A new Contract, Field Upgrade, Killstreak, Perk, and ATV are all set to drop into Verdansk during Season 04:
[h3]Clash Mode Features Expansion (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6ebae9edf0382beb7a296a097d81e4026b7f40c4.jpg[/img]

After an evaluation period in Call of Duty: Warzone’s Clash Mode, expect the following new equipment to become available across additional modes at mid-season. Here’s what to expect:
[list]	[*][b]Contract: Search & Destroy:[/b] Battle Royale, Resurgence, Plunder.[/*]	[*][b]Field Upgrade: Door Barricade:[/b] Battle Royale, Battle Royale Casual Modes. Available via Care Package.[/*]	[*][b]Killstreak: Hand Cannon:[/b] Battle Royale, Battle Royale Casual, and Plunder Modes. Available via Care Package.[/*][/list][h3]Killstreak: Care Package (Mid-Season)[/h3]
Open ground loot caches for a rare chance to obtain the Care Package, a throwable Killstreak that, when lobbed, explodes into trail of smoke, after which a loadout-sized crate falls from the skies. Open this crate for a chance to obtain rare loot including rare equipment, the Specialist Perk, and more.
[h3]New Perk: Loot Master (Mid-Season)[/h3]
Available only as Ground Loot during Resurgence and Plunder matches, the Loot Master Perk allows you to maximize your scavenging potential and gear up faster by increasing the amount of loot you find while opening caches. Gain the early advantage or sustain yourself during prolonged engagements. Expect an increased drop rate for equipped weapon ammo, a higher chance to find tacticals and lethals, more cash, and a greater chance at field upgrades, killstreaks, and other high-tier gear.
[h3]ATV: Polaris Sportsman XP 1000 (Launch)  [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/13cdd9c20dbe5d033878107ecb23b28f65669f04.jpg[/img]

Added to the vehicle pool is the Polaris Sportsman XP 1000, a real wild ride allowing you to hit the Verdansk goat trails in comfort with legendary suspension, great clearance and traction, and versatility for positioning up to three Operators on the surface of the vehicle. Compared to the current ATV, the wheelbase and size of the Sportsman XP 1000 offers more stability than ever before.

[b]Note: Call of Duty: Warzone Events:[/b] Check the General section later in this blog to uncover the full complement of events for this mode across Season 04.
