notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 04: Full intel revealed, part 3
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: General Content (MP, ZM, WZ)[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3fe4f85d61658b381fc0b991f369d71f2d437827.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Weapons Detail:[/b] Five new weapons arrive in Season 04, including two at launch: the LC10 SMG and FFAR 1 Assault Rifle. Later in the season, get your hands on the, Essex Model 07 Marksman Rifle, Olympia Special weapon and Pickaxe Melee weapon, and change up your playstyle with new attachments.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]The Events Horizon:[/b] Season 04 is packed with Events, including Rivals, Ballerina (From the World of John Wick), and even more coming mid-season.. Plus, prove your worth across the Zombies leaderboards and become King of the Dead!
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Battle Pass and BlackCell: [/b]The Season 04 Battle Pass brings Stitch and brutal BlackCell Operator Omen to the forefront alongside new Weapon Blueprints, Operator Skins, Calling Cards, Finishing Moves, Emotes, and more in a mix of free and premium tiers. Free tiers include two new base weapons and the G-Grip Tactical Foregrip.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Season 04 Operators: [/b]Stitch returns after being freed from prison, headlining the new Battle Pass next to the sinister Omen leading BlackCell. Plus, deploy as assassin Eve Macarro in a collaboration with Ballerina, followed by much more at the mid-season.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]CDL Announcements:[/b] Major IV is almost here! Find out where to watch, plus the in-game rewards you can unlock, just for tuning in!
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Primary Weapon: LC10 (Launch)[/h3]
[i]SMG, Battle Pass Page 3, Page 14 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/347768bc3df3361033adbd90caba8598ecd7abb8.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 38[/b]

[b]MAGS: 4[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 34[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camos and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[i]Full-auto submachine gun. Excellent accuracy and range, with a moderate rate of fire. Average mobility and very slow handling for its class.[/i]

Returning after its debut in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War[/i], the LC10 SMG spits out rounds fast coupled with good accuracy and range, moderate damage, and a quick reload to get you back into the fight.

The weapon performs well off the hip or down sights, with 34 rounds in the base magazine for a hefty ammo supply. Via Gunsmith, equip a variety of improvements such as a Laser for improved hipfire spread and an updated Barrel to further extend the weapon’s respectable damage range.
[h3]Primary Weapon: FFAR 1 (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Page 6, Page 11 HVT Tier Battle Pass Blueprint[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6556e24dd73cec00a7d9af1a6f17c08329e09736.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 42[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[i]Full-auto assault rifle. Very high rate of fire and excellent CQB power, but slower handling and mobility.[/i]

Boasting a blazing fast fire rate that rivals the SMG weapon class, this bullpup Assault Rifle is designed for taking down targets fast. The somewhat unpredictable recoil favors burst fire when tackling distant targets, but once you’re locked on it’s all over for them. Supporting a variety of Underbarrel Launcher attachments, use Gunsmith to add greater versatility to the weapon. Running low on ammo? Grab an Extended Mag while you’re at it.
[h3]Primary Weapon: Essex Model 07 (In-Season)[/h3]
[i]Marksman Rifle, Event Reward[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cac5423d38b26575be8248d1f4cb6d036c4a7387.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 38[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 8[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Lever, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[i]Lever-action marksman rifle. High damage potential. Balanced by slower rate of fire and handling.[/i]

Inflict heavy critical point damage with this lever-action tactical rifle. An ideal tool for the new sheriff in town, this classic armament offers smooth handling with shots that quickly recenter after kicking up. Choose from a variety of Levers to further customize the weapon’s action, improving ADS speed, sprint to fire speed, and other movement abilities.
[h3]Special Weapon: Olympia (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]Special, Event Reward[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5b3c5914c2a06dac22adcc29cd3acb4e8ab3a628.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30 [/b]

[b]MAGS: 8[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 2[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Barrel, Stock

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camos (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[i]Double-barrel shotgun. Very high damage and respectable range but requires frequent reloading.[/i]

The double-barrel Olympia – not seen since [i]Black Ops 3[/i] – makes its debut in [i]Black Ops 6[/i], returning as a Special Weapon that makes for the perfect backup when entering tight spaces. The Olympia holds two shots at a time, each spraying multiple pellets when your Operator pulls the trigger. Light customization via the Short Barrel and Cut-Off Stock attachments gives you some control over the weapon’s playstyle, but the fundamentals remain the same: get up close and make your shots count. Fire down the sight for a tighter pellet spread or shoot off the hip to inflict damage over a wider area.
[h3]Melee Weapon: Pickaxe (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]Melee, Event Reward[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0400d253918fc3fa1f20d034d1f04ce7779bef41.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]None

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins.

[i]One-hit kill. Medium attack speed. Short range.[/i]

Without a Pickaxe, you’ll be lost in the tundra. Bring the right tool for the job when deploying to Iceland in Season 04’s Multiplayer maps, starting with this deadly Melee weapon that downs unarmored enemies with brutal severity. Though its range is short, the Pickaxe’s combination of rapid slashes and overhead swipes will keep enemies frozen in their tracks. Close the distance and say farewell.
[h3]New: Special Weapon Attachments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e165dc9dc8c7615d0f107181333bb6ac27d63859.jpg[/img]
[h3]G-Grip (Launch)[/h3]
[i]SMGs (except PP-19), Assault Rifles, Battle Pass Page 7 Reward[/i]

Vertical foregrip with integrated laser for improved firing stability, horizontal recoil control, and tightened spread when transitioning between hipfire and aiming down sights. Beam: Blue. Blocks Laser attachments.
[h3]Stryder .22 3-Round Burst Mod (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Stryder .22 Pistol, Event Reward[/i]

Convert the Stryder .22 into a 3-round burst. Drastically improves fire rate and maintains manageable gun kick but alters the weapon’s damage profile outside of the effective range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f2e50e30ef08dccf63eb0554f9ac968bc1276ebd.jpg[/img]
[h3]SVD Full Auto Mod (In-Season)[/h3]
[i]SVD Sniper Rifle, Event Reward[/i]

Convert the SVD from semi-auto to full-auto functionality, ramping up the speed of your damage output and drastically improving recoil and handling.
[h3]TR2 CQB Auto Conversion (In-Season)[/h3]
[i]TR2 Marksman Rifle, Event Reward[/i]

Alter the TR2 Marksman Rifle to fire handgun caliber rounds, resulting in a Marksman Rifle with a compact frame and fully automatic capabilities that rival fire rates of an SMG!
[h3]Season 04 Battle Pass and BlackCell[/h3][h3]Stitch Returns to Action in the Season 04 Battle Pass[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d27070f530ecec3ceb3685dde6eb5810da9f3bc.jpg[/img]

Stitch returns to the fray, leading this season’s Battle Pass content in a shocking team up with Adler. Purchase the Season 04 Battle Pass for 1,100 COD Points or the Season 04 Battle Pass Bundle for 2,400 COD Points to immediately unlock the Instant Rewards Page of the Battle Pass, including the following items:
[list]	[*]10% Battle Pass XP Boost[/*]	[*]The new “Supermax” Stitch Operator and “Supermax BlackCell” Stitch Operator Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/*]	[*]The “Lock Up” Legendary Blueprint for the Feng 82 LMG[/*]	[*]The “Try Me!” Emote[/*]	[*]The “Untamable” Large Decal[/*]	[*]Start to unlock up to 1,100 COD Points as you progress through the Battle Pass[/*][/list]
The Season 04 Battle Pass includes over 110 pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including two new Base Weapons, the G-Grip Tactical Foregrip Attachment, and several unlockable <s>mil-sim</s> style skins for Bailey, Payne, Grey, Caine, Brutus, Toro, Adler, Nazir, and Marshall. Stay tuned for the BlackCell, Battle Pass and Store Bundles blog prior to Season 04 launch for more details.
[h3]BlackCell Offerings[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7c6e9bd8f11c32e6f7052846da888ff0a24484ae.jpg[/img]

When the job needs to get done, summon Omen, the otherworldly Operator leading BlackCell content in Season 04. The menacing Operator and his three-headed guard dog are joined by a cast of infected, black and purple-hued Operator Skins and Weapon Blueprints earned exclusively through BlackCell.

BlackCell owners can access the Season 04 Battle Pass via the exclusive BlackCell Page, instantly unlocking the following items:
[list]	[*]The “Omen” BlackCell Operator and Skin[/*]	[*]10% XP Boost[/*]	[*]1,100 COD Points[/*]	[*]The “Guard Dog” Companion Finishing Move[/*]	[*]The “Hellblock” Mastercraft Blueprint for the Ladra SMG[/*]	[*]The “Kill Tally” Gun Screen[/*]	[*]The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and Winner’s Circles)[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e72cc8a890ac48e46e1200b4dc6f90f7aa833e73.jpg[/img]

BlackCell owners get access to page after page of additional exclusive rewards within the Season 04 Battle Pass, including:
[list]	[*]Seven BlackCell-exclusive skins for Stitch (two skins), Bailey, Payne, Caine, Brutus, and Adler.[/*]	[*]Seven BlackCell-exclusive Weapon Blueprints for the Krig C (Assault Rifle), XMG (LMG), SWAT 5.56 (Marksman Rifle), ASG-98 (Shotgun), FFAR 1 (Assault Rifle), Model L (Assault Rifle), LC10 (SMG)[/*]	[*]Over 130 item rewards (Battle Pass and BlackCell related) for those who fully complete the Season 04 BlackCell Battle Pass.[/*][/list]
As usual, players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive back the COD Points they spent.

[b]BlackCell Daily Challenges: [/b]Players with BlackCell will receive additional Daily Challenges throughout Season 04 for Multiplayer, Zombies, and Call of Duty: Warzone, giving even more chances to rake in the XP during your play sessions!

[b]BlackCell Loyalty Bonus[/b][b] [/b]: Players who purchased BlackCell in a previous [i]Black Ops 6[/i] season and go on to purchase Season 04 BlackCell will earn a permanent 10% Player and Weapon XP Loyalty Bonus, up to 30% for players who purchased Season 01, Season 02, and Season 03 BlackCell!
[h3]Operators[/h3]
The return of Stitch signals a shift in the battles ahead, requiring new Operators to meet the demands of the intensifying conflict. Predict a swift demise for your opponents with Omen leading BlackCell, joined by Stitch at the head of the Battle Pass plus a special appearance by Eve Macarro from [i]Ballerina[/i].
[h3]Omen (BlackCell, Crimson One, Launch)[/h3]
[i]“Omen” Operator: BlackCell Instant Reward Page[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f4adbf2340e2a1fb5d15b06016ec205c2ab4c7b8.jpg[/img]

It’s time for lockdown. Omen is a presence who strikes fear even in the world’s most dangerous criminals, with an almost preternatural ability to keep even the most sinister prisoners in line.
[h3]Stitch (Battle Pass, Rogue Black Ops, Launch)[/h3]
[i]“Supermax” and “Yard Dog” Skins: Battle Pass Instant Reward Page, Battle Pass Completion Page[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/82c6485bf41cc231117fc332a306c1fc30db32f9.jpg[/img]

Until recently, Stitch was assumed dead. Instead of eliminating his enemy, however, Adler sent him off to a black site prison. Now the time has come, and following a daring jailbreak, Stitch is once again free. Adler needs his help cracking the codenames that will finally lead to the Pantheon moles, but at what cost?
[h3]Ballerina (Bundle, Crimson One, In-Season)[/h3]
[i]Store Bundle[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e9be41c2a9d25ce7f2f035eada651d40ac771331.jpg[/img]

Seeking revenge for her slain father, Eve Macarro embarks on a relentless mission against the High Table’s most feared opponents in [i]Ballerina[/i], the highly anticipated new action film from the World of [i][u]John Wick[/u][/i]. Deploy as the elite assassin in one of two looks in the Ballerina Bundle arriving in Season 04.
[h3]Season 04 Events[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bc34c89196d294ad533e7b4f307478b7db1916a9.jpg[/img]

Participate in a new round of scheduled Events across Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Earn rewards like new weapons, special attachments, and more. Here’s a first look at the Events to come:
[h3]Event: Ballerina (MP, ZM, WZ, In-Season)[/h3]
[i]Activation Dates: June 5 to June 12[/i]

[i]Total Rewards: 10 (+ One BlackCell reward)[/i]

Enter the world of John Wick with the new Ballerina Event. Prove your capabilities as a supreme assassin by slaying your way across Multiplayer, Zombies, and Call of Duty: Warzone. Rewards include the new Essex Model 07 Marksman Rifle and a Ballerina-themed Nunchuck Melee Blueprint for BlackCell Owners.
[h3]Event: Rivals (MP, ZM, WZ, In-Season)[/h3]
[i]Activation Dates: June 12 to June 26[/i]

[i]Total Rewards: [/i]15 (+ One BlackCell reward)

Enemies become allies in the Rivals Event, when Stitch brings his code-cracking expertise to help uncover the real names of the final Pantheon moles in the CIA. The goal is simple; prove you’re the most proficient Operator by earning XP across all game modes and unlock a plethora of impressive free items. Dominate your enemies to become the first to unlock rewards including the Stryder .22 3-Round Burst Mod (Attachment) and Grim Reaper (Scorestreak).
 
[h3]Events: King of the Dead, Master of Grief (Zombies, Mid-Season)[/h3]

[i]Activation Dates (Master of Grief): July 10 to July 17[/i]

[b]King of the Dead: [/b][i]“Eliminate zombies in any Zombie mode to earn points to climb the leaderboard.”[/i]

[b]Master of Grief: [/b][i]“Collect Essence in Grief to earn points to climb the leaderboard.”[/i]

Earn points by slaying all types of undead! As you’d expect, you receive more points for dispatching the harder zombie types. This, in turn, causes you to climb the Zombies leaderboard, and once the Event is over, rewards will be granted based on your leaderboard position. Everyone receives some kind of reward, but to obtain the really good stuff, it’s time to perfect your Special and Elite Zombies slaying!
[h3]New Store Offerings[/h3]
Season 04 brings new Bundles to the Store, including a special crossover event with Ballerina. Get more intel in the Season 04 BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Bundles blog arriving before launch.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Ballerina[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/220a797babc8d3aba072c4f5a8e0da14258c4006.jpg[/img]

Choose one of two Operator Skins for Eve, a red sequin dress as “Eve Macarro” or a sleek black professional fit as the “Ruska Rogue.” Bring light to the darkness with three Legendary Weapon Blueprints featuring High Table Coin Tracers and High Table Coin Death FX: the “Relevé” AK-74 Assault Rifle, “Plié” Saug SMG, and the “Arabesque” 9MM PM Pistol. For a snazzier elimination, take them out with the “Dance With Death” Finishing Move.

Balance lethality and elegance with additional [i]Ballerina[/i] themed content, including the “Pirouette” Emote, “Keepsake” Weapon Charm, animated “Caged Grace” Emblem, animated “Pas de Duex Calling Card, and the “Take a Bow” Loading Screen.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Ink and Smoke Reactive Ultra Skin[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4849c7abfc50ce2bf5a717937ab4e7c86a1beb3b.jpg[/img]

Add some class to your deployments with the cel-shaded, black and greyscale “Hardboiled” Ultra Operator Skin for Weaver, accompanied by the Reactive “Lethal Inspection” AMES 85 Assault Rifle and “Personal Detective” ASG-89 Shotgun Weapon Blueprints, both featuring Noir Tracers and Ink Annihilation Death FX. For a closer finish, leap for their throats using the “Wire Cut” Finishing Move.

When taking on the undead, equip the “Search Engine” Wonder Weapon skin for the Thrustodyne M23 and show off your Zombies credentials with the “Sidepiece” Weapon Charm, “Dead Noir” Weapon Sticker, “Evidence” Spray, “Greyscale” Loading Screen, and the consumable Time Out GobbleGum.
[h3]Other Incoming Bundles[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/63169fca7d0eae2028c6c78e933f79cd84951f6a.jpg[/img]

There’s plenty more awesome new content arriving in the Season 04 Store, including the [b]“Tracer Pack: Olympus Bolt Mastercraft Ultra Skin” [/b]Bundle, featuring an electrifying Mastercraft Weapon Blueprint for the new LC10 SMG alongside a divine Ultra Operator Skin for Caine. Also incoming is the [b]“Tracer Pack: System Breach” [/b]Bundle, and the [b]“Tracer Pack: The Goat Ultra Skin” [/b]Bundle with a Goat Companion Finishing Move. See more of the season’s upcoming Bundles and more in the Season 04 BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Store Bundle blog.
[h3]Call of Duty League Brings Major IV, Challengers Open to DreamHack Dallas[/h3]

Black Ops 6 is available now, and now’s definitely the time to experience the spy action thriller Campaign, the in-depth tactical chaos of best-in-class Multiplayer, and to soak in the gory glory of an incredible round-based Zombies experience with five maps and the brand-new Grief mode! notes.title: Stitch Returns in Season 04
notes.notes:
Vikhor “Stitch” Kuzmin has escaped captivity once more, but this time he’s been extricated from maximum security detention by his nemesis, Russell Adler, the same operative who imprisoned him in an Icelandic CIA black site prison in the first place.

These two share a deep history to their rivalry—one they’ll have to leave behind them if they hope to accomplish the mission ahead.

[previewyoutube=6g-pQLuCHsk;full][b][u][[CINEMATIC VIDEO]][/u][/b][/previewyoutube]

Prepare to deploy as Stitch when he rejoins the fight as part of the Season 04 Battle Pass coming to [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i].

If you’re new to his story, read on for the main events leading up to this dramatic twist in the search for the Pantheon moles, before returning tomorrow, May 21, for the full Season 04 Announcement Blog, Roadmap, and Gameplay Trailer.
[h3]Rebirth R&D: Nova 6 Production[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fbd6c625e2acf3074959070589596386b81ff502.jpg[/img]

Scanning intelligence reports, it appears to have started on Rebirth Island, where Stitch was placed in charge of production of the chemical gas Nova 6 in the 1960s. Growing up in the Soviet Union, Stitch was recruited by the KGB after graduating top in his class studying organic substances and pharmaceutical chemistry. Once he proved his skills working within the Laboratory 12 R&D facility, Stitch found himself reporting directly to the villainous Colonel Kravchenko for his new assignment on Rebirth Island.

Originally developed by German scientist Friedrich Steiner for use against his country’s enemies in World War II, Nova 6 was seized by those within Stitch’s sphere of influence after thwarting a planned attack. Picking up where Steiner left off, Stitch pushed the island’s facilities to produce countless barrels of the gas, creating a large stockpile of the chemical weapon.
[h3]The Eyes Have It: Raid on Rebirth Island[/h3]
Stitch worked for three years producing Nova 6 until his plans were foiled when the CIA uncovered the truth about Rebirth Island’s facilities in 1968. Led by Grigori Weaver and Jason Hudson, the CIA conducted a successful, but costly raid on the island.

Despite Steiner getting assassinated in the conflict, Adler was able to capture and interrogate Stitch. His efforts proved unsuccessful, however, when Stitch refused to give up more than his name and rank. Eager to send a message, an angered Russell Adler gouged out Stitch’s left eye, cementing their intense rivalry.
[h3]A Trip to the Gulag[/h3]
Returning to his homeland, Stitch was found guilty of dereliction of duty for failing to stop the American raid on Rebirth Island. Kravchenko stripped him of his rank and sent him to the Petropavlovsk Gulag, where he left the name Vikhor Kuzmin behind and emerged as Stitch.

During his captivity, Stitch stewed in his hatred for the West and even his own country, which abandoned him, and his intense desire for vengeance was used to turn him into an agent of Perseus. Then the chance to exact his desires finally came when a deadly attack on the gulag left Stitch MIA.
[h3]Setting the Trap[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae686c086f143b3cecd68f0854eeb79ff496ed6d.jpg[/img]

His expertise in the production of Nova 6 and the power it offered was not lost, as it was later discovered Perseus agents were responsible for breaking Stitch free from his imprisonment—members of an international spy ring composed of rogue military operators under the leadership of a mysterious figure. It wasn’t long before the original “Perseus” died, and his protégé Stitch took command of the group, before finally turning his attention to an old foe.

Dropping clues to Adler regarding his return to the fight, Stitch lured the agent to a mall in New Jersey where Nova 6 was secretly being manufactured and stockpiled. He ambushed the agents on site and captured Adler. In a daring scheme to incriminate his old foe, Stitch tried brainwashing Adler using MKUltra techniques while setting his sights on Verdansk.
[h3]“Adler… You Took Your Time.”[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/383ad1b33e27dc31ba13b20ba2c992d2bb83274d.jpg[/img]

Adler was able to escape and dismantled Stitch’s operation in Verdansk by detonating explosives beneath the city. After being brought in and deprogrammed by Jason Hudson and Alex Mason in the 11th hour, Adler and the team tracked down his nemesis in the mountainous Kastovian terrain and prepared to end their conflict once and for all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/151d5f7660e06b24c050ea84ee912ac24bf5ad47.jpg[/img]

After an intense stand-off, where Stitch revealed the true origins of Perseus, Adler spared his adversary from execution after realizing he would be of more use alive. Instead, he had Stitch incarcerated at a remote black site prison, off the grid and deep inside the Icelandic interior, tucking him away for a day when Adler might need his particular talents.

And now that day has come. A deal with the devil has been made, as Adler needs Stitch’s help to crack the codenames needed to identify and capture the Pantheon moles.
[h3]First Look: Deploy as Stitch, Available in the Season 04 Battle Pass[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/712eab1cf0ee770e7166a611ff3d6e8fb748d814.jpg[/img]

Control the next step in the villain’s journey as Stitch arrives in the Season 04 Battle Pass for [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].

Purchase the Battle Pass to instantly unlock the “Supermax” Operator Skin for Stitch. Still in his prison clothes, he deploys in his signature mask ready to join the battle. Other rewards earned in the Battle Pass Instant Rewards Page include a 10% Battle Pass XP boost, a Legendary Emote, Weapon Blueprint, a Large Decal, and up to 1,100 COD Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3bec251df23beb3ee0c1171798e9e86161d39d6c.jpg[/img]

Upgrade to BlackCell to additionally unlock the “Supermax BlackCell” Operator Skin variant. In this version, chains drape over the villain’s body, his sinister stare looking out from under a black hood, energy pulsing under translucent skin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fede8cd8374b8652e01ef9709e4163bcc80559e7.jpg[/img]

Ramp up the lethality even further with his “Yard Dog” and “Yard Dog BlackCell” Operator Skins unlocked in the Battle Pass Completion Page. In this look, his mask bears a terrible grin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3941eb8a19351b97a97bb6bf44e6e1ed9a82f2ea.jpg[/img]

To really dig into the rivalry, don’t miss Adler’s “Truth Chaser” and “Truth Chaser BlackCell” Operator Skins on Page 12 of the Battle Pass, a look that twists the events of what happened during their fateful meeting on Rebirth Island.

Grab the Battle Pass when Season 04 launches in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] and get Stitch back into the field.

Expect the full Season 04 Announcement and Roadmap on May 21.

For Call of Duty Updates, follow @CODUpdates on X (formerly Twitter).[/i]

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 03 Reloaded: All the details
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Season 03 Reloaded: Incoming Intel[/u][/h2][h3]The Mystery Deepens[/h3]
The global search for the Pantheon moles accelerates as Operators revisit new territories revealed in the video Hudson recorded before his death.   

[previewyoutube=8_JtCQeKbB0;full][/previewyoutube]

Prepare for a wealth of new content in the mid-season update coming to [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], bringing new maps, modes, events, Loadout items, and more, including new features on Verdansk like a moving train and High Value Loot Zones.

[i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] Season 03 Reloaded arrives on Thursday, May 1 at 9AM PT.
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: Season 03 Reloaded[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6f5235f25f967bb58ee035f9eec02193137dceed.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Two New Maps:[/b] Travel to an estate turned KGB safehouse in the mid-sized Haven, seeking out targets across the sprawling grounds and lavish interiors. In the new Signal Strike map, revisit the infamous Numbers Station as Operators battle above and below the water.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Join Operations LTM:[/b] Test your endurance in a new multi-mode LTM complete with special breaks that introduce gameplay modifiers to every Operator in the field.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Perk:[/b] Seek out the enemy who eliminated you with the new Vendetta Perk, marking them out for elimination.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][h3]Haven[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/43d24e5df508f8f232c8baea3b2bbecd79eeea57.jpg[/img]

Head to a KBG safehouse established in a neglected estate, its aesthetics forgotten in favor of its usefulness as a base of operations. Fight for control of the command center built up in the old Ballroom and view an impressive array of armaments brought into the Hall. Reams of cable connect running generators and supplies at the Entrance promise an extended stay.
[h3]Signal[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Strike, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f2ef42d635efad83a78873881166a9def095d908.jpg[/img]

Turn the clock back to 1968 when Pantheon moles infiltrated the Numbers Station, where water floods in through a breach in the walls and flames lap the upper walkways. Engage enemies in the central Broadcast center or fight through the flashing lights and alarms of the Control room. When things get heated, drop into the water below and swim behind enemy lines.
[h3]Joint Operations Limited Time Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cdbc564e8dc0d6f395bd53dbc139d3da52e9801d.jpg[/img]

Ride to victory in a blaze of glory in Joint Operations, a gauntlet that challenges players across a series of Multiplayer mode variants including Team Deathmatch, Domination, Hardpoint, Kill Order, and Kill Confirmed.

Catch your breath during breaks throughout the match, shifting the play of the game by adding modifiers that affect every Operator, including a +420 Score Bonus, 3<sup>rd</sup> Person, Visual Impairment, Double Health, Hardcore, Paranoia Sounds, Low Gravity, Double Jump, and Increased Movement Speed.

Battle in 6v6 across all five modes, their order randomized at the start of each match. Compete for two minutes in each mode, ending when one team reaches the Score Limit or at the conclusion of all five modes. The team with the most points wins the game.
[h3]New Loadout Content[/h3]
Seek vengeance on the Operator who eliminated you with a new Multiplayer Perk that encourages payback.
[h3]New Perk[/h3]
[b]Perk: Vendetta[/b]

[b]Perk Slot:[/b] 2

[b]Type:[/b] Recon (Blue)

[b]Available: [/b]Season 03 Reloaded Blaze of Glory Event Reward

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bbd2481e92daa084862c73ab6c2ca7c4ebb18c47.jpg[/img]

On respawn, mark your killer’s last known position for a short duration. Get a bonus score for eliminating that enemy. The Vigilance Perk counters being marked by Vendetta.
[h2]Zombies: Season 03 Reloaded Content[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3568f113697f521da1d424efddc1a9d40f3c4331.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Zombie Snacks LTM: [/b]Reach a flow state in the new Zombies Snacks limited-time mode, replacing your Operator’s health with an energy meter and granting special abilities to those who get in the flow.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Returning Field Upgrade: [/b]Freeze the undead in their tracks with the Frost Blast Field Upgrade, complete with researchable Major and Minor Augments that further empower the blizzard attack.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Shattered Veil – Directed Mode:[/b] Directed Mode arrives for Shattered Veil, providing round cap limitations and extra guidance when tackling the Main Quest.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6083dc54839192a13d436fc1219f0cd8ba435727.jpg[/img]
[h3]Get in the Flow in Zombie Snacks[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e43b79344cf98a0d1e8ce3ca7d2a09dfaebe043d.jpg[/img]

Whet your appetite in the Zombie Snacks limited-time mode, challenging Operators to keep their energy reserves up while aiming to enter a flow state, providing extra power for slaying the undead.

Play Zombie Snacks on all five maps, including Shattered Veil, The Tomb, Citadelle des Morts, Terminus, and Liberty Falls, in both Standard and Directed playlists with the following gameplay changes:

[b]Energy Meter: [/b]In Zombie Snacks, your Operator’s health bar is replaced with an energy meter which depletes when taking damage or moving. The energy meter does not passively recharge. For that, you need food.
[list]	[*]In Standard, your energy depletes when moving or taking damage.  Jumping, mantling, sliding, and diving all deplete energy on use. In Directed Mode, your energy only depletes when taking damage.[/*]	[*]Replenish your energy by eating snacks (+50), drinking Perks (+150), or chewing a GobbleGum (+50).  Other health-based features will also refill energy, such as the Stimshot (+50) and the Light Mend Ammo Mod (+5 per glyph, +10 with the Extra Strength Augment).[/*]	[*]The Jugger-Nog Perk will increase your total energy bar.[/*][/list]
[b]Food Items: [/b]Eat food to partially replenish your energy meter, dropped by downed enemies and found throughout the map.
[list]	[*]Specials, Elites, and HVTs are guaranteed to drop three snack items.[/*][/list]
[b]Refrigerator Powerup: [/b]When activated, all eliminated zombies will drop food items for a short period of time. Nobody’s going hungry when this Power-Up drops.

[b]Flow Mode: [/b]Eliminate 10 zombies without taking damage to enter a flow state. Operators in the flow inflict plenty of extra damage and gain special boosts, such as improved handling and movement. Take any damage, and the flow state is lost. We suggest you turn up your music for this one.

Earn GobbleGum rewards upon the first completion of the Main Quest in Standard or Directed Mode on any map:
[list]	[*]Directed: A custom collection of 4 GobbleGums per map.	[list]		[*]Each contains one high-rarity GobbleGum and 3 GobbleGums of other rarities.[/*]		[*]15,000 XP per map, for a total of 75,000 XP across all maps.[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Standard: A custom collection of 6 GobbleGums per map.	[list]		[*]Each contains one high-rarity GobbleGum and 5 GobbleGums of other rarities.[/*]		[*]15,000 XP per map, for a total of 75,000 XP across all maps.[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]New Gameplay Content[/b]

The Frost Blast Field Upgrade returns for [i]Black Ops 6[/i]! Create a cyclone in front of your Operator and chill enemies to their bones.

[b]Additional Field Upgrade: Frost Blast[/b]

[i]Available: [/i][i]In-Season Blaze of Glory Event Reward[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fb3569b843f2006efeedbb4ffa0e3874ea0e85f8.jpg[/img]

Create a blizzard that deals lethal frost damage on activation and slows enemies that enter it.
[list]	[*]This Field Upgrade can be used in all five Zombies maps along with the previously accessible Field Upgrades, assuming it is chosen as part of your Loadout, or swapped via the menu during a game.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b68ba9f4f68cc25798e7b43d096bf4adf9eda59c.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Frost Blast: Major Augments[/i][/b]

Research the following Augments to further customize the Field Upgrade.

[b]Ice Slick[/b]

Enemies within the blizzard may be knocked down.

[b]Frost Cast[/b]

The blizzard moves forward when activated.

[b]Flash Freeze[/b]

Normal enemies within the blizzard will be frozen solid and are killed when damaged.

[b][i]Frost Blast: Minor Augments[/i][/b]

[b]Extension[/b]

Significantly increases blizzard duration.

[b]Frostbite[/b]

Increase damage to frozen enemies.

[b]Extra Charge[/b]

Increase max charges by one.
[h3]Shattered Veil: Directed Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2ff6861a7d3149c01a8ad40b8a01d9f2aa65d738.jpg[/img]

Get some extra guidance when taking on the Main Quest in Shattered Veil with the arrival of Directed Mode in Season 03 Reloaded. Head to Colton Hall in the wooded hills above Liberty Falls and deliver the Sentinel Artifact to S.A.M. with a maximum round cap of 15.

Battle the Elder Disciple and its empowered minions, and keep your ears peeled for Toxic Zombies, which screech as they rush your position and explode, leaving a damaging pool of acid in their wake. Fight back with the upgraded Ray Gun Mark II and burst enemies apart with the Microwave Trap. In the halls and grounds of this old mansion, the team will need every advantage they can get.

[b]Ray Gun Mark II Comes to All Maps[/b]

Ever wanted to wield the Ray Gun Mark II as an additional Wonder Weapon on Liberty Falls, or maybe Citadelle des Morts? With Season 03 Reloaded, now you can. Treyarch is adding the base version of the Ray Gun Mark II to the Mystery Box on all existing Zombies maps to expand your arsenal even further.
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Warzone: Season 03 Reloaded Content [/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5219a6e2a9334edce2d60a2950b1b60d00f4341.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Features in Verdansk:[/b] Hop on the train, fight for the best gear in High Value Loot Zones, tear through Downtown on the Triumph TF 250-X, and compete in Verdansk for this season of Battle Royale Ranked Play. Get intel on all the mid-season changes coming to Verdansk.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Two Limited-Time Modes: [/b]Spice up your Verdansk deployments with two mid-season LTMs, High Trip Resurgence and Massive Resurgence.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td][/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h2]New Features in Verdansk[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/75edfb07d4c4db52b1c41195aec6f1fcb6d6893c.jpg[/img]

The battle rages on as millions of players continue deploying to the original Big Map. Verdansk’s return has taken the community by storm with more features coming to the map in the mid-season update, including two limited-time modes. Plus, expect continued support for Rebirth Island Resurgence and the Battle Royale Casual mode on Verdansk introduced at the start of Season 03.
[h3]All Aboard![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6d08aafdf276bbd6a73a9a89655ade1eabd54fb1.jpg[/img]

The Verdansk Train Station is back in business, sending a loot-filled train around Verdansk with multiple access points and a free ride for those who can defend against approaching enemies. Let off some steam and climb aboard, if your fellow passengers don’t stop you first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e6fcd79b13a638f69e35fd5aedf255a3b33f0f09.jpg[/img]

Engage with other fan-favorite Battle Royale features coming in the mid-season, including:

[b]High Value Loot Zones: [/b]Be a risk taker and search for powerful gear in High Value Loot Zones. Be ready to engage enemy squads eager to compete for the quality loot on hand.

[b]More Contracts: [/b]Track down and eliminate the Operator with the highest number of eliminations when picking up the Big Game Bounty Contract. If you’re looking for a ride, get on board and hold your position with the Train Recon Contract.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/32572c306018c0b1cf2a46daa8d22e771969156b.jpg[/img]

[b]New Vehicle: [/b]Mount up for a thrilling ride on the tried-and-true Triumph TF 250-X, already available in Rebirth Island and coming to Verdansk in the mid-season update.
[h3]Battle Royale Ranked Play in Verdansk[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9d34c031b392fc6c9807f0d630d83b0a3b52b056.jpg[/img]

It’s time to show how well you really know the lay of the land. For the first time in the map’s history, Verdansk will be featured in Battle Royale Ranked Play, returning in the mid-season as players squad up in Trios and seek to dominate 49 other teams as 150 players spread out through Verdansk in search of the best placement they can get.

Earn Skill Rating (SR) points for outlasting squads, eliminating opponents, and completing challenges. The amount of SR earned for getting eliminations will be greater or lesser depending on the comparison between your rank and your target’s rank.

Earn seasonal rewards for reaching milestones in the remainder of Season 03, including:

[b]Season 03 Ranked Play Rewards[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c87ab28f7a776e31c9a716d301fe61566592a94f.jpg[/img]
[list]	
[*]Get 25 Eliminations: “Crownbreaker” Weapon Sticker[/*]
[*]Get 100 Eliminations: “Ranked Renegade” Weapon Camo[/*]
[*]Win a Ranked Play match: "Junkyard Dog" Weapon Charm[/*]
[*]Get 250 Eliminations: “Exile’s Resolve” Assault Rifle Blueprint[/*]
[*]Silver: “Platatag” Emblem[/*]
[*]Gold: “Arumural” Emblem and “Golden Cup” Spray[/*]
[*]Platinum: “Platinumpasting” Emblem and “Platinum Blet” Spray[/*]
[*]Diamond: “Blue Carbon Style” Emblem and “Diamond Crown” Spray[/*]
[*]Crimson: “Crimsonpiece” Emblem and “Crimson Banner” Spray[/*]
[*]Iridescent: “Iridosketch” Emblem and “Iridescent Wreath” Spray[/*]
[*]Top 250: “Factum Heroes” Emblem and “Unstoppable 250” Spray[/*]
[*]#1 Overall: “Semideistsyle” Emblem[/*]
[/list]

[h3]Two Verdansk Limited Time Modes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4bca59143a744911c49c144dece5dfec5353cee0.jpg[/img]

[b]High Trip Resurgence: [/b]Smoke the competition and power up in the High Trip Resurgence LTM coming to Verdansk. Operators will deploy with one of several predetermined weapons and their fists. To improve your odds, seek out Shades found in supply caches, giving the Operator various boosts, including faster reloads, super speed, and no fall damage.

[b]Massive Resurgence: [/b]Up the competition with support for 120 Operators on Verdansk Resurgence. Stay alive to redeploy fallen squadmates and be ready to engage enemies with greater frequency in this last squad standing battle.
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: General Content (MP, ZM, WZ)[/u][/h2][table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Weapon Detail:[/b] Get info on the new Ladra SMG, combining a high fire rate with excellent range. For a more explosive approach, equip the 7.62 Mini-Rocket Conversion for the Goblin Mk 2.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Events:[/b] Unlock the Ladra and 7.62 Mini-Rocket Conversion in the High Art Event featuring Seth Rogen. Unlock the Vendetta Perk, Frost Blast Field Upgrade, and more in the Blaze of Glory and Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Got Your Six Events.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Store Offerings:[/b] Check out new Ultra, Reactive, and Mastercraft Skins across several new Bundles arriving in the mid-season Store, including the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) United Force: Tracer Pack which supports veterans in their search for high-quality jobs.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Weapon Detail[/h3]
Wield the blistering-fast Ladra LMG, arriving as an event reward in the mid-season update.
[h3]Primary Weapon: Ladra[/h3]
[b][i]SMG, High Art Event Reward[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/df214fa997c1e754afdf4ccff291df75428e14f5.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 37[/b]

[b]MAGS: 4[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 38[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options: [/b]Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[i]Full-auto submachine gun. Extreme rate of fire, excellent range, and low recoil. Headshots can help offset lower base damage.[/i]

Combining a high fire rate with excellent range and low recoil, the Ladra SMG can compete with the best even out to the mid-range. More shots are needed due to the weapon’s lower base damage, so consider an Extended Mag, Scavenger, or the Assault Pack to keep your ammo stocked through even the thickest of fights.
[h3]New: Special Weapon Attachments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2899d97b12489a91a70d94905c68507f2709b058.jpg[/img]
[h3]Goblin Mk2 7.62 Mini-Rocket Conversion[/h3]
[i]Goblin Mk2, Assault Rifle, High Art Event Reward[/i]

Converts the Goblin Mk2 into a fully automatic weapon with explosive rocket ammunition. Splash damage capabilities come at the expense of bullet velocity and rate of fire. Equips a new default Barrel and Magazine. Blocks Barrel, Muzzle, and Magazine Attachments.
[h3]Season 03 Reloaded Events[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7b9cbc79f5779882b6aba97e0bbd36c668f9dead.jpg[/img]

Earn XP and unlock rewards including the new Season 03 Reloaded Ladra SMG, the 7.62 Mini-Rocket Conversion for the Goblin Mk2, and more across three in-game Events.
[h3]High Art (MP, ZM, WZ)[/h3]
Activation Dates: May 1 to 15

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8c1673a50172b9a028a778b2634925c67ae77758.jpg[/img]

Join actor, comedian, and filmmaker Seth Rogen on an epic High Art journey. Earn XP in Multiplayer, Zombies, or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] while the event is live to earn rewards like the new Ladra SMG. Purchase the premium track to earn additional rewards including the Seth Rogen Operator.

[b]Free Track[/b]

Get explosive with the 7.62 Mini-Rocket Conversion for the Goblin Mk2 along with other Free Track rewards like the “Casual Ops” Operator Skin for Stone, plus a unique Spray, Weapon Charm, Sticker, a Loading Screen and Emblem featuring Seth Rogen, and a one-hour Double Battle Pass XP token.

[b]Free Track Mastery Reward: Ladra SMG[/b]

Complete the Free Track to unlock the new Ladra SMG, boasting a high fire rate combined with excellent range and low recoil.

[b]Get More with the Premium Reward Track[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/03e8b936f4be66f525f04a8b6fa33450b6f99595.jpg[/img]

Players who purchase the Premium Track for 1100 COD Points will also unlock along a second track featuring additional rewards including the instantly unlocked “Fired Up” Operator Skin for the new Seth Rogen Operator plus progress through the Premium Track to unlock additional items  the “Glazed Out” Assault Rifle and “Flameware” SMG Weapon Blueprints, “Missed ‘Em” Finishing Move, and a new Calling Card, Emote, Large Decal, Gunscreen, and one-hour Double XP Token.

[b]Ultimate Mastery Reward: “Host Rogen” Operator Skin[/b]

Deploy as Seth Rogen in a new Operator Skin featuring the actor in a colorful jacket and tie and black-rimmed glasses.
 
[h3]Event: Blaze of Glory (MP, ZM, WZ)[/h3]
Activation Dates: May 6 to 15

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/13cb813949b25448fb1118070052347be32ba374.jpg[/img]

Collect Blaze Bucks dropped by eliminated enemies and found in supply caches in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Redeem your bucks for rewards, including the new Vendetta Perk, the Frost Blast Field Upgrade, and the “Highly Decorated” Weapon Camo with an additional variant for Season 03 BlackCell owners.
[h3]New Store Offerings[/h3]
Look forward to a variety of Ultra, Reactive, and Mastercraft Skins across a variety of exciting Bundles coming to the mid-season Store. Here are some highlights. Check the Store throughout the mid-season for more.

[h3]Tracer Pack: Peek Performance Reactive Ultra Skin[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c7b9ce90723e669f1773f61972463902a9e4df5d.jpg[/img]

It’s nothing that a little needle and thread can’t fix when deploying as the “Mr. Peeks” Operator Skin based on everyone’s favorite Mystery Box stuffed animal. Go for the win with the Reactive “Egg Breaker” PPSh-41 SMG, “Gummy Disaster” Feng 82 LMG, and the “Fudgey” Maelstrom Shotgun Weapon Blueprints, all three equipped with Blue and Pink Tracers and Chocolate Eggs Death FX.

Give your enemies something to bite on with the “Chew This!” Finishing Move, “Unlimited Power!” Large Decal, a Loading Screen, and one consumable Hidden Power GobbleGum.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Charm ‘n Harm Reactive Ultra Skin[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/411e1226819e10d005b65d464c3fd6057fe4cb1b.jpg[/img]

Hex the competition with the Ultra Reactive “Hocus” XMG LMG Weapon Blueprint, a masterclass in magical design, paired with the “Pocus” KSV SMG Blueprint, both featuring Pink Tracers and Nebula Death FX. Revel in the nightfall as the “Arcana Conqueror” Operator Skin or drive away your enemies as the “Solar Diviner” Operator Skin.

Spellbind enemies with the “Plaything” Finishing Move and put your powers on display with the “Hoot Hoot” Weapon Charm, “Devastating Rage” Weapon Sticker, animated “Wand Way” Calling Card, “Behold the Power!” Spray, and a Reticle and Loading Screen.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Dulce Catástrofe[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cb36af6407552e4acfe2c9683860fcc294d9353e.jpg[/img]

A colorful storm is heading to combat as the new Dulce Catástrofe Bundle celebrates Cinco de Mayo by bringing a fresh, festive twist to your Loadouts inspired by vibrant party traditions and packed with high-impact style.

Deploy with the “Goloso” Operator Skin outfitted with the “Dale!” Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint, “No Te Pierdas” Sniper Rifle Weapon Blueprint, and “Trancazo Festivo” Melee Weapon Blueprint. Plus, light up the party in Multiplayer and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] with the “Golpe Sorpresa” Emote, “Pinatastico” Weapon Charm, “Explosive Festivity” Emblem, and “Candy! Candy! Candy!” Spray.
[h3]Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Military Appreciation Month Presented by USAA[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dc32ecdab8c725674c43ad4309dada765cfef305.jpg[/img]

The Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Military Appreciation Month presented by USAA kicks off May 1, and will honor service members and veterans for having our six. Arriving soon are the C.O.D.E. United Force: Tracer Pack and accompanying C.O.D.E. Got Your Six Event.

Follow the Endowment on social media for updates on how you can support US and UK military veterans seeking high-quality jobs throughout Military Appreciation Month.
[h2]Upgrade to Black Ops 6 Today![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/84d6c4fc4defbbb57e6f83286233cef55061b8b4.jpg[/img]

[i]Black Ops 6[/i] is available now, and there’s never been a better time to experience the spy action thriller Campaign, the in-depth tactical chaos of best-in-class Multiplayer, and soak in the gory glory of an incredible round-based Zombies experience! notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 03 Battle Pass, BlackCell, and Bundles
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Finish the Job with the Season 03 Battle Pass![/u][/h2]
Special Agent Jason Hudson has evidence pointing to the identities of the Pantheon moles who have been working in the shadows. It’s time to finish the job he started and track down the traitors with some help from the BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Store content arriving in Season 03 of [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], launching April 2 and April 3 respectively.

The Season 03 Battle Pass introduces 100+ rewards including new free base weapons plus new Operators and Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Calling Cards, Finishing Moves, and more.

Access free rewards including new cosmetic content and base weapons or purchase the premium Battle Pass and earn up to 1,100 COD Points as you progress through the Battle Pass Pages. For the optimal seasonal experience, purchase BlackCell, including exclusive animated Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, and other rewards.
[h2][u]BlackCell Season 03: R0-Z3 Operator (Crimson One)[/u][/h2]
[i]BlackCell Instant Rewards Page, HVT[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3cf3db995f54ac2ad327f763f9ecc4e8fa798249.jpg[/img]

The return of Verdansk marks the comeback of several Operators with extensive experience in the locale. R0-Z3 leads the Season 03 BlackCell content in her “R0-Z3” Operator Skin alongside a host of other unlockable BlackCell content including additional Operator Skins and Weapon Blueprints sporting animated fragmentation.
[h3]Additional BlackCell Instant Rewards Content[/h3]
Get the ultimate Battle Pass experience by purchasing BlackCell, offering complete access to all the rewards available in the Season 03 Battle Pass. A purchase grants immediate access to the BlackCell Instant Rewards page, giving the following items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fb5e315471c832d93a8b12385b34e95161ed60b1.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*]20 Battle Pass Tier Skips[/*]	[*]1,100 COD Points[/*]	[*]The “R0-Z3” BlackCell Operator[/*]	[*]The “Energy Siphon” Mastercraft Blueprint for the XM4 Assault Rifle[/*]	[*]The “Goodest Boy” Companion Finishing Move[/*]	[*]The “Martial Arts” Emote[/*]	[*]The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and Winner’s Circles)[/*]	[*]BlackCell Daily Challenge (see below)[/*][/list]


BlackCell owners can additionally unlock page after page of additional rewards throughout the Season 03 Battle Pass, including:
[list]	[*]Up to ten BlackCell-exclusive skins for Mace (two skins), Hudson (two skins), Woods, Marshall, Maya, Park, Stone, and Toro.[/*]	[*]Up to seven BlackCell-exclusive Weapon Blueprints for the XM4 (Assault Rifle), Feng 82 (LMG), GPMG-7 (LMG), Tanto .22 (SMG), ASG-89 (Shotgun), HDR (Sniper Rifle), and the CR-56 AMAX (Assault Rifle).[/*]	[*]Over 130 item rewards (Battle Pass and BlackCell related) for those who fully complete the Season 03 BlackCell Battle Pass.[/*][/list]
Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/562ae050c43d1535bb05721265e73f150d7ba3ca.jpg[/img]

[b]BlackCell Loyalty Bonus: [/b]Players who purchased BlackCell in a previous [i]Black Ops 6[/i] season and go on to purchase Season 03 BlackCell will earn a permanent 10% Player and Weapon XP Loyalty Bonus, up to 20% for players who purchased Season 01 and Season 02 BlackCell (up to a 50% bonus for purchasing BlackCell in every Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 season!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8520586d3e639bdf8253c84b76513ea8c9aee604.jpg[/img]

[b]NEW! Extra Daily Challenges: [/b]Players with BlackCell will also receive an additional Daily Challenge throughout Season 03 for Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Rake in that XP!
[h2][u]Purchase the Battle Pass: Instantly Unlock Mace Operator[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f2b33268c4cfc6c0b730ee0e9546d8f586639656.jpg[/img]

Players who purchase the premium Season 03 Battle Pass or BlackCell will immediately unlock the Battle Pass Instant Rewards Page with the following items:
[list]	[*]The new “Mace” Operator and “Mace BlackCell” Mace Skin for BlackCell owners.[/*]	[*]10% Battle Pass XP Boost.[/*]	[*]The “Day Ones” Legendary Weapon Sticker.[/*]	[*]The “Package Received” Finishing Move.[/*]	[*]The “Marbled” Legendary Weapon Blueprint for the Saug SMG.[/*][/list][h3]New Operator: Mace (Crimson One)[/h3]
[i]Battle Pass Instant Reward Page, HVT[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e229f2df6d5f0b471e6a6d895395f6df917b656c.jpg[/img]

The Special Forces Army Ranger turned PMC returns for a new foray into Verdansk, utilizing his brutal and brash tactics to overcome foes who dare challenge him in the field.
[h3]New Operator: “Hudson” (Rogue Black Ops)[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 2[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9cbeb8639b5073e8ca2ca806b766c71882a203a6.jpg[/img]

Follow your instincts and complete the mission as Hudson deploys in aviator glasses, mud smeared over his face and arms with a tactical vest and camo. In the BlackCell variant, Hudson wears a VR interface over a scorched face, debris rising from his left arm.
[h3]Additional Battle Pass Operator Skins[/h3]
Progress through the Battle Pass to unlock additional content including a variety of Operator Skins, many paired with BlackCell variants with animated fragments floating from their bodies, like Verdansk rubble held in suspension.
[h3]Woods: “Winter Guise” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 4[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ab889e189df2d838d39f88d513f116de53481305.jpg[/img]

Woods deploys in winter gear, ready to engage in Arklov Peak and other mountainous regions of Verdansk. With climbing rope and gloves, he’ll traverse any snow drift to sneak behind the enemy lines. Swap to a black and gold full body tactr0ical suit in the BlackCell variant, goggles pulled down over a breathing mask.
[h3]Marshall: “Hazard Prep” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, Page 6[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/465ded9ceb3e1630e08de2c95d7bfbafa9ad7b97.jpg[/img]

Marshall isn’t taking any chances as he dons an over-the-head breathing mask and protective clothing to help mitigate the effects of chemical warfare. The BlackCell variant offers similar protection in black and gold, fragments floating from his left arm and mask.
[h3]Maya: “Rogue Archer” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 7[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e15ce795ca40e2d3957d152144de6e78f6ecc4cf.jpg[/img]

Strike enemy squads as a tactical gunslinger, hood up with durable lightweight armor and a gun belt hanging at her hip. The BlackCell variant features animated fragments over both arms, sunglasses and a balaclava concealing her identity.
[h3]Park: “Survivor’s Guile” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 10[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/60f4b6f5d069d27cd28ff33cc06a9bef961258a8.jpg[/img]

Park deploys in style, wearing a vintage trapper hat and aviator shades with a leather jacket. Swap the hat for a beret in the BlackCell variant paired with a black jacket and mask.
[h3]Mace: “Apocalypse King” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 12[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9c4ed3c4e4ab14724ef00bcafeb90d52cd11e013.jpg[/img]

Rule over Verdansk and instill fear in your foes as Mace wears a skull mask with rising bones like a crown. Spiked forearm guards accent the skeletal look. Flames burn under the mask in the BlackCell variant, fragments rising from his armor and crown.
[h3]Stone: “All Terrain” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, Page 13[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db5db1a4e9af3ba0f04bdd4e7ac638fa8c9a1d1e.jpg[/img]

Adapt to any environment as Stone deploys in fatigues and full-face coverage for concealment when striking deep in enemy territory. The fragments rising off his right side in the BlackCell variant lend Stone a more sinister twist.
[h3]Caine: “Future Combatant” Skin[/h3]
[i]Operator Skin, Battle Pass, Page 14[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ed2e274824dd3498747823ebb1ff06b852e78d39.jpg[/img]

Show the present what it means to be a cut above the rest as Caine gets teched up with a precision optical instrument and full tactical gear.
[h3]Hudson: “Icebreaker” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 14[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1bf5c46c06d355f887c66a7348f7c228396b8638.jpg[/img]

Hudson sports shades and a beanie over animated blue sleeves like water pulsing through his arms. In the BlackCell variant, change out the shades for goggles and full animated fragmentation down both arms.
[h3]Toro: “Jug-o-Not” Skins[/h3]
[i]Operator Skins, Battle Pass and BlackCell, Page Completion[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/79ed27ef6c1a06b23493fb215b3391b73ab2e770.jpg[/img]

Toro deploys in heavy armor, a bandolier draped over his shoulder. Don a sleeker look in the BlackCell variant, black with gold accents, fragments burned across the faceplate and left arm.
[h3]Season 03: Battle Pass Base Weapons[/h3]
Unlock two new Base Weapons in the Season 03 Battle Pass, each one a Verdansk-era favorite returning for the fight. All players can unlock these weapons for free by progressing through their listed Battle Pass Pages.
[h3]HDR Sniper Rifle[/h3]
[i]Battle Pass, HVT, Page 3[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a43fc394fdb83b938d7cbebae9a5989b5c841351.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 38[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 5[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[b]Military Camos: [/b]27 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[b]Special Camos: [/b]6 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[b]Mastery Camos: [/b]12 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[i]Anti-material bolt action sniper rifle chambered in 12.7 x 108mm ammunition. Bullets have a lower muzzle velocity but remain devastating even at very long ranges.[/i]

An Operator’s best friend when up in the Control Tower and other vantage points around Verdansk, the HDR inflicts heavy damage from a long distance, perfect for downing squads before they can even pinpoint your position. Hold your breath while aiming to help zero in on targets before taking the shot.
[h3]CR-56 AMAX Assault Rifle[/h3]
[i]Battle Pass, HVT, Page 6[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aead1226a01c5d09c1e52cb22341adf01d52f676.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 42[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[b]Military Camos: [/b]27 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[b]Special Camos: [/b]6 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[b]Mastery Camos: [/b]12 (MP, ZM, WZ)

[i]This lightweight 7.62 x 39mm full-auto assault rifle is compact and powerful. Built exclusively for military use, the standard issue rifle is deadly at mid-range combat and easily configured for a variety of assault tactics.[/i]

A fast fire rate and solid handling give the CR-56 AMAX just what it needs to excel in mid-range fights. Its fast reloads help to minimize downtime so you can keep up the pressure, eliminating unarmored enemies in three to four shots up to 25 meters out.
[h3]New Weapon Attachments[/h3]
The Monolithic Suppressor returns for all your big map stealth needs, joined by a full-auto conversion kit for the SWAT 5.56 Grau.
[h3]SWAT 5.56 Grau Conversion (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Premium Battle Pass, Page 5[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5686e5fea5d18eb184d6217fb5eb1525c5365b09.jpg[/img]

Convert the SWAT 5.56 into a fully automatic weapon with lower damage and range but improved accuracy, mobility, and handling. Equips a new default Barrel and Magazine and unlocks an exclusive 50-round extended Magazine. Blocks Barrel attachments.
[h3]Monolithic Suppressor (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Premium Battle Pass, Page 7[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d01f1192d46e2eca9eae3a5b786ff5f497241aca.jpg[/img]

The Monolithic Supressor provides superior sound suppression and increased range. Moderate weight increase affects agility. The ideal attachment for extending your damage range on big maps like Verdansk while retaining the concealment provided by a suppressor.
[h3]Unlockable Weapon Blueprints[/h3]
The Season 03 Battle Pass and BlackCell feature over 20 earnable Weapon Blueprints, including the following themed armaments:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db4dfe54e4e0ad05cb945754cac10283a3589ee5.jpg[/img]

(Above) “Marbled” Saug SMG, Instant Reward

Get two more Weapon Blueprints to lead the pack, the “Threatening Howl” DM-10 and the “Pack Leader” AS VAL. All three Blueprints feature Teal and Black Tracers and Claw Mark Death FX.

Nail down the plot holes and create your own heroic story with this comic book inspired Bundle featuring three paneled Weapon Blueprints: the “Retcon” Blueprint for the new Nail Gun Special Weapon, the “Single Issue” AK-74 Assault Rifle, and the “Comic Cutout” Cleaver Melee Weapon. All three feature Comic Bubbles Death FX, plus Red and Yellow Tracers for the Nail Gun and AK-74.

Say goodbye to your foes with the “One. Two.” Finishing Move and be the comic book hero by displaying the “Big Boom!” Weapon Charm, “Panel Pop” Spray, and “Stand Heroically” Emblem.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Shattered Veil Reactive[/h3]

Deploy in a black hazmat suit and gas mask with the “Undying Radiation” Operator Skin for Toro, and dominate the competition with the “Detonate” Emote. The Bundle also comes with a Reticle, Weapon Charm, animated Loading Screen, Emblem, and Calling Card.
