[h2][u]Conflict and Chaos: Black Ops 6 Season 03 is Here![/u][/h2][h3]Season 03 Overview: Unfinished Business[/h3]
In a video recorded before his death, Special Agent Jason Hudson warns of the Pantheon moles who have been working in the shadows for decades ever since Vietnam. They’ve managed to avoid detection throughout the years, using conflict and chaos to cover their tracks. With some new leads in play, however, their secrecy is no longer certain. Time to pick up the trail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0b2b86fcd2a9887eb6a485687f6bb4ccfc960ecc.jpg[/img]

Hudson left you to finish the job that he started, beginning with a file of codenames and documents leading you back in time to help solve the mystery at its roots.

Turn the tide on the Pantheon spies with this massive offering of free and premium content coming to [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] when Season 03 launches on April 2 at 9AM PT, with Call of Duty®: Warzone™ going dark for 24 hours before Verdansk comes online April 3 at 9AM PT.

[b]Note: [/b]Consult the following blogs prior to the launch of Season 03:

[b]Read This Now:[/b] [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/03/call-of-duty-warzone-verdansk-map-return-intel-drop]Return to Verdansk Call of Duty: Warzone Content[/url]

[b]Read This Now:[/b] [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/03/call-of-duty-warzone-verdansk-map-tour-intel-drop]Tour of Verdansk[/url]

[b]Read This Now:[/b] [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides/tac-atlas-verdansk]Verdansk Tac-Atlas[/url]

[b]March 28:[/b] Updates to Ricochet: Anti-Cheat™ and security updates

[b]April 2:[/b] Battle Pass, BlackCell and Store Bundles Blog
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: Season 03[/u][/h2]
[b][[BO6-SEASON-03-ANNOUNCEMENT-001]][/b]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Five Maps and a Variant:[/b] Head to the front lines in Barrage and Nomad, two new maps arriving alongside a remaster of the timeless Firing Range at Season 03 launch. Expand your deployment options in the mid-season with Haven and Signal plus a special Nuketown map variant.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Returning Modes:[/b] Test your skills across two classic game modes returning for [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. Display your mastery of weapons in Sharpshooter and bomb the enemy team in Demolition.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Additional Equipment:[/b] Rapidly deploy your Dedicated Melee weapon using the new Close Shave Perk and blast enemies to pieces with the glorious return of the Death Machine Scorestreak. In the mid-season, get even with help from the Vendetta Perk.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Season 03 Ranked Play: [/b]Get wins, climb the Ranks, and beat out the competition in a new season of Multiplayer Ranked Play bringing all-new rewards to earn.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][h3]Barrage (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4fdd5d0fd79f2a958437f0abc1233650aef4f9e5.jpg[/img]

Revisit 1968 Vietnam as you follow Hudson’s clues surrounding one Summit Watch at the front lines of battle. The trees have been cleared and the landscape flattened to make room for this base housing an artillery battery in active combat. The area has taken hits with large chunks blown off buildings including the Command Center and Barracks, the damage opening new pathways through the map.

Watch for sharpshooters trading shots near the base of the Watchtower, from Overlook, and through the second floor of the Command Center. Move quickly down the dirt roads to get out of sight or push out to the wings, battling around the artillery pieces in the Gun Pits and the Tree Crusher facing the Hill.
[h3]Nomad (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Strike, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/743ae1d06cd79611efba8db63f2e6cb9a6028c6c.jpg[/img]

The Pantheon moles were in Afghanistan, too, when Woods fought there in 1986. Fight in the ruins of a fortified settlement commandeered for the ensuing battle, a parked missile carrier facing out over the valley where a convoy lies in ruins on the narrow road leading up to the map. Navigate the crumbled archways and walls as you engage enemies in the open, the only accessible building being the Tower standing over the middle. A zipline offers fast access up and down from the coveted position, promising frequent skirmishes for control of its views.
[h3]Firing Range (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Remaster, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/54b7857621195c697ea1cb8d1ce5609d9b8aa73d.jpg[/img]

Firing Range makes its glorious return in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] in a faithful remaster of the fan-favorite map. Watch for crossfire down the long center Road as Operators fight for control of the vantage points in the Tower and the upper levels of the Shoot House and Garage. Shooting targets move back and forth on their tracks behind the Office and several other spots adding a useful diversion while preparing for the next fight. Avoid the center chaos by branching off to the Dirt Road, keeping your guard up against ambush as you pass the Storage unit along the way.
[h3]Haven (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/21bc4e092671180c7dac8f7398538261ad66c83d.jpg[/img]

Enter a KGB safehouse in 1991. This once opulent compound now sits in a dilapidated state of disrepair, overgrown and cracking apart at the seams. Its current owners, however, are less interested in aesthetics and more interested in the site’s former use.

A crystal chandelier lies smashed on top of a sculpture in the Foyer while reams of cable connect running generators to the armory in the Hall, the command center set up in the Ballroom, and out to the Entrance where parked vehicles monitor the surroundings and deliver vital supplies. The indoor and outdoor spaces are tightly intertwined here, spilling the battle through the estate halls and past scenic areas of contemplation like the Gardens and Bath.
[h3]Signal (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Strike, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5685d35498d7afb4f4a3948f6e3b21b32f935443.jpg[/img]

Taking Operators back to 1968, this site connects the moles to activity surrounding the infamous numbers station. Flashing lights and alarms sound in the Control room of an ocean rig numbers station, flames erupting along the upper wing. Starting from opposing submarine bays, Operators can funnel straight down the middle into the Broadcast station or fire down on the action from the Communications landing. Take an alternate path through the Control room, its flooded hall giving access to the water below. Jump in and swim underneath the structure to access either submarine bay, providing the means to jump out of the water and flank the enemy team.
[h3]Blazetown at Mid-Season[/h3]
Plus, light up the competition in a special Nuketown variant joining the map pool for a limited time later this season!
[h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3]
Get in some intense gaming sessions as two classic modes with a rich history in the Black Ops series arrive in Season 03. Adapt to cycling weapons in Sharpshooter and throw yourself at two bombsites in Demolition.
[h3]Sharpshooter (Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/870e8406f4585606b9860faaea42ad8b56d57cac.jpg[/img]

Flex your skills in this classic Black Ops free for all party mode where every Operator is assigned the same Loadout which changes every 45 seconds. Each cycle introduces a new Primary and Secondary Weapon from scoped Sniper Rifles to akimbo Pistols, plus a new Dedicated Melee weapon and Tactical and Lethal Equipment.

Use everything at your disposal to eliminate enemies while unlocking bonus abilities for going on a streak:
[list]	[*][b]1<sup>st</sup> Elimination: [/b]Increased movement speed.[/*]	[*][b]2<sup>nd</sup> Elimination:[/b] Increased reload speed.[/*]	[*][b]3<sup>rd</sup> Elimination:[/b] Increased sprint recovery speed.[/*]	[*][b]4<sup>th</sup> Elimination:[/b] Increased ADS speed.[/*]	[*][b]5<sup>th</sup> Elimination:[/b] Earn double score for eliminating enemies.[/*][/list]
Keep the streak going to unlock double score and make a run for the top three. When you’re taken out, respawn and build up those bonuses again. A short countdown precedes each weapon swap. Adapt and win.
[h3]Demolition (Launch Window)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a7c65427ce0c49f334952ae0189ee4cdc37ed94e.jpg[/img]

Alternate between attacking and defending two bomb sites. The attacking team must destroy both bomb sites to win the round, gaining a time bonus after detonating the first site. All attacking Operators spawn with a bomb and respawns are active for both teams throughout the match.

Defense is all about running down the clock. Defuse planted bombs right away, as the match timer pauses whenever a bomb site is in active countdown. If one of the sites is destroyed, regroup and throw everything you have into defending the last one.

The first team to win two rounds wins the match. If the score reaches 1-1, enter a tie-breaking final round where both teams race to detonate a single neutral bomb site.
[h3]Joint Operations: New Limited-Time Mode (Mid-Season)[/h3]
Leave the enemy up in smoke in this Limited Time Mode that tests teams with a gauntlet of five Core mode variants in a single match: Head Stash (TDM), Inhalation (Domination), Hotbox (Hardpoint), Very High Target (HVT), and Munchies (Kill Confirmed).

Cycle through all five modes under a variety of changing effects, including double health, low gravity, visual hallucinations, and third-person POV.
[h3]Additional Gameplay Content[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5b018846bebd99dbdbad4f1b96747ddafc9b454c.jpg[/img]

Unleash powerful melee attacks with ease, get vengeance on the Operator who eliminated you, and mow down everything in sight with two new Perks and a Scorestreak.
[h3]New Perks[/h3]
[b]Perk: Close Shave (Launch, Event Reward)[/b]

[b]Perk Slot:[/b] 1

[b]Type:[/b] Enforcer

Automatically use your Dedicated Melee attack when you perform a weapon butt attack. Simply tap the Melee button to attack. Like the old days!

[b]Perk: Vendetta (Mid-Season, Event Reward)[/b]

[b]Perk Slot:[/b] 2

[b]Type:[/b] Recon

On respawn, mark your killer’s last known position for a short duration. Get a bonus score for eliminating that enemy. The Vigilance Perk counters being marked by Vendetta.
[h3]New Scorestreak[/h3]
[b]Scorestreak: Death Machine (Event Reward)[/b]

[b]Type: [/b]Lethal

[b]Score: [/b]825

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2ca31eab30602a6e49651289900635554f4e499b.jpg[/img]

[i]Heavy minigun with a fast fire rate, high penetration, and a large ammunition capacity.[/i]

Wield the infamous Death Machine, a powerful weapon with a single large magazine that fires high impact rounds at a blistering rate of fire. Score earned while using the Death Machine contributes to your current Scorestreak progress, making this a great tool for bumping up to the next streak.
[h3]Multiplayer Ranked Play (Launch)Season 03 Ranked Play Overview[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/16a91d9dc3b0515c0673e459c10c3fe0604c580e.jpg[/img]

Find out what you’re really made of by dropping into competitive Multiplayer matches using the same settings, maps, modes, and weapon restrictions used by the Call of Duty League®. Win matches to earn SR (Skill Rating) and progress through the Ranks while earning career rewards like Rank Skins and Win Challenge rewards.

Get wins and progress through the Ranks throughout Season 03 to earn new seasonal rewards like a new Pro Issue Weapon Blueprint, Rank-themed Calling Cards, and more:

[b]Season 03 Ranked Play Rewards[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5a6f750e246e37a6b2ee8e717c8e6dd09bed58c9.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*]Get 10 Wins: Pro Issue AMES 85 Weapon Blueprint[/*]	[*]Get 100 Wins: “100 Season 3 Wins” Large Decal[/*]	[*]Silver: “Ranked Season 3 – Silver” Calling Card[/*]	[*]Gold: “Ranked Season 3 – Gold” Calling Card[/*]	[*]Platinum: “Ranked Season 3 – Platinum” Calling Card[/*]	[*]Diamond: “Ranked Season 3 – Diamond” Calling Card[/*]	[*]Crimson: “Ranked Season 3 – Crimson” Calling Card[/*]	[*]Iridescent: “Ranked Season 3 – Iridescent” Calling Card[/*]	[*]Top 250: “Ranked Season 3 – Top 250 Champion” Calling Card[/*][/list]
[b]Season 03 Ranked Play Weapon Blueprints[/b]
[list]	[*]Players will also earn themed Weapon Blueprints for the Jackal PDW SMG representing the Rank achieved in Season 03 Black Ops 6 Ranked Play:[/*]	[*]Gold: Start in/above or reach Gold at any point in Season 03[/*]	[*]Platinum: Start in/above or reach Platinum at any point in Season 03[/*]	[*]Diamond: Start in/above or reach Diamond at any point in Season 03[/*]	[*]Crimson: Start in/above or reach Crimson at any point in Season 03[/*]	[*]Iridescent: Start in/above or reach Iridescent at any point in Season 03[/*]	[*]Top 250: Finish Season 03 in the Top 250[/*][/list]
[b][u]Retroactive SR Adjustments [/u][/b]

[i]To help reverse the impact cheaters have on the Ranked Play SR system, retroactive SR adjustments will be made starting in Season 03. When a Ranked Play cheater is banned, anyone they’ve recently beaten will receive a SR refund for those matches. Players who we detect playing with cheaters may have SR for those wins taken away.[/i]

[b][u]Rejoin in Progress[/u][/b]

[i]Now a feature coming with Season 03, players will be able to rejoin Ranked matches if they disconnect. Players will have five minutes to rejoin, and teammates will receive a reduced SR Loss if a matchmade teammate rejoins and they lose the match.[/i]

[b]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: Season 03 Zombies [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/668126d2d1f3babcf10f1cd1a40c9b6ca4249ef7.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			
[b]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/b]
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Shattered Veil:[/b] Move into the heart of an Appalachian apocalypse as the crew descends on Colton Hall, a diabolical mansion that holds the key to saving Agent Maxis.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Additional Gameplay Content:[/b] Boost your fire rate with the Double Tap Perk-a-Cola, enjoy the effects of three new GobbleGums, and wield the Death Machine.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Enemy Types, Wonder Weapons, and More:[/b] Battle the Elder Disciple and its empowered minions, take on the new Toxic Zombies in special rounds, disintegrate enemies with the Ray Gun Mark II and its variants, as well as the classic Wunderwaffe DG-2 Wonder Weapon, and heat up the undead leftovers with the Microwave Trap.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Team Cranked: [/b]Power up and keep slaying with friends to replenish the countdown timer and stay in the game as Team Cranked debuts with fresh rewards in Season 03.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Shattered Veil (Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7cf819535caf02a00b11e417ec50685f4c5334b4.jpg[/img]

With the Sentinel Artifact in hand, the crew heads to the remote wooded hills above Liberty Falls to meet with S.A.M. at an old mansion in the forest which has been retrofitted to [[REDACTED]]. Only with the aid of S.A.M.’s synthetic mind can the team hope to unlock the ancient artifact’s mysteries and bring back Agent Maxis. What could possibly go wrong?

[previewyoutube=FjdEtiV_n0I;full][b][u][[ZM TRAILER VIDEO]][/u][/b][/previewyoutube]

Brave the horrors of Colton Hall and confront a tyrant in the next chapter of the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Zombies narrative, launching at the start of Season 03 on April 2 at 9AM PT.
[h3]Operation Save Maxis: Your Comms Team Handlers[/h3]
[i]“I hope it was worth dragging the Sentinel Artifact halfway around the globe.”[/i]

[b]- Sergei Ravenov[/b]

S.A.M. leads comms in anticipation of receiving the Sentinel Artifact once the team successfully enters Colton Hall. Further guided by Ravenov, Peck, and Strauss with exfil assistance from Raptor One, the crew must approach the synthetic mind promising the imminent return of Agent Maxis.
[h3]Shattered Veil: Initial Recon Tour[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a99230669137166e4f508134edd8cb7bf7e258ad.jpg[/img]

Venture into the mist-laden grounds of this tumbledown mansion that rivals the size of Citadelle des Morts, searching the Conservatory for [[REDACTED]] [[REDACTED]] the scene of fierce fighting at the Grand Foyer [[REDACTED]]. [[ALL EXPLORATORY CONTENTS HAVE BEEN REDACTED BY REQUEST OF PROJECT JANUS]]
[h3]New Enemy Sighted: Elder Disciple[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/201ad73192ee9ce5ff397fbcfa3519a5efa20080.jpg[/img]

Strange, floating apparitions have been seen flitting about the sprawling gardens and rambling mansion estate. Known to some as Elder Disciples, these powerful enemies likely spell trouble for the crew.

Elder Disciples gain strength as they empower the zombies around them while summoning more undead to join the battle. Using their dark magic, these fetid, floating carcasses can force their allies to evolve more quickly, allowing a lowly zombie to more rapidly transform into a Doppelghast or some other sinister form.

Eliminate the Elder Disciple before their forces grow too powerful, keeping it at a distance to avoid the scream it lets loose against players who draw too close. The deadly enemy grows more agitated as it takes damage, so try to get the job done fast.
[h3]Other Entities of Shattered Veil[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b2812d2b2f38e5e365b4fc7c6d3535635d7efed6.jpg[/img]

Beware the Toxic Zombie!

As a sickly yellow fog descends across the mansion, expect the inhabitants to take on an even-more revolting pallor. Easily identifiable due to their greenish hue and more skeletal exterior, Toxic Zombies seem to have lost all but their base perambulatory functions and seem intent on sprinting toward their prey before exploding, leaving a damaging pool of acid in their wake. Listen for their telltale shriek and get the jump on them before they can close the distance.

These glowing ghouls are joined by a variety of Project Janus scientists and military personnel-turned zombies caught up in the nearby outbreak, along with an unhealthy horde of other ghastly entities, the Elder Disciple stands—or perhaps floats—ready to speed them through their evolutionary journey.
[h3]New Wonder Weapon: Ray Gun Mark II (and Variants)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f407ed069bb7899da0ae1300386e8c0e0fe9c0fc.jpg[/img]

Face the enemies of Shattered Veil with two time-honored Wonder Weapons ideally suited to clearing out more than just the musty halls of an old mansion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a3f3b91f61707eb2a5af33b65c4b2a84ade01686.jpg[/img]

Drop multiple zombies at once with the upgraded and modestly unstable Ray Gun Mark II. Recovered from the Dark Aether by Project Janus, this powerful laser armament delivers three-round bursts of energy, can be Pack-a-Punched, and doubles as a bludgeoning instrument if you’re running low on ammunition.

Then there’s the three new variants.

Provided you’ve [[REDACTED]], you can experiment with an additional three variants of the Ray Gun Mark II:

[b]Ray Gun Mark II-W: [/b]Offering similar bullet patterns to a submachine gun, this also has a random chance to ignite enemies.

[b]Ray Gun Mark II-P: [/b]Shooting ammunition like a shotgun, with a chance to spawn a sigil with the ability to grant invulnerability to the player standing on it for a limited time.

[b]Ray Gun Mark II-R: [/b]Dropping zombies with a Marksman Rifle-like discharge, expect a chance to spread a plague infection that can inflict area-of-effect damage.
[h3]New Wonder Weapon: Wunderwaffe DG-2[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c0d5951196795c04cfa0ca967dbdac6893155b92.jpg[/img]

Take a more electrifying approach to your undead denizen disposal with the original Wonder Weapon: The Wunderwaffe DG-2.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2e45306b7e2f16e74fdb8e3d42fe7fd24099d60d.jpg[/img]

Capable of striking down hordes with chain-lightning blasts, this has the bonus effect of stunning crowds of zombies, usually resulting in additional, and eventually terminal damage. The only real drawback to the weapon that users have experienced is the stench of electrified undead.
[h3]Shattered Veil: Additional Content[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1da51e6fe23ab3f5f4b7df6f8fb258449a3731dc.jpg[/img]

[b]Main Quest and Quest Rewards: [/b]The Main Quest for Shattered Veil goes live when the map releases with Season 03 on April 2. Complete the Main Quest to earn the “PhDeadly” Operator Skin for Carver, an animated Calling Card, and 5,000 XP. Players who complete the Main Quest before Directed Mode arrives for Shattered Veil will also earn a unique Calling Card variant.

[b]Microwave Trap: [/b]Burst zombies with microwaves for a mere 750 Essence. Get a horde of followers on your tail and then flip the switch.

[b]Dark Aether Field Generator: [/b]Dissolve zombies with Dark Aether energy in a static field that zaps anything that passes through. Circle the trap to entice enemies into the center of it.

[b]Lore and Intel: [/b]Dig deeper into the history of Colton Hall and other lore related to Shattered Veil with Intel in the form of Audio Logs, Documents, and Artifacts discovered throughout the map.
[h3]New Gameplay Content[/h3]
Access the following new content within Shattered Veil as well as The Tomb, Citadelle des Morts, Terminus, and Liberty Falls.
[h3]Additional Perk-a-Cola: Double Tap[/h3]
[i]Available: In-Game at Perk Machine[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/37b1fef2a6ebacbfdd860b2c2ae329d1c59ceff5.jpg[/img]

The classic rapid-fire Perk returns for the first time in nearly a decade, dramatically increasing your weapon’s fire rate to chew through enemy hordes in record time. Research the iconic Perk for powerful enhancements like an even faster fire rate and the chance to inflict double damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/83b37cee91bb27ea39e5dc001e8cdd3ad5a92dc1.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*]Double Tap is available in Shattered Veil along with the other previously accessible Zombies Perks. Note that some of these Perk-a-Colas are only available via the Der Wunderfizz machine.[/*]	[*]Double Tap is available on The Tomb, Citadelle des Morts, Liberty Falls and Terminus maps via the Der Wunderfizz machine.[/*][/list][h3]Double Tap: Major Augments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dc05a5b8b76b373511f971b831442b9a129d2675.jpg[/img]

Research the following Augments to further customize the Perk.

[b]Double Jeopardy[/b]

Normal zombies at low health have a chance to die immediately when shot.

[b]Double Impact[/b]

Double hits on the same target in quick succession deal more damage.

[b]Double Standard[/b]

All non-critical shots do double damage. Only applies to normal bullet weapons.
[h3]Double Tap: Minor Augments[/h3]
[b]Double Time[/b]

Increases fire rate bonus.

[b]Double or Nothing[/b]

Weapons have a chance to do double damage but also have a chance to do zero damage.

[b]Double Play[/b]

Killing two enemies in quick succession has a chance to return two rounds to your magazine. Only applies to normal bullet weapons.
[h3]New GobbleGums[/h3]
Enjoy three new GobbleGums available across all maps once acquired and equipped in your GobbleGum Loadout Pack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/76369cfd88cdea70c75613bc72497976b0f9b504.jpg[/img]

[b]Tactical Diffusion (Rare): [/b]Disables the next Nuke Power-Up explosion you activate and gives everyone 2,000 Essence instead.

[b]Support Group (Legendary): [/b]Gobble up this tasty GobbleGum to acquire the ARC-XD, Mangler Cannon, Sentry Gun and Mutant Injection Support items.

[b]Die Pitched (Whimsical): [/b]Zombies have high-pitched voices. Lasts three minutes.
[h3]Additional Support Scorestreak: Death Machine[/h3]
[i]Available: Event Reward[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/03a693c5ccc6eb00d6bf123f75fc8a0c8f29ac32.jpg[/img]

[b]Salvage: 1,750[/b]

Head to the Support tab at the Crafting Table to piece together the Death Machine, a powerful machine gun with a fast fire rate, high penetration, and a large magazine. Mow through multiple zombies with an all-time favorite, once you unlock this heavy weapon during the Black Ops Tribute Event.
[h3]Shattered Veil: Directed Mode and Events[/h3]
For adventures seeking extra guidance in completing the Main Quest on Shattered Veil, jump into Directed Mode arriving at the Mid-Season, as well as the following additional Modes:
[h3]Team Cranked (Launch Window)[/h3]
Following the awesome collaboration that introduced Cranked to [i]Black Ops 6[/i] in the last season, the high-octane mode returns for more in Season 03 with a team-focused twist: now the Cranked Timer is shared across the whole team and any kill from any team member fills it! Eliminate a zombie to activate the Cranked state, powering up your Operator with improved abilities and setting a countdown timer that can only be replenished by eliminating more enemies.

The rules are simple:
[list]	[*]The Cranked Timer starts when the first enemy is eliminated.[/*]	[*]The timer starts at 30 seconds. Each enemy eliminated replenishes the timer to its current maximum, and every round survived causes the maximum timer to be reduced by 1 second.[/*]	[*]Essence earned by eliminating zombies is increased compared to Standard/Directed.[/*]	[*]The Time Stopper Field Upgrade replaces your loadout’s Field Upgrade.[/*]	[*]Main Quests and Easter Eggs are enabled.[/*][/list]
Use the following abilities to keep the timer from hitting zero:
[list]	[*][b]Time Stopper: [/b]Temporarily pause the Cranked timer for all teammates. All Operators begin the match with the Time Stopper Field Upgrade equipped.[/*]	[*][b]Time Extended:[/b] Grab this rare power-up to add a small amount to the maximum time allowed.[/*][/list]
Wall Buys are disabled in this mode, so the Mystery Box is your source for new weapons in Team Cranked. Because Operators gain increased Essence while Cranked, you’ll have plenty of chances to “spin the Box” for high-powered weapons! Good luck.

Team Cranked also delivers some tantalizing rewards for players who can survive past Round 50 on each map while this limited-time mode is available:
[list]	[*]A custom selection of six GobbleGums per map.	[list]		[*]Each contains one high-rarity and five GobbleGums of other rarities.[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]15,000 XP per map, or a total of 75,000 XP across all maps.[/*][/list][h3]New LTM and Field Upgrade (Mid-Season)[/h3]
Plus, whet your appetite with the Zombie Snacks Limited-Time Mode arriving later in the season, and put a chill on the undead using the Frost Blast Field Upgrade!

			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]

			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Return to Verdansk[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/96f19b0f2787be3efa300c450704741cd8a9793c.jpg[/img]

The Battle Royale Map that started it all is back! Get all the details about Call of Duty®: Warzone’s™ original Big Map, including a recon of this massive Big Map, the features, original gameplay modes, the new coastal POIs, plus details on the huge launch Event with 20 free rewards by the following blogs:

[b]Read This Now:[/b] [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/03/call-of-duty-warzone-verdansk-map-return-intel-drop]Return to Verdansk Call of Duty: Warzone Content[/url]

[b]Read This Now:[/b] [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/03/call-of-duty-warzone-verdansk-map-tour-intel-drop]Tour of Verdansk[/url]

Equip your Kilo 141, CR-56 AMAX and HDR, and drop in on April 3 at 9AM, one day after the launch of Black Ops 6 Season 03 on April 2! Check further down the blog on the launch schedule.
[h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][h3][/h3][h3]Primary Weapon: Kilo 141 (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Assault Rifle, Call of Duty: Warzone Login Reward[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2c1bbb4fbeb00123bcb8917dcdae6b88c97999d0.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 42[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camos and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[i]Fully automatic assault rifle with an ergonomic design that improves handling, and a steady fire rate helps stay on target.[/i]

The Kilo 141 is back and ready to tear it up across Multiplayer and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone.[/i] The weapon’s smooth handling, manageable recoil, and steady fire rate give it room to shine in a variety of combat situations, leaving no doubt as to why the Kilo 141 was a favorite in Verdansk. Now that the location is back, it’s time to relive the glory days with this hard-hitting Primary Weapon.

Players will automatically unlock the Kilo 141 for use in Black Ops 6 and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] after logging in to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] at the launch of Season 03.
[h3]Primary Weapon: CR-56 AMAX (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Page 6 HVT Tier Reward, Completion Page Battle Pass Blueprint[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/750742473d3cb844261f13ce6fc8f52fa0c87e8a.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 42[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[i]This lightweight 7.62 x 39mm full-auto assault rifle is compact and powerful. Built exclusively for military use, the standard issue rifle is deadly at mid-range combat and easily configured for a variety of assault tactics.[/i]

Combining high-damage hits with a fast fire rate and good handling, the CR-56 AMAX is the perfect mid-range weapon for downing targets fast. Eliminate enemies in three to four shots up to 25 meters out, leaving plenty left over to chew through equipped armor. Quick reloads get you back into the action fast, a helpful trait no matter how you choose to customize the weapon via Gunsmith.
[h3]Primary Weapon: HDR (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Sniper Rifle, Battle Pass Page 3 HVT Tier Reward, Page 11 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/17d746d8233c1d72fe0df9db6f3bcf6f0ffd1ac3.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 38[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 5[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[i]Anti-material bolt action sniper rifle chambered in 12.7 x 108mm ammunition. Bullets have a lower muzzle velocity but remain devastating even at very long ranges.[/i]

Veterans of Verdansk know the power of the HDR and the havoc a sniper can inflict with it when stationed in high vantage points like the infamous Airport Control Tower. The weapon’s long reach and heavy damage make it a favorite of sharpshooters, its distinctive firing sound sending squads running. Add the Reinforced Barrel attachment to further extend your damage range and bullet velocity, and don’t forget to hold your breath for difficult shots.
[h3]Melee Weapon: Kali Sticks (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Melee, Event Reward[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/34464f7174937a89cd680e1aa354da9876ffde23.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]None

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Camos (MP, ZM, WZ).

[i]Two-hit kill. Extremely fast attack speed. Short range.[/i]

The infamous Kali Sticks return, dealing out damage with rapid swings that’ll take down your target in a flash. Smack them with fast follow-up hits using the weapon’s light attack or take them out in a more dramatic fashion by unleashing the heavy attack. Use Kali Sticks in Multiplayer with the new Close Shave Perk to deploy a quick whack against enemies without having to manually swap to your Dedicated Melee slot first.
[h3]Primary Weapon: Ladra (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]Submachine Gun, Event Reward[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8c49842544a55b839eeec1ba2f9ebeeb5021a77b.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 37[/b]

[b]MAGS: 4[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 38[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Camo and Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3).

[i]Full-auto submachine gun. Extreme rate of fire, excellent range, and low recoil. Headshots can help offset lower base damage.[/i]

What this SMG lacks in power it more than makes up for with a blistering fire rate that’s effective even in mid-range fights due to the weapon’s low recoil. Consider an Extended Mag to cut down on reloads and aim for the head to improve your damage output. Pairs well with Scavenger and the Assault Pack, giving you the ammo reserves you need to keep up the pressure and continue spitting out damage.
[h3]Special Weapon: Nail Gun (In-Season)[/h3]
[i]Special, Event Reward[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5c5c95dd9fa4f638a7aeb6e620bfef8242fe5f7e.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30[/b]

[b]MAGS: 4[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 15[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]None

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Camos (MP, ZM, WZ).

[i]Full-auto Nail Gun. High damage at close range with fast handling speeds and very low muzzle velocity.[/i]

Stick it to them with this handy tool configured with a magazine of 15 nails that fires at full auto. The damage drops off quickly after 25 meters and performs best up close. The Nail Gun’s low muzzle velocity can make it difficult to land shots against fast moving targets, so get them in your sights and unload before they know what hit them. This armament is a reward earned during the Black Ops Tribute Event.
[h3]New: Weapon Attachments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3dc315b5132ddec5f3954f419e5d47d73dcfffe2.jpg[/img]
[h3]Monolithic Suppressor (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Assault Rifles (except AS VAL), SMGs, Shotguns, LMGs, Marksman Rifles, Sniper Rifles, Pistols, Battle Pass Page 7 Reward[/i]

Monolithic Core provides superior sound suppression and increased range. Moderate weight increase affects agility. The ideal attachment for extending your damage range on big maps like Verdansk while retaining the concealment provided by a suppressor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5c67ca194479e0b82d8508225538be9510361973.jpg[/img]
[h3]SWAT 5.56 Grau Conversion (Launch)[/h3]
[i]SWAT 5.56 Marksman Rifle, Battle Pass Page 5 Reward[/i]

Convert the SWAT 5.56 into a fully automatic weapon with lower damage and range but improved accuracy, mobility, and handling. Equips a new default Barrel and Magazine and unlocks an exclusive 50-round extended Magazine. Blocks Barrel attachments.
[h3]C9 10mm Auto 30-Round Mags (In-Season)[/h3]
[i]C9 SMG, Event Reward[/i]

Conversion kit to use higher caliber 10mm Auto ammunition for increased stopping power. Though the conversion results in some increased recoil and a slightly lower fire rate, the extra damage, range, and velocity make this attachment a worthy consideration when approaching enemies on bigger maps.
[h3]Goblin Mk2 7.62 Mini-Rocket Conversion (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]Goblin Mk2 Assault Rifle, Event Reward[/i]

Converts the Goblin Mk2 into a fully automatic weapon with explosive rocket ammunition. Splash damage capabilities come at the expense of bullet velocity and rate of fire. Equips a new default barrel and magazine. Blocks Barrel, Muzzle, and Magazine Attachments.
[h3]New Features (MP, ZM, WZ)[/h3][h3]Base Blueprint Swap (Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5898a9f15828d62b9d87297e616b2737c96c6349.jpg[/img]

You’re now able to customize any Black Ops 6 base weapon or Weapon Blueprint with a skin you’ve unlocked or purchased, across Multiplayer, Zombies, and Call of Duty: Warzone.
[list]	[*]For Base Weapons, you can only change the skin of the Base Weapon, not any Attachments.[/*]	[*]For Blueprints, you can customize the skins with other existing Attachments.[/*][/list]
[b]Camo Hub (Launch Window, MP/ZM)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e3c83f785ba5b712d8730ada7449d01e5a4e6b51.jpg[/img]

This new user-interface section is planned to be added shortly after launch, available in the Barracks > Challenges Menu. This allows you to view the challenges you need to complete to unlock Weapon Camos in a single location, with weapons sorted by furthest camo unlocked. Simply visit the Camo Hub to start planning out the next steps on your journey to Dark Matter and Nebula.
[h3]Season 03 Events[/h3]
Season 03 delivers an assortment of scheduled Events across Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Earn rewards such as a new Primary Weapon, Melee Weapon, Launcher, new special attachments, and more.
[h3]Event: Return to Verdansk (WZ only)[/h3]
[i]Activation Dates: April 3 to 15[/i]

[i]Free Event. Total Rewards: 20, including Instant unlocks for new and veteran players[/i] [i]and the Kali Sticks Melee Weapon[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8dc8d3cafadfefe4abe1e633197eba0a2bc22f20.jpg[/img]

Open Verdansk Safes across several unique locations to earn rewards. Players also have the chance to earn the “Trail Blazer” Operator Skin for Caine, if you can find the right safe to open before someone else gets there first.

As part of this event and to celebrate the return of Verdansk, all players who log in to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] following the Season 03 launch will unlock the Kilo 141 plus two Operators exclusively for use in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Players whose Activision ID matches those who deployed to the original Verdansk map will also receive three additional items when logging in after the update: the “Blue Legacy” Contrails, “Coming Home” Parachute, and “Like We Never Left” Gun Screen.

For all the details on this Event, check out the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/03/call-of-duty-warzone-verdansk-map-return-intel-drop]Return to Verdansk Blog[/url].
[h3]
Event: Black Ops Tribute (MP, ZM, WZ)[/h3]
[i]Activation Dates: April 17 to May 1[/i]

[i]Total Rewards: 17, including the Death Machine Scorestreak, Nail Gun Special Weapon, Close Shave Perk, and Thermite Lethal[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0b7c4121bd97d23a7b6e1acb8d73f31fe7f30b40.jpg[/img]

Don’t miss out on this legendary tribute to Black Ops in an event stuffed with rewards that honor the history of the series.

Earn XP in any mode to progress the Event and earn Black Ops themed rewards. Black Ops 6 owners will receive additional rewards only available to use in Black Ops 6.

Earn cosmetic content and functional equipment, including the Nail Gun (Special Weapon), C9 10mm Auto 30-Round Mags (Attachment), Thermite (Lethal in Call of Duty: Warzone), Death Machine (Scorestreak in MP/Support in Zombies), Close Shave (MP Perk), an Emote, GobbleGums, and the fan-requested Operator, “John Black Ops”.

[b]More in the Mid-Season: [/b]Look for more events and rewards throughout Season 03, including the Blaze of Glory Event and the Call of Duty Endowment Got Your Six Event. Expect more event coverage in the Season 03 Reloaded announcement.
[h3]Season 03 Battle Pass and BlackCell[/h3][h3]Hudson and Mace Lead the Charge in the Season 03 Battle Pass[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/81c1591b6bb5ec78b1f14db0f34d1c4a29445611.jpg[/img]

Memories are a powerful tool, and even the departed can change the course of history. The road back to Verdansk involves unlocking some core memories, as well as some unforgettable weaponry and new Operators. A flashback to agent Jason Hudson, bringing echoes of his frontline savvy, Hudson is unlockable by progressing within the Battle Pass. Joining him is Mace, the metal-faced mercenary, who will bring the war anywhere, anytime, for anyone, unlocked instantly upon Battle Pass purchase.

Purchase the Season 03 Battle Pass for 1,100 COD Points or the Season 03 Battle Pass Bundle for 2,400 COD Points to immediately unlock the Instant Rewards Page of the Battle Pass, including the following items:
[list]	[*]The new Mace Operator and “Mace BlackCell” Mace Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/*]	[*]10% Battle Pass XP Boost[/*]	[*]The “Day Ones” Legendary Weapon Sticker[/*]	[*]The “Package Received” Finishing Move[/*][/list]
The “Marbled” Legendary Blueprint for the Saug SMG

The Season 03 Battle Pass includes over 110 pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including free, earnable armaments; two new Base Weapons, the Monolithic Suppressor Attachment, and more. Check out the BlackCell, Battle Pass and Store Bundles blog prior to Season 03 launch for a closer look at what’s coming.

BlackCell owners can access the Season 03 Battle Pass via the exclusive BlackCell Page, instantly unlocking the following items:

notes.title: Tour of Verdansk: Where we dropping?
notes.notes:
[b]Major Points of Interest: [/b]From Gora Dam to the Zordaya Prison Complex, Verdansk in Season 03 receives an in-depth visual tour, with commentary describing each major POI, along with any updates the location has received.

[b]Prisoner of War Zone: [/b]An inspection of the three different Gulag Showers variants, all identical to the originals, from the rock-throwing rivals along the upper cell blocks to the cracked tiles of the arenas themselves.

[b]Unmarked Areas: [/b]A further graphical showcase across Verdansk: A visual tour of the minor points of interest you remember, from Fire Stations to Burger Towns, as well as the unique POIs scattered across the map.
[h3][b]Overview: Where We Dropping?[/b][/h3]
Go back to where it all began. Welcome back to Verdansk.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/106de11c69c7f37c1bdc8b9cdfc7b9903cb81ae6.jpg[/img]

From long-missed hot drop zones of Superstore, Hospital and Storage Town to the familiar foothills surrounding Military Base and Quarry, there’s a great deal of tactical knowledge to remember from your past times in Verdansk. Before your return to the original, back-to-basics gameplay that Season 03 Verdansk delivers, here’s an in-depth recon reminiscence to jog a memory or two, starting with a clean and fully annotated Tac-Map:

[b]Note: [/b]Before you tour the map, ensure you’re up to date with all Season 03 content by checking out the following blogs prior to the season launch:

[b]Read This Now:[/b] [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/03/call-of-duty-warzone-verdansk-map-return-intel-drop]Return to Verdansk[/url]

[b]Read This Now:[/b] [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides/tac-atlas-verdansk]Verdansk Tac-Atlas[/url]

[b]March 27: [/b]Season 03 Announcement (Multiplayer, Zombies, General Content Intel)

[b]March 28:[/b] Updates to Ricochet: Anti-Cheat™ and security updates

[b]April 2:[/b] Battle Pass, BlackCell and Store Bundles Blog

Then make sure you preload the game prior Black Ops 6’s Season 03 launch on April 2, which comes with a 24-hour Free Trial featuring all premium content available to everyone, and the launch of Verdansk and Call of Duty: Warzone on April 3! All the details you need to know are later in this blog.
[h3][b]Verdansk: Major Points of Interest[/b][/h3][h3][b]Dam[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/03cb25ca03cf7d6ef8b1dbe121fc907ac34aa9c7.jpg[/img]

CAPTION:[b] Gora Dam[/b]: Gain the high ground at the Dam complex, the only area of Verdansk still iced over. Expect a frosty reception as you traverse the large dominant dam structures that provide elevational advantages and excellent views across much of the rest of the map.

While there are interior Ascenders from the tunnels inside the lower generator complex up to the sluice gate towers either side of the Dam wall, the parked helicopter is perhaps the most versatile way to get around this facility. Also check the thick ice behind the Dam. Is that the faint outline of a submarine you can see below the surface? No, it isn’t. Though that rumor is still likely to persist.
[h3][b]Military Base[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/055762baa95e8cae74942df7c5673b41fdc3152a.jpg[/img]

[b]Arklov Peak Military Base:[/b] On the upper plateau below the northern mountains sits a large Military Base that has seen recent action. Featuring a runway; numerous numbered hangars; a maze of barracks, warehouses, and storage areas; and a Killhouse training yard, there’s much to discover (and loot) in these parts.
[h3][b]Quarry[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/50f9190f8cc4c41a305c7dc77ec8912397c58049.jpg[/img]

[b]Karst River Quarry: [/b]Mining the vast Arklov range for various rocks and minerals since 1961, the Quarry is a vast complex of interconnecting warehouses, refineries, dirt roads, rail lines, yards filled with weighty cubes of stone, and… secrets.
[h3][b]Airport[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b510c801f1761259e96545523c4444cc4fd21d31.jpg[/img]

[b]Verdansk International Airport: [/b]Likely a dangerous and active combat zone, Airport features long-range sniping opportunities at the Control Tower, a long underground roadway, vast terminal buildings, and a large Airport Maintenance Hangar complex. Though giant concrete jacks dot the runway in greater numbers than before, this is still a risky place to venture into without a proper game plan.
[h3][b]Storage Town[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/08d89be72ef946aa3174b70681764c6d4384a02f.jpg[/img]

[b]Storage Town: [/b]A bona fide hot drop, this is a maze of over 30 garage structures with six alleyways running north to south and three alleys running east to west. Among this collection of self-storage garages are military tents and a few small brick or metal container offices. Every structure but one is a single level and has a roof you can climb on using nearby scenery.

These tight combat corridors result in ambushes being a frequent occurrence. Venture east to visit the last remaining farmsteads in this zone, and south to the infamous swimming pool.
[h3][b]Superstore[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dae2e31f922e9cd2f79fedc6fa3b4bd261be895b.jpg[/img]

[b]Atlas Superstore:[/b] A vast commercial structure sits just south of the Airport, and it’s the default hot drop for Operators both veteran and new; you’ll be landing on the roof or trying to parachute through the back window like a pro in no time. Superstore has a distinctive blue and yellow logo, two huge signs at each entrance, and a mazelike interior, making it an excellent place to commandeer, but not one you’d want to get lost in.
[h3][b]TV Station[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3496b6c6429777251cb18155d6b34249cd41fd4e.jpg[/img]

[b]BCH TV Station: [/b]Once serving the surrounding communities with quality programming and hard-hitting news, TV Station is in ruins, though it tends to attract Operators with its caches of loot. TV Station is a key strategic point to hold, with its multi-tiered roof, mazelike interior, and excellent defensive potential.
[h3][b]Boneyard[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7d55e1f605dc63cf87645752cb704a169b802282.jpg[/img]

[b]Zhokov Boneyard: [/b]This is the place where planes go to decompose: A sprawling cemetery of airline fuselage sections, hangars, and warehouses where aircraft parts were stripped and sold to the highest bidder. Explore this massive airplane mausoleum using the numbered floodlight poles to situate yourself. Note the walled central area inside the Boneyard with the helipad; known as “Scrapyard”.
[h3][b]Train Station[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd111216a9f8a5e0990a0543f216a478ffcdf94d.jpg[/img]

[b]Verdansk Train Station: [/b]The main concourse is imposing Greek Revival building with an impressive façade, domed roof, and ornate ticket hall. Breach this via the pavement steps close to the Metro entrance. Between the two (currently inaccessible) skybridges and covered steps to the northeast and southwest is the main train platform. Two main hallways through the main station building are accessible – just as they were five years ago – but the interior mezzanine, stairs and shopping mall is currently sealed until Mid-Season.
[h3][b]Hospital[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6cbc3958d19f0a497e5c5a82c5b5c7d2262eb87e.jpg[/img]

[b]Verdansk Hospital: [/b]The main hospital structure has recently seen conflict and chaos, and you can add to it if you spot the helicopter and use its rotors to mow down rival Operators across the rooftops. The ten-level tower is the easiest landmark in the area to distinguish – partly because one of the upper floors is on fire – and the main hospital building below and connected by a skybridge has interior wards and surgery rooms to explore.
[h3][b]Stadium[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ffa6677066209ab31590f56095c309ae2c79c3bc.jpg[/img]

[b]Verdansk Stadium (Acropolis National Arena)[/b]: Before a dark-suited member of Shadow Company opened the massive skylight with a distinct lack of subtlety in Modern Warfare 2019 Season 05, the Acropolis National Arena was a giant structure with a curved rooftop favoring long-range campers, and a large ground concourse along with entrances to subterranean parking. The current stadium interior is sealed. But for how long?
[h3][b]Lumber[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aa6e2faf31af12c95d3db5baaf10f367c1fc387e.jpg[/img]

[b]Gorengard Lumber Yard: [/b]The edge of the forest wilderness east of Karst River is home to the once-thriving Gorengard Lumber Factory. A scattering of outbuildings offering pre-cut lumber, logs, and rail transportation is now a great place to get away from it all; either to stock up before venturing into more active combat zones, or on the way to Farmland or the wilds further north.
[h3][b]Downtown[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a3998444165a98d743abde7ed8a4c4df30fc6262.jpg[/img]

[b]Downtown Tavorsk District[/b]: The main financial, parliamentary, design, arts, and entertainment districts combine into a once-thriving Downtown. The architecture is as varied as the loot you’ll be picking up. The large-scale urban landscape features the most variation in both horizontal and vertical combat, dominated by the infamous SKN Broadcast Tower (get your steps in by climbing the 16-story interior stairwell), City Hall (with the action centered around the half-circle of entrance pillars), and Museum (a large brutalist structure with a rooftop favored by snipers).
[h3][b]Farmland[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a67b05db9ae365fcded7a19e56acf9314f656e2d.jpg[/img]

[b]Krovnik Farmland:[/b] A vast swathe of arable land has been farmed for centuries but has been left abandoned due to the recent conflagration. Barns, cottages, orchards and fallow fields await, along with swift violence. The three old wooden windmills are the unofficial landmark of the northwestern edge of this area, which meanders through pastures, dotted farmsteads, fields of baled hay, all the way to the foothills of Prison.
[h3][b]Promenade[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2a62560255f9a835c788c0fd77cd4b28c447947f.jpg[/img]

[b]Barakett Promenade: [/b]The old East and West Promenade POIs have been combined (on your Tac-Map, but not during Infil) into a single main arterial avenue linking the more rural areas of southwest Verdansk to the once-bustling fairground and Ferris wheel adjacent to the Gora River channel and Downtown, with the Train Station bisecting both Promenades. This divided highway was a bustling hive of commerce. Now the stores, tenement blocks, and open markets sit empty.
[h3][b]Hills[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/46ba52be9a7b3d801dce6227b995715720c7d838.jpg[/img]

[b]Novi Grazna Hills: [/b]The low coastal hills offer views across the map and the POI stretches from the Kart Racing Track (west) all the way to the mouth of the Gora River. Dotted residential tracts, one half-built, encroach the Coastal Memorial. Of all the POIs, Hills has changed the most, with an entirely new stretch of rocky beach and the shallow coastal waters of the Kastovian Sea now accessible. Skulk below the cliffs and use the cliff trails and wooden lookout decks to tactically gain the upper hand.
[h3][b]Park[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4f87d62c3722b80487e1e81441cbdb9df6039635.jpg[/img]

[b]Tavorsk Park: [/b]A small coastal recreational area now sits abandoned, with closed kiosks and drained fountains. A concrete memorial silently watches over this once-vibrant park. Close by is the floodgates at the mouth of the Gora River, the Kastovian Sea with access to Operators seeking aquatic adventures, and impressive subterranean surprises if you manage to (eventually) open Bunker 10 and discover all its secrets….
[h3][b]Port[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/718d09673fa319c78628ca45978f9b278bc0cac0.jpg[/img]

[b]City of Verdansk Port: [/b]The ten dockside cranes, rusting monolithic guardians at the mouth of the Karst River, are your visual cues when heading for the main cargo port. This is a concrete maze of container stacks, crane tracks, checkpoints, processing buildings, fuel depots, and overpass, and a shipping office best described as “Vacant”.
[h3][b]Prison[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/048355969b99a68400841a105f4f5b437e40962e.jpg[/img]

[b]Zordaya Prison Complex: [/b]Constructed in medieval times. Perfected as a place of torture and lament: Prison is a stronghold of cells, yards, and gulag showers where the majority of combat rivalry is settled. Roam the outskirts of this ominous building as the coastal marshland has new trenches to explore. Then prepare for elevated combat across the battlements, down into the cell block tower, past the main Gulag, and out the overflow pipe.
[h3][b]Prisoner of War Zone: Gulag Showers[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a85896ae0f8fbe58f9ff17d79294b4a77e068238.jpg[/img]

Fail at victory the first time during a match, and you’re sent to the infamous Prison Showers Gulag, for a 1v1 confrontation with the victor redeploying. As with the original Verdansk, all three Gulag variants are returning, along with the optional, raucous rock-throwing from the cellblocks above.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f22785e4915a5ad44189678943b37fb13a7f5f0d.jpg[/img]

[b]Gulag (Variant 1)[/b]: The only variant not completely symmetrical, with a U-shaped central shower block.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5c9e7f315b0cf50d3525b97e37bb5f1248407781.jpg[/img]

[b]Gulag (Variant 2)[/b]: A wider central area with increased maneuverability, featuring two opposing shower blocks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6043cec281ad11ce9568567a1f41edf6976acaa3.jpg[/img]

[b]Gulag (Variant 3)[/b]: The central area is dominated by two curved shower block sections, and more cover.
[h3][b]Unmarked Points of Interest[/b][/h3]
Remember these places from your past?

Get ready to revisit the smaller, but just as memorable areas across Verdansk, including those outside the boundaries of the main named POIs. Some of your fiercest firefights are likely to have centered around these instantly recognizable smaller locations, many likely to be stocked with high value loot or other advantages. Below, we’ve gathered some of the most notable. And infamous….
[h3][b]Public Building Landmarks[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f7cb2f31a5f6d8962443a7adaa4247da426e4ca.jpg[/img]

[b]Police Station (Top-left): [/b]Storm the interior armory, drop in via that handy roof hatch, and look for the parked ATV.

[b]Pharmacy (Top-right): [/b]Grab medical supplies at the blue and pitched-roof pharmacy with a nickname more associated a popular breakfast restaurant chain.

[b]Metro (Bottom-left):[/b] Though all the Metro entrances are available across the map – including those added during [i]Modern Warfare[/i] 2019’s live seasons – there are no plans to open the Fast Travel system.

[b]Fire Station (Bottom-right):[/b] Still the best place to grab a “Bertha” truck. Just watch for snipers in the watch tower.
[h3][b]Public Building Landmarks (Continued)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d6efe2f00bbc3eafec27226afab876fb7d9ae410.jpg[/img]

[b]Public House (Top-left):[/b] Almost totally sealed from the outside, with a lot of heavy wood and booths and a kitchen on the inside. Does the expertly timed jump trick from the open patio umbrellas onto the exterior balcony still work?

[b]Gas Stations (Top-right): [/b]Head to the low roof to survey your surroundings, and to go prone in a pinch, and come here to pick up an all-terrain vehicle, but there’s no need to stop for repairs and gas for your rides; that game mechanic isn’t in Verdansk.

[b]Banks (Bottom-left): [/b]Big green buildings could be the place for valuable loot, and the crenelated roof wall offers sniping peeking opportunities.

[b]Burger Towns, Gun Stores, and Tenement Blocks (Bottom-right): [/b]Lozoff Pass has it all, including examples of infamous interior stairwell and ranged-roof combat around the apartment building, with loot and concealment opportunities available within the Burger Town and Gun Store.
[h3][b]Unmarked POIs (Northwest Mountains)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2e10d3193ff15f7989f3b69ffc4437351f266883.jpg[/img]

The various hamlets known as “Blocs” are dotted across the northern wooded foothills, and feature dwellings in various stages of dilapidation, a rickety railway bridge, impressive views from the tops of comms towers, and giant concrete memorials where you’re likely to find transport as well as an ambush.
[h3][b]Unmarked POIs (North and Northeast)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/41c062e661b36a1829850c6382ef2bfffc8c5db8.jpg[/img]

Exploration close to the Karst River Quarry brings you to various out-of-the-way places, including a Loading Yard, the Crash Site, various wooded compounds in Bloc 14, and remote but strategically important huntsman’s hide towers.
[h3][b]Unmarked POIs (Northeast Wilderness)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a9649500db0d94e8807f8c9a145654d3d15f538e.jpg[/img]

The wilderness south of Quarry still features frozen tundra and an illegally parked bus (Top-right), and at lower altitudes, a WHP Camp (Top-left) with overwatch possibilities when viewing Stadium to the south. Meanwhile at Bloc 14, the mechanic’s bay garage (Bottom-left) indicates less visual glare when viewing the outdoors from inside. Finally, a reconnoiter wouldn’t be complete without a visit to Grandma’s House (Bottom-right).
[h3][b]Unmarked POIs (Western Verdansk)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/77875b891d6c9e67fa419a317cc81abc036474af.jpg[/img]

The western edge of the map features low foothills and a shipping yard just below the windfarm (Top-right). But the largest collection of vehicular scrap outside of Boneyard is a little further south in the Junkyard (Top-left). There are also Bunkers to explore (Bottom-right), though they seem to be locked… for the moment. Venture southwest to the Kart Racing Track (Bottom-left), a likely spot for an ATV and new access down to the coastal waters.
[h3][b]Unmarked POIs (Central Verdansk)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/671d82b0da81747a9abb8302b04770def375924b.jpg[/img]

From the remains of the local swimming pool (Bottom-left) and Old Farmstead (Top-right) that provides treacherous movement opportunities from Storage Town to Superstore, it’s time to remember your preferred routes across the map. Utilize any piece of cover you can, from the Hobo Carriage (Top-left) just east of Hangars, to the collection of fuel vats just south of Airport Maintenance (Bottom-right), the latter earning a nickname a little too rude to mention in this Blog.
[h3][b]Unmarked POIs (Central Verdansk, continued)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d7a3bed03690ec00f153f177562b05f426058921.jpg[/img]

On the wooded hills overlooking Hospital where a Streamer was once run over by his own Cargo Truck is a small hut and radio mast; usually occupied, more often than not (Top-left). West of Train Station, the view from an interior carriage shows the refined and improved draw distances (Top-right). But the twin tenements of Torsk Bloc (Bottom-left) and the surroundings south of Superstore, including the Graveyard, are where power positions can be claimed. As well as getting a brutal stairs workout to reach the top of the Bloc.
[h3][b]Unmarked POIs (Central and Eastern Verdansk)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d6b005a996cecbededb759d3d2d9387a4fe3e03c.jpg[/img]

As you move across various major POIs like Stadium, it’s beneficial to plot a course through the surrounding areas, like the fumigation warehouse and Bloc 6 (Top row). Or you can hole up in the wilderness close to the unfrozen Karst River and Bloc 18 (Bottom-left). Further downstream is the old Fishing Hut (Bottom-right) on the edge of the concrete river basin, a common place to see hapless squads eliminated trying to reposition during a late circle collapse.
[h3][b]Unmarked POIs (Southern Verdansk)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/516deca8981f87141f4b67c5559db0a3fcb957c3.jpg[/img]

Along the southern edge of Verdansk, the Kastovian Sea has become accessible to Operators, and the shoreline (Top-left) with its steep paths and viewing decks has creating new, but usually not match-changing opportunities for maneuvering. Further inland are the dotted dwellings across Novi Grazna Hills (Top-right), with some remote homesteads being an optimal place to seek cover. Further east, the small military storage depot adjacent to Port (Bottom-left) is now one of the entrances to the newly dug marsh trenches that meander all the way to the base of Prison, offering a respite of cover. South of the Prison, the seldom-visited cove and rugged coastal offers Operators a fair share of new surprises….
[h2][u]Prepare for Season 03 Now! Verdansk Launch Sequence[/u][/h2]
[b]Important Intel: [/b]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 Multiplayer, Zombies, and General game content drops a day early on Wednesday April 2, 9AM PT. Call of Duty: Warzone content launches 24 hours later, on Thursday April 3, 9AM PT.

[b]Free Trial: Play All of Black Ops 6 During 24-Hour Countdown: [/b]Pre-load the game, then access Black Ops 6 as a premium player or via a Free Trial with [u]the entire Season 03 premium game[/u] accessible for 24 hours, allowing you to grind out some of the new weapons, including the Kilo 141, CR-56 AMAX, and HDR.

[b]Welcome Home: [/b]At around 9AM PT on April 3rd, expect to access the Call of Duty: Warzone lobby, squad up, and return to Verdansk on PC for the first time since December 2021.
[h3][b]Season 03 and the Return of Verdansk: April 2 9AM PT to April 3 9AM PT[/b][/h3]
Prior to the March 27 Season 03 Announcement Blog and Roadmap detailing all new Multiplayer, Zombies, and general content shared with Call of Duty: Warzone, we can confirm that the Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 Season 03 launch is planned to roll out across two separate days:

[b]Wednesday April 2, 9AM PT: [/b]Black Ops 6 Multiplayer, Zombies, Battle Pass, and general content launches.

[b]Thursday April 3, 9AM PT: [/b]Call of Duty: Warzone content launches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/52ecd10a6ea1d8b22200c789f2cd4fd009d7d57e.jpg[/img]

Be sure you preload both Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Warzone content files in the hours before launch, as there’s plenty of content for all players to enjoy throughout this 24-hour period! Here’s a timeline of what to expect:

Call of Duty: Warzone won’t be available until the next day, but the Kilo 141 will![/*][/list][h3][b]24-hours Countdown: Wednesday April 2, 9:01AM PT to Thursday April 3, 8:59AM PT[/b][/h3][list]	[*]A 24-hour “Countdown to Verdansk launch” timer now begins.[/*]	[*]Use these 24 hours wisely: This is the very best time to level up all preferred weapons you want to use in Verdansk![/*]	[*]Obtain the Kilo 141 for free, optionally pop a couple of 2WXP tokens, and play Black Ops 6 content to unlock attachments and camos, via the Premium game or Free Trial.[/*]	[*]Get into the proper Grindset: Complete Season 03 Battle Pass Pages (free or paid) to unlock two additional new base weapons; the CR-56 AMAX Assault Rifle, and the HDR Sniper Rifle.[/*][/list][h3][b]Welcome Home: Thursday April 3, 9:00AM PT[/b][/h3]
