notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 02 Reloaded: All you need to know
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Season 02 Reloaded: Incoming Intel[/u][/h2][h3]The Fight Continues[/h3]
Sev and Rogue Team remain on the run, evading capture while fighting back when the opportunity strikes. In the ongoing game of cat and mouse, the hunt continues.

[previewyoutube=qTmFLpEiKyE;full][b][u][[TRAILER VIDEO]][/u][/b][/previewyoutube]

The mid-season update for [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] sets the stakes even higher with new maps, new weapons and attachments, Perks, and more, including an awesome seasonal collaboration featuring everyone’s favorite heroes in a half-shell.

[i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] Season 02 Reloaded arrives on Thursday, February 20 at 9AM PT.
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: Season 02 Reloaded[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1b785e52b03676fb2bbdf4d66c39ec2dfef6d14d.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Two Maps:[/b] Catch some air and battle around ramps and rails as Grind Ooze arrives in a special variant of the fan-favorite skatepark. Take the fight to a speeding train in the Bullet Strike map, battling within its narrow carriages and up top in the whistling wind.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]TMNT Moshpit:[/b] Experience a radical new limited-time Moshpit as the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles bring their elite combat abilities to Multiplayer.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Loadout Content:[/b] Mark your next target for elimination with the Hunter’s Instinct Perk and be prepared for any and all aerial threats using the new Flyswatter Wildcard.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][h3]Grind Ooze[/h3]
[i]Remaster, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d64a6e98d34783ab8470c057295a7e57318cbdb4.jpg[/img]

The fan-favorite map first released in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops II[/i] returns for [i]Black Ops 6[/i] in the mid-season! Show off your best combat moves in the outdoor Half Pipe and Cradle or take your chances inside as Operators trade shots around the Store and across the indoor skate ramps, with TMNT decals, posters, and artwork spread across the scenery.
[h3]Bullet[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Strike, 6v6/2v2, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d950bb1bec290356a51296257bbaf5e79a7ee784.jpg[/img]

Sev and Rogue Team deploy to a high-speed bullet train to neutralize a key enemy target. Keep your eyes sharp when moving up and sweeping the carriages; the automatic sliding doors may reveal an incoming enemy at a moment’s notice. Climb up to the roof of the train to feel the whipping wind and marvel at the landscape flying by. Be ready to defend your spot up top and then drop back down behind the enemy line.
[h3]Turtle Power! New TMNT-themed Limited Time Mode[/h3]
The Ninja Turtles have arrived in [i]Call of Duty[/i] and are kicking things off with a limited time Moshpit giving everyone the chance to let loose with their best TMNT-themed abilities and moves.
[h3]TMNT Moshpit[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/82a32b2b8900048d0c3404712e0aba61c31f76b7.jpg[/img]

Enter a game of Team Deathmatch, Domination, or Hardpoint and unleash ninja-level abilities and TMNT Scorestreaks against your enemies in pursuit of victory. These special Scorestreaks are earned by scoring as normal, but because the turtles work as a team, objective plays award an increase in the score.

Activating your special Scorestreak gives you the following benefits:

[b]General Abilities[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e8a336df97df4b8726d29b91fd9c0fa852135a7a.jpg[/img]

For 30 seconds, gain increased health plus fast health regen and increased movement speed and melee range. A HUD indicator will flash when an enemy is outside your view and being shot while running toward an enemy will not slow you down. You can perform Finishing Moves on enemies from any direction. Plus, gain the ability to Double Jump and Air Dash.

[b]Turtle Powers[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/34ed3ea4afd1117d4402adf63dea2902851e7e41.jpg[/img]

Using your TMNT Scorestreak also activates one of several different character-specific abilities. One of these abilities is assigned randomly to players at the start of the match. Those deploying with a TMNT Operator, however, will get access to that character’s specific Scorestreak. The abilities include:
[list]	[*][b]Splinter: [/b]Vanish in smoke and teleport to a safe location behind enemy lines.[/*]	[*][b]Leonardo: [/b]Gain the Tracker, Ghost, Vigilance, and Cold-Blooded Perks to navigate the map in stealth.[/*]	[*][b]Donatello: [/b]See Operators through walls as well as Equipment, Field Upgrades, and Scorestreaks. Hack enemy Equipment and Field Upgrades.[/*]	[*][b]Michelangelo: [/b]Drops a Pizza Box for your team. Players who eat a slice will deal Double Damage for a short time. Replenishes ammo and Equipment.[/*]	[*][b]Raphael: [/b]Unlimited Shuriken.[/*][/list][h3]New Loadout Content[/h3]
Mark the next target for elimination and swap your Dedicated Melee for a Launcher with two new Loadout items expanding your options in the field.
[h3]New Perk[/h3]
[b]Perk: Hunter’s Instinct[/b]

[b]Perk Slot:[/b] 2

[b]Type:[/b] Enforcer (Red)

[b]Available: [/b]Season 02 Reloaded Reward

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0a8d1bd313730e218ba0bfb2aaa4a8e8f9d996dd.jpg[/img]

Eliminating an enemy will mark the next closest one. A narrow cone briefly appears on your mini-map after an elimination, showing the general direction of your next nearest foe.
[h3]New Wildcard[/h3]
[b]Wildcard: Flyswatter[/b]

[b]Available: [/b]Season 02 Reloaded Reward

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4493afea9dbdb4d413412bd6402b538774917ed6.jpg[/img]

Allows a player to replace their Dedicated Melee weapon with a Launcher.
[h2]Zombies: Season 02 Reloaded Content[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ffb5c06a442ce9445a948b1a788b39d0f2316e5e.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Cowabunga Cranked:[/b] Kick undead butt and don’t let up as the timer keeps ticking down in this TMNT Zombies LTM, challenging players to take down target after target to beat the clock and stay alive.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]The Tomb – Directed Mode:[/b] Directed Mode arrives for The Tomb, granting players extra guidance and round cap limitations when taking on the Main Quest.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Rage like Raph in TMNT Cranked[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/70ae474872ac8a6e315e452424489513c865ee7e.jpg[/img]

There’s nothing like a train of undead targets to test the turtles’ fighting prowess. It’s time to go loud in this new limited-time Cranked variant, testing players with a timer that left unchecked will count down to their own destruction. Here’s how this plays out:
[h3]Cowabunga Cranked[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9ab9cd6f312f83538d87c94fd9444a63a0e2d01c.jpg[/img]

Add some high-octane urgency to any of the four Zombies maps and your undead horde slaying in Cowabunga Cranked. Drop into Terminus, Liberty Falls, Citadelle des Morts, or The Tomb with your Loadout of choice and eliminate a zombie to trigger the Cranked timer. Fail to eliminate a zombie before the timer hits zero and ka-boom! You’re gone.

As rounds progress, the Cranked timer will continue to shrink, so keep pushing the fight to stay in the game! Thankfully, there are several Pizza power-ups that can drop in the match, including:
[list]	[*][b]Turtle Power: [/b]Temporarily empowers the player with a health bonus and Pack-A-Punch 3 Legendary Melee Weapons[/*]	[*][b]Pizza Box:[/b] Fills the Cranked Timer to max[/*]	[*][b]Slice-O-Pie: [/b]Partial time added to the Cranked Timer[/*][/list]
Plus, all players in this mode are given the Donny’s Time Stopper Field Upgrade; activate it to pause the Cranked timer for one full minute!

Deploy as a Ninja Turtle Operator to gain 50% reduced damage from behind; join as Splinter for a slightly increased chance for a Slice-O-Pie to drop from eliminated enemies.

For those craving a real challenge, Main Quests will be active in Cowabunga Cranked, with a subtly different TMNT version of each map’s Main Quest completion Calling Card available as a memento for anyone radical enough to achieve this feat! Think you can finish all of them?
[h3]The Tomb: Directed Mode[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/70d7952a4db1bd15635ba42b44d25f260b7f2cd7.jpg[/img]

Season 02 Reloaded brings Directed Mode for The Tomb. Explore the cursed catacombs and teleport to a world of chaos through the Doorway to Nowhere. In Directed Mode, players can take on the Main Quest with added guidance and a maximum round cap of 15.

Start at the Dig Site and descend into the tombs, unearthing ancient burial sites and shrines along with the new Shock Mimic enemy, the Arrow Trap, and the legendary Staff of Ice Wonder Weapon. If you haven’t yet experienced the full Main Quest — or if you’re itching to play it through again with some added help — this is your chance to discover the newest shocking revelations, as Weaver, Maya, Carver, and Grey seek out the Sentinel Artifact in hopes of freeing Samantha Maxis from her Dark Aether imprisonment.
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Warzone: Season 02 Reloaded Content [/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9a8939bbdec86a809628282b40f69f8cd13f674d.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Season 02 Reloaded:[/b] We’re continuing to prioritize gameplay tuning, quality of life improvements, and more throughout the mid-season as players deploy across Urzikstan, Area 99, and Rebirth Island.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Perk: [/b]Stay low and keep on the move with the new Low Profile Perk, improving your movement speed when crouched, prone, and downed.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Call of Duty: Warzone Updates[/h3]
As stated in our Season 02 launch article, our main focus in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] is prioritizing gameplay tuning by addressing quality of life improvements, ongoing bugs, and more. Consult the consistently updated [url=https://www.callofduty.com/patchnotes/2025/01/call-of-duty-bo6-warzone-season-02-patch-notes]Patch Notes[/url] for further information.
[h2]Overview and Features[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a41cd43ef3c973bbf1ebba8c7f770c35a359c049.jpg[/img]

Players will continue duking it out in Battle Royale, Resurgence, and Plunder across Urzikstan, Area 99, and Rebirth Island, and Ranked Play across Urzikstan. XP earned within [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] will also contribute toward ongoing Events including the [i]Call of Duty x Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles[/i] and Clover Craze Events, detailed later in this blog.
[h3]New Perk[/h3]
[b]Perk: Low Profile[/b]

[b]Perk Slot:[/b] 1

[b]Available: [/b]Season 02 Reloaded Reward

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/76b473b27385ee2a5d7d20b1bc56502a98cbcc15.jpg[/img]

Move more quickly while crouched and prone. Enemies you kill will not have death markers for their allies. Move slightly faster when downed.
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: General Content (MP, ZM, WZ)[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fcaa5d64849225ab704faa5aacba9eb085662037.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Upgrade Your Arsenal:[/b] Earn six new weapons (D1.3 Sector Special, Skateboard Melee, Bo Staff, Katanas, Sai, and Nunchaku Melee Weapons) plus the new Belt-Fed Attachment for all four LMGs.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Events:[/b] Earn new base weapons, Operators, Skins, and more across the Call of Duty x TMNT and St. Patrick’s Day in-game Events.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Store Offerings:[/b] Keep the Ninja Turtles at your fingertips with four new Bundles featuring the green team and enjoy free gift packs celebrating Black History Month and Women’s History Month.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Weapons Detail[/h3]
The mid-season update brings epic new weapons to battle with, including a sawblade Secondary Weapon and a whopping five new Melee Weapons. Note that the base versions of the Bo Staff, Katanas, Sai, and Nunchaku Melee weapons will be available to unlock via the Armory at the start of Season 02 Reloaded.
[h3]Secondary Weapon: D1.3 Sector[/h3]
[b][i]Special, TMNT Event, Free Track Reward[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c04d7ed79091bea091a8e67da60aeea9260dd09b.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 20[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 5[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Stock

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Accessories (1), Decals (1).

[i]Rechambering blade launcher. Equip different magazines to access a variety of deadly projectile types.[/i]

Cut the enemy to ribbons with this Special Secondary Weapon that fires saw blades at your foe. A variant based on the infamous D1.3 Sector in [i]Black Ops III[/i], use this special launcher by firing down sights or off the hip and account for the weapon’s heavier projectiles when acquiring targets. A quick reload speed gets you back into the action with several powerful attachments available via Gunsmith including new projectile types like the Explosive Blades and Ricochet Blades as well as a Long Barrel, Crossbar, and an Overclocked Stock.
[h3]Melee Weapon: Skateboard[/h3]
[b][i]Melee, TMNT Event, Free Track Reward, Premium Track Reward (additional Blueprint)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/86aea3ec51fa2df3bbec3628515bf941e9f24537.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]None

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins.

[i]One-hit elimination. Moderately fast attack speed. Moderately long range.[/i]

Hold onto your board deck side out and swat away enemies in your way. The Skateboard features swiping attacks from side to side as well as an overhead slam. Wind up with a heavy attack to knock the wind out of your target before finishing with the final blow.
[h3]Melee Weapon: Katanas[/h3]
[b][i]Melee, Armory Unlock, Blueprint version shown (available via Bundle)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/48df9fddd5552420cb12e3a94e8b4c3dda8bb534.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]None

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins.

[i]One-hit elimination. Moderately fast attack speed. Short range.[/i]

Slice, chop, and hit with both Katanas at once using this impressive dual wield setup that makes short work of enemies in close proximity. Prepare a heavy attack to end the encounter with a dispatch above the collar.
[h3]Melee Weapon: Bo Staff[/h3]
[b][i]Melee, Armory Unlock, Blueprint version shown (available via Bundle), TMNT Event, Premium Track Reward (additional Blueprint)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/387185c3396c9a2ecf5de2722e183d6f0c2c7a22.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]None

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins.

[i]One-hit elimination. Slow attack speed. Very long range.[/i]

Swipe and strike at targets using the Bo Staff’s long reach to hit them from further out compared to other Melee Weapons. Conduct a heavy attack to knock foes silly with a clobbering smash.
[h3]Melee Weapon: Nunchaku[/h3]
[b][i]Melee, Armory Unlock, Blueprint version shown (available via Bundle)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/59b5ec1a13d1dbc2fdd4aed81ab8bf9cee91c583.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]None

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins.

[i]Two-hit elimination. Very fast attack speed. Medium range.[/i]

Though they don’t dish out as much damage as the other ninja weapons, the Nunchaku more than makes up for it with a rapid attack speed that quickly chains into follow-up attacks. Prepare the heavy strike to spin your target around and then knock them to the ground.
[h3]Melee Weapon: Sai[/h3]
[b][i]Melee, Armory Unlock, Blueprint version shown (available via Bundle)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd1130ab5de4dff84d5eef27d5ee3414dc5e26a1.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]None

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins.

[i]One-hit elimination. Fast attack speed. Very short range.[/i]

Equip a pair of Sai and get up close and personal with rapid attacks that will send foes reeling. Hold your weapons at the ready using the heavy attack and unleash them when the time to strike is right.
[h3]New: Special Weapon Attachments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3a250fb7bfabaad6e444e45090a70e013df2fc27.jpg[/img]
[h3]Belt-Fed Attachment[/h3]
[i]Four variants; PU-21, XMG, GPMG-7, Feng 82 LMGs, Magazine Attachment, TMNT Free Track Reward[/i]

Outfit any of the four available LMGs with a large helping of extra ammo continuously fed to the weapon through sustained fire. Belt-fed weapons can overheat through extensive use, so lay off the trigger now and then to let things cool down before resuming your attack.
[h3]Season 02 Reloaded Events[/h3]
Rack up the XP and earn rewards including a new Season 02 Reloaded Secondary Weapon, Melee Weapon, Ammo-chewing Attachments, and more across two green-themed in-game Events.
[h3]Call of Duty x Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (MP, ZM, WZ)[/h3]
Activation Dates: February 27 to March 13

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3c2db2469bce6fa7d1020b8bf806f244cd74a46c.jpg[/img]

The [i]Call of Duty x Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles[/i] collaboration includes its own in-game Mid-Season Event Pass, offering rewards like the new “Splinter” Operator, Skateboard Melee Weapon, and the sawblade shooting D1.3 Sector Special Weapon.

[b]Free Track[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c01e610eadeb2fc0643542dbedaa8e101df9df3e.jpg[/img]

All players can make progress and unlock rewards along the Free Track simply by earning XP in Multiplayer, Zombies, or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] while the Event is live. Earn new Foot Clan themed Operator Skins plus highlights like the new Skateboard Melee Weapon, the Belt-Fed Attachment, and the sharp-toothed D1.3 Sector Special Weapon.

[b]Free Track Mastery Reward: D1.3 Sector[/b]

Complete the Free Track to unlock the D1.3 Sector Saw Blade Launcher Special Weapon, firing razor sharp blades that cuts down enemies in their tracks.

[b]Get More with the Premium Reward Track[/b]

Players who purchase the Premium Track for 1,100 COD Points can also progress along a second track featuring even more TMNT-themed rewards, including a new Finishing Move, Weapon Blueprints like the “Splinter’s Cane” Bo Staff, “Sewer Surfer” Skateboard, and “Sliced” D1.3 Sector, and the “Brainiac” Gun Screen.

[b]Ultimate Mastery Reward: “Splinter” Operator[/b]

Take on the role of turtle sensei by completing the Premium Track and unlocking the ninja master himself as the new “Splinter” Operator.
[h3]Event: Clover Craze (MP, ZM, WZ)[/h3]
Activation Dates: March 13 to end of Season

Total Rewards: 10

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fd281d3c88b5a1025b56fb4a4fa0cbca782afbfe.jpg[/img]

Eliminate enemies in Multiplayer and Zombies and open Caches in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] to acquire different types of clovers. Find the Rare Gold Clover for the most points! Redeem for rewards, including the lucky “Cloverleaf” AMES AR Blueprint.
[h3]New Store Offerings[/h3]
The Ninja Turtles lead the way with four new Store Bundles, each themed around one of the reptilian green teens. Also look for Free Gift Packs arriving throughout the mid-season, celebrating Black History Month in February and Women’s History Month in March.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Leonardo[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a3ae532cf4aeb49d30f82b551e20778d6accd163.jpg[/img]

Deploy as Leonardo, the trusty and honorable leader of the Ninja Turtles. Lead your teammates into battle with “Leonardo’s Katanas” Melee Weapon Blueprint and shred enemies with the “Dicer” Krig C Assault Rifle and the “Scrapper” Kompakt 92 SMG, both featuring Blue Tracers. All three Weapon Blueprints include TMNT Comic Death FX. Up close, finish them off with the “Blade Dance” Finishing Move.

Plus, dangle some ooze with the “Containment” Weapon Charm, hang upside down with the “Balanced Life” Emote, and equip the “Turtle Stance” Animated Calling Card, “Into the Night” Large Decal, and “Stoic Leo” Animated Emblem.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Donatello[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bb3b42bdce771b5592fc197d419d8f6f9a839254.jpg[/img]

Unleash your ninja skills as Donatello and knock some sense into the bad guys with “Donatello’s Bo Staff” Melee Weapon plus the “Rampager” GPR 91 Assault Rifle and “Max Damage” SVD Sniper Rifle Weapon Blueprints, both featuring Purple Tracers while all three include TMNT Ooze Canister Death FX. In close-quarters, make them dance with the “Bo-Staff Boogie” Finishing Move.

Keep a memento of the Turtle Van with the “Primo Ride” Weapon Charm and show off your style with the “Parkour Patrol” Animated Calling Card, “Halfshell” Weapon Sticker, and “Donatello Rizz” Animated Emblem.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Michelangelo[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4f71f0e069e83e05a0f79e3d61d7eec5f9c92997.jpg[/img]

Get the party started as Michelangelo and fly into battle with his signature “Michelangelo’s Nunchucks” Melee Weapon Blueprint. Inflict Mikey’s particular brand of chaos with the “Chaos Sow” AK-74 Assault Rifle and “On Call” DM-10 Marksman Rifle Weapon Blueprints, both featuring Orange Tracers while all three Weapon Blueprints include TMNT Pizza Death FX. From behind, take foes down with the “Nunchuk Chop” Finishing Move.

Keep pizza close at hand with the “Dished” Weapon Charm and “Pizza Party” Emote and keep the party alive with the “Swinging Heat” Animated Calling Card, “Home Sweet Home” Spray, and “Mikey Charmin’” Animated Emblem.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Raphael[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8534ff93e97486a4e5b05d9c4fd04b288a6275e3.jpg[/img]

Get ready to rage as Raphael, always the first to the fight. Face down the competition with “Raphael’s Sai” Melee Weapon Blueprint along with the “Tank” C9 SMG and “Big Brained” GPMG-7 LMG Weapon Blueprints, both featuring Red Tracers. All three Weapon Blueprints include the TMNT Ninja Star Death FX. Make short work of foes with the “Quick Skills” Finishing Move.

Keep in fighting shape with the “Kickin’ It’ Emote, “Crossed Sai” Reticle, “Fortress” Frag Skin, “Ready Raph” Animated Calling Card, and “Raph’s Grin” Animated Emblem.
[h3]Black History Month: Free Gift Pack (February 20)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/07644d6a38ec419f02ca61606c5789bc7fbe324d.jpg[/img]

To honor Black History Month, we’re releasing a free gift pack featuring a Loading Screen, Emblem, and Calling Card, available in the in-game Store starting February 20.
[h3]Women’s History Month: Free Gift Pack (March 10)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b4cffc795abc16161319f13eb14610aff9b749a0.jpg[/img]

Get another free gift pack with a Loading Screen, Emblem, and Calling Card celebrating Women’s History Month, available in the in-game Store starting March 10.
[h2]Invite Drop: Join the Call of Duty Recon Squad[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a265d76325103ae7adb2d999ca232bf152a5aafa.jpg[/img]

Our commitment to community feedback remains unwavering and ongoing as we strive with our continuing mission: making our games social and fun. We truly value your opinions and feedback on what matters to you. With this in mind, and in addition to the usual methods of communication, our players now have a new way to give their feedback.

Introducing the Call of Duty: Recon Squad.

While playing Call of Duty, you may be invited to join the Call of Duty Recon Squad operated by Fuel Cycle. The Call of Duty Recon Squad is a Fuel Cycle research community that will be active throughout the [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] Seasons. You’ll have opportunities to provide feedback through surveys, online community discussion boards, and potentially even invited to focus groups. And best of all, any feedback you provide will earn points in the Recon Squad that you can redeem for BO6 and/or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] in-game items!

Fuel Cycle community research topics will be centered on recently released [i]Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] content and many other topics related to Call of Duty.We’re interested in hearing what you have to say about recent maps, modes, and other seasonal content from our games!

This Fuel Cycle community is ‘invite-only’, so you won’t be able to forward this to any of your friends or family to have them sign up – so any invite you may receive is just for you. All types of players are being invited – no matter the modes or number of hours you play, we want to hear from you! If you receive an invite (from Call of Duty, via the email related to your Activision ID), don’t miss out on this chance to have your voice heard and score some in-game items as a result!
[h2]Upgrade to Black Ops 6 Today![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a42fcb00e339348bc63af39bdb25d2ca30e6b408.jpg[/img]

[i]Black Ops 6[/i] is available now, and there’s never been a better time to experience the spy action thriller Campaign, the in-depth tactical chaos of best-in-class Multiplayer, and soak in the gory glory of an incredible round-based Zombies experience! notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 02 Free Trial: Multiplayer and Zombies
notes.notes:
For a limited time from February 6 through February 10, play Multiplayer and Zombies in [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] during the Free Trial period, including select content released with the launch of Season 02.

In Multiplayer, drop into new maps like Bounty and Dealership and keep the streak going in the new Overdrive mode. Plus, play fan-favorite maps with Nuketown 24/7, Stakeout 24/7, and more.

In Zombies, continue the terrifying narrative in Season 02’s newest map, The Tomb, and head to the once idyllic West Virginian town of Liberty Falls, including its Directed Mode featuring objective markers guiding players through the entire Main Quest.
[h2][u]New Season 02 Multiplayer Maps[/u][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/68c60ecabab01e41613ab7adbffcf46b1ab32ced.jpg[/img]
[b]Bounty (6v6):[/b] Ascend to the top an Avalon skyscraper at sunrise, battling through the Riviera Rouge where rich clientele rub shoulders in the gilded Nightclub and Lounge, including V.I.P. access for the cream of the crop.

Fight through the Lobby to reach the rear Office, currently under construction with building tools and materials littered across the floor. Head out to the Rooftop for a breath of fresh air and surprise your enemies by running around the building’s outer perimeter. Watch your step when moving over the Skylight — if the glass gets shot out from under your feet, it’s a long drop to the bottom.

Get more intel on this map with our in-depth [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides/blackops6/multiplayer-maps/call-of-duty-guides-black-ops-6-multiplayer-map-guide-bounty]Bounty map guide[/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e834431b5797f61fd47c04518948df540d57281e.jpg[/img]
[b]Dealership (6v6): [/b]Plant your feet firmly back on the ground floor in the luxurious Pallasar Dealership, a black-market front for the criminal underworld where deals are made for guns, ammunition, and other favors.

Engage the enemy around the wreckage in the Car Lot and Showroom, pressing the fight into the interior Sales room and Commissary. In the back, activate the sliding doors on either side of the Garage, and get above the action by taking up a vantage point in the Admin office. Race to the enemy by steering an RC-XD through the floor vent and detonating right under their feet.

Get more intel on this map with our in-depth [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides/blackops6/multiplayer-maps/call-of-duty-guides-black-ops-6-multiplayer-map-guide-dealership]Dealership map guide[/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f309d68e6fef50d577eeeb281855e0a6ffe602cf.jpg[/img]
[b]Lifeline (2v2/6v6): [/b]Hit the high seas on this new Strike map taking place on a small, high-end yacht that’s been set ablaze by Sev and her Rogue team allies during a daring escape. Chaos ensues as Operators collide in the center Bar and gambling den and along the tight steps on Portside and Starboard. Keep up the pressure and check your six as threats close in from every side.

Get more intel on this map with our in-depth [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides/blackops6/multiplayer-maps/call-of-duty-guides-black-ops-6-multiplayer-map-guide-lifeline]Lifeline map guide[/url].
[h2][u]Play the New Overdrive Mode[/u][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fbf5b96deae92c34e07045a6ee229ffb08fc1d8b.jpg[/img]
Get a taste of the brand-new Overdrive mode introduced in Season 02. This heart-pumping twist on Team Deathmatch sees teams competing to earn stars by accomplishing the following actions:
[list]	[*]Earn 1 star for Basic Eliminations like finishing off an enemy with body shots.[/*]	[*]Earn 2 stars for Core Medal Eliminations like headshots and melee attacks.[/*]	[*]Earn 3 stars for completing Distinguished Medal Eliminations, reserved for only the most impressive takedowns.[/*][/list]
Earning stars also grants special Operator abilities to help you in the fight, including the following buffs:
[list]	[*][b]1 Star:[/b] Awakened Senses: See enemies through walls and replenish your health after eliminating a target.[/*]	[*][b]3 Stars:[/b] Physical Enhancements: Increased movement and reloading speed.[/*]	[*][b]6 Stars:[/b] Augmented Handling: Improved hip-fire accuracy and improved sprint-to-fire and ADS speeds.[/*][/list]
Earn all three buffs to active Overdrive, earning double the stars when eliminating enemies. If you get eliminated, or the elimination timer runs out, you’ll start back at your base abilities. The first team to collect the maximum number of stars wins.
[h2][u]Enter The Tomb and More in Zombies[/u][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7cb2c50bc4b60d82d5fc01cca96a0ae1e34421ce.jpg[/img]
[b]The Tomb: [/b]Gear up and deploy to The Tomb, a brand-new Zombies map introduced in Season 02. Take the amulet secured at the Citadel to a cursed excavation site and the ancient catacombs within. Reports of paranormal phenomena go back centuries, possibly related to the presence of the Sentinel Artifact.

In this epic new adventure, follow in the footsteps of a doomed explorer and uncover a long-forgotten dig site with a past that stretches back to ancient times.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dbb835b5c1865b5cc17f9f45500b15fe10cf1f53.jpg[/img]
[b]Liberty Falls: [/b]Explore the once-idyllic West Virginian town of Liberty Falls, whose residents have either fled or barricaded themselves into the settlement in a last desperate attempt to survive. By the time you arrive — under the watchful eye of Project Janus Security Chief John Blanchard — the town is overrun, and the battle seems well and truly lost.

The Free Trial period also includes [b]Directed Mode[/b] for Liberty Falls. For players who want to follow the Zombies stories with a guiding hand, Directed Mode marks all objectives with a maximum round cap of 15. This is perfect for new players and those who want to focus solely on the map’s narrative elements.
[h2][u]All Supported Maps and Modes[/u][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c13d2a180c5da84681f59151d8d06fe3fc28d469.jpg[/img]
[b]Multiplayer Playlists and Game Modes: [/b]Nuketown 24/7, Stakeout 24/7, Overdrive, Gunfight, Team Deathmatch, Hardpoint, Domination, Kill Confirmed, Kill Order

[b]Zombies Maps and Playlists: [/b]The Tomb (Standard), Liberty Falls (Standard + Directed Mode)
[h2]Upgrade to Black Ops 6 Today![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f41f8e63007d1cdad0a34330438e8534ad09e3f8.jpg[/img]

[i]Black Ops 6 [/i]is available now, and there’s never been a better time to experience the spy action thriller Campaign, the in-depth tactical chaos of best-in-class Multiplayer, and soak in the gory glory of an incredible round-based Zombies experience! [url=https://www.callofduty.com/playnow/blackops6]Click here to Purchase Black Ops 6[/url].

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 02 Battle Pass, BlackCell, and bundles
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Eliminate Your Mark with the Season 02 Battle Pass![/u][/h2]
The Luttazzi crime family won’t go down easily. They’ve broadcasted a bounty against the entire Rogue Team as payback for their actions in the previous season. Whether hunting or hunted, Operators will need the best gear they can get their hands on for the impending clash. Get equipped with the latest BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Store content arriving in Season 02 of [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], launching January 28.

[previewyoutube=piK3QLsBzaY;full][b][u][[TRAILER VIDEO]][/u][/b][/previewyoutube]

The Season 02 premium Battle Pass introduces 100+ rewards including new free base weapons plus new Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, Calling Cards, Finishing Moves, and more.

Access and earn free rewards including new cosmetic content and base weapons or purchase the premium Battle Pass and earn up to 1,100 COD Points as you progress through the Battle Pass Pages. For the optimal seasonal experience, purchase BlackCell, including assassin-themed Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, COD Points, and other rewards.
[h2][u]BlackCell Season 02: Vortex Operator (Crimson One)[/u][/h2]
[i]BlackCell Instant Rewards Page, HVT[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6891e406ce7d1ccccc07795c90148fc0393a5a9a.jpg[/img]

When there’s a bounty to collect, Vortex is the first in line to collect. The master techno assassin deploys as the lead of the Season 02 BlackCell content, emitting black and red vapors off his outfit and the dual swords at his back. Vortex heads up an excellent BlackCell offering, including Operator Skins and Weapon Blueprints that bring the heat with hot vapors streaming off their sleek designs.
[h3]Additional BlackCell Instant Rewards Content[/h3]
Get the ultimate Battle Pass experience by purchasing BlackCell, offering complete access to unlock all the rewards available in the Season 02 Battle Pass. A purchase grants immediate access to the BlackCell Instant Rewards page, giving the following items:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ca454fa3b80a50df4e1aa9d539012cfbee6df1b4.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*]20 Battle Pass Tier Skips[/*]	[*]1,100 COD Points[/*]	[*]The “Boneshard” Mastercraft Weapon Blueprint for the Jackal PDW Submachine Gun with Dread Shadow Tracers, Crimson Darkness Death FX, and a unique weapon inspect animation.[/*]	[*]The “Blacksmoke” AMR Mod 4 Sniper Rifle Weapon Blueprint.[/*]	[*]The “Hound’s Tooth” Finishing Move with Void Howler Companion.[/*]	[*]The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and Winner’s Circles).[/*]	[*]The “Vortex” New Operator.[/*][/list]


BlackCell owners can additionally unlock page after page of additional earnable rewards throughout the Season 02 Battle Pass, including:
[list]	[*]Up to Seven BlackCell-exclusive Operator Skins for: Nocturne (two Skins), Rossi, Marshall, Grey, Stone, and Toro.[/*]	[*]Up to Six BlackCell-exclusive Weapon Blueprints for the AK-74 (Assault Rifle), DM-10 (Marksman Rifle), Feng 82 (New LMG), Cypher 091 (New Assault Rifle), ASG-89 (Shotgun), and PPSh-41 (New SMG).[/*]	[*]Over 130 item rewards (Battle Pass and BlackCell related) for players who fully complete the Season 02 BlackCell Battle Pass.[/*][/list]
Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the premium Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.

[b]BlackCell Loyalty Bonus: [/b]Players who purchased Season 01 BlackCell and subsequently purchase Season 02 BlackCell will activate a permanent 10% Player and Weapon XP bonus in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] (up to a 50% bonus for purchasing BlackCell in every [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 season!).[/i]
[h2][u]Purchase the Battle Pass: Instantly Unlock Nocturne Operator[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/34fefce8a5d3e3aa5fe2dfdfd8705fa49ebeb011.jpg[/img]

Players who purchase the premium Season 02 Battle Pass or BlackCell will immediately unlock the Battle Pass Instant Rewards Page with the following items:
[list]	[*]The new Nocturne Operator (also known as “Nocturne”), along with the “Nocturne BlackCell” Operator Skin for BlackCell owners.[/*]	[*]10% Battle Pass XP Boost.[/*]	[*]The “Skill Issue” Emote.[/*]	[*]The “Profit Sharing” GobbleGum (x2).[/*]	[*]The “Shared Fate” Legendary Weapon Blueprint for the XM4 Assault Rifle.[/*]	[*]The “Scarred” Legendary Weapon Sticker.[/*][/list][h3]Nocturne (Crimson One)[/h3]
[i]Battle Pass Instant Reward Page, HVT[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0aeeb5ea8ff6edee302c1c56883ae0893d69026a.jpg[/img]

Nocturne joins in on the hunt for Rogue Black Ops, aiming to collect the huge payout offered by the Luttazzis. Little is known of Nocturne’s shadowy past, but rumors run deep among Avalon’s criminal elite. Some believe his high-level special forces skillset reveals military training, while others claim he is the last remaining descendant of an ancient clan of assassins. No bounty passes through the city without his knowledge, and no quarry escapes once he’s accepted a contract.
[h3]Additional Battle Pass Operator Skins[/h3]
Progress through the Battle Pass to unlock content across the various pages, including a variety of Operator Skins, many paired with animated BlackCell variants emitting currents of searing power.

[i]Operator Skins, Premium Battle Pass and BlackCell, HVT, Page 2[/i]

Rossi arrives straight from battle, dirt-smeared and in military fatigues, wearing a black mask and body armor over a sleeveless shirt. The alternate BlackCell Skin favors a more menacing look, featuring a spiked pauldron, black hood and gilded mask, and armaments stored throughout.
[h3]Marshall: “Kingmaker” Skins[/h3]

On the run, Marshall dons a large hood and tactical gear designed to prosper in all environments with survival gear to keep him going until the time to strike draws near. The BlackCell variant adds bone-spiked armor and a demonic grimace, fangs curved out under a pair of glowing eyes.
[h3]Bayan: “Wrap” Skin[/h3]
[i]Operator Skin, Premium Battle Pass, Page 6[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db93ba43e26f0a000b5b31fbe36c75793da1566f.jpg[/img]

Bayan covers up in an all-white wrap with a hood and mask, a range of armaments strapped across his torso, gloves and knee pads protecting him when scrambling over rough terrain toward his next target.
[h3]Grey: “Toxigenic” Skins[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8211a783c4a65c11ff1c973c043f962c091d67c8.jpg[/img]

Grey prepares for inhospitable environments with a gas mask, a stack of tactical grenades, body armor, and fatigues. She swaps the fatigues for a black robe in the BlackCell variant along with a full-face mask and pauldrons lined with molten cracks and seams.
[h3]Stone: “Shadow Work” Skins[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e01c0dc3ab15960bd785fa97cf7ba96eae3d995b.jpg[/img]

Opting for total concealment, Stone covers every identifiable part of his body in tactical gear. Two throwing knives and a throwing star sit ready at his side, a counterpoint to the line of spikes on his shoulder. The BlackCell variant streams powerful red and black currents over metal adornments, paired with night vision goggles for tracking targets in the dark.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7685f5dc658fcc7166eadf073c68f77efb92395c.jpg[/img]

With wire cutters at the ready, Caine won’t let barriers impede his progress. A purple head band and arm wraps add a stylish flair to the sleek warrior outfit, designed for optimal mobility in heated combat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/53009e60e7e9bcd3e02f3a7c80a79767c722a3ce.jpg[/img]

Zipped up in a white tracksuit, Toro unnerves his targets with an obscured silver face mask, twisting lines presenting an eerie front with nothing to grasp onto. The BlackCell variant removes the mask and swaps the white suit for bleeding-edge black tactical armor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fc2c057891ff875d80af1623676047b92853f40a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bc9c539f977e6b7dd10fc544aa290394f49d16b2.jpg[/img]

A bandage over his eye and wearing blood-smeared clothing, Weaver’s seen better days. Still, he hasn’t lost a bit of grit and remains ready to jump back into the onslaught at a moment’s notice.
[h3]Season 02: Battle Pass Base Weapons[/h3]

[i]Full-auto light machine gun. Very slow rate of fire with great damage and handling.[/i]

The Feng 82 outputs high damage with smooth handling for optimal frontline operations. Its slower rate of fire provides steadier control through sustained combat, featuring a three-to-four shot elimination out to 50 meters. For Operators seeking the heavyweight firepower of an LMG without the extensive downtime often associated with the class, this is your go-to weapon.

[i]Full-auto submachine gun. Fast fire rate with impressive damage and high recoil. Moderate handling.[/i]

The fan-favorite World War II era SMG returns to the franchise in Season 02. The PPSh-41 features a high rate of fire that knocks enemies off target and downs them fast at close range. Whether shooting down the sights or off the hip, it chews through ammo fast, so consider equipping Loadout items like the Extended Mag, Assault Pack Field Upgrade, or Scavenger Perk to stay in the fight over the long run.

[i]Full-auto assault rifle. Slower rate of fire balanced by great handling and excellent mobility.[/i]

The Cypher 091 offers a versatile and reliable Assault Rifle option outputting steady fire with excellent handling and mobility. Its clear front-mounted iron sight keeps targets in view even without an Optic and its fast reload speed gets you back to dishing out damage in the blink of an eye.

To get the job done, the cyborg comes packing with four Red Tracer-equipped Weapon Blueprints based on classic armaments from the 1984 film in addition to the “T-800 Style” Finishing Move, “Tracking… Tracking…” Emote, “What Pain?” Emblem, and “Lookin’ Fly” Calling Card.

Plus, feel the power of light and dark with the “Hellwielder” Spray, “Pour One Out” Emote, “Angelic Demon” Large Decal, “Devilishly Cute” Charm, “Hell’s Wings” Sticker, and a 1 Hour Double XP Token.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e965cbaffd09a06282749278b9e535679a89dd92.jpg[/img]

Wield them as the infamous creature from the boggy depths with the Legendary “Saltwater” Operator Skin for Toro.

Ambush enemies with the “Skewered” Finishing Move and terrify the locals with alien cosmetic content including the “Hatchling” Charm, “Invasion Force” Animated Calling Card, “Space Rider” Animated Emblem, and “Take a Look” Spray.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Satin Smoke Reactive[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9577a2b66f25c007a024d7d7eb61b54cc4a1fd38.jpg[/img]

Strut your stuff with the “Humble Brag” Reactive Weapon Blueprint for the new TR2 Marksman Rifle, paired with the “Ripple” AS VAL Assault Rifle Blueprint, each with Satin Tracers. Deploy with the fatal “Smoking Gun” Operator Skin for Bailey and add some flair to your weapons with the “Fatale View” Gun Screen.

Further your femme fatale style with the “Try Me” Loading Screen, “Neutralized” Spray, “Lethal Shade” Sticker, and “Fatale” Calling Card.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Falconer Ultra Skin Mastercraft Reactive[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/31bb19b5640909b1ba5e3a85d13c0113cf08c1a5.jpg[/img]

Tear up your enemies with the cel-shaded “Falconer” Ultra Skin for Caine. Do some blade work with the “Razorbreak” Mastercraft Reactive Melee Blueprint for the Cleaver and swoop in the for the win using the “Hawkwing” Krig C Assault Rifle and “Carrion” PP-19 SMG Blueprints, all three including the Cel Shaded Death FX with the two ranged weapons also featuring Birdcall Tracers.

Command the skies with the “Get Winged” Companion Finishing Move featuring a falcon attack from Caine’s animal friend, “Let’s Move” Animated Calling Card, “Pull the Pin” Reticle, “Boxed Lunch” Charm, “Bird Call” Animated Emblem, and “Falcon Master” Loading Screen.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Year of the Snake Ultra Skin[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1bbef6ce2de0280391fa832fbc89958430af85e3.jpg[/img]

Hiss and strike with this Bundle celebrating the Year of the Snake, including the “Vibrant Serpent” Ultra Skin for Adler along with three Weapon Blueprints featuring Year of the Snake Tracers and Death FX: the “Venomer” XM4 Assault Rifle, “Coiled Strike” “AMR Mod 4 Sniper Rifle, and “Firecracker” 9mm PM Pistol.

Ring in the new year with the “Lunar Snake” Animated Calling Card, “Year of the Snake” Emblem, “Lunar New Year: Snake” Charm, and a unique Finishing Move.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Killer Content Mastercraft[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/675ee6dd492bfd6cc57139aa92e464b8ef23e426.jpg[/img]

Give your followers the content they crave with this killer Bundle featuring three Weapon Blueprints including the animated Mastercraft “Stream Team” Assault Rifle for the new Cypher 091 plus two Legendary Blueprints: the “Like” LR 7.62 Sniper Rifle and the “Subscribe” Tsarkov 7.62 Marksman Rifle, all three Blueprints featuring Influenced Tracers and VTuber Death FX.

Plus, keep them entertained and in your sights with the “UWU” Reticle, “Hi Chat!” Loading Screen, “Smash That Like!” Emblem, and “Streaming Soon” Calling Card.
[h3]And More on the Way![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6354374fb7a6c9b7c2618f77b1a117144655544a.jpg[/img]

Look for additional Bundles arriving in Store throughout Season 02, including the [b]“Tracer Pack: Street Legal”[/b] Bundle, the [b]“Forever Alone” [/b]Bundle, and the [b]“Tracer Pack: Bank Roll Ultra Skin Reactive” [/b]Bundle.

[h2][u]The Hunter Becomes the Hunted: Black Ops 6 Season 02 is Here![/u][/h2]

[h3]Season 02 Overview: You're in the Fight Now[/h3]

As Sevati “Sev” Dumas toasts a new era of Avalon, her short-lived victory over the Luttazzi crime family comes to an abrupt end. During a celebration in the French Syndicate Penthouse, an urgent notice arrives for all attendees: the Luttazzis have placed a lucrative bounty on the entire Rogue Team as payback. This is the price for working with criminals: In the dog-eat-dog world of Avalon, loyalties can change on a dime.

[previewyoutube=SXpnKJBhL48;full][b][u][[TRAILER VIDEO]][/u][/b][/previewyoutube]

Now the Rogue Team is on the run, pursued by an anonymous and lethal assassin. Who can they really trust, and where can they hide? This season, the hunter becomes the hunted.

Now’s the time to draw your line in the sand and bring in your targets and bounties… dead or alive.

[h3]Bounty (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/246fcc3538f67f2f8f39472475aefb78936650d0.jpg[/img]

Deploy at sunrise to the top of an Avalon skyscraper, surging into the penthouse suite of a local crime boss. The Rogue team are here to celebrate their previous victories, but the party is short-lived, as friends turn into enemies and chaos reigns. From the starting point of a pristine Patio, move inside an opulent, gold-plated Nightclub and Lounge where top-shelf entertaining was provided to a variety of rich guests. Ambush enemies by jumping over the light fixtures hanging over the Lobby below.

The party is in the front, but business is in the back; the rear Office is seemingly still under construction, but on closer inspection, this is the place where those displeasing the crime boss were tortured, as indicated by some particularly unpleasant evidence. Race over the tarp and battle between the unfinished walls or move out to the Rooftop for a tactical breath of fresh air. Shoot the glass out from underneath your enemy’s feet on the Skylight, or race along the outer Ledge, jumping over the top of a neon sight to reach the other side, as Bounty has plenty of routes to learn if you aren’t scared of heights.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6a19484ecefa3d0d5e22a1f52ffacd3bf5214660.jpg[/img]
[h3]Dealership (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8c1a41f536885465d9b515ede4c9c98c62446c78.jpg[/img]

For Avalon’s wealthy clientele, nothing compares to the luxury vehicles on display at the Pallasar car dealership. However, this dealership is a front, and in reality serves as a lucrative black market for the criminal underworld where vehicles are traded for guns, ammunition, and other unsavory valuables. Rogue team flees from Bounty, looking for friendly contacts in the vicinity, but are met with retaliatory skirmishes at every turn.

Battle around the wreckage in the Car Lot and Showroom, pushing the fight into the interior Commissary and Lounge or out on the Courtyard. Open the sliding doors to either side of the Garage for a quick ambush or close them to stall incoming enemies. For the best sights over the Garage and Sales room, head into the Admin office and bounce between the two windows overlooking the areas, controlling the center of the map. For the ultimate element of surprise, equip the RC-XD and drive through the floor vent, exploding in the enemy’s face on the other side.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fdbd5c33a17edc41db899bc4a84f4a35d1aa7121.jpg[/img]
[h3]Lifeline (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Strike, 2v2/6v6, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9726858ff5adcea0583d457674a180880eae736b.jpg[/img]

Expect high stakes on the high seas as Rogue team escapes by boat in the aptly named Lifeline, a small, high-end yacht still ablaze after a successful boarding by Sev and her allies. Currently chopping through the waves at high velocity, enemy evasion is certainly not guaranteed.

This small-sized Strike map funnels Operators directly into the fight. Smoke billows from its flaming hardtop while the fight rages on below. From Bow to Aft, it won’t take long to collide in the center Bar and gambling den, the disco room, or along the steps on Portside and Starboard.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c82f628258283129d04a875e2e8b3c0924f6b1c8.jpg[/img]
[h3]Bullet (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Strike, 2v2/6v6, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c25bd423cbd80127ad881df098fced5cf20824a7.jpg[/img]

After regrouping and learning of the location of the Luttazzi Godmother – responsible for placing the bounty on the Rogue team in the first place – Sev and her team will go on the offensive and drop onto the rapidly-moving bullet train to gain the upper hand and neutralize a key enemy target.

This mid-season Strike map presses the fight up close along its narrow interior carriages. Race through the automatic sliding doors separating each car, from the first-class lounge through the dining car, second-class seats, and up to the cab where the conductor has fallen. When things get too hot inside, try your luck via a roof hatch up top; watch your step or risk being thrown from the train.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b6c83a6ecd2fa0fc99764446253ab01249766d96.jpg[/img]
[h3]Grind (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[i]Remaster, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e3676ef9049af37d59aac9dba20327239ca37476.jpg[/img]

The infamous skatepark first introduced in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops II[/i] makes its [i]Black Ops 6[/i] debut in the mid-season! Shred your enemies across the indoor stadium and pro shop or soak up the sunshine in the huge skate bowl and halfpipe outdoors. Use the ramps for cover and to get above the competition and bust out your best tricks like the 360-corkscrew one-shot. Also expect an additional surprise related to this map, later in the season….

[h3]Multiplayer Modes[/h3]
A new Mode and a returning fan-favorite match type start the season off with a bang, in the days leading up to a new and enhanced Ranked Play later in the month.
[h3]Overdrive (Brand New, Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e0ace60827ce79434f276f5ce07b431d0328e172.jpg[/img]

Kick into Overdrive in this charged-up twist on Team Deathmatch. Teams compete to be the first to reach the maximum number of stars. Earn these stars by executing the following maneuvers:
[list]	[*]Earn 1 star for Basic Eliminations like finishing off an enemy with body shots[/*]	[*]Earn 2 stars for Core Medal Eliminations like headshots and melee attacks[/*]	[*]Earn 3 stars for completing Distinguished Medal Eliminations, reserved for only the most impressive takedowns.[/*][/list]
Rack up stars to unlock special Operator abilities that will greatly aid you in battle and keep that streak going to reach Overdrive! If you get eliminated, or the elimination timer runs out before you take out another target, you’ll start the process over again. Operators “attempting Overdrive” can expect the following improved capabilities:
[list]	[*][b]1 Star: Awakened Senses: [/b]See enemies through walls and replenish your health after eliminating a target.[/*]	[*][b]3 Stars: Physical Enhancements: [/b]Increased movement and reloading speed.[/*]	[*][b]6 Stars: Augmented Handling: [/b]Improved hip-fire accuracy and improved sprint-to-fire and ADS speeds.[/*][/list]
Earn all three buffs to activate Overdrive! This allows you to earn double the stars when eliminating enemies.
[h3]Gun Game (Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7798c09c8d699addd87ddd7ec2fdb44e93099d71.jpg[/img]

The fan-favorite Party Game returns! Compete in a free-for-all mode where all Operators begin the match with the same starting weapon and cycle through the same set of 20 weapons, varying from match to match. Eliminate enemies to advance to the next weapon, testing your skills across a variety of weapon types.

To keep the action moving, frequent radar sweeps reveal the last known location of all Operators on the map. The top two performing players and their current progress are also displayed on-screen. If someone starts pulling too far ahead, try taking them out with a melee attack to set them back to the previous weapon. The first Operator to cycle through all 20 weapons wins the match!
[h3]Valentine’s Day Limited Time Modes[/h3]
Show your love with two limited-time modes for couples and third wheelers alike.
[h3]Third Wheel Gunfight (In-Season)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/12aef080adf43c657cfaddc093cf5912e373b020.jpg[/img]

Not everyone’s hungry for love. Some people just want to do things their own way. In Third Wheel Gunfight, you can now bring along that untethered friend and duke it out 3v3.

[b]The Tomb (Launch)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9e0db5a6d918493b4c3902c040f9a2d20f52204d.jpg[/img]

Following the events at Citadelle des Morts, Weaver, Maya, Carver, and Grey must take the amulet secured at the Citadel to a cursed dig site and the ancient catacombs within. Professor Krafft indicated that the elusive Sentinel Artifact may be found in the tunnels below. Reports of paranormal phenomena go back centuries, possibly related to the presence of the artifact. If the team can secure it, there may yet be hope in releasing Samantha Maxis from her imprisonment in the Dark Aether.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e68f7d33eea9ccbacc8fd652793fcff5b1899f3b.jpg[/img]

In this enthralling new adventure, follow in the footsteps of a doomed explorer and explore a long-forgotten dig site while seeking out a door to nowhere. What lurks behind this door? You’ll find out when brand-new Zombies map launches at the start of Season 02 on Tuesday, January 28, at 9AM PT.

[b]Echoes in the Dark: Your Comms Team Handlers[/b]

[i]“A shiny ha’penny to the lucky blighter who finds that door first!”[/i]

[b]- Sir Archibald Fotherington-Smythe[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6441ca611d1fd8a30f96ebeef9c066a1833c02d3.jpg[/img]

You’ll need all the guidance you can get to navigate the dark and dusty passages of the cursed catacombs within this Romanesque dig site. Aiding you on this adventure is S.A.M., Ravenov, Peck, as well as Raptor One and the increasingly erratic Strauss. Adding to the oddities are reports of audible anomalies in the form of echoes of a former British explorer who led an ill-fated 1908 expedition into the earthworks.

[b]The Tomb: Initial Recon Tour[/b]

Bolster your knowledge of The Tomb before attempting to survive its many dangers with this abridged and narrative-focused overview of its main locations. What of the Tomb’s many secrets? These are left for you to discover!

[b][i]Dig Site[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b1706845e6f896e48063a2b3ec3375462453e7dd.jpg[/img]

The surface-level Dig Site is your entryway to the rest of the map. Strange glowing runes mark certain alcoves, perhaps gateways to the subterranean regions beyond. A large, partially uncovered stone face lies at the pit of the site, roped off and long forgotten, a nearby fallen pillar. Scale the stairs and scaffolding to further explore the area. Don’t linger too long, lest you end up like the headless statue on the upper tiers of this archeological area.

[b][i]Neolithic Catacombs and Ossuary[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3af9394f5cbb355517f20e43cf7d15f884876e87.jpg[/img]

Exploring the Neolithic Catacombs, you may notice how far back the area goes, both physically as well as through layers of ancient cultures and civilizations. Cave paintings adorn the cavernous walls, while winding pathways lead through the natural hollows of the earth. In the Ossuary, stacked with the skulls of the long dead, the cavern gives way to the stone architecture of a later age, its bone piles and altars lending an ominous presence throughout.

[b][i]Tombs[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/40d87e68e777109403c47b20bd70e51492c5f07b.jpg[/img]

Statues of ancient warriors line the Tombs in alcoves along the walls along with depictions of shielded hoplites engaging a charging bull. Though the vault has long crumbled into disarray, the remnants of pristine architecture are on clear display, illuminated through the patch of sunlight falling through a crumbled hole in the ceiling.

[b][i]Shrine of the Hierophants[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eb31be5aa9a7c782b1d4c8a183acd138197d2e86.jpg[/img]

Ancient priests charged with interpreting the sacred mysteries, the hierophants seem to have uncovered more than they were bargaining for. The candlelit, vaulted ceiling marks the resting place of important figures, a frieze sculpted into the wall showing a fierce battle between opposing forces. Arrow Trap installations line the stairway down into the shrine, flanked by skulls on chain pullies.

[b][i]Subterranean Temple and Deep Excavation[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/341bb5286370fde97bc0532ee0b4624986b91bc0.jpg[/img]

Descend into the catacombs to reveal the huge, cavernous Subterranean Temple, where the stone architecture leads downward to a rocky outcropping peninsula known as the Deep Excavation. Scattered pillars encircle a place of worship below, the murky depths illuminated via faint shafts of what appears to be sunlight entering from a natural space in the rock above.

[b][i]Doorway to Nowhere and Dark Aether Nexus[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/85007cc8cce1deb949f92a9f3893f87acc720b0f.jpg[/img]

Take your expedition deeper still, seek out the Doorway to Nowhere, and [REDACTED]...

[b]New Enemy Sighted: Shock Mimic[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c6e46ba796f17d8026b8b3ba3296d15a2801ac02.jpg[/img]

Often disguising themselves as useful items, these shocking creatures break out of the illusion on approach, grabbing victims with their tentacles and razor-sharp claws, pulling them in for an electrifying bite. This hits harder than expected, and the distortion camouflage the Shock Mimic emits disrupts your radar as well as your eyesight.

[b][i]Other Entities of The Tomb[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8cb916332852648aa88419a3907c3cbcbe2bfaa3.jpg[/img]

The inhabitants of The Tomb represent a swath of laborers, worshipers, and armored guards from eons past, heavily rotted, some mummified, and many with a more skeletal appearance than previously encountered undead. Alongside the familiar enemies you’re bound to encounter throughout, these ancient undead reveal the importance of the site. But what they were digging up, and perhaps more ominously, who or what they came to worship, remains to be discovered.

[b]New Wonder Weapon: Staff of Ice[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/21d945a2128c72a003f242f11361509a1e353e78.jpg[/img]

[i]This masterpiece of ancient technology fires a withering blast of frost and can generate healing energies to resuscitate allies from a distance. Origins unknown.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/56658327ea512d83340b256f56368050cf17dd8d.jpg[/img]

Rumors of a magical staff promise exceptional power to anyone who can get their hands on the devastating weapon. Known as the Staff of Ice, this offers an exceptional blast that can slow and freeze enemies in place, as well as a more devastating area-of-effect attack. This archaic Wonder Weapon is also imbued with the power to revive teammates with a precision-shot restorative blast.

[b]The Tomb: Additional Content[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/028386d7adbb8b72027e8fc873032d4155d9d929.jpg[/img]

[b]Main Quest and Quest Rewards: [/b]The Main Quest for The Tomb goes live when the map releases alongside the launch of Season 02 on January 28. Complete the Main Quest to earn the “X91 Ice-Pike” Wonder Weapon Skin — a Project Janus facsimile of the “Staff of Ice” — as well as 5,000 XP and a unique Calling Card awarded to players who complete the Main Quest before Directed Mode is released for The Tomb.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9351b8f08fa66a2bc03f730c2fe955c443e25ebe.jpg[/img]

[b]Arrow Trap: [/b]Got a horde of zombies on your back? Activate the Arrow Trap to send out darts of damaging energy from the wall, devastating its targets on contact. If you need to backtrack, run and slide to avoid getting shot by your own trap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1138f623a7d69b005c0d203dc375f0b573074fe9.jpg[/img]

[b]Aetheric Lanterns:[/b] Dark Aether chandeliers and light sources give off a pale glow over their surroundings. With the correct projectile and aiming confidence, you can use these dynamic hazards to rain down Aetheric fire, damaging anything that shambles through the flames.

[b]And More: [/b]Dig deeper into the lore of the ancient site with Intel in the form of Audio Logs, Documents, and Artifacts to discover while exploring the map.

[b]New Gameplay Content[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a92e3361bc59adec194ef9a6b08773bb0b288cdf.jpg[/img]

Access the following new content within The Tomb as well as on Citadelle des Morts, Terminus, and Liberty Falls.

[b]Additional Perk-a-Cola: Death Perception[/b]

[i]Available: In-Game at Perk Machine[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/96c90c580f8f047478d2c7b10e12e7b39150c295.jpg[/img]

Returning since its original introduction in [i]Black Ops 4[/i], Death Perception gives players the ability to detect enemies through obstacles and walls via outlines of their bodies, plus new abilities for its [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]debut. When navigating the tight confines of The Tomb, there’s no better Perk for anticipating danger around the next corner. Research its Augments to further empower Death Perception, ensuring that nothing escapes your notice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8437344e5de646259a51bc4dfe85cb51f2e265f1.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*]Death Perception is available within The Tomb, along with the nine previously accessible Zombies Perks. Note that some of these Perks are only available via a Der Wunderfizz machine.[/*]	[*]Death Perception is available on Citadelle des Morts, Liberty Falls and Terminus maps via the Der Wunderfizz machine.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e7fd4f32a0435a273b8662f23c7d2a6bfa793792.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Death Perception: Major Augments[/i][/b]

Research the following Augments to further customize the Perk.

[b]Treasure Hunter[/b]

Spot items others can miss from loot containers as well as Special and Elite kills.

[b]Death Stare[/b]

Your Elemental Weakness damage has a chance to kill an enemy that is low on health.

[b]Critical Eye[/b]

Small chance that a body shot becomes a critical shot.

[b][i]Death Perception: Minor Augments[/i][/b]

[b]Bird’s Eye View[/b]

The minimap’s scan rate is increased.

[b]Extra Change[/b]

Find extra Essence under more locations.

[b]Further Insight[/b]

Increase perception radius.

[b]New GobbleGums[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3edb2c8138e1cef4ced94e01e25e48f466ec799e.jpg[/img]

Chew on three new GobbleGums, all available at Season 02 launch across all maps once acquired and equipped in your GobbleGum Loadout Pack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3373e9890ccaa97e3cb0ced6277de8cc28e12b9b.jpg[/img]

[b]Dead Drop (Epic): [/b]Drop rates of Salvage and Equipment are greatly increased. Lasts five minutes.

[b]Modified Chaos (Legendary): [/b]Greatly reduce all Ammo Mod cooldowns. Lasts two minutes.

[b]Quacknarok (Whimsical): [/b]Zombies move around in rubber ducky inner tubes. Lasts three minutes.

[b]Additional Support Weapon: War Machine[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b737a89272fc3a96cdf722adbbf02e7413d1cd4e.jpg[/img]

[b]Salvage: 2,500[/b]

Give the undead an explosive taste of their own entrails with the semi-automatic War Machine grenade launcher arriving in the Support section of the Crafting Table.

[b]The Tomb: Directed Mode and Events[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c29ae01f84e2177157053aa6c644b8b55d148fa4.jpg[/img]

For the explorers who need an extra hand in completing the Main Quest on The Tomb, stay tuned for the arrival of Directed Mode planned to arrive at Mid-Season.

Look for more announcements in the mid-season update, including a special Limited Time Mode you won’t want to miss.
