notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 02: What you need to know, part 2
notes.notes:
[h3]New Quality of Life Updates[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/355c2c6abc765c74591640431a2e957ab86d0efe.jpg[/img] [i]Want to know how far you’re off from unlocking Nebula on your PPSh-41? Access a Weapon Camo or Calling Card challenge and simply select “Add to Tracked” (in the bottom-left corner of your menu screen). See the Multiplayer section of this blog for more details.[/i] In addition to the challenge tracking and per-mode HUD Preset features listed above in the Multiplayer section, the Zombies team is also bringing new quality of life updates to the mode, including: [list] [*][b]Co-op Pause[/b] [list] [*]In matches where everyone is in the same party, the party leader will now be able to pause the game for everyone to regroup on strategy or take a snack break during those high-round runs.[/*] [/list] [/*] [*][b]AFK Kick Loadout Recovery[/b] [list] [*]If a player gets kicked for going AFK for too long in a co-op game, their loadout, Essence, and Salvage will now be restored after they rejoin the match in progress.[/*] [/list] [/*][/list] For more details, [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/01/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-warzone-community-update]click here for the Community Update Blog[/url]. [h2][u]Call of Duty: Warzone: Season 02 Content [/u][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/205f5e2918c276f2ffdec661468b858935e039aa.jpg[/img] [table] [tr] [td] [h2]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/h2] [/td] [/tr] [tr] [td] [b]Season 02:[/b] A focus on gameplay tuning, quality of life improvements, and addressing ongoing bugs. [/td] [/tr] [tr] [td] [b]New Perk:[/b] Regenerate your armor via the new Reactive Armor Perk at launch. In the mid-season, get the Low Profile Perk, improving your movement speed when crouched, prone, and downed. [/td] [/tr] [tr] [td] [b]Season 02 Ranked Play: [/b]Prepare for a new season of Battle Royale Ranked Play, including all-new rewards. [/td] [/tr] [/table] [b]Incoming Call of Duty: Warzone Updates[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d364b25b35794075bdf0d08f038fa704fb0fb00f.jpg[/img] As announced in the recent Community Updates blog, we’ve made the decision to prioritize focus on gameplay tuning, adding more quality of life improvements, and addressing ongoing bugs. This means that in order to deliver meaningful improvements to our players, new content originally planned for Season 02 has been shifted to create bandwidth to address foundational issues. These improvements won’t come all at once – rather, they’ll be staggered across the season and with quite a few quality of life changes coming mid-season. Our priority is having the most solid foundation that Battle Royale can offer and are excited for players to see it all live. Rest assured, a full selection of content is still accessible, with access to our maps (Area 99, Urzikstan, Rebirth Island) and modes (Battle Royale, Resurgence, Plunder) available at Season 02 launch, and with BR Ranked coming during the launch window. [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] players will also be part of The Terminator and Shadow Hunt Events during the first few weeks of the season, and access all the shared Season 02 content, including the new base weapons. For more details on updates to RICOCHET Anti-Cheat, [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], Multiplayer, and Zombies, [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2025/01/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-warzone-community-update]click here for the Community Update Blog[/url]. [h3]

Additional Equipment[/h3] Fight to gain the upper hand with the help of two new Perks coming in Season 02. [h3]New Perks[/h3] [b]Perk: Reactive Armor (Launch)[/b] [b]Perk Slot:[/b] 2 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8b18f217a2771dfd9851aabfcabb7f73553dfb23.jpg[/img] Your armor will regenerate up to 50% if you haven’t taken damage in the last 5 seconds. [b]Perk: Low Profile (Mid-Season)[/b] [b]Perk Slot:[/b] 1 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/92cc07de64cea9b30d668be886110c5cd1d13b32.jpg[/img] You are able to move more quickly while crouched and prone. Move slightly faster when downed. [b]Gameplay, Quality of Life, Bug Fixes, & More[/b] Season 02 of Warzone brings a wave of key updates aimed at tuning gameplay, improving quality of life, and addressing persistent bugs. Weapon reload and swap speeds, jump mechanics, parachute transitions, and audio clarity have been fine-tuned to bring Battle Royale closer to our intended experience. This extends further with adjustments to default perks, equipment count, and body shield behavior. We’re also introducing new quality of life updates, including being able to ping buy back flares and improvements to the stat tracker font for better legibility, Regarding Ranked Play, players will see a refinement to the amount of SR required and adjustments to deployment fees. To round it all off, we are deploying important bug fixes that target issues with map visibility, weapon interaction, and several perks. [h3]Call of Duty: Warzone Ranked Play[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/572af24a642d11ce5760001e122c0acb537256d1.jpg[/img] Compete in a second season of Battle Royale Ranked Play, earning the following seasonal rewards as you progress: [b]Season 02 BR Ranked Play Rewards[/b] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8e52092670972617626e0b1450a3902e3e3fd853.jpg[/img] [list] [*]First Season Win: Elimination Charm[/*] [*]Get 25 Eliminations: Elimination Sticker[/*] [*]Get 100 Eliminations: Elimination Weapon Camo[/*] [*]Get 250 Eliminations: Elimination Weapon Blueprint[/*] [*]Silver: “Ranked Season 2 – “Silver” Emblem[/*] [*]Gold: “Ranked Season 2 – “Gold” Calling Card, Emblem, and Weapon Camo[/*] [*]Platinum: “Ranked Season 2 – Platinum” Calling Card Emblem, and Weapon Camo[/*] [*]Diamond: “Ranked Season 2 – Diamond” Calling Card Emblem, and Weapon Camo[/*] [*]Crimson: “Ranked Season 2 – Crimson” Calling Card Emblem, and Weapon Camo[/*] [*]Iridescent: “Ranked Season 2 – Iridescent” Calling Card Emblem, and Weapon Camo[/*] [*]Top 250: “Ranked Season 2 – Top 250” Calling Card Emblem, and Weapon Camo[/*][/list][h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: General Content (MP, ZM, WZ)[/u][/h2] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/22ab501ea15acd64d9d4a5fd346a0bde5831e4a9.jpg[/img] [table] [tr] [td] [h2]Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)[/h2] [/td] [/tr] [tr] [td] [b]Weapons Detail:[/b] Grab more than six new Weapons across Season 02, with four armaments revealed today, including the Cypher 091 Assault Rifle, PPSh-41 SMG, Feng 82 LMG, and TR2 Marksman Rifle. Expect a melee-focused set of new weapons to be revealed at mid-season! Plus, unlock new weapon attachments including the Underbarrel Crossbow, Belt-Fed Magazine, and more. [/td] [/tr] [tr] [td] [b]Battle Pass and BlackCell: [/b]The brand-new Season 02 Battle Pass delivers an impressive amount of new content, including free tiers and three base weapons alongside rewards like new Weapon Blueprints, Operator Skins, Calling Cards, Finishing Moves, Emotes, and more. [/td] [/tr] [tr] [td] [b]Season 02 Operators: [/b]The teched out Vortex headlines as the BlackCell Operator, accompanied by Battle Pass Operator Nocturne, a lethal assassin who ruthlessly hunts down his targets. Plus, take control of the cybernetic assassin The Terminator arriving in the Store alongside other incredible Bundles. [/td] [/tr] [/table][h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][h3]Primary Weapon: PPSh-41 (Launch)[/h3] [i]SMG, Battle Pass Page 6 HVT Tier Reward, Page 14 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b1d9edfc7a87d55e18d3edd5b31de13397b1e156.jpg[/img] [b]Levels: 35[/b] [b]MAGS: 4[/b] [b]MAG SIZE: 32[/b] [b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b] [b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods [b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3). [i]Full-auto submachine gun. Fast fire rate with impressive damage and high recoil. Moderate handling.[/i] Make mincemeat out of the competition with the return of the fan-favorite World War II era PPSh-41 SMG, boasting an incredibly fast fire rate that makes short work of enemies at close range. Tame its unpredictable recoil by firing in bursts or empty the whole clip in hip-fire engagements. Consider the Extended Mag, Assault Pack Field Upgrade, or the Scavenger Perk to keep from running dry in long fights and keep pushing forward maximize your damage. [h3]Primary Weapon: Cypher 091 (Launch)[/h3] [i]Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Page 8 HVT Tier Reward, Page 11 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a90393a17702b7834d4eb9cb2cc502aeff8de4d1.jpg[/img] [b]Levels: 42[/b] [b]MAGS: 3[/b] [b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b] [b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b] [b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods [b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3) [i]Full-auto assault rifle. Slower rate of fire balanced by great handling and excellent mobility.[/i] For versatility, few weapons outshine the Cypher 091. With excellent range, handling, and mobility, the weapon performs well in a variety of engagements. With clear front mounted iron sights, minimal muzzle smoke, and controllable recoil, this AR makes for easy target acquisition even without an attached Optic. To top it off, its fast reload speed reduces downtime between mags, getting you straight back into the fight. [h3][/h3][h3]Primary Weapon: Feng 82 (Launch)[/h3] [i]LMG, Battle Pass Page 3 HVT Tier Reward, Page 10 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bab4c637e0cf379bb0b57b4e2b6994e5d31d04f9.jpg[/img] [b]Levels: 48[/b] [b]MAGS: 5[/b] [b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b] [b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b] [b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods [b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3) [i]Full-auto light machine gun. Very slow rate of fire with great damage and handling.[/i] Possessing the best accuracy and handling in its class, the Feng 82 LMG offers a more aggressive, frontline option for players looking to stay in the thick of the fight without losing the LMG firepower expected of the weapon type. While the base magazine size is lower than its peers, the five magazines provided ensure that you’ll still have a lot of ammo to chew through before running low. The weapon features a reliable three-to-four shot elimination out to 50 meters with moderate upward recoil that can be mitigated via controlled bursts as well as several Gunsmith attachments offering improved vertical recoil control. [h3]Primary Weapon: TR2 (Launch)[/h3] [i]Marksman Rifle, Event Reward[/i] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2301ea8efad0a7adcde89df3d5dd0fb18e4b24f0.jpg[/img] [b]Levels: 39[/b] [b]MAGS: 3[/b] [b]MAG SIZE: 20[/b] [b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b] [b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods [b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers (3) [i]Semi-auto marksman rifle. Great rate of fire and respectable handling.[/i] Featuring best-in-class handling, this semi-auto Marksman Rifle is ideal for fast-moving sharpshooters seeking to combine mobility with precision and power. Its rapid re-centering speed encourages quick follow up shots without losing sight of your target, eliminating unarmored enemies in three-to-four shots out to 100 meters. Whether you opt for a long-range Optic to engage enemies at a distance or prefer a closer fight, the TR2’s ease of use promises a good outcome in the hands of a trained Operator. [h3]Additional Ordnance (Mid-Season)[/h3] Season 02 offers an incredible choice of armaments for those Operators favoring close-combat takedowns! Expect to fill your Melee Loadout slot with multiple additional hand-to-hand weapons coming at mid-season... plus a rip-roaring projectile armament coming later on. Expect more information in the Season 02 Reloaded Blog. [h3]New: Special Weapon Attachments[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/66f715213c966d46924d5923fe014c3ab2dddfe8.jpg[/img] [h3]Crossbow Attachment (Launch)[/h3] [i]Assault Rifles, SWAT 5.56 and AEK-973 Marksman Rifles, Underbarrel Attachment, Battle Pass Page 7 Reward[/i] Add some flare to your Primary Weapon with the Crossbow Underbarrel Attachment. The three explosive tipped bolts detonate shortly after impact for an explosive finish, even if you hit just wide of the mark. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5767f0dd576eac61b2087fd596f74e6a947a367.jpg[/img] [h3]Full Auto Mod (Launch)[/h3] [i]AEK-973 Marksman Rifle, Fire Mod Attachment, Event Reward[/i] Convert the AEK-973 into a fully automatic weapon chambered in 5.45x39mm. The change gives the Marksman Rifle a steady upward kick; press slightly downward through sustained fire to stay on target. [h3]Binary Trigger (Launch)[/h3] [i]Tanto .22 SMG, Fire Mod Attachment, Event Reward[/i] Alter the weapon’s typical full-auto firing mode to a specialized semi-auto function that fires a bullet when the trigger is pulled and when it’s released for rapid fire capabilities. Blocks Barrel and Underbarrel attachments. [h3]Belt-Fed Attachment (Mid-Season)[/h3] [i]Three Attachments, LMGs, Magazine Attachment, Event Reward[/i] Add an extreme amount of ammo that’s continuously fed to the weapon through sustained fire. The weapon may overheat, so allow it to cool off now and then before resuming your barrage of damage. [h3]Season 02 Events[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dc683f49806a1c2211e842d2dd82158b133660ed.jpg[/img] Expect an assortment of scheduled Events across Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Earn rewards such as a new Primary Weapon, Melee Weapon, a razor-sharp Launcher, new special attachments, and more. [h3]Event: The Terminator (MP, ZM, WZ)[/h3] [i]Activation Dates: February 6 to 20[/i] [i]Total Rewards: [/i]13, including Full Auto Mod for the AEK-973 Marksman Rifle and a PP-919 SMG Weapon Blueprint Collect skulls to unlock rewards. Skulls are earned via eliminations in Multiplayer and Zombies, and by eliminating players and opening caches in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Earn bonus skulls for eliminating enemies with explosive or fire damage. [h3]Event: Shadow Hunt (MP, ZM, WZ)[/h3] [i]Activation Dates: February 13 to 20[/i] [i]Total Rewards: [/i]7, including Binary Trigger Fire Mod for the Tanto .22 SMG and the TR2 Marksman Rifle To join Nocturne, you must first complete the challenges he has laid out before you. Don’t fail him. [h3]Event: St. Patrick’s Day: Clover Craze (MP, ZM, WZ)[/h3] [i]Activation Dates: March [[REDACTED]][/i] [i]Total Rewards: [/i][[REDACTED]] Collect four-leaf clovers for landing eliminations in Multiplayer and Zombies, and by eliminating players and opening caches in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Redeem for rewards. [b]More in the Mid-Season: [/b]Expect even more events and rewards arriving in the mid-season, with full coverage in the Season 02 Reloaded announcement. [h3]Season 02 Battle Pass and BlackCell[/h3][h3]Operator Nocturne Leads the Season 02 Battle Pass[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e431598764f32ad5395dad7157cd0017a3e106e7.jpg[/img] Dispatch your enemies swiftly and efficiently with the new Nocturne Operator, a highly trained assassin who never fails to eliminate any assigned targets. Purchase the Season 02 Battle Pass for 1,100 COD Points or the Season 02 Battle Pass Bundle for 2,400 COD Points to immediately unlock the Instant Rewards Page of the Battle Pass, including the following items: [list] [*]10% Battle Pass XP Boost[/*] [*]The “Champ” Emote[/*] [*]The “Shared Fate” Legendary Blueprint for the XM4 Assault Rifle[/*] [*]The “Scarred” Legendary Weapon Sticker[/*] [*]The “Nocturne” Operator and Skin, along with the “Nocturne BlackCell” Skin for those who purchase BlackCell[/*][/list] The Season 02 Battle Pass includes over 110 pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell) including three new Base Weapons, an Underbarrel Crossbow Attachment, new Operator Skins and Weapon Blueprints, and a whole lot more. Read on for more BlackCell intel and stay tuned for a deeper dive with the BlackCell, Battle Pass and Store Bundles blog prior to Season 02 launch for a deep dive into the massive offering. [h3]BlackCell Offerings[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cb4140b8c8be1a7ce474b6e86b3c6ffb0c026f2a.jpg[/img] Deploy as the master assassin and new Operator Vortex headlining the Season 02 BlackCell content. Equipped with the latest technological advancements in stealth warfare, the “Vortex” Operator and animated Operator Skin emits black and red smoke from his arms and twin-sword handles. Vortex joins an exciting lineup of BlackCell content, including Operators well equipped to complete their mission, whether as assassin-themed hunters or unlucky targets on the run. BlackCell owners can access the Season 02 Battle Pass via the exclusive BlackCell Page, instantly unlocking the following items: [list] [*]20 Battle Token Tier Skips[/*] [*]1,100 COD Points[/*] [*]The “Boneshard” Mastercraft Blueprint for the Jackal PDW SMG[/*] [*]The “Blacksmoke” Weapon Blueprint for the AMR Mod 4 Sniper Rifle[/*] [*]The “Hound’s Tooth” Finishing Move[/*] [*]The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and Winner’s Circles).[/*] [*]The “Vortex” BlackCell Operator Skin for the new Vortex Operator[/*][/list] Additionally, BlackCell owners can expect to access page after page of additional rewards within the Season 02 Battle Pass. These include: [list] [*]Seven BlackCell-exclusive skins for Nocturne (two Skins), Rossi, Marshall, Grey, Stone, and Toro.[/*] [*]Six BlackCell-exclusive Weapon Blueprints for the AK-47 (Assault Rifle), DM-10 (Marksman Rifle), Feng 82 (New LMG), Cypher 091 (New Assault Rifle), ASG-89 (Shotgun), and PPSh-41 (New SMG).[/*] [*]Over 130 item rewards (Battle Pass and BlackCell related) for those who fully complete the Season 02 BlackCell Battle Pass.[/*][/list] As usual, players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back. [b]BlackCell Stackable XP Boost: [/b]Players who purchased Season 01 BlackCell and go on to purchase Season 02 BlackCell will earn a permanent 10% Player and Weapon XP boost! The 10% Player XP and Weapon XP Loyalty Bonus is for purchases of subsequent BlackCell seasons (up to 50% for BO6 seasons only). [h3]Operators[/h3] The Season 02 Battle Pass brings two new base Operators to Crimson One along with multiple Operator Skins for both factions, accessible within the Operators menu once acquired. [h3]Vortex (BlackCell, Crimson One, Launch)[/h3] [i]“Vortex” Skin: BlackCell Instant Reward Page[/i] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/06ed209ce43a1d6ae4848e1cccf4caa6b518d441.jpg[/img] There’s no escaping this master assassin, known only under the alias Vortex. All biographical information for this Operator has been [[REDACTED]]. [h3]Nocturne (Battle Pass, Crimson One, Launch)[/h3] [i]“Nocturne” and “Obsidian” Skins: Battle Pass Instant Reward Page, Battle Pass Completion Page[/i] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/04e00f3e443d4a260fe6e79b4d2011ffe89e13cb.jpg[/img] [i]“Nowhere to run. Nowhere to hide.”[/i] – Nocturne A bounty’s been activated on the Rogue Black Ops team, and Nocturne is here to collect. Other than his incredible lethality on display, all biographical information for this Operator has been [[REDACTED]]. [h3]The Terminator (Bundle, Crimson One, In-Season)[/h3] [i]Store Bundle[/i] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d772269695f7bee83917e779c8f07f667ef4feef.jpg[/img] [i]“I’ll be back.”[/i] – The Terminator The ultimate killing machine arrives as The Terminator deploys from the future to decimate its enemies across Season 02. This brand-new Operator comes with two Ultra Skins inspired by the original movie. Take control of the cyborg assassin who first crashed onto the silver screen in 1984, releasing as a Store Bundle shortly after Launch. [h3]New Store Offerings[/h3] Get a look at some of the top Bundles coming to the Store in Season 02 before we offer an even deeper dive in our Season 02 BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Bundles blog arriving prior to Season 02 launch. [h3]Tracer Pack: The Terminator[/h3] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/541f6b7707992e7138ade9f6622ab49f0d2f10f0.jpg[/img] Sent by the supercomputer Skynet to crush the human population’s chance at survival, The Terminator stands ready to annihilate anyone in its way in the “Tracer Pack: The Terminator” Operator Bundle. notes.title: Netflix Squid Game Comes to Call of Duty
notes.notes:
The competition begins as Squid Game drops into [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 [/i]and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] in celebration of the release of Squid Game Season 2 on Netflix!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0ae7d9ba08122bb8dcc7fae6bd375c7f237fd548.jpg[/img]

Try your luck in the deadly games with Squid Game-themed LTMs across all three modes going live alongside the in-game Event featuring rewards, like the new “Front Man” Operator and the new Cleaver Melee Weapon. Plus, get into the competitive spirit with three Squid Game-themed Bundles arriving throughout the Event.

[previewyoutube=lzXgt2aR_IM;full][/previewyoutube]

Enjoy a thrilling start to the New Year as the Squid Game Event goes live starting January 3 at 10AM PT through January 24 at 10AM PT.
[h2][u]Earn XP, Get Rewards in the Squid Game Event[/u][/h2]
[[EVENT PASS REWARDS INFOGRAPHIC]]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b16ac97b8e7726abb66a65330e7002965c14ac0b.jpg[/img]

Zip up your green tracksuit and gain XP in Multiplayer, Zombies, or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] to earn rewards in our new Squid Game Event Pass and prove your standing as a top contestant. The Squid Game Event Pass is free for all players, and the Premium Track will be available for 1,100 COD Points.

All players can earn Squid Game-themed rewards along the Free reward track of the Event Pass, including the instant reward “Player 006” Operator Skin, plus the “Player 115” Operator Skin and Loading Screen, Emblem, Sticker, Calling Card, the new Cleaver Melee Weapon, and more.

[b]Free Track Mastery Reward: Cleaver[/b]

Unlock the new Cleaver Melee Weapon to make short work of the competition. Chop and slice with a mix of attacks, including a devastating heavy attack.
[h3]Get More with the Premium Reward Track[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6e929f24454461356503383dce60df207faf143f.jpg[/img]

While every player can progress and unlock items along the Free reward track, a second Premium reward track in the Event Pass offers even more. Purchase the Premium track to access the ability to unlock additional themed rewards, including the instant reward “High Authority” XM4 Assault Rifle Blueprint plus Blueprints for the Knife, GS45 Pistol, and Saug SMG as well as a Concussion Grenade Equipment Skin, a Finishing Move, the “Throwdown” Emote, the “Who’s Left” Talking Gun Screen, and more!

Complete the premium track to turn the tide on the other competitors:

[b]Ultimate Mastery Reward: “Front Man” Operator[/b]

Become the leader of the Pink Guards with the “Front Man” Operator. Deploy as the ruthless administrator of the Squid Game and take your team to victory.
[h2][u]Let the Games Begin![/u][/h2]
Compete in multiple Squid Game-themed Limited Time Modes across Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Pay close attention to the rules; your life depends on it!
[h3]Red Light, Green Light [MP][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b97eaf9216f2a8f62808ca1110b5f54d5318368f.jpg[/img]

Young-hee is watching, so don’t misstep at the wrong time. Get on the pitch in the Red Card stadium and play three rounds of Red Light, Green Light, each two minutes long. In Round 1, no one gets a weapon. In Round 2 and 3, you can pick up weapons on the ground and eliminate other competitors with melee attacks and Finishing Moves.

There’s just one simple rule: When Young-hee says “Green Light,” the fight is on. Move a muscle after she says “Red Light” and you’re toast.
[h3]Pentathlon [MP][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/343ce1c33413c23feffc69a95909e42db425d78d.jpg[/img]

Prove that you have what it takes in the long run by competing in a series of Multiplayer modes to find out who reigns supreme! Play Domination, Kill Confirmed, and Hardpoint along with two new mode variants: Piggy Bank Team Deathmatch and Roulette. In Piggy Bank TDM, every elimination adds score to the Mega Piggy Bank; fight for possession of the huge payout when it drops part way through the match. In Roulette, one-shot eliminations via the Roulette Handgun award double the points, though with each fired shot there’s a chance it’ll blow up in your hands!

Matches can end in a draw, so fight for every advantage to see that you win.
[h3]Squid Game Moshpit [MP][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8f1e87bdc4f590393f1dec84d744120ccea9e75d.jpg[/img]

Fire up the Squid Game Moshpit including Team Deathmatch, Domination, and Hardpoint with a twist as Operators gain access to three important Squid Game-themed features:

[b]Red Light, Green Light Scorestreak: [/b]Is the fight getting too hectic for you? Stop the enemy in their tracks with this Scorestreak that calls “Red Light,” commanding all enemy Operators to stop moving or risk elimination.

[b]Piggy Bank: [/b]Eliminated Operators have a chance of dropping a Piggy Bank that awards a small score boost when picked up. For a bigger pay day, watch for the Mega Piggy Bank. Every elimination adds additional score to the Mega Piggy Bank, so once it drops, fight for it to acquire all the deposited score within.

[b]Roulette Handgun: [/b]The epitome of high risk, high reward. The Roulette Handgun spawns in the center of the map; grab it to activate a permanent UAV effect while wielding it and land one-shot eliminations against enemies, earning more than double the normal score to help you obtain Scorestreaks more quickly. The catch?  Your location will be marked for everyone to see, and every shot has a chance to blow up the weapon, taking you down with it.
[h3]Dead Light, Green Light [ZM, Liberty Falls, Citadelle des Morts][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f29f3e9956aecdb59b94443205d6bca6e385f91f.jpg[/img]

Deploy to Liberty Falls and the new Citadelle des Morts Zombies map to compete in an undead version of the stop-and-go game in Dead Light, Green Light. In the “Green Light” phase, Operators gain a bonus to earned Essence, so rack up the zombie eliminations. Once “Red Light” is called, Essence is drained from any Operator who moves, so spend big before this phase or hang tight to avoid throwing away your hard-earned currency.

And it doesn’t end there. When the dreaded “Dead Light” phase begins, prepare for a tough fight as a meaner wave of enemies approach.
[h3]Squid Game — Call of Duty: Warzone [Urzikstan][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aae32bea70b6be8aed6c12e99aceb1a7c1f7c639.jpg[/img]

Squad up and compete in a rotating series of challenges on Urzikstan that will see only the most hardened competitors emerge victorious. At the end of each round, underperforming squads will be eliminated. Keep your eyes peeled: at any time, a new challenge may trigger a round of Red Light, Green Light. You know what to do.
[h2][u]New Squid Game Store Bundles[/u][/h2]
Why compete when you can control, spectate, and determine who wins and who loses in the race? Look for new Squid Game-themed Bundles arriving in the Store throughout the Event.
[h3]Squid Game 2: Pink Guards Tracer Pack[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/92ea08d9e99fb1ad7fd09d4f21d48bd901f89f87.jpg[/img]

Keep the games under control with one of three new Operators included in this Bundle: Deploy with the “Masked Manager,” the “Masked Soldier,” or the “Masked Worker.” For close eliminations, take out enemies with the “Winner” Finishing Move.

Enforce the rules with two Weapon Blueprints: the “Game Guard” SMG and the “Rule Master” Assault Rifle. Plus, get the “Enforcer” Emblem, “Bank” Reticle, “Where it Stops” Weapon Charm, “Bank” Reticle, and “Play Time” Calling Card.
[h3]Squid Game 2: The VIPs Tracer Pack[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c3aa6d82e22adde8e3a3a06160b3c7b701908f20.jpg[/img]

Sit back and soak in the spectacle with two VIP-themed Operators, the “Panther Mask VIP” and the “Lion Mask VIP.” Not the humble type concerning their immense wealth, the Bundle also features a variety of rich items, including the “Choicest” Launcher, “Lacquered” Sniper Rifle, and “Satin Slayer” SMG Weapon Blueprints, plus the “Death Plated” Frag Grenade Equipment Skin.

For a classier finish, end them with the “Pinky Up” Finishing Move, and never let them forget your elite status by equipping the “Gilded” Emblem, “List Required” Calling Card, and “Very Important Player” Loading Screen.
[h3]Squid Game 2: Young-hee Tracer Pack[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0cf773ddf6aec4bd7b85a1d8ed5d0d2875da0523.jpg[/img]

Punish the enemy’s every move with the “Young-hee” Operator, accompanied by the “Don’t Move” Assault Rifle and “The Curator” Marksman Rifle Weapon Blueprints, and the “Hit Pause” Finishing Move for close-ranged eliminations.

Young-hee watches their every move; keep them in line by also equipping the “She Watches” Emblem, “Lethal Look” Large Decal, “Stay Still” Spray, “Under Her Gaze” Calling Card, and the “Uncorked” Emote.

Welcome back to the game. Good luck.

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 01 Reloaded: What you need to know, part 1
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Prepare for an Incredible Holiday Season! Black Ops Season 01 Reloaded: Incoming Intel[/u][/h2][h3]Season 01 Reloaded Overview: Goodbye, Luttazzis[/h3]
In the mid-season update for [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i], the French Syndicate continue their operation to overthrow the Luttazzi Crime Family with assistance from Sevati “Sev” Dumas and other Rogue Black Ops Operators seeking to expel the group from Avalon. If the mission is successful, the French Syndicate can next turn their muscle against Pantheon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d0a5ab3cbf6947dd53f9eb28c320a17778717f0f.jpg[/img]

Now’s the time to complete the heist, getting rid of the Luttazzis for good. Do it all with a smile as the mid-season also celebrates the holiday season with the return of CODMAS, featuring Nuketown Holiday and limited time modes (LTMs) like Ran-Snack, Infectious Holiday, Slay Ride Resurgence, and more.

[previewyoutube=-dJAhKekt_I;full][b][u][[ZOMBIES TRAILER VIDEO]][/u][/b][/previewyoutube]

Meanwhile, you’ll encounter old allies and investigate new haunts in Zombies, uncovering powerful new weapons and heretical adversaries in Citadelle des Morts!

[i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] Season 01 Reloaded arrives imminently, on Thursday, December 5 at 9AM PT.
[h2][/h2][h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: Season 01 Reloaded Zombies[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7db3fb1af84d2e53eb5127618f547f5a9fa1ba69.jpg[/img]

[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]ZOMBIES CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Citadelle des Morts:[/b] Encounter an unexpected ally and investigate an ominous medieval fortress in Avalon, as the zombie hordes threaten to overwhelm you!
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Additional Equipment:[/b] Research and utilize new powers courtesy of four elemental Wonder Weapons, the Vulture Aid Perk-a-Cola, Light Mend Ammo Mod, and Tesla Storm Field Upgrade. Plus, new GobbleGums and more!
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Modes Aplenty:[/b] Liberty Falls gets hellishly festive, Directed Mode comes to Citadelle des Morts later in-season, and the Zombies Training Course arrives for new players to cut their teeth on.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]

[h3]Citadelle des Morts[/h3]
One of Avalon’s oldest landmarks, the Citadel is shunned by locals both for its sinister history and because it is a base of operations for the crime family known as the French Syndicate. The castle was established in the 1100s on the site of a leper colony, and construction was completed a century later. In the 1300s, the renegade knight Guy de Saint Michel and his four enforcers took over the fortress and instituted a criminal reign of terror that birthed the Syndicate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/45d4532915be259ea1ed941305b003c62c75dd97.jpg[/img]

Having withstood medieval sieges and two world wars, the castle’s prominence waned as modern-day Avalon grew and prospered. Now it is closed to the public, housing a Syndicate crew led by a man named Franco whose dealings with Project Janus have brought a dark disaster upon a place already soaked in blood.

Welcome to Citadelle des Morts.

After the events of Terminus, Weaver, Maya, Carver, and Grey—along with Peck, Raptor One, and Strauss—embark on an expedition to the European principality of Avalon, hoping to rendezvous and ally with a luminary named Gabriel Krafft. There the Operators hope to learn more about an ancient relic known as the “Sentinel Artifact,” which in turn, when its power is harnessed, may be able to save Samantha Maxis from her aethereal imprisonment.

[previewyoutube=e6zSlQHm-q0;full][b][[ZOMBIES CINEMATIC TRAILER HERE]][/b][/previewyoutube]

It is an overcast Avalon dawn. A light mist rises from the wet ground, as the crew arrives at the site of the derelict castle. A reunion with an old colleague provides confirmation that S.A.M.'s intel was sound, and that Franco—a local French Syndicate Crime Boss and the focus of Maya's revenge—is on site, with Krafft as his hostage.

Unfortunately, there’s very little time for catching up. Dimensional breaches start to form around the citadel, and a major zombie outbreak threatens to overwhelm and devour the entire team.

This brand-new Zombies map experience launches at the start of Season 01 Reloaded, on Thursday, December 5, at 9AM PT.
[h3]Comms Team: Your Handlers[/h3]
[b][i]“It is good to see you, my friend. You remind me of the purpose I once had.” – [/i][/b][b]Ravenov[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/93a2bf70277e7f0463e26ca88b9dd7ebc626396b.jpg[/img]

Away from the carnage are your Handlers; expect radio contact with Peck, the newest member of the team (Sergei Ravenov), and S.A.M. Raptor One and Oskar Strauss stand ready to provide Exfil services, just so long as Strauss’s incessant fiddling with the helicopter’s instrumentation panels doesn’t kill them both.
[h3]Citadelle des Morts: A Hidden History[/h3]
Before learning of the new ways you can defeat the zombie hordes, it is worth gaining some perspective regarding the history of this place. The Citadel has had many names and roles over many lifetimes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7f79421e47918994fead03cae91c4c0dbcc47811.jpg[/img]

[b]750 A.D. [i]Abbaye des Oubliés[/i][/b]

Earliest records show construction of “The Abbey of the Forgotten.” Serving as a leprosarium—or leper colony—with those afflicted by the horrific disease being cared for by a Benedictine monastic order.

[b]1137 – 1220 A.D. [i]Citadelle de la Reine[/i][/b]

Adelaide of Murienne (1092–1154), Queen of France and widow of the recently-deceased Louis VI, begins construction of a keep on the site of the Abbey, which had suffered its first abandonment—after the infamous “leper revolt”—in the preceding decades. At the base of the rock outcropping that the keep sits on, a village to house the hundreds of artisans working on the project begins to take shape. Most of the building materials are scavenged from the structure of the old Abbey. Construction concludes in 1220.

[b]1314 A.D. [i]Relique des Templiers[/i][/b]

Jacques du Molay, the last Grandmaster of the Knights Templar, is burned at the stake for heresy in Paris. Surviving members of the order scramble to hide relics gathered during the Crusades. A lone knight rides south, carrying [[REDACTED]], once owned by Abdul [[REDACTED]], said to be able to [[REDACTED]] and even capable of [[REDACTED]] itself! Once at the keep, using a ritual learned from [[REDACTED]] [[REDACTED]], he [[REDACTED]], and Guy de Saint Michel along with his four enforcers ruled [[REDACTED]], the descendants now [[REDACTED]] [[REDACTED]].

Obviously, such [[REDACTED]] is considered apocryphal.

[b]1533 A.D. [i]Nouveau Propriétaire[/i][/b]

After Avalon is declared a free state by Papal order, the entire principality is granted to a powerful family now known as the French Syndicate.

[b]1939-1945 A.D. [i]Tombeau des Templiers[/i][/b]

Though Avalon stayed neutral during World War II, the Citadelle itself suffered several hits by off-target bombers over the course of the conflict, inflicting major damage to many internal chambers.

[b]Current Day. [i]Citadelle des Morts[/i][/b]

Nowadays, the abandoned Citadelle is mostly used by the French Syndicate. A convenient location to make inconvenient problems disappear, and enough off the beaten track to serve as a depot for their illicit smuggling and narcotic manufacturing activities.
[h3]Citadelle des Morts: Recon Tour[/h3]
A recent initial survey of the fortification and its vicinity reveals the first details regarding possible exploration choices. What additional secrets could this castle contain?
[h3]Town Square[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8c7e1b5279396e3fe529d2a5c40e4d3ef1dbc9f3.jpg[/img]

The central hub of the fortified village sitting below the main castle parapets, this square—which appears to have suffered recent damage centered around a vehicle fire—is dominated by a fountain with a large and imposing stone statue. To the southeast is an impressive example of a medieval bell tower, and a portcullis gate on opposing walls offer two ways to explore further. Directly across is access to the Tavern.
[h3]Tavern and Cellar[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5a1f05df2790eb0b88dcd74dbd885b4bf11e304c.jpg[/img]

From casks of ale to expensive bottles of rouge and blanc wines, [i]Le Maison de Macon[/i] (Mason’s House) used to offer a tranquil and authentic pub experience. Inside, the L-shaped ground floor features a banquet table, impressively large wooden bar, plenty of booth and table seating, and a mezzanine games room with a pool table. The restrooms are most definitely out of order.
[h3]Village Ascent and Upper Village[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/abd6c79df7c4c567f7b6fe1095beaaac301ea484.jpg[/img]

Shafts of sunlight are beginning to pierce the fog-filled alleyways of the village, casting light on the vile aftermath of a zombie incursion. Blood seeps into the cobblestone streets, and the main path ascends from the lower gate to a small forecourt and well (it may be pointless wishing for good luck).
[h3]Nature Path and Hilltop[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d8f6365dc542855f63c936291bf016c470837afc.jpg[/img]

Open the western gate, and an alternate path to the ramparts can be ascended, though there’s nothing natural about the inhabitants encroaching on this farmyard trail. Pass the ruins of a tower, and a stone barn and stables, the animals long-since bolted. Climb past the tiered stone buttress walls to the Hilltop, offering once-idyllic, now horrific views of the castle, surrounding fields, and encroaching shamblers.
[h3]Citadelle Courtyard, Village, and Hillside Ramparts[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/abee6c195c6066acca0694c2632243603e1d779b.jpg[/img]

Ivy snakes around the grand entrance edifices, and the interior of the keep seems firmly sealed. Explore either of the ramparts before venturing onto the outer battlements of the castle. It’s here you’ll discover an ornate and fearsome cannon, sculpted into the head of a roaring lion.
[h3]Entrance Hall[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a398f5b6760f4beafb1121d419e1a0add240069e.jpg[/img]

Entering the citadel, an imposing, cathedral-like entrance vestibule beckons, once resplendent with tapestries and torches, now only crumbling walls and graffiti-daubed alcoves remain. A central stone staircase leads to a carved dragon bust, under what was once the castle’s coat of arms. Both petroleum lamps and construction floodlights bathe the hall in an eerie glow and hint at the horrors ahead.
[h3]Sitting Rooms[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/58743f900cdbcbde605d5c9f51220ff36d3f4950.jpg[/img]

Another impressively sized room within the citadel, the interior walls are seemingly unstable and held together by scaffold poles and luck. Past the perimeter torches, the chamber shows evidence of recent activity with bunk beds and desks sitting next to an ancient wood-carved fireplace.
[h3]Dining Hall[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9625851dae3ba144a6e3260099bb23d6aaf6e3f4.jpg[/img]

Ideally any feasting going on in this derelict chamber won’t feature your own entrails as the main course, though there are many nooks, balconies, and entrances to be caught unawares during an undead ambush. The Main Hall remains an imposing chamber to explore, despite the complete collapse of its ceiling – likely caused by the unexploded WW2 bomb – that now protrudes from the pile of rubble at its center.
[h3]Dungeon[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7224ab05f39d327e86599f6033d429c76866217e.jpg[/img]

In the deepest, darkest levels of this fortress is a place of torture, and the surgical blades, thick chains, car batteries, lump hammers, and chairs with restraint harnesses suggest this despicable practice has continued into modern times. The French Syndicate have a rudimentary communications set up here along with generators and a basic bookkeeping desk. Perhaps they’re logging the prisoners kept in the filthy jail cells that span the outer walls of this disturbing place.
[h3]Undercroft and Oubliette Room[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d8159cee8cd972ffd32ef55f84e67b7d394e3a0a.jpg[/img]

A vaulted ceiling in the subterranean cellars of the castle is leaking what you hope is just rainwater, partially flooding the lowest levels of the place, and this crypt is perhaps a location one doesn’t linger at for long. Old paintings, strange statuary, stacked gravestones, and an impromptu game of chess, now fully concluded if the state of the players is anything to go by.

Deeper still within the Dungeon lie secrets better left forgotten. A lower dungeon—or Oubliette—provides damp and damning discoveries, and the earthen-floored chamber contains shelves of chemicals, barrels of hazardous materials, and a table where illicit drug manufacturing appears to be under way.
[h3]New Enemy Sighted: Doppelghast[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/40f7601eba5d68b20ece6f675a70fae3143f2329.jpg[/img]

Roughly translated as [i]double horror[/i] from the original German and old English respectively, these tormented ghouls are pale imitations of something that looks human but most certainly isn’t, not least because the entity sports two screaming skulls, rotting flesh stretched across each of them, seared into a sinewy and pockmarked torso of pallid gray skin, tendrils and protruding entrails.

Serving as the next stage in the evolutionary chain of Dark Aether metamorphosis, Doppelghasts are violent and display erratic and unsettling movement, as if each head is independently fighting for control of its body. It lurches, randomly knots itself up to perform fast and unexpected maneuvers and tends to outrun its lesser brethren using its powerful, elongated feet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/79251cddc224deef897e9dcae2bff21da68d7bfa.jpg[/img]

Though hunched and twisted, Doppelghasts are still one-and-a-half times as tall as most humans. They prefer to launch from the shadows or emerge from a horde of lesser undead. It is wise not to underestimate the creature’s abilities when cornered. Aside from rapid melee strikes, where it lashes out with its many tendrils and appendages, it can burst forth an array of sharp, bloody needles to disrupt incoming attacks. If they pierce flesh, the needles cause not only lacerating damage but attack the target’s nervous system, leading to hallucinations.

Should a weak point be discovered and a Doppelghast finally succumbs, you may want to stand back as the final explosion of blood and gore is as revolting as it is spectacular.
[h3]Other Entities of the Citadelle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bb4c1b1cc0bf7ff535b68d5f8c35ffc66cdd7aeb.jpg[/img]

The packs of lesser undead roaming the environment are mainly comprised of local townsfolk, farmers, and laborers, now in various stages of decomposition, with tougher enemies occasionally sporting French Syndicate insignia on their blood-soaked attire.

Additional entities observed within the vicinity of the castle include scuttling Vermin, airborne Parasites, and grotesque appendage-flailing behemoths known as Amalgams.
[h3]New Wonder Weapons: The Bastard Sword‘s Elemental Forms[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/da35c6610d907213af29ca40f14e937a5cc4b56b.jpg[/img]

While its exact nature is shrouded in mystery, it appears that four powerful elemental weapons may be forged from a claymore known as The Bastard Sword through unknown means.

The Bastard Sword itself is a formidable melee weapon, splitting the filth-filled undead into cleaved chunks with a devastating slash, along with a defensive parry, particularly useful when blocking incoming projectiles. However, this claymore can be transformed into one of four elemental Wonder Weapons, each with a unique and devastating special attack, as well as a passive effect that is powered up over time:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ed86232e2bfd88039d780f7bed737eb35c28d72f.jpg[/img]
[h3]Caliburn: Dragon’s Fire[/h3]
Create a fiery maelstrom of burning undead flesh, setting zombies alight and summoning an immense fireball.
[h3]Durendal: Stag of the Storms[/h3]
Summon thunderous power from the skies, discharging voltaic power to stun and stagger, before an electrical beam serves up a severe searing.
[h3]Balmung: Raven’s Shadow[/h3]
Cast your rotting foes into the Aetherial abyss, warping nearby enemies with a focused liminal tear.
[h3]Solais: Lion of Light[/h3]
The warmth of Light courses through you as you send foes screaming into darkness.
[h3]Citadelle des Morts: Additional Content[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ca7cafe26b06ac999145a3064222f1790f533aff.jpg[/img]

[b]Main Quest Active and Quest Rewards: [/b]The Main Quest for Citadelle des Morts will be live at the same time as the map launches, on December 5. Complete the Main Quest successfully, and your rewards include the “Jackknife” Operator Skin for Weaver, 5,000 XP, and a unique Calling Card only available by completing the Quest before Directed Mode is released for Citadelle des Morts!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ba87945a1ecdb363e964624758c136689731657d.jpg[/img]

[b]Oil Trap: [/b]A medieval method of dissuading attackers storming the outer parapets, overturning huge vats of boiling oil atop a battlement onto a horde of advancing zombies has the exact same end results, made even more potent if a Molotov Cocktail is thrown into the mix…

[b]The Lion Cannon: [/b]A giant, ornate bronze lion cannon on a large rotating cog platform dominates the outer battlements of the fortress and provides a spectacular means to enter the keep. What would happen if you climbed inside it?

[b]Syndicate Loot Crates: [/b]Evidence of the presence of this group can be seen as you explore the citadel, as they’ve marked some specific crates for their own uses. Those of an inquisitive nature may wish to investigate.

[b]Points of Power: [/b]Strange, metallic manhole covers have been discovered in various locations across the map, but none of them seem to lead to any kind of sewer system. Instead, they appear to have another, perhaps otherworldly use…

[b]Additional: [/b]Expect a fresh selection of Calling Card Challenges, including Dark Ops Challenges, as well as Intel in the form of Audio Logs, Documents, and Artifacts to discover, throughout your exploration of the Citadelle des Morts.
[h3]New Gameplay Content[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/70386255103cbfe031e2b758d75c1811e6c4f3b7.jpg[/img]

The following items are also available during the Citadelle des Morts mission, as well as on Terminus and Liberty Falls.
[h3]Additional Perk-a-Cola: Vulture Aid[/h3]
[i]Available: In-Game at Perk Machine[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ea17cea4cedfc1de0919ad4a67bbfbd78d24e39f.jpg[/img]

Available for the first time since [i]Black Ops II[/i], consume a can of Vulture Aid Elixir once you find the monstrous avian sculpture of a Perk-A-Cola machine, and you’ll discover an increase in the variety of loot dropped from enemies. Additional loot takes the form of Essence Vials and small Ammo drops. This is only available (and visible) to the player with Vulture Aid active. Then unlock the full power of the Perk by ensuring Augments are added!
[list]	[*]Vulture Aid is available on Citadelle des Morts, along with the eight previously accessible Zombies Perks. Note that some of these eight Perks are only available via a Der Wunderfizz machine.[/*]	[*]Vulture Aid is available on Liberty Falls and Terminus maps via the Der Wunderfizz machine.[/*][/list][h3]Vulture Aid: Major Augments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b873ea67175f469ca43929d20cf47a8a2e11e86c.jpg[/img]

The following Augments for Vulture Aid are available, once researched.

[b]Fetid Upgr-aid[/b]

On death, zombies have a chance to create a gas cloud that charges your Field Upgrade.

[b]Smell of Death[/b]

On death, zombies have a chance to create a gas cloud that conceals you while standing in it.

[b]Parting Gift[/b]

Vulture Aid ammo drops give more ammo to Wonder Weapons.
[h3]Vulture Aid: Minor Augments[/h3]
[b]Condor’s Reach[/b]

Auto-pickup loot from farther away.

[b]Carrion Luggage[/b]

Critical kills have a chance to drop extra Salvage.

[b]Picky Eater[/b]

On death, zombies have a higher chance of dropping your current equipment.
[h3]New Ammo Mod: Light Mend[/h3]
[i]Available: Unlocked reward as part of the Merry Mayhem Event[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/30c10532000cfdb7d975dac1dc540610be11e6c6.jpg[/img]

Bullets deal Light (i.e. elemental) damage. Each bullet has a chance to transform a normal or Special enemy’s health into a healing glyph that moves to nearby injured allies.
[list]	[*]This Ammo Mod can be used in all three Zombies maps along with the previously accessible Ammo Mods, assuming it is chosen at an Arsenal Machine.[/*][/list][h3]Light Mend: Major Augments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f6c3f9a1b0edb3135bdb29425d9625837516f8b1.jpg[/img]

[b]Antibiotic[/b]

The healing glyph now damages enemies that touch it, but its lifetime is reduced.

[b]Big Game[/b]

Light Mend can activate on Elite enemies, dropping three more healing glyphs.

[b]Dual Action[/b]

Consuming a healing glyph will temporarily allow you to heal faster.
[h3]Light Mend: Minor Augments[/h3]
[b]Longer Life[/b]

The healing glyph’s lifetime is increased.

[b]Extra Strength[/b]

The healing glyph replenishes more health when consumed.

[b]Express Remedy[/b]

Increase the range that the glyph will move to an ally.
[h3]Additional Field Upgrade: Tesla Storm[/h3]
[i]Available: Unlocked reward as part of the Merry Mayhem Event[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/13d2669cdd4b82f69309e56f101d324ea9c56b70.jpg[/img]

For ten seconds, lightning connects to other players, stunning and damaging normal enemies.
[list]	[*]This Field Upgrade can be used in all three Zombies maps along with the previously accessible Field Upgrades, assuming it is chosen as part of your Loadout, or swapped via the menu during a game.[/*][/list][h3]Tesla Storm: Major Augments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f98e14f9feff5ebcd7b455a58ffa565621766fd8.jpg[/img]

[b]Transformer[/b]

The field’s damage is increased by the number of allies that are connected.

[b]Shockwave[/b]

On activation, stun and damage all nearby enemies.

[b]Static Discharge[/b]

On activation, create a lethal surge of electricity around you.
[h3]Tesla Storm: Minor Augments[/h3]
[b]Power Grid[/b]

Increase the range the electric tether can connect to allies.

[b]Overclocked[/b]

Your movement speed is increased during Tesla Storm.

[b]Lithium Charged[/b]

Increase Tesla Storm duration.
[h3]New GobbleGums[/h3]
[i]Available: See below[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4f28c6263c0851612f1b7201d51a8040ecfef13c.jpg[/img]

Three new GobbleGums are available across all maps, and available (once acquired) to be swapped into your GobbleGum Loadout Pack:
[list]	[*][b]Power Keg (Rare):[/b] Spawns a Full Power Power-up.[/*]	[*][b]Time Out (Ultra):[/b] Lasts three minutes. Clear all Normal and Special enemies and end the Round. Normal spawning will not resume during this time.[/*]	[*][b]Holiday Cheer (Whimsical):[/b] Zombies have festive decorations.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2b0bd118f58d208cbe0e6633b35f88d3c6e392b5.jpg[/img]

Here’s how to unlock the GobbleGums:
[list]	[*][b]Power Keg: [/b][i]Unlocked reward as part of the GobbleGum Mania Event.[/i][/*]	[*][b]Time Out: [/b][i]Unlocked reward as part of the GobbleGum Mania Event.[/i][/*]	[*][b]Holiday Cheer: [/b][i]Primarily unlocked in the Jingle Hells Limited Time Event, potentially whenever you earn GobbleGums by playing. Also unlocked randomly from a successful Exfil. Once acquired, Holiday Cheer GobbleGums can be kept (they do not expire) and used in any of the three available maps. Expect these to be earned even after the Holiday Season.[/i][/*][/list]

See the Events section of this blog (below) for full details.
[h3]Additional Support Scorestreak: Hand Cannon[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7f30777b01c0ece8255badeff8f10a70daafcb87.jpg[/img]

[b]Salvage: 1250[/b]

Available during The Hit List Event in Season 01 (and in the Armory starting with Season 01 Reloaded for those who missed out), this is a powerful large caliber handgun with high bullet damage and penetration.
[h3]Zombies Training Course (Reloaded Launch)[/h3]
With a host of Weapon Camos, Badges, Calling Cards, and other rewards to earn, it’s well worth jumping into Round-Based Zombies if you haven’t already!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/394646e5c316b1e64ae0fd2bfd905cf810b869aa.jpg[/img]

Coming in Season 01 at Reloaded Launch, the Zombies Training Course allows you to learn the basics if you’re a new or casual player or refresh your knowledge if you’re a more seasoned player.

Polish your favorite armament and drop into Liberty Falls where the gruff Arsenal Machine Drill Sergeant gives you tough love as you maneuver to a sequence of different “Station” flags dotted around the map. If you’re unsure how to play this game mode, visit the following stations and learn (and perform) a different aspect about the game.
[list]	[*][b]Killing Zombies:[/b] Learn how to kill zombies and replenish resources.[/*]	[*][b]Map Progression:[/b] Learn how to navigate the world and progress rounds.[/*]	[*][b]Powering Up Players:[/b] Buff your strength and survivability with Perks and Armor.[/*]	[*][b]Powering Up Weapons:[/b] Increase your lethality with weapon upgrades.[/*]	[*][b]Getting New Weapons:[/b] Discover methods to acquire new weapons.[/*]	[*][b]GobbleGums:[/b] Learn how to use GobbleGums for unique power-ups.[/*]	[*][b]Exfil:[/b] Learn how to exit a match.[/*][/list][h3]Citadelle des Morts: Directed Mode[/h3]
Once the map has been thoroughly explored by players and the Zombies community, expect to complete the Citadelle des Morts Main Quest with added guidance in Directed Mode prior to the start of Season 02.
[h3]Zombies-Related Events (Mid-Season Launch, In-Season)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b376e6c7274fc169958ebd5efce01af12ed0176c.jpg[/img]

Zombies players should be ready to drop into a number of Events, one specifically related to Zombies, between Mid-Season launch and the start of January:
[list]	[*][b]Event: [/b]GobbleGum Mania (ZM only, December 5 – 19).[/*]	[*][b]Event: [/b]Merry Mayhem (MP, ZM, WZ, December 5 – 19).[/*]	[*][b]Event: [/b]Archie’s Festival Frenzy (MP, ZM, WZ, December 19 – January 3).[/*][/list]
Check out the Events section of this blog (below) for full details.
[h3]Jingle Hells (LTM, In-Season)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9a0743747a815b5a7eaf8563daa763cf305c45c5.jpg[/img]

Deck the Falls with boughs of holly, as the Jingle Hells festive Limited Time Mode returns! Last seen in [i]Black Ops Cold War[/i], Jingle Hells drops you in what could optimistically be called a winter wonderland, as the entirety of the Liberty Falls map is festooned with wreaths, ribbons, twinkling lights, Christmas trees, garlands of fir tree bunting, and a thin blanket of snow. Although, something feels a bit off… not least the melting piles of slush stained with bloody entrails…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a1cb2881863895343765d1b2eeee3a4ac762b8b4.jpg[/img]

The nearby river has frozen over, all the Mystery Boxes, Crafting Tables, and Arsenal Machines have gone missing, and the locals are just as unfriendly as ever. Don’t fret, as you’ll be making your own holiday cheer thanks to some special features found in this game mode:
[list]	[*][b]Main Quest is Active![/b] The Main Quest is available to complete this time around, with some added challenge now that the Arsenal and Crafting Tables aren’t around. Note: you’ll earn the standard Main Quest completion rewards if you finish the quest in Jingle Hells.[/*]	[*][b]Hear that Jingling? [/b]Expect bespoke audio to bring the festive flavor. You might want to look to the skies, too…[/*]	[*][b]GobbleGum Gifts: [/b]This is the best way to earn the “Holiday Cheer” GobbleGum![/*]	[*][b]Snowball Piles:[/b] Gather up to five snowballs from various piles scattered about the map, then use them as potent projectiles![/*]	[*][b]Naughty or Nice Power-Up: [/b]This large, floating stocking dishes out presents or spawns Vermin, depending on whether you’ve been naughty or nice.[/*]	[*][b]Snowmen:[/b] Undeniably jolly, but also fiendishly unfriendly, Liberty Falls has snowmen dotted around the map, and these can hide zombies or loot if left intact. It’s wise to make these your primary targets, especially as they drop handy loot when dispatched.[/*]	[*][b]Present Boxes:[/b] Under certain circumstances, zombies may drop a small present box, which can be opened for a gift that keeps on giving.[/*]	[*][b]S.A.M.T.A. Trials:[/b] The Trial computers that appear around the map now have a much more festive appearance. S.A.M.T.A. also has a few present boxes spawning nearby the machine when entering the map, so it’s worth seeking out![/*]	[*][b]Frozen Rounds:[/b] There’s strange fog in the air, and during certain rounds you’ll be chilled to the bone, slowing your reactions considerably. Perhaps it’s time to head indoors…[/*][/list][h3]Zombies Gameplay Updates[/h3]
Treyarch is also implementing several additional gameplay updates with Season 01 Reloaded for high Rounds and Special Rounds. These include:
[list]	[*]Reducing the number of Mangler spawns at mid-to-high Rounds.[/*]	[*]Implementing a maximum cap on active Manglers in the game, ramping up until the cap is released at Round 100.[/*]	[*]Reducing the Mangler’s arm cannon health.[/*]	[*]Significantly reducing the length of Special Rounds by reducing the number of spawns and adjusting the spawn delay rate for Special Rounds.[/*]	[*]Scaling Parasite damage between Rounds 31-91.[/*]	[*]Slightly increasing damage scaling for base zombies at Round 150-400.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 01 Reloaded: What you need to know, part 2
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: Season 01 Reloaded Multiplayer[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f27533e84f737ab30834b3b24bfe890d718d1ddf.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]MULTIPLAYER CONTENT SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Three Maps:[/b] Return to the fan-favorite Hacienda, hit the Luttazzi crime family where it hurts in the brand-new Racket Strike map, and celebrate the holiday season with Nuketown Holiday.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Two Festive LTMs:[/b] Satisfy your cravings in Ran-Snack and show some holiday spirit alongside the undead in Infectious Holiday.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Additional Content:[/b] Blast enemies onto the minimap with the new Shrapnel Radar Perk and add a fourth Scorestreak via the High Roller Wildcard.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Multiplayer Maps[/h3][h3]Hacienda[/h3]
[i]Remaster, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e07a42d4d68cd65cf51175f9b6d5188aca02eeed.jpg[/img]

The lush vineyard estate returns under new ownership as Operators descend on the mansion and its immaculate grounds. Fire down on enemies from the gallery and swim past their front line along the Terrace. Traverse the extended hallway overlooking the vineyard—a renovation first introduced in Hacienda Twilight in [i]Black Ops 4—[/i]and marvel at the wealth on display in the showroom, the in-office aquarium, and the elegant fountain at the map’s center. Using the new Omnimovement system, Hacienda becomes a whole new experience ripe with tactical opportunities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d84ee1a1cba0c8ad52522ddad05724e63ee6daeb.jpg[/img]
[h3]Racket[/h3]
[i]Brand-New, Strike, 2v2/6v6, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b429e8504efa0a56e84a1cb3cf9fe8b4366862c4.jpg[/img]

The French Syndicate continues with their plans to topple the Luttazzi crime family by hitting them directly in their finances. Battle within the labyrinthine bank vault, dashing in and out of the vault cells to flank enemies in the halls. This new three-lane map requires quick thinking to survive its tight confines, so don’t let all that gold distract you from the mission at hand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3c8c6822cab404c1a7a60e3991fc06676bced9bd.jpg[/img]
[h3]Nuketown Holiday[/h3]
[i]Variant, Core 6v6, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5772d09043c529270fceb8bd67dc0095a08a1c6.jpg[/img]

Good cheer arrives as Nuketown dresses up for the holidays. Get into snowball fights and gawk at the festive decorations lining every surface. On Nuketown Holiday, you can almost forget that you’re in the middle of a battle… albeit one where Operators exchange grenades instead of presents. Good luck out there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/588d5bf0ff0de35e539b2be6c59db326bd9148e4.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Festive Limited Time Modes[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8a824fd2f67356a260d4b5b6e0e08607c85f9470.jpg[/img]

Indulge your sweet tooth while gaining buffs in Ran-Snack and add a little levity to fighting for your life in Infectious Holiday.
[h3]Ran-Snack (Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f35642fa0f965e114756315c215b8ec9b7facd14.jpg[/img]

Trade gold for sweets in this festive LTM that challenges teams to gather and deposit the most cookies. Grab cookies from the rotating crate, fallen Operators, and by breaching the enemy’s cookie box and taking the goods back to your own. In honor of the season of giving, your Operator also earns buffs for depositing cookies, including a speed boost, faster reload, and faster health regen. The first team to reach the Score Limit or have the best score when the Time Limit expires wins.
[h3]Infectious Holiday (In-Season)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/67483d10d675ea755053a8964d3c6801a29b3c6c.jpg[/img]

Even the undead are getting into the holiday spirit as zombies and fallen Operators don festive clothing in this festive twist on the fan-favorite Infected mode.

When playing either of these LTMs on Nuketown Holiday, look for snow piled around the map that you can pick up and throw at enemies for a one-shot elimination!
[h3]New Loadout Content[/h3]
Enhance your explosions with intel-gathering capabilities and grant yourself the gift of an extra Wildcard with two new Loadout items to help carry you through the year.
[h3]New Perk[/h3]
[i]Available: Unlocked reward as part of the Merry Mayhem Event[/i]

[b]Perk: Shrapnel Radar[/b]

[b]Perk Slot:[/b] 3

[b]Type:[/b] Recon

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a753bd067c82e0153edffa9687c69242fd3725b8.jpg[/img]

Blast damage dealt from area-of-effect Lethals, Tacticals and Field Upgrades mark the injured target on your minimap.
[h3]New Wildcard[/h3]
[i]Available: Unlocked during Mid-Season[/i]

[b]Wildcard: High Roller[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f0e87767d8e2c903e1a5524cb2c7038e4691f38e.jpg[/img]

Equip a fourth Scorestreak for use in Core 6v6 Multiplayer matches. Pairs well with Assassin, Dispatcher, and Bankroll.
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Warzone: Season 01 Reloaded Content [/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/31eeab44fefa0b83ddfcdd799b6a0c9d348af53a.jpg[/img]
[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE SUMMARY[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Introducing BR Ranked Play:[/b] Compete for placement and exclusive rewards with the arrival of BR Ranked Play for [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Deploy to Urzikstan using a competitive ruleset including new innovations and updates for the best possible experience.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]CODMAS LTMs: [/b]Celebrate the arrival of two holiday-themed LTMs. Get in snowball fights and fight for loot in tree hot zones as you deploy to Area 99 in Holiday Rush and Urzikstan in Slay Ride Resurgence.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]New Perk: [/b]Shrug off enemy traps with the new Reflexes Perk. Nothing can stop you now.
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Call of Duty: Warzone BR Ranked Play (Reloaded Launch Window)[/h3]
Drop in and back up your talk with the arrival of Battle Royale Ranked Play for [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], the competitive experience returns to Battle Royale. Give it all to be the last squad standing in Urzikstan and earn exclusive Ranked Play rewards for your efforts.
[h2]Overview and Features[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/18cc73dda0ff899c4ce615f4ca56fa886c4fdcd2.jpg[/img]

[b]BR Ranked Play Access:[/b] To access BR Ranked Play, players must first place in the Top 15 in Battle Royale or the Top 6 in Resurgence across a total of 30 matches. Placements from Season 01 count toward this requirement.

[b]Updated Rank: [/b]The 1-50 Rank and Skill Division system seen in previous versions of BR Ranked Play have been combined into a single Rank, representing what was previously your Skill Division and Tier. Earn SR and progress through 8 Ranks: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Crimson, Iridescent, and Top 250.

[b]SR (Skill Rating): [/b]Progress through Ranks by earning SR in each match. New this year, SR is earned from your placement and your personal elimination performance. The amount of SR earned from an elimination is now determined by your rank in relation to your opponent. This means more SR’s for killing higher ranked players, and less SR for killing those below you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1096d9a2cccce18fabefb96a4bc4b0f0ff4e3c0c.jpg[/img]

[b]Update: Party Skill Restriction: [/b]Full squads can party together without restrictions. Matchmaking will be based on the highest ranked player in the squad.

[b]Update: Seasonal Setback:[/b] The End-of-Season SR Setback has been adjusted in BR Ranked Play to reduce the impact felt by players early in their Rank journey. Every new season, your Rank may be reset based on where you ended the previous season, as follows:
[list]	[*][b]Bronze or Silver [/b]Ranked players are not impacted by the Seasonal setback and will be able to pick up where they ended each Season with no SR deduction.[/*]	[*][b]Gold or Platinum[/b] players will start the next Season in Tier I of Gold or Platinum respectively.[/*]	[*][b]Diamond and above players [/b]will start the next Season at Diamond I.[/*][/list]
[b]Update: Loss Forgiveness:[/b] No matter what your Rank, each player’s first loss of the day will be forgiven and not deduct SR. This does not stack. Additionally, the three games of Loss Forgiveness that are granted when you’re promoted to a new Rank or at the start of the season now only count down after Losses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/72b41b488485b37c37692ea3d2044db74a6c24f6.jpg[/img]

[b]BR Ranked Play rewards: [/b]BR Ranked Play features a variety of unique rewards players can earn to show off their skill and engagement with the mode, including new Operator Skins, Calling Cards, Decals, Emblems, plus a Loading Screen and Sticker:
[list]	[*][b]Rank Rewards:[/b] Reach Gold Rank or higher to earn special Rank Rewards that are awarded the moment you’re promoted into the Rank instead of at the end of the Season.[/*][/list][list]	[*][b]Win Challenges: [/b]Reach Career Win milestones over the course of your Ranked Play career to earn rewards including the base Ranked Operator Skin, Call of Duty: Warzone-themed Weapon Camo, and the “Whisper” Combat Knife Blueprint. These can be completed across multiple seasons.[/*][/list]

[list]	[*][b]Top 250 Competitor and Top 250 Champion Skin (#1 Overall):[/b] Climb to the Top 250 BR Ranked Play leaderboard to earn the “Top Competitor” Operator Skin (Home and Away). The #1 overall player for the season will get the sole privilege of equipping the “Top 250 Champion” Operator Skin.[/*][/list][list]	[*][b]Seasonal Rewards:[/b] Each BR Ranked Play Season introduces new Seasonal Rank Rewards to earn. These are only available to be earned during that specific Season. Like the Rank Skins, Seasonal Rank Rewards are awarded as soon as the player is promoted into each Rank instead of at the end of the Season.[/*][/list][h3]New LTMs: Holiday Rush, Slay Ride Resurgence[/h3]
Throw snowballs at your enemies, fight for loot around decorated trees, and hijack Undead Santa’s ride in these two LTMs arriving in the mid-season.
[h3]Holiday Rush (Area 99, Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4774fdb6fb2218960b258502f0f1c271964eebf5.jpg[/img]

Enter Area 99, newly outfitted with Deck the Halls trees and Snowball coolers. Get right to the point with access to high-tier loot along with a smaller gas circle and faster transitions between collapses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1fae4f1a3eeda51861cb43a57fa9cfb303e29f12.jpg[/img]

Undead Santa has hijacked the train. Toss deadly snowballs, capture trees, hunt reindeer, and battle for control of Santa’s Slay Ride. Last team standing wins.

[b]Perk Slot:[/b] 1

[b]Available: [/b]Season 01 Reloaded Reward

Rush enemy positions without getting caught in a trap. With this Perk equipped, triggered explosives detonate on a delay when sprinting past them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/623d70d8d80867933f406a5455d595fe96989396.jpg[/img]

Get these and more with an epic slate of new Bundles arriving throughout the mid-season, including a pair of ugly holiday sweaters to warm you through the winter.
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Free Trial: [/b]Get two weeks of free access to Multiplayer and Zombies including new maps like Nuketown Holiday and modes like Prop Hunt introduced in Season 01!
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table][h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][h3]Primary Weapon: Maelstrom[/h3]
[b][i]Shotgun, Event Reward (Merry Mayhem)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f34832183402e43b6e7572c24a467452d04fa07e.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 34[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 10[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers 3).

[i]Fully automatic shotgun. Good range and handling. High recoil and large hip spread.[/i]

Clear rooms with this fast firing full-auto Shotgun that overwhelms enemies with a hail of lead. The perfect weapon for the new Racket Strike map and in any confined area, the Maelstrom requires getting up close, its heavy recoil and large hip spread quickly losing effectiveness at range. If you can close the distance first, they’re toast.
[h3]Primary Weapon: AMR Mod 4 (In-Season)[/h3]
[b][i]Sniper Rifle, Event Reward (Archie’s Festival Frenzy)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dc324b18d33807285020958fa5c1860cac9b564f.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 38[/b]

[b]MAGS: 4[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 6[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Stock Pad, Magazine, Rear Grip, Comb, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Reticle Unlocks (MP, ZM, WZ), Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers 3).

[i]Semi-auto sniper rifle. One-shot kill to torso, arms, hands, and upper legs. Very high recoil and slow rate of fire. You can steady your aim while ADSing.[/i]

Down enemies fast with this powerful Sniper Rifle providing a one-shot elimination across the upper body not accounting for armor. Its high damage is balanced by slow aim speed and heavy recoil, though these drawbacks can be alleviated with the right attachments. However you customize it, this thing is guaranteed to hit hard.
[h3]Melee Weapon: Cleaver (In-Season)[/h3]
[b][i]Melee, Event Reward[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f8c09e075c040a320e4ada8c321aec51e70d0992.jpg[/img]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]None

[i]One-hit kill. Short-medium range. Medium attack speed.[/i]

Go ham with the close-quarters Cleaver Melee weapon. Chop and slice with a mix of heavy and light attacks. Equally useful for enemy Operators and the undead.

[i]Available: Unlocked reward as part of the Merry Mayhem and Archie’s Festival Frenzy Events[/i]
[h3]3-Round Burst Mod Conversion (In-Season)[/h3]
[i]XM4 Assault Rifle, Fire Mod, Merry Mayhem Event Reward[/i]

Convert the XM4 Assault Rifle’s primary firing mode into a three-round burst, conserving ammo and supporting a steadier aim through sustained combat.

[i]Kompakt 92 SMG, Fire Mod, Archie’s Festival Frenzy Event Reward[/i]

Add some control to the rapid-fire Kompakt 92 SMG with a three-round burst primary firing mode. Each burst cycles quickly to the next, allowing you to still pump out damage when its needed most.

30 Minutes “Double Battle Pass XP Token”

[b]Archie’s Festival Frenzy ZM LTM:[/b] Jingle Hells: Liberty Falls (In-Season)

[b]Archie’s Festival Frenzy WZ LTM:[/b] Slay Ride Resurgence

[b]New BlackCell Loyalty Bonus[/b]

Your BlackCell offering continues to get better and better! [b]Player and Weapon XP Boosts[/b]

As players progress through the seasons of Black Ops 6 content, BlackCell owners are set to receive some exceptional additional benefits[i].[/i] As well as unique rewards during specific Events, expect to receive an additional 10% Player and Weapon XP boost for each additional seasonal BlackCell purchase you make after the first one.

The first 10% initial boost will start once you obtain two BlackCell seasons. These BlackCell Loyalty Bonus boosts are added in the next and subsequent seasons, and will stack in addition to other XP boosts, like the Black Ops 6 ownership boost, 2XP events and 2XP tokens. The maximum BlackCell Loyalty Bonus boost is 50% for Black Ops 6 seasons only and this bonus will conclude after the final season of Black Ops 6 ends.

By obtaining each season of BlackCell, you can receive the maximum boost possible, as shown in the following table:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cb4bcc46d6bbd74d9719cbe360d496c73d35967f.png[/img]
[h3]New Store Offerings[/h3]
A new helping of awesome in-store Bundles arrives in Season 01 Reloaded, including new Reactive and Mastercraft weapons, Ultra Operator Skins, and more.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Brightmare Mastercraft Ultra Skin Bundle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bace90a3ae561a6775d4082f4a70ae06599e1317.jpg[/img]

There are two sides to every unicorn, and this one’s in a slaying mood. Throw your opponents off guard with the vibrant “Brightrider” Operator Ultra Skin before mowing them down with the “Dreadhorn” Mastercraft Blueprint for the AS VAL Assault Rifle, featuring light or dark visuals that change upon weapon inspect.

Suppress enemy positions with the high-capacity “Painbow” Jackal PDW SMG and “Myth Horse” PU-21 LMG Blueprints. Plus, share your penchant for bright colors and pageantry with the “Gift Horse” Care Package Blueprint, “Refraction Action” Finishing Move featuring your very own companion unicorn, “Rainbows and Unicorns” Emote, “Starsight” Weapon Reticle, and “Saddle Up” Spray.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Dank Days Reactive Mastercraft Ultra Skin Bundle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/111f084d89e67ce9b823d0c62d0a70d5bcf9ca8a.jpg[/img]

Coast through the holiday season with the smoking hot “Bongshot” Mastercraft Blueprint for the KSV SMG, with visual effects that intensify as you land more eliminations, wielded by the amphibious “Blunty” Operator Ultra Skin. From a distance, smoke’ em out with the Legendary “Blunt Trauma” LMG Blueprint for the GPMG-7. Keep it green with additional items including the "Weed Wacker” A.G.R. Mk 1 Scorestreak Skin, “Toke-a-Bloke” Finishing Move, “Aim High” Weapon Reticle, “My Bong” Weapon Charm, “Pass It” Spray, and “Greener Grass” Loading Screen.
[h3]Tracer Pack: Otaku We Gotchu Mastercraft Ultra Skin Bundle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/01e4426a73f2bdc121f7528d54acdcc89790cb3e.jpg[/img]

Share your love for all things anime with this exciting Bundle featuring the “Helm” Mastercraft Blueprint for the LW3A1 Frostline Sniper Rifle featuring an animated co-pilot, the perfect sci-fi fit for the “Aero” Operator Ultra Skin. Keep the pain coming with the Legendary “Hardwire” C9 SMG Blueprint plus the “Kawaii” Emote, “Targeting Computer” Weapon Reticle, “Super Determined” Animated Emblem, “Bitty Bot” Weapon Charm, “Infinite Wilderness” Loading Screen), and “GG” Spray.
[h3]Tracer Pack: DOA Mama’s Back Reactive Ultra Skin Bundle[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0a4b4b283fe8bd3332d9ffadaa7f60e1ac2f00e3.jpg[/img]

Bring it back to the classics with the 8-bit style “Mother Clucker” Weapon Blueprint for the ASG-89 Shotgun, a Reactive weapon that alters its appears as you eliminate enemies. Keep up the pressure with the “Payback” AK-74 and blast zombies with the “Propulsion” Thrustodyne Model 23 Wonder Weapon Blueprint and “Monkey Bit-ness” Monkey Bomb Skin. Fight up close with the “Ladle” Knife Blueprint and celebrate the classic arcade game with the “Weird Birds” Emote, “Dot Ops” Weapon Reticle, “Clap Clap Boom” Calling Card, and “Immolation Liquidation” consumable GobbleGum.
[h3]Other Incoming Bundles[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8b394e258a5e2b77178918b3aaa3a49683bdfb56.jpg[/img]

These are just some of the highlights coming in the mid-season. Watch for other Bundles arriving throughout the end of the year and beyond like the [b]“Hella Fresh Starter Pack,”[/b] [b]“Sweater Ops Reactive” [/b](including festive Skins for Weaver and Maya), the [b]“Dark Practitioner Reactive” [/b](including a Ray Gun Weapon Blueprint), the “Toxic Pawsitivity Mastercraft” (including a rave-worthy Baseball Bat Mastercraft) and more.
[h2][u]Black Ops 6 Multiplayer and Zombies Free Trial[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4d0430c6e395fb6389f091920d2e7e5e82882174.jpg[/img]

Dive into Call of Duty Multiplayer and get in the festive spirit by checking out Nuketown Holiday! Beyond that, experience the new Omnimovement system and more gameplay features on great maps such as Hacienda, Extraction, Racket, and more – The Free Trial is playable across five core modes including Prop Hunt, new to [i]Black Ops 6[/i] and returning to Call of Duty for the first time in years.

If you’re brave enough, jump into the fan-favorite Zombies mode, and uncover the secrets of the Round-Based Zombies maps Terminus and Liberty Falls using the new Directed Mode. Season 01 Reloaded of [i]Black Ops 6[/i] is here; it’s time to see what all the hype is about!

The Free Trial runs from December 13 to 20.
[h2]Upgrade to Black Ops 6 Today![/h2]

[i]Black Ops 6[/i] is available now, and there’s never been a better time to experience the spy action thriller Campaign, the in-depth tactical chaos of best-in-class Multiplayer, and soak in the gory glory of an incredible round-based Zombies experience!
