[b]Grenadier[/b]

Available: Immediately

Explosive damage slows enemy health regeneration and movement speed. Throw equipment farther and see a previous of the trajectory.

[b]Dexterity[/b]

Available: Player Level 20

Reduced weapon motion while jumping, sliding, and diving. Take less fall damage.

[b]Scavenger[/b]

Available: Player Level 26

Start equipped with maximum reserve ammo for your primary weapon. Resupply ammo equipment, and plates from dead enemies.

[b]Survivor[/b]

Available: Player Level 47

Start regenerating health more quickly. Your allies revive you faster when you’re Downed.
[h3]Perk 2 Slot (Red, 6)[/h3]
Pick one of the following six Perks, assuming you’ve unlocked them:

[b]Quartermaster[/b]

Available: Immediately

Recharge equipment over time (50 seconds).

[b]Bomb Squad[/b]

Available: Player Level 8

Reduces incoming explosive and fire damage. Spot enemy equipment and Killstreaks through walls.

[b]Tracker[/b]

Available: Player Level 29

See enemy footsteps. Bullets you fire briefly mark an enemy for you and your squad. Enemies that down you are automatically pinged.

[b]Sprinter[/b]

Available: Player Level 32

Can Tactical Sprint indefinitely.

[b]Cold-Blooded[/b]

Available: Player Level 41

Undetectable by AI targeting and thermal optics. Prevents some enemy recon Perks and effects.

[b]Quick Fix[/b]

Available: Player Level 50

Killing enemies or inserting armor plates immediately starts health regeneration. Can insert amor plates one-handed.
[h3]Perk 3 Slot (Yellow, 6)[/h3]
Pick one of the following six Perks, assuming you’ve unlocked them:

[b]Gung-Ho[/b]

Available: Immediately

Reduced movement penalties when reloading or using equipment. Reload while Tac Sprinting.

[b]Resolute[/b]

Available: Player Level 5

Taking damage from gunfire provides a boost to movement speed for a short duration.

[b]Ghost[/b]

Available: Player Level 17

Undetectable by enemy Radar Pings while moving. Cannot be detected by some devices.

[b]Birdseye[/b]

Available: Player Level 23

UAVs you call in are 25% larger and show the heading of the enemy for your squad. Detects players with Ghost.

[b]Tempered[/b]

Available: Player Level 35

Refill armor plates to full with two plates instead of three.

[b]Alertness[/b]

Available: Player Level 44

Sense when enemies are nearby. Tell when you are being aimed at by the enemy.
[h3]Wildcards (4)[/h3]
Pick one of the following four Wildcards, assuming you’ve unlocked them, to complete your Perk and Wildcard choices before looting for more during a match.

[b]Overkill[/b]

Available: Player Level 24

Equip two primary or secondary weapons.

[b]Bandolier[/b]

Available: Player Level 15

Your loadout provides a Munitions Satchel.

[b]Gunfighter[/b]

Available: Player Level 33

Equip three extra attachments to your Primary weapon.

[b]Battle Ready[/b]

Available: Player Level 38

Your loadout provides a UAV and Utility Box.
[h3]Lootable Perks and Specialist[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/63ec957578e53615c0f7dfdfab439e01ba2a49b5.jpg[/img]

Once you’ve dropped into a match, there are additional Perks you can find to fully kit out your Operator with up to six additional advantages. These valuable items are found in caches and other locations across the map, and there are up to six to find:
[list]	[*]Four of them are Perks from the “Pick-3” Slots, usually ones you haven’t chosen. These are always the same four Perks.[/*]	[*]Two of them are lootable-only Perks: Irradiated and Shrouded.[/*]	[*]If you’re dispatched during a match, your Pick-3 Perks stays where you dropped, and can be looted by the enemy.[/*]	[*]If you’re dispatched during a match, any Lootable Perks vanish and cannot be obtained by the enemy.[/*]	[*]At the start of Season 01, the four “Pick-3” Perks that are also Lootable, will be chosen. These will be the same very match but expect frequent “rotations” as the Seasons progress, where four new “Pick-3” Perks are updated into the loot pool, replacing the previous four.[/*][/list][h3]Lootable Perks (Purple, 6)[/h3]
Obtain up to four Perks from the previous “Pick-3” Slots by looting them in-game, as well as one or both of the following:

[b]Irradiated[/b]

Available: In-Game Only

While under the effects of the gas circle or equipment you will move faster, take reduced gas damage, and can insert armor plates.

[b]Shrouded[/b]

Available: In-Game Only

Drop a Smoke Grenade when entering the downed state.
[h3]Specialist Perk Package[/h3]
The legendary Specialist Perk is also back! This Package is a rare loot drop and can also be obtained via the Care Package Killstreak, and simply grants you every single available [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] Perk in the game! That’s all 18 Pick-3 Perks, plus Irradiated and Shrouded! If you’re dispatched during a match, your Specialist Perk Package stays where you dropped, and can be looted by the enemy.
[h3]The Company You Keep: Operators (157)[/h3][h3]MWII Operators (70), MWIII Operators (61), BO6 Operators (26, Launch and In-Season)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a27f927591f6182fc7f813a77e0193322b70cee7.jpg[/img]

With the integration of content from [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] and [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] into [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], with Season 01 under way, you’ll have access to over 150 different Operators! This is, of course, assuming you unlocked or purchased all available Operators during the lifespan of the previous two Call of Duty games. To maintain easy accessibility, the Operators Menu has three easily switchable sub-menus, each containing Operators from the three games.

Each Operator comes with any Skins you may have purchased during MWII and MWIII, and there are no restrictions on who you squad up with. Need to drop into Area 99 with Price, Ghost, Woods, and Adler? Let’s do this!
[h3]New Combat Features[/h3][h3]Omnimovement and Body Shield[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/19b45d6ab0ea06b743064a40476867fb84dd64c0.jpg[/img]

The amazing innovations to movement and combat that arrived in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] at launch are fully integrated and realized in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. This includes the genre-defining game changer known as Omnimovement, allowing you to Sprint, Slide, and Dive in any direction. Be sure to play some [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer matches to prepare yourself, so you’re able to:
[list]	[*]Sprint forward, sideways, or backwards.[/*]	[*]Shoot targets while sliding or diving forward, sideways, or backwards.[/*]	[*]Perfect the 180-degree Combat Dive (Sprint, dive from height, rotate to face an enemy, and eliminate them before you hit the ground).[/*]	[*]Ensure you’re able to perform the Combat Supine, dropping to Prone and rotating your Operator, eliminating foes as you slowly spin.[/*]	[*]Combine Omni-Sprint with Combat Slides and Dives, usually at doorways or thresholds and spin to target and drop foes as you complete the maneuver.[/*]	[*]Use Body Shield as an alternate to a Finishing Move; grab a foe from behind and use them to soak up the damage while optionally giving them encouraging whispers in their ear. Then drop them.[/*][/list][h3]Emotes and Sprays[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3356a43cc520afb8312802b6014bc6932953b074.jpg[/img]

Operator gestures known as Emotes, which can be employed during a match or in the Winner’s Circle after a victory, are back and earnable via Level Unlocks, with additional Emotes available in the Battle Pass. Note you can equip Emotes to any Operator; even those from [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] and [i]III[/i]!

Veteran [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] players well remember covering walls with the “D-Day” Operator spray to confuse enemies entering an ambush point, and we’re happy to announce that Sprays are back and ready to be employed in a variety of new and inventive ways!
[h3]Quick Inventory (Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fd0194bf77a85b12316d06b36dfbb7fc9733b879.jpg[/img]

As confirmed at Call of Duty: NEXT, at the start of Season 01, streamlining of the Inventory system comes to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], with the removal of the current “Backpack” system and a return to an inventory menu that veteran players may recognize. Working from left to right in the above image, your inventory is divided into the following sections:
[list]	[*]Cash on hand[/*]	[*]Gas Mask[/*]	[*]Armor Plates[/*]	[*]Killstreaks[/*]	[*]Field Upgrade[/*]	[*]Primary, Secondary, and Melee Weapons[/*]	[*]Ammunition for your AR, SMG, Shotgun, Sniper, and Launcher[/*][/list]
If you’re concerned about the number of items you’re able to carry, you’ll be pleased to learn that Satchels are returning to the game.
[h3]Satchels (Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/37a0e9732cf618b0b3f03810b958509497dd251d.jpg[/img]

Satchels are optional, lootable equipment that increase the storage capacity of the dedicated inventory slots within a [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] Match. These provide Operators with duplicates of the same items to increase your storage capabilities, thus increasing your effectiveness. Satchels can’t be (and don’t need to be) dropped, and one or both individual Satchel types can be found and equipped once per match. If an Operator carrying one or more Satchels is killed, all their Satchels are dropped and can be looted. Expect the following Satchel types:
[list]	[*][b]Armor Satchel:[/b] This substantially increases your Armor Plate carrying capacity.[/*]	[*][b]Munitions Satchel:[/b] This increases the Ammunition capacity for AR, SMG, Shotgun, Sniper, and Launcher ammunition.[/*][/list][h3]Progression, Prestige, and Challenge Integrations (Launch)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6d7ff1c07cf0e302ed0b1f959927cde773bc04e8.jpg[/img]

As detailed [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/10/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-launch-progression-leveling-prestiging-challenges-intel]in the recent Progression and Prestige Blog[/url],[i] Black Ops 6[/i] comes with a robust and granular Progression experience for those wanting to unlock a variety of free content. At the start of Season 01, a similarly sized grind becomes available to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]players. Here’s what to expect:
[list]	[*][b]Level Unlocks: [/b]Your Player Level will be reset to 1, and you’ll earn XP to progress through 55 Player Level Unlocks, gaining access to Weapons, Equipment, Killstreaks, and Perks as you go.[/*]	[*][b]Classic Prestige: [/b]After reaching Player Level 55, you have the option to Prestige, re-locking most of your Player Level content, but allowing you to progress through ten Prestige levels, all of which come with incredible unlockable content! Note that some of this content is only available to those who own [i]Black Ops 6[/i], though these rewards can be retroactively obtained if you purchase the game.[/*]	[*][b]Prestige Mastery: [/b]Once you complete Prestige 10, you unlock Prestige Mastery, with a further 1,000 Levels to climb, and ultimate rewards to claim![/*]	[*][b]Calling Card Challenges: [/b]Expect an impressive selection of Calling Cards to be unlocked the Black Ops way, including cards only available after Prestiging, or completing fully redacted “Dark Ops” challenges! Naturally, there’s many animated Cards to obtain, including the fabled “100 percent” complete for unlocking all Career, Hardened, and Prestige challenges.[/*]	[*][b]Reticle Challenges:[/b] Equip a [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Optic to one of the new weapons and a “reticle” option opens in the Gunsmith > Cosmetics menu. Here you’re able to access ten unlockable reticles per Optic, each requiring a set number of ADS kills to complete. You can then share these Reticles – or those you’ve unlocked in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer and Zombies – in either mode or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].[/*]	[*][b]Weapon Camos: Military Camos:[/b] The final set of weapon camos are now available to unlock! Grind through nine Military Camos per [i]Black Ops 6[/i] weapon, each usually requiring a set of in-game eliminations to obtain. These are unlocked on a per-weapon basis and are not shared.[/*]	[*][b]Weapon Camos: Special Camos: [/b]Then focus on unlocking both Special camos for each weapon, with a specific unlock criteria for each. Complete both (in any order), and these become available to place on any other [i]Black Ops 6[/i] weapon you’ve already unlocked Special Camos for. Note that Multiplayer and Zombies Special Camos are also equippable in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].[/*]	[*][b]Weapon Camos: Mastery Camos: [/b]The final prize is to unlock the four Mastery Camos for each [i]Black Ops 6[/i] weapon! This is the Gold Tiger, King’s Ransom (Animated), Catalyst (Animated), and finally the Abyss (Animated, Dynamic).[/*][/list]

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Season 01: What You Need to Know, Part 4
notes.notes:
[h2][u]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6: General Content (MP, ZM, WZ)[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e69b3a110720bfa9d8400fa14cac46eedcebd844.jpg[/img]

[table]			[tr]			[td]			[h2]Call of Duty: General Content Summary (All Modes and Games)[/h2]			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Weapons Detail:[/b] Seven new weapons are accessible across Season 01, including four Primaries (the Krig C AR, Saug SMG, Maelstrom Shotgun, and AMR Mod 4 Sniper Rifle), a Special Secondary (the foldable Sirin 9mm), as well as two Melees (Power Drill and Cleaver). Plus, unlock four special weapon attachments, and face more Challenges to unlock firepower in the Armory!
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Battle Pass and BlackCell:[/b] Whether you’re unlocking the free tiers and base weapons or purchasing the Battle Pass Bundle or the exclusive BlackCell offering, the brand-new Season 01 Battle Pass offers new ways to unlock the content you want, when you want it. Plus: There are more types of content to earn than ever before!
			[/td]		[/tr]		[tr]			[td]			
[b]Season 01 Operators: [/b]A molten man of fire, Goliath leads the charge as the BlackCell Operator, along with Sevati “Sev” Dumas, a clandestine assassin and main player in the Rogue Team. Plus, The Replacer is back, and “Competitor” Operators arrive in time for the 2025 CDL Season. Finally, there’s a first glimpse at what’s in Store, including some incredible Mastercraft Bundles!
			[/td]		[/tr]	[/table]

[h3]Weapons Detail[/h3][h3]Primary Weapon: Krig C (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Assault Rifle, Battle Pass Page 3 HVT Tier Reward, Page 14 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/074c450a1be470ce6079b2466707e1eeaac7903d.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 43[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Reticle Unlocks, Weapon Camos, Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers 3).

[i]Full-auto assault rifle. High damage and average handling. Recoil pattern starts very controllable before ramping up.[/i]

For a hard-hitting, versatile Assault Rifle that performs well across multiple ranges, look no further than the Krig C. The weapon inflicts moderate damage across the whole body with a four-shot elimination within its effective range. Recoil control becomes shakier through sustained fire, so burst fire to retain accuracy or consider attachments offering improved control to help counter the ramped-up movement.
[h3]Primary Weapon: Saug (Launch)[/h3]
[b][i]SMG, Battle Pass Page 3 HVT Tier Reward, Page 11 Battle Pass Blueprint[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a285828bd267de3081e75679eb8bd43573c48332.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 39[/b]

[b]MAGS: 4[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 36[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Reticle Unlocks, Weapon Camos, Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers 3).

[i]Fully automatic submachine gun. Excellent mobility and good handling. Great rate of fire. High recoil.[/i]

Pepper your enemies with a hailstorm of lead using this rapid-fire SMG that’s perfect for breaching and clearing small spaces. The Saug kicks up like a horse when fired down sights; pull down when aiming to counter the recoil or better yet improve the weapon’s already great hip-fire capabilities with the appropriate attachments, including the Tactical Laser for a killer combo of mobility and accuracy via Tactical Stance. Or go all out on hip-fire with the Akimbo Saug Stock for unmatched SMG firepower.
[h3]Primary Weapon: Maelstrom (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[b][i]Shotgun, Event Reward[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/87e29f42d0621e767bd6e80b57e79b6daae09643.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 34[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 10[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Reticle Unlocks, Weapon Camos, Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers 3).

[i]Fully automatic shotgun. Good range and handling. High recoil and large hip spread.[/i]

What this weapon lacks in power compared to the other Shotguns, it makes up for with its rapid-fire full-auto capabilities. Its heavy recoil and large hip spread require getting up close to the enemy, but within its effective range it’s devastating. Consider equipping the Overkill Wildcard to pair this shotgun with a mid-range weapon for greater versatility. When moving into tight spaces, swap to the full-auto Shotgun and let loose.
[h3]Primary Weapon: AMR Mod 4 (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[b][i]Sniper Rifle, Event Reward[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d336635858134007dfab0f83b8f5de122db23abe.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 38[/b]

[b]MAGS: 4[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 6[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Stock Pad, Magazine, Rear Grip, Comb, Laser, Fire Mods

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Reticle Unlocks, Weapon Camos, Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers 3).

[i]Semi-auto sniper rifle. One-shot kill to torso, arms, hands, and upper legs. Very high recoil and slow rate of fire. You can steady your aim while ADSing.[/i]

The hardest hitting weapon in its class, this sniper rifle rewards patience with a huge one-shot elimination range across the upper body. It’s slow to aim and it kicks hard, but when the shot connects, say goodbye to the enemy. Inflicting major damage out to 100 meters, its selection of closer ranged optics also offers the possibility of fighting in the vanguard, a veritable frontline cannon.
[h3]Secondary Weapon: Sirin 9mm (In-Season)[/h3]
[b][i]Special Event Reward[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5f15ffebd1277270610a904e6319573c324d2899.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30[/b]

[b]MAGS: 3[/b]

[b]MAG SIZE: 32[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]Optic, Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins, Reticle Unlocks Weapon Camos, Accessories (1), Decals (1), Stickers 2).

[i]Fully automatic specialty weapon. Offers SMG characteristics as a secondary weapon. Slow rate of fire.[/i]

Take your Secondary Weapon game to the next level with this foldable Secondary Weapon offering full-auto fire with a slow and steady fire rate to help you stay on target up to the mid-range. Its base configuration offers 32 rounds to keep you in the fight during sustained combat, with an Extended Mag option that pushes that number to 40. The weapon has a moderate kick after each shot fired, but several of its attachments offer improved recoil control to help counter the movement. Once unlocked, look for this weapon in the new “Special” category within Secondary Weapons.
[h3]Melee Weapon: Power Drill (In-Season)[/h3]
[b][i]Melee, Event Reward[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/99c75a1526458ce6f39b095a17e672376a3fcac8.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]None

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins.

[i]Two-hit kill. Very short range. Very fast attack speed.[/i]

There’s no better tool for the job than the Power Drill, offering a rapid attack speed for quick follow-up hits to get the job done. Including a mix of sweeps, jabs, uppercuts, and a heavy attack that drills straight on, this weapon is ideal for putting a hole in the competition when the going gets tough.
[h3]Melee Weapon: Cleaver (Mid-Season)[/h3]
[b][i]Melee, Event Reward[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4d3e176d796ea174365b0708aae55f0cc139e0e7.jpg[/img]

[b]Levels: 30[/b]

[b]Mastery Badges: Yes[/b]

[b]Attachments: [/b]None

[b]Customize Options:[/b] Skins.

[i]One-hit kill. Short-medium range. Medium attack speed.[/i]

Featuring a combo of sweeping attacks and head-on strikes, the Cleaver is the perfect Melee weapon for clearing out multiple and single targets in enclosed spaces. Use its heavy attack to prep the strike when anticipating incoming enemies, taking them to the chopping block the moment they appear.
[h3]New: Special Weapon Attachments[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9596772ae2ca68cb684fabaf9bd3c2d97f8a4cb0.jpg[/img]
[h3]12 Gauge Dragon’s Breath (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Shotguns, Fire Mod, Battle Pass Page 7 Reward[/i]

Add some heat to your Shotgun blasts with incendiary rounds comprised of magnesium sparks that stick to and burn enemies over time. Equipping the 12 Gauge Dragon’s Breath Fire Mod prevents using Barrel Attachments, but the tradeoff is well worth it when seeking a fiery finish.
[h3]Buffer Weight Stock (In-Season)[/h3]
[i]XM4 Assault Rifle, XMG LMG, DM-10 Marksman Rifle, Stock Attachment, Event Reward[/i]

The heavier Buffer Weight Stock provides significantly smoother action through the additional resistance met by the bolt carrier group. The improvement results in more manageable recoil through sustained fire, ideal for staying on target though at the expense of ADS Speed and Aim Walk Movement Speed.
[h3]Burst Fire Conversion (In-Season)[/h3]
[i]XM4 Assault Rifle, Fire Mod, Event Reward[/i]

Convert the XM4 Assault Rifle’s primary firing mode into a three-round burst to help conserve ammo and stay on target. There’s an impressive lack of recoil too, so it’s still possible to pump out consistent damage when facing heavy threats.
[h3]Burst Fire Conversion (In-Season)[/h3]
[i]Kompakt 92 SMG, Fire Mod, Event Reward[/i]

Convert the Kompakt 92 SMG’s primary firing mode into an exceptionally rapid three-round burst. Equipping the Burst Fire Conversion Fire Mod locks the Underbarrel and Barrel Attachment slots. When you need to fire quickly in close quarters, hold down the trigger to automatically cycle through burst shots.
[h3]Weapons Access: Feature: The Armory (Launch)[/h3]
[i]Global System: MP, ZM, WZ[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/790ccdab2f28a93f0f9f6bf3febb8789ede1eac6.jpg[/img]

Coming to [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] at the start of Season 01 is the Armory, easily accessible from your Barracks > Challenges menu. Like in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Armory is a repository that provides access to previously missed Loadout content from prior Battle Passes and Events. Activate an item in the Armory to start earning XP toward unlocking it.

The Armory is unlocked at Player Level 24 and is added to the Level Unlock Menu. It is an area to check on items that otherwise cannot be earned through normal weapon progression. For example, if you miss the chance to obtain one of the Season 01 weapons unlocked via an Event, it is likely to be available to earn after the Event concludes.

For [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] players [u]only[/u], the Armory enables you to earn XP to unlock any weapon from [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] and [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] that you missed, including all Seasonal Battle Pass weapons and Challenge weapons, as well as [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] Armory-exclusive attachments, and Aftermarket Parts. You can then employ these in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].
[h3]Season 01 Events[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f0301c36b7d81896a566ff23fd67431232706d48.jpg[/img]

Events are back and provide some of the finest cosmetic loot to unlock! As the first part of the Season is truncated (with Season 01 Reloaded and a wealth of new content arriving in early December), expect the Hit List Event prior to Mid-Season. Once Season 01 Reloaded arrives, expect multiple Events to look forward to – including one focused on Zombies – during the latter half of the Season.
[h3]Event: Hit List (In-Season)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/358ce9103592e2df82e0df9a8e2c247bc9462b5c.jpg[/img]

Who’s next? Keep up your luxurious – but slightly corrupt – lifestyle during the Hit List Event. You’re offered up a take-no-prisoners mission: kill or be killed. The Hit List Limited Event gives players a board of contracts with one goal – take them all out. Cross off the entire list and earn some exclusive loot for hire.
[h3]Season 01 Master Prestige Menu[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b3b8814e18b1755cc9e772f221d0b83f8a8777fc.jpg[/img]

At Season launch, expect an additional in-game menu, visible and accessible to all, called “Master Prestige,” appearing next to the Prestige Menu when you locate it within the Barracks. This showcases some of the rewards available to the dedicated legends who are making the final grind to Level 1,000! This is where you’ll go to check out rewards as they are obtained, as well as viewing the legacy Prestige emblems you accrue every 100 levels!
[h3]Brand-new Battle Pass System and BlackCell[/h3][h3]Operator Sev Headlines the New and Improved Battle Pass[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/26556651fd3e04ddaeec2055b66b0faa12021792.jpg[/img]

Trained assassin, espionage expert, and key Rogue Black Ops player from the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Campaign, Sevati “Sev” Dumas headlines the brand-new Season 01 Battle Pass with four different Skins to unlock! Purchase the Battle Pass Bundle for 2,400 COD Points to immediately unlock the Instant Rewards Page of the Battle Pass, with the following items:
[list]	[*]10% Battle Pass XP Boost[/*]	[*]The “Bloom Boomer” Frag Grenade Skin[/*]	[*]The “Thorn” Legendary Blueprint for the Tanto .22 SMG.[/*]	[*]The “Rose Goes” Legendary Weapon Sticker.[/*]	[*]The “Sev” Skin (and Sev Operator), along with the “Sev BlackCell” Skin for those that purchase BlackCell.[/*][/list][h3]Turning the Page: The Season 01 Battle Pass Expanded Overview[/h3]
The Season 01 [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Battle Pass is brimming over with content, which is both showcased and unlocked in a brand-new “Page” system. Think of the Battle Pass as a book, with two front pages of Instant Rewards (one BlackCell), then 100 in-game Battle Pass rewards across 14 Pages and a Completion Page that is instantly unlocked once all other Pages are completed. Pages include Free and Paid content. As always, all Base Weapons are free to unlock.
[h3]Starting Your Battle Pass Journey: Page 1[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ce25e92f8c7d77b6ba96b87ec1c66e5a19db9cd5.jpg[/img]

As you start your new Battle Pass journey, the Instant Reward Page and Page 1 is unlocked by default. All the other Pages are locked but can be previewed. Your goal is to complete the Battle Pass and access the 100 percent Completion Page at the end of the Battle Pass.

Each Page contains a slight variation on the following:
[list]	[*]Around six item rewards (known as “Tiers”) that are unlocked in any order you wish within the Page. Each requires an earned Battle Token to unlock.[/*]	[*]Each Page contains two free Tier rewards. The rest are unlocked via purchasing the Battle Pass Bundle or BlackCell.[/*]	[*]An “HVT” (High Value Target) Tier reward that is unlocked once the previous items are unlocked. This is usually an Operator Skin or Weapon Blueprint, and sometimes there’s a BlackCell variant.[/*]	[*]When both the regular and HVT Tiers are unlocked (usually a total of seven Tiers), the Page is complete.[/*]	[*]Battle Pass owners can elect to automatically or manually unlock reward item Tiers as they reach them.[/*][/list][h3]Battle Tokens: Unlocking a Page[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5c25a3b70c131d05e434fe8f187538c3a52b0b6b.jpg[/img]

Battle Tokens return to the Battle Pass and work in a similar way to those in previous Battle Passes. A Token Bank is displayed in the top-right corner of your Battle Pass. These are used to unlock the 100 individual reward Tiers across all 14 Pages.
[list]	[*]You spend these Tokens on any available Tier reward on an unlocked Page.[/*]	[*]You can automatically unlock Tier rewards as you play, and not store up any earned Tokens. Players without the Battle Pass earn rewards in a linear order and have no access to Tokens.[/*]	[*]Or you can earn Battle Tokens and Claim Tiers and manually unlock Pages later in the Battle Pass (only available if you purchase the Battle Pass or BlackCell offering).[/*]	[*]Earning five total Tier rewards on a single page unlocks the next Page in the Battle Pass, meaning you don’t have to complete a single Page to access the next Page.[/*]	[*]This means you can choose to claim Tier rewards on the current or any new Page.[/*]	[*]Every subsequent Page requires five further total Tiers to be unlocked from any unlocked Page. The number of Tiers required to unlock each Page is displayed on that Page.[/*][/list][h3]Unlocking Later Pages[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bed63f35eab4b8a407a06ac1d010f8eda71add5f.jpg[/img]

If there are specific Tiers you’re particularly interested in unlocking, you simply need to accrue enough Battle Tokens to unlock the Page and its Tier content.
[list]	[*]For example, if you have BlackCell and 20 Tokens, and Page 6 of the Battle Pass requires 18 more Tiers to unlock, you simply spend your Tokens to access the Page and choose the 18 Tier Rewards from Pages 1-6.[/*]	[*]Remember, there are seven total Tier reward unlocks per Page, but only five Tiers are needed to unlock each Page. This means you can save some Tokens for future Pages.[/*]	[*]BlackCell owners receive an added Bonus of being able to unlock any Battle Pass Page and start unlocking Tier Rewards on that Page.[/*][/list][h3]Crammed with Content: The Season 01 Battle Pass[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e93ff90961a044f7dbe5625c3efd17759c9574a2.jpg[/img]

Prior to a Battle Pass, BlackCell and Bundles Blog prior to Season 01 Launch where all the incredible Battle Pass content is revealed, expect the following types of content, including new types of rewards:
[list]	[*]Over 110 pieces of unlockable content (excluding BlackCell).[/*]	[*]Over 130 pieces of unlockable content (including BlackCell).[/*]	[*]Two free Base Weapons:	[list]		[*]The Saug SMG (Page 3 HVT Tier Reward)[/*]		[*]The Krig C Assault Rifle (Page 6 HVT Tier Reward)[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Sev Operator with four different Skins (Operator unlock and “Spycraft” and “Spycraft BlackCell” Skin in the Instant Reward Page, as well as “Opulent” and “Opulent BlackCell Skins in the Completion Page)[/*]	[*]New Operator Skins for Bayan (+BC), Maya, Bailey (+BC), Carver (+BC), Alvarez (+BC), Nazir, Stone (+BC), Rossi, and Niran.[/*]	[*]Rewards in the following categories:	[list]		[*]COD Points[/*]		[*]Weapon Blueprints (Primary, Secondary, Melee)[/*]		[*]Weapon Attachments[/*]		[*]Weapon Reticles[/*]		[*]Weapon Charms[/*]		[*]Weapon Decals[/*]		[*]Weapon Stickers[/*]		[*]Equipment Skins[/*]		[*]GobbleGums[/*]		[*]Operators[/*]		[*]Operator Skins[/*]		[*]Finishing Moves[/*]		[*]Emblems[/*]		[*]Calling Cards[/*]		[*]Emotes[/*]		[*]Sprays[/*]		[*]Loading Screens[/*]		[*]Clan Tags (BlackCell only)[/*]		[*]Consumable 2XP Tokens[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][h3]BlackCell Offerings and Vault Edition Upgrade[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e425d9a3fb006f9cc460139d36e5f00dc205ab4b.jpg[/img]

Join the molten, crystalized skull-headed Goliath as he stalks the epic Season 01 BlackCell content. Featuring an animated Operator Skin with writhing flames across his onyx carapace armor, this orange-hued demon favors brutal blades and swift deaths. Goliath is part of an impressive BlackCell offering that brings the fire, including Operators clad in black with a fiery orange accent hue.

BlackCell owners can access the Season 01 Battle Pass via the exclusive BlackCell Page, instantly unlocking the following items:
[list]	[*]20 Tier Skips.[/*]	[*]1,100 COD Points.[/*]	[*]The “Boiling Point” Mastercraft Blueprint for the Goblin Mk2 (Assault Rifle).[/*]	[*]The “Who’s Laughing Now” Finishing Move with Pet Hyena.[/*]	[*]The “BlackCell” Clan Tag (showcased in Lobbies and Winner’s Circles).[/*]	[*]The “Goliath” BlackCell Operator.[/*][/list]
Additionally, BlackCell owners can expect to access page after page of additional exclusive rewards within the Season 01 Battle Pass. These include:
[list]	[*]Seven BlackCell-exclusive skins for Sev (two Skins), Bayan, Bailey, Carver, Alvarez, and Stone.[/*]	[*]Six BlackCell-exclusive Weapon Blueprints; for the XM4 (Assault Rifle), Marine SP (Shotgun), Tsarkov 7.62 (Marksman Rifle), GPMG-7 (LMG), Saug (SMG), Krig C (Assault Rifle).[/*]	[*]BlackCell Page Unlock: The ability to unlock any Page from the Battle Pass, ignoring the usual minimum Tier requirements. From here, you can unlock the Tiers within that Page, and progress forwards (or backwards) from the Page providing the subsequent Tier unlock criteria is met. Or you can progress from the start of the Battle Pass Page 1 as normal.[/*]	[*]NEW: Exclusive access to BlackCell-themed rewards available during Season 01 Events, offering you earnable content throughout the Season.[/*]	[*]Over 130 item rewards (Battle Pass and BlackCell related) for those who fully complete the Season 01 BlackCell Battle Pass.[/*][/list]
As usual, players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.
[h3]Vault Edition Upgrade[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4d0404e1daa050748171c605e943753a4b3a8065.jpg[/img]

If you’re considering an upgrade to the Black Ops 6 Vault Edition, this is the time to do it! For the same price as the BlackCell offering ($30 or your regional equivalent), the Vault Edition entitles you to the very same Season 01 BlackCell offering, along with the following:
[list]	[*]The Hunters vs. Hunted Operator Pack featuring skins and accessible Operators for Adler, Park, Brutus, and Klaus.[/*]	[*]The Mastercraft Weapon Collection (five weapons)[/*]	[*]The GobbleGum Pack (12 single-use consumables)[/*][/list]
[b]Note for Prestige Players:[/b] Any Weapon Blueprint and Equipment Skin you unlock in the Battle Pass becomes fully unlockable, does not re-lock when you subsequently Prestige, and a Permanent Unlock is not required to access it. Be sure to check out the Battle Pass, BlackCell and Bundles Blog prior to Season 01 Launch for the specific content available!
[h3]Operators[/h3]
The following four Operators are dropping into Season 01, and accessible via the Operators menu once acquired.
[h3]Goliath (BlackCell, Rogue Black Ops, Launch)[/h3]
[i]“Goliath” Skin: BlackCell Instant Reward Page[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/77086b42682c0fe0a323d2dc801663d8c0fbaa51.jpg[/img]

Solidify your fiery combat mastery as the molten man of fire himself, Goliath! All biographical information for this Operator has been [[REDACTED]].
[h3]Sevati “Sev” Dumas (Battle Pass, Rogue Black Ops, Launch)[/h3]
[i]“Spycraft” and “Masquerade” Skins: Battle Pass Instant Reward Page, Battle Pass Completion Page[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fb91dc68aeef25d581f92218d16293d892841627.jpg[/img]

[i]“It’s all about influence and control.”[/i] – Sevati “Sev” Dumas

A main player in the Rogue Team after the conclusion of the Campaign, Sev is ready to make a deal with the untrustworthy French Syndicate and is gearing up to take down the rival Luttazzi family to prove it. Sporting two different Skins depending on the infiltration mission at hand, Sev is more than ready to lead the charge.
[h3]The Replacer (Bundle, Rogue Black Ops, In-Season)[/h3]
[i]Store Bundle[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d8ffc65c5bcd3c8c529902f173380402bffc405e.jpg[/img]

[i]“I’m your daddy now.”[/i] – The Replacer

There’s no substitute for greatness. Last seen in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 4’s[/i] Blackout mode, and first appearing in [i]Black Ops 2[/i], The Replacer has concluded his whirlwind [i]Black Ops 6[/i] takeover tour and has freed up some time to appear in-game, and available as a Store Bundle shortly after Launch.
[h3]Competitor CDL Home and Away Operators (Bundle, Rogue Black Ops, Crimson One, In-Season)[/h3]
[i]Store Bundles[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7eab4b21477c4c7f140d8769274762746da25709.jpg[/img]

[i]“Is this a skill issue?”[/i] – CDL Home Competitor

[i]“You’re chalked, bro!”[/i] – CDL Away Competitor

Two new Operators arrive just in time for the 2025 Call of Duty League® season, and both are available (along with a host of other content including a Weapon Camo) in the CDL Store Bundle. The first available Bundle includes the “2025 CDL Home” “Competitor” Operator (Rogue Black Ops), and the “2025 CDL Away” “Competitor” Operator (Crimson One).

Access either of the Competitor Operators to find the location where a variety of incoming Operator Skins will become available, once earned. Expect the following as Season 01 progresses:
[list]	[*][b]CDL Team Packs [/b]for the Atlanta Faze, Boston Breach, Carolina Royal Ravens, Los Angeles Guerrillas, Los Angeles Thieves, Miami Heretics, Minnesota Rokkr, Cloud9 New York, Vancouver Surge, Optic Texas, Toronto Ultra, and Vegas Falcons.[/*]	[*][b]Skins unlocked during Multiplayer Ranked Play [/b]for Challenge Wins, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Crimson, Iridescent, Top 250, and Seasonal World Champion.[/*]	[*][b]Skins unlocked during Warzone Ranked Play [/b]for Challenge Wins, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Crimson, Iridescent, Top 250, and Seasonal World Champion.[/*][/list][h3]New Store Offerings[/h3]
Gain a more complete knowledge about the in-store Bundles coming to Season 01 in the BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Bundles blog next week. Before then, here’s the first glimpse at the highlights we have in Store for you:

[i]The Replacer voiced by Peter Stormare[/i]

notes.title: New updates bring Infected and Classic Nuketown to Call of Duty: Black Ops 6
notes.notes:
[i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] is live, and players have been deploying in droves across the epic Campaign, Multiplayer, and Zombies game modes. In the first week after launch, two new updates pave the way for Season 01 and beyond with the addition of two Multiplayer favorites: the Infected game mode and the original 1950s Nuketown map.

[previewyoutube=t6ukMUq-iQQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The first content drop begins [u]right now[/u] starting with Infected, followed by the release of Nuketown on November 1. Here’s what you need to know:
[h3]Play Infected the Black Ops 6 Way[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd0f59abfeb50414656b9b9a92e9adfba948d27c.jpg[/img]

Infected makes its [i]Black Ops 6[/i] debut just in time for Halloween! With the new Omnimovement system in place, this Party Mode takes on a whole new life… for the living and the undead. Cheat death — or add to the undead ranks — with the most fluid movement mechanics to date.

For new and returning players, an Infected match begins with one player randomly assigned as the starting infected. The infected player’s goal is to eliminate all other players. Each time a survivor is eliminated, they will join the ranks of the undead, while the remaining survivors must keep the horde at bay until the match timer runs out.

Drop into the Infected playlist right now, live in [i]Black Ops 6[/i]!
[h3]Classic Nuketown Arrives November 1[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/accfa45c99394a7105aabce1d286dc2f078f3c7d.jpg[/img]

The original Nuketown is back! This homage to the version players first encountered in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops[/i] is an exact — though graphically much improved — version of the original, keeping the classic 1950s design of the Nevada testing site. For first-time Nuketowners and returning veterans alike, here’s the lay of the land:
[h2]The Streets of Nuketown[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c45631fa1c39601d996af5563f8712435bdad7d2.jpg[/img]

Built by Veteran Treyarch Map designer Adam Hoggatt and released as part of [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops[/i] in November 2010, this remaster remains extremely faithful to the original design and layout of the map, even down to the precise placement of parked vehicles and other scenery harking back to the original three-lane design. This is Nuketown in its most original form, with a bright and bleached desert landscape, and even a double rainbow to gaze at, taking you all the way back to where it all began.

Hoggatt gave a little more insight into this remastered version of his original creation. Although rumored to have been designed in just two days, it’s been a fan favorite for 14 years: "The original Nuketown has always been my favorite, mainly because of how it came about and how the studio rallied around it,” Hoggatt said. “Recently, it occurred to me that many of our current players have never experienced the original, so they get to feel the Nuketown magic for the first time.” But Hoggatt also expressed excitement for players familiar with the original map. “I'm excited that we are bringing back the original Nuketown exactly as you remember it but looking better than ever! Those players will definitely be hit with a big wave of nostalgia. I can't wait!"

[b]Nuketown for Dummies: A Tour of the Homes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/96540c9a4850bf86542b64a8f71758830a2a4a34.jpg[/img]

While most of the combat is centered around the bus and container truck, the interiors (and upper floors) of the opposing houses – recently installed after being constructed and shipped from nearby Area 99 – allow for a variety of excellent sightlines toward the opposing team’s spawn point. That is provided you’re not put off by the dead gaze of the plastic people inhabiting the cul-de-sac on the corner of Latchkey Road and Trinity Avenue.
[h2]Welcome to the Nuketown Neighborhood: Warhead, Area 99[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e93a4e047607937968f1a91bfbffcfa475b08086.jpg[/img]

Can’t get enough of the iconic location? Deploy to the Multiplayer launch Strike map Warhead to battle in vicinity of the infamous testing site via Face Off 6v6 or 2v2 Gunfight.

Warhead’s set of dwellings has been reclaimed by the desert sands. Watch the debris scattered all over the maps, with model homes and vehicles slowly sinking into the desert sands, and a colossal crater just out of bounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/14051a356ce9156e55e2163372c787ea0c873a45.jpg[/img]

And at the start of Season 01, deploy to the new Area 99 Resurgence map in the free-to-play [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i] update. Also set in the Nevada desert, this top-secret government site is just miles away from the original Nuketown location. See where it all began by exploring the mannequin assembly plant, the factory warehouse including pieces of the Nuketown homes in development, and much more, when Season 01 launches!

So… when is that, exactly?
[h3]Massive Content Drop: Season 01 Arrives on Thursday, November 14![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0d2f8d83a44717a86196cde7af14248d58149a75.jpg[/img]

Make sure your [i]Black Ops 6[/i] weapons are fully leveled up, and all your gear is unlocked and ready to go when Area 99 launches just over two weeks from now! Season 01 arrives on November 14, adding a colossal amount of free content like all-new Multiplayer maps and modes, a terrifying new in-season Zombies map, as well as the introduction of Omnimovement and [i]Black Ops 6[/i] weapons and Loadout features to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]!
[h3]Support Veterans with the Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Endeavour: Tracer Pack[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f175368b6afc024940c9650229e2ae291d503a07.jpg[/img]

Don’t miss out on your chance to support U.S. and U.K. military veterans by purchasing the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/endeavour]Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Endeavour: Tracer Pack[/url], inspired by real-life U.K. Special Forces Veterans, and founders of high-performance British outdoor apparel brand, [url=https://us.thrudark.com/?shpxid=b81ebb85-5777-448a-b6d9-862d4de23c64]ThruDark[/url].

The C.O.D.E. Endeavour: Tracer Pack is available now, including the “SC1” Operator Skin, “Ghostly Guile” LR 7.62 Animated Blueprint, “Seaworthy Strength” AMES 85 Animated Blueprint,  the “Not Alone” Weapon Charm, “Going Commando” Spray, “Dead of Night” Animated Emblem, “Feeling Froggy” Weapon Sticker, “Wolf of Metals” Animated Calling Card, the “Look Sharp” Finishing Move, and a Double XP and Double Weapon XP token.

Activision will contribute 100% of the net proceeds from every Endeavour: Tracer Pack purchased to the Call of Duty Endowment.

The C.O.D.E. Endeavour: Tracer Pack is available now at www.CallofDuty.com/Endeavour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/65a922cfd5fe6636e669ada678d79bc894670002.jpg[/img]

[b]THE ENDEAVOUR APPAREL COLLECTION[/b]

In case you missed it on the Call of Duty blog earlier this week, the in-game pack is launching alongside the Endowment’s first-ever limited edition apparel line exclusively available at ThruDark. Each piece is inspired by ThruDark’s founders’ time in the Royal Marines Commandos and the Special Forces (SBS) and comes with a free code for a Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Endeavour: Tracer Pack. While supplies last. Quantities limited. Check out the full collection at [url=http://www.thrudark.com/CallofDutyEndowment]www.ThruDark.com/CallofDutyEndowment[/url] today.

[b]USAA GIVEAWAY[/b]

As a special thank you for their service, the Endowment and USAA are offering free C.O.D.E. Endeavour: Tracer Packs to U.S. military and veterans available now in Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6. To redeem, please visit [url=http://www.callofdutyendowment.org/usaa]www.callofdutyendowment.org/usaa[/url] for more information. While supplies last. Quantities limited. ID.me account required. See official rules [url=http://callofdutyendowment.com/sweepstakes]here[/url]. 

[b]ABOUT THE CALL OF DUTY ENDOWMENT[/b]

The Endowment has placed more than 130,000 veterans in jobs since 2009. That’s equal to 23 vets placed per day over the last 14 years, creating more than $7 billion in economic value for U.S. and U.K. veterans and their families. Last year, the average cost to place a veteran in a job was $618, about 1/19th the cost per placement of U.S. government’s efforts.

For more information about the Call of Duty Endowment, visit the website or explore more on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@callofdutyendowment]TikTok[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/callofdutyendowment/?hl=en]Instagram[/url], [url=https://x.com/CODE4Vets]X (formerly Twitter)[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/CallofDutyEndowment]Facebook[/url].
[h3]#CODBlog: Stay Tuned for Season 01 Info[/h3]
Keep ahead of the competition, and Trust No One except the latest official [i]Black Ops 6[/i] information from the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog]Call of Duty Blog[/url] as we near the Season 01 announcement, breaking down all the new maps, modes, weapons, features, and more across Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].

notes.title: Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 accessibility updates and new features
notes.notes:
[h2]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 Accessibility Updates and New Features[/h2]
Making [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] more accessible makes it easier for more players to jump into the game, which is why innovating and introducing accessibility options across Call of Duty has always been a priority. The accessibility settings menu is accessed by nearly half of all players, and with the launch of [i]Black Ops 6[/i], we’re excited to share even more accessibility updates and new features which will allow players to further customize their experience.

In [i]Black Ops 6[/i], we’re launching asymmetrical hearing compensation, an improved high contrast mode, updating the accessibility settings menu, and more. All the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/ca/en/blog/2023/12/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-iii-new-accessibility-features-update#CONTRAST]familiar accessibility features[/url] that were available in [i]Modern Warfare® III [/i]will also be available in [i]Black Ops 6[/i], like graphical adjustment options to reduce motion blur and joystick setting options. Read on for more info on new accessibility updates and features coming to [i]Black Ops 6[/i].
[h3]Introducing Asymmetrical Hearing Compensation Settings[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fcbebbf995270c50f6c2175cf92fe087d9cd8575.jpg[/img]

[i]Black Ops 6[/i] is proud to be the first Call of Duty game to launch asymmetrical hearing compensation settings, which allows players with asymmetrical hearing loss to create a custom audio profile and adjust audio settings for each ear. Created with veterans and players with hearing loss in mind, asymmetrical hearing compensation audio settings will now be individually customizable for each ear. In addition to the new asymmetrical hearing compensation settings, [i]Black Ops 6[/i] will continue to support the option for players to “Reduce Tinnitus Sound,” which replaces sounds made from Concussion and Flash Grenades with a duller sound.
[h3]Customizable High Contrast Settings[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4f7ddb42f09c339f7c525b90cf67767fdbc62fe4.jpg[/img]

High Contrast Mode was first introduced in [i]Modern Warfare III [/i]in Campaign only, giving players the option to highlight allies and enemies during gameplay. In [i]Black Ops 6[/i], High Contrast Mode has been expanded and advanced and is now available in both Campaign and Zombies. Players will now be able to customize the color outline of allies and enemies, allowing players with vision impairment and color blindness to tailor their player experience even more. Players will also be able to enable a “Dark Background” setting in High Contrast Mode, which further adds contrast from the background elements to assist with low vision.
[h3]Intelligent Movement[/h3]
Newly introduced in [i]Black Ops 6[/i], Intelligent Movement allows players to customize four elements for how Operators move through the landscape. The suite of customizable movement includes Sprint Assist, Mantle Assist, Crouch Assist, and Corner Slice, which may help players with mobility issues reduce inputs by allowing options to minimize and customize button and stick processes. Read more about Movement in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides/blackops6/training/call-of-duty-guides-black-ops-6-multiplayer-training-movement#Intelligent]here[/url].
[h3]HUD Presets[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/820ac4ed77ce2b68413ce3fedd1b6dd30653cb57.jpg[/img]

Another newly introduced feature in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] is the ability to adjust your gameplay HUD with a variety of Layout presets, as well as color adjustment options for your minimap.

Layouts give players options to customize the HUD for optimal playing. For players who wish to reduce visual clutter or find that checking the minimap takes their eyes away from enemies, try the Target Tracker or Central Command presets. Play around and experiment with whichever preset works best for your play.
[h3]Arachnophobia Settings[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d051ca0f844fa76ef228f77c7960197758e3e6bf.jpg[/img]

For the first time in [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]Zombies, a new arachnophobia toggle feature will be available. This setting will allow players to change the appearance of spider-like enemies in Zombies without affecting their game play.
[h3]Pause and Save in Zombies[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ca99aeda9c6ecf0d6f5bc0a9b3a1de593b6dd8ab.jpg[/img]

Also newly arriving to [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]Zombies is the ability in Solo matches to pause, save, and load into games (while in full health). With the return of Round-Based Zombies, gameplay is guaranteed to be fast-paced and intense, so providing the ability to pause or save a Solo game and return later can make all the difference in gameplay for some players.
[h2]Accessories[/h2]
Both the Xbox Adaptive Controller and Sony Access Controller will work out of the box with [i]Black Ops 6[/i].

Jump into the game on October 25<sup>th</sup> and explore all the accessibility features and updates. 
[h2]Get the Latest on Black Ops 6 and More[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/77a11ba6cff827e1d80840e4ad1ac95009d9329d.jpg[/img]

Stay one step ahead with the latest official [i]Black Ops 6[/i] information by checking the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog]Call of Duty Blog[/url] frequently as we approach the October 25 launch date.

[i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] is published by Activision. Development for the game is led by Treyarch, in partnership with Raven Software. Additional development support provided (in alphabetical order) by Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Infinity Ward, and Sledgehammer Games. 

The Truth Lies.

This in-game content features the Endowment’s first ever U.K. operator skin. With a combined 28 years of military experience the pair personally design, develop and test each piece of ThruDark apparel to the most rigorous of standards.

The pack includes a ThruDark insignia Weapon Charm, Weapon Sticker, Spray and more. Visit [url=http://www.callofduty.com/endeavour]www.callofduty.com/endeavour[/url] to purchase the pack on Friday at 10AM PT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c38e0cd642e531281c03f1300549e25a1d05c2ec.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Progression preparation: What to unlock in Black Ops 6, part 2
notes.notes:
[h3]Earning Calling Cards[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/673bbcee3f18e802392793c481294cb7eed7c789.jpg[/img]

Calling Cards and their corresponding Challenges are grouped into categories, and each category has multiple sets of Calling Cards to earn and complete. Complete a Challenge set by earning every individual Calling Card in the set to obtain the Animated Mastery Calling Card for that set.
[h3]Prestige Challenges[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/78d9dad33a6f4b52712039f6330082225be89903.jpg[/img]

Career and Battle Hardened are not the only Calling Card Challenge categories in each mode available at launch: players who Prestige will also gain access to an additional Challenge set for Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] (Season 01) each time they enter a new Prestige.

With 10 Prestiges and Prestige Master, that means an additional 11 Challenge sets to complete in each mode for players dedicated enough to make it to Prestige Master.
[h3]Dark Ops Challenges[/h3]
It wouldn’t be a Black Ops game without Dark Ops Calling Card Challenges! Not seen in a Call of Duty since [i]Black Ops Cold War[/i], these involve tasks so mysterious, the unlock criteria is [[REDACTED]] until you complete them! Are you up for the challenge to prove yourself worth of Dark Ops Mastery?

For the first time ever, Dark Ops Calling Cards will be present in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] (Season 01).

Earn the [[REDACTED]] number of Dark Ops Calling Cards in Multiplayer, Zombies, Campaign, or Call of Duty: Warzone (Season 01) and you’ll earn Dark Ops Mastery for that mode.
[h3]100 Percenter Cards[/h3]
Challenge chasers will be pleased to know that “100 Percenter” completion Animated Calling Cards will be available in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] at launch for Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. The Challenge grind is real this year, and if you’re dedicated enough to complete every Calling Card Challenge in a given mode, you’ll earn that mode’s “100 Percenter” Card for the ultimate bragging rights.

NOTE: Only Career, Battle Hardened, and Prestige Challenges count towards 100 Percent Complete. Dark Ops Calling Cards do not count towards 100%.

Prove your dedication and mettle with friends and foes alike. Make sure you add your three favorite Calling Cards to your Showcase as part of your Player Profile in the Social menu.
[h3]Calling Card Reward Highlights[/h3]
With over 450 Calling Cards to unlock via Challenges, expect a huge variety to unlock and show off in your Profile. Here’s a selection:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d290c4c1bb9e0fc08ee54f38adca34773109a504.jpg[/img]

A showcase of Calling Cards from [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dbbe9417828151c2a43a8119ce5c2a4337f4fd5c.jpg[/img]

A showcase of Calling Cards from [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Zombies.
[h2]Weapon Camos[/h2]
[i]Global System (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i]

[i]Weapons > Loadouts > Gunsmith > Cosmetics[/i]
[h3]Weapon Camos: System Overview[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b7699d3c2768d37dbc26729c73b7b5b557f1e70e.jpg[/img]

The Weapon Camo system has been overhauled in [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. Inspired by Headshot-based Camo Challenges in past Black Ops games, with a mix of elements from modern Camo Systems you’re familiar with, the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Camo journey removes many of the barriers that interrupted the flow of earning Camos in past games. The result is a streamlined and meaningful Camo journey for each Weapon. Also, for the first time ever, [i]Call of Duty: [/i][i]Warzone[/i] will have its own dedicated Camo journey with unique Camos and Challenges only available to unlock in [i]Call of Duty: [/i][i]Warzone[/i] (in Season 01).
[h3]No Weapon Leveling Needed[/h3]
Unlocking Weapon Camos in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] is accessible from the moment you get your hands on a weapon; no Weapon Leveling required. Earn Camos at your own pace without any barriers.
[h3]Unlocking Weapon Camos[/h3]
Each Weapon’s quest for the final Mastery Camo – Dark Matter (MP), Nebula (ZM), and Abyss (WZ) -- is broken down into three steps:
[h3]Step 1: Military Camos[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/db2165e6881e2c10b744679788a0050da821762a.jpg[/img]

Each Weapon’s Camo journey begins with nine Military Camos that are unlocked sequentially by reaching progressive milestones in each mode. For [i]most[/i] weapons, these are progressed by earning:

[b]Multiplayer: [/b]Headshots

[b]Zombies:[/b] Critical Kills

[b]Call of Duty:[/b] [b]Warzone:[/b] Eliminations

This means that in Multiplayer, just earning Headshots with a Weapon will progress through and unlock the 9 named Military Camos:

[b]Granite:[/b] 5 Headshots required.

[b]Woodland:[/b] 10 Headshots required.

[b]Savanna:[/b] 15 Headshots required.

[b]Splinter:[/b] 20 Headshots required.

[b]Moss:[/b] 30 Headshots required.

[b]Shade:[/b] 40 Headshots required.

[b]Digital:[/b] 50 Headshots required.

[b]Tide:[/b] 75 Headshots required.

[b]Red Tiger:[/b] 100 Headshots required.

Military Camos must be unlocked individually per weapon. For example, if you’ve unlocked the first Multiplayer Military Camo (Granite) for the AMES 85, it can be equipped to the AMES 85 (in MP, ZM, or WZ), but not to any other weapon until you’ve separately unlocked Granite with that weapon.
[h3]Step 2: Special Camos[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2b669b5d543e1d36c6652379a3ba3cb55e0b7b78.jpg[/img]

Complete all nine Military Camos for a Weapon in your mode of choice, and the next step in the journey is Special Camos! Each Weapon has two unique Special Camo Swatches per mode that can only be earned with that weapon only. Special Camos can be unlocked in any order once you’ve gained access to them, and each has a different unlock criteria, usually related to the strengths or playstyle of the Weapon you’re progressing.
[h3]Special Camos: Equip to Any Weapon[/h3]
Once unlocked, Special Camos are universal and can be equipped to any weapon, [i]as long as[/i] that new weapon has completed the Military Camos and unlocked access to the Special Category in at least one mode. It can then be fitted with any Special Camo you like and used in any game mode you like.
[h3]Step 3: Mastery Camos[/h3]
With Military Camos and both Special Camos unlocked for a specific weapon, your Weapon Camo grind enters its final phase: Mastery Camos! As previously revealed, [i]Black Ops 6[/i] has four Mastery Camos available to be earned in each mode: Multiplayer, Zombies, and – for the first time ever – Call of Duty: Warzone (in Season 01). Here’s a look at each set:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6148e3e570f80a0f4f31d1d113815345541fd442.jpg[/img]

[b]Multiplayer Mastery Camo:[/b] Gold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d0e64f6ee849034f5ef50059425e89b637e55145.jpg[/img]

[b]Multiplayer Mastery Camo:[/b] Diamond.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4c26bff165ac96cee2a2cc8e8d385f4ec7224e52.jpg[/img]

[b]Multiplayer Mastery Camo:[/b] Dark Spine (Animated).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6c89cfb3415eb292ea5ffb9843d22c9fff498342.jpg[/img]

[b]Multiplayer Mastery Camo:[/b] Dark Matter (Animated, Dynamic).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/af7070a06aac4a677bff92aa1747a6d7c2778ba8.jpg[/img]

[b]Zombies Mastery Camo:[/b] Mystic Gold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f884de99835747e7915ab8ed50393c15960ba947.jpg[/img]

[b]Zombies Mastery Camo:[/b] Opal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5163df2a203da4eb87cfd1a8c15b214d50db3656.jpg[/img]

[b]Zombies Mastery Camo:[/b] Afterlife (Animated).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3d91726024e7159ca43643149926040704aae06a.jpg[/img]

[b]Zombies Mastery Camo:[/b] Nebula (Animated, Dynamic).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9fa73362c13b3400538e269551f35a30dc5547dd.jpg[/img]

[b]Call of Duty: Warzone Mastery Camo:[/b] Gold Tiger.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c3d6575e3c2ad935b22400bd1c966d8d9466ff97.jpg[/img]

[b]Call of Duty: Warzone Mastery Camo:[/b] King’s Ransom (Animated).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ab263d8dc8d73d16593943a95a8d09ee7628e90e.jpg[/img]

[b]Call of Duty: Warzone Mastery Camo:[/b] Catalyst (Animated)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5f7972263639bad07340bc1bf6183251806e148.jpg[/img]

[b]Call of Duty: Warzone Mastery Camo:[/b] Abyss (Animated, Dynamic).

[b]Dynamic Mastery Camos: [/b]For the first time in Call of Duty, the final Mastery Camo in each mode has dynamic elements that change as you fire your weapon for maximum visual impact.
[h3]How to Unlock Mastery Camos[/h3]
Mastery Camos require full participation in the Camo System to access and unlock.
[h3]Mastery Camo Tier 1: Gold (Multiplayer), Mystic Gold (Zombies) & Gold Tiger (Call of Duty: Warzone)[/h3]
Access by earning all nine Military Camos and two Special Camos in the corresponding mode, and then complete the applicable Camo Challenge.
[h3]Mastery Camo Tier 2: Diamond (Multiplayer), Opal (Zombies) & King’s Ransom (Call of Duty: Warzone)[/h3]
Access by earning Mastery Camo Tier 1 for the designated number of Weapons in one Weapon Class in the corresponding mode, and then complete the applicable Camo Challenge. For example, in Multiplayer players must earn Gold Camo on seven Assault Rifles before they gain access to the Diamond Camo Challenge on those Weapons.
[h3]Mastery Camo Tier 3: Dark Spine (Multiplayer), Afterlife (Zombies) & Catalyst (Call of Duty: Warzone)[/h3]
Access by earning Mastery Camo Tier 2 for the designated number of Weapons across multiple Weapon Classes in the corresponding mode, and then complete the applicable Camo Challenge. For example, a Multiplayer player must earn Diamond Camo on 33 Weapons (the number of launch Weapons in [i]Black Ops 6[/i]) before they gain access to the Dark Spin Camo Challenge on those Weapons.
[h3]Mastery Camo Tier 4: Dark Matter (Multiplayer), Nebula (Zombies) & Abyss (Call of Duty: Warzone)[/h3]
Access by earning Mastery Camo Tier 2 for the designated number of Weapons across multiple Weapon Classes in the corresponding mode, and then complete the applicable Camo Challenge. For example, a Multiplayer player must earn Dark Spine Camo on 33 Weapons (the number of launch Weapons in [i]Black Ops 6[/i]) before they gain access to the Dark Matter Camo Challenge on those Weapons.

Just like Military Camos, Mastery Camos must be unlocked individually with each Weapon and once unlocked can only be used with that Weapon. For example, if you’ve unlocked Gold Camo for the AMES 85, it can be equipped to the AMES 85 anywhere you use it, but not to any other weapon until you’ve separately unlocked Gold with that weapon.
[h2]Reticle Challenges[/h2]
[i]Global System (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i]

[i]Weapons > Loadouts > Gunsmith > Customize[/i]
[h3]Reticle Challenges: System Overview[/h3]
[b]Recap: [/b]The classic Call of Duty Reticle unlock system has returned! Not only are interchangeable Reticles back for every Optic Attachment in the Gunsmith, but there are robust customization and unlock challenges for them across all three modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/577869e8fd2fdd2f155569ccac45eaf07206df76.jpg[/img]

Reticle Customization and Challenges can be accessed within the Gunsmith. To gain access to Reticle Challenges and Customization, you must first equip an Optic Attachment to your Weapon. Once equipped with an Optic, head to the “Customize” tab in the Gunsmith and enter the “Reticles” menu. From here you’ll see your progress through 10 Reticles available in each Mode, as well as have access to any Reticle rewards you’ve acquired via other means.

There are 10 Reticles to unlock in each mode: Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] (in Season 01).

Each of an Optic’s available Reticle Unlocks can be unlocked by getting Kills while Aiming Down Sights in the applicable mode with the Optic equipped.

Reticle Challenges and Unlocks are bound to each individual Optic, not any specific Weapon. This means that you can make progress towards Reticles for your favorite Optic with any compatible Weapon. Whenever you’re using that Optic you’re progressing towards its next Reticle unlock.

Unlock a Reticle, and you can fix it to the compatible Optic anywhere it can be equipped in any mode. For example, if you unlock a Reticle from Zombies, and you prefer its look over all other Reticles, you can equip it to that Optic in Multiplayer and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] as you wish.

[b]Optic Availability Note:[/b] All weapons share Optics, but some weapons – like Sniper Rifles – have specialized Optics are only available for particular weapon types. Check your Optics lists in-game for all those that are available. Optics are available for all Primary Weapons and Pistols.
[h3]Reticle Highlights[/h3]
An impressive variety of Reticle colors and shapes are available for you to unlock, and the following is a showcase of available Reticles:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b000ae50232df02d1fd6776854c7eda7f334e38d.jpg[/img]

A selection of Optic Reticles you can unlock in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer and Zombies.
[h2]Mastery Badges[/h2][h2][i]Global System (MP, RBZ)[/i][/h2]
[i]Barracks > Challenges > Mastery Badges[/i]
[h3]Mastery Badges: System Overview[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/549cdd887096b6a4310d4592559cd4ab97a95643.jpg[/img]

Become an expert and showcase your proficiency with every type of Weapon, Equipment, Field Upgrade, and Scorestreaks by unlocking a series of Mastery Badges with each piece of gear as you play Multiplayer and Zombies in [i]Black Ops 6[/i].

Each Weapon and piece of Gear has its own Multiplayer and Zombies Mastery Badge journey, assuming the item appears in both modes. Show proficiency with a piece of content and you’ll begin progressing through its three Badge Tiers:
[list]	[*]Badge I (Bronze)[/*]	[*]Badge II (Silver)[/*]	[*]Mastery Badge (Gold + Stat Tracker)[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e84544a4a10ad69988420ad3e9777be2839de987.jpg[/img]

Badges are progressed by being successful with each piece of equipment. Here are some examples of how different types of Badges are progressed in Multiplayer:
[list]	[*][b]Weapons: [/b]Get Eliminations with the Weapon[/*]	[*][b]Frag Lethal Equipment: [/b]Get Frag Kills[/*]	[*][b]Prox Alarm Tactical Equipment: [/b]Kill enemies detected by your Prox Alarms[/*]	[*][b]Trophy System: [/b]Intercept enemy Projectiles with your Trophy System[/*]	[*][b]RC-XD: [/b]Get RC-XD Kills[/*][/list]
[b]Mastery Badges Per Mode: [/b]Both Multiplayer and Zombies modes have their own set of Badges that are statistically tracked and unlocked for equipment available in both modes. For example, the Frag Grenade has a Multiplayer Badge track, and a Zombies Badge track. Earn each by using the Lethal Equipment in both modes.

Unlock the Mastery Badge for a piece of content and a Stat Trat tracker is added to the Badge, showing off how many times you’ve had success with that piece of content. Always wanted to let players know you’ve earned 10,000 Eliminations with your Weapon of choice? Now you can.
[h3]Category Mastery[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/364e9ad40d49fdea51c44a2d1ab855ea51796ba1.jpg[/img]

[b]Diamond Badge Upgrade and Category Mastery: [/b]Unlock the Mastery Badge for the required number of item types in each Badge Category and all Mastery Badges will automatically receive a Diamond Badge Upgrade (with a healthy XP Bonus to boot). For Example, in MP players can earn Diamond Badges for the Scorestreak Category by earning Gold Mastery Badges with 18 Scorestreaks (the number of Scorestreaks available in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] at launch).
[h3]Showcasing Your Badges[/h3]
Mastery Badges are shown off in your Showcase in your Social Menu, and are also displayed whenever you’re present in the Winner’s Circle at the end of Multiplayer Matches. By default, your top three Badges will be automatically equipped to your Showcase – but players who want more control of what they choose to show off can manually equip Badges of their choice. The Badge of the killing weapon is also shown off in the KillCam so the opponent you just dispatched will know how much time and sweat you’ve put into your tool of destruction!
[h3]Reward Highlights[/h3]
Below you’ll find a selection of the Mastery Badges available for you to earn in [i]Black Ops 6[/i]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0961968c2148264efcd1506472df14d07d7ab53b.jpg[/img]

A showcase of Mastery Badges you can unlock in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/da779977db516915da7acd9014815b3961e1d08f.jpg[/img]

A showcase of Mastery Badges you can unlock in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Zombies.
[h2]Medal Collection[/h2]
[i]Global System (MP, RBZ)[/i]

[i]Barracks > Stats > Medal Collection[/i]
[h3]Medals: System Overview[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c746e89543e29670a99d0ec9bacf9ccad59b57b4.jpg[/img]

Medals recognize and reward incredible in-game feats with a satisfying Medal celebration on the in-game HUD and small XP bonus. There are over 200 Medals available to be earned in Multiplayer and Zombies in [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. Many of these Medals are returning Black Ops favorites and staples, and many have never before been seen in Call of Duty. Players can view their earned Medals in the After Action Report at the end of each match, as well as in the Medal Collection.
[h3]Medal Collection[/h3]
Your Medal Collection tracks which Medals you’ve earned in Multiplayer and Zombies and how many times you’ve earned them in each mode. From the Medal Collection, you’ll also be able to see what needs to be done to earn any Medals you haven’t yet been able to earn. You can view your Medal Collection via the “Stats” button in the Barracks tab.

[b]Distinguished Medals[/b]

New in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] are Distinguished Medals. Distinguished Medals are a curated set of Medals that highlight specific skill-based feats in each Medal category. Each Medal Category’s Distinguished Medals are clearly displayed at the top of the category.
[h3]Medals Spotlight[/h3]
Below you’ll find examples of some new and returning Medals that [i]Black Ops 6[/i] has to offer:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5028ca7428f5abef41188c332d597d72e62f7b3.jpg[/img]

A showcase of Medals you can earn in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a5d6769cb0c565f4eb41145e4ff4351bc9e6d999.jpg[/img]

A showcase of Medals you can earn in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Zombies.
[h2]Black Ops 6: Unredacted Launch Comms Complete![/h2]
[u]All critical intel has now been unredacted! Make sure you’re fully prepared for [i]Black Ops 6[/i] by reading the following missives:[/u]

[b][u]Launch Comms Blog 1: Multiplayer and More: [/u][/b]Essential Intel on the Multiplayer Modes, Maps, Factions, and Operators Coming to [i]Black Ops 6[/i].

[b][u]Launch Comms Blog 2: [/u][/b][b]Zombies Mode Prep:[/b] Full Equipment, Power-Ups, Augments, GobbleGums, a Full Tour of Terminus and Liberty Falls, and Confirmed Launch Changes.

[b][u]Launch Comms Blog 3: [/u][/b][b]Weapons Hot:[/b] Primary, Secondary, and Melee Weapons Detail for [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. Includes new details on the latest innovations across Gunsmith and Attachments.

[b][u]Launch Comms Blog 4: Gear Up: [/u][/b]Ensure you’re fully equipped for [i]Black Ops 6[/i] launch as we confirm all the launch Equipment (Tacticals, Lethals, Field Upgrades), Perks, Specialties, Wildcards, and Scorestreaks available.

[b][u]Launch Comms Blog 5: Progression:[/u][/b] You’re reading this blog now!
