[b][u]Round Based Zombies: Overview and Recap[/u][/b]

With two Round-Based Zombies maps at launch, and a third map arriving before the end of the year, the time has come to fully prepare for tackling the terrors of Terminus, Liberty Falls, and this extensive game mode!

Past Blogs have covered many aspects, gameplay systems, and innovations in Zombies. Here’s a recap related to all of this, before we confirm all the launch content, including a Loadout Overview, unlockable Augments, Equipment, and full list of GobbleGums available at launch.

[b]Links to Previous Zombies Intel[/b]

Click on the following links for more information on:
[list]	[*]An Overview of Round-Based Zombies. Includes:	[list]		[*][url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-zombies-deep-dive-terminus-map-intel#Round]The Currency of Zombies: Essence and Salvage.[/url][/*]		[*][url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-zombies-deep-dive-terminus-map-intel#Quest]Quests, Exfilling, Display Options and Saving.[/url][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Gameplay of Round-Based Zombies. Includes:	[list]		[*][url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-zombies-deep-dive-terminus-map-intel#Systems]Ground Loot, Ammo Caches, Trials, Elemental Damage, Weapon Rarity Upgrades, Wall Buys (Weapons and Armor), Mystery Boxes, and Pack-A-Punch Machine.[/url][/*]		[*][url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-next-black-ops-6-reveal-zombies-liberty-falls-showcase-intel#quest]Information on Main Quests and Directed Mode[/url][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Enemies of Round-Based Zombies. Includes:	[list]		[*][url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-zombies-deep-dive-terminus-map-intel#Undead]The tormented horrors of Terminus Island.[/url][/*]		[*][url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-next-black-ops-6-reveal-zombies-liberty-falls-showcase-intel#inhabitants]The twisted inhabitants of Liberty Falls.[/url][/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]The Wonder Weapons of Round-Based Zombies. Includes:	[list]		[*][url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-next-black-ops-6-reveal-zombies-liberty-falls-showcase-intel#ray-gun]Ubiquitous Wonder Weapon: Ray Gun.[/url][/*]		[*][url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-zombies-deep-dive-terminus-map-intel#Wonder]Terminus Wonder Weapon: Beamsmasher.[/url][/*]		[*][url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-next-black-ops-6-reveal-zombies-liberty-falls-showcase-intel#thrustodyne]Liberty Falls Wonder Weapon: Thrustodyne Model 23[/url].[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
This blog also contains intel regarding updates and changes to the game confirmed for launch. Read on for all the details.

[b][u]Zombies Launch Updates from Treyarch[/u][/b]

[b]Liberty Falls Updates[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c57cdbfcc3bb8000743cbb150696113ca7890ead.jpg[/img]

Since the debut of early gameplay footage at Call of Duty NEXT back in August, the Zombies team at Treyarch has continued to iterate on the look, feel, and sound of Liberty Falls to crank up the map’s creepiness factor. Heading into launch, players can expect a moodier visual tone to the map, along with gorier set dressings and new environmental audio to more intensely reflect the chaos of a [i]very [/i]recent dimensional breach.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/51e90ce04f823046f43656df2a8ccf0242d7ccb8.jpg[/img]

[u]Additional atmospheric elements related to the map’s Main Quest will also be present throughout Liberty Falls as players begin to solve the mysteries waiting for them in the wake of the undead incursion. And of course, there might be a brand-new Easter Egg song from Treyarch’s Kevin Sherwood to discover along the way...[/u]

[b]HUD Touch-ups[/b]

The UI team has also continued to update the game’s modular HUD, touching up some of the Zombies-specific elements that can appear across most HUD preset options and adding new settings. These updates include:
[list]	[*]Character portraits added to the lower-left corner by default[/*]	[*]General alignment and color adjustments made across the entire HUD[/*]	[*]Perk icons now positioned closer together[/*]	[*]Zombies-specific widgets added for certain in-game actions[/*]	[*]In-game GobbleGum reward animation added[/*]	[*]Visibility sliders added to allow players to fine-tune or completely disable additional HUD elements, including Score Feed, Medals & Notifications, Minimap Opacity, Weapon & Equipment Information, and more.[/*][/list]

[b][u]Terminus Island Recon[/u][/b]

[b]Terror Island: A Tour of Terminus[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/831361f7958001c1e745c71a47158b2877c7ed24.jpg[/img]

From the long disused mining tunnels to its use as a WWII resupply depot, to the structures built as part of a shuttered CIA Blacksite, there’s a wealth of discoveries to be made across Terminus Island. Given the more recent evidence of heinous biological experimentations led by the nefarious Project Janus group, our newly freed Requiem crew will need to stay on their toes.

[b]Cells and Guard Station[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/39c13f2b7c0b4a6b421a7578088f05d638ed4e06.jpg[/img]

At the top of the prison sits a series of Holding Cells where the Requiem crew have been biding their time for the last half decade. The paint is peeling, the ducts are rusting, and there’s an odd smell coming from one of the air vents. Adjacent is the Guard Station where your handlers (Peck and Strauss) have barricaded themselves, as well as a lower interrogation room, with the remnants of a torture session still visible.

[b]Security Overlook and Control Center[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8dfce1e33967cf477455e8e9d8a8d4d110086d2b.jpg[/img]

A cracked concrete overlook lies below a guard tower, which leads to a two-level control center with monitor banks and a well-stocked armory. Further down the embankment the prison is built on, the remains of a Project Janus Communications structure seem to have been well-maintained, until the recent incursion.

[b]Living Quarters, Storage, and Mess Hall[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3546afd2259b190cccd26b2a787dcc9904d82a4a.jpg[/img]

The large storage area leads down an unloading ramp to the Rec yard, and on either side is an older structure built in 1942, when the U.S. Navy established a Resupply Base on the island. Nearby is an Engineering room, stocked with electronics and tables to tinker on.

[b]Sea Tower[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7e11c36540fcfc8524793c11e2bdaa9c768bb848.jpg[/img]

Explore the Dark Aether Reactor (DAR) Sea Tower, a gun emplacement atop an octagonal tower, with attached metal ramps and gantries (and an ascender) all the way down to the gigantic concrete footings.

[b]Gun Battery Platform[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bce850f0714aec8f1d4d246fe3c5476f15754b0d.jpg[/img]

A massive WWII vintage gun emplacement rests atop a thick concrete platform, seemingly modified by Project Janus in recent years as part of an unusual experiment.

[b]Sea Caves and Mining Tunnels[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/857ef14dc58cd1e1ffb49bd0562f3ea44647e6d5.jpg[/img]

Below the outer areas of the island prison are a pair of subterranean tunnels, one naturally occurring, and the other man-made, dug out toward the end of the 19th century, when the island’s long-mined out coal reserves were being greedily exploited.

[b]Bio Lab[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/58338a1e9d1f5648839beea078d9e9d77d972f97.jpg[/img]

An impressive feat of engineering awaits on the island; a large sea cave has been completely hollowed out, and a large-scale secret research facility has been constructed within the cavern walls. Multi-level gantry walkways and stairs are clamped to the outer walls, and what appears to be an experimentation chamber lies within.

[b]Inclined Lift and Maglev Elevator[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/507ba28e9a9ad07a885d0e457c197a0a4cb42448.jpg[/img]

Though the Bio Lab is set within a huge cavern, it has multiple pathways outward thanks to an Inclined Lift that periodically trundles up to the top level behind the living quarters. Further around the Bio Lab gantries is an operational Project Janus-constructed Maglev Elevator.

[b]Shipwreck[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/20b4d7e94002b885de7f6bac57c7037aea9aba57.jpg[/img]

Despite the radar buoys in close proximity, the remains of a shipping tanker indicate just how treacherous the waters around Terminus Island are. Slowly rusting from stern to prow, the salt waters have eaten away at the hull, though the main deck is still seemingly accessible.

[b]The Outer Islands[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cc5442e2f88b0347157359bdef7214d4af9e8dc8.jpg[/img]

To the northwest is Temple Island, with its odd pillar-like carvings. Due east is Castle Rock Island, named after the natural stone edifice jutting from the tidal sands that appears to be an old fortification. The largest of the three outcrops is Crab Island, where Project Janus disposal crews would discard the remains of their science team’s unwholesome experiments.

The seas around Terminus Island are also home to something more foreboding: a terror in the water, writhing up from an irradiated cloud and violently attacking those that remain outside the confines of the prison for too long…

[b][u]Liberty Falls Recon[/u][/b]

[b]Almost Hell, West Virginia: A Tour of Liberty Falls[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0f9ee35e9d416b91ed441a5b9ee4c0dc767f8f4b.jpg[/img]

The atmosphere of Liberty Falls, which takes place concurrently with the aftermath of the dimensional breach over on Terminus Island, feels a world away from the dark, stormy waters of the Philippine Sea and the massive concrete prison Grigori Weaver and his crew are fighting to escape from.

Players must explore the once-idyllic, now horrific small West Virginian town of Liberty Falls, whose residents have either fled or barricaded themselves into the settlement in a last desperate attempt to survive. By the time you arrive – under the watchful eye of Project Janus Security Chief John Blanchard – the town is overrun, and the battle seems well and truly lost.

Here’s a closer look at the Liberty Falls locations you’ll be able to explore:

[b]Pump & Pay[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/74e9f3427245098e56d8b7c1035ee4b5547f5de8.jpg[/img]

You begin your battles against the swarms of rotting townspeople from a gas station rooftop vantage point. This soon becomes a disadvantage when you realize how nimble zombies are at reaching you. If you’re a glutton for punishment, switch on the Rampage Inducer here to speed up the action. Otherwise, descend to the ground and bear witness to the true horrors that have befallen this cursed hamlet.

[b]Motor Lodge[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5487adbc2a17d2ec04b552adbb923bde8c52df56.jpg[/img]

The ironically named Rest E-Z Motor Lodge is one of the first structures you’ll investigate after scrambling down from the gas station. Partly ablaze with the word “HELP” daubed across the roof, this is seemingly an epicenter of zombie activity, with shambling horrors crashing out of rooms on the ground and upper floors.

[b]Olly’s Comics [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4599fb221526192b06022db66cd15612394809dc.jpg[/img]

In the southern corner of town is the local comic shop run by Olly. Best not think about what happened to him. The shop caters to the true collector, with both the latest and back issues of “Charged Up,” “Heavy Space,” and “Odd Stories” on sale at reasonable prices. But most folks come here for the life-sized statue of Aetherella to pose with, star of the comic line of the same name.

[b]Fuller’s Liberty Lanes [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/87e664e9872a800859ff546d951e9e6464cf19b5.jpg[/img]

An old-fashioned bowling alley comprised of a snack bar and small arcade has been overrun with the undead. The lanes themselves seem to be just wide enough to herd larger zombie hordes without getting trapped and ripped apart... but looks can be deceiving.

[b]Savings & Loan [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3e50c1cec0aa7ab08ba336c2f572dc991acbc6b2.jpg[/img]

The Bank of Liberty Falls is a grand stone edifice and seems to have been well barricaded before the baying hordes overran the place. That’s not to say this a safe place to visit, but it’s centrally located with fine marbled floors, only somewhat tarnished by the wreckage, strewn debris, and unpleasant fluids.

[b]Holy Falls Church [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/67bca1bab02be6b50a0c353953cd7bac08d97332.jpg[/img]

This neo-gothic house of worship becomes more terrifying the further inside you investigate it. Placed on a plateau at the highest point in town, a dimensional anomaly seems to have fully enveloped the interior.

[b]“The Alamo” [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5d0e925fb864f6c6a8baa942bcabfa20b4ae0ed0.jpg[/img]

Judging by the sandbags, razor wire and other defenses, the bank's rooftop is where the last surviving members of the Project Janus response teams made their last stand. You'll find everything you need here....

[b][u]Augments Overview[/u][/b]

Equip Augments to your Perk-A-Colas, Ammo Mods and Field Upgrades to modify their performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/123e9b7f24d45dc2307ac401964ab8e1da48b836.jpg[/img]

[b]Recap: [/b]Augments are unlockable gameplay advantages you can apply to every Perk-a-Cola, Ammo Mod, and Field Upgrade in the game, and provide a rich and innovative customization experience, allowing you to invest into research between matches. [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-zombies-deep-dive-terminus-map-intel#Augments]Learn more about Augments here[/url].
[list]	[*]There are 108 Augments available to unlock and equip at the game’s launch, divided as follows:	[list]		[*][b]Perk-a-Colas:[/b] Eight, each with six Augments (48).[/*]		[*][b]Ammo Mods:[/b] Five, each with six Augments (30).[/*]		[*][b]Field Upgrades: [/b]Five, each with six Augments (30).[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]
[b]Researching and Choosing Augments[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c2e9ebb8f468a8fc372545c24d12bbf192b82da3.jpg[/img]

[b]Augment Research:[/b] The key to unlocking the full potential of your loadouts is Augment Research. This unlocks at Player Level 11.

Once you research and unlock individual Augments, they can be chosen before the start of a match for each individual Perk, Ammo Mod, or Field Upgrade. To start researching an Augment, simply select which item you’d like to research in the menu and start earning XP in-game to make progress toward unlocking the Augment.
[list]	[*]Each item has two available Augment slots: one for a Major, and one for a Minor Augment.[/*]	[*]Expect three Major Augments to choose from, per item. A Major Augment offers a substantial advantage to the behavior of the item, usually during use.[/*]	[*]Expect three Minor Augments to choose from, per item. A Minor Augment offers a limited advantage to the item, usually during use.[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4db766689bed173a14be0526c7214cfa10924619.jpg[/img]

The depth of the Augments customization experience becomes apparent as you learn the different effects of each Augment, and how they stack and affect other upgrades across the game. This subsequently allows you to customize your Augments for your style of play, whether solo or squad-based.
[list]	[*]If you’ve played a particular role in your squad – as a healer for example – you may already have a good idea of which Augments you should search for, unlock, and employ along with other related power-ups to optimize your team’s dynamics and survivability![/*][/list]
[b][u]Perk-A-Colas (8) and Augments (48)[/u][/b]

[i]Currency to access Perk-a-Colas: Essence[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cbb705dd74cec4ddf83766eb4b1d6d3a488340d6.jpg[/img]

[b]Recap: [/b]If you’re after a tasty beverage that also has the benefit of granting abilities to aid you and your teammates’ survival chances, then get ready to hunt down your preferred vending machines, as Perk-a-Colas are back and with more of a kick than ever: For Black Ops 6 Zombies, every Perk-a-Cola can comes with up to six Augment options to choose from (three Minor, three Major).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4f9695be5a675cda5d4727874bb54a453bbdf262.jpg[/img]

Perks are purchased in-game using Essence and have been designed to offer a wide variety of bonuses that suit your style of play, allowing you to choose the order and number you need. Each time you purchase a new Perk, the Essence cost increases, and your Perk collection – displayed along the bottom of your HUD – lasts as long as you do: If you’re downed, expect to lose Perks depending on how many you’ve obtained, and how long you’re downed for.

At launch, expect to access the following Perk Machines:

[b]Jugger-Nog:[/b] Increase maximum health by 100.

[b]Quick Revive:[/b] Reduce the health regen delay time by 50%. Reduce the time it takes to revive an ally by 50%.

[b]Speed Cola:[/b] Increase reload and armor replating speed bonus by 30%.

[b]Stamin-Up:[/b] Increase movement speed.

[b]PhD Flopper:[/b] Immunity to all self-inflicted damage and status effects. Dive to prone triggers an explosion, which increases the higher you fall. Immunity from fall damage while diving prone.

[b]Deadshot Daiquiri:[/b] Aiming down sight moves to enemy critical location. Increase critical damage to enemies.

[b]Elemental Pop:[/b] Every bullet you fire has a small chance to apply a random Ammo Mod effect.

[b]Melee Macchiato:[/b] Replace weapon gun butt with a deadly punch that sends enemies flying.

Here is a complete list of Augments for each of the Perk-a-Colas available at launch:

[b]Perk-A-Cola Augments[/b]

[b]Jugger-Nog[/b]

Increases maximum health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/35e98708306d4d1680be9ab4b44a870d36314597.jpg[/img]

[b]Major Augments[/b]

[b]PROBIOTIC: [/b]Slightly increase maximum health with Jugger-Nog.

[b]TURTLE SHELL: [/b]Armor acts as a shield on your back, completely absorbing damage to your back. No damage mitigation when hit from the front.

[b]REACTIVE ARMOR: [/b]When an armor plate breaks, nearby normal enemies are stunned for a short time.

[b]Minor Augments[/b]

[b]RETALIATION: [/b]Deal bonus damage while health is low.

[b]HARDENED PLATES: [/b]Armor plates have more damage mitigation.

[b]DURABLE PLATES: [/b]Slightly increase armor durability.

[b]Stamin-Up[/b]

Increase movement speed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0196ba438f171a2d8e6afd4fe979bcea12f36a1a.jpg[/img]

[b]Major Augments[/b]

[b]FREE FALLER: [/b]Become immune to fall damage.

[b]DASHER: [/b]Increase Tactical Sprint duration.

[b]STALKER: [/b]Walk faster while aiming.

[b]Minor Augments[/b]

[b]HARD TARGET: [/b]While Tactical Sprinting, projectile damage is reduced.

[b]QUARTERBACK: [/b]Use equipment while sprinting.

[b]HOT FOOT: [/b]Gain a speed boost after your equipment kills an enemy.

[b]Speed Cola[/b]

Reload weapons and replate armor faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9dff02a3f36f3cbe1a075706e3a4e5670e75bccd.jpg[/img]

[b]Major Augments[/b]

[b]SUPERCHARGED: [/b]Field Upgrades recharge a bit faster.

[b]CLASSIC FORMULA: [/b]Reload speed is even faster.

[b]PHANTOM RELOAD: [/b]Weapon magazines are slowly refilled over time.

[b]Minor Augments[/b]

[b]SPEEDY ROULETTE: [/b]The Mystery Box settles much faster.

[b]QUICK SWAP: [/b]Swap weapons faster.

[b]FAST PITCHER: [/b]Deploy equipment faster.

[b]Deadshot Daiquiri[/b]

Drink to improve ADS precision and increase critical damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2c841333195cce7c52972916736188d22795999d.jpg[/img]

[b]Major Augments[/b]

[b]DEAD HEAD: [/b]Further increase in critical damage.

[b]DEAD FIRST: [/b]Deal double critical damage if an enemy is at full health.

[b]DEAD AGAIN: [/b]Critical hits have a chance of adding a bullet to your magazine.

[b]Minor Augments[/b]

[b]DEAD BREAK: [/b]Increase damage to armor pieces.

[b]DEAD DRAW: [/b]Reduce hip-fire spread.

[b]DEAD SET: [/b]Reduce gun movement while performing advanced movement.

[b]Quick Revive[/b]

Recover health and revive allies faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fcd7da457034b2b7d6b62d97d6be96a498f25d8c.jpg[/img]

[b]Major Augments[/b]

[b]EMT: [/b]Reviving an ally allows them to keep all of the Perks on their bleed-out bar.

[b]EQUIVALENT EXCHANGE: [/b]Killing an enemy while downed will revive you and remove Quick Revive. This can be done up to three times.

[b]DYING WISH: [/b]On lethal damage, become immune to all damage for two seconds and keep one health. Quick Revive is removed on use.

[b]Minor Augments[/b]

[b]SWIFT RECOVERY: [/b]Reviving an ally increases both of your movement speeds for a short time.

[b]KARMIC RETURN: [/b]Reviving an ally heals you to full health.

[b]SLOW DEATH: [/b]Increase your time in last stand.

[b]Elemental Pop[/b]

Attacks can trigger random Ammo Mods.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7f87725211e633e4df7d401dde2a2140644e2556.jpg[/img]

[b]Major Augments[/b]

[b]CITRUS FOCUS: [/b]If a weapon has an Ammo Mod applied, Elemental Pop will only activate that one.

[b]IMPERIL PEACH: [/b]Enemies that hit you have a chance to trigger a random Ammo Mod.

[b]ELECTRIC CHERRY: [/b]Reloading creates an electric damage discharge that damages and stuns nearby normal enemies. The emptier the magazine, the stronger the damage.

[b]Minor Augments[/b]

[b]VULNERA BEAN: [/b]Slightly increase enemy elemental weakness damage.

[b]PINEAPPLE BLAST: [/b]Equipment can also trigger a random Ammo Mod.

[b]CHILL BERRY: [/b]Slightly reduce all Ammo Mod cooldowns.

[b]PHD Flopper[/b]

Explosive dive to prone and immunity to self-inflicted explosive damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ceef39d789531540a4d6c985028d9708b1f30198.jpg[/img]

[b]Major Augments[/b]

[b]GRAVITY MD: [/b]Just falling from heights creates explosions.

[b]DR RAM: [/b]Tactical Sprint knocks down and damages base zombies.

[b]PHD SLIDER: [/b]Sliding into enemies triggers explosions.

[b]Minor Augments[/b]

[b]ENVIRONMENTALIST: [/b]Become immune to environmental damage while sliding.

[b]EOD TECHNICIAN: [/b]Slightly reduce height and distance requirements for explosions.

[b]TRIBOLOGIST: [/b]Sliding distance and speed are increased.

[b]Melee Macchiato[/b]

Replace weapon gun butt with a deadly punch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5c8911f6cbf7d9a607a8368ee27b4d25a24321c3.jpg[/img]

[b]Major Augments[/b]

[b]EXPRESSO: [/b]All melee attacks are slightly faster.

[b]VAMPIRIC EXTRACTION: [/b]Melee attacks heal a small amount of your health.

[b]TRIPLE SHOT: [/b]Your punch can hit multiple enemies at once.

[b]Minor Augments[/b]

[b]STICK ’N MOVE: [/b]Backpedal speed is increased after a successful melee attack.

[b]STRENGTH TRAINING: [/b]Your punch can one-hit kill normal enemies for longer.

[b]HIDDEN IMPACT: [/b]Melee kills reload a portion of your held weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f48543dce03b40ea3bf1170bcef6480c2e25fb76.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Ammo Mods (5) and Augments (30)[/u][/b]

[i]Currency to access Ammo Mods: Salvage[/i]

[b]Recap: [/b]Along with Rarity and Pack-a-Punch capabilities ([url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-zombies-deep-dive-terminus-map-intel#Rarity]showcased in this blog[/url]), your Primary and Melee Weapons can be outfitted with an upgrade known as an Ammo Mod. Obtained in-game via a purchase at the Arsenal Machine using Salvage, Ammo Mods grant the affected weapon a percentage chance of dealing a special additional effect upon a successful projectile impact. Only one Ammo Mod can be applied to the weapon at a time, though you can purchase a new Ammo Mod as necessary.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2361e6a000447394e4c5a6ca6b3444ea7bd3b530.jpg[/img]

At launch, expect to access five Ammo Mods, some of which require you to be a specific Player Level. Each Ammo Mod has six Augments to unlock and choose from, to further bolster the following base effects:
[list]	[*][b]Brain Rot: [/b]Bullets deal toxic damage. Each bullet has the chance to turn a Normal or Special enemy into an ally.[/*]	[*][b]Cryo Freeze:[/b] Bullets deal frost damage. Each bullet has a chance to slow Normal or Special enemies.[/*]	[*][b]Dead Wire: [/b]Bullets deal electrical damage. Each bullet has a chance to stun any Normal and Special enemy, generating a field that deals electric damage to nearby enemies.[/*]	[*][b]Napalm Burst: [/b]Bullets deal fire damage. Each bullet has a chance to ignite Normal and Special enemies.[/*]	[*][b]Shadow Rift: [/b]Bullets deal shadow damage. Each bullet has a chance to spawn a black hole if striking Normal or Special enemies, warping nearby zombies away and dropping some from the air at high speed.[/*][/list]
[b]Progression: Ammo Mods Unlocks[/b]

Ammo Mod - Player Level

DEAD WIRE 0

NAPALM BURST 6

CRYO FREEZE 14

BRAIN ROT 27

SHADOW RIFT 44

AMMO MOD RESEARCH 11

Bullets deal toxic damage. Each bullet has a chance to temporarily turn a normal or special enemy into an ally.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e40573a8b1d22c67b954b5d5b69ca29ef5e8b848.jpg[/img]

[b]Major Augments[/b]

[b]PLAGUE: [/b]The charmed enemy has a chance to turn other enemies.

[b]HASTE: [/b]Brain Rot cooldown is slightly reduced.

[b]EXPLOSIVE: [/b]Charmed enemies explode at the end of Brain Rot’s duration, dealing toxic damage.

[b]Cryo Freeze[/b]

[b]Available:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 14

Bullets deal frost damage. Each bullet has a chance to slow a normal or special enemy and increase the damage they receive.

[b]ICE CLOUD: [/b]Enemies that are killed while frozen may leave a cloud that slows enemies.

[b]FROZEN STIFF: [/b]Enemies are frozen in place.

[b]Minor Augments[/b]

[b]EXTENSION: [/b]Slightly increase the slow duration.

[b]FREEZER BURN: [/b]Slightly increase damage to frozen enemies.

[b]LIQUID NITROGEN: [/b]Significantly increase your chance for Cryo Freeze to activate.

[b]Dead Wire[/b]

Bullets deal electric damage. Each bullet has a chance to stun a normal or special enemy, causing them to generate an electric damage field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c7958808aaefabebc10b5d9744e3db7078884bab.jpg[/img]

[b]Napalm Burst[/b]

[b]Available:[/b] Unlocked at Player Level 6

Bullets deal fire damage. Each bullet has a chance to apply a burn effect on normal and special enemies, dealing damage over time.

notes.title: Zombies prep: equipment, power-ups, augments, and more, part 2
notes.notes:
[b][u]Field Upgrades (5) and Augments (30)[/u][/b]

[b][i]Mastery Badges available for this Equipment Type[/i][/b]

[i]Currency to access Ammo Mods: Salvage[/i]

Field Upgrades are selected prior to a Match, within your Loadout Menu. During a match, you can also swap to a different Field Upgrade at any time by using the in-game menu. Note that your cooldown will reset upon switching to a different Field Upgrade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9c090b5286fab2466f27573be560bc55d78be6e0.jpg[/img]

At launch, expect to choose the following Field Upgrades:

[b]Aether Shroud: [/b]Phase into the Dark Aether, becoming hidden from enemy detection.

[b]Frenzied Guard: [/b]Repair armor and force all enemies in the area to target you. During this time, kills repair a portion of your armor.

[b]Healing Aura: [/b]Summons beams of energy down on yourself and allies to instantly revive and heal to full health.

[b]Energy Mine:[/b] Create a mine of pure energy that detonates in rapid succession, dealing lethal electric damage.

[b]Dark Flare:[/b] You generate a massive energy beam that deals lethal shadow damage. The beam penetrates everything in its path.

[b]Progression: Field Upgrades Unlocks[/b]

[b][u]Round-Based Zombies: Match Preparation[/u][/b]

[b]The Zombies Loadout (Updated)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e8add9636292b406684c36b1075a94794f3299aa.jpg[/img]

Locate the Loadout Option in the Weapons Menu. It is here you’ll choose and save your Zombies Loadouts. Compared to Multiplayer, the Loadouts for Zombies are set up a little differently. The Zombies Loadout is comprised of the following:
[list]	[*]Weapon (Primary)[/*]	[*]Melee Weapon[/*]	[*]Field Upgrade[/*]	[*]Tactical[/*]	[*]Lethal[/*]	[*]GobbleGum Pack[/*][/list]
[b]Weapons(Primary or Secondary)[/b]

Choose the armament you wish to drop into a Zombies Match with. These can be Base Weapons, Builds, or Blueprints. Gunsmith is available for these weapons. Choose from the following weapon types:
[list]	[*]Assault Rifles[/*]	[*]SMGs[/*]	[*]Shotguns[/*]	[*]LMGs[/*]	[*]Marksman Rifles[/*]	[*]Sniper Rifles[/*]	[*]Pistols[/*]	[*]Launchers[/*][/list]
[b]Weapon (Melee)[/b]

Your second Loadout weapon is a close-quarters armament with no ranged ordnance. Gunsmith is available for this weapon (Cosmetics only).

[b]Field Upgrade[/b]

Though they share the same name, Zombies Field Upgrades are distinct from those in Multiplayer, though they share the same cooldown and recharge mechanism. In Zombies, Field Upgrades are powerful devices that offer a chargeable elemental ability, followed by a cooldown period after each use when the Field Upgrade recharges, ready to be used again. You’ll earn faster recharges simply by eliminating enemies, not with the passage of time. Look for a complete list of Field Upgrades and the Augments you can fit to each of them, later in this Blog.

[b]Tactical Equipment[/b]

These are limited-quantity items that range from healing to disorientation devices, designed to offer a non-lethal advantage in combat.

[b]Lethal Equipment[/b]

These are limited-quantity items that harm enemies, usually via an explosion.

[b]GobbleGum Packs[/b]

Crack your teeth as well as the skulls of the undead with a variety of custom GobbleGum Packs, based on your stored reserves of this killer candy! Pick a single Pack to bring with you; with each Pack containing five different types of single-use GobbleGums. During a match, you access these via a special confectionary machine that holds each GobbleGum in your pack and spits out one randomly once you interact with it. For more information on how this works, [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-zombies-deep-dive-terminus-map-intel#GobbleGums]read more here[/url]. Look for a complete list of GobbleGums available at launch later in this Blog.

[b]Weapons Detail Note: [/b]The Primary and Melee Weapons you can choose from, along with Gunsmith and Attachment Intel, is covered in the Weapons Detail Blog, available here. Additionally, you have an additional space to carry a second (non-Melee) weapon that can be sourced from ground loot, a Wall Buy, or the Mystery Box.

[b]Mastery Badges Note: [/b]Almost every weapon and equipment in your Zombies Loadout – Weapon, Melee, Field Upgrade, Tacticals and Lethals – have their own Medal Challenge (with associated XP Reward), and all individual Equipment items have a specific set of Mastery Badge Challenges to complete. Consult the Launch Comms: Progression Blog for more Intel.

[b][u]GobbleGums: Launch Overview[/u][/b]

[b]GobbleGum Rarity[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9c7d6aca255307511b837477deea27fe34f9a38d.jpg[/img]

[b]Recap: [/b]GobbleGums come in a variety of rarities: Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Ultra, with the general rule that the higher the rarity, the more powerful the effect of the GobbleGum. There are also Whimsical GobbleGums, which produce amusing results that don’t typically affect gameplay.

[b]Availability and Launch Variety[/b]

As discussed in previous blogs [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-zombies-deep-dive-terminus-map-intel#GobbleGums]here[/url] and [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-next-black-ops-6-reveal-zombies-liberty-falls-showcase-intel#gobblegums]here[/url], GobbleGums are single-use power-ups that are chosen and kept in your Loadout. Packs of five are brought into each match based on the GobbleGums you’ve unlocked and/or collected. Additional GobbleGums are earned in a variety of ways, including simply by playing Zombies and surviving rounds, or by Store purchase. Here it the complete list of all GobbleGums available to earn at launch:

[b]Progression: GobbleGum Rewards[/b]

GobbleGum - Player Level

KILL JOY 5

STOCK OPTION 8

WHO'S KEEPING SCORE? 11

CACHE BACK 15

ANYWHERE BUT HERE 21

EXIT STRATEGY 23

SODA FOUNTAIN 26

PROFIT SHARING 29

WALL TO WALL CLEARANCE 32

FREE FIRE 36

ON THE HOUSE 38

NOWHERE BUT HERE 42

WONDERBAR! 51

HIDDEN POWER 54

[b]Available GobbleGums (ZM)[/b]

[b]Rare GobbleGums[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/36db35ce90a49a9d20793e2304abaaa401c29505.jpg[/img]

[b]Stock Option[/b]

(Lasts one minute) Ammo is taken from the player’s stockpile instead of their weapon’s magazine.

[b]Kill Joy[/b]

Spawns an Insta-Kill Power-Up.

Instantly teleport to a random location. A concussive blast knocks away nearby zombies.

[b]Cache Back[/b]

[b]Temporal Gift[/b]

(Activates on Next Time-Based Power-Up) Power-Up lasts longer.

[b]Shields Up[/b]

(Lasts three minutes) Armor is twice as strong.

[b]Arsenal Accelerator[/b]

(Lasts five minutes) Charge the player’s Field Upgrade faster.

[b]Epic GobbleGums[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7a385e8469ab975da58513f54432a5c15e3c1e23.jpg[/img]

[b]Nowhere But There![/b]

Instantly teleport to a random downed player. Instantly revive nearby players.

(Activates on Perk purchase) The next Perk purchased gives an additional random Perk.

[b]Profit Sharing[/b]

(Lasts two minutes) A portion of the essence you earn is also received by nearby players and vice versa.

Re-spins the weapon in the Mystery Box after it has settled to one of equal or higher rarity.

(Activates on Mystery Box spin) The next weapon taken from the Mystery Box comes Pack-A-Punched.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/17f88065eecdb12d12acab086ae2397cba173784.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Additional Access: Operators, Intel, and More![/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9ec295f145acf34597565c3dbff54180b74ea3fb.jpg[/img]

Gathering all new and pertinent data, this section allows you to fully prepare for the forthcoming Zombies experience on October 25! Here’s what you need to know:

[b]Pre-Game Menu Intel[/b]

[b]Weapon Select: Gunsmith (Global System, Weapons Menu)[/b]

Build your optimal zombie-culling armament here, and then share it as a Global Weapon Build across Multiplayer and [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i] (at Season 01)! If you’ve built a weapon in a different mode (Multiplayer or Warzone), it will appear here along with all Attachments, both functional and cosmetic. You can then easily add it to your Loadout.

[b]Weapon Select: Wonder Weapon (Weapons Menu)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/182b77763e398602bc815cf10fd39e151eed21ac.jpg[/img]

Along with Gunsmith, Loadout, and Augments, any Wonder Weapons you may have previously unlocked, along with any associated Skins, are displayed here. This menu is simply for you to choose the preferred Skin for your Wonder Weapon, before obtaining it during a Match.

[b]Operators Select: Dedicated Crew[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c3331a03d8aec3baacad08c6c6026e87c9abc6ef.jpg[/img]

The Operators Menu allows you to choose from every Black Ops 6 Operator, though the opposing factions present in Multiplayer (Rogue Black Ops and Crimson One) are not as critically important when facing horrific dimensional breaches. Therefore, expect a single Operator menu, with “Dedicated Crew Operators” (Grigori Weaver, Elizabeth Grey, Mackenzie “Mac” Carver, and Maya Aguinaldo) flagged. You are encouraged to play as one of these four characters in Zombies for an enhanced story experience and unique content. Consult the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/10/call-of-duty-black-ops-6-launch-comms-multiplayer-modes-maps-operators-intel]Launch Comms: Multiplayer Blog[/url] for biographies and unlock criteria for all Operators.

[b]Barracks: Progression and Zombie Intel Access[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cde474373fe48874667afaf30e3ca089ea54af54.jpg[/img]

Ensure you spend some time between matches in the Barracks Menu, as you’re able to confirm the following:

[b]Progression: [/b]Your Player Level Progression is your main focus; unlocking levels 1-55 gradually allows access to all the different elements, items, power-ups, equipment and weaponry discussed in this blog. For example, you need to be level 11 to access Augment Research.

[b]Challenges:[/b] Weapon Camos, Calling Cards, and Mastery Badges all have a substantial number of unlocks to undertake. Learn the techniques to unlock Weapon Camos, check all of your Calling Card Career, Hardened, Prestige, and Dark Ops Challenges, and track the Mastery Badges you’re unlocking for every weapon, Support Scorestreak, Lethal, Tactical, and Field Upgrade!

[b]Customize:[/b] Ensure other players know exactly what you’ve unlocked during your time playing Zombies!

[b]Zombie Intel:[/b] View the Audio Logs, Documents, and Artifacts you’ve discovered during your exploration of each Zombies map. Have you found everything? Need to listen or read intel again for clues to the Zombies storyline? Then this is the menu to come to!

[b]Stats:[/b] View your Combat Record, Medal Collection, and check out your placement in the worldwide Leaderboard of Zombies players!

[b]Progression Blog Note: [/b]Consult the Launch Comms: Progression Blog for full details on every aspect of the Barracks.

[b][u]Black Ops 6: Unredacted Launch Comms Incoming![/u][/b]

[u]Expect further critical intel to be unredacted in the coming days as we confirm additional launch content across Multiplayer and Zombies. Look for the following missives:[/u]

[b][u]Launch Comms Blog 1: Multiplayer and More: [/u][/b]Essential Intel on the Multiplayer Modes, Maps, Factions, and Operators Coming to [i]Black Ops 6[/i].

[b][u]Launch Comms Blog 2: [/u][/b][b]Zombies Mode Prep:[/b] Full Equipment, Power-Ups, Augments, GobbleGums, a Full Tour of Terminus and Liberty Falls, and Confirmed Launch Changes. You’re reading this blog now!

[b][u]Launch Comms Blog 3: [/u][/b][b]Weapons Hot:[/b] Primary, Secondary, and Melee Weapons Detail for [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. Includes new details on the latest innovations across Gunsmith and Attachments.

[b][u]Launch Comms Blog 4: Gear Up: [/u][/b]Ensure you’re fully equipped for [i]Black Ops 6[/i] launch as we confirm all the launch Equipment (Tacticals, Lethals, Field Upgrades), Perks, Specialties, Wildcards, and Scorestreaks available.

[b][u]Launch Comms Blog 5: Progression:[/u][/b] Unlock your true potential as we detail the critical Player Level equipment you’ll need on day one, detailed intel on Classic Prestige and the available rewards, full info on Calling Cards, Reticles, and Mastery Badges Challenges. Plus: Are You Ready for a Deep Dive into the Weapon Camo System?

notes.title: The road to Black Ops 6 launch: Preload and new user interface
notes.notes:
The October 25 launch date for [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i] is just around the corner, meaning it’s almost time to start preloading the game so you can jump right in when it releases next week.

To prepare for launch, we’re delivering an update that combines the preload of [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]and the rollout of the new Call of Duty user interface into a single download. This is one of the last steps in the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/08/call-of-duty-optimizing-experience-roadmap]Roadmap to [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Launch[/url] we discussed in August, with more coming in Season 01. Once the download is completed, players can check out the new UI immediately and be ready to play [i]Black Ops 6[/i] as soon as it is released. Here’s what you can expect in the pre-launch update arriving on Monday.

[b]CONTENT SUMMARY[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Preload and Play at Launch:[/b] Preload [i]Black Ops 6[/i] starting this Monday, October 21 at 9AM PT.[/*]	[*][b]Separate Downloads:[/b] On most platforms, [i]Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] are separate downloads, offering more control over your files.[/*]	[*][b]Greater File Control:[/b] Keep the titles and individual modes that you’re currently playing and uninstall the rest to free up storage space.[/*]	[*][b]Meet the New UI:[/b] Access featured titles and modes on your Home page, previous titles under All Games, and the latest purchasable content under Store.[/*]	[*][b]Faster Access to the Fun:[/b] Instantly load up [i]Black Ops 6[/i] at launch. Starting with Season 01, instantly access [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] as well.[/*][/list][h2]Black Ops 6 Preload[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a27222aee803aeb23d2f3e682d09ad15a28c5627.jpg[/img]

Preloading for [i]Black Ops [/i]6 begins this Monday, October 21 at 9AM PT. Players who have pre-purchased the game or subscribe to select Game Pass plans can download Campaign, Multiplayer, and Zombies so they’re ready to go when [i]Black Ops 6[/i] officially releases on October 25.

To make the preload as smooth as possible, players who pre-purchased [i]Black Ops 6[/i] and already have Call of Duty installed will receive the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] preload as an automatic update to their existing install, similar to previous Call of Duty updates.

Players who pre-purchased [i]Black Ops 6,[/i] but don’t already have Call of Duty installed can initiate the preload from their platform storefront.

The download will be larger for players who already have Call of Duty installed as they’re getting the new UI and [i]Black Ops 6[/i] at the same time.

[b][u]Call of Duty: Warzone — A Separate Download[/u][/b]

[i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i] content is not automatically included in the default download for [i]Black Ops 6[/i].

However, players who don’t already have [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] installed can still choose to download it alongside [i]Black Ops 6[/i] by selecting it in your platform’s install manager. Players can also download [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] at any point after their initial [i]Black Ops 6[/i] install from within the new Call of Duty user interface. We encourage players to download [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] to get the most out of their Call of Duty experience and prepare for some exciting updates coming in Season 01!

There will be no impact to this change for players who already have [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] installed – you will continue to receive game updates automatically as you have in the past.

[b][u]Downloading Black Ops 6 with Call of Duty: Warzone[/u][/b]

On most platforms, [i]Black Ops 6[/i] content will not be included in new [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] downloads.
[h3][u]Managing Your Call of Duty Storage Space[/u][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/184da85aae8393bdce55202c0bb908d75e20137e.jpg[/img]

[i]*Final UI subject to change, may vary by player.[/i]

With [i]Black Ops 6[/i] on the way, Call of Duty will take up more space on your device if you choose to keep all of your previous content installed since a new game is being added on top of your existing files.

Prepare for the [i]Black Ops [/i]6 download and future Call of Duty updates by actively managing what you have installed. To free up additional space, you can remove content that you’re no longer playing, including full titles and individual modes (e.g. uninstalling single player once you’ve finished the Campaign).

Players can uninstall content within the Call of Duty user interface or via their platform’s install manager. After content is removed, you can reinstall it at any point if you wish to return to those games or modes in the future.

[h2]A Tour of the New UI[/h2]
On October 21, players can check out the new Call of Duty UI — formerly known as Call of Duty HQ — after downloading the pre-launch update.

At launch, the new interface will include three main hubs: Home, All Games, and Store. Each hub displays all of its content on one page, eliminating the need to scroll. Here’s a rundown of what you’ll find in each section.
[h3]Home[/h3]
The new UI features a landing page that brings together a variety of Call of Duty content. The Home tab showcases various tiles which each serve different purposes:
[list]	[*][b]Game Tiles [/b]– Unlike the previous Call of Duty UI, players will now be able to directly access games, which have their own self-contained user interfaces. The newest annual title – [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]starting on October 25 – and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]will be shown on the Home tab. Other games are accessible via the All Games tab.[/*]	[*][b]Featured Tile [/b]– This tile can showcase a variety of top content such as modes, maps, and Battle Passes depending on what is new and most relevant at the time.[/*]	[*][b]What’s Hot Row [/b]– Similar to today’s What’s Hot row, these tiles highlight new playlists, bundles, etc. and give players easy access to that content.[/*]	[*][b]Last Played Tile [/b]– This tile gives players quick access to what they played most recently. When you first log in to the new interface, this tile will be a fourth What’s Hot option until you’ve played a game within the UI[/*][/list]
Depending on your preference, you can access game content through both the Game Tiles and any modes or playlists that are elevated to the Featured Tile or What’s Hot Row.
[h3]All Games[/h3]
Cycle to the All Games tab to view your full library of [i]Call of Duty[/i] titles dating back to [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare® [/i](2019). Cross-launch into owned titles, purchase unowned titles, and manage your installations from here.
[h3]Store[/h3]
This tab will give players a path to access the Call of Duty in-game stores and showcase any other top purchasable content. The full Call of Duty in-game stores will be accessible at the game-level of the UI within [i]Black Ops 6[/i],[i] Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], etc. This tab sends players to those full stores.
[h2]UI Evolution[/h2]

The new UI will evolve over three initial phases, reaching its full capabilities with the start of Season 01.

[b]Phase 1: Pre-Black Ops 6 Launch (October 21 – October 24)[/b]

Initially, there will be a transition period from October 21 through 24 when the new UI goes live before [i]Black Ops 6[/i] launches.

During these few days, [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III [/i]and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]will be the primary Game Tiles on the Home tab and players will cross-launch into those games. [i]Modern Warfare III [/i]will retain its legacy UI. [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]will retain its legacy UI until the Season 01 update.

The Store tab will direct players into the full [i]Modern Warfare III [/i]and [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone [/i]in-game stores via cross-launch.

[b]Phase 2: Post-Black Ops 6 Launch (October 25 – [Redacted])[/b]

When [i]Black Ops 6[/i] launches, it will replace [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], making [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] the primary Game Tiles on the Home tab. Players will be able to instantly access [i]Black Ops 6[/i] and cross-launch into [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].

Players who wish to continue playing [i]Modern Warfare III [/i]can access it via cross-launch on the All Games tab or the Last Played Tile if that’s the content you’ve played most recently.

For players who have purchased [i]Black Ops 6[/i], the Store tab will now direct you to the full [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]in-game store.

[i]Black Ops 6[/i] will have its own individual user interface designed to easily get players into the modes and content they want to play. Players can access Campaign, Multiplayer, and Zombies from the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] game UI. Look out for new updates to the gunsmith, playlist selection, and social showcase within [i]Black Ops 6[/i]!

[b]Phase 3: Season 01 ([Redacted])[/b]

When Season 01 begins, the UI will enter its fully realized state. [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] will continue to be the primary Game Tiles on the Home tab and players will be able to instantly access both [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]for a faster, more direct path to gameplay.

The Store tab will now direct all players to the full [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]in-game stores based on what you have installed.

A Battle Pass tab will be introduced in Season 01 with similar functionality as the Store tab, directing players to the full Battle Pass within [i]Black Ops 6[/i] or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].

With the Season 01 update, [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] will also have its own individual user interface with improvements similar to the [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]UI.

[b]Changes to Features and Settings Management[/b]

Players will be able to manage some global settings at the top Call of Duty level of the UI that apply to all games. Settings in this bucket will be automatically imported from your previous title.

Other settings that are more game-specific can be managed at the individual title levels of the UI (e.g. gameplay settings related to new mechanics like Omnimovement). Settings at this level will not be automatically imported from prior games.
[h2]Get the Latest on Black Ops 6 and More[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fffaf7e3f616e463fbf49d4d046740fad2ce7b34.jpg[/img]

[i]*Final UI subject to change, may vary by player.[/i]

Stay one step ahead with the latest official [i]Black Ops 6[/i] information by checking the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog]Call of Duty Blog[/url] frequently as we approach the October 25 launch date.

[i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] is published by Activision. Development for the game is led by Treyarch, in partnership with Raven Software. Additional development support provided (in alphabetical order) by Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Infinity Ward, and Sledgehammer Games.

[i]For more information, please visit [url=http://www.callofduty.com/]www.callofduty.com[/url] and [url=http://www.youtube.com/callofduty]www.youtube.com/callofduty[/url], and follow @Activision and @CallofDuty on X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, and Facebook. For Call of Duty Updates, follow @CODUpdates on X (formerly Twitter).[/i]

notes.title: Black Ops 6: Multiplayer modes, maps, and more
notes.notes:
[b][u]Launch Modes for Multiplayer[/u][/b]

As you stalk the dark corridors of the Black Ops 6 Lobby, expect a wealth of available Modes for your Quick Play Matches, Moshpits, and other Playlists. Additional Modes will continue to drop during the Preseason and Season 01, in the weeks after the October 25 game launch.

Note: For each Quick Play Match or Playlist, you’re able to quickly press the “Info” button and confirm the Team Size, Maximum Players, Map Size, Available Maps, and Game Modes.

[b]Standard Modes[/b]

[b]Team Deathmatch (6v6)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b513e9c7fa42b99b0d79c4dcadf2084a8571d44c.jpg[/img]
Eliminate enemy players to earn scores for your team. Face Off Alternate Mode also supports Team Deathmatch.

[b]Domination (6v6)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ee9e67e2a27f3d85b943f7fc6d9cf6dc141777ea.jpg[/img]
Capture, hold and defend objectives to earn score for your team. Note that Domination Flags now include a small zone around the flag itself where scoring occurs. Face Off Alternate Mode also supports Domination.

[b]Search and Destroy (6v6)[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/16cde980156e80962dfff10b1c6e0289b6c0082c.jpg[/img]

[b][u]Launch Maps for Multiplayer[/u][/b]

Recap: All the [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]launch maps are small to medium-sized, with traditional three-lane routes and have been meticulously designed to fully realize the signature [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops[/i] experience. This means offering rapid, energetic combat, along with a variety of scenic set-pieces, cover opportunities, and ranged thoroughfares to ensure your favorite style of play is catered to, from close quarter strikes to long-range sniping, with emphasis always on the action. This culminates into tighter gameplay that’s perfectly suited to Omnimovement.

Maps are split into two main categories: There are 12 brand-new Core 6v6 maps. In addition, there are four brand-new, compact-sized Strike maps designed to be played in either Face Off 6v6 or 2v2 configurations. Below is a showcase of all the maps along with final Tac-Maps.

[b][u]Core Maps (6v6)[/u][/b]

[b](Core 6v6) [/b]

[b][u]Operators and Factions (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/u][/b]

There are over 20 Black Ops 6 Operators to choose from at launch, with 11 allied to the Rogue Black Ops Faction, and 10 allied to Crimson One.

[b]Factions Overview[/b]

Operators are chosen from one of two main Factions, with some affiliations to other groups within these conclaves (for example, Grigori Weaver is “Ex-Requiem”). The overarching goals of each faction is as follows:

[b]Rogue Black Ops[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fabc94c7a26fe7eb2d4987a1fd6f3435c725562e.jpg[/img]
On the run and hunted by their former employers - the Rogue Black Ops team seek to uncover the truth of the infiltration of the CIA and expose the conspiracy for what it is. All while staying alive and clearing their names.

Without the financial or technological backing of the US, Woods and his squad find themselves having to strike uneasy alliances with the criminal underground, as well as with old enemies, to equip themselves.

As they no longer have state backing, much of their equipment is either improvised, supplied by friends/contacts from other intelligence services, purchased from criminals, or supplied on the promise of future favors owed. They know who’s hunting them and refer to them by the name Crimson One.

[b]Crimson One[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/97390b07e3d41bbe6cd8657a38dab93362bf27b2.jpg[/img]
Crimson One represents the CIA operation initiated to hunt down the Rogue squad. The team is officially sanctioned by the CIA and has access to all intel and tools to get the job done.

It is made up of elite Black Ops soldiers to get the job done and led by the imposing Jackson Caine.

With the CIA infiltrated, Crimson One represents the CIA operation initiated to hunt down and silence Adler, Woods, and their team, permanently.

notes.title: Anti-Toxicity Report: Modern Warfare III results and Black Ops 6 launch
notes.notes:
The Call of Duty team is dedicated to fostering a positive and welcoming community for all players. Part of these ongoing initiatives involve the development and use of technology to help our teams combat disruptive behavior, in accordance with the Call of Duty Code of Conduct.

In today’s Progress Report, the Disruptive Behavior team shares the latest results and upgrades made to Call of Duty’s anti-toxicity tools, which will reinforce the ongoing work toward deploying our anti-toxicity systems for the launch of [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops 6[/i].
[h3]Voice & Text Moderation in Black Ops 6 on Day One[/h3]
Voice and text moderation systems designed to combat toxic behavior already deployed in [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® [/i]III will launch with [i]Black Ops 6[/i] on day one on October 25. This includes the global availability (excluding Asia) of Call of Duty’s AI-powered voice moderation system in English, Spanish, and Portuguese. Call of Duty will also expand voice moderation support to French and German for [i]Black Ops 6[/i] at launch.

Text-based moderation of in-game text chat and usernames in twenty languages will be deployed for [i]Black Ops 6[/i] on day one.

The Disruptive Behavior team knows that hype and passion is part of Call of Duty’s DNA. Voice and text-based moderation tools in Call of Duty don’t target our competitive spirit – it enforces against behavior identified in the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/values]Call of Duty franchise Code of Conduct[/url], targeting harassment and derogatory language. Similar to [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], the Call of Duty Code of Conduct will be visible during the initial in-game flow when players first launch core multiplayer modes in [i]Black Ops 6[/i], asking players to acknowledge the Code of Conduct pillars.
[h3]Over 45 million Text Messages Blocked, Across 20 Languages[/h3]
Since Modern Warfare (2019), Call of Duty has collaborated with Community Sift to support text-based moderation. In August, our text moderation expanded from 14 to 20 languages.

Call of Duty’s text moderation is available in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Chinese (Traditional and Simplified), Turkish, Dutch, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Finnish, and Romanian.

Call of Duty has implemented a new analysis system for username reports to enhance efficiency and accuracy, surfacing critical reports to our moderation team for investigation and action.

The Disruptive Behavior team has also been emphasizing proactive measures for text moderation activity, reducing exposure to disruptive behavior for our community. The system also analyzes text chat traffic in near real-time, resulting in the blocking of over 45 million text-based messages in violation of the Call of Duty Code of Conduct since November 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ad3a03681d3c621e8e8eaffb2fc5c17953b1fba1.jpg[/img]
[h3]Exposure to Voice Toxicity Dropped 43%; French and German Support Added for Launch[/h3]
Call of Duty’s [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2023/08/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-warzone-anti-toxicity-progress-report]proactive voice moderation strategy[/url], powered by ToxMod, has helped reduce exposure to disruptive voice chat for millions of players since its global launch (excluding Asia) last year.

Since rolling out an improved voice chat enforcement in June 2024, Call of Duty has seen a combined 67% reduction in repeat offenders of voice-chat based offenses in Modern Warfare III and Call of Duty: Warzone. In July 2024, 80% of players that were issued a voice chat enforcement since launch did not re-offend. Exposure to disruptive voice chat continues to fall, dropping by 43% since January 2024.

At launch, [i]Black Ops 6[/i] will expand its voice moderation to French and German, in addition to English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9f45388f9235077bff641223369b1a5ba0ad6e92.jpg[/img]
[h3]Call of Duty Collaborates to Battle Disruptive Behavior[/h3]
The Disruptive Behavior team is continually making improvements to reduce our community’s exposure to disruptive behavior as well as enhancing our moderation effectiveness across all types of social interactions in Call of Duty. These improvements include improved messaging to players, Code of Conduct updates, and enhancements to our enforcement strategies.

As part of this work, Call of Duty has been working with the California Institute of Technology (Caltech) [url=https://www.caltech.edu/about/news/caltech-and-activision-publishing-team-up-to-combat-bad-behavior-online]since 2022[/url] which has resulted in [url=https://research.activision.com/publications/2024/02/Challenges-in-Moderating-Disruptive-Player-Behavior]research paper[/url] publication and improvements to our disruptive behavior approach which include reduced time to moderation enforcement as a result of Caltech’s research contribution.

The team has also worked closely with the University of Chicago Booth School of Business and their Product Innovation student cohort. This collaboration began in 2022 and continues to this day, with results of developed research providing our team with insights to better identify and combat disruptive behavior.

Additionally, the team is actively engaged in research surrounding disruptive behavior and prosocial activities in gaming. The knowledge gained from these research initiatives are valuable input to be fed back into the game as part of Call of Duty’s overall strategy to combat disruptive behavior.

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Campaign: The Story So Far, part 2
notes.notes:
In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/4705789239623998524]part 1 of The Story So Far[/url], we covered the [i]Black Ops [/i]story starting in the early 1960s through the late 1980s with major story beats and character profiles influenced by the narratives of [i]Call of Duty®: Black Ops[/i], [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops Cold War[/i], and [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops II[/i].

[previewyoutube=h0uxvKUjsj4;full][/previewyoutube]

It’s now time to set the stage for [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] so you’re ready to dive right into the Campaign when the game launches on Friday, October 25.
[h2]Campaign — The Next Chapter of Black Ops[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/62fe7437b67b9b7b42a362102311953cbc06876d.jpg[/img]

Forced to go rogue. Hunted from within.

Enter a period of transition and upheaval in global politics, characterized by the end of the Cold War and the rise of the United States as a single superpower. The Gulf War dominated headlines and there was growing mistrust in government reflected across the music, television, and pop culture of the time.

While the Gulf War commands the global spotlight, a shadowy clandestine force has infiltrated the highest levels of the CIA, branding anyone who resists as traitors. Exiled from their agency and country that once hailed them as heroes, [i]Black Ops[/i] veteran Frank Woods and his team find themselves hunted by the military machine that created them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/44361cf1b27df5d3633b296caed069f4a8ba9434.jpg[/img]

Join Woods and his protégé Troy Marshall, both now working for CIA handler Jane Harrow, a fearless and brilliant leader who helps manage their relationships in the agency. However, when an operation goes wrong, Woods and Marshall are suspended and forced to go rogue.

They must build their own team of rogue agents, including Felix Neumann, a technical genius, and Sevati Dumas, a mysterious assassin. The infamous Russell Adler also returns! His allegiances and motivations remain unclear, but the team needs all the help they can get.

In the thrilling action to come, there’s just one rule above every other: Don’t trust anyone.
[h2]Bios — Jane Harrow, Troy Marshall, Felix Neumann, Sevati Dumas[/h2]
Meet the cast of characters most important to the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Campaign narrative. We covered Frank Woods, Russell Adler, and Helen Park in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/4705789239623998524]Part 1[/url]. Now we’re highlighting some new faces you’ll encounter in the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Campaign:
[h3]Jane Harrow[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5e796658b5bffcdaa996d0acbc44232e8109fa43.jpg[/img]

An operations specialist in the CIA’s Special Activities Division (SAD), Jane Harrow coordinates mission planning and intelligence gathering alongside multiple paramilitary handlers. Harrow reports directly to SAD Deputy Director Daniel Livingstone.
[h3]Troy Marshall[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ac748a3bf9e600e4bc067d7b6b86e580f25723d5.jpg[/img]

Marshall has been making a name for himself in the field. A protégé of Frank Woods, he is a methodical leader driven by a strong moral compass. With a single-minded focus on overcoming adversity and a stubborn streak that borders on recklessness, it isn’t surprising that Woods and Marshall share common ground. Both men are now working with CIA handler Jane Harrow.
[h3]Felix Neumann[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/597efc9f7b5f52132177862fdb223c9a1db5d6fb.jpg[/img]

Raised in East Berlin after the formation of the GDR, Felix Neumann excelled at sports but showed little interest in them, preferring to read or tinker with appliances and electronic devices. Following compulsory military service, Neumann was recruited and trained by the Stasi.

However, after several years within their ranks Felix began to regret his association with the brutal Stasi. He started selling state secrets to West Germany and its allies to build a nest egg, with a plan to eventually flee East Germany. After successfully escaping to the West, he made a living by providing the criminal underworlds of Europe with his technological expertise and inventions.
[h3]Sevati Dumas[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/279a40542d35e3901fc19785841813ef914c789f.jpg[/img]

Taken in by the Guild, one of the Avalon Crime Factions, at a young age, Sevati Dumas loyally served the crime family as they trained her to become an assassin and espionage expert. Her allegiance changed when she met the love of her life, an idealistic man who helped reveal the ugliness of the criminal underworld.

When Dumas expressed her desire to quit the life of an assassin, the crime family manipulated her into thinking that her partner was an inside agent for a rival crime family. She orchestrated his death, but afterward discovered that the ordeal was a setup to keep her in line.

Sevati disowned her adopted family and became an independent assassin, funneling her resources into waging a personal war against the Avalon Crime Faction. Her exploits eventually caught the eye of CIA operatives in Europe who were eager to use her uncanny ability to track down elusive targets.
[h2]Campaign: Your First Steps[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/339540404d07749c626230f40bd688908b2ccb4b.jpg[/img]

Select Single Player from the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] main menu to reach the Campaign screen. Get an overview of the first mission and view completion rewards earned for progressing and follow the prompts when starting the Campaign to choose your difficulty setting.
[h2]Choose Your Difficulty[/h2]
Choose one of four difficulty levels when playing the Campaign. The higher the difficulty, the greater the challenge. You can change the game’s difficulty at any time.
[list]	[*][b]Recruit:[/b] For players who are new to [i]Call of Duty[/i].[/*]	[*][b]Regular: [/b]Your abilities in combat will be tested.[/*]	[*][b]Hardened:[/b] Your skills will be strained.[/*]	[*][b]Veteran:[/b] You will not survive.[/*][/list][h3]Gameplay Tips[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5a0ab20a155a334ddb72b3777a23dbdf5156f493.jpg[/img]

Consider these tips when getting started with the Campaign to make your journey into the next [i]Black Ops [/i]chapter a smooth one:

[b]Know Your Inventory: [/b]Check your in-game backpack for supplies throughout the Campaign. Opening the backpack reveals the Equipment Wheel selection screen where various tools and explosives can be equipped, including series favorites like the RC-XD.

[b]Check Your Vitals: [/b]Keep your Operator in fighting shape by watching the health and armor meters on your HUD. If your health bar depletes all the way, your Operator goes down for the count. Seek out armor pieces in the environment to bulk up your defenses.

[b]Renovations: [/b]Seek out piles of cash while playing the Campaign to invest in your Safehouse, a manor perched atop a granite cliff that used to serve as a KGB Black Site in the 1950s and ‘60s. As the Safehouse evolves, gain additional customization options to fine tune your Operator for the next mission.

[b]Evidence Board: [/b]Check the manor’s Evidence Board between missions to access additional intel and mission briefings. This is where the tactical planning occurs. Piece together the puzzles within the storyline between deciding on your best course of action.
[h2]Campaign Mission Rewards[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/471407008be41bebfd0f663c92a505c52eb2abab.jpg[/img]
