notes.notes:
[b][u]CALL OF DUTY: NEXT COMMS AND THE BLACK OPS 6 BETA[/u][/b]

The following Blog is one of five Deep Dives into the announcements at the 2024 Call of Duty: NEXT showcase, as well as bringing you a wealth of free, official guides to every aspect of the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer Beta that starts on August 30**. Be sure to read all the following content to ensure you’re up to date with breaking news and Beta content:
[list]	[*][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/4599951478186690892]Blog 1: Black Ops 6: Global Gameplay Systems[/url]. [/b] Detailing content – like Omnimovement, Gunsmith changes, Global Weapon Builds, Classic Prestige, and Mastery Camos – applicable to all the different games and modes, mainly focused on innovations across Multiplayer Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i].[/*]	[*][b]Blog 2: Black Ops 6: Multiplayer Intel. [/b]All of the specific announcements related to [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer from Call of Duty: NEXT. You’re reading this blog now![/*]	[*][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/4599951478186670233]Blog 3: Black Ops 6: Zombies Intel[/url].[/b] All of the new details regarding Round-Based Zombies in [i]Black Ops 6[/i], including information on Liberty Falls, Wonder Weapons, and more, straight from Call of Duty: NEXT.[/*]	[*][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/4599951478186962107]Blog 4: Black Ops 6: Warzone Integrations[/url]. [/b] Important information regarding the brand-new Area 99 Resurgence Map, as well as new gameplay innovations, Mastery Camos, and more.[/*]	[*][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/4599951478187089360]Blog 5: Black Ops 6 Beta: Everything You Need to Know[/url]. [/b] Ready to drop into the Multiplayer Beta? Prepare yourself with this game-winning overview and guide to levelling up to ensure you unlock all the Beta Rewards, including the two exclusive Operator skins![/*][/list]
[b][u]BLOG 2: THIS IS BLACK OPS 6 MULTIPLAYER[/u][/b]

An incredible showcase of brand-new locations from the 16 launch maps. Innovations across game Modes. Key evolutions in how you create and save your Loadouts, utilize weapons, equipment and Perks. And more.

This is [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer.

[previewyoutube=GYG_h-L-K2E;full][/previewyoutube]

Read on to gain all the knowledge you need before you jump into the Black Ops 6 Beta on August 30!

[b][u]THE MULTIPLAYER MAPS[/u][/b]

Set to deliver an impressive selection of all brand-new maps at launch, the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer team is focusing on incredible movement and fast-paced, explosive action, and this vision for the game extends to the creation of the 16 multiplayer maps.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c445f27d18701fc4c16a662247ae427eb60826c8.jpg[/img]

All the launch maps are small to medium-sized maps with traditional three-lane routes and have been meticulously designed to fully realize the signature [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops[/i] experience. This means offering rapid, energetic combat, along with a variety of scenic set-pieces, cover opportunities, and ranged thoroughfares to ensure your favorite style of play is catered to, from close quarter strikes to long-range sniping, with emphasis always on the action. This culminates into tighter gameplay that’s perfectly suited to Omnimovement.

Maps are split into two main categories: There are 12 brand-new Core 6v6 maps. In addition, there are four brand-new, compact-sized Strike maps designed to be played in 6v6 configurations.

[b]Confirmed Launch Maps[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dfe3b03184e7e6ae6bba05f7c7188bf1ff3d7b75.jpg[/img]

Here’s a list of the 16 confirmed Multiplayer Maps for launch, along with some basic intel on the eight maps from this list that you’ll be playing during the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Beta:

[b]Core 6v6 Maps:[/b]
[list]	[*]Babylon (Playable at Beta)[/*]	[*]Derelict (Playable at Beta)[/*]	[*]Lowtown (Available at Launch)[/*]	[*]Payback (Available at Launch)[/*]	[*]Protocol (Training Map at Beta, MP Map Available at Launch)[/*]	[*]Red Card (Available at Launch)[/*]	[*]Rewind (Playable at Beta)[/*]	[*]Scud (Playable at Beta)[/*]	[*]Skyline (Playable at Beta)[/*]	[*]Subsonic (Available at Launch)[/*]	[*]Vault (Available at Launch)[/*]	[*]Vorkuta (Available at Launch)[/*][/list]
[b]Strike Maps:[/b]
[list]	[*]Gala (Playable at Beta)[/*]	[*]Pit (Playable at Beta)[/*]	[*]Sand House (Available at Launch)[/*]	[*]Stakeout (Playable at Beta)[/*][/list]
[b][u]Black Ops 6 Beta: Core 6v6 Maps[/u][/b]

[b]Babylon [/b]

[i](Core 6v6, Playable at Beta)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c49ec0a32ff8801dfb984d079c410f0fb21c0893.jpg[/img]

Battle amongst the ruins of an ancient city, climbing on its crumbled columns and crawling underneath the palace. There’s plenty of verticality to make use of here, so stay limber as you circle the central alter and seek out the best ground. Back out to the chapel or depot for more concealed views or get heated and rush the middle.

[b]Derelict[/b]

[i](Core 6v6, Playable at Beta)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6727ebb2ac346d2617dc5e067afa771a5c67950e.jpg[/img]

Deep in the Appalachian Mountains, a train graveyard lies shrouded by a lush forest. Abandoned and forgotten, this derelict depot along the NOR Appalachian Railroad has become a prime ambush point for Rogue Black Ops and Crimson One to face off in a deadly skirmish.

[b]Rewind[/b]

[i](Core 6v6, Playable at Beta)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f025fd976bef8ccfd56388d07c8e1765d3b1457c.jpg[/img]

Visit the Liberty Shopping Plaza right on the edge of Liberty Falls, West Virginia and wreak havoc through the strip mall. This 6v6 map has a unique layout, as two outer lanes are connected by multiple routes through and around the shops, a video store in the middle housing several major objectives.

[b]Scud[/b]

[i](Core 6v6, Playable at Beta)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7df4cd2045a616cf997e62dfb4d9dced207fd00b.jpg[/img]

Deploy to a desert military outpost following a devastating attack. The damaged radar dish and nearby buildings have taken several hits, the air thick with smoke from the surrounding fires. Bunker down in the depot or HQ or flank enemies in the trenches. Watch for snipers near the radar dish; its base provides a near 360-degree view.

[b]Skyline[/b]

[i](Core 6v6, Playable at Beta)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ef3577a7605ad2c3d6e1f60b61d2d90b1d3e29d4.jpg[/img]

Take in breathtaking views of the surrounding countryside from the rooftop of a luxury resort featuring an exquisite penthouse with access to a lounge, kitchen, gym, and pool. Descend into the panic room to cross under the map or fight in the open around the victims of a recent hit job.

[b][u]Black Ops 6 Beta: Strike 6v6 Maps[/u][/b]

[b]Gala[/b]

[i](Strike Map, Playable at Beta)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/95cbdab026898291c2312ec5721f5df5df21d9de.jpg[/img]

Explore the aftermath of an annual fundraising event in Washington, D.C. Get up on stage or kick back in the lounge. Along the sides, move through a makeshift bar, coatroom, and campaign stand. Every move counts on this tiny map, so get out there and punch the winning ticket.

[b]Pit[/b]

[i](Strike Map, Playable at Beta)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5d9a40b3a9f1b00a529f2f8d1601be490538dc14.jpg[/img]

Burrow into a small subsection of an underground mining tunnel and collide in the central cave. A ventilation shaft casts some natural light over the cave, the mine tracks within circling back to the narrow tunnels. Climb up the ladders to reach an overhead vantage point or weave between the mine carts for ground floor cover.

[b]Stakeout[/b]

[i](Strike Map, Playable at Beta)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/48e2da27a2ac994f9ecbb735ed9a305323ca6a79.jpg[/img]

A stakeout in the Mediterranean region of Avalon has been compromised as Operators breach the small apartment, battling through the living room, kitchen, bedrooms, and spilling out onto the balcony. Leftover surveillance equipment marks the progress of the conducted intel-gathering, a smashed-out wall giving the former agents easy access to their gear.

[b]FREE OFFICIAL GUIDES: [/b]Need exclusive tactical guides to every Beta Multiplayer map? We have a guide with an interactive Tac-Map and quick tips so you’re ready to go on August 30.

[b]Protocol[/b]

[i](Training Map at Beta)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d5c60e6b10aa28b443019f2102783a491dcbd41e.jpg[/img]

Omnimovement is definitely a gamechanger, but it’s also designed for players of every skill level to enjoy, and for those feeling a little intimidated about controlling an Operator for the first time in the Beta, then ensure you spend time listening to Frank Woods taking you through your paces on the all-new Training Course:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/01d332ae9418a05762183834107be084fd0986a4.jpg[/img]

There’s no better way to get used to all the Omnimovement innovations and combat basics required to be proficient in [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] than jumping into the Training Course featured on the Multiplayer map, Protocol. Follow the training missions assigned to you and pay attention to the instructions. Run around the Training Course as often as you wish and practice your favorite maneuvers before facing real players in the Beta moshpits!

[b][u]THE MULTIPLAYER MODES[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4571d6e13f3118364b541c62c8cd027fae51137a.jpg[/img]

Along with a vast selection of new maps to play, [i]Black Ops 6[/i] is set to offer an equally impressive variety of modes, including many not yet revealed at Call of Duty: NEXT or Beta. For [i]Black Ops 6[/i], Treyarch took the time and looked at all the standard core modes, added some improvements, and ensured they played amazingly well. These improvements include adjustments for Domination and Hardpoint (see below), as well as a brand-new mode you’ll be able to play during the Beta: Kill Order.

[b]New Mode: Kill Order[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/68ff370e7f07d481356db4452346133385517856.jpg[/img]

[i]Eliminate the enemy High Value Target (HVT) while keeping your HVT alive. HVT eliminations earn bonus score for your team.[/i]

Kill Order is a 6v6 respawn mode that pits two teams against each other, each with their own High Value Target, or HTV, at any given time. Teams score points for all eliminations throughout the match, however focusing on defeating the enemy’s HVT is worth the largest number of points, followed by eliminations by the HVT, then normal eliminations.

Also expect to play the Face Off Kill Order variant. This follows all the same rules as Kill Order with two caveats. As with all Face Off modes, Scorestreaks are completely disabled. Additionally, Face Off modes will also take place on more compact Strike maps, which can lead to even greater chances for “tactical chaos”!

[b]Other Announced Modes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/42f5f60e5482bc22f6a72f22756c01f0f51a6268.jpg[/img]

Other modes announced at Call of Duty: NEXT include the following:

[b]Team Deathmatch: [/b]

[i]Eliminate enemy players to earn scores for your team.[/i]

[b]Domination: [/b]

[i]Capture, hold and defend objectives to earn scores for your team.[/i]

For [i]Black Ops 6[/i], expect the scoring footprint of each Domination flag to be larger, more visibly marked and renamed as a “Zone”, offering greater tactical opportunities no matter whether you’re attacking or defending.

[b]Hardpoint: [/b]

[i]Capture and hold the Hardpoint zone to earn scores for your team. [/i]

To heighten the tactical tension and help teams working well together, a number has been added to each Hardpoint zone for players to call out. Play like the pros and call out your rotations to your team.

[b]Face Off: [/b]

[i]This follows the rules of a particular game mode (Team Deathmatch, for example), with Scorestreaks disabled. [/i]

[b]Gunfight:[/b]

[i]Eliminate all enemy players using pre-determined classes to win the round. No respawns.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cbe8bd474c4148c427d01b09bbfa0fb0f89d39a8.jpg[/img]

Gunfight is a 2v2 mode that takes place specifically on Strike maps. In this single-life mode, teams must either eliminate the other team or capture the zone in the center of the map when it appears. Each player will have the same exact Loadout as each other player during a round. Every round, the Loadouts will randomize and players will continue to battle until one team reaches the number of wins required to win.

[b]FREE OFFICIAL GUIDES: [/b]Want exclusive tactical guides to every Beta Multiplayer mode from Kill Order to Face Off? We’ve got you covered.

[b][u]THE MULTIPLAYER GAMEPLAY[/u][/b]

[i]Black Ops 6 [/i]is driven by ensuring the gameplay feels like a Call of Duty: Black Ops game, delivering fast, fluid, and frenetic action (which can be turned up a few notches on Strike maps). Let’s start with the adjustments to TTK:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/24489e4bfafb256a7007cc20b02677446c75d89d.jpg[/img]

[b]TTK[/b]: The Time To Kill in [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]has been fine-tuned over the course of development to synergize with innovations like Omnimovement and of course with a heavy focus on weapon balance, including the 12 brand new weapons at launch, never before seen in the franchise. Time to Kill is slightly faster than players may remember from [i]Black Ops Cold War[/i] Multiplayer while still retaining the ability to react to incoming damage and have meaningful engagements, or disengagements if you prefer. While your enemies won’t have visible health bars, a personal contextual health bar when taking damage is one of the many bespoke features that you’ll find on your own HUD…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e5cf1101182a53faf74bbb8b81590b056840bd7a.jpg[/img]

[b]Heads Up: Display Options: [/b]One of the many innovations made to the game is the flexibility of the HUD, and the [i]Black Ops 6 [/i] Beta is the place to try out a few visual examples in preparation for a full complement at launch. Simply access the Barracks, or Settings “cog” menu, select “Interface”, scroll over to “Gameplay HUD”, and choose from the Presets that suit your style of play, as well a variety of Interface Element Colors and Settings.

[b]Audio Improvements: [/b]A cornerstone of [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]gameplay is how the audio reacts to your actions, and this was a key priority during development. You’ll hear for yourself during the Beta, but making sure a player can hear the most important audio information, at the most important time within a match, is a key feature. Whether it’s ensuring spatially accurate gunplay or footsteps, [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]has audio prioritization when you need it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5f3f611ef3a2f54337daf285d13c6c44ae033bf7.jpg[/img]

[b]Slide Cancelling: [/b]More advanced maneuvers that take a modicum of skill to pull off are also part of [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]Multiplayer and designed to ensure fast-paced and fluid combat. We can confirm Slide Cancelling in any direction thanks to Omnimovement, as well as other favorite maneuvering elements, are part of the game, and you can test this out in the Beta.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/002bf61bdf6b3291b183a5283512acf9b90ac691.jpg[/img]

[b]Body Shield: [/b]If you’re behind an enemy at close quarters, and you require an extra layer of protection, you can choose to double-tap the Melee button and grab them to use as a Body Shield, rough-housing them around for a few seconds while using your foe to absorb any incoming ordnance. Drop the foe with a quick dispatch or Finishing Move before they expire.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/68a0cc080d9cd91d7c90d8afda499a39420c186e.jpg[/img]

[b]Dynamic Death Camera: [/b]With the number of hit zones more than doubling compared to previous titles, the way you succumb to enemy fire results in far more bespoke animations. The dynamic camera takes this one step further, following your final takedown in the Kill Cam, and focusing on the death animations. For example, if you’re rocked by an exploding lethal device, the Kill Cam follows your body in its spectacular demise!

[b]Other Features and Enhancements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6bc7088030e20a184c9f9a9fe094577fa892bfbf.jpg[/img]

As well as quickening the time it takes to get into a match, [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]Multiplayer brings a variety of refinements and fan-favorite elements to the game. These include:
[list]	[*][b]Map Voting: [/b]Available at Beta, you’re able to vote in the Lobby for your preferred map or a classified random map, prior to a match.[/*]	[*][b]Best Plays: [/b]Depending on the mode and the match-up, expect the final Dynamic Kill Cam to showcase the best play of the game, prior to the Winners’ Circle. For Search & Destroy mode, players will view a Final Kill Cam.[/*]	[*][b]Winners’ Circle: [/b]The most impressive players of the winning team in a match receive their own Winners’ Circle showcase, with some of their statistical competence on display. This is also a location where you can celebrate your prowess more individually by employing a favorite Emote, too![/*]	[*][b]Theater Mode: [/b]Though not available in the Beta, the Multiplayer experience of [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]brings a fully featured Theater Mode at launch, allowing you a robust suite of viewing options, including the ability to watch, pause, slow down, speed up, and play back your previous gameplay, including the ability to take screenshots.[/*]	[*][b]Ranked Play:[/b] We’re excited to confirm that Multiplayer Ranked Play will be coming to [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. Not only that; Ranked Play arrives at the earliest point ever in a Call of Duty title, only a few weeks after launch at the start of Season 1![/*]	[*][b]Additional Global Gameplay Systems:[/b] Ensure you read Blog 1, which details Omnimovement, Gunsmith changes, Global Weapon Builds, Classic Prestige, Mastery Camos, and more![/*][/list]

[b][u]MULTIPLAYER WEAPONS, LOADOUTS[/u][/b]

[b]Loadouts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae7b20cd52945147440257acedf789ce2adc2a4d.jpg[/img]

Your pre-match Loadouts screen, which allows for up to ten total Loadouts to be created, renamed, duplicated, or deleted, is based around a weapons bench you can see in the background, behind the Loadout UI. This is updated as you access each part of your Loadout. Your Loadout – also known as Create-a-Class – is comprised of the following:
[list]	[*][b]Primary Weapon[/b][/*]	[*][b]Secondary Weapon[/b][/*]	[*][b]Melee Weapon[/b][/*]	[*][b]Tactical[/b][/*]	[*][b]Lethal[/b][/*]	[*][b]Field Upgrade[/b][/*]	[*][b]Perks[/b][/*]	[*][b]Combat Specialty[/b][/*]	[*][b]Wildcard[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Primary Weapons[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8f76acd5fa11ff9241981e3cbcee2ec23a73f8e2.jpg[/img]

Your main, and usually hardest-hitting weapon, used for most of your time in combat. Gunsmith is available for this weapon. Choose from:
[list]	[*][b]Assault Rifles [/b][/*]	[*][b]SMGs[/b][/*]	[*][b]Shotguns[/b][/*]	[*][b]LMGs[/b][/*]	[*][b]Marksman Rifles[/b][/*]	[*][b]Sniper Rifles[/b][/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a20669139d1a845e50ef71adf971f83736491843.jpg[/img]

[b]Weapon Examples: [/b]Expect 12 Primary Weapons to be available to use during the [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]Beta. Vault Edition players can also try out Mastercrafted versions of some of the most potent weapons on offer, as follows:

[b]Assault Rifle: AMES 85[/b]

[b]Vault Edition Mastercraft Blueprint “Plague Doctor”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c51a9cf7630ab75740b989efb409f74dfaa6d3f4.jpg[/img]

[i]Full-auto assault rifle. Impressive accuracy and a suitable rate of fire makes this an excellent weapon for mid to long range engagements.[/i]

[b]SMG: Jackal PDW[/b]

[b]Vault Edition Mastercraft Blueprint “Scourge”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d01b6cea584241b7d21f79eb7a1096f781eff17c.jpg[/img]

[i]Full-auto SMG. Great mobility and handling make this an easy choice for Operators who aggressively seek CQB engagements.[/i]

[b]Shotgun: Marine SP[/b]

[b]Vault Edition Mastercraft Blueprint “Unrepentant”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/478991bfb46b92bf37bc4154c1bdc17914ab1328.jpg[/img]

[i]Pump-action shotgun. Powerful and versatile with a short cycling time that allows for rapid target acquisition. Hand loaded with 1-shot kill potential in close quarters.[/i]

[b]Sniper Rifle: LR 7.62[/b]

[b]Vault Edition Mastercraft Blueprint “Brainstorm”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d2b10d7165bb6750f8620b667edb20ce608ea3b3.jpg[/img]

[i]Bolt-action sniper rifle. The LR 7.62 delivers high damage with minimal recoil and slower handling. One-shot kill to the head, chest, and arms. Focus while ADS to steady.[/i]

[b]Secondary Weapons[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9ec7d4839c859a6bbd7113273a04de807f626fce.jpg[/img]

Your back-up weapon, used in emergency or context-specific situations. Gunsmith is available for this weapon. Choose from:
[list]	[*][b]Pistols[/b][/*]	[*][b]Launchers[/b][/*][/list]
[b]Weapon Example: [/b]Expect three Secondary Weapons to be available to use during the Black Ops 6 Beta, including this impressive sidearm:

[b]GS45[/b]

[i]Semi-auto pistol. The GS45’s auto round makes the sidearm unmatched in close range stopping power.[/i]

[b]Melee Weapons[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f117b14982c7e0edf8d3ba7984ac2dd6db240133.jpg[/img]

Your third weapon is a close-quarters armament with no ranged ordnance. Gunsmith is available for this weapon (Cosmetics only).

[b]Weapon Example: [/b]Expect the Knife to be available to use during the [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]Beta. Vault Edition players can also try out a Mastercraft version of this blade:

[b]Knife[/b]

[b]Vault Edition Mastercraft Blueprint “Mind’s Eye”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2338682518bc1bdc71454a268482b1c1b075035d.jpg[/img]

[i]One hit kill. Military-issue tactical knife well-suited for CQC scenarios where stealth, speed, and lethality are required.[/i]

[b]NOTE: MELEE WEAPON USE: [/b]As you’d expect your Melee involves the same key or button press as Melee (for controllers, this is the Right thumbstick). Tap this for a gun butt melee. Hold to bring out your Melee weapon, which will remain equipped until you swap back to your Primary or Secondary.

[b]PLEASE NOTE: [/b]For a full list of all weapons and equipment available throughout the Beta, ensure you check out the free and official Black Ops 6 Guides.

[b]Tacticals[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1a611ee2f90e86f5ef3cc261ed91bb96d2ede640.jpg[/img]

Limited-per-life and reusable items that range from intel-gathering sensors to healing or disorientation devices, designed to offer a non-lethal advantage in combat.

[b]Equipment Examples: [/b]Expect five Tacticals to be available during the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Beta. Along with the Concussion and Tactical (Stun) grenades and the Stim Shot that refreshes your health and Tactical Sprint, be sure to try out the Prox Alarm; a set of two sticky alarms that ring and flash when an enemy is near, with tripped alarms showing up on allied minimaps.

[b]Lethals[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d81b25a2a93e60a574fce95ad90cf197ac5b5998.jpg[/img]

Limited-per-life items that harm enemies, usually via an explosion.

[b]Equipment Examples: [/b]Expect five Lethals to be available during the Black Ops 6 Beta, including the Frag, Sticky, and Thermo grenades, as well as the trusty Combat Axe. For perhaps the biggest explosion in this category, try out the Blast Trap, a planted explosive device that detonates when enemies approach.

[b]Field Upgrades[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/50cc80ec577796b8bb425f523a57199399c7d1b2.jpg[/img]

Impressive tactical or lethal devices that are powerful and recharge during a match after use.

[b]Equipment Examples: [/b]Expect five Field Upgrades to be available during the [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]Beta, with some being familiar (the Trophy System), some being a hybrid from previous games (the Assault Pack that drops extra ammo and equipment to resupply your team), and some well-suited to Black Ops, like Sleeper Agent. This allows you to infiltrate the enemy team, appearing as a friendly to them for a short duration. Kills extend the time you’re in disguise, though gunfire and closeness to the enemy reveals your true identity!

[b]Perks, Specialties, and Wildcards[/b]

The [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer Perk system brings innovation, familiarity, and streamlining to your initial choices when choosing the three abilities you bring to each MP match, with added depth as you ponder the advantages of Combat Specialties, as well as the Wildcard feature you can pick to fully flesh out your Operator.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b347544d9c37f7cbfc731487a8bed7ef22a573af.jpg[/img]

[b]Perk 1, 2, 3: [/b]You have a selection from all the available Perks to choose from in one of three different slots. This might be “Assassin” ([i]Enemies on a kill streak get a unique minimap marker and drop Bounty Packs when killed. Pick up the Packs for more Score) [/i]in Perk 1 or Double Time[i] (Greatly increased duration of Tactical Sprint) [/i]in Perk 3. You pick one Perk per slot, for a total of three Perks that activate immediately at the start of every match.

[b]“Combat Specialty”: [/b]In addition to the name and combat capabilities, each Black Ops 6 Perk has color associated with it. This visual reference denotes the Combat Specialty the Perk offers, but only if grouped with two other Perks of the same color (or Specialty).
[list]	[*]For example, “Engineer” (Perk 2) is color-coded blue, meaning it grants the Recon Combat Specialty, but only if your two other Perks (from Perk selections 1 and 3) are also color-coded blue (i.e., they are also grant the “Recon” Specialty).[/*]	[*]Choose three Perks of the same color in slots 1, 2, and 3, and you’re able to pick an additional Specialty.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Combat Specialties[/u][/b]

Equipping three Perks of the same Combat Specialty (Enforcer, Recon, or Strategist, denoted by the red, blue, or green color) will activate its Combat Specialty in-game. There are three, which are automatically added to the Specialty slot. If your three Perks are of differing colors (or Specialties), no Specialty is granted. The Black Ops 6 Beta has the following Specialties available:

[b]Enforcer (Red)[/b]

[i]Killing enemies grants a temporary buff to movement speed and health regeneration rate.[/i]

[b]Recon (Blue)[/b]

[i]Enemies can be seen through walls for a short time after respawn, a HUD edge indicator flashes when an enemy is outside your view, leave no death skulls when killing enemies.[/i]

[b]Strategist (Green)[/b]

[i]Earn a score bonus for objectives and destroying enemy content, see enemy content through walls a short distance, deploy equipment and Field Upgrades faster.[/i]

[b][u]Wildcards[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6a2fb220a6ef18a4917d1dee5f1d6d2912e6843c.jpg[/img]

Lastly, you can further augment your favorite Loadouts by adding a single Wildcard. Last utilized in [i]Black Ops Cold War[/i], these allow you to add a modifier that would normally bend or break the rules of the Create-a-Class system. The [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Beta has the following Wildcards examples available (with more at launch):

[b]Overkill[/b]

[i]Equip any non-melee weapon in Primary and Secondary slots.[/i]

[b]Gunfighter[/b]

[i]Receive three extra attachment points for your Primary Weapon.[/i]

[b]Perk Greed[/b]

[i]Equip an extra Perk.[/i]

[b][u]Scorestreaks[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e98b01956a3a866257cac4a0b093445d4b237c18.jpg[/img]

As well as bringing a Loadout to battle, you’re able to choose three Scorestreaks, some of the most powerful recon, tactical, or destructive tools at your disposal. These are earned by increasing your score count during a single life, as score resets if you die. Equip the Dispatcher (Green) Perk, and the score required to access each non-lethal Scorestreak is reduced. [i]Black Ops 6[/i] also has no limitations to the three Scorestreaks you can choose from: Pick any three you like. Examples include the following, which will be available in the Beta:
[list]	[*][b]Scout Pulse: [/b][i]Radar ping that reveals nearby enemies on the user’s minimap.[/i][/*]	[*][b]RC-XD: [/b][i]Deploys a small remote controlled, remote detonated explosive vehicle.[/i][/*]	[*][b]Hellstorm: [/b][i]Control a long-range missile with brake and boost capabilities and secondary missiles.[/i][/*]	[*][b]Interceptors: [/b][i]Call in a fighter jet squadron that eliminates enemy air targets.[/i][/*]	[*][b]Chopper Gunner: [/b][i]Take control of the door gun turret on an assault chopper.[/i][/*][/list]
[b][u]OPERATORS AND FACTIONS[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0c890f72a848f94b1201dbba7ab49e003355a07d.jpg[/img]

A partial roster of Operators has been unredacted: These are in-game characters you can play as and are chosen in the associated menu. Additional Operators will be available at launch, but here are the Operators you can pick from during the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Beta, from both the Rogue Black Ops and Crimson One Factions:

[b]Rogue Black Ops[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/65be8034bec65205db551d4a047ceeee0f401f93.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*]Adler (Vault Edition)[/*]	[*]Park (Vault Edition)[/*]	[*]Westpoint[/*]	[*]Nazir[/*]	[*]Bayan[/*]	[*]Marshall[/*][/list]
[b]Crimson One[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d324b336a7f73584a52a9aa7a7ac2f5c96a6e51d.jpg[/img]


[list]	[*]Brutus (Vault Edition)[/*]	[*]Klaus (Vault Edition)[/*]	[*]Caine[/*]	[*]Toro[/*]	[*]Bailey[/*]	[*]Stone[/*][/list]

[b]Note! [/b]Operator Westpoint has two limited skins (named “Squish” and “Squash”) that are only unlockable during the [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]Beta, which are available permanently at game launch.

[b][u]ADDITIONAL INTEL[/u][/b]

[b][u]Black Ops 6 Beta Rewards[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/98d66f54580e49235955289a9422fd387bc9a457.jpg[/img]

Earn cosmetic rewards by reaching Player Level milestones throughout the Multiplayer Open Beta that will persist through the launch of [i]Black Ops 6[/i] when it releases on October 25***.

The rewards and required levels follow:
[list]	[*]Level 2: “Beta Tester” Animated Emblem[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 6: “Beta Tag” Spray[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 11: “No Bugs” Weapon Charm[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 15: “Quick Draw” Emote[/*]	[*]Level 20: “Squish” Westpoint Operator Skin (only unlockable during Weekend One)[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 20: “Squash” Westpoint Operator Skin (unlocked during either Weekend)[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 23: “The Truth Lies” Loading Screen[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 27: “Beta Expert” Animated Calling Card[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 30: “Bug Smasher” Weapon Blueprint[/*][/list]
Stay up to date on all the latest information – updated by Treyarch – during the [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]Beta Weekends and beyond by visiting the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/patchnotes]Call of Duty Patch Notes[/url] page. Be sure to follow CODUpdates and Treyarch on X for additional, timely intel.

[b][u]Pre-purchase Digitally and Get the Reflect 115 Camo Pack, Vault Edition Available[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/93c60d8320b2587eb9ad594381fa03746dd555c7.jpg[/img]

Pre-purchase [i]Black Ops 6[/i] today, and you’ll receive a variety of pre-purchase benefits, including the brand-new Reflect 115 Camo Pack for [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]!

Pre-purchase the Digital Edition on PC to receive the following:

Woods Operator Pack*

Early Access to the Open Beta**

Pre-purchase the Vault Edition on PC and receive the previous rewards as well as the following:

BlackCell Season 1

Mastercraft Weapon Collection

GobbleGum Pack

Game Pass Subscribers are set to receive all Digital Edition benefits, and those who upgrade for $30 (or local equivalent) to the Vault Edition will receive all Vault Edition benefits.

Those players who have already pre-purchased [i]Black Ops 6[/i] will receive the Reflect 115 Camo Pack automatically.

The Reflect 115 Camo Pack consists of the Reflect 115 Mastery Camo for use in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. In addition, you receive three Flawless Aetherium Crystals, three Legendary Aether Tools, and three Ray Gun Weapon Cases for immediate use in [i]Modern Warfare Zombies[/i]. All content does not carry forward into [i]Black Ops 6[/i].

[b][u]Official Comms Active: Stay Informed. Not Misinformed[/u][/b]

Misinformation is everywhere: Ensure you stay one step ahead with the latest official [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]information by checking the Call of Duty Blog in the weeks up to launch with important comms you won’t want to miss.

[i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] is published by Activision. Development for the game is led by Treyarch, in partnership with Raven Software. Additional development support provided (in alphabetical order) by Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Infinity Ward, and Sledgehammer Games.

The Truth Lies.

[i]*Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III / Call of Duty: Warzone on the pre-purchased platform required to redeem Woods Operator Pack and Reflect 115 Camo Pack. Sold / downloaded separately. Must be redeemed by October 25, 2025.[/i]

[i]**Actual launch date(s) and platform availability of Open Beta subject to change. See www.callofduty.com/beta for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only. Internet connection required. Online multiplayer subscription may be required.[/i]

[/b]Detailing content – like Omnimovement, Gunsmith changes, Global Weapon Builds, Classic Prestige, and Mastery Camos – applicable to all the different modes, mainly focused on innovations across Multiplayer Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. [/b] All the specific announcements related to [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer from Call of Duty: NEXT.[/*]	[*][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/4599951478186670233]Blog 3: Black Ops 6: Zombies Intel[/url]. [/b] All the new details regarding Round-Based Zombies in [i]Black Ops 6[/i], including information on Liberty Falls, Wonder Weapons, and more, straight from Call of Duty: NEXT.[/*]	[*][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/4599951478186962107]Blog 4: Black Ops 6: Call of Duty: Warzone Integrations[/url]. [/b] Important information regarding the brand-new Area 99 Resurgence Map, as well as new gameplay innovations, Mastery Camos, and more.[/*]	[*][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/4599951478187089360]Blog 5: Black Ops 6 Beta: Everything You Need to Know[/url]. [/b] Ready to drop into the Multiplayer Beta? Prepare yourself with this game-winning overview and guide to leveling up to ensure you unlock all the Beta Rewards, including the two exclusive Operator skins![/*][/list]
[b][u]BLOG 1: THE GLOBAL GAMEPLAY SYSTEMS OF BLACK OPS 6[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/eefe6b70b00bd3a14404f499c6147356cd304228.jpg[/img]

Impressive innovations to movement and your HUD. Key evolutions in how you create and save your Loadouts, utilize weapons, equipment and Perks. A streamlining of the Gunsmith. An in-depth look at the exciting classic Prestige progression system. And more.

These are the Global Gameplay Systems underpinning [i]Black Ops 6[/i].

Read on to gain all the knowledge you need before you jump into the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Beta on August 30!

[b]PLEASE NOTE! [/b]The innovations shown at Call of Duty: NEXT and contained in this blog are tagged as “global”, with game initials flagged under each title header. Here’s what these initials mean:

[b]SP: [/b]Available in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Campaign (Single Player).

[b]MP: [/b]Available in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer.

[b]RBZ: [/b]Available in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Zombies (Round Based Zombies).

[b]WZ: [/b]Available in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i].

[b][u]THE MOVEMENT[/u][/b]

[b][u]Omnimovement[/u][/b]

[b][i]Global innovation (SP, MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

A genre-defining game changer across Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], Omnimovement immediately allows the player to move like never before and seamlessly chain combat maneuvers together, like sliding, diving and a newly enhanced supine prone, all with a full 360 degrees range of motion.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5cecd8aafe0348152b5920adee07ad28232c51f2.jpg[/img]

This might sound intimidating to try, but Omnimovement is designed for players of all different skill levels, and you’re able (and encouraged) to learn how to really take advantage of these maneuvering innovations prior to your first Beta match:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cb147dc73fcca1a258c1b1d28ee36604349205d0.jpg[/img]

In the Multiplayer Beta, you can access the Training Course by selecting “Find a Match” in the Lobby. You’re dropped into the MP Map Protocol (which is otherwise a launch map), where Frank Woods is on hand to offer you some “encouragement.” It’s here you can fully learn your Omnimovement capabilities, as well as optionally testing out the Intelligent Movement system (see below).

[b]Omnimovement Basics: [/b]At its most basic level, Omnimovement allows you to Sprint, Slide, and Dive in any direction. Be sure you perfect the following:

Sprinting forward, sideways, or backwards.

Shooting targets while sliding or diving forward, sideways, or backwards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b74a36bca8dcc688d1d6310b5f997f2f369ee483.jpg[/img]

[b]The 180 Degree Combat Dive:[/b] Combine Omni-Sprint and 180-degree dives like a true Black Ops action hero with a technique designed to show off Omnimovement and act as a springboard for your own maneuvering combinations. You can:

Sprint towards the edge of a building, then dive from the edge.

As you’re diving in mid-air, you quickly rotate yourself to face an enemy situated behind you.

As you finish your dive, you should be firing to eliminate the enemy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4ed199739e44ce08849fbd411c040ae8e8a797a8.jpg[/img]

[b]Combat Supine: [/b]Master the supine position to effectively counter ambushes and enhance your combat skills.

Drop to a prone position, then rotate your Operator for a complete 360-degree view of your surroundings.

Locate the positions of nearby enemies.

Then fire to eliminate the enemy quickly as they appear, all the while staying in the supine position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ad0d08ecc2b94dd4c3fa90d72570bd4a83b63f53.jpg[/img]

[b]Combat Slide and Dive:[/b] Use the element of surprise against enemies by combining Omni-Sprint with Combat Slides and Dives.

Quickly sprint towards a door (closed or open) or another threshold.

Evade enemy gunfire by Diving or Sliding through the opening.

Then quickly aim and fire to eliminate enemies positioned to the left or right of your ending position.

[b][u]Intelligent Movement[/u][/b]

[b][i]Global innovation (SP, MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

In addition to Omnimovement, [i]Black Ops 6[/i] also features Intelligent Movement, which is a brand-new way for players to customize three elements of how Operators traverse the landscape. Available in the Keyboard & Mouse or Controller Options under “Movement,” you’re able to adjust the following features:
[list]	[*][b]Sprint Assist:[/b] Choose whether you want to manually or automatically sprint, tactically sprint, how much of a delay you want before sprinting begins, and if the assist occurs while sprinting sideways or backwards (due to Omnimovement).[/*]	[*][b]Mantle Assist:[/b] Customize whether you want you automatically mantle over no objects, low obstacles, or all obstacles that can be mantled.[/*]	[*][b]Crouch Assist: [/b]This enables crouching and sliding when your intent is to move through a valid opening (i.e., one requiring you to crouch).[/*]	[*][b]Corner Slice: [/b]Allows you to simulate a corner slice, the act of inclining your weapon (and camera) when adjacent to or moving around a corner. This doesn’t affect your aim. Default is “on.”[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7dfb0e838e66e7d1f4770a2afff98debb9d4c939.jpg[/img]

[b]Sprint Assist: [/b]You can choose how this behaves. This can be switched off (default), turned on, or just related to Tactical Sprint Assist.

[b]Off: [/b]Sprint is activated manually with the Sprint button.

[b]On: [/b]Full movement input will activate Sprint after the Sprint Assist Delay time.

[b]Tactical Sprint Assist: [/b]Forward movement input will activate Tactical Sprint after the Sprint Assist Delay time. Sideways and Backward movement can also be separated to activate Sprint after the Sprint Assist Delay time.

[b]Sprint Assist Delay: [/b]This is the amount of time (in milliseconds) of movement input before Sprint Assist activates. You can choose from zero (default) to 1,000 milliseconds (or one second) delay in 50 millisecond increments.

[b]Sprint Assist Sideways and Backwards: [/b]Default is “on” and allows Sprint Assist to activate when moving in the specified directions.

[b]Mantle Assist: [/b]You can choose how this behaves. This can be switched off (default), set to Low Mantle Assist, or turned on.

[b]Off: [/b]Mantling (the movement over traversable objects) is activated contextually with the Jump button.

[b]Low Mantle Assist: [/b]Mantle Assist activates when sprinting towards low obstacles.

[b]On: [/b]Mantle Assist activates when sprinting towards all obstacles that can be mantled.

[b]Sideways and Backwards:[/b] Mantle Assist can also be activated when sprinting sideways or backwards towards low obstacles. Default is “off” for both, though they can be set to “on” for either or both movement options.

[b]Tactical Sprint Only:[/b] You can set Mantle Assist to activate only while Tactical Sprinting. Default is “off.”

[b]Mantle Cancels Reload:[/b] Mantle Assist activates while reloading, canceling the reload. Default is “on.”

[b]Crouch Assist: [/b]You can enable or disable this function:

[b]Off:[/b] This is the default setting and allows you to Crouch or Slide manually with the Change Stance button.

[b]On: [/b]Crouch Assist activates when Walking or Sprinting forward towards a valid opening.

Tactical Sprint Only: Crouch Assist only activates when Tactical Sprinting towards a valid opening. Default is “off.”

[b]TIP: [/b]You’re encouraged to change your Intelligent Movement settings prior to, or between matches until you find the customizable choice you prefer. There’s an entire Training Course map where you can spend time perfecting your Intelligent Movement choices, and this is also available to utilize during the Beta.

[b][u]A MORE APPROACHABLE GUNSMITH[/u][/b]

[b][i]Global innovation (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/137560347d479a9ba8569c45cd5f497e51c10bc4.jpg[/img]

With a more streamlined navigational experience, choosing a Loadout has never been quicker and easier. This includes a reworking of the Weapon Gunsmith to make it much more approachable, allowing you to choose from the vast array of unlockable weapon attachments with a renewed set of confidence that the build you’re making is suited to your exact style of play.

And thanks to the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Global Weapon Builds (read on for more intel), your weapon creations can be shared across Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]!

It all starts in the Weapons Menu, and it’s here you’ll choose your Loadouts. While [i]Black Ops 6[/i] is set to bring an exceptional arsenal of weaponry and equipment to the game – including 12 weapons all-new to the franchise – the following information details the streamlining and innovations made to the Gunsmith, beginning with Attachments.

[b]Gunsmith: Attachments[/b]

[b][i]Global System (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1f9457ffc9763a8e06264a8669b7672bc502d05f.jpg[/img]

Looking back at how approachable the weapons systems of [i]Black Ops 2[/i] was, served as a huge inspiration for the Weapons Team, and though there are no plans to return to that system, the focus for [i]Black Ops 6[/i] is to condense and streamline Attachments so a player always feels positive and understands the bonuses when it comes to utilizing the Gunsmith. Here are some of the changes:
[list]	[*][b]Gaining the Advantage: [/b]Attachments almost always come with a benefit (Pro), and not a detriment (Con), so you know you’re creating a weapon more potent than the base version.[/*]	[*][b]Optics for All…: Almost all [/b]Optic Attachments are shared across all weapons in a Weapons Class. For example, unlock the Red Dot Sight with a SMG and you’ll be able to equip it to all SMGs in the Weapon Class.[/*]	[*][b]… Everything Else is Unique:[/b] All other Attachment Types – Muzzle, Barrel, Underbarrel, Magazine, Rear Grip, Stock, Laser, and Fire Mods – are unique to the weapon in question.[/*]	[*][b]Getting Specific: [/b]Instead of having a weapon function – such as ADS speed – being affected by multiple attachments that are difficult to keep track of, they are related to a single Attachment type.	[list]		[*]For example, equipping a “Rear Grip” Attachment will always improve your handling, and the grip you choose will boost a unique combination of handling stats (to Sprint to Fire Speed, Slide to Fire Speed, Dive to Fire Speed, ADS Speed, or a combination thereof). All the different grips are designed to improve the weapon’s potency, not reduce it.[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]Information is Power: [/b]The net result of this new system – which we’ve just scratched the surface of – is that it allows players to make informed weapon-building decisions easily and create effective Builds without constantly needing looking up “meta” builds online.[/*]	[*][b]Details Matter:[/b] Don’t mistake this streamlining as “dumbing down” the Gunsmith, as your Firepower, Accuracy, Handling, and Mobility statistics can also be seen in an expanded view, with individual elements like Reload Quickness, Recoil Gun Kick, and Bullet Velocity all available to compare in granular detail. There are over 30 stats you can view and improve in the expanded view. Note this view will not be accessible during the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Beta.[/*][/list]
[b]Gunsmith: Weapon Leveling[/b]

[b][i]Global System (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/456c0c953590d26d0c593296472664216bcd8624.jpg[/img]

Every [i]Black Ops 6[/i] weapon has its own Weapon Leveling journey to progress through and complete. Most Primary Weapons have between 40-50 Weapon Levels, with each level providing access to a different Attachment unique to the Weapon or a Class Optic that can be used with any Weapon in the Class. While we’re talking Optics, players will no longer need to unlock each Weapon’s Optic “Node” as part of the Weapon Leveling journey. Instead, players will have access to the Optic Attachment Category from Weapon Level 1 and can immediately equip any of their favorite previously unlocked Class Optics when starting out with a new Weapon.

[b]Gunsmith: Global Weapon Builds[/b]

[b][i]Global Innovation (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/918e4d9e860b8c5ceffd7f979371b6c1308dc836.jpg[/img]

Perfecting your favorite weapon loadout builds or Blueprints doesn’t need to be done more than once, as [i]Black Ops 6[/i] brings the concept of Global Weapon Builds into a reality across all three modes ([i]Black Ops 6[/i], Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]). This Loadout and Gunsmith usability improvement is a huge time-saver, as it allows you to make a change to any Build or blueprint in any game, and it permeates out everywhere the gun is equipped. Look for more information on this exciting feature soon!

[b]Gunsmith: Cosmetics[/b]

[b][i]Global System (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c639a9b6e98d0259d21cec89ea13e440e59b3056.jpg[/img]

Across [i]Black Ops 6[/i], Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], the Cosmetics for your weapons feature a wide variety of content to unlock, which is further subdivided into the following categories:
[list]	[*][b]Camo: [/b]The place to begin an epic grind to unlock Weapon Camos, including Mastery Camos for Multiplayer, Zombies, and for the first time, a dedicated Camo Challenge system for [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]![/*]	[*][b]Reticle: [/b]Expect robust customization and unlock challenges for optic reticles, across all three modes![/*]	[*][b]Weapon Accessories: [/b]Affix a small charm from your collection or a Gun Screen onto the side of your weapon.[/*]	[*][b]Large Decals: [/b]Add some customization to your weapon by adding a Large Decal to the side of the armament.[/*]	[*][b]Stickers: [/b]Further add custom flourishes by placing up to three stickers in designated areas across your weapon. In [i]Black Ops 6[/i], players can equip both three Stickers and a Large Decal simultaneously with no limitations.[/*][/list]
It’s worth spending some time looking at the Reticle and Weapon Camo challenges [i]Black Ops 6[/i] will have to offer:

[b]Weapon Camos and Mastery Camos[/b]

[b][i]Global System (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c0ac7263b63826e58da1392400cbd0520d9fa3f4.jpg[/img]

Weapon Camos are cosmetic patterns that cover a large portion of every weapon and are unlocked via specific “Camo Challenges”. For [i]Black Ops 6[/i], expect a serious undertaking, set to test the mettle of even the most battle-hardened grinder! The variety of camos to unlock at launch is impressive, includes a dedicated camo track for [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] for the first time.

Veterans of Black Ops should be happy to learn that the way many of the camos are unlocked takes inspiration from previous titles.

All three modes have a full set of Camo Challenges, for each weapon in [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Each Weapon’s Camo journey is broken up into three categories – featuring a mix of elements from traditional Black Ops Camo Systems of past as well as modern Camo Challenge elements seen in recent titles:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/70f2d5d8ea9fafa0e8979b7137ccd059753b6ec6.jpg[/img]

[[CAPTION]] A showcase of the Dynamic properties of the Dark Matter (Column 1, MP), Nebula (Column 2, RBZ) and Abyss (Column 3, WZ) Mastery Camos.

[b]Step 1: Military Camos:[/b] Progress through nine linear Military Camo styles, usually by reaching Headshot milestones with the weapon. Launchers, Knives, and Shotguns have different criteria.

[b]Step 2: Unique Camos: [/b]After completing the Weapon’s nine Military Camos, players will gain access to two Challenges to earn Unique Camos. Each Weapon has two Unique Camos, per mode (six total). Unique Camos can be completed in either order, and once completed Unique Camo swatches can be used with any other Weapon that has also completed its nine Military Camos.

[b]Step 3: Mastery Camos: [/b]Once through the Military and Unique Camos, advance into the weapon’s four Mastery Camos. See below for a full reveal of these Mastery camos!

Expect this exact same trackable setup in Zombies and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], effectively meaning three sets of unlockable camos depending on the game you’re playing. [i]Black Ops 6[/i] also has a “Camo HUB” menu to help you keep track of all your weapon camo unlocks, where you can check each weapon class (for example, SMGs or Handguns), and how your grind is going on a per-camo challenge, per-weapon basis!

Let’s delve into the three different camo types:

[b]Military Camos[/b]

[b][i]Nine Camos Per Weapon, per game (27 per weapon)[/i][/b]

These camo types are consistent across every gun in the game, and progression is extremely straightforward. For the majority of Primary Weapons, you unlock Military camos in order by completing Headshot challenges, and you unlock Military camos in order, one by one. Once you’ve unlocked all Military camos for your weapon, you unlock the Unique Camo category.

[b]Unique Camos[/b]

[b][i]Two Camos Per Weapon, per game (six per weapon)[/i][/b]

These unlock and are accessible in a similar way to how camos are obtained in [i]Modern Warfare® II[/i] and [i]Modern Warfare III[/i]. These are unique camos you can only earn with the specific weapon you’re using, but once unlocked, these camos can be applied to any other weapon. Unique Camos have unlock criteria that are more tailored to the playstyle of the weapon. Complete both Unique Camos (in either order) and you graduate to unlocking Mastery Camos!

[b]Mastery Camos[/b]

[b][i]Four Camos Per Weapon, per game (12 per weapon)[/i][/b]

Featuring some of the showstopping patterns ever seen in a Call of Duty game, the final focus of your camo grind is unlocking the fabled final four Mastery camos! While we can’t reveal the unlock criteria yet, expect specific, and then general challenges incorporating unlocks across your weapon categories, to unveil Mastery camos in all their unrivalled glory!

[b]Multiplayer Mastery Camos:[/b]

[list]	[*][b]Gold Camo: [/b]Complete all Military and Unique Camos for the Weapon and then complete the Gold Camo Challenge.[/*]	[*][b]Diamond: [/b]Earn Gold Camo for all Weapons in the Weapon Class and then complete the Diamond Camo Challenge.[/*]	[*][b]Dark Spine: [/b]Earn Diamond Camo for all Weapons in the game and then complete the Dark Spine Camo Challenge.[/*]	[*][b]Dark Matter: [/b]Earn Dark Spine for all Weapons in the Game and then complete the Dark Matter Camo Challenge.[/*][/list]
[b]Zombies Mastery Camos:[/b]

[list]	[*][b]Mystic Gold Camo: [/b]Complete all Military and Unique Camos for the Weapon and then complete the Mystic Gold Camo Challenge.[/*]	[*][b]Opal: [/b]Earn Mystic Gold Camo for all Weapons in the Weapon Class and then complete the Opal Camo Challenge.[/*]	[*][b]Afterlife: [/b]Earn Opal Camo for all Weapons in the game and then complete the Afterlife Camo Challenge.[/*]	[*][b]Nebula: [/b]Earn Afterlife for all Weapons in the Game and then complete the Nebula Camo Challenge.[/*][/list]
[b]Call of Duty: Warzone Mastery Camos:[/b]

[list]	[*][b]Gold Tiger Camo: [/b]Complete all Military and Unique Camos for the Weapon and then complete the Gold Tiger Camo Challenge.[/*]	[*][b]King’s Ransom: [/b]Earn Gold Tiger Camo for all Weapons in the Weapon Class and then complete the King’s Ransom Camo Challenge.[/*]	[*][b]Catalyst: [/b]Earn King’s Ransom Camo for all Weapons in the game and then complete the Catalyst Camo Challenge.[/*]	[*][b]Abyss: [/b]Earn Catalyst for all Weapons in the Game and then complete the Abyss Camo Challenge.[/*][/list]
[b]Remember:[/b] You’ve got Military, Unique, and Mastery camos to unlock for each Black Ops 6 weapon in Multiplayer, Zombies, and Call of Duty: Warzone!

[b]Reticle Challenges[/b]

[b][i]Global System (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4315cb209bbc4ca1898a90b8a6551bafe907ee3d.jpg[/img]

The classic Reticle system has returned! Not only are interchangeable weapon reticles back, but there are robust customization and unlock challenges for them, across all three modes!

Equip an Optic Attachment, and select the Cosmetics Tab in Gunsmith, and access the Reticle category. Here you can view the Reticles you’re currently unlocking, along with the associated Challenges, which are always ADS-related. Like Weapon Camos, Reticle sets are available for:
[list]	[*]Multiplayer[/*]	[*]Zombies[/*]	[*]Call of Duty: Warzone[/*][/list]
Unlock a Reticle, and you can fix it to any Optic and any weapon, in any game: For example, if you unlock a Reticle from Zombies, and you prefer its look over all other Reticles, you can equip it in Multiplayer and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] as you wish.

[b]Calling Cards and Dark Ops Challenges[/b]

[b][i]Global System (SP, MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2983e0e5eab14ffd60a9adf83347dd168367c8aa.jpg[/img]

[b]Calling Card Challenges: [/b]The Black Ops way to unlock Calling Cards is back and bigger than ever! Starting at launch, track your progress from a centralized Calling Cards Menu where every type of Calling Card – across Campaign, Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] – can be viewed, while also allowing you to see your Calling Cards that are closest to being earned.

There are sets of Calling Cards per mode to unlock, and this menu system also has pages that summarize your progress throughout each set in percentage terms, with the unlock criteria for each Calling Card still readable even after completion. Fans of receiving “100 Percenter” completion animated Calling Cards should be pleased to learn these are also returning, allowing you to prove your dedication and mettle with friends and foes alike. Make sure you add your three favorite Calling Cards to your showcase as part of your Player Profile in the Social menu.

Finally, it wouldn’t be a Black Ops game without Dark Ops Calling Card Challenges! Not seen since [i]Black Ops Cold War[/i], these involve tasks so fiendish, the unlock criteria is [[REDACTED]] until you complete them! These don’t count toward your percentage completion, but they are the ultimate, classified set of Calling Card rewards available!

[b]Emotes and Sprays[/b]

[b][i]Global System (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9f3a772fc669f0c249a4b06817682a23b9289462.jpg[/img]

Adding to the personalization of your Operators are the return of Emotes (a physical taunt or movement) and Sprays (iconography you primarily daub on walls, either to tag them or to tactically flag a location for your teammates).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/137dae9d72a090647960b90afd26c82035aa0849.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Call of Duty: NEXT: Black Ops 6 Global Systems Revealed, part 2
notes.notes:
[b][u]PROGRESSION AND PRESTIGE[/u][/b]

[b][i]Global System (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e8fcf3b05dbc32e86cfb1129819620a50ee847fd.jpg[/img]

The progression systems available throughout [i]Black Ops 6[/i] provide an impressive number of challenges, leveling, Prestiging, and unique rewards well worth grinding for. Here’s an overview of the Progression System available at launch, as well as information on the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Beta progression systems.

[b]Please Note! [/b]Your progression is accessed via the new “Barracks” menu at the top of your screen, and/or the “Progression” tile in the secondary menu at the top-right of your screen.

[b]Progression Overview[/b]

[b]Leveling Up: [/b]

[b][i]Beta: Levels 1-30, Full Game: Levels 1-55[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/03cdd7ed799954f6063673c30e50f040e5720dc9.jpg[/img]

[b]Leveling Overview: Black Ops 6 Launch Content[/b]

At launch, begin your leveling journey with the familiar system, with 55 levels to unlock as you receive Experience Points (XP) based on your in-game actions across all game modes. As you progress through the levels, you’ll unlock a variety of item sets from all three game modes (Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]).

Expect to unlock additional content to your Loadouts. Examples include:
[list]	[*][b]Default Loadouts[/b] (predetermined with recommended armaments)[/*]	[*][b]Custom Loadouts[/b] (your own customizable loadouts)[/*]	[*][b]Weapons, Tacticals, Lethals, Field Upgrades, [/b]and [b]Scoresteaks[/b] [b]Perks and Wildcards[/b] (some of the Perks and Wildcards you can pick from)[/*]	[*]Zombies [b]Ammo Mods[/b] and [b]GobbleGums[/b][/*][/list]
The tracking menu for your Level also flags whether the item you’re unlocking is for Multiplayer-only (examples include Perks and certain Field Upgrades), or for All Modes (including MP, RBZ, and WZ, examples include base weapons and certain Lethals).

[b]Leveling Overview: Black Ops 6 Beta Content[/b]

The exact same principle applies to the Levels you can reach during the Black Ops 6 Beta, with a few additional caveats:
[list]	[*]You can only reach Level 20 during the first Weekend.[/*]	[*]You can hit the Beta maximum of Level 30 during the second Weekend.[/*]	[*]In addition to the previously listed unlockable items you can utilize during the Beta, additional Beta Rewards are available for reaching certain levels, including an Emblem, Emote, Charm, Calling Card, Loading Screen, Spray, Weapon Blueprint, and different Skins for Westpoint (Operator).[/*]	[*]Beta rewards will be added to your account at the launch of [i]Black Ops 6[/i] on October 25***.[/*]	[*]Whether you reached Level 30 during the Beta weekends or not, all Beta leveling content will reset when the game launches.[/*][/list]
[b]Leveling Completion: The Road to Prestige[/b]

When you’ve amassed enough XP – in the full version of [i]Black Ops 6[/i] – to completely unlock all 55 Level, moving up the ranks from Private I to Commander and you’ve filled the Level 55 XP bar, you receive the option to take your grinding to the next level.

Welcome to [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Prestige.

[b]PRESTIGE OVERVIEW[/b]

[b][i]Global System (MP, RBZ, WZ)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/623a5d3ba10236da5a0fff3611755274a7c64e5b.jpg[/img]

What is “classic Prestige?” For the uninitiated, this is an incredibly in-depth leveling system coming to [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Multiplayer and Zombies at launch, and to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] at Season 1, that rewards your dedicated grind with dozens of truly spectacular and unique rewards. Prestiging is purely optional and can be done at any time once you’ve leveled up to Level 55.

Choose not to Prestige, and your Level caps at 55, and you can continue playing as normal.

[b]Choosing to Prestige[/b]

Choose to Prestige, and you enter Prestige 1. You gain access to the following:
[list]	[*][b]Prestige 1 Icon:[/b] You receive your first Prestige icon, which slots into the center of your Level insignia for all players to see.[/*]	[*][b]Prestige Menus:[/b] You can access the Prestige menu screens and gain quick and easy descriptions of how the system works, with viewable rewards.[/*]	[*][b]Prestige Level Climb: [/b]You are now able to climb through 10 Levels of Prestige, each inspired by a title in Call of Duty: Black Ops history.[/*]	[*][b]Rewards:[/b] Concerned there may be a lack of rewards for Prestiging? Fear not: [i]Black Ops 6[/i] has the most rewarding Prestige system ever in a Call of Duty: Black Ops game.[/*]	[*][b]Prestige-specific Rewards:[/b] There's plenty to unlock, and this includes rewards per Prestige, including Operator Skins, Blueprints, and more.[/*]	[*][b]Prestige Mastery:[/b] Complete all 10 Prestige Levels to graduate into Prestige Master, with 1,000 Levels to climb through, also with additional rewards.[/*][/list]
Of course, with this being “classic Call of Duty: Black Ops Prestige”, but with a large-scale improvement to the earnable rewards, your level is also reset. Here’s how this works:

[b]Level Reset:[/b] Your Level is reset to Prestige 1. This means all content level unlocks from 1-55 are relocked and must be unlocked again. This includes all the Loadout content – including weapons, equipment, and perks – that you unlocked during the previous leveling.

[b]Keep Your Progress:[/b] However, all your Weapon Levels, Operators, Challenge Progress, Weapon Builds, and Customizations are kept. For example, the AK-74 is unlocked at Level 7. It becomes locked until you level back up past Level 7, but once you do, any prior progress you made with that weapon continues from when you Prestiged.

[b]Permanent Unlocks:[/b] Each time you Prestige you acquire a “Permanent Unlock”. You can keep this indefinitely, or better yet, use it to unlock a single item of your choice within the Levels. For example, if you don’t wish to wait until you’ve leveled back up to Level 7 to unlock the AK-74, you can use the Permanent Unlock and have immediate access to the weapon. Players are encouraged to make strategic choices about which items to permanently unlock, also giving you more control over your gameplay experience by ensuring access to your preferred gear.

[b]Permanent Unlocks (Additional):[/b] Note that Blueprints and Equipment skins that you may own also permanently unlock items, including the “base” version of the item.

[b]Prestige Rewards:[/b] As previously noted, once you’ve Prestiged, you gain access to earn otherwise-unobtainable Prestige Rewards, Prestige Challenges, and an increased XP reward for completing Daily Challenges.

[b]Stats Reset:[/b] Your combat stats – such as your current Elimination/Death record – start fresh every time you Prestige. However, you can always view your career stats across all your levels in the Combat Record menu.

[b]Seasonal Content:[/b] Items acquired from a Battle Pass, Store Bundle, or in-game Event are never locked.

[b]Prestige HUB:[/b] A Prestige menu with rewards showcases is now accessible. Highlights include visuals showing how far you’ve progressed through the Prestige system, and the rewards across future Prestiges, even those you haven’t unlocked yet.

[b]Prestige Leveling[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c08f28cb25010507849ea50e1b8db1d81386eaf8.jpg[/img]

If you took the plunge and entered Prestige, your level resets to Level 1, Prestige 1. The date you entered Prestige is recorded, and you receive [[REDACTED]] instant rewards. Now, as you level up and re-unlock the Level rewards, you also unlock the Prestige rewards as well.

Each Prestige has a theme, featuring a variety of content across Multiplayer and (where appropriate Zombies) related to a specific Black Ops title from the franchise’s past history. For example, Prestige 1 features rewards inspired by 2008’s [i]Call of Duty: World at War[/i].

Specifically, some of the rewards are an homage to the Zombies content in that game. Look for a showcase of this nostalgia and nightmare-fueled content in our Black Ops 6 Prestige blog closer to launch!

[b]Premium Rewards: [/b]Though the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Prestige Progression System is global across Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], free-to-play players will receive fewer Prestige rewards compared to those who own [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. If you decide to subsequently purchase [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]while Prestiging and in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], any previous, premium-only rewards are instantly granted.

[b][u]ADDITIONAL INTEL[/u][/b]

[b][u]Black Ops 6 Beta Rewards[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c5ff7e042ecdda1260d374c08c0a1f54cbf38778.jpg[/img]

Earn cosmetic rewards by reaching Player Level milestones throughout the Multiplayer Open Beta that will persist through the launch of [i]Black Ops 6[/i] when it releases on October 25***.

The rewards and required levels follow:
[list]	[*]Level 2: “Beta Tester” Animated Emblem[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 6: “Beta Tag” Spray[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 11: “No Bugs” Weapon Charm[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 15: “Quick Draw” Emote[/*]	[*]Level 20: “Squish” Westpoint Operator Skin (only unlockable during Weekend One)[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 20: “Squash” Westpoint Operator Skin (unlocked during either Weekend)[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 23: “The Truth Lies” Loading Screen[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 27: “Beta Expert” Animated Calling Card[/*][/list][list]	[*]Level 30: “Bug Smasher” Weapon Blueprint[/*][/list]
[b][u]Pre-purchase Digitally and Get the Reflect 115 Camo Pack, Vault Edition Available[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c5bd72f26f69fc985455217f5ac13bacf088cd5d.jpg[/img]

[b][[SCREENSHOT]][/b]

Pre-purchase [i]Black Ops 6[/i] today, and you’ll receive a variety of pre-purchase benefits, including the brand-new Reflect 115 Camo Pack for [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]!

Pre-purchase the Digital Edition on PC to receive the following:

Reflect 115 Camo Pack (New!)

Woods Operator Pack*

Early Access to the Open Beta**

Pre-purchase the Vault Edition on PC and receive the previous rewards as well as the following:

Hunters Vs. Hunted Operator Pack

BlackCell Season 1

Mastercraft Weapon Collection

GobbleGum Pack

PLEASE NOTE! Those players who pre-purchased the Vault Edition will be able to gain access to the Hunters Vs. Hunted Operator Pack, as well as the Mastercraft Weapon Collection, during the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Beta.

Game Pass Subscribers are set to receive all Digital Edition benefits, and those who upgrade for $30 (or local equivalent) to the Vault Edition will receive all Vault Edition benefits.

Those players who have already pre-purchased [i]Black Ops 6[/i] will receive the Reflect 115 Camo Pack automatically.

The Reflect 115 Camo Pack consists of the Reflect 115 Mastery Camo for use in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. In addition, you receive three Flawless Aetherium Crystals, three Legendary Aether Tools, and three Ray Gun Weapon Cases for immediate use in [i]Modern Warfare Zombies[/i]. All content does not carry forward into [i]Black Ops 6[/i].

[b][u]Official Comms Active: Stay Informed. Not Misinformed[/u][/b]

Misinformation is everywhere: Ensure you stay one step ahead with the latest official [i]Black Ops 6 [/i]information by checking the Call of Duty Blog in the weeks up to launch with important comms you won’t want to miss.

[i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6[/i] is published by Activision. Development for the game is led by Treyarch, in partnership with Raven Software. Additional development support provided (in alphabetical order) by Activision Central Design, Activision Central Technology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Infinity Ward, and Sledgehammer Games.

The Truth Lies.

With developers from Treyarch and Raven at the helm, plus representatives from across Call of Duty Studios and community channels, in-depth intel on what’s coming to [i]Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 Multiplayer[/i], [i]Zombies[/i], and[i] Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i] is locked in and ready to be shared.

[previewyoutube=GYG_h-L-K2E;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3712addacfb10b1c1b219351112568ec31889bab.jpg[/img]

Are you planning on playing the [i]Black Ops 6[/i] Beta on a PC? Then ensure your rig is prepped to the correct specifications:
