notes.title: Black Ops 6 Zombies: What you need to know, part 3
notes.notes:
[b][u]PART 4: INTO THE FRAY: ROUND-BASED SYSTEMS[/u][/b]

[b][u]Black Ops 6 Zombies Gameplay Systems[/u][/b]

[b][u]Perk-a-Colas[/u][/b]

[b]Cost to Access: Essence[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1d59bfd949ab43934e557f4a82f9a9b89794790a.jpg[/img]

If you’re after a tasty beverage that also has the benefit of granting abilities to aid you and your teammates’ survival chances, then get ready to hunt down your preferred vending machines, as Perk-a-Colas are back and with more of a kick than ever: For [i]Black Ops 6 Zombies[/i], every Perk-a-Cola Can comes with up to six Augment options to choose from (three Minor, three Major).

Perks are purchased using Essence and have been designed to offer a wide variety of bonuses that suits your style of play, allowing you to choose the order and number you need. Seek out specific Perk Machines, scattered throughout the play-space, or seek out the infamous Der Wunderfizz Machine, offering all available Perks in a single, usually dangerous, location.

Each time you purchase a new Perk, the Essence cost increases, and your Perk collection – displayed along the bottom of your HUD – lasts as long as you do: If you’re downed, expect to lose Perks depending on how many you’ve obtained, and how long you’re downed for.

At launch, expect to access the following returning Perk Machines across Terminus Island, each with six Augments to unlock and choose from, to further bolster the following base effects:
[list]	[*][b]Jugger-Nog: [/b]Increase maximum health by 100.[/*]	[*][b]Quick Revive:[/b] Reduce the health regen delay time by 50%. Reduce the time it takes to revive an ally by 50%.[/*]	[*][b]Speed Cola:[/b] Increase reload and armor replating speed bonus by 30%.[/*]	[*][b]Stamin-Up:[/b] Increase movement speed.[/*]	[*][b]PhD Flopper:[/b] Immunity to all self-inflicted damage and status effects. Dive to prone triggers an explosion, which increases the higher you fall. Immunity from fall damage while diving to prone.[/*]	[*][b]Deadshot Daiquiri:[/b] Aiming down sight moves to enemy critical location. Increase enemy critical damage.[/*]	[*][b]Elemental Pop:[/b] Every bullet you fire has a small chance to apply a random Ammo Mod effect.[/*][/list]
In addition, expect to access a new and delicious drink designed to inflict enhanced and severe punishment at close range, the Melee Macchiato!
[list]	[*][b]Melee Macchiato:[/b] Replace weapon gun butt with a deadly punch that sends enemies flying.[/*][/list]
[b]Perk-a-Cola Example and Augments: Melee Macchiato[/b]

After swigging down a can of Melee Macchiato and using it for a few games, focusing on researching this Perk between matches, you begin to learn and unlock both Minor and Major Augments to add additional benefits to future uses of the Perk. Once you fully research this Perk, you have three Minor Augments, and three Major Augments to choose from. We chose the following:

[b]Minor Augment: [/b]
[list]	[*][b]Hidden Impact: [/b]Melee kills reload a portion of your held weapon.[/*][/list]
[b]Major Augment: [/b]
[list]	[*][b]Vampirism: [/b]Successful melee attacks heal for 25 health.[/*][/list]
Before your next match, you simply choose one Minor, and one Major Augment, depending on your specific needs, and can swap between other Augments between Matches.

[b][u]Ammo Mods (The Arsenal Machine)[/u][/b]

[b]Cost to Access: [/b]Salvage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/55ca9265437ebbefdc9074d1fd2f0f5c384f1cc4.jpg[/img]

Along with Rarity and Pack-a-Punch capabilities, your Primary Weapon can be outfitted with an upgrade known as an Ammo Mod. Obtained in-game via rare ground loot, and more specifically at the Arsenal Machine using Salvage you’ve collected as payment, Ammo Mods grant the affected weapon a percentage chance of dealing a special effect upon a successful projectile impact. Only one Ammo Mod can be applied to the weapon at a time, though you can purchase a new Ammo Mod as necessary.

At launch, expect to access the following returning Ammo Mods, each with six Augments to unlock and choose from, to further bolster the following base effects:
[list]	[*][b]Brain Rot: [/b]Bullets deal toxic damage. Each bullet has the chance to turn a Normal or Special enemy into an ally.[/*]	[*][b]Cryo Freeze: [/b]Bullets deal frost damage. Each bullet has a chance to slow Normal or Special enemies.[/*]	[*][b]Dead Wire: [/b]Bullets deal electrical damage. Each bullet has a chance to stun any Normal and Special enemy, generating a field that deals electric damage to nearby enemies.[/*]	[*][b]Napalm Burst: [/b]Bullets deal fire damage. Each bullet has a chance to ignite Normal and Special enemies.[/*][/list]
In addition, expect to access a new elemental power only barely contained with the following Ammo Mod, geared towards controlling dense crowds of the undead!
[list]	[*][b]Shadow Rift: [/b]Bullets deal shadow damage. Each bullet has a chance to spawn a black hole if striking Normal or Special enemies, warping nearby zombies away and dropping some from the air at high speed.[/*][/list]
[b]Ammo Mod Example: Riffing on the Shadow Rift[/b]

After some encouraging anomalies from the warp inflicted impressive damage to the shambling hordes, research began in earnest on cultivating additional Augments for this Ammo Mod. We ended up going with the following combo of Augments:

[b]Minor Augment:[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Targeted: [/b]Dropped zombies fall on other zombies.[/*][/list]
[b]Major Augment:[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Explosive Rain: [/b]Zombies that are dropped from portals will explode on contact with the ground.[/*][/list]
[b][u]The Rampage Inducer[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d9f6223cf81bb9aa2ad9541b7f01f612108b2a0a.jpg[/img]

“Tear them to pieces!”

Those considering themselves advanced enough not to be troubled by zombies in the early rounds of a match should seek out an orange-hued container of Aether crystals. When activated (and with all team members agreeing on the activation), this drives zombies into an absolute frenzy. Zombies will appear and move more quickly for the first 20 rounds, and providing you aren’t overwhelmed, this allows you to speed through the early rounds of a match. Or you can return to the Rampage Inducer and vote to switch it off, if the challenge was more than you bargained for!

[b][u]Ground Loot[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3bfdb1b9db518482b68c2937cf681617f536bcaa.jpg[/img]

Gather a variety of useful items dropped by the recently deceased, with the knowledge that most of what you need will be automatically picked up. Loot comes in the following types:
[list]	[*][b]Salvage (Green):[/b] These are automatically picked up, adds to your Salvage total, and is used to increase your Weapon Rarity (Arsenal Machine), purchase or swap an Ammo Mod (Arsenal Machine), or craft Tactical, Lethal, or Support Equipment (Crafting Machine).[/*]	[*][b]Armor Plates (White):[/b] Providing you have fewer than three Armor Plates in your reserve inventory (that you are carrying, not wearing), Plates found on the ground are automatically picked up.[/*]	[*][b]Tacticals, Lethals, Support Equipment, Ammo Mods (Blue): [/b]Dropped Tacticals and Lethals, and much less commonly, Support Equipment and Ammo Mods, are also available to be manually grabbed from the ground, if you’re wanting to swap out parts of your current setup or have a space free.[/*][/list]
There are other ways to secure Ground Loot, including [[REDACTED]].

[b][u]Ammo Caches[/u][/b]

[b]Cost to Access: [/b]Essence

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4e7831b31c26c35dcadff2df564ec45517d4587a.jpg[/img]

Dotted around the maps are familiar military caches, and interacting with them refills your currently held weapon for a sum of Essence. This includes any weapon in your immediate repertoire that takes bullets or shells, including Wonder Weapons. The cost of the ammo increases as the power of your weapon goes up, so keep an eye on your Essence levels as you continue to visit the Pack-a-Punch!

[b][u]Tactical Raft[/u][/b]

[b]Cost to Access: [/b]Essence

Terminus features boat delivery portals allowing for on-demand transportation around the vicinity of the main island, usually on a well-utilized dock or pier. As swimming in the choppy waters of the ocean under current circumstances is possible but not advised, the Tactical Raft is the fastest way to reach the outer islands and the abandoned shipwreck, as further discoveries are made.

[b][u]Trials[/u][/b]

[b]Cost to Access: [/b]Essence

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/834172679cc04bb2e13d9a750a091e955756d576.jpg[/img]

Phasing in and out of reality across the map is an odd and intriguing terminal, which intermittently allows you to complete [[REDACTED]] special objective trials. With enough Essence, you can activate a terminal unit and begin a short challenge. This could involve holding a specific zone, dispatching enemies in a skillful manner, or a host of other conditions. Succeed, and a special chest warps into reality, offering up [[REDACTED]] variety of interesting rewards. The computer is then beamed out of existence, only to periodically return for further trials to be completed.

[b][u]Power-Ups[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e721f84494f56a81521206b8a41bdb29a2fb5c9c.jpg[/img]

As a reward for clearing enemy incursions, expect a variety of well-known Power-Ups to make an appearance in [i]Black Ops 6 Zombies[/i]. Encouraging you and your team to work together, there’s strategy in when to automatically activate a Power-Up prior to its eventual disappearance during battle, sometimes resulting in you escaping certain death! Expect the following Power-Ups to be available, depending on the situation on the ground:
[list]	[*][b]Insta-Kill:[/b] Base zombies are dispatched with one hit, and more powerful enemies aren’t killed, but receive additional damage. Does not count towards Field Upgrade charging.[/*]	[*][b]Double Points:[/b] Doubles the amount of Essence points gained for enemy takedowns.[/*]	[*][b]Max Ammo:[/b] Refills all ammunition carried for every weapon and equipment.[/*]	[*][b]Nuke:[/b] Destroys all base zombies, and more powerful adversaries aren’t killed, but receive additional damage. Enemy spawns are delayed by a few seconds.[/*]	[*][b]Fire Sale:[/b] After the Mystery Box moves, this may appear, activating all Mystery Box locations and reducing the purchase cost considerably.[/*]	[*][b]Bonus Points:[/b] Grants all players an additional amount of Essence points.[/*]	[*][b]Full Power:[/b] Instantly fills all players’ Field Upgrade.[/*]	[*][b]Max Armor:[/b] Fully repairs armor to the maximum Tier you own.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Elemental Damage[/u][/b]

[i]Black Ops 6 Zombies[/i] continues to utilize damage sources with an elemental association, and each one has a specific benefit or behavior associated with it. You are wise to experiment with such powers, as the enemies you encounter are likely to be weakened more effectively by at least one of the following types of elemental damage:
[list]	[*][b]Frost:[/b] This slows or freezes foes. [b]Sources:[/b] Cryo Freeze (Ammo Mod).[/*]	[*][b]Fire:[/b] Burst damage and damage over time. [b]Sources:[/b] Napalm Burst (Ammo Mod), Molotov (Lethal Equipment).[/*]	[*][b]Electric:[/b] Stunning and area-of-effect damage.[b] Sources: [/b]Dead Wire (Ammo Mod).[/*]	[*][b]Toxic:[/b] Corruption and mind control. [b]Sources: [/b]Brain Rot (Ammo Mod).[/*]	[*][b]Shadow:[/b] Gravity and associated damage. [b]Sources: [/b]Dark Flare (Field Upgrade), Shadow Rift (Ammo Mod), LT53 Kazimir (Tactical Equipment)[/*][/list]
Just which enemies have a particular weakness to an elemental salvo is likely to be a key to your continued success as the hordes become ever more ferocious.

[b][u]Weapon Rarity Upgrades (The Arsenal Machine)[/u][/b]

[b]Cost to Access: [/b]Salvage

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/809acdb8f0f21d53e7bf043c3ef19ab5b38ce481.jpg[/img]

The Upgrade Tier of your weapon is visible on your HUD, as the color behind the ammo and reserves, along with a small diamond icon, signifies the Tier of damage your weapon is capable of inflicting. Use increasing amounts of Salvage to add potency to your weapon damage:
[list]	[*][b]Uncommon (Green): [/b]Tier 2 Damage[/*]	[*][b]Rare (Blue): [/b]Tier 3 Damage[/*]	[*][b]Epic (Purple):[/b] Tier 4 Damage[/*]	[*][b]Legendary (Orange):[/b] Tier 5 Damage[/*][/list]
[b][u]Wall Buys: Weapons[/u][/b]

[b]Cost to Access: Essence[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c93f2ff69cec6f7b52fb16f37cbc14d873bf072c.jpg[/img]

Daubed on walls and boards across the island are chalk outlines of a weapon, complete with a glowing color representing the rarity of the weapon; green (Uncommon), blue (Rare), purple (Epic), or Orange (Legendary). The rarity of a Wall Buy increases with the number of Rounds you complete. Wall Buys have a number of uses:
[list]	[*]They allow you to obtain a different weapon type, in case your loadout isn’t doing the job, or you want a secondary Primary weapon to replace the Handgun.[/*]	[*]A Wall Buy weapon already has a rarity value associated with it (and is therefore more powerful).[/*]	[*]If you’ve defined a Zombie Build, the weapon you purchase will be a rarified version of that customized Weapon or Blueprint, complete with your preferred Attachments and Cosmetics![/*][/list]
[b][u]Wall Buys: Armor Levels[/u][/b]

[b]Cost to Access: Essence[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5b931e8bb5743c4d2b75f8226a1ea69710d7fcf4.jpg[/img]

Plating up is also important to lengthening your survival, and the new Armor Wall Buy ensures you added protection. There are likely to be two different types of Armor Wall Buys, and these increase your Armor Level:
[list]	[*][b]Level II Armor Vest (Rare/Blue): [/b]Two plates can be worn.[/*]	[*][b]Level III Armor Vest (Epic/Purple): [/b]Three plates can be worn.[/*][/list]
Once you visit an Armor Wall Buy, it ceases to function; you accrue Armor Plates via Ground Loot or crafting them (Crafting Table).

[b][u]Mystery Boxes[/u][/b]

[b]Cost to Access: Essence[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1729d4d9b107f701ab996f9cce4efea9d32e105d.jpg[/img]

With crate power comes great responsibilities, and the classic Mystery Box is back, appearing in a semi-random location, and allowing you to obtain a random weapon, including some that are only available from the Mystery Box.

The purchaser can elect to keep the weapon, drop it for a teammate, and/or spin again. Rewards include:
[list]	[*]A random Weapon.[/*]	[*]A random Wonder Weapon.[/*]	[*]A random Support item.[/*][/list]
The random weapon also has a random Rarity (Uncommon, Rare, Epic or Legendary, signified by the glowing color around the weapon appearing from the Box), and this Rarity Tier indicates how much extra damage the weapon can inflict, allowing you to obtain a hard-hitting weapon earlier than by simply using a Loadout Weapon. The higher the round, the greater the chance of a higher Rarity Weapon or a Wonder Weapon appearing.

In addition, thanks to the Zombie Build system, there’s a chance that a Mystery Box weapon spawns one you’ve already built out in the Loadout Menu, but with the added benefit of a Rarity Upgrade.

After a few spins, the Mystery Box displays everyone’s favorite undead cuddly rabbit, and Mr. Peeks teleports with the Box to a different part of the map, a shard of vertical blue light indicating where a Mystery Box is located.

[b][u]Increase Your Firepower: The Pack-a-Punch Machine[/u][/b]

[b]Cost to Access: Essence[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a5fee3ab01aa112eaf43684648aedf0fa166a692.jpg[/img]

Arguably the most important machine on a Round-Based Zombies map, the Pack-a-Punch (or PAP) Machine is used to upgrade your weapons into more powerful variants using the Essence gained from slaying zombies. Initially, the machine lacks any power, but once the outpost is back online and enough Essence is acquired, you can easily reach the machine and automatically upgrade with a single button press – no more menu to slow down the action.

Your Primary and Melee weapons can all be upgraded up to three times at the Pack-a-Punch machine, as well as any Wonder Weapon you may have to hand. The actual firepower enhancement varies depending on the gun or melee weapon you’re using, occasionally comes with surprising effects, but usually increases the potency, chambered ammo, and ammo reserves of the weapon.

Though you may elect to keep the current cosmetic look of the weapon you’re Pack-a-Punching by toggling PAP camos on or off in Settings, each of the three PAP tiers include an impressive, and usually glowing camouflage, as well as a change in audio, especially when firing the weapon.

[b][u]Wonder Weapons[/u][/b]

Incredibly rare and exceptionally potent, occasionally you may uncover highly secretive plans to construct several prototype armaments with almost unimaginable power. Research on Terminus Island has uncovered the existence of just such a device, known colloquially as a “Wonder Weapon”.

[b]Beamsmasher[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e5dd40095a68d0ef77394ee21f6d81450b7b9db2.jpg[/img]

Visually, the Beamsmasher is comparable in size and shape to a light machinegun and features a single barrel emitting a super-charged and incredibly damaging Aetheric beam. Set around the barrel are Resonator Focus flaps that direct the energy created by the weapon. The weapon is reloaded by swapping out the side-mounted DAPP canister.

The Beamsmasher has two firing modes:
[list]	[*][b]Primary:[/b] This fires a solid beam of Aetheric energy, causing organic matter to break down at the molecular level. This occurs almost instantly, and enemies appear to explode in a cloud of vaporized innards. Further testing is needed, but it appears that the longer the weapon fires, the more ungainly it becomes to move.[/*]	[*][b]Secondary:[/b] Focused soundwaves cause the molecules of multiple enemy targets to vibrate at alarmingly fast rates. Targets are wracked with pulsing head trauma that incapacitates by slowing the target rather than damaging them. Entities in this state become much more easily damaged by both the primary firing mode and conventional firepower.[/*][/list]
[b]Additional Notes:[/b] This weapon may experience energy venting as excess pressure builds up during the expenditure of an ammunition tube. Automatic reloading appears to cause a small blast radius and appears to knock down enemies within this vicinity. The weapon also appears to be able to be Pack-a-Punched three times, with increased [[REDACTED]], not to mention [[REDACTED]].

[i]*Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III / Call of Duty: Warzone on the pre-ordered platform required to redeem Woods Operator Pack. Sold / downloaded separately. Must be redeemed by October 25, 2025.[/i]

[i]**Actual launch date(s) and platform availability of Open Beta subject to change. See www.callofduty.com/beta for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only. Internet connection required. Online multiplayer subscription may be required.[/i]

notes.title: Black Ops 6 Zombies: What you need to know, part 4
notes.notes:
[b][u]PART 5: MEAT THE ENEMY[/u][/b]

[b][u]Know Your Terminus Zombie: Hordes of the Undead[/u][/b]

[i]“Give me a minute, I’m about to be up to my neck in blood, bones, and brains!” [/i]– Carver

Almost all the residents of the maps you visit in Round-Based Zombies appear to have gone through a horrifying transformation, becoming a rotting host, shambling into a crowd of walking cadavers, each with sunken glowing eyes now reborn with a relentless purpose; to hunt you down and consume your still-twitching corpse!

[b]PLEASE NOTE! [/b]Consult the following Bestiary to learn more about the foul forms encountered throughout the Terminus map. Remember: These entities do not represent the full miscellany of [i]Black Ops 6 Zombies [/i]enemies you should expect to face in the game.

[b][u]Bipedal Shamblers[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/935fbe5169dc80abefccc7dbcc477b71b71fed33.jpg[/img]

Visiting Terminus Island reveals the impressive variety of zombies you’ll be facing, with some clad in the remains of hazmat suits, Project Janus security attire, scientist lab coats, prisoner garb, torn rags, as well as civilian clothing. Bloated experiments, decomposed and mutated forms abound, and other more sinister variants appear across the rounds of horde combat. Though not a complete list of the horrors you’ll encounter, here’s what to expect to battle across Terminus.

[b]Zombies[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8eabfa225dea436147882080c8061ae921feb75c.jpg[/img]

Zombies are relentless. They will follow you, crowding into a swarm-like horde, intent on your demise. If they can’t reach you to claw you to death, they rip a portion of their own form and use it as a revolting meat projectile.

[b]Armored Zombies [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d6ddd7fe0ea09a0c3207f9951131893eef9dfd16.jpg[/img]

These are a zombie variant that have protective coverings, and also take reduced damage from projectiles and explosive damage. Focused fire on a particular appendage is a possible effective plan here.

[b]Heavy Zombies[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6b0fe279131e681eb1b17a963f8dc7608631869c.jpg[/img]

Armored Zombies clad in greater protective armor and are even better protected from projectiles and explosive damage compared to their lightly armored brethren.

[b][u]Grotesques and Tormented Horrors [/u][/b]

Quite how scuttling, spiderlike human heads and bloated bile sacks with wings have evolved to join the zombie throng is yet to be determined, but be prepared to be attacked by eldritch things arguably more grotesque than a mere animated corpse!

[b]Vermin[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/725f15df04e63676388202165cd5b85c93cab7bc.jpg[/img]

Vermin are large, spider-like ravenous scuttlers with a central thorax that seems to take the form of a screaming human head. Relatively weak individually, they become more dangerous in packs, and sometimes appear after “detaching” from a fallen zombie host: In a spray of blood, the head and some internal organs rip free of the skin and sprout legs. Keep your head on a swivel, lest you’re dropped on. Vermin sprint and jump to inflict damage, mouth wide-open with a wet growl. They’ve also been known to spit a caustic substance, but this is the least of your worries.

Vermin also have the potential to evolve into another form, emitting gas, elongating their skull thorax and changing into an airborne terror, the Parasite.

[b]Parasites[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e3a47923ac1654fd6dcaa9065d6d8ffe7534b13b.jpg[/img]

Parasites are horrific flying creates consisting of a toothy head attached to spindly membrane-like wings, and a bulging sack of flesh as an abdomen. They seem to possess a level of cunning, preferring to remain at a distance, harassing you with a pelting of acid bile projectiles spat from the maw.

[b]Manglers[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9378c966b3d8b6d1cddef5d64daf3a7f9397c507.jpg[/img]

A new Mangler suit variant has been greenlit by Project Janus, now armed with an Aetherium-augmented cannon and prone to extended bouts of primal rage. It is these bipedal tanks that now roam parts of the island, threatening all with a cannon that shoots multiple shots, and a vicious melee that anyone should steer well clear of.

[b]Amalgams [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a3306ae069ec45c5a3312363dc3bc2fa268e8bdd.jpg[/img]

The zenith of the body horror aesthetic, the Amalgam is a form of fleshy deviancy that until now has defied explanation. Roughly over eight feet in height, and retaining a general humanoid mass, this appears – to put this politely – to be the combined DNA of multiple individuals. It has multiple appendages, including heads, all growing from seemingly random locations.

There are limbs in places there shouldn’t be.

Nothing about this heresy of nature is quite right.

Amalgams appear to be violent masses of flesh and sinew, emitting bellows from multiple heads. Up to ten arms and five legs have been counted, and they seem to regenerate limbs previously shot off. They mainly try to absorb you (or other zombies) by stretching a cluster of limbs into a tendril to pull the victim into a maw-like chest cavity.

Though not witnessed, it is theorized that should an Amalgam be killed, it will spontaneously lose cohesion, exploding into sprays of blood, entrails and innards.

[b][u]Higher-Round Hordes[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5e1858743a7965dc7d7e914ef610158249141860.jpg[/img]

For those advanced players hoping for a challenge, get ready to pull out all the stops and learn a few new tricks as the round numbers climb. Zombies start to move with an increased swiftness, from shamble to run, to sprint. It becomes even more critical to learn escape and circular routes as well as every zombie spawn nest, lest you’re hemmed in and overwhelmed in seconds. The horde itself grows as the rounds increase, as does the frequency of Armored and Heavy Zombies, Manglers, the more revolting parasitical entities, as well the grotesque Amalgams.

Players should also expect a higher level of difficulty in general when it comes to high-round play, as Treyarch has limited the number of Self-Revive purchases to three per match. Coupled with the risk vs. reward nature of Augments (rather than relying on five tiers of permanent Weapon Skill upgrades in [i]Black Ops Cold War[/i], for example), players will need to make some tough choices to plan for their survival compared to more recent Zombies experiences.

[b][u]Terminus: A Living World of Terror and Traps[/u][/b]

[b]A Living World[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ff313e571966b0fa70ceb0571403abf2a2df4bed.jpg[/img]

Expect each Zombies map to come with ambient encounters specific to the environment. Explore Terminus, and you’ll encounter the last vestiges of Project Janus Security forces being pounced on and ravaged to death as the entire base is lost to a zombie outbreak. Body bags twitch on gurneys. Bloated corpses suspended in amniotic fluid twitch and peer out at you from large experimentation vats.

[b]Tentacle Traps[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fb09cdd39453bc665bcb65d201cff111293bb916.jpg[/img]

Located across the prison complex on the main island are a number of ceiling containment shutter vents. These seem to be holding back an <s>amorphous gelatinous monster</s>, perhaps something that has escaped from containment. Activate a switch to open the shutter vents, and long, limb-like tendril appendages seep through and dangle, waiting to be brushed against. Perpetually hungry, any zombies wandering under these tentacles are grabbed and dragged upwards into the vent for a bloody feasting.

[b]Void Cannon Trap[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/80c21e2ec5ac4e239e167fb466a85d674bd603cf.jpg[/img]

After the fortification of the island in 1942, a 16-inch artillery defense cannon was left to rust in the elements. Recently upgraded and improved by Project Janus forces in an attempt to weaponize Aetherium, this battery now serves as a devastating trap, providing you have the necessary power, as the cannon now shoots out a beam, the muzzle flash acting as a singularity that slows enemy advancement, and pulls any zombie enemies that are present within the deck area beneath the cannon up into the beam before they are vaporized.

[b]“The Tentacle”[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ddabfadfdd78458813f0208511ec7196ab471a85.jpg[/img]

Where there’s smoke, there’s fire. Or in this case, where there’s an alarming, choking, lightning-imbued cloud of toxic smog, there’s a monstrously sized, writhing tendril intent on capsizing tactical rafts. This worm-like crime against nature seems possessed by a proto-intelligence of sorts, spitting out a billowing spray of noxious vapors from its hideous, splayed maw, before quickly retreating beneath the waves.

Venture off the main island or into the water at your own risk!

[b][u]PART 6: NEXT STEPS[/u][/b]

[b][u]Incoming Comms: Prepare for Call of Duty®: NEXT on August 28![/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c9ba19a59a53e086882e34e77662a4991383814a.jpg[/img]

Call of Duty: NEXT returns on Wednesday August 28, 2024, and can be viewed live on either the Official [url=https://www.twitch.tv/callofduty]Call of Duty Twitch® Channel[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/callofduty]Call of Duty YouTube® Channel[/url]., or via your favorite streamer’s channel.

With developers from Treyarch and Raven on deck, and a host of other representatives from across the Call of Duty studios and community channels, Call of Duty: NEXT is the premier showcase for [i]Black Ops 6[/i]. Get ready to learn more about Multiplayer and Zombies, as well as [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]™.

[b][u]Pre-Order Digitally and Get the Reflect 115 Camo Pack[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c069d43acd009786f0c624c9ea20c2b29f3452ff.jpg[/img]

Pre-order [i]Black Ops 6[/i] today, and you’ll receive a variety of pre-order benefits, including the brand-new Reflect 115 Camo Pack for [i]Modern Warfare® III[/i], [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i]!

The Reflect 115 Camo Pack consists of the Reflect 115 Mastery Camo for use in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i]. notes.title: Black Ops 6 Zombies: The Story So Far
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/711b6bb7f8247792843048ec7cf52856b106a178.png[/img]

[h1][h2]THE STORY SO FAR: REQUIEM FOR A LOST SOUL[/h2][/h1]

After two years battling undead outbreaks across the globe during the Call of Duty®: Black Ops Cold War timeline, the CIA-led Requiem team finally succeeded in closing the last remaining dimensional portal, banishing its denizens back to the nightmarish hellscape known as the Dark Aether. 

[previewyoutube=6Z0Ni2JIqzw;full][/previewyoutube]

However, the team’s success came at a heavy price. Agent Samantha Maxis sacrificed herself to essentially seal this twisted dimension from the inside. Worse was to follow, as Requiem’s senior staff members were unceremoniously arrested on the orders of the Project Director—finally revealed to be none other than Edward Richtofen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9b791b523a1669a9f127c9651250ea222ac0f8ec.jpg[/img]

Taking place over half a decade later, Black Ops 6 Zombies continues the Dark Aether storyline, exploring the fortunes of key characters while also delving further into Richtofen’s motivations and goals.

During the intervening years, former Requiem staff—Grigori Weaver, Mackenzie “Mac” Carver, Elizabeth Grey, Oskar Strauss, and Stoney Maddox (better known by his callsign, Raptor One)—have been incarcerated at an outpost known as Terminus, a mysterious garrison located in the Philippine Sea.

After being imprisoned for over five years, these characters have undergone significant mental and physical changes. 

[h2]Operators and Handlers: Meet the Terminus Team[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/044d45a554bf7c398bf0d3854db12d46f11ee785.jpg[/img]

As a longstanding veteran of the broader Call of Duty: Black Ops storyline, Grigori Weaver is no stranger to the ever-evolving nature of war and conflict—and the gray area it frequently inhabits. Despite the guilt he feels for his perceived “failure” as the team’s commander, he is more than determined to confront and expose his former Director’s duplicity and agendas—whatever they may be. He's done playing politics and is willing to burn the whole house down to expose the corruption that has led them to their current situation.

Elizabeth Grey is no longer the meek and somewhat naive scientist who was so thrilled to be invited to work with Requiem that she was somewhat blind to the realities of the Dark Aether threat... and the dubious ethics of those who sought to control its power. These qualities had already changed with the loss of Samatha Maxis, but the injustice of her imprisonment brought out a tougher side she never even knew existed within her. Thanks to Carver’s mentorship and training, her transformation has made her more than capable of facing any threat head on.

For Carver, his lifelong belief in the military—not to mention his own distinguished career—has been shattered. He is understandably aggrieved, but not bitter. On the surface, it may seem that he has “run out of [[REDACTED]] to give,” but instead he is more dedicated to his friends and colleagues than ever, and believes that with determination, they will right this terrible injustice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1c9496ce33d4c5b058430518fe3f10986d8012e4.jpg[/img]

As for Strauss, not only has he not fared well under the strain of incarceration and intense interrogation, his age and increasingly eccentric personality mean he is deeply reliant on his colleagues—not just for his own physical wellbeing, but also his sanity. 

Events take an explosive turn when Maya Aguinaldo, a young Filipina smuggler, arrives on the island in pursuit of her own (and very personal) agenda related to the disappearance of her own brother. More significantly for our team, she is accompanied by a familiar, but far from welcome face…

There are many profanities that could be used to describe Dr. William Peck, but even the most offensive ones would fail to adequately do justice to just how detestable he is in the eyes of our heroes. 

[h2]Aetheric Incursions: An Outpost Overrun[/h2]

Even though Aguinaldo and Peck are primarily here to set our heroes free, their arrival coincides with Terminus Island suddenly becoming the epicenter of yet another outbreak. Consequently, suspicions are high. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/baeefdfe2f1fe616af93cc2812770291e9b7d5ac.jpg[/img]

Not only that, but it soon becomes clear that the chaos on Terminus is not the only incursion from the Dark Aether. On the other side of the globe, the West Virginian town of Liberty Falls is also facing its own zombie onslaught.

Personal grievances and suspicions aside, their dire circumstances mean that this disparate group of battle-hardened heroes has little choice but to fight together if they are to have any chance of survival…

[h1]GET READY: EXTENSIVE ZOMBIES INTEL COMMS INCOMING![/h1]

August 8. 8AM PT.

Return to the Call of Duty Blog at the time indicated to secure everything you need to know about Black Ops 6 Zombies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5cca192e298644760d59d1fcc7322288def38fbd.jpg[/img]

Expect extensive comms direct from the Treyarch Zombies Team, including an in-depth gameplay overview, information about your pre-match preparation options, full details on Round-Based Zombies gameplay, and a bestiary of the undead.

[h2]Additional Intel: Stay Informed. Not Misinformed[/h2]

Misinformation is everywhere: Ensure you stay one step ahead with the latest official Black Ops 6 information by checking the Call of Duty Blog in the coming days and weeks, as we dive deeper into the game, along with Call of Duty: NEXT, Open Beta, and other important comms you won’t want to miss.

notes.title: Season 5 BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Bundles
notes.notes:
[b][u]Brawl for the Championship in the Season 5 Battle Pass![/u][/b]

Operators must face off and eliminate all threats to muscle their way to the championship. Gear up for brutal battles ahead with the Season 5 Battle Pass, BlackCell, and Store content arriving in [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® III[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i].

[previewyoutube=wDb8uJHrmIg;full][/previewyoutube]

The Season 5 Battle Pass introduces over 100 rewards, including new Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, base weapons, and more. Purchase the premium Battle Pass to earn up to 1,400 COD Points as you progress through the Sectors, or purchase BlackCell for the ultimate seasonal experience including a variety of electric Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, COD Points, and other rewards.

Continue for a detailed overview of all the epic content arriving in Season 5, starting with BlackCell’s premium offering.

[b][u]BlackCell Season 5[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c99e1954650aaed61d7f90eb2d136d4cf513eef6.jpg[/img]

Terrify your enemies as the ghostly Reckoner leading Season 5’s BlackCell offerings alongside a variety of BlackCell Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, and more found throughout the Battle Pass.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e06c77119f4bb3ab76a2137e1f9671544a53039f.jpg[/img]

[b]Upgrade Your Battle Pass Experience: [/b]Purchase BlackCell for full access to the Season 5 Battle Pass along with 1,100 COD Points, 20 Battle Token Tier Skips, and earnable BlackCell-alternate content including 7 Tracer Weapon Blueprints and 11 animated Operator Skins.

[b]BlackCell Sector: Overview[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/208c139b23bc3c44841930786c5edd3ab3d2e523.jpg[/img]

Purchase BlackCell to enter the Battle Pass map via an exclusive Sector. This Sector immediately rewards 1,100 COD Points, the “Reckoner” Operator, and the following:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9da20a4b9da281928a1da96b87a005cf2cc029a3.jpg[/img]

Dish out kingly judgement with the “Long Live the King” SMG and the “Malleus” Sledgehammer. A spear, sword, and hammer circle the barrel of the SMG featuring Inquisitor Tracers, while glyphs stream down the length of the hammer imbued with Inquisitor Impact. An eerie smoke emanates from the weapons, and each one inflicts the “Divine Enforcement” Death Effect on defeated foes.

Instantly access the “Judge, Jury, and Finisher” Finishing Move whereby your Operator settles the matter for good using extrajudicial means. Other BlackCell items are unlockable throughout the Season 5 Battle Pass. These include 11 alternate BlackCell Operator Skins and 7 animated Weapon Blueprints.

[b]BlackCell Operator Skins confirmed:[/b] Valeria (x2), Mami (x2), Bantam, Byline, Enigma, Price, Hammer, Ivan, Jet

Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.

[b][u]Haunt Your Enemies as BlackCell’s Reckoner[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6bc3936bccee6575da8376740bcd1ace9b24e4d5.jpg[/img]

The veiled Reckoner reveals its ghastly inner presence as an animated Operator sparking with the energy of transformation. Reckoner joins KorTac as a menacing new presence, his penchant for retribution displayed in the “Judge, Jury, and Finisher” Finishing Move.

Reckoner is joined by a cast of animated BlackCell Operators imbued with a similar electric effect and geared up in intricate black and yellow tactical gear.

[b][u]Purchase the Battle Pass: Instantly Unlock Valeria, Rhea “Mami” Ripley[/u][/b]

Whether you purchase the BlackCell offering or the premium Battle Pass for 1,100 COD Points, the Instant Reward Sector becomes available, including a new Skin for Valeria plus the new Mami Operator.

Roving Adventure (SpecGru, Battle Pass Instant Reward)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/72dd55f6ba2ad6a3ec583df171231cdf7cadaad3.jpg[/img]

There’s no messing around with the Baroness. Leader of the Las Almas Cartel and cunning beyond belief, Valeria is here to exact revenge on those who put her away. Strike fear with her “Roving Adventure” Operator Skin, adorned with ancient relics acquired in dangerous escapades.

BlackCell Owners: Get the “Valeria BlackCell” alternate Skin for a grander black and yellow look with animated armor and a skull-painted face.

Rhea “Mami” Ripley (KorTac, Battle Pass Instant Reward)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3f281d8cbfd66da1ebf76c68b5f2134f607a8572.jpg[/img]

WWE star Rhea Ripley brings her a one-of-a-kind brutality to the battlefield with her “Mami” Operator. She joins the fight on the KorTac side, ready to take enemies head on with her signature gothic look: dark eyeliner and lipstick, a spiked leather vest, and knee-high combat boots.

BlackCell Owners: Get the “Mami BlackCell” alternate skin for a flashier fit, with a patterned leather vest over a yellow body suit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d6f3ad1dd8328181a1d78f2598c1419dc6f7a048.jpg[/img]

The Instant Reward Sector also grants a 10% Battle Pass boost, the “Prismtrap” Weapon Blueprint for the FJX Horus SMG featuring the JAK Scimitar Kit Aftermarket Part, and the “Riptide” Operator Finishing Move.

[b][u]Additional Battle Pass Skins[/u][/b]

Complete the Battle Pass Sectors to unlock a variety of new Operator Skins, each paired with an animated BlackCell alternate Skin:

[b]“Night’s End” Skins (Bantam Operator Skin, Sector 1)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1fedad04b609b590105072629ff239dfa030d27e.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]Bantam calls on the sun’s power with a burnished metal mask and intricate adornments snaking over his tattooed arms. Equipped with an armored vest, camo pants, and boots, he’s ready for the vigors of battle whatever may come.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]The sun darkens in the BlackCell variant of this Skin, sparks and smoke rising from the mask as if it’s just been snuffed out. The silver adornments and black and yellow tactical gear show there’s some life yet in this star.

[b]“Luchadora” Skins (Byline Operator Skin, Sector 4)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7076f1372685d1b87d54d104f551152ad2b59568.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]Don the confident attire of the Luchadora in a flame-accented mask over inlaid red and yellow attire tailored for the ultimate prize fight.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]Byline upgrades her championship outfit with striking black tactical gear inlaid with yellow highlights and a dark phantom mask. The BlackCell variant sparks and steams with latent power.

[b]“Trophy King” Skins (Enigma Operator Skin, Sector 5)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3a7a7766154d8f994aa1527078a68a574c27a0d5.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]Enigma gears up for heavy combat in the desert carrying an excess of ammunition over a camouflaged uniform designed for fighting in hot conditions.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]Swap camo for the season’s signature BlackCell look combining a black tactical uniform with yellow highlights and sparks flying. Notice the ghastly color of the rounds in his bandolier.

[b]“Homecoming” Skins (Price Operator Skin, Sector 10)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fe74b42a3f18a34620f931ffb1baa5bf28a22162.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]Captain Price at your service. As a formidable soldier and leader of Task Force 141, Price deploys in a military uniform ready for anything, the Union Jack strapped to his chest and back.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]Don a sleeker look with black gear highlighted by yellow and white accessories. Sparks fly from animated hang wraps signifying Price’s electric performance on the trigger.

[b]“Knight's Resolve” Skins (Hammer Operator Skin, Sector 11)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f52d2b84ded035b605589daa671a3e0cb58ee831.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]For nighttime operations, Hammer’s your guy. This Operator Skin features high-tech night vision goggles and a thick red jacket with heavy armor. A red plume rises from the helmet in the style of a knight.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]Hammer’s night vision goggles flicker and glow in the BlackCell variant as a ghostly animation flows through his heavy armor accentuated with the pale plume rising over the black and yellow uniform.

[b]“Ivan” Skins (Ivan Operator Skin, Sector 16)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a4584ee7f4adac3d9272b9bbf93e71374b32dae8.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]Ivan proudly displays the Konni Group logo on winter gear suited for combat in the harshest conditions, with accessories and tools intended to get out of all emergencies thrown at him.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin:[/b] Ivan deploys in the BlackCell-alternate “Boss’ Favorite” Skin, popping with yellow highlights over his gear and sparking for a fight.

[b]“Samurai’s Camo” Skins (Jet Operator Skin, Sector 18)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/40872b17ecbd277922284a3372069e3118bce950.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]Jet recalls the might of the samurai with a modern take on their traditional attire, employing tan and black armor fashioned with orange highlights matching the grinning mask peeking out from the helmet.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]Polished metal shines over this black samurai armor with yellow threads and an unnerving golden mask. The weapons at her side display a ghostly animated pattern, sparking for a fight.

[b][u]New Functional Weapons[/u][/b]

Gear up with two new functional weapons available to earn as rewards in the standard and premium Battle Pass at launch:

[b]Static-HV (Sector 6, HVT)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b958d567acb8897a5388abc096b1e637551321ee.jpg[/img]

[b]Bring compact lethality to the battlefield with this small SMG chambered in 5.7mm, boasting a high fire rate and significant ammo capacity in the factory magazine.[/b]

Lead your squad to victory by taking point with this ruthless SMG featuring 50 rounds in its base configuration. Excel in skirmishes where the odds are against you, eliminating multiple enemies in a row before needing to reload. Use Gunsmith to adjust its playstyle, whether that’s catering to a breathless off-the-hip approach or designing a precision model with pinpoint ADS fire.

[b]New Assault Rifle (Sector 7, HVT)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6538aacf7176ce878d0ca6c9f13cc2e61b44d07b.jpg[/img]

[b]The rifle that heralded the age of the assault rifle as a global standard. Fully automatic and chambered in 7.92x33mm, this is a hard-hitting primary weapon.[/b]

This powerful weapon breeds confidence, exhibiting a controllable recoil pattern with hard-hitting shots and clear iron sights. Add handling and mobility improvements to create a snappy mid-ranged weapon to lead the fight or opt for extra range and a magnified scope to burst fire enemies from further out.

[b][u]New Weapon Blueprints[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/62cc27e68a2b99d127b7e78d8ec4c661dee0ce15.jpg[/img]

Earn up to 20 Weapon Blueprints in the premium Season 5 Battle Pass alongside new Calling Cards, Emblems, Weapon Stickers, Decals, Finishing Moves, XP Tokens, COD Points, a Charm, and Zombies Acquisitions (including an Aether Tools, Aetherium Crystal, Ray Gun Weapon Case, and Shatter Blast Ammo Mod).

[b]Weapon Blueprints[/b]

The Season 5 Battle Pass Weapon Blueprints can generally be grouped into four main themes:

[b]Purple and White[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/815f565b455a0265ad5000f60d9e5ca48e6f7b09.jpg[/img]

[b]Instant Sector: [/b]“Prismtrap” FJX Horus SMG

The Instant Sector features its own studded purple and white Blueprint with a metallic sheen and laces akin to a wrestler’s boot.

[b]Red Metal[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6f7f4725db11cbc7fa30049fa0bc8ac53942b385.jpg[/img]

[b]Sector 1: [/b]“Flamma” TYR Handgun

[b]Sector 10: [/b]“Provocator” Bolt-Action Marksman Rifle

[b]Sector 12: [/b]“Parmularius” Lockwood 680 Shotgun

[b]Sector 16: [/b]“Merciful Downfall” Striker SMG

[b]Sector 18: [/b]“Luminous Dread” KV Inhibitor Sniper Rifle

[b]Sector 20: [/b]“Grand Assailant” XRK Stalker Sniper Rifle

Equip red metal Blueprints with intricate inlays over top-of-the-line parts. A combination of blue, black, and silver highlights further enhances weapons from this pristine category.

[b]SPQR Models[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/15bef7726ec7da79b14e8b134bc9175908007d8e.jpg[/img]

[b]Sector 2: [/b]“Laquearius” SVA 545 Assault Rifle*

[b]Sector 4: [/b]“Crixus” DG-58 LSW LMG

[b]Sector 8: [/b]“Attilius” Soulrender Melee*

[b]Sector 13: [/b]“Unyielding Forge” Sledgehammer Melee

[b]Sector 15: [/b]“Castus” KATT-AMR Sniper Rifle*

[b]Sector 19: [/b]“Dimachaerus” New Assault Rifle*

[b]Completion Sector: [/b]“Praetor” MCW Assault Rifle

Fit for a champion, these Blueprints recall the iron discipline of an ancient past. The brass and Latin inlays add further gravitas to these slayers.

[b]Paintball Blaster[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b390d017e134189e6927aee75b1b90fa766c70b1.jpg[/img]

[b]Sector 3: [/b]“Carpophorus” Reclaimer 18 Shotgun*

[b]Sector 9: [/b]“Bestiarius” RAM-7 Assault Rifle

[b]Sector 11: [/b]“Thraex” Renetti Handgun

[b]Sector 14: [/b]“Benign Hero” WSP Stinger Handgun and “Gladius Graecus” BAS-B Battle Rifle*

[b]Sector 17: [/b]“Sculpted Aptitude” Static-HV SMG*

Straight off the field, these paint-splattered Blueprints sport bright designs blasted with color from the impact of enemy paintballs.

[i][* Denotes a Weapon Blueprint with a BlackCell variant, detailed below][/i]

[b]Weapons with Additional BlackCell Blueprints[/b]

Seven of Season 5’s Battle Pass Blueprints are paired with a BlackCell variant in the same tier. These variants combine a textured black surface with yellow highlights. An animated glyph pattern alternately crawls up and retreats down the barrel.

[b]Laquearius[/b][b] — SVA 545 Assault Rifle (Sector 2, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant [/b]comes with Inquisitor Tracers and “Divine Enforcement” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ec05bcbd923f6ead30899dc3709b5db988caf19b.jpg[/img]

Outfitted with a heavy break muzzle that significantly reduces recoil and a precision barrel for improved accuracy and range, this Blueprint is ideal for powerful, controlled shots using the weapon’s 2.5x magnification optic.

[b]Carpophorus[/b][b] — Reclaimer 18 Shotgun (Sector 3, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant [/b]comes with Inquisitor Tracers and “Divine Enforcement” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/67e117b1beaf6ec321e3766cf01575dfa541a604.jpg[/img]

Inflict heavy damage up close with this Blueprint built with improved damage range and ADS handling plus additional tube ammo capacity at the cost of slower reloads. Grip tape enhances Tac-Stance spread and no stock amps up your Operator’s mobility.

[b]Attilius— Soulrender Melee Weapon (Sector 8, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant [/b]comes with Inquisitor Tracers and “Divine Enforcement” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2a2c7f8d480460dfc270ca6e50c0e1f210194b1f.jpg[/img]

Wield the ceremonial Soulrender Melee blade in combat, attacking your enemies with rapid slashes and slices while remaining light on your feet. Glyphs flow down the length of the weapon in its BlackCell variant, and a dispersing mist rises from its inner power.

[b]Gladius Graecus — BAS-B Battle Rifle (Sector 14, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant [/b]comes with Inquisitor Tracers and “Divine Enforcement” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5d32b1101bb2025ca7eb122dafa79af6690c0955.jpg[/img]

This snappy Battle Rifle Blueprint utilizes a flash hider for a shortened ping on the enemy’s radar after firing plus a compensator for improved recoil. A 30-round mag helps you stay in the fight longer with recoil control and stability enhancements working to keep you on target.

[b]Castus[/b][b]— KATT-AMR Sniper Rifle (Sector 15, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant [/b]comes with Inquisitor Tracers and “Divine Enforcement” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ba8f9522fc04bd50f0b9331b2bcc9a13c94db60a.jpg[/img]

This versatile Blueprint features a 3.7x and 7.0x variable zoom scope with suppressor to keep shots off the radar. Snipers on the move will appreciate its high-velocity ammo and improved ADS speeds.

[b]Sculpted Aptitude[/b][b] — Static-HV SMG (Sector 17, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant [/b]comes with Inquisitor Tracers and “Divine Enforcement” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d22c04e99a24c31e4fc6e81e2b608fceef179148.jpg[/img]

Based on the new Season 5 SMG, this SMG Blueprint adds the JAK Glassless Optic for a clean sight paired with enhancements to ADS and sprint to fire speeds. AN integrally suppressed barrel offers further benefits, allowing you to strike more stealthily.

[b]Dimachaerus[/b][b] — Season 5 Assault Rifle (Sector 19, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant [/b]comes with Inquisitor Tracers and “Divine Enforcement” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/598b7577c94c78675145e9a05a008330e5c619b1.jpg[/img]

Trade speed for suppression with this Blueprint based on the new Season 5 Assault Rifle, combining a 60-round drum with a long barrel and heavy grip to help stay on target during sustained fire.

[b][u]Complete the Battle Pass for Completion Sector Tier 100 Rewards[/u][/b]

Complete 100% of the map by conquering all Sectors to access the final Completion Sector, including 300 COD Points plus the “Praetor” MCW Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint, the “Powerbomb!” Finishing Move, and the following Operator Skins:

[b]“Eradicator” Skin for Mami[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/359ff9741a0ce017045654cf1fefb7f28feb12b7.jpg[/img]

Seek vengeance as the Eradicator in this gothic-themed Operator Skin. Rhea Ripley adds studs, spikes, and chains to her vest and garments in a tailored look for dominating even the toughest fights.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin:[/b] Sparks fly off Mami in the BlackCell version of this Skin. Deploy in chained black with yellow highlights, including the wrestler’s initials "RR” on the back of the vest.

[b]“Death’s Medallion” Skin for Valeria[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a55d4c70acabcd45dc0c5d59827b3b0f0213f338.jpg[/img]

In red and black with a rose in her ear matching red eyes peering through a skull mask, Death’s Medallion brings her foes to a swift end with incredible style. Rose petals drift over the medallion at her waist, and she carries a guitar over her serape to play melodies for friends and foes alike.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]Striking yellow highlights over black bring a more sinister look in the BlackCell variant, her guitar now throwing sparks over a ghostly animation over its surface, her armor embedded with the medallion exhibiting similar effects.

[b][u]Store Highlights: WWE Superstars, New Ultra Skin, and More[/u][/b]

Expand your champion roster with WWE Superstars Cody Rhodes and Rey Mysterio, joined by an eclectic mix of Bundles featuring the divine to the cosmic and beyond. Here are some of the highlights coming to Season 5:

[b][u]Tracer Pack: WWE — Cody Rhodes Operator Bundle[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f8a3ef3cbf82dec43d490579d20857d4482e138c.jpg[/img]

Born into wrestling royalty as the son of the late WWE Hall of Famer "The American Dream" Dusty Rhodes, "The American Nightmare" Cody Rhodes was destined for greatness. He honed his skills for years, capturing multiple titles in WWE from 2007 to 2016 by capturing two Intercontinental Championships and six WWE Tag Team Championships before departing to forge his own path. At WrestleMania XL, Cody achieved his destiny, dethroning Roman Reigns to claim the Undisputed WWE Championship.

The “Tracer Pack: WWE — Cody Rhodes” Operator Bundle comes with the “American Nightmare” Operator Skin plus two stars and stripes-themed Weapon Blueprints with tracers, the “Nightmarish Precision” Marksman Rifle and “The American Nightmare Arsenal” Superi SMG.

Slam your enemies with the “Cross Rhodes” Finishing Move and haunt them with the “The American Nightmare Weight Belt” Large Decal, “The American Nightmare” Weapon Sticker, “The American Nightmare” Weapon Charm, and the “Cody Rhodes” Loading Screen.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: WWE — Rey Mysterio Operator Bundle[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a18aca0b91cfcc25c6a33eb6fcf9c6e3ed91b2f7.jpg[/img]

Rey Mysterio has spent his entire life defying odds and shattering expectations. Trained from childhood in the Mexican lucha libre tradition, Mysterio adopted his namesake mask to honor his uncle's legacy. His high-flying, innovative offense and never-say-die attitude helped him capture every major title from the NXT Cruiserweight Championship to the World Heavyweight Championship, becoming the smallest man to ever hold that prestigious prize.

The “Tracer Pack: WWE — Rey Mysterio” Operator Bundle includes “The Ultimate Underdog” Operator Skin and two red and black Weapon Blueprints with “619” Tracers and the “LWD” Death Effect. The “Masked Mayhem” M16 Assault Rifle includes an Aftermarket Part alongside the “Defy Expectations” WSP Swarm SMG set in akimbo with drum magazines.

End the discussion with the “Mysterio Bulldog” Finishing Move and the “Booyaka Booy AKA 619” Large Decal, “Luchador Legacy” Weapon Sticker, “619” Weapon Charm, and “Rey Mysterio” Loading Screen.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Toon Force 141[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/96fddc62996d8b3b2db1d5bc24ed6664316c48c1.jpg[/img]

Take down your enemies, comic book style. This Bundle includes cel-shaded Operator Skins for Price, Ghost, Gaz, and Soap. Never to leave home without new armaments, Toon Force 141 is bringing two new cel-shaded Weapon Blueprints along for the ride, the “Shady Shotty” Reclaimer 18 Shotgun and the “Arid Shade” HRM-9 SMG.

Stick it to ’em with additional weapon accessories including the “Ghost Goes Boom!” Large Decal plus the “I Want You” and “Last Smoke” Weapon Stickers.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Down From the Skies Mastercraft Ultra Skin[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/86847a9d9e61da3cf155fa448ec95c600b080310.jpg[/img]

Strike with divine ferocity as “The Goddess” Reactive Ultra Skin for Alpine. Wield ancient armor over a statuesque form whose eyes and body increasingly glow after eliminating enemies. Use the "Divine Touch” Finishing Move to dispel any doubts regarding your power.

The Goddess brings two incredible Weapon Blueprints, both featuring “Divine” Tracers and the “Divine Dismemberment” Death Effect. Strike from afar with the “Celestial Core” XRK Stalker Sniper Rifle emboldened with snakes slithering across the body and at the barrel. Cast judgement up close with the brass and black “Celestial Rays” RAM-9 SMG, its divine power pulsing through the weapon’s body.

Bless your armaments with the “Heart of the Divine” Weapon Charm and express your strength with the animated “Unfathomable Power” Calling Card. Set an epic theme to your sessions using the “Origin Tale” Loading Screen.

[b][u]Wildlife Wanted: CODFish[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/da5067f0d966a08eac2b7f3d38e76fce80f18bad.jpg[/img]

You’ll feel right at home in Season 5’s new Bait Multiplayer map as Ripper’s “All Gilled Up” Operator Skin featuring a large fish head over scaled armor and a reflective windbreaker. Gut your enemies with the “Scale and Bone” BP50 Assault Rifle and the akimbo “Phantom Soul” Basilisk Handgun; both Blueprints feature translucent parts and inflict shocking effects on foes with “Neon Angler” Tracers and the “Bottom Feeder” Death Effect.

Glow up your cosmetic collection with the “Seafood Diet” Large Decal, “Something Fishy” Weapon Sticker, and “Heads or Tails” Emblem.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Black Hole[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7d920907fad230711a0d0a0447b4d10c591e5562.jpg[/img]

Hypnotize your enemies with the depths of infinite space in the “Event Horizon” Operator Skin for Doc. A gravity well circles her chest as stars orbit across her armor and face plate. Acquire two galactic Blueprints with “Supernova” Tracers and the “Orbital Yeet” Death Effect, the “General Relativity” TAQ Evolvere LMG and “Gravity Wave” RAM-9 SMG, both animated with cosmic power.

Display your intergalactic prowess with the “Spaced-Out” Large Decal, “Black Hole” Weapon Sticker, and “Galactic Marble” Weapon Charm. For your next deployment into the Exclusion Zone, the Bundle also includes a Flawless Aetherium Crystal; consume it once to Pack-A-Punch your current weapon to Level III.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Obon Festival[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/98fa4d9147538a8675f6ab80fb2c5aff03e4191c.jpg[/img]

Honor past warriors with the “Dreamer’s Entropy” Operator Skin in celebration of the Obon Festival, mixing traditional Japanese elements over red and black tactical gear and a grimacing mask recalling vengeful spirits. Wield two festival-themed Blueprints with “Obon Ember” Tracers, the “Crane’s Birth” Static-HV SMG based on a new Season 5 weapon and the “Snake’s Demise” BAS-B Battle Rifle.

Embrace the spirit of honoring ancestral ties with the “Summer Festival” Large Decal, “Hyottoko” Weapon Sticker, “Uchiwa” Emblem, and “Obon Festival” Loading Screen.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Echo Endo Thunder-Bolt[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/319f00fa4c81dbe787c1eaf53436fc05f43e7703.jpg[/img]

Let the beast run free as the “Miryou Echo” Operator Skin for Jet. Frost drips from this white and black tactical uniform suited for combat in the arctic wilds. A wolf pelt and tail provide warmth and flair, and sharp teeth line the bottom of a digital mask.

Strike your enemies with the “Beastly Howler” DG-58 LSW LMG and “Howling Demise” Striker SMG, both equipped with “VwV 4.0” Tracers and the “Okami” Death Effect which whisks away beaten enemies in wind and dust. Plus, shock the competition with the “Tag, You’re It” Calling card, “Lone Wolf” Weapon Sticker, “Wolf Tags” Large Decal, and “Echo Endo: Thunder-Bolt" Loading Screen.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Underboss Pro Pack[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0e21f69603b5f242a05141b3c04ade6ff54b9855.jpg[/img]

Rule and control the fight with the Tracer Pack: Underboss Pro Pack featuring the “Hooded Figment” Operator Skin for Enigma, combining lightweight state-of-the-art equipment with a hooded figure built for stealth and mobility. Slay your demons with the “Demon Hunter” Superi 46 SMG and “Soul Stealer” Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprints featuring “Ryujin” Tracers; both weapons are animated alongside illustrations of a raging oni.

Silence your enemies with the “Hiss of Death” Large Decal and “God of Storms” Weapon Sticker and equip the “Connective Honor” Emblem. The Bundle also includes a whopping 2400 COD Points for use toward your next Battle Pass or Store purchase!

[b][u]Upgrade to Modern Warfare III[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/181eca642666d4b222b717add591fe7566d02cfb.jpg[/img]

[i]Modern Warfare III[/i] celebrates the 20<sup>th</sup> anniversary of [i]Call of Duty[/i] with one of the greatest collections of Multiplayer maps ever assembled, including modernized versions of all 16 launch maps from [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2[/i] (2009), plus the introduction of an all-new open-world Zombies and a Campaign that finds Task Force 141 facing off against the ultimate threat in Vladimir Makarov.
