notes.title: Fully Revealed: Season 5 Content Drop
notes.notes:
[b][u]Get in the Ring: Modern Warfare® III Season 5 is Here![/u][/b]

Prepare for an all-out brawl in Season 5. We’re going to need a cleanup in aisle five... the infamous Superstore makes its return to Urzikstan in [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i]! Meanwhile, two new Multiplayer Core 6v6 maps are coming to [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III[/i], along with three cel-shaded and vibrant Variants: Celship (Shipment), Toonoxide (Rust), and Ink House (Stash House).

Also included are four free base weapons, six Aftermarket parts, the Mid-Season return of Resurgence Supreme to Rebirth Island, the arrival of Valeria and Ivan Alexxeve as Battle Pass Operators, plus an impressive roster of WWE superstars Rhea Ripley, “The American Nightmare” Cody Rhodes, and Rey Mysterio.

[previewyoutube=JbszDAPQ2Ms;full][[GAMEPLAY TRAILER HERE]][/previewyoutube]

Prepare for battle with a huge selection of free content, as well as Events, Challenges, and numerous Weapon Camos to unlock. Season 5 for [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] goes live on Wednesday, July 24 beginning at 9 AM PT.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e4cc8b51001c60005a81ad9df0f650ce90bc311a.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned with the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog]Call of Duty Blog[/url] for all official comms and announcements.

Check [url=https://www.callofduty.com/patchnotes]the Patch Notes[/url] prior to the release of Season 5 on July 24, with separate notes for [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] (led by Sledgehammer Games) and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] (led by Raven Software).

Plus, don’t miss out on [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides]free official Guides[/url] for new Season 5 Multiplayer launch maps on July 18.

[b][u]MODERN WARFARE III OVERVIEW (MWIII)[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d0b4ccb72c20d8686c46ad7c1c91d1bb8f88d151.jpg[/img]

[b]CONTENT SUMMARY [/b]
[list]	[*]Bait and Switch: Two new maps arrive in Season 5. Deploy dockside on a hot Florida day in Bait and Yard brings the fight to a desert junkyard in a new small-sized cel-shaded map. In addition, three fan-favorite maps receive a sketchy new cel-shaded look with the arrival of Celship (Shipment), Toonoxide (Rust), and Ink House (Stash House).[/*]	[*]Play to Win: Operators will be put to the test in new competitive Modes. Slam Deathmatch brings out the WWE Superstar within, requiring a showman’s finest Finishing Moves to take down enemies. COD Warrior is a 2v2v2 quickfire mini-game mode, but don’t forget – it’s all about the team that comes out on top.[/*]	[*]Fishing, Paint, and ‘Fuse: Three new Modes arrive Mid-Season! Fishfection Mode is a scaly twist on Infected, arming Operators with only the Spear and Compound Bow to fend off a growing school of fallen Fish Operators. Unleash the artist within in the vibrant new Paintball Mode, which replaces bullets with paint... and lethal one-shot kills. Then play Defuse or Destroy, a defensive twist on S&D that starts rounds with a bomb already planted. Tick, tick… boom![/*][/list]
[b][i]Multiplayer Maps: Two Brand New Core 6v6 Maps[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e2bacce115b1514707e9393332bdfb541940be47.jpg[/img]

Two new and diverse Core 6v6 maps arrive in Season 5, whisking you to a sunny dock in Florida and a cel-shaded junkyard in the Sonoran Desert. Stay sharp, because there’s more reimagined cel-shaded maps coming. Don’t get sketched out by these Map Variants – these ones will feel much more familiar.

[b]Bait (Launch)[/b]

[i]Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c9f134eaab1c44b1702426effadaf024eaf44da2.jpg[/img]

Catch some rays in the Sunshine State on the mid-sized Bait. Battle amongst tiki huts and take a swim in the pool or remain dockside watching for enemy movement near interior spaces like the Restaurant, Boat House, and Bait Shop. The map’s twisting layout provides endless tactical opportunities for every playstyle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7ca89c4ab78863b5e5954ab050e34dc0860498b1.jpg[/img]

Reach the Loading Docks via the Boat House crawl space and ambush enemies from the alcoves along the Jetty. Be the angler and not the prey, making use of every advantage.

[b]Yard (Launch)[/b]

[i]Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/95094376987ff5f1925e4086a9e4305045a64ef6.jpg[/img]

Crush your enemies in a dusty junkyard out in the Sonoran Desert. The small cel-shaded map twists around the base of the central Crane, surrounded by dirt pathways, containers, and discarded components. The eastern Garage offers a tight flanking path down the map, but most of the fighting takes place in the open.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e4b162e1833b4233c179b576535109b312e8c8e4.jpg[/img]

Try your luck in the base of the Crane, where its rounded interior curves around a dividing wall adjacent to a small work room. Prepare to encounter Shotguns and explosives; an Operator who survives the inner gauntlet will be rewarded with its critical position as the map’s dead center.

[b]Celship (Launch)[/b]

[i]New (Variant), Core, 6v6, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/828e0d925d4943457577afd652cfdb65889fef08.jpg[/img]

Deploy to a cel-shaded version of Shipment where multi-colored containers and the bright blue sea add vibrancy to the intensely chaotic map. Animations take on a new life, too, the bright sun shining a light on every little detail.

[b]Toonoxide (Launch)[/b]

[i]New (Variant), Core, 6v6, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0a1c461427e7d32919a4bdc7c01c3a31d671514a.jpg[/img]

It’s dusk on Rust with a full moon overhead. As another cel-shaded map variant, the fan-favorite location takes on a whole new vibe. The threat — and opportunities — presented by the central Tower, however, remain ever at the heart of this classic battleground.

[b]Ink House (Mid-Season)[/b]

[i]New (Variant), Core, 6v6, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/39ae6b0fed257d27adce0b80c0744b488c73d036.jpg[/img]

Return to Palo Alto as Stash House gets the cel-shaded treatment with a stress on bold black outlines lending the map an inked look. Enjoy the details in the heightened contrast while fighting for every inch around the iconic house.

[b][i]Multiplayer Modes: Slam Deathmatch, COD Warrior Mini-Game Mayhem, Fishfection and More[/i][/b]

[b]Game Mode: Slam Deathmatch (In-Season) [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ff2b9944be0f804aa9a58f7f45c02eba4de895e8.jpg[/img]

Wrestle up your finest Finishing Moves in this spin on traditional Team Deathmatch. It’s still all about eliminations in Slam Deathmatch, but in this Mode weapons can only down your enemies. To earn points, you must finish off opponents by hitting them with a Finishing Move.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2e4c55355562e701bd1782b493e881bd2d247f2a.jpg[/img]

All Finishing Moves will be randomized WWE Finishing Moves in upcoming Slam Deathmatch brawls, and the Mode will only be available during the WWE SummerSlam event, starting on July 31.

[b]Game Mode: Arcade Playlist (In-Season)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/11cd02571460b1f841f207b3de4e95c9858afecb.jpg[/img]

Power up with the return of Arcade, featuring two new strategic abilities and several exciting new power weapons. In addition, all Arcade players will benefit from increased jump height and the ability to slam (non-damaging) to quickly return to the ground.

Abilities: Two new abilities arrive with Arcade this season. Players can Ground Slam, doling out damage in an area of effect upon landing from a jump. If successfully completed within range of an enemy, the blow can be lethal. Forcefield is a defense ability, creating a big transparent bubble around the player that defends against incoming bullets. As the Forcefield absorbs more damage, it will eventually be destroyed.

Weapons: Deliver the pain with five new power weapons, each with a unique effect:
[list]	[*]Sledgehammer Melee: Increased knockback ability[/*]	[*]Minigun: Battle Rage ability[/*]	[*]MORS Sniper Rifle: Explosive knockback effect[/*]	[*]TYR Pistol: Akimbo Snakeshot Dragon’s Breath[/*]	[*]Push Dagger Melee: Big lunge ability[/*][/list]
[b]Game Mode: COD Warrior (Launch)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2250520f0d7b24ccc51179571f1b9d0c68274a57.jpg[/img]

Mini-games, anyone? COD Warrior is a new Mode that puts three teams of two to the test in a series of randomized quickfire mini-games. Every round wins one point, and the first team to reach five points takes the game.

Be prepared for mini-game mayhem! Round timers for mini-games will range from 30 to 90 seconds, and all mini-games will be weapon-based and give Operators one life, with no respawn.

[b]COD Warrior Mini-Games:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6d10913e5f0fe8dce31a05bea0bdf78c1acfdaf6.jpg[/img]

CAPTION: [i]Beat up the Car Mini-game (above)[/i]

[b]Beat Up the Car![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 Seconds[/b]

Each team spawns in with Sledgehammers and a vehicle. The first team to destroy their car wins.

[b]Breacher Ball![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 seconds[/b]

All Operators are provided with unlimited Breacher Drones as their only armament. Survive to win.

[b]Bullet Time![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 seconds[/b]

Test your reflexes against extremely low velocity weapons, allowing you to better sidestep and evade enemy fire. Survive to win.

[b]Shoot![/b]

[b]Round Time: 30 seconds[/b]

Spawn in a circle with every Operator wielding the powerful TYR Handgun. Draw fast and survive to win.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/119a533001a17470237826e0261fc8ef0405317e.jpg[/img]

CAPTION: [i]Bullet Time Mini-game (above)[/i]

[b]Don’t Shoot![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 seconds[/b]

Listen closely. In this variant, everyone spawns in a circle with the TYR Handgun equipped. Anyone who shoots, however, will die on the spot. Survive to win.

[b]Drone Wars![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 seconds [/b]

All Operators spawn with Stormenders and Bomb Drones. Survive to win.

[b]Fragged![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 seconds[/b]

Settle things explosively in this mini-game where all Operators are provided with unlimited Frag Grenades only.

[b]The Hunt![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 seconds [/b]

Operators are assigned the role of a hunter or a runner. Hunters must eliminate the runners who have no weapons to fight back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f51c64acdd9f23f964352c2fa9cd9e9f982036f1.jpg[/img]

CAPTION: [i]Breacher Ball Mini-game (above)[/i]

[b]Knives![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 seconds [/b]

Operators spawn with knives only. Survive to win.

[b]“Meta” Loadout![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 seconds [/b]

Do your best in this ironic take on the meta as Operators duke it out with poorly optimized Loadouts. Survive to win.

[b]Miniguns for Everyone![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 seconds[/b]

Prepare for brutal combat as each Operator is provided a Juggernaut suit and a minigun. Survive to win.

[b]Last Ninja Standing![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 seconds[/b]

Operators battle with Throwing Stars only while benefiting from increased movement speed and jump height. Survive to Win.

[b]Revive![/b]

[b]Round Time: 60 seconds [/b]

Each team spawns with a downed Operator. The first team to locate and revive their downed teammate wins.

[b]Shocking![/b]

[b]Round Time: 90 seconds[/b]

Push through the pain. In this mini-game, all Operators must battle under the permanent effects of a Shock Stick.

[b]Turret Time![/b]

[b]Round Time: 90 seconds[/b]

All Operators are provided with Stormenders and a Remote Turret. Survive to win.

[b]Game Modes: Mid-Season[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/227aab5e959b8fe9d095de467042f83571fde38d.jpg[/img]

Along with other surprise content, expect three new game modes to arrive later in the season, offering new ways to perfect the new Bow and Spear, as well as novel and new methods of gaining the win:

[b]Game Mode: Fishfection (Mid-Season)[/b]

Avoid the hook in this slippery twist on Infected. Equipped with only the Compound Bow and Spear as your weapons in Fishfection, where it’s your goal to prevent getting eliminated by a bloodthirsty school of Fish Operators composed of previously fallen players.

[b]Game Mode: Paintball (Mid-Season)[/b]

We’re going painting! Paintball, played predominantly on small maps and in modes like Capture the Flag and Kill Confirmed, gives players increased movement abilities for the duration of the Mode and replaces all bullet impacts with paint splatters. That means every weapon is a one-shot kill, so take cover behind a bunker of choice and get ready for some quick-action painting.

[b]Game Mode: Defuse or Destroy (Mid-Season)[/b]

Expect an explosive twist on Search & Destroy at mid-season too! In this round-based objective mode, teams take turns attacking and defending bomb sites. The twist? This mode’s rounds start with a bomb already planted in one of two possible locations, putting a literal ticking time bomb into play as teams alternate to defend and defuse.

[b][i]Multiplayer Ranked Play Intel (Launch Window)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/36aa2b990a3fb77fe20d8715a06e93928b189053.jpg[/img]

As always, earn MWIII Ranked Play rewards in three ways:
[list]	[*][b]Rank Rewards:[/b] Available at launch and can be earned in any season. Players can continue their previous rank grind in Season 5.[/*]	[*][b]Season Rewards:[/b] Available at the start of the season and only available that season.[/*]	[*][b]End-of Season Rewards:[/b] Rewards that are awarded after the season concludes and represent either your highest attained division or an active placement in the Top 250 Division.[/*][/list]
Ranked Rewards are consistent from season to season, but Competitor and Skill Division Rewards have been updated for Season 5. Note that the Ranked Play Operator Skins remain unlockable from season to season.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f770d82c7bced16b6024c762d9702621ec6a6047.jpg[/img]

[b]New Season 5 Competitor Rewards:[/b]
[list]	[*]5 Wins: “MWIII Season 5 Competitor” Weapon Sticker[/*]	[*]10 Wins: “Pro Re-Issue MCW” Weapon Blueprint[/*]	[*]25 Wins: “Smell of Victory” Weapon Charm[/*]	[*]50 Wins: “MWIII SR Monster” Weapon Decal[/*]	[*]75 Wins: “MWIII Ranked Play Season 5” Loading Screen[/*]	[*]100 Wins: “MWIII Season 5 Ranked Veteran Weapon Camo[/*][/list]
[b]New Season 5 Skill Division Rewards[/b]

The following are the end-of-season rewards for Season 5, awarded based on the highest placement in your Skill Division:
[list]	[*]Bronze: “MWIII Season 5 Bronze” Emblem[/*]	[*]Silver: “MWIII Season 5 Silver” Emblem[/*]	[*]Gold: “MWIII Season 5 Gold” Animated Emblem[/*]	[*]Gold: “MWIII Season 5 Gold” Weapon Camo[/*]	[*]Platinum: “MWIII Season 5 Platinum” Animated Emblem[/*]	[*]Platinum: “MWIII Season 5 Platinum” Weapon Camo[/*]	[*]Diamond: “MWIII Season 5 Diamond” Animated Emblem[/*]	[*]Diamond: “MWIII Season 5 Diamond” Weapon Camo[/*]	[*]Crimson: “MWIII Season 5 Crimson” Animated Emblem[/*]	[*]Crimson: “MWIII Season 5 Crimson” Weapon Camo[/*]	[*]Iridescent: “MWIII Season 5 Iridescent” Animated Emblem[/*]	[*]Iridescent: “MWIII Season 5 Iridescent” Weapon Camo[/*]	[*]Iridescent: “MWIII Season 5 Iridescent” Animated Calling Card[/*]	[*]Top 250: “MWIII Season 5 Top 250” Animated Emblem[/*]	[*]Top 250: “MWIII Season 5 Top 250” Animated Calling Card[/*]	[*]Top 250: “MWIII Season 5 Top 250” Animated Weapon Camo[/*][/list]
Need a refresher on Ranked Play for Modern Warfare III? Consult the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/01/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-iii-warzone-season-1-reloaded-multiplayer-zombies-content#Ranked]Multiplayer Ranked Play Guide here[/url], and tune into the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/patchnotes]Patch Notes[/url] for additional Ranked Play intel, updates, and more.

[b][i]New Equipment (Launch)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aa6a10673dfe8d9c890f735666a0791cf7b44efa.jpg[/img]

[b]New Tactical: EMP Grenade (Launch)[/b]

This deactivates enemy electronics and disrupts enemy sensors for a short time. Even if no equipment is affected, you’ll still negatively impact the HUD of any enemies caught in the blast, making this a good breaching tool to disorient opponents before rushing in for the clear.

[b][u]MODERN WARFARE ZOMBIES OVERVIEW (MWZ)[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7564695d900a3d9f3869d8f95279af8eb6557275.jpg[/img]

[b]CONTENT SUMMARY [/b]

[b]Content Summary [Mid-Season][/b]
[list]	[*]The end is here. Descend into the Dark Aether to disrupt and sever the link between Dr. Jansen and the Entity. Experience a gravity-defying Dark Aether arena, featuring Aetherium launch pads and an all-new boss.[/*]	[*]Brave the Dark Aether and unlock a new replayable experience and earn three new schematics. Can you survive the horrors ahead?[/*][/list]
[b][i]Final Story Mission (Mid-Season)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6e4cfb2333102485f39c8138d419ed9f5ed5066c.jpg[/img]

Operation Deadbolt must face the ultimate challenge in confronting the Entity in a terrifying new section of the Dark Aether. Use Aetherium launch pads to soar through the environment and keep away from the dangerous hordes of undead lurking on the ground. Prepare to abandon all hope as you make your way towards the climatic conclusion and the final boss.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d60846e5a9f719bdd9d506fc741ddeb743891231.jpg[/img]

Survive the narrative driven final Story Mission to unlock the conclusion cinematic and secure the first piece needed to access the new Dark Aether Rift.

[b]New Dark Aether Rift [i](Mid-Season)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7ec20bcc69e5ed27e1f498015c6ca867286d73a3.jpg[/img]

Stay alert for clues and work with the community to discover the path towards a lucrative and lethal Season 5 Reloaded Dark Aether Rift. This perilous challenge offers players a fresh way to experience the Dark Aether and awards the opportunity to earn powerful rewards, including permanent unlocks.

[b]New Secrets, Schematics [i](Mid-Season)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c91045a4c797297adc469c129f09bbfaf6e7cd76.jpg[/img]

Deploy with your squad to unlock and acquire the following schematics, boosting your damage and permanently increase your carrying capacity:
[list]	[*][b]Disciple Bottle: [/b]Spawn a friendly Disciple to wreak havoc against your foes.[/*]	[*][b]Grenade Bandolier:[/b] Replenish your Lethal and Tactical Equipment over time, allowing you to regularly bombard enemies.[/*]	[*][b]Stash Increase: [/b]Increase your stash size to 30. Get lootin’.[/*][/list]

notes.notes:
[b][u]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE OVERVIEW (WZ)[/u][/b]

[b]CONTENT SUMMARY[/b]
[list]	[*]Get some retail therapy as the infamous Superstore POI returns to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] in Urzikstan.[/*]	[*]Compete in new modes like Superstore Resurgence and Supreme Resurgence on Rebirth Island. Test your skills in new Public Events and tackle new features like the Redeploy Drone Beacon and Elite Contracts.[/*]	[*]Gain bragging rights in an all-new season of Ranked Play on Rebirth Island, featuring new Skill Division rewards for dedicated competitors.[/*][/list]
[b][i]New POI: Urzikstan Superstore Returns (Launch)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/176c97b2aef09d23b4594cde88efb7d26f68b70a.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the Atlas Superstore, inspired by the original Superstore in Verdansk, and home to all your [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] shopping needs. Whether it be a rare weapon, a new perk set, a fresh set of armor plates, or some other coveted item, the Superstore has what you need to secure the win. Stay tuned to your surroundings as other squads are bound to heed the same shopping impulse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e14897228bec437c2dd3bf780791b295189a7644.jpg[/img]

Just south of the Orlov Military Base, Superstore is located in the central-eastern side of Urzikstan. Landing on the large roof from the plane or via redeploy is the quickest way to get into the Superstore. It’s a large two-story building with a good amount of cover via the skylights and air A/C units, but your goal should be to get inside as quickly as possible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/87b5cda45ada2c8e4c584575ba2d22ec2608234c.jpg[/img]

From the roof there are four different entry points, so find them and get through as soon as you can. You can also enter from Al-Sada Village via a zipline. However, from the ground there are more than 10 different entrances, so there’s always another way in nearby.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f20509dea22acb9c307494e036f7aad36073b03b.jpg[/img]

Once inside, if you’ve used any of the main entrances, you may have a moment of peace as you loot because of how large the Superstore really is. It feels even larger due to the many aisles and staff and storage rooms there are that make up the Superstore. Check every corner and keep your head up as you venture through the building because enemy players can be hiding in one of many locations built into this incredible POI.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/81faa941f33152d898ef64efbaa0bedc36d900c2.jpg[/img]

Entering from the ground floor, you’re positioned in one of the corners which can be used as cover to protect your squad’s six, but also to breach and clear one quadrant at a time. Entering from the second floor, you’ll encounter an office or break room that overlooks a portion of the main floor. Use these angles to call a cleanup on aisle 4 while you loot to your heart’s content.

[b][i]Call of Duty: Warzone Modes, Features, and Public Events[/i][/b]

[b]Superstore Resurgence (Urzikstan, Launch)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6a38a465b653f170df1c70df5129f8008587e191.jpg[/img]

Break in the new Superstore POI with a dedicated Resurgence mode. This is a custom-made experience focusing on the Superstore POI, dropping 28 players into a ten-minute match with the emphasis on who can control the roof and aisles and other chokepoints throughout the location.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bd7a9251f718bd4a0ef0426b2a95dfdcb3dd9bd2.jpg[/img]

Compact combat, vicious firefights, and rapid pacing make this an instantly satisfying mode you can drop into again and again. This is also the perfect training ground to explore the classic area whether you’ve battled across these aisles before or it’s your first time browsing.

[b]Supreme Resurgence (Rebirth Island, Mid-Season)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/622c4a44e2f81f822261b85ce35ac4907e2fc226.jpg[/img]

Supreme Resurgence is back! In this mode, Rebirth Island is filled with exceptional ground loot. This includes powerful meta-inspired Weapon Blueprints with cool camos; there’s a premium price for Loadouts, so obtaining these weapons is recommended. Experience these and other changes to the Resurgence formula including additional health for all Operators.

Plus, players who win their first match in Supreme Resurgence will unlock the “Spilled Beans” Weapon Camo.

[b]New Public Event: Bounty Contest (Resurgence Modes, Launch)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ed75076df0fd8242d266b96bd5ecd83c943fc5ae.jpg[/img]

Prepare for heated battle when the Bounty Contest Public Event activates in Resurgence. When this occurs, every squad is instantly given a Bounty Contract to complete within the designated time. Eliminate the target to accrue kudos as well as some in-game cash, then move onto the next squad member, progressing until you’ve wiped out the whole squad. With every squad sent on a Bounty at once, expect fierce fighting to occur across the map. Squads going on a Bounty streak should also expect to rack up some serious money at a seriously quick pace!

[b]New Feature: Redeploy Drone Beacon (R.D.B.) Field Upgrade (All Modes, Launch)[/b]

Throw out a line when you need it using the new portable R.D.B. Field Upgrade. Once deployed, it can be used by the whole squad to evade incoming dangers, seek out new looting areas, or to reposition for a stronger attack.

[b]New Feature: Elite Contracts (All Modes, Mid-Season)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1f7fc2485f03b87f933669698b419fbab788a11d.jpg[/img]

Complete Elite Contracts to earn a variety of rewards listed below. The Elite Contract is no easy task; the time given to complete one is reduced compared to a normal Contract. Providing you prove your mettle, an Elite cache drops into the AO, with Bonus XP, Cash, and one of the following:

Foresight Killstreak

Multiple Redacted Weapons

Specialist Perk Package

Advanced UAV

[b]New Public Event: Recon Flyover (All Modes, Mid-Season)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a36ff0181efaace045c1a670cc763ce5599d0fc1.jpg[/img]

There’s no place to hide during a Recon Flyover, so get out there and fight. When this event is activated, two waves of Advanced UAVs highlight scanned Operators as red player arrows – with the recon zone shown as a red circle in your mini-map – and fly towards them. If you’re caught in this Recon, you will be exposed to other players. Use the intel to reassess your plan, seeking the best ground to engage imminent danger.

[b][i]Call of Duty: Warzone Season 5 Ranked Play Resurgence (Launch Window)[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4c22b7f94d295081e5ca01e0b2128dddd9e66848.jpg[/img]

Compete in the next season of [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]Ranked Play as Rebirth Island Resurgence returns challenging players to prove their skillset on the way to the Top 250. Harness the competitive spirit and earn new rewards for ranking up and advancing through the Skill Divisions. [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/03/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-iii-warzone-wzm-season-3-maps-modes-zombies-announcement#Play]For a refresher on this Mode, click here.[/url]

Ranked Play Resurgence players can earn rewards via Ranking, the completion of Placement Challenges, and Skill Division rewards.

[b]New Season 5 Skill Division Rewards[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/627f31013da7c4dce29bf60e7c249c680a2bb925.jpg[/img]

Here are the Season 5 Kills or Assists and Placement rewards:

Get 25 Kills or Assists: “WZ Season 5 Competitor” Weapon Sticker

Get 250 Kills or Assists: “WZ Ranked Play Season 5” Loading Screen

Get 1,000 Kills or Assists: “WZ Season 5 Ranked Veteran” Weapon Camo

Place in the Top 15, 25 times: “SR Monster” Weapon Decal

Place in the Top 5, 25 times: “Pro Issue SOA Subverter” Weapon Blueprint

Place 1<sup>st</sup>: “Straight Fire” Weapon Charm

The End of Season rewards for Season 5 are awarded based on your highest Skill Division placement, including:

Bronze: “WZ Season 5 Bronze” Emblem

Silver: “WZ Season 5 Silver” Emblem

Gold: “WZ Season 5 Gold” Animated Emblem

Gold: “WZ Season 5 Gold” Weapon Charm

Platinum: “WZ Season 5 Platinum” Animated Emblem

Platinum: “WZ Season 5 Platinum” Weapon Charm

Diamond: “WZ Season 5 Diamond” Animated Emblem

Diamond: “WZ Season 5 Diamond” Weapon Charm

Crimson: “WZ Season 5 Crimson” Animated Emblem

Crimson: “WZ Season 5 Crimson” Weapon Charm

Iridescent: “WZ Season 5 Iridescent” Animated Emblem

Iridescent: “WZ Season 5 Iridescent” Animated Calling Card

Iridescent: “WZ Season 5 Iridescent” Weapon Charm

Top 250: “WZ Season 5 Top 250” Animated Emblem

Top 250: “WZ Season 5 Top 250” Animated Calling Card

Top 250: “WZ Season 5 Top 250” Weapon Charm

#1 Overall: “Season 5 #1 Overall” Animated Emblem

#1 Overall: “Season 5 #1 Overall” Animated Calling Card

Ranked Play competitors can also earn the Skill Division Operator Skin sets for use with both the CDL Male and Female Operators (for both factions) to represent your highest Skill Division obtained above Gold. These Skins are the same as the ones you can unlock in Modern Warfare III Multiplayer Ranked Play.

[b][i]Season 5 Call of Duty: Warzone Rewards[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ebd4bca486d46518549211c590bff9f1f43a0e71.jpg[/img]

The Call of Duty: Warzone Rewards system introduced in Season 4 continues with new trackable Challenges and rewards in Season 5! Found in the “Call of Duty: Warzone Rewards” section of the Challenges Menu, the Season 5 tab introduces four new categories:
[list]	[*][b]Combat Expertise:[/b] Acquire your Loadout and get hunting. Earn rewards for taking the fight to the enemy and surviving to the end.[/*]	[*][b]Cooperation:[/b] Assemble your squad, work together to eliminate enemies, and share your Cash.[/*]	[*][b]Mobility:[/b] Get out and explore the map. Move fast and far to acquire the rewards in this category.[/*]	[*][b]Redacted:[/b] Sometimes Operators must make do with limited intel. Puzzle out these redacted Challenges to reap the rewards.[/*][/list]
There are four Challenges in each category, a reward given after completing every Challenge. Unlock a new Weapon Camo as the final reward in each, including “Iron Ore” for completing Combat Expertise, “Rose Quartz” for completing Cooperation, “All Speed” for completing Mobility, and “Decipher” for completing Redacted.

New to Season 5, players will also earn a mastery reward Weapon Blueprint upon completing all 16 Challenges. Wield the “Sports Icon” Bruen MK9 LMG, a black and white precision Blueprint featuring the JAK Glassless Optic Aftermarket Part and a 60 Round Mag for sustained fire.

[b][u]CONNECTED CONTENT OVERVIEW (MWIII, MWZ, WZ)[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/39f4cd3d5cecfb6b1ad2b1eebfc56a7d28f90e0a.jpg[/img]

[b]CONTENT SUMMARY[/b]
[list]	[*]Unlock two weapons for free at the launch of Season 5 via the Battle Pass. Two more arrive later in the season that can pin enemy Operators against the wall.[/*]	[*]Access six new Aftermarket Parts arriving throughout Season 5, including the JAK Widemouth Barrel for the MORS Sniper Rifle and other devastating configurations.[/*]	[*]Steel yourself for the Reckoner, Season 5’s leading BlackCell Operator featuring a ghostly veil that occasionally reveals the phantom within. Use the accompanying BlackCell Finishing Move to settle the score for good.[/*]	[*]Valeria joins WWE Superstar Rhea Ripley AKA Mami alongside Ivan Alexxeve, the man who led the mission to free Makarov. Unlock these and other rewards in the Season 5 Battle Pass including additional Operator Skins, Weapon Blueprints, COD Points, and other more.[/*]	[*]Expand your all-star roster with WWE icons “The American Nightmare” Cody Rhodes and Rey Mysterio joining an epic lineup of other Store Bundles.[/*]	[*]Rule the ring and unlock new content across Weekly Events like the WWE SummerSlam. Plus, keep the competitive spirit alive by tuning into C.O.D.E. Bowl V and climbing those Prestige Ranks all the way to Level 1,050 to reach new rewards for committed grinders.[/*][/list]
[b][i]Weapons Detail:[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/098a1b8e5c2ae28020852f835d52c87d37fa6421.jpg[/img]

Tackle the battles ahead with new armaments beginning with a beast of an SMG and a time-honored Assault Rifle before moving on to less conventional weaponry later in the season.

[b]Static-HV (Submachine Gun, Launch, Battle Pass Sector 6)[/b]

Levels: 18, Battle Pass Blueprint [Sector 17]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/77365193972a6563a7e0e840de21d30a576b002e.jpg[/img]

[i]Bring compact lethality to the battlefield with this small SMG chambered in 5.7x28mm. The weapon boasts a high fire rate and significant ammo capacity with a base of 50 rounds in its factory magazine.[/i]

Like a bite-sized LMG, the Static-HV keeps on firing through even the thickest of fights. Overwhelm your opponents with a hail of fire and use Gunsmith to specialize in hip-fire, Tac-Stance, or ADS. Try different Ammunition attachments and test out various Muzzle and Barrel combinations to squeeze out the most out of this close quarters needler.

[b]STG (Assault Rifle, Launch, Battle Pass Sector 7)[/b]

Levels: 21, Battle Pass Blueprint [Sector 19]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/70f505ef6294b4ad6880a83754679a6a64a107d7.jpg[/img]

[i]The rifle that heralded the age of the assault rifle as a global standard. Fully automatic and chambered in 7.92x33mm, this is a hard-hitting primary weapon.[/i]

That power results in a signature recoil pattern that though noticeable is easily controlled for accurate fire. The weapon’s high-quality iron sights potentially free up an extra attachment slot if you forgo an Optic. Fine tune your playstyle in Gunsmith with attachments like a 60 Round Mag and the recoil-reducing JAK BFB Aftermarket Part. However you build it, its powerful base ensures you'll come out with a reliable weapon.

[b]Spear (Melee Weapon, Mid-Season via BP Sector Unlock and Challenges)[/b]

Levels: 6

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ebdd1dd1635322ddb02416426df3e642b4b98776.jpg[/img]

Fight like the ancients with a throwable Spear built for the demands of modern combat. Three Spears are provided at each spawn; they throw fast and straight, with a reticle provided to account for various distances. Thrown Spears can be retrieved from the environment and at least one should be kept for the weapon’s rapid piercing strikes in close quarters.

[b]Torque 35 (Launcher, Mid-Season, Weekly Challenge)[/b]

Levels: 6

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f0a80c7f6f1e31ce9ac4f021f4dc92df350cbf8a.jpg[/img]

Wield a compound bow with 20 retrievable arrows, a red dot sight for accurate shots on target, and a weapon inspection animation that shouldn’t be missed. The bow’s excellent handling allows quick follow-up shots and in close fights the option to fire off the hip keeps you light on your feet. Pull back for longer to increase the strength and velocity of each shot and get creative with an array of Ammunition options including arrowheads equipped with thermite, explosive, and gas cartridges.

Both the Spear and the Torque 35 can pin enemies against the wall, so stick your insertion points accordingly.

[b][i]Six New Aftermarket Parts [Launch, In-Season, MWIII, MWZ, WZ, WMZ][/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/be28ca93417a0ae5ba35b59c3bdc34c0d1600e51.jpg[/img]

Get attached to six new Aftermarket Parts being introduced in Season 5, usually unlockable via Weekly Challenges, like the JAK Cataclysm for the RPK LMG (pictured above).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9ebc6f854f55e5b3b6d145386b9af95aed55d789.jpg[/img]

[b]JAK Widemouth Barrel[/b]

[b]Compatibility: MORS Sniper Rifle [MWIII][/b]

A widemouth barrel crafted to accommodate magnetic ball bearings that shatter upon firing, creating a barrage of small and lethal projectiles.

[b]JAK Slash[/b]

[b]Compatibility: Many Weapons with underbarrel capabilities[/b]

This underbarrel vertical grip doubles as a combat knife, replacing your melee attack with a lethal slash.

[b]JAK Protean[/b]

[b]Compatibility: RAAL LMG[/b]

This conversion kit turns the RAAL into a highly adaptable prototype weapon with a telescoping barrel that can be toggled between full-auto and semi-auto fire, offering suppressive fire and precision in the same weapon.

[b]JAK Cataclysm (RPK)[/b]

[b]Compatibility: RPK LMG[/b]

Command the battlefield with this .50 Cal conversion kit for the RPK. Slow yet powerful with a high-capacity drum mag, this kit is your enemy's nightmare.

[b]JAK Devastators[/b]

[b]Compatibility: Reclaimer 18 Shotgun[/b]

Dual-wield Reclaimer 18 Shotguns and become a mobile artillery barrage with this Aftermarket Part. Accuracy and recoil control are minimal, but destruction is maximized.

[b]JAK Deathmarch[/b]

[b]Compatibility: BAL-27 Assault Rifle[/b]

This Aftermarket Part replaces standard ammo with high-voltage power cells and the barrel with a photonic scatter barrel. Fire a spread of lethal laser blasts that take down enemies at short range.

El Sin Nombre never backs down from a fight, and she’s ready to prove that she can rumble with the best of them. Head into battle in sleeveless tactical gear or get dressed up for the championship fight with a black and red serape and skull mask.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0fb8abd41752a7f0ad231ef6a001f888826caf58.jpg[/img]

All biographical information for this Operator has been [[REDACTED]].

[b][u]New Store Offerings (MWIII, MWZ, WZ, WZM)[/u][/b]

While the [i]Call of Duty[/i] blog will cover Season 5 Bundles content in more detail in another article, here’s are some of the highlights to look forward to:

[b]WWE Superstars [/b]
[b]“The American Nightmare” Cody Rhodes, Rey Mysterio[/b]

WWE Superstars Cody Rhodes and Rey Mysterio are trading the ring for the battleground in two WWE-themed Bundles designed to bring the pain to anyone who dares stand in their way.

[b]“The American Nightmare” Cody Rhodes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1bac0a7d8cd15a58bdcb58cdbeca9d3f1e0ae2f8.jpg[/img]

Born into wrestling royalty as the son of the late WWE Hall of Famer "The American Dream" Dusty Rhodes, "The American Nightmare" Cody Rhodes was destined for greatness. He honed his skills for years, capturing multiple titles in WWE from 2007 to 2016 by capturing two Intercontinental Championships and six WWE Tag Team Championships before departing to forge his own path. At WrestleMania XL, Cody achieved his destiny, dethroning Roman Reigns to claim the Undisputed WWE Championship.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1863abf638865d502fd2d2cb4a1e2f1fb540f864.jpg[/img]

The “Tracer Pack: WWE — Cody Rhodes” Operator Bundle comes with the “American Nightmare” Operator Skin plus two stars and stripes-themed Weapon Blueprints, a Weapon Charm, Weapon Sticker, Large Decal, Loading Screen, and the “Cross Rhodes” Finishing Move.

[b]Rey Mysterio[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5b48cf28eb4a6d1d854d993bc8239317fd23fc52.jpg[/img]

Rey Mysterio has spent his entire life defying odds and shattering expectations. Trained from childhood in the Mexican lucha libre tradition, Mysterio adopted his namesake mask to honor his uncle's legacy. His high-flying, innovative offense and never-say-die attitude helped him capture every major title from the Cruiserweight Championship to the World Heavyweight Championship, becoming the smallest man to ever hold that prestigious prize.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/825ada3c182922e22aa19552cfe29fdfe95ee32c.jpg[/img]

The “Tracer Pack: WWE — Rey Mysterio” Operator Bundle includes “The Ultimate Underdog” Operator Skin plus two red and black Weapon Blueprints and a Weapon Charm, Weapon Sticker, Large Decal, Loading Screen, and the “Mysterio Bulldog” Finishing Move.

[b]Tracer Pack: Toon Force 141[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7b5a6b4fd39c4c7d1fb78868545563044d1048a1.jpg[/img]

Never to leave home without new armaments, Toon Force 141 is bringing two new cel-shaded Weapon Blueprints along for the ride, the “Shady Shotty” Reclaimer 18 Shotgun and the “Arid Shade” HRM-9 SMG.

Stick it to ’em with additional weapon accessories including the “Ghost Goes Boom!” Large Decal plus the “I Want You” and “Last Smoke” Weapon Stickers.

[b]Tracer Pack: Underboss Pro Pack[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2167992bfdf073aa07a7e5372e6740c8784f4750.jpg[/img]

Rule and control the fight with the Tracer Pack: Underboss Pro Pack featuring the “Hooded Figment” Operator Skin for Enigma. Attack enemies with the “Demon Hunter” SMG and “Soul Stealer” Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprints featuring “Ryujin” Tracers.

Say goodbye to your enemies with the “Hiss of Death” Large Decal, plus get the “Connective Honor” Emblem, the “God of Storms” Weapon Sticker and a heaping 2400 COD Points!

[b]Other Incoming Bundles[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d738a86211cd7ecf242edab8795d52373fb2f989.jpg[/img]

Other Season 5 Store offerings include the upcoming [b]Tracer Pack: Sock Puppets[/b], [b]Tracer Pack: Obon Festival, Wildlife Wanted: CODFish Mastercraft[/b], [b]Tracer Pack: Black Hole[/b], and more. Look for more details in the Season 5 BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Bundle article.

notes.title: Black Ops 6: Multiplayer Open Beta dates revealed!
notes.notes:
[h2]Incoming Comms: Black Ops 6 Multiplayer Beta: Dates Confirmed![/h2]

Two days after Call of Duty: Next (on August 28), the Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 Multiplayer Open Beta begins, starting on August 30! Experience the game-changing Omnimovement and other gameplay innovations for yourself across a variety of brand-new maps built by Treyarch, as well as building your own loadouts, accessing a variety of weapons, equipment and Perks, and dropping in with your squad across a number of modes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/742818853bcabdfa0577bc232c55356c5a18741c.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, players who have pre-ordered the Vault Edition should expect to play as any of the four Operators from the Hunters vs. Hunted Operator Pack (Park, Adler, Brutus, or Klaus), as well as being able to test out any of the five weapons from the Mastercraft Weapon Collection!

The Black Ops 6 Multiplayer Beta occurs across two weekends andwill feature Early Access days as well as an Open Beta period.

Internet access is required for participation.

Expect more details to come regarding the full Beta details, including rewards for participating. For now, mark your calendar accordingly!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a8a30a71e4f29fff4f011fc9bf1e9e2b5169ab38.jpg[/img]

[h3]Weekend One: Early Access[/h3]

Available to players who have pre-ordered the game on PC, the first Beta weekend is scheduled to begin on [b]Friday August 30 at 10AM PT[/b], and end on [b]Wednesday September 4 at 10AM PT[/b].

[h3]Weekend Two: Open Beta[/h3]

The second Beta weekend is for all players, and is scheduled to begin on [b]Friday September 6 at 10AM PT[/b], and end on [b]Monday September 9 at 10AM PT[/b].

[h2]Additional Intel: Pre-orders Available Now! Additional Benefits Incoming![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e589c8247c374a72d0bb3e2f8121a11fd33e4c30.jpg[/img]

Misinformation is everywhere: Ensure you stay one step ahead with the latest official Black Ops 6 information by checking the Call of Duty Blog in the coming days and weeks, as we dive deeper into the incredible Campaign, Multiplayer, and Round-Based Zombies content, along with Open Beta and other important comms you won’t want to miss.

Pre-orders are available now at participating retailers, in-game, via your platform Stores, or at CallofDuty.com.


Call of Duty: Black Ops 6 is published by Activision. Development for the game is led by Treyarch, in partnership with Raven Software. Additional development support provided (in alphabetical order) by Activision Central Design, Activision CentralTechnology, Activision QA, Activision Shanghai, Beenox, Demonware, High Moon Studios, Infinity Ward, and Sledgehammer Games.

The Truth Lies.

[i]Actual platform availability and launch date(s) of MP Beta subject to change. See www.callofduty.com/beta for more details. Minimum Open Beta duration is 2 days. Limited time only, while Early Access Beta Codes last, at participating retailers. Online multiplayer subscription may be required.[/i]

[i]A mobile phone number must be linked to your Steam Account to play the Black Ops 6 Multiplayer Beta.[/i]

notes.notes:
[b][u]Mutations Take Hold in Season 4 Reloaded![/u][/b]

The DNA bomb at Popov Power has detonated and Operators across Urzikstan, as well as throughout Multiplayer confrontations are reporting otherworldly abilities in the fallout. The Season 4 Reloaded update brings new maps, modes, playlists, weapons, events, and more, including Unstable Rift explorations in [i]Modern Warfare® [/i]Zombies.

Battle face to face using the new Reclaimer 18 Shotgun supporting two modes of fire and the Sledgehammer Melee Weapon, plus earn new Aftermarket Parts and the animated “Helical Reverb” Weapon Camo for completing new Weekly Challenges.

[previewyoutube=MGjpkuUNxLs;full][/previewyoutube]

Embrace your altered state and drop in when the Season 4 Reloaded mid-season updates launches on June 26 at 9AM PT across all platforms. Visit the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog]Call of Duty Blog[/url] for all official comms and announcements, and the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/patchnotes]Patch Notes[/url] for ongoing Season 4 updates.

[b][u]CONTENT SUMMARY:[/u][/b]
[list]	[*][b]New Core 6v6 map, additional map Variants.[/b] Explore a research outpost in the mountains of Urzikstan in Incline, a new snow map featuring intense fights in hostile weather. Then watch your step as you navigate the alien ooze across Das Gross, retro-actively investigate Bitvela, bring your best buds into G3T_H1GH3R.[/*]	[*][b]Mutation, Havoc, and More.[/b] Drop into game-altering modes where Operators wield mutant powers and the rules of play change over time.[/*]	[*][b]Bit Party and Vortex Mosh Pit.[/b] Go retro in the new Bit Party Playlist featuring the Bitvela map variant and deploy to another surreal locale with the return of the Vortex Mosh Pit.[/*][/list]
[b][u]New Core 6v6 Map: Incline[/u][/b]

[b]Incline [6v6][/b]

[i]Brand-New, Core, 6v6, Small Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1bbc12bb846f26bc9cd8ed6aaae119e4efce3c4d.jpg[/img]

Head into the mountains of Urzikstan on this mid-sized snow map based around a research outpost and transit facility. Fight over frozen ground or seek shelter in one of the outbuildings. When battling in the center station, hop into the lower cable car for a view over the lower gantry. Several climbing spots offer other ways to get above the enemy. Watch that you don’t overstep at the cliff’s edge; it’s a long drop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/71c6d7cf1ca090143804f3c54935d27a23ff99b5.jpg[/img]

For [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides/multiplayer-maps/call-of-duty-guides-modern-warfare-iii-multiplayer-map-guide-incline]an interactive Tac-Map and full guide to Incline, click here[/url].

[b][u]New Modes and Playlist Modifiers[/u][/b]

Altered strains of DNA are causing strange (and impressive) deviant evolutions in Mutation Mode. Plus, cause Havoc, aim for the cranium in Headshots Only, and more…

[b][u]Mutation Mode[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/84d1843bac0748a1007e1d130fdec3bc6669244b.jpg[/img]

As part of the Altered Strain Event, modified DNA strands have infected multiple Operators, and current Multiplayer skirmishes could devolve at any time into Mutation Mode!

Mutation pits one team of humans against a frightening selection of mutants, across a Mosh Pit of familiar game modes. Here’s how the forces stack up:

[b]Humans: [/b]One team is comprised of regular Operators. This team is clad in player-chosen skins and carrying the usual loadouts and weapon blueprints. Expect a sizeable increase in your ammunition reserves. You’ll need it!

[b]Mutants: [/b]The other team spawns into a match as mutants, but these DNA-altered undead aren’t merely cannon-fodder. Mutants possess a series of unique abilities that can stun, disorient, and eliminate enemy humans, and they’ll have help in the form of non-player controlled Mutants shambling into combat with them.

Once the chaos begins, both teams must defeat the opposing side in a variety of tactical, or grotesque ways. Teams switch sides at halftime; humans become mutants and mutants become humans. The team with the highest score wins.

[b]Humans: Killstreaks[/b]

With a swarm of unnatural mutations threatening to overwhelm your team at every turn, you need some serious firepower. Fortunately, you have some specific Killstreaks to acquire at a different rate to normal modes:
[list]	[*]For every 1 player-controlled Zombie kill, you receive +1 Killstreak point.[/*]	[*]For every 5 non-player-controlled Zombie kill, you receive +5 Killstreak points.[/*][/list]
The three main Killstreaks to focus on are:
[list]	[*]SAE: 6 points.[/*]	[*]Remote Turret: 7 points.[/*]	[*]Juggernaut: 15 points.[/*][/list]
[b]Mutant: Special Classes[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/56646a656cc8195dfcb947ae9f4387e0f0a1c391.jpg[/img]

Mutants have no need of Primary and Secondary Weapons, Perks, or Field Upgrades. Instead, they can choose from a variety of special classes, each with a total of three different advantages. Choose your Mutant:
[list]	[*][b]Mutated Leaper: [/b]Beware a Leaper on the hunt. These lethal mutants can become enraged, gaining faster movement, increased melee damage, and the ability to detect enemies around corners. Toss a Snapshot Grenade to reveal foes to your team and finish the job with a high impact charged leap.[/*][/list][list]	[*][b]Radioactive Beast: [/b]Half dog, half demon, the Radioactive Beast charges their enemies, shellshocks opponents while improving the health and move speed of their allies with a howl and can reveal nearby enemies on the minimap for their whole team.[/*][/list][list]	[*][b]Contaminated Sludger:[/b] Keep your distance from the Sludger, capable of exploding in a large radius of mutant sludge. Obscure the field with a Smoke Grenade and eject a strong acid blast that deals close-ranged damage and leaves pools of acid that hurt and slow the enemy.[/*][/list][list]	[*][b]Camouflaged Sneaker: [/b]The ultimate stealth play mutant. Scramble toward the enemy with an electrified leap and disorient them with an EMP. During critical maneuvers, activate your cloak to become partially invisible for a brief time.[/*][/list]
In addition, you may wish to amass multiple human kills, and transform into a particularly powerful radiated abomination known to some as the Mutant Juggernaut….

[b]Altered Strain Event: Augmentations[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0f35c6a9b77457ff562fe1735aa78e5f598360fd.jpg[/img]

Expect this mode to become increasingly rampageous as the Altered Strain Event commences during the Season. As the Event progresses, expect to unlock augmentations to your Mutant powers:
[table]	[tr]		[td]Progression Augmentation[/td]		[td]Description[/td]	[/tr]	[tr]		[td]First Strike[/td]		[td]Provides rapid cooldown on first ability used after respawn.[/td]	[/tr]	[tr]		[td]Flop Shot[/td]		[td]Diving from elevated surfaces produces a small explosion.[/td]	[/tr]	[tr]		[td]Repocket[/td]		[td]Kills with abilities have a chance to replenish your tactical ability.[/td]	[/tr]	[tr]		[td]Attuned[/td]		[td]Reduces cost to acquire the Mutant Juggernaut.[/td]	[/tr]	[tr]		[td]Galvanized[/td]		[td]Provides temporary damage reduction from explosives.[/td]	[/tr][/table]
[b]Other Modes: Havoc, Headshots Only, Blueprint Gunfight[/b]

[b]Havoc[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f4dc6b49ea88201095ea084e4645b79a5b51e5ce.jpg[/img]

Battle under shifting conditions with the return of Havoc, a Core Multiplayer mode inspired by classic arena-shooter gameplay involving wild match modifiers that upend the traditional rules of Team Deathmatch.

The first of five total modifiers activates near the start of the match, with the remaining four modifiers activating when either team reaches the score milestone of 12, 24, 36, and 48 eliminations. The first team to reach 75 points wins the match, and Killstreaks are disabled except for those awarded with a modifier.

With a pool of 14 available modifiers, no two matches of Havoc are the same. The modifiers are as follows:
[list]	[*][b]Ammo Feeder:[/b] Auto reload after you kill an enemy.[/*]	[*][b]Boots off the Ground:[/b] Low gravity.[/*]	[*][b]Camera Shift:[/b] Third-person mode.[/*]	[*][b]Chain Reaction:[/b] Sticky Grenades launched on kill.[/*]	[*][b]Charged Up:[/b] Gain Cranked on kills.[/*]	[*][b]Equipment Restock:[/b] Equipment is refilled on kills.[/*]	[*][b]Eyes On:[/b] Advanced UAV is always active.[/*]	[*][b]Gun Runner:[/b] Random gun on kill.[/*]	[*][b]Hero Smash:[/b] Explosive landing from an elevated position.[/*]	[*][b]Hot Shot:[/b] Crossbows only, Molotov bolts.[/*]	[*][b]Lucky Three:[/b] Every three kills gives you a random Killstreak.[/*]	[*][b]One Tap:[/b] Headshots kill with one bullet.[/*]	[*][b]Snapshot Killer:[/b] Launch a snapshot grenade (and ping pulse) on kill.[/*]	[*][b]System Reroll (Fifth Modifier only):[/b] Full reroll of all active modifiers.[/*][/list]
[b]Headshots Only[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6a9eb1969df728ec6639042b1e93a3ef5b20780e.jpg[/img]

Aiming for the head isn’t just a suggestion in this mode, but a requirement. Deploy across a small selection of maps using Team Deathmatch with one caveat: players can only be injured and eliminated through damage to the head. This applies to ranged weapons as well as thrown Lethals like the Throwing Knife or Throwing Star. Grenades are also only effective if they inflict head damage. After a few matches of this mode, you’ll be lasering onto enemy craniums with ease.

[b]Blueprint Gunfight[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b1ae87da1ca78cf76d140c8d30e41756f7259e1f.jpg[/img]

Add some spice to your Gunfight matches with the mid-season Blueprint Gunfight Playlist, featuring a compact map selection, and Loadouts using a variety of new Weapon Blueprints.

[b][u]New Playlist Modifier: Bit Party[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8696c29c8f7e39d4a6d536b8f54c66d3ead5d533.jpg[/img]

Experience Multiplayer like never before with the new Bit Party Playlist modifier, debuting in Season 4 Reloaded. In this Playlist, eliminating enemies inflates your own Operator’s head, with expansion head sizes of small, medium, and large. Get eliminated and your Operator’s head will reset back to small.

While having a larger head makes you an easier target, it also confers objective bonuses! The larger your Operator’s head, the more points you’ll earn for eliminating enemies in Team Deathmatch, picking up tags in Kill Confirmed, and holding the objective in Hardpoint. In Domination, bigger heads capture flags more quickly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/77a7fe8a4bbe2ef0ddcf3ca1f4836c74689e5c04.jpg[/img]

Look for the in-game Retro Warfare Event launching alongside Bit Party, along with the pixel-art inspired members of Task Force 141 in the 8-Bit Blitz Bundle, both detailed later in this blog.

The Bit Party Playlist occurs across, and includes a variety of Vortex Variant Multiplayer maps alongside the introduction of Bitvela:

[b]Bitvela (6v6)[/b]

[i]New [Variant], Core, 6v6, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/11952fb09c059678e731ac25b664b13a5eec1129.jpg[/img]

Retro-actively set some time aside to visit a pixel-art inspired version of Favela in the Bit Party Playlist. Thousands of pixels converge in a faithful recreation of this classic map. Vibrant colors, pixelated cars, buildings and trees, jagged clouds, and box-like smoke particles perfectly mimic the original map, without a curved edge in sight.

[b][u]Das Gross Enters the Vortex Mosh Pit[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8169ca23bf0301eab7320e1c31aa31bc69b2cd94.jpg[/img]

The Vortex Mosh Pit Playlist returns for a limited time in Season 4 Reloaded. This time, a new hellscape joins the current lineup of Airborne, Satan’s Quarry, Skidgrow, Sporeyard, and Tetanus. Prepare yourself for Das Gross:

[b]Das Gross (6v6)[/b]

[i]New [Variant], Core, 6v6, Small-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d779738f2c04ebba905eb8bb5fd3c7622b3921f9.jpg[/img]

The downtown buildings in New York City are enveloped by an alien entity, its red tendrils reaching out over every surface. In this horrifying map variant of Das Haus, blood drips from the walls and sharp, pointed teeth protrude from exposed muscle. Above, the night sky conceals a looming planet in the clouds. Focus on the mission at hand and try not to lose your sanity.

[b]Return to the Synthwave Sun: G3T_H1GH3R[/b]

[b]G3T_H1GH3R[/b]

[i]New [Variant], Playlist, LTE, Medium-Sized[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c3840d99fe7f470993bea8f3c98130649d838f57.jpg[/img]

Return to the bliss-fueled retro-futuristic utopian voidscape, and gaze upwards at hundreds of newly repositioned floating geometric neon-grids, platforms, and other cosmic bewilderments, leading to the one, true destination; the utopian mind palace itself; a fortress floating beneath the synthwave sun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d81c8700f24c91385abfed446c991500b9a6daa5.jpg[/img]

Stretch out those parkour muscles as the G3T_H1GH3R map is entirely new, with a longer and entertainingly challenging course to ascend, multiple secrets to discover, collectibles to find, and traps more dangerous than you might remember from G3T_H1GH. Blaze a trail to the skies, don’t make a hash of it, and seek the ultimate reward; three new Weapon Camos.

[b][u]MODERN WARFARE ZOMBIES OVERVIEW [MWZ][/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/375a4b57b79c58fd8b40f28c3c128a4bbcd3fd84.jpg[/img]

[list]	[*][b]Face Waves of Enemies in an Unstable Rift.[/b] Race to enter Unstable Rift before other squads and face off against increasingly difficult waves of enemies.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Unstable Rift[/u][/b]

Prepare for a new wave-based combat challenge arriving in the form of Unstable Rifts. Several opportunities to enter an Unstable Rift can appear per match, and squads must race to be the first to enter; reports of [[REDACTED]] appearing in the Exclusion Zone may hint at the way forward.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/efa290f0116b5e8d6c75aa32ddfd3bc2c1408cd0.jpg[/img]

Upon entering an Unstable Rift, Operators will face off against increasingly intense waves of enemies until completing the challenge or falling in the attempt. Completing an Unstable Rift resets the cooldown on all of your insured weapons and schematics, so you can head into the next match equipped with your best setup. Strike Team Operators are also encouraged to locate additional Unstable Rifts across the map if you were unable to enter a previous Rift, until Rift infiltration is a success.

Be warned that an Unstable Rift is… unstable. Not everything works as it does elsewhere. Some things are granted, while others are taken away. However, expected loot is impressive, and may include a maxed-out Pack-A-Punch weapon with excellent Rarity value once your Rift exploration begins, as well as an assortment of free Perks and Upgrades that you’ll need when facing the hordes. Good luck!

notes.title: MWIII Content Drop, Part II: Season 4 Reloaded
notes.notes:
[b][u]CALL OF DUTY®: WARZONE™ OVERVIEW [WZ][/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c069c39d0157dc327ad46d66e518fe91ae5956fe.jpg[/img]

[list]	[*][b]Popov Power Plant POI Update. [/b]The DNA Bomb at Popov Power Plant has detonated, opening new pathways and leaving a toxic chemical agent in its wake.[/*]	[*][b][Redacted] Weapons, Runaway Train: [/b]Discover powerful [Redacted] Weapons, featuring a bounty of attachments for ultra lethal play. Achieve victory on the Runaway Train.[/*]	[*][b]The Mutation Spreads: [/b]Drop into new limited-time Playlists involving the mutation mechanic, including Mutation Resurgence Quads and Mutation Buy Back Quads.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Urzikstan: Popov Power Plant, [Redacted] Weapons, Runaway Train[/u][/b]

[b]Detonation at Popov Power Plant (Urzikstan)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d0e71729d92f1e36c578eb9aeb06b7f928d45399.jpg[/img]

The DNA Bomb has detonated at the Popov Power Plant, opening new pathways around the point of interest and covering the vicinity in a toxic chemical agent. Exercise caution, though the risk of exposure to the green sludge content much of the vicinity appears to have lessened. You should now focus on getting in close to explore the outcome of this major attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fbe46b708f281c092a872be70c986f45e3841806.jpg[/img]

It appears the vast power plant has suffered a catastrophic explosion, spilling this chemical agent across a wide area. The gigantic main cooling tower has almost completely collapsed, and the reactor itself has fully ruptured. Exercise extreme caution when investigating this area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/118e5f9c7e87481ab4922b3cde495b14e31c0d18.jpg[/img]

The devastation seems to extend to a number of outbuildings which are currently designated no-go areas. Operators within the vicinity with little regard to safety have reported a new, subterranean network of previously-unknown tunnels has now become accessible. Perhaps answers lie hidden down there?

[b][u]New Limited-Time Modes[/u][/b]

[b]Mutation Resurgence Quads and Buy Back Quads[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/df6a2733da54198699969509cf3010e00eaa9d07.jpg[/img]

With normal Resurgence rules, this Mode centers around dropping into the vicinity of the destroyed Popov Power plant. Gain victory by any means necessary, including exposing your Operator to a variety of mutant abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/329e5c7fbaeae877f24bc1eaa4bb50cdab8cee19.jpg[/img]

Both Mutation Resurgence and Mutation Buy Back Modes removes all Tacticals and Lethals from ground loot, allowing you to focus on gathering and enhancing your Operator’s DNA to discover a multitude of mutations!

[b]Mutation Powers[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f5f27c426c13253aa55eb6ef5ea6f16f37abe3e2.jpg[/img]

The following seven mutations can affect your Operator as you engage your opponents in any Mutation-based [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] match:
[list]	[*][b]Bioshield: [/b]Creates a protective bubble that blocks incoming damage but allows you to shoot out from within this sphere.[/*]	[*][b]Divebomb: [/b]Rocket into the air, then dive towards a target. On impact any nearby enemies are damaged and pushed back.[/*]	[*][b]Mutant Leap[/b]: Perform a charged jump that covers vast distances.[/*]	[*][b]Toxic Stim Cloud[/b]: Deploy a poisonous cloud that inflicts damage to enemies and boosts your squad mates’ speed for a short duration.[/*]	[*][b]Sludge Sling: [/b]Toss sludge grenades that explode into a toxic gas cloud on impact. The gas slows and damages enemies over time.[/*]	[*][b]Mutant Cloak:[/b] Turn partially invisible for a short time. You leave green footprints while cloaked.[/*]	[*][b]Mutant Vision[/b]: See enemies outlined in red through walls for a short duration.[/*][/list]
[b][Redacted] Weapons[/b]

Head into battle with the upper echelon of weaponry through new [Redacted] Weapons found within Loot Hot Zones and Bunkers. These powerful weapons feature more than the traditional five allowed attachments, giving Operators who find them an edge in combat.

[b]Runaway Train Public Event[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/13f1c44f1b8b4cd27b52350129b35a80ff4b91dc.jpg[/img]

This event is currently active in [i]Warzone[/i], prior to Season 4 Relaunch, and continues into the Season. When battling in Urzikstan, each match will have the chance to trigger the Runaway Train Public Event announced around the sixth gas circle. When this occurs, it’s a race for control of the train as the safe zone remains over it until the end of the match. Fight off enemy squads as it careens through the map and achieve victory after taming this mechanical beast!

[b][u]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE MOBILE OVERVIEW [WZM][/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9e5102f987a04579cfd37dc5acf606bfc56fd1e9.jpg[/img]

[list]	[*][b]New Modes. [/b]Prepare for a zombie invasion as Zombie Royale arrives in Season 4 Reloaded along with Havoc Resurgence.[/*]	[*][b]New Map Features.[/b] Explore graveyards, approach hellish crash sites, and take down undead targets in Verdansk.[/*]	[*][b]A Unified Mid-Season. [/b]Share the same Battle Pass, BlackCell, weapon progression, and rewards across all three games alongside [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]mobile-specific rewards and events.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Beware the Zombie Apocalypse[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0eb6914932a455214fd387c853d223002ca80578.jpg[/img]

The chemical catastrophe has resulted in an onrush of zombies in [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™ Mobile[/i]. Battle your enemies — living and undead — in a new game mode supported with updated map features plus new weekly events, mobile original Store offerings, and more.

[b]Zombie Royale (Rebirth Island, Limited-Time Mode) [/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/813ab473eef30abdef3e5a51e4dc7c18ae42c5d2.jpg[/img]

You can run but you can’t hide from the undead uprising. The horrifying Zombie Royale experience comes to Battle Royale in the mid-season update. Players who are eliminated will return as zombies to hunt down the remaining humans. Zombies can redeploy as a human by collecting antivirals, dropped by fallen human Operators. The last team standing with a living Operator wins the match.

[b]Havoc Resurgence (Rebirth Island, Limited-Time Mode) [/b]

Resurgence with a twist. As in traditional Resurgence, players must survive for their teammates to redeploy into the match. All Operators will furthermore receive special Havoc Perks in the match that dramatically alter the gameplay experience such as super speed and random killstreaks every three kills. These perks will activate over time, so the longer you survive the more Havoc Perks, up to an extent, you’ll have to use.

[b][u]New Map Features[/u][/b]

[b]Verdansk  Map Update: Zombie Graveyard & Crash Site[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c4c91a438d28262412886433a5d551272db7c3f8.jpg[/img]

The gates of hell have been pried open! There are massive boulders falling out of a mystical portal in the sky, generating new points of interest across the map. Beware of these remnants of an ancient evil. Head through the broken stone gate leading to the graveyard where danger and high-value loot crates await Operators foolish enough to enter.

[b]Verdansk & Rebirth Island Map Update: Undead Targets[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/65521d59798a29abf794b8189b6a10a95470775f.jpg[/img]

The zombie uprising has sent its undead denizens across Verdansk and Rebirth Island. Target the rotting creatures throughout your Battle Royale matches to earn additional Event Points.

[b][u]A Unified Mid-Season[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3dea5cdac6fe9ee736e7661ba13d38746c9a3102.jpg[/img]

[i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile [/i]will synchronize with [i]Modern Warfare III [/i]and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] for the Season 4 Reloaded update, sharing the same Battle Pass, BlackCell, weapon progression, and rewards including certain Bundles across all three games.

Look for the new weekly events:Going Viral, Kill Zombies, Tech Control, and Pluck It. Earn Event Points and Undead Badges to use in the Event Store for rewards like the Chuy - Sentinel Rising Operator Skin and the Haymaker – Cortex Crusher Weapon Blueprint.

Get new content specific to mobile with Season 4 Reloaded [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i] Original Keeps: Toxic Terror, Hades’ Hand, Circuit Breaker, and Extra Crispy.

[b][u]GENERAL OVERVIEW [MWIII, MWZ, WZ, WZM][/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/954d9e54bf661f9617767e128fd0377beae2be52.jpg[/img]

[list]	[*][b]New Weapons. [/b]Choose between two firing modes with the Reclaimer 18 Shotgun and smash heads with the Sledgehammer.[/*]	[*][b]New Store Offerings.[/b] Deploy as 8-Bit members of Task Force 141, get crabby with a new Zodiac-themed Bundle, and more.[/*]	[*][b]New Weekly Challenges, Events.[/b] Earn new Aftermarket Parts and more via the mid-season Weekly Challenges, and progress through multiple Events.[/*][/list]
[b][u]New Weapons[/u][/b]

[b]Reclaimer 18 (Shotgun)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d3c425b93d2d7ab59c3276545048cd5e925b5e17.jpg[/img]

[i]“A tactical shotgun that can be fired in both pump-action and semi-auto modes. Pump-action provides superior range while semi-auto increases fire rate.”[/i]

Supporting two firing modes, the Reclaimer 18 gives Operators the ability to customize their Shotgun experience with the flip of a switch. For precision fights, use pump-action to eliminate enemies from further out; when you need to clear out a group, switch to semi-auto and let loose in close quarters.

Further customize the weapon with incendiary Dragon’s Breath or Slug Ammunition plus Barrel Attachments providing extended range, enhanced recoil control, or speedier handling.

The Reclaimer 18 introduces the new Bugged Out, He’s Looking At You, Azure Refract, and Donut Worry Weapon Camos, accessible by completing Reclaimer 18 specific in-game challenges.

[b]How to Unlock the Base Weapon: [/b]Via a new Sector in the Season 4 Battle Pass.

[b]Sledgehammer (Melee)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/02c97e86673d6390d09a4a7120089205b80ed03f.jpg[/img]

[i]“Smash the competition into the dirt with this sledgehammer melee weapon.”[/i]

Bash the competition with this Melee slugger sporting a 20-pound carbon steel head with an assortment of moves including swings, an overhead attack, and a pole butt. Inspect the weapon in-game for a closer look at its lethal properties, then get back to the clobbering.

The Sledgehammer introduces the new Dubs Dubs Dubs Weapon Camo, accessible by completing a Sledgehammer-specific in-game challenge.

[b]How to Unlock the Base Weapon: [/b]Via weekly challenges.

[b][u]New Store Offerings: 8-Bit Blitz and More[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/820def8437a7cca5955d05f040b44e208e3aef94.jpg[/img]

Along with the [b]Cursed Arts Pack[/b], [b]Underworld Morrigan Tracer Pack[/b], [b]TacGas Tracer Pack[/b], and [b]Cyber: Misaki Pack[/b] (shown above), you can expect to get retro with 8-Bit versions of Task Force 141 in the Tracer Pack: 8-Bit Blitz Bundle, snap back at your enemies in a new Zodiac-themed Pro Pack, and explore the outer reaches of combat excellence using the pioneering Out of This World Pack.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: 8-Bit Blitz[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/07be667e67c98216a0179fa52df82dad9a93afd6.jpg[/img]

Deploy with pixel-art inspired Operator Skins including “8-Bit” versions of Ghost, Price, Soap, and Farah, perfect for the Bit Party Playlist. Keep your pixel fix going with two Weapon Blueprints featuring red 8-Bit Tracers and red 8-Bit Violence Death Effect: the “Along for the Ride” Striker SMG and the “Concealed Carry” SVA 545 Assault Rifle. Plus, sneak up on your enemies and make them dance with the “Bullet Boogey” Finishing Move.

For your retro makeover, equip the animated “Bitsplosion” Calling Card and “Blasted to Bits” Emblem along with the “Pixel Perfect” Large Decal, “Commander Pixel” Charm, and a 1-hour Double Weapon XP Token.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Zodiac: Cancer Pro Pack[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/def71ad3ec4dd9ebe99c0b765406dd9927bbb0b7.jpg[/img]

Like the crab, the “Plated Rogue” Operator Skin features a hard outer shell and mandibles curving over the mouth. Take two red zodiac-themed Weapon Blueprints into battle, the “Shell Casing” TAQ Eradicator LMG and the “Ardent Shell” Sidewinder Battle Rifle. Both feature Constellation Tracers and high-capacity magazines for sustained combat operations, including the JAK Thunder LMG Kit Aftermarket Part on the “Ardent Shell.”

Armor up and take no prisoners with the “Crab Attitude” Large Decal, the “Crab Rage” Weapon Sticker, the “Consortium of Crabs” Loading Screen, two additional Loading Screens, and an Emblem. In addition to these in-game items, this Bundle includes 2400 COD Points to spend toward your next Battle Pass or Store purchase!

[b][u]Out of This World Pack[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/58152d41d841cd83f200b21646313aff41cd28b1.jpg[/img]

Rocket to the moon with the “Spaced Out” Operator Skin for Ripper, featuring an armored space suit with a purple visor and gold trimming. Wield the moon-textured “Rocket” MTZ-762 Battle Rifle Blueprint and prepare for takeoff with the “Decorated” Emblem and the “Blueprint” Calling Card. Boost your progress with a one hour Double Player XP Token, a one hour Double Weapon XP Token, and two Battle Pass Tier Skips.

And don’t miss out on the [b]Tracer Pack: Fallout Vault Dweller [/b]and the international football-themed [b]Tournament Favourites [/b]Bundles, only available for a limited time alongside an assortment of other great Bundles arriving throughout the mid-season.

[b][u]New Weekly Challenges and Events[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2f41ad8fed0931e91d08bd8e18dd9e9332aaa012.jpg[/img]

Refer to the in-game Weekly Challenges throughout the mid-season to view the remaining rewards arriving in Season 4, including new Aftermarket Parts plus the animated “Helical Reverb” Weapon Camo unlocked for completing all eight Weekly Challenges.

[b]Season 4 Reloaded Events[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5212e42488a46435da484cb4bdc8f1e720d3d7ca.jpg[/img]

[b]Altered Strain (June 26 to July 24)[/b]

[b]Rewards: 19[/b]

The strain has mutated! Collect altered DNA samples from fallen foes and caches to earn rewards and unlock effects for Mutation Mode in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i]. See the MWIII section of this Blog for more information.

[b]Retro Warfare (June 26 to July 3)[/b]

[b]Rewards: 10[/b]

Press start to begin the party that is Retro Warfare launching alongside the Bit Party Playlist Modifier and Bitvela map variant! Earn XP to unlock rewards. Equip any of the 8-Bit Operators from the Tracer Pack: 8-Bit Blitz Bundle for a boost.

[b]Vacation Squad (July 3 to July 10)[/b]

[b]Rewards: 7[/b]

The beach is calling and Task Force 141 is headed off for summer vacation. Complete Event challenges to earn tropical rewards. Don’t forget the sunscreen!

[b]Vortex: Death’s Grip (July 10 to July 24)[/b]

[b]Rewards: 10[/b]

Death’s grasp has taken over the Vortex. Complete challenges to unlock ghastly rewards. Equip the Horsemen Death Ultra Skin for a boost.

[b][u]Upgrade to [i]Modern Warfare III[/i][/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6e5f5ecc23b4089d59f508edd845dbe4ac0337e6.jpg[/img]

There’s never been a better time to purchase [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] and experience the rapid, fast-action combat Call of Duty is famous for, along with a heart-pounding Campaign and the terrifying open-world Exclusion Zone of [i]Modern Warfare Zombies[/i].

Stay frosty.

notes.title: Call of Duty x Fallout: Deploy as a Vault Dweller
notes.notes:
[b]A Strange Message…[/b]

[b][i][u]>>Intercepted Missive to Mr. Jack Cabot from Edward Deegan<<[/u][/i][/b]

[i]Missive 4: October 25, 2287.[/i]

[i]Parsons State Insane Asylum, Commonwealth.[/i]

[i]Mr. Cabot,[/i]

[i]To wit: Furthering my updates regarding the possible Vault 141 escapees:[/i]

[i]I hope this message finds you well.[/i]

[i]I’ve been tracking four military scavs since my Eyebot caught a glimpse of them on the outskirts of Beacon Hill. They’ve ventured all over the place, from Spectacle Island clear across to Fort Hagen.[/i]

[i]As you know, I’m always looking for people who know how to handle themselves in dangerous situations. From what I hear, they may fit the bill.[/i]

[i]They can certainly handle themselves in a fight. Their leader appears to answer to the name “Price”. Gruff sort. Favors a gauss rifle at longer ranges. Wicked shot. Seen him take out a Mirelurk at 100 paces. Could be the Overseer. [/i]

[i]Scarlett over at the Dugout Inn tells me she’s had chats with one of them. Gent called Gaz. Seems to be Price’s right-hand man. Tasty with a pistol. A bit moody. [/i]

[i]One of them they call “Ghost,” quiet type with a strange face. Might be a fellow Ghoul. Shorter chap as well; Scottish fellow. Wonder how a Mole Rat like him passed selection?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b5c5e34164398f85bc880b47201af617406785bd.jpg[/img]

[i]From my tracking, and I can’t be sure of this of course, but it appears this squad hails from one of those remote islands off the coast, near the old Boston Light. I haven’t pinpointed the exact entrance, and mapping is a chore as the Pip-Boy is playing up again, but Vault 141 seems to be under the ancient Gun Emplacement east of here, in the Atlantic.[/i]

[i]I know you have misgivings given that they’re all British, but they’re more rough-and-tumble, salt of the earth types. Plus, they’re stacked to the gills with armaments.[/i]

[i]Shall we organize a meet and greet?[/i]

[i]Your faithful servant, [/i]

[i]Edward.[/i]

[b][u]Please Stand By[/u][/b]

War… war never changes. Rise to the surface and face your enemies in a brand-new collaboration with the post-apocalyptic Fallout series. Deploy as one of four Task Force 141 vault dwellers — including Price, Ghost, Soap, and Gaz — with Vault-Tec enhanced Weapon Blueprints and other Fallout-themed items for use in [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® III[/i], [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™[/i], and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i].

[previewyoutube=gm2Fj9JtCZs;full][/previewyoutube]

The [b]Tracer Pack: Fallout Vault Dweller Bundle[/b] features over 15 items and is available June 20. Read on for full info on the Bundle’s contents along with a list of further rewards earnable through the in-game Fallout: Vault Dwellers Event going live at 10AM PT on June 20 through 8AM PT June 26.
[h1]Tracer Pack: Fallout Vault Dweller[/h1]
Purchase the Tracer Pack: Fallout Vault Dweller Bundle to immediately unlock the following in-game items:

[b]Two Fallout-Themed Weapon Blueprints[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4eafbc321c114920d8a8379431935c4c34246374.jpg[/img]

Survive against the worst of the wasteland with two new Weapon Blueprints featuring Vault-Tec Tracers and V.A.T.S. Death Effect.

Equip the [b]“Vault-Tec Approved” M16 Weapon Blueprint[/b] with two Aftermarket Parts: the JAK Cutthroat Stock offering an unrivaled combination of speed and stability while aiming down sights, plus the JAK Patriot Conversion Kit which transforms the M16 into a fully automatic rifle with superior recoil control and firing aim stability.

Accompanied by a 45 Round Mag plus two attachments improving handling and recoil control, this is the ideal weapon for lasering down foes from a distance.

For closer fights, opt for the [b]“Atomic Disintegrator” HRM-9 Weapon Blueprint [/b]geared for sustained combat in close quarters. With a 50 Round Drum Magazine plus thermal target identification, improved accuracy and recoil control, and extended range, this SMG configuration is ideal for aiming down sights with the ability to compete out to the mid-range.

[b]Plus Four Operator Skins, Six Loading Screens, and More[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fbf22c2ec10dd4124e4342d0d5905e4d9b3ff7f1.jpg[/img]

The Fallout Bundle also features a “Vault 141” Operator Skin for Price, Ghost, Soap, and Gaz plus six Loading Screens and more. The full list of included content is as follows:
[list]	[*]Four “Vault 141” Operator Skins[/*]	[*]“Atomic Disintegrator” HRM-9 Weapon Blueprint[/*]	[*]“Vault-Tec Approved” M16 Weapon Blueprint[/*]	[*]“Let’s Do This!” and “Fatman” Charms[/*]	[*]“Wasteland Workshop” Calling Card[/*]	[*]“You’re Special” Large Decal[/*]	[*]“Vault-Tec Engineer” Emblem[/*]	[*]“Nuka-Cola Spacer” Sticker[/*]	[*]Six Loading Screens including “Nuka-Cola,” “Please Stand By,” “Survivors’ Journey,” “Sanctuary Hills,” “Vault 141,” and “Restoring Democracy”[/*][/list]
[b][u]Restore Democracy in the Fallout: Vault Dwellers Event[/u][/b]

Don’t miss the in-game Fallout: Vault Dwellers Event appearing alongside the Bundle, featuring challenges across Multiplayer, Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]. Use any of the Vault Dweller Skins during the Vault Dwellers Event for an additional XP boost. Earn additional Fallout-themed cosmetic items like the “New California Republic” Large Decal, “Nuka-Cola Caps” Emblem, “Slocum’s Joe” Sticker, “Nuka-Cola” Charm, and the “Nuka-Cola Quantum” Weapon Camo.

The Fallout: Vault Dwellers Event begins at 10AM PT on June 20 and ends at 8AM PT June 26.

Stay frosty, vault dweller.
