notes.title: Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile Operation: Day Zero Launch Event
notes.notes:
[b][u]Welcome to the Operation: Day Zero Launch Event[/u][/b]

Give an action-packed welcome to [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™ Mobile[/i] ([i]Call of Duty: WZM[/i]) with the Operation: Day Zero launch event! Drop into six different contested zones across Verdansk and Rebirth Island as the entire [i]Warzone Mobile[/i] community works together to complete Event Actions and earn Event Points toward unlocking individual and community rewards that are usable across [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i], [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], and [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare® III[/i].

[previewyoutube=eBYXHsbeYKU;full][/previewyoutube]

Join the millions of players who have already pre-registered for the game during this inaugural in-game event.

Operation: Day Zero begins on March 22, the day after [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i] launches worldwide. Read on for mission details and a breakdown of the earnable rewards.

[b][u]Operation: Day Zero Mission Details[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0c61bb589e5c0370ccdec722e853169bc169737a.jpg[/img]

Operation: Day Zero features a total of six contested zones — five for Verdansk and one encompassing the entirety of Rebirth Island. Players who complete certain Event Actions within the corresponding zones will accrue Event Points (EP).

The EP that you earn tracks toward individual rewards and will be added to the total community EP score to unlock Day Zero zones. A zone is cleared once players have collectively accumulated the required Community EP displayed in-game.

[b]Earning Event Points[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dcba22002aa8c8817749bcabfedbdbe6951c9d12.jpg[/img]

Event Points are earned by playing any mode and completing Event Actions in a contested zone. The amount of EP earned varies based on the action completed. Event Actions that reward Event Points include:
[list]	[*]Opening a Supply Box or Day Zero Supply Drop.[/*]	[*]Eliminating an enemy player.[/*]	[*]Completing a Contract.[/*]	[*]Using a Killstreak.[/*]	[*]Landing a headshot.[/*]	[*]Purchasing items from Buy Stations.[/*][/list]
And when warming up for your Battle Royale matches in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i]’s Multiplayer mode, you’ll earn EP for every elimination as well, though a lesser amount compared to eliminating enemies in Battle Royale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/55cfcaf30ec32efc633971894374af13f11607e4.jpg[/img]

[b]Day Zero Supply Drop: [/b]Earn Event Points more quickly by acquiring items and gear from a special Day Zero Supply Drop, awarding better loot, cash, XP, and EP compared to opening a traditional Supply Box. Day Zero Supply Drops are periodically dropped into active zones and show up on the radar as a crate icon.

[b][u]Day Zero Zones[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/322a3aea39329b94349a6f9e4e1a76784549939c.jpg[/img]

When the event begins, the first zone will activate. Complete the above actions when inside an active zone to earn Event Points. As the event goes on, the next zone will activate as the community EP milestones are reached.

[b][u]Individual and Community Rewards[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2e3d1b204ee19f052d3c740d8fc6811f7412e312.jpg[/img]

Operation: Day Zero features both community and individual rewards. All players will have the opportunity to claim the earned community rewards at the end of the event. Individual rewards are given based on the total number of Event Points that you specifically contribute to the greater community total.

[b]Community Rewards[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/366c496952e099ac8b67336dccd2fb1988bec0c3.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*][b]“Gilded Devil King” Large Decal: [/b]Clear Zone 1[/*]	[*][b]“Scorched Beginnings” Animated Calling Card: [/b]Clear Zone 2[/*]	[*][b]“Golden Blaze” Emblem: [/b]Clear Zone 3[/*]	[*][b]“Golden Flame” X12 Weapon Blueprint: [/b]Clear Zone 4[/*]	[*][b]“Heavy Thunder” M4 Weapon Blueprint: [/b]Clear Zone 5[/*]	[*][b]“Golden Phantom” Ghost Operator Skin: [/b]Clear Zone 6[/*][/list]
[b]Individual Rewards[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/699435af09a243877ba876320de320acd7b58674.jpg[/img]
[list]	[*][b]“Crimson Blaze” Emblem[/b][/*]	[*][b]“Nightmare Rift” Calling Card[/b][/*]	[*][b]“Forsaken Past” Emblem[/b][/*]	[*][b]“Tearing Me Apart” Sticker[/b][/*]	[*][b]“Demon’s Claw” Combat Knife Weapon Blueprint[/b][/*]	[*][b]“Last Word” Charm[/b][/*]	[*][b]“Hell Scrapper” LTV Vehicle Skin[/b][/*]	[*][b]“Nightmare Inferno” Large Decal[/b][/*]	[*][b]“Crimson Prince” X12 Weapon Blueprint[/b][/*]	[*][b]“Vengeful Devil King” Large Decal[/b][/*]	[*][b]“Raging Blaze” M4 Weapon Blueprint[/b][/*]	[*][b]“Bloody Reaper” Ghost Operator[/b][/*][/list]
The community earns a reward for each zone that is cleared, while individual players also earn specific rewards (listed above) that are accessible as soon as you earn them. As the event progresses and more Event Points are earned individually and collectively, the rewards get better. Each respective zone’s rewards can be claimed as soon as the zone has been cleared. All rewards can be claimed in the Event Store up until April 3rd at 9:00 AM PT. Rewards must be claimed within [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i], but once claimed can be used across [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i], [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i], and [i]Modern Warfare III[/i].

[b][u]Top 5 Tips for Operation: Day Zero[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ca01c7dd3e70a92c5b17cdcaeeee64d72ad63c39.jpg[/img]

With individual and community rewards on the line, there’s a lot to be won in this event. Here are our top tips for maximizing your EP gain.

[b]1. Contract complete. [/b]Completing contracts rewards a large amount of EP, so try to complete as many as you can in a match to maximize your earnings. They often lead to opportunities to engage enemy players as well, further increasing your EP gain upon eliminating the threat.

[b]2.  Fight together. [/b]Invite friends to infiltrate the contested Day Zero zones as a unit. Stick together to improve your chances of survival and call out opportunities to earn EP throughout the match. By grouping up, you’ll help reach the community EP milestones more quickly as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/83e4e6830bbacd2f3feb5aca4409ab00212153a9.jpg[/img]

[b]3. Stay active. [/b]You’ll encounter many of the EP-awarding actions simply by being an active player in the match. Track down enemies, seek out Supply Boxes and Day Zero Supply Drops, spend your cash at Buy Stations . . . the more you engage with the map, the better your earnings.

[b]4. Need a boost?[/b] Collect Tactical Boosts to increase the amount of Event Points earned for certain Event Actions in Battle Royale and Multiplayer playlists.

[b]5. Take a drive. [/b]Grab a vehicle early in the match to drastically cut down on travel time. By speeding from one area to the next, you’ll gain more chances to open Supply Boxes, complete contracts, and eliminate enemy players.

[b] Need a hand?[/b] [b]Consult our guides. [/b]First time entering the warzone? Or maybe you just need a refresher. We’ve got you covered. Check out [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides]the free and official guides here on March 21[/url], including our [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i] How to Play guide to get started and then get briefed with detailed overviews and strategies for Verdansk and Rebirth Island.

[b][u]Stay Tuned for More[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/797ddfbf818f31550eeae8e6d303ffaf0b275ce0.jpg[/img]

Check the Call of Duty Blog regularly for more news and updates regarding [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i].

For more, follow [url=https://twitter.com/WarzoneMobile]@warzonemobile[/url] on X, [url=https://www.instagram.com/codwarzonemobile/]@codwarzonemobile[/url] on Instagram, and [url=https://www.facebook.com/CODWarzoneMobile/][i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i][/url] on Facebook.

Stay frosty.

notes.title: MWIII Content Drop: Season 2 Reloaded
notes.notes:
[b][u]Season 2 Reloaded Arrives in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® III[/u][/b]

On the heels of the massive Season 2 content drop, the mid-season update is nearly here and bringing even more opportunities for mayhem and destruction. Compete in a compact and chaotic 6v6 Multiplayer map, explore overgrown and unsettling map variants, and get ready for Bounty and Juggermosh game modes. Take on the next Zombies story mission, Dark Aether Rift, and Warlord; and explore the new mobile Point of Interest and more in Fortune’s Keep.

Unlock two new weapons, new Aftermarket Parts, plus new seasonal events and challenges. There’s plenty more to experience in this colossal season of content.

The Season 2 Reloaded mid-season update launches on March 6 at 9 AM PT. You’ve come to the right place: Check the [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog]Call of Duty Blog[/url] for all official comms and announcements.

Here’s what’s on the way:

[b][u]MODERN WARFARE® III OVERVIEW[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b9c66b659dca3dea87c0cd1db379bf30c2b7b805.jpg[/img]

[b]CONTENT SUMMARY:[/b]
[list]	[*][b]New (Remastered) 6v6 Multiplayer Map.[/b] Revisit Das Haus in a whole new location as the setting moves from a training facility to the top of a skyscraper.[/*]	[*][b]Introducing Bounty, Juggermosh.[/b] Eliminate the HVT in Bounty for extra points, and battle as a Space Marine inspired Juggernaut in the Juggermosh limited-time mode.[/*]	[*][b]Vortex: Decay’s Realm.[/b] Redeploy to the Vortex with an expanded map pool featuring the new map variants Skidgrow and Airborne.[/*][/list]
[b][u]New (Remastered) 6v6 Map: Das Haus[/u][/b]

[b]Das Haus (6v6)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/255a85375c451bbc45743bf53ceacde839cc67ff.jpg[/img]

Players first deployed to Das Haus in the form of a training facility in [i]Call of Duty®: Vanguard[/i], battling nonstop in the map’s tight confines. For Season 2 Reloaded, the iconic and compact map returns in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], now reimagined and situated on the top of a skyscraper in the vicinity of Highrise. In fact, that map can be spotted in the distance from one of the spawn points. The layout is just as chaotic as you remember it, rewarding Operators who stay on the offensive and don’t let up.

Need an interactive Tac-Map and full guide to Das Haus? [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides/multiplayer-maps/call-of-duty-guides-modern-warfare-iii-multiplayer-map-guide-operation-das-haus]Click here[/url]!

[b][u]New Playlist and Map Variants: Vortex — Decay’s Realm[/u][/b][b] [Limited-Time Mode][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b6caf7c00763c78928a7ebc41486a72720187aa2.jpg[/img]

The eldritch realms within the Vortex expand with the addition of Airborne and Skidgrow alongside Tetanus, Sporeyard, and Satan’s Quarry. Drop into the Vortex: Decay’s Realm Playlist to compete on the new map variants across Team Deathmatch, Domination, Kill Confirmed, and Hardpoint.

Look for the Vortex: Decay’s Realm in-game Event arriving later in the mid-season and detailed under “New Weekly Challenges and Events” near the end of this article.

[b]Airborne[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3856266db833087c4b585762c6eedc2a6a94c769.jpg[/img]

You might want to skip your afternoon meal at Burger Town this visit as Terminal falls victim to an alien infestation covering the environment in a putrid green growth. Locusts swarm overhead and a heavy fog blankets the outer apron; if you think that’s bad, just wait until you board the plane. Secure your victory then evacuate ASAP… until it’s time to return for the next fight.

[b]Skidgrow[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cf58ec214820cb37b18bb7b4ac6a6e38010eac06.jpg[/img]

The flora has taken over as Skidrow becomes the site of massive overgrowth, as if the population vanished letting nature take its inevitable toll. Ivy hangs down the sides of the buildings and creeps along abandoned vehicles, even breaking into the interior spaces of the map. Weeds and grass push up through the crumbled concrete. At this rate, the once urban center will soon resemble a jungle. Fight on to ensure that you’re the king of it.

[b][u]New Modes: Bounty, Juggermosh[/u][/b]

[b]Bounty[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/78cf779da9add85b6fe02fc8461e334986e7f46a.jpg[/img]

Face off against the enemy in a Team Deathmatch–style game mode where players have unlimited lives and the first team to reach the elimination-based score limit wins. In Bounty, however, the biggest slayer on each team will be designated as an HVT (high-value target). The HVT on each team carries a flag and is highlighted for all to see and awards extra points when eliminated.

[b]Juggermosh[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2c1baa1f7d171d0d5a4c7e199e11212f30b70274.jpg[/img]

Prepare for heavy combat as players slug it out as imposing Juggernauts clad in Space Marines skins inspired by the [i]Warhammer 40,000[/i] universe, fully viewable in third-person perspective for the entire match, occurring across Kill Confirmed and Domination modes.

When a match begins, you drop in as an Ultramarines inspired Juggernaut clad in “Ultramar’s Vengeance” Power Armor or a Blood Angels Space Marine encased in “Baal’s Wrath” Power Armor. This armor skin offers the same capabilities as a Juggernaut Recon Killstreak, and every player comes equipped in these ornate and advanced protective suits.

You’re here to battle for possession of the OHK (one-hit kill) melee weapon — a flesh-tearing Chainsword! — in the center of the map. Grab armor from fallen enemies to patch back up and aim for the head to inflict even greater increased damage. In this mode, all players will display a health bar over their heads so you can better coordinate with your teammates to focus fire on the weakest link in the fight.

Use heights to your advantage. These massive suits not only prevent fall damage but also release an area-of-effect stun and damage effect on foes when landing from a high enough drop, a great way to initiate fights. You’ll need every advantage, too, as only air support Killstreaks are allowed, meaning it’s solely up to you to inflict damage on your opponent using an array of mode-specific  armaments, Perks, and reduced melee damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5ad77598ab95ee37b7da605ef2fc5014e6b42f8e.jpg[/img]

[b]Fight for the Imperium — Deploy in armor inspired by the 41st millennium: [/b]The fearsome Space Marines of the [i]Warhammer 40,000[/i] universe are ideally suited to stand toe-to-toe with multiple Juggernauts! Players who purchase the Tracer Pack: Warhammer 40,000 Space Marines Bundle will receive the “Ultramar’s Vengeance” Ultramarines and “Baal’s Wrath” Blood Angels Space Marine Juggernaut Recon Killstreak Skins permanently, as part of the offering.

Though anyone entering the limited-time Juggermosh game mode brings Power Armor inspired by the 41st Millennium into the fray, only players purchasing the Bundle will receive these Killstreak Skins permanently, after the Juggermosh mode concludes.

[b]Note! [/b]The two Space Marine Power Armor variants mentioned above are not Operator Skins, allowing you to change the Skin of the Juggernaut Recon Killstreak only: The “Ultramarine Scout” and “Blood Angels Scout” Skins are the Operator Skins contained within the Tracer Pack: Warhammer 40,000 Space Marines Bundle. See later into this blog post for further details.

[b][u]ZOMBIES OVERVIEW[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9b7905acfd68346b648ff000743e2778f6c224f1.jpg[/img]

[b]CONTENT SUMMARY:[/b]
[list]	[*][b]New Story Mission. [/b]Continue your journey alongside Sergei Ravenov as you’re pulled back into the Dark Aether while investigating a new anomaly, presenting terrifying and exciting challenges you haven’t encountered before.[/*]	[*][b]Dark Aether Rift.[/b] Squad up and conquer the Dark Aether once more in an all-new Dark Aether Rift, earning new and powerful rewards.[/*]	[*][b]Battle Warlord Keres.[/b] A new Warlord enters the Exclusion Zone, a chemical warfare specialist who’s willing to use any means necessary to choke out opposing Operators.[/*]	[*][b]New Schematics. [/b]Fire and keep on firing with the Mags of Holding. Summon an otherworldly two-wheeler with the Blood Burner Key. Expand your squad with the V-R11 Wonder Weapon.[/*][/list]
[b][u]New Story Mission, Dark Aether Rift[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/025ac52301f7f809960a4084957c6597d6170244.jpg[/img]

The story continues for Operation Deadbolt in Season 2 Reloaded. The Dark Aether is closing in again and bringing new enemies with it. Confront the anomaly and enter the Dark Aether once more. . . .

Operation Deadbolt is tasked with investigating a new anomaly in the next [i]Modern Warfare[/i] Zombies Story Mission. Terminus Outcomes is becoming bolder and has followed your squad into the Dark Aether. Lean on your expert guide, Sergei Ravenov, to assess the situation, defeat the mercenaries, and survive the Dark Aether.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/64654b7cd320eb0b7d11542056a42b128894b2ef.jpg[/img]

After completing the new Story Mission, a fresh Dark Aether Rift experience awaits. . . . Keep your eyes open, follow the cryptic clues, and complete timed tasks to unlock access to the Rift Gate. Once inside, complete challenges and survive to earn coveted rewards, like the Blood Burner Key and more.

[b][u]New Warlord: Keres[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/73cd180ce6f9f0256f3c6f7adf688cc7ce667119.jpg[/img]

A deadly and elusive chemical warfare specialist, Keres is set to challenge even the most prepared squads. Those brave enough to face her will find her in the Killhouse at Orlov Military Base. Come prepared and approach with extreme caution: Expect her fortress to be well-defended by soldiers, snipers, turrets, traps, and poison gas grenades. Gas masks are highly recommended.

Breaching the fortress is only the first hurdle. Inside, a new gas compound spread throughout the facility disrupts multiple sensors and thermal weapon scopes. Once it’s time to face Keres, be ready to engage not only against her Loadout of ballistic weapons but also her signature poisonous smokescreen and other bioweapons.

[b][u]New Schematics[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ffb0740ee329e7cfcaa4388651c71fa9aa66d419.jpg[/img]

[b]Mags of Holding: [/b]Skip the reload and pull ammo directly from your weapon’s ammo stash, so you can keep pumping out damage without needing to stop and fill up again.

[b]Blood Burner Key: [/b]Need a sick ride? Look no further. With the Blood Burner Key, you can summon this two-wheeler Wonder Vehicle at will. Cruise in style with this nearly indestructible bike that can move across water and is fueled by the blood of zombies you flatten under its tires. Surrounded? Activate the bike’s Aether Pulse ability to blast enemies in near proximity.

[b]V-R11 Wonder Weapon: [/b]In battle, every ally counts. Bolster your numbers using the V-R11 Wonder Weapon, capable of transforming zombies into friendly mercenaries and mercenaries into friendly zombies. Squadmate getting swarmed? You can also target allies with the V-R11, providing them temporary immunity from zombie aggression.

[b][u]WARZONE OVERVIEW[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7eec4e8bd34cfed256785099f7880fc0855a1664.jpg[/img]

[b]CONTENT SUMMARY:[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Research Vessel Mobile POI. [/b]Board the Research Vessel on Fortune’s Keep, a new mobile POI circling the island’s shoreline.[/*]	[*][b]New Killstreak: [/b]Clear out buildings of entrenched enemies with this aerial attack that decimates anyone within the targeted location.[/*]	[*][b]New Field Upgrade: [/b]Create a safe zone in the gas with the Portable Decontamination Station, protecting any Operators within its area of effect.[/*][/list]


[b][u]New POI, Killstreak, and Field Upgrade[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9052942b503e9ee819fee9cb69b155ccafc8b9eb.jpg[/img]

[b]Research Vessel (Mobile Point of Interest)[/b]

Reports of a pontoon-style watercraft off the coast of Fortune’s Keep have been confirmed as the ship arrives offshore in the mid-season update. Climb aboard once you spot it, because this mobile POI stays on the move throughout the first two minutes of a match, before dropping anchor in one of a few predetermined locations.

Keep your eyes out for enemy Operators who are also exploring the vessel; the ship features multiple levels as well as its own helipad and Ascenders, so danger can appear at any moment even if it appears safe on first boarding. Once you’re on the Research Vessel, it’s usually a great idea to commandeer the craft and utilize the equipment on board. You can:
[list]	[*]Access a decontamination station that works like the PDS (see below).[/*]	[*]Watch for enemies after activating the UAV tower.[/*]	[*]Purchase unique and exclusive items from the special Buy Station.[/*]	[*]Toot the vessel’s horn to prove you’ve stormed the ship, and if you’d like more enemy interest in your current whereabouts.[/*]	[*]Pilot the helicopter (or another chopper) onto the helipad.[/*]	[*]Investigate the [[REDACTED]] and unlock the loot-filled [[REDACTED]].[/*][/list]
[b]New Killstreak — Bunker Buster[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f55507a6e4f9c52494accb70b390ceb0f82b3ff8.jpg[/img]

Pinned down by enemy snipers holed up in the building across the street? Instead of charging them head-on and wishing for the best, pull out your binoculars and target the building with the new Bunker Buster Killstreak. Once this is activated, watch your enemies bite the dust as a missile drops down on the building, sending an explosive blast through multiple floors and leaving a column of gas in its wake.

[b]New Field Upgrade — Portable Decontamination Station[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/58ed7162da94a607e6121f1e63ff3a6ccc3ec158.jpg[/img]

Clear away the gas using the new Portable Decontamination Station (PDS) Field Upgrade. With this item, you decide when it’s time to move. Emitting a cloud of chemicals that counteracts the corrosive effects of the circle gas, a temporary safe zone is created for all Operators within its area of effect, though it’s also available on the Tac Map for all Operators to see. Note that the duration of this Field Upgrade shortens after the sixth circle of gas.

Looking for mobile gas protection? Attach the PDS to your vehicle and clear the way. The Field Upgrade can also be deployed in the water and near a Buy Station to reactivate it.

[b][u]GENERAL OVERVIEW[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8bc08ee61fa19c75a29053e37a105a18078f3671.jpg[/img]

[b]CONTENT SUMMARY:[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Two New Weapons. [/b]Slice up the competition with the Soulrender Melee weapon and dominate the mid-range with the SOA Subverter Battle Rifle.[/*]	[*][b]New Store Offerings.[/b] In the grim of darkness of the far future, there is only war! [i]Warhammer 40,000[/i] storms into the Store in Season 2 alongside [i]Godzilla x Kong [/i]and a new [i]Dune[/i] Bundle.[/*]	[*][b]New Weekly Challenges, Events.[/b] Amass awesome rewards through completing new Weekly Challenges and Events going live in the mid-season.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Two New Weapons[/u][/b]

[b]Soulrender (Melee, Classified Sector)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0555ce66e028e516732672da59b0ac71a254fae2.jpg[/img]

[i]A ceremonial blade capable of razor-sharp cuts and deadly melee action in close-quarters combat.[/i]

Cut your enemies down to size with this vicious blade capable of rapid slicing for quick takedowns. The Soulrender offers rapid slashing attacks via the Aim button alongside its heavier primary attack; hold the Fire button to prepare the heavy slash and release in time to down your foe with a devastating hit. Combo the two attack styles together for maximum damage.

The Soulrender introduces the new Omnigenesis Weapon Camo, accessible by completing a Soulrender-specific in-game challenge.

[b]How to Unlock the Base Weapon: [/b]Via a set of challenges within the new mid-season Sector in the Season 2 Battle Pass.

[b]SOA Subverter (Battle Rifle)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8d76c3186c16552b63ed28497085ad036f8937f4.jpg[/img]

[i]Chambered in 7.62, this hard-hitting rifle dominates at mid to longer ranges thanks to a low rate of fire and predictable recoil.[/i]

With an effective damage range up to 25 meters and the highest rate of fire within its class, the SOA Subverter is well worth considering as your new main weapon. Its steady upward recoil is easily manageable for staying on target through sustained fire, combined with a solid damage output that downs most enemies in three to four shots before factoring in Armor Plates.

The SOA Subverter introduces three new Weapon Camos: Fjord, Tidepool, and Dopamine, accessible by completing SOA Subverter-specific in-game challenges.

[b]How to Unlock the Base Weapon: [/b]Complete via Weekly Challenge.

[b][u]New Store Offerings: Warhammer 40,000, Godzilla x Kong, Dune[/u][/b]

Season 2 sees the arrival of the three [i]Warhammer 40,000[/i] Store Bundles, featuring Operators inspired by the Space Marines, the Sisters of Battle, and the Astra Militarum. Get downright monstrous with the new [i]Godzilla x Kong[/i] Bundle, and don the mantle of House Harkonnen in a new [i]Dune: Part Two [/i]Bundle.

[b][u]Warhammer 40,000 Bundles[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b3291595b2cd8d02d795e9685cda9ccda5990c3e.jpg[/img]

In the grim darkness of the far future, there is only war. Humanity stands alone, beset on all sides by the heretic, the mutant, and the alien.

The defenders of the galaxy-spanning Imperium have arrived as part of the mid-season update across three [i]Warhammer 40,000[/i] Bundles. Crush your enemies in armor inspired by the 10th Company of the Ultramarines or Blood Angels, rush into the thick of combat adorned like a Sister of Battle, or fight in the regalia of an elite Cadian Kasrkin.

Find out more about [url=https://warhammer40000.com/]the Warhammer 40,000 game and setting here[/url].

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Warhammer 40,000 Space Marines[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dcb26e42b0e43152f5adf9892fd318759850bd2e.jpg[/img]

Show your loyalty to your Chapter and the Emperor and adorn yourself like an Angel of Death. This Bundle features two Operator Skins: the “Ultramarines Scout” Skin inspired by the armor of the Ultramarines 10th company, and the “Blood Angels Scout” Skin inspired by the armor of the Blood Angels 10th Company.

In addition, bring havoc to the limited-time Juggermosh Multiplayer Mode! In this mode, any player, whether purchasing this Bundle or not, dons the “Ultramar’s Vengeance” Ultramarines and “Baal’s Wrath” Blood Angels Space Marine Power Armor, which are not Operator Skins, but variant Skins of the Juggernaut Recon Killstreak. However, only owners of this Bundle can equip either Power Armor Skin as a Killstreak variant after the Juggermosh limited-time mode concludes!

In addition, equip the “Ultramarines” and “Blood Angels” Weapon Charms, and head into battle with “The Flesh Tearer” and “The Teeth of Terra” Melee Weapons based off the iconic Chainsword. Lead your allies to victory with the emblazoned “Aegis Imperialis” Riot Shield Blueprint. Or just finish them in one fell swoop with the “Evisceration” Finishing Move.

When fighting from afar, take control with the choice of three Weapon Blueprints featuring Warhammer Tracers and Gorehammer Dismemberment: The “Angel’s Fury” and “Courage and Honour” Battle Rifle Blueprints and the “Contempt” Shotgun Blueprint.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Warhammer 40,000 Sisters of Battle[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/13e11f49dc8a0ccb642ffea856afc6f88d795651.jpg[/img]

There is only war. Join the fight with furious zeal by equipping the “Battle Sister” Operator Skin, and decimate your foes with the “Heretic’s Bane” LMG Weapon Blueprint and “Emperor’s Fury” Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint, both featuring Warhammer Tracers and Gorehammer Dismemberment, including an Aftermarket Part on the Holger 556.

Spread the light of the God-Emperor by displaying the “Imperium Aquila” Weapon Charm, the “Valorous Heart” Emblem, the “Daughters of the Emperor” Loading Screen, the “Adepta Sororitas” Large Decal, and the “Adeptus Ministorum” Sticker.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Warhammer 40,000 Astra Militarum[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/38a78cbcbc625fe0ad9ef43d0a1e6747e361b3cf.jpg[/img]

Defend humanity from the horrors of the 41st millennium and deploy with the “Cadian Kasrkin” Operator Skin, an elite trooper of the Imperial Guard. Slice through your enemies with the “Munitorum Issue Blade” Melee Weapon Blueprint and wield Lasgun-inspired weapons with the “Hammer of the Emperor” Assault Rifle Blueprint and the “Born Soldier” Marksman Rifle Blueprint, both featuring Lasrifle Tracers and Gorehammer Dismemberment. Or you can always tear them apart with the “Tactical Pet: Servo-Skull” Finishing Move.

Wear your insignia with pride by equipping the “Astra Militarum” Emblem, the “Sacred Rosarius” Weapon Charm, the “Warstorm” Loading Screen, the “Cadia Stands” Calling Card, and the “War’s Decree” Large Decal.

Be sure to arrive in your battle armor ready for the Warhammer 40,000: For the Emperor! Event (see below), which runs from March 13 to March 27.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Godzilla x Kong: New Empire — Kong[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4a9402760c3b9f8816434c729b4a37b966b2c699.jpg[/img]

Embrace your inner beast with the savage “Kong Armor” Operator Skin, featuring a high-tech, heavily armored suit and Kong-inspired helmet.

Unleash primal fury with the “Titan Tech Rifle” LMG, a Weapon Blueprint that goes the distance with improved damage range and bullet velocity. For closer fights, swap to the “Monarch Stinger” Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint, designed with heightened mobility, including improved sprint speed, Aim Down Sight (ADS) speed, and Sprint to Fire speed. Both Weapon Blueprints feature B.E.A.S.T. Tracers.

Obliterate enemies from behind using the “Kong’s Knuckle Slamwich” Finishing Move and show off your bestial nature with the “Bow to No-One” Large Decal and the “King Kong” Weapon Charm.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Dune Part Two — Harkonnen Pack[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/44873393ba1acb1ce052557501d6df88a088e1e8.jpg[/img]

[i]“No Atreides shall live.”[/i] — Baron Vladimir Harkonnen

Deploy as the enemy of House Atreides with the “Harkonnen Hunter” Operator Skin, covered from head to toe in state-of-the-art armor capable of withstanding even the most severe weather conditions.

Overwhelm your foes with two Weapon Blueprints featuring Spice Tracers: the “Harkonnen” Assault Rifle features an underbarrel flamethrower for extra-crispy eliminations, while the “Harkonnen” Sniper Rifle offers a highly mobile long-distance option with Attachments catered toward Sprint to Fire speed, ADS speed, and movement speed. For dispatching enemies up close, deploy with the ”Harkonnen Long Sword” Melee weapon based off the new mid-season Soulrender.

So that no one mistakes you as one of the good guys, equip “The Oppressors” animated Calling Card, the “Harkonnen Rage” Large Decal, the “Baron’s Pet” Weapon Charm, and the “House Harkonnen” animated Emblem.

[b]Bonus: [/b]Purchase both Bundles in the [i]Dune Part Two[/i] collection — this one plus the [b]Tracer Pack: Dune Part Two — Paul Atreides Operator Bundle[/b] — to unlock the “Paul Atreides Fedaykin Stealth Suit” Operator Skin.

[url=https://www.dunemovie.com/]Dune: Part Two[/url] is now in theaters.

[b][u]New Weekly Challenges and Events[/u][/b]

Check your Weekly Challenges throughout the mid-season to acquire the remaining Season 2 rewards on offer, including the new SOA Subverter Battle Rifle, new Aftermarket Parts, plus a new Weapon Blueprint and Weapon Camo.

[b]Mid-Season Weekly Challenges[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/51130c854128eb84d3abc1d942cb3c2f043485a6.jpg[/img]

[b]SOA Subverter Battle Rifle[/b]

Get the new mid-season Battle Rifle — detailed earlier in this blog post — in a Weekly Challenge arriving with the launch of the mid-season update.

[b]JAK Backsaw Kit (Aftermarket Part)[/b]

[b]Compatibility: [/b]Holger 556 (Assault Rifle)

Attach a high-capacity drum magazine to the Holger 556 alongside a double-barrel configuration allowing the weapon to fire two bullets at a time.

[b]JAK Outlaw-277 Kit (Aftermarket Part)[/b]

[b]Compatibility: [/b]BAS-B (Battle Rifle)

Transform the BAS-B into a lever-action rifle, slowing its rate of fire while massively improving its accuracy for pinpoint precision.

[b]New Weapon Blueprint and Camo: [/b]Plus, keep an eye out for the Rook SMG Weapon Blueprint for the HRM-9, and complete all eight Weekly Challenges to unlock the Rotten Inferno Mastery Camo, which can be equipped to all weapons.

[b]Season 2 Reloaded Events[/b]

Focus on unlocking a wide variety of unique rewards as Season 2 Events continue to drop challenges for you to complete! Complete each of the following Events in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] Multiplayer, [i]Modern Warfare [/i]Zombies, and/or [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i].

[b]EVENT: Dune: Rule of Fate (March 6 to March 13)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/11aa74a91a029e6de44eb6afefd43e99f86d2e45.jpg[/img]

Take control of the throne of fate and earn XP to unlock exclusive rewards. Equip the “Harkonnen Hunter” Operator Skin from the [b]Tracer Pack: Dune Part Two — Harkonnen Pack[/b] for a boost to earned event XP.

The milestone rewards for this event include:
[list]	[*]“Emperor’s Arrival” Weapon Sticker.[/*]	[*]“Deep Desert” Large Decal.[/*]	[*]“Imperial Tent” Large Decal.[/*]	[*]“The Emperor’s Blade” Weapon Charm.[/*]	[*]“House Corrino” Emblem.[/*]	[*]“The Calculus of Power” Calling Card.[/*]	[*]“Imperial Shield” Weapon Camo.[/*][/list]
[b]EVENT: Warhammer 40,000: For the Emperor! (March 13 to March 27)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2c1baa1f7d171d0d5a4c7e199e11212f30b70274.jpg[/img]

Take up arms and do your duty for the Imperium! Earn XP in-game to unlock rewards. Equip the “Ultramarines” Operator Skin or the “Blood Angels” Operator Skin from the [b]Tracer Pack: Warhammer 40,000 Space Marines Bundle[/b] for a boost to earned event XP. Only in death does duty end!

The milestone rewards for this event include:
[list]	[*]“Inquisitorial Seal” Weapon Sticker.[/*]	[*]“Know No Fear” Large Decal.[/*]	[*]“For the Emperor” Emblem.[/*]	[*]“Righteous Hatred” Weapon Charm.[/*]	[*]“Psyk-out” Grenade Tactical Skin.[/*]	[*]“Sons of Sanguinius” Animated Calling Card.[/*]	[*]“March for Macragge” Calling Card.[/*]	[*]“Innocence Proves Nothing” Animated Emblem.[/*]	[*]“Adeptus Astartes” Loading Screen.[/*]	[*]“Righteous Storm” WSP-9 SMG Weapon Blueprint.[/*][/list]
[b]EVENT: Vortex: Decay’s Realm (March 27 to April 3)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f380236d4841100798254fcd304f0371f116eba8.jpg[/img]

The Vortex is back and seeping with Decay’s blighted touch. Complete challenges across all games to unlock rotted rewards, including the:
[list]	[*]“Apocalyptic” Calling Card.[/*]	[*]“Valve Replacement” Emblem.[/*]	[*]“The Swarm” Weapon Charm.[/*]	[*]“Grave Worm” Weapon Sticker.[/*]	[*]1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token.[/*]	[*]“Wriggler” Weapon Camo.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Pre-register Now! Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile Launches Worldwide March 21[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0cb673218321348bcc3d72ce9f9807a9c5735cbd.jpg[/img]

Drop into Battle Royale with the upcoming global release of [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™ Mobile[/i]. Return to the fan-favorite Verdansk Battle Royale map or turn up the heat in the high-octane Rebirth Island. Looking to warm up? [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone Mobile [/i]features classic Multiplayer maps like Shoot House and Shipment, and fan-favorite modes as well.

Cross progression confirmed! Share weapons, level up, and progress through seasonal Battle Pass content across [i]Modern Warfare III [/i]and [i]Call of Duty[/i]: [i]Warzone[/i]. Pre-order and [url=https://www.callofduty.com/warzonemobile]pre-register[/url] on the App Store and Google Play to earn extra rewards at launch, and see our official [i]Call of Duty: Warzone Mobile[/i] [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2024/02/call-of-duty-warzone-mobile-launch-worldwide-announcement]worldwide launch date announcement[/url] for more details.

[b][u]Upgrade to Modern Warfare III[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6ab08c7f56da0712ac5308e67bae3784a181b4fa.jpg[/img]

[i]Modern Warfare III[/i] offers one of the greatest collections of Multiplayer maps ever assembled, including modernized versions of all 16 launch maps from [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 2 [/i](2009), plus the introduction of an all-new open-world Zombies and a campaign that finds Task Force 141 facing off against the ultimate threat.

Stay frosty.

notes.title: Intel Drop: Season 2 BlackCell, Battle Pass, and Bundles
notes.notes:
[b][u]The Season 2 Battle Pass is Here![/u][/b]

Spectral forces arrive in [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® III[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone™ [/i]as the Season 2 Battle Pass delivers a wide variety of content across all three games, with more Elite Operator Skins, ghostly Weapon Blueprints, vicious Finishing Moves, and more!

[previewyoutube=8VMIBiPdjgk;full][/previewyoutube]

The Season 2 Battle Pass features over one hundred rewards, including two new base weapons. Purchase the full Battle Pass and earn 1,400 COD Points as you progress through the Sectors to access all the Season 2 Battle Pass content. Or why not purchase BlackCell for extra content, including reactive spectral Operator Skins, Battle Token Tier Skips, and additional rewards.

Here's all the intel on the incredible Battle Pass content you can earn, beginning with the BlackCell’s premium offering.

[b][u]BlackCell Season 2[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/93743d6a0d37503df5dc17dacd906adb3c1c2c1c.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the Season 2 Battle Pass! Bring the fight to the undead infestation with the Season 2 premium BlackCell offering, featuring items, rewards and more. Highlights to follow:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/964820e471d64762c2fb19bc984b62c26272b470.jpg[/img]

[b]The Battle Pass: [/b]Obtain BlackCell for full access to the Season 2 Battle Pass along with 20 Battle Token Tier Skips. The full Battle Pass includes up to 1,400 COD Points within 100 Tiers of unlockable content from Battle Pass progress.

[b]BlackCell Sector: Overview[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/413109072d2be1a98c79ea38bea64c625faa7735.jpg[/img]

Drop into the Battle Pass AO at an alternative starting location by accessing the exclusive BlackCell Sector. Unlock this Sector to immediately receive 1,100 COD Points, the new “John Doe” BlackCell Operator, and the following:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9875ae8ae1b128452109b356bbe20f8b84f5c8b9.jpg[/img]

The animated “Molten BlackCell” SVA 545 Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint featuring dripping animations, and comes with Pyrite Tracers and “Gilded Ghoul” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/efb4b85b8cfb869a47180667335915b56ec04e22.jpg[/img]

The animated “Lament BlackCell” Sidewinder Battle Rifle Weapon Blueprint featuring dripping animations and comes with Pyrite Tracers and “Gilded Ghoul” Death Effect.. Also in the Sector is the “Knuckle Sandwich” Operator Finishing Move.

In addition, scattered throughout the Sectors of the Season 2 Battle Pass are BlackCell-only items. These include 11 reactive BlackCell Operator Skins and six alternate animated Weapon Blueprints with dripping animations.

[b]BlackCell Operator Skins confirmed[/b]: John Doe, Rick Grimes, Kate Laswell, Soap, Alpine, Farah, Valeria, Price, Ghost (x2), Riptide, and Warden.

Players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.

[b][u]Engage in Spectral Operations with BlackCell’s John Doe[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d79349652e65b1d9e13828be2200d1e5d6ba8a45.jpg[/img]

Bound to an eternal cycle of war, some souls can never find peace. This stalking revenant brings an otherworldly menace to any match, clad in the tattered remains of black and gold armor, with a glowing purple hue, most predominant within this specter’s sunken eye sockets.

John Doe brings with him a task force of spectral soldiers, all featuring a reactive skin. Seek out enemy Operators to defeat, and your corporeal form changes:

After two kills, you take on a more zombified appearance.

After five kills, you take on a more skeletal state.

[b][u]Purchase the Battle Pass: Instantly Unlock Rick Grimes & Kate Laswell[/u][/b]

Whether you purchase the BlackCell offering or the standard Battle Pass for 1,100 COD Points, the Instant Reward Sector becomes available, and includes two new Operators, as part of this Bonus Sector.

[b]Rick Grimes (SpecGru, Battle Pass Instant Reward)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/28e265147f2ac1cc54fcd428e752cb466d61186c.jpg[/img]

After being shot in the line of duty, Sheriff’s Deputy Rick Grimes awoke from a coma to find the world irrevocably changed. Rick will not hesitate to act against any threat to his group, be it human or walker. He puts his people first, and though he is battle-hardened and at times overwhelmed by this harsh new reality, his dream of rebuilding civilization and paving the way for a better future never wavers.

BlackCell Owners: You also unlock the “Rick Grimes BlackCell” Operator Skin.

Kate Laswell (SpecGru, Battle Pass Instant Reward)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/328ee9e98735568bab0d8b63069191f74270f77e.jpg[/img]

Kate Laswell began her career in communications where she was quickly recognized for her advanced strategic analysis and climbed the CIA ranks. Across her tenure, she has saved tens of thousands of lives with her detainee information, and now works closely with select special agents to respond to terrorist activity across the globe.

BlackCell Owners: You also unlock the “Kate Laswell BlackCell” Operator Skin.

The Instant Reward Sector also grants you a 10% Battle Pass boost, the “Clank” Weapon Blueprint for the MTZ-762 Battle Rifle, and the “Goose” Operator Finishing Move for Laswell, featuring a vicious takedown by Laswell’s pet dog.

[b][u]Additional Battle Pass Skins[/u][/b]

Complete the Battle Pass Sectors to unlock a variety of new tactical Operator Skins, all of which come paired with a skeletal, animated and reactive BlackCell alternate Skin:

[b]“Hector” Skins (Operator Skin, Soap, Sector B3)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9a7f912bc8623dbdc2b88d7205f6258e686046b7.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]Gear up in lightly armored Mil-Sim garb featuring a masked helmet and tactical padding across the torso and legs.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]Keep the mohawk, lose the skin as Soap becomes a glowing-eyed apparition, seeking vengeance.

[b]“Keres” Skins (Operator Skin, Alpine, Sector B4)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/23bdf59dea0d9feb1d8a0168cfa469312268b5a8.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]Ignore any chemical imbalances in the atmosphere as you arrive in combat clad in a long coat, full gas mask, and dark camo.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]Bring the dripping undeath look, the skeletal Keres appears in the remains of a light tactical outfit, and baseball cap.

[b]“Skulker” Skins (Operator Skin, Farah, Sector B8)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fdd70645325f8ee36169fb1748ff565905cfa522.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]An unnerving pair of eyes peer out from a ghillie balaclava, as Farah comes ready for combat in urban tactical gear.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]A hooded skull with glowing purple eyes dominates Farah’s BlackCell variant, with peeling bones beneath the combat clothing.

[b]“Rupture” Skins (Operator Skin, Valeria, Sector B11)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ab06ca1805ab9f5e9ee344abede0f7ee5be379b6.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]Designed for specific combat opportunities, Valeria comes masked in an all-white combat outfit with light marbling accents.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]As gold drips down her combat vest, a skull-faced Valeria comes ready to turn foes into corpses.

[b]“Veil” Skins (Operator Skin, Price, Sector B16)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/994255638b531fff0b5dc2c3d4f0ee9a96915cfa.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]Bravo-6 is docked out in impressive all-weather tactical gear, with a double hood and tactical poncho.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]New look, same hat: The boonie sits atop of an impressively emaciated Captain Price.

[b]“Venator” Skins (Operator Skin, Ghost, Sector B17)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/55c4bf4de34fedcfc8420d9b9ce8470a6221b219.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]Simon “Ghost” Riley becomes a venerated hunter with comms, obligatory face mask, and inclement weather fatigues with an orange accent.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]The meat may have fallen off the bone, but Ghost commands just as much awe and respect. Note the gold mask.

[b]“Scar” Skins (Operator Skin, Riptide, Sector B20)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/51adde61801cea64ae994bd52b8fdfb28dbd440f.jpg[/img]

[b]Battle Pass Skin: [/b]A fully covered head mask with eye slits for facial features, Riptide favors the impromptu incognito look.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin:[/b] Clad in a partial “ghoulie” suit of black and dripping gold, this otherworldly shroud obscures a skull-faced visage.

Also expect two further Skins (each with a BlackCell variant) once you finish the Battle Pass and unlock the Completion Sector (see below).

[b][u]New Functional Weapons[/u][/b]

Unlock two new functional weapons in Sectors B6 and B7:

[b]RAM-9 Submachine Gun (Sector B6, HVT, Free)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c11e71eff54e6ed110c8b283fda2a9b833587ac7.jpg[/img]

[b][i]More maneuverable and agile than its assault rifle counterpart, this bullpup SMG chambered in 9mm is lethal at close range.[/i][/b]

Offering among the best-in-class Recoil Control and Mobility, as well as the most Rounds and Reserve of any SMG, the RAM-9 may not win any pinpoint accuracy awards (especially a distance), but it can certainly mow down the opposition with high-damage, chamber-emptying assaults, especially as you close in for the kill.

[b]BP50 Assault Rifle (Sector B7, Free)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4bd74da646900670990753fccc1073ed2fd3061d.jpg[/img]

[b][i]A modular bullpup chambered in 5.56. Tear down the competition with a high rate of fire and exceptional accuracy for dominating at mid to long ranges.[/i][/b]

For Operators needing optimal mobility from their weaponry, the BP50 is a spectacular contender. Offering exceptional maneuverability and a spectacular rate of fire compared to other rifles in its class, this Corvus-built armament can cut down the opposition in a variety of rapid and impressive ways.

[b][u]New Weapon Blueprints, Vehicle Skin, Additional Content[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2df751c3c0bfec4021fabe4a2544f6fa7194a471.jpg[/img]

The Season 2 Battle Pass features 20 Weapon Blueprints and a Vehicle Skin for the UTV. Also get access to an array of Calling Cards, Weapon Charms, Decals, Stickers, Emblems, Finishing Moves, COD Points, and Zombies Acquisitions (including Ammo Mods, Aether Tools, and Raw Aetherium Crystals).

[b]Weapon Blueprints[/b]

Several of the Battle Pass Blueprints fit within a visual theme so that you can equip a variety of armaments with a similar style. Themes you’ll encounter in Season 2 include:

[b]Wear and Tear[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/daf8d5a01ca582f0998d8e4931db373bdca97c2c.jpg[/img]

[b]Sector B1: [/b]“Grume” DM56 Marksman Rifle*

[b]Sector B8: [/b]“Shoot Your Shot” Lockwood 680 Shotgun

[b]Sector B10: [/b]“Better Days” FR 5.56 Assault Rifle

[b]Sector B16: [/b]“Make Shift” Striker 9 SMG

These Weapons Blueprints bear the marks of battle. Scratched up, taped together, smeared with blood, and not for the faint of heart.

[b]Occult[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a4bfa397752b8022f07122308efcaa82aa547ae7.jpg[/img]

[b]Sector B13: [/b]“IBIS” HRM-9 SMG

[b]Sector B14: [/b]“Old Faith” XRK Stalker Sniper Rifle*

[b]Sector B15: [/b]“Crocus” BAS-BXXXsp Battle Rifle

[b]Completion: [/b]“Hands On” TAQ Evolvere LMG

Featuring rusted, hand painted models alongside purple aetherium laced models, this series lends a touch of chaos to your future deployments.

[b]NODE: Lime Green and Black[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/865eba0834a5a8d5efea3da1baa84bb3d312d413.jpg[/img]

[b]Sector B2: [/b]“Edge Node” Karambit Melee

[b]Sector B3: [/b]“Marigold” Pulemyot LMG

[b]Sector B11: [/b]“Crash Dummy” Assault Rifle

[b]Sector B12: [/b]“Full Stop” TAQ Eradicator LMG*

Season 2 features two NODE-themed series of Weapon Blueprints, the first you’ll encounter being the lime green and black variant.

[b]NODE: White and Black[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e64b2d61d77de54e01c0996cab2d5310a9aaf7a9.jpg[/img]

[b]Sector B11: [/b]“Pale Death” Bruen MK9 LMG

[b]Sector B18: [/b]“Sabertooth” RAM-9 SMG*

[b]Sector B19: [/b]“Anguish” BP50 Assault Rifle*

Opt for the white and black variety of NODE Weapon Blueprints.

[i][* Denotes a Weapon Blueprint with a BlackCell variant, detailed below][/i]

[b]New Vehicle Skin — Trust No One! (Sector B5)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c4ed89e4692003edb885fe4f4e63b1c89f0b1d0f.jpg[/img]

Carve offroad paths and send enemies fleeing in terror with this white, black, and red UTV Vehicle Skin emblazoned with the word ‘Beware’ written in blood across its doors.

[b]Weapons with Additional BlackCell Blueprints[/b]

This season’s signature BlackCell aesthetic is dripping with style across six Weapon Blueprints found within the Season 2 Battle Pass. The following Blueprints feature both a regular and BlackCell variant within the same tier. Both versions feature the same attachments, so pick your preferred style and start slaying.

[b]Grume — DM56 Marksman Rifle (Sector B1, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant comes [/b]with Pyrite Tracers and “Gilded Ghoul” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bae2551127902d3a04e800d487bff1b12460465b.jpg[/img]

Equip a battle worn version of this Marksman Rifle geared for improved accuracy and recoil control with an integrated Optic for rapid target acquisition. The BlackCell variant oozes confidence with a black and gold dripping animation.

[b]Triggerfinger — Basilisk Handgun (Sector B9, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant comes [/b]with Pyrite Tracers and “Gilded Ghoul” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6b7f2e1faff3e504e8b3d8a15ad897b297087ea5.jpg[/img]

Wield immense stopping power with this Handgun Weapon Blueprint that enhances the revolver with improved mobility and aiming speed, keeping you light on your feet while wielding the five-shooter. Equip its dripping BlackCell variant for a wilder look.

[b]Full Stop — TAQ Eradicator LMG (Sector B12, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant comes [/b]with Pyrite Tracers and “Gilded Ghoul” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d2368dff4cfc04856242c249452277612b811854.jpg[/img]

Conduct stealth operations with this lime green and black Weapon Blueprint featuring a suppressor to keep you off the radar while firing along with enhanced damage and recoil control for added stability. Trade its sleek look for something more sinister using the BlackCell variant.

[b]Old Faith — XRK Stalker Sniper Rifle (Sector B14, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant comes [/b]with Pyrite Tracers and “Gilded Ghoul” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/59c63c7dafd2fe3629df116011906b4795362869.jpg[/img]

A Weapon Blueprint fit for the meanest Operators. Rugged and featuring a spray-painted skull design, the weapon’s fit for distant engagements with range-enhancing attachments plus a suppressor to keep off the radar and a bipod mount for heightened accuracy when mounted or prone. For a more out-of-this world design, swap in the BlackCell variant.

[b]Sabertooth — RAM-9 SMG (Sector B18, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant comes [/b]with Pyrite Tracers and “Gilded Ghoul” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/40658e469c3aa4c913723e2515351cea38b0b407.jpg[/img]

Engage in fierce fighting with this smooth white Weapon Blueprint offering improved recoil control and handling to help stay on target during critical engagements, plus a sprint to fire speed boost for quick transitions between running and skirmishing. Equip the BlackCell variant to show that you mean business.

[b]Anguish — BP50 Assault Rifle (Sector B19, BlackCell Alternate Option)[/b]

[b]BlackCell variant comes [/b]with Pyrite Tracers and “Gilded Ghoul” Death Effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e6abab06243a59dc44b1a58186594513169fa565.jpg[/img]

Based on the new Season 2 Assault Rifle, this otherwise sleek Weapon Blueprint has been tagged up and bloodied. Keep the enemy at bay with a hefty 45 round Magazine complimented by a recoil control-enhancing attachments and a 2.5x magnification Optic for mid-ranged precision. Swim in a sea of black gold with its BlackCell variant.

[b][u]Complete the Battle Pass for Completion Sector Tier 100 Rewards[/u][/b]

Complete 100% of the map by conquering all Sectors to access the final Completion Sector, featuring 300 COD Points to spend toward your next Battle Pass or Store Bundle purchase, the "Leave the Dead” Finishing Move, the “Hands On” Weapon Blueprint, and the following Operator Skins:

[b]“Sovyna” Skins for Warden[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bbd07ce0d4d50967307bb98a900d9fd895084fe0.jpg[/img]

Warden dons an alien face mask paired with tactical gear and a hood for all-weather combat. Her sleeves are rolled up, tattoos on displayed, and she’s ready to engage any threat in her way.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]Warden trades her sleeves for skeletal arms, a golden skull face mask with shining purple eyes, and the season’s signature black and gold drip adding the final sinister element.

[b]“Shade” Skins for Ghost[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2fee99b5bb04538cf0ccc77694e20a8846f21720.jpg[/img]

Ghost leans into his ethereal qualities in this Operator Skin awarded for completing the Season 2 Battle Pass. A spectral power flows from his eyes and forearms, his mask radiant in the afterglow.

[b]BlackCell Additional Skin: [/b]Ghost trades his white skull mask for a golden one, accentuated with golden flames over the eyes and vapor rising from his arms.

[b][u]Store Highlights: AMC’s [i]The Walking Dead[/i], Year of the Dragon, and More[/u][/b]

Prepare for some wild new Store Bundles in Season 2, ranging from the terrifying Resonance Operator Skin to a Zombies-themed Bundle and the perfect Bundle for the trash talker in all of us. Look out for new Mastercraft Weapons and Ultra Operator Skins, featured in our Season 2 highlights below:

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Resonance Ultra Skin[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6bda8a32af44d5cbe8b30fc83c5caed06f087799.jpg[/img]

Enter battle from another plane and as a warrior without equal using the “Titan” Operator Skin for Bantam, featuring animated alien designs over tough upper body armor and a helmet of alien design. Equip two Weapon Blueprints with Netherblaze Tracers and the Netherburst Death Effect: the “Primordium” SMG, crafted with an animated alloy and geared for mid-ranged precision; and the “Quasar” LMG, outfitted with a bipod mount and muzzle flash concealment for precise, low-profile engagements.

Resonate with the alien designs featured in the “Ancient Alloy” Large Decal, the “Dark Matter” Weapon Sticker, and the “Anomaly” Weapon Charm. This Bundle also includes a 1 Hour Battle Pass XP Token.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Echo Endo: Evergreen Rhino New Weapon[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c0dc1199aabca70332176a5df69788bae7a67808.jpg[/img]

Don bright green armor in the “Kabuto” Operator Skin for Pathfinder. resembling a futuristic carapace with horns, hanging wires, and an animated visor. Equip the green and gray “Midori” Weapon Blueprint for the new Season 2 BP 50 Assault Rifle bolstered by a 45 round Magazine and an extended damage range; delete enemies using the weapon’s Kawaii Cruelty Tracers and the VwV 2.0 Tracer Death Effect.

Go loud with the “Crocodile” LMG packing a punch with X. Liven up your weapons with the “Midori” Large Decal, the “Sweet Rampage” Weapon Sticker, and the “Evergreen” Weapon Charm. Dazzle your enemies with the “Green Genjitsu” Animated Emblem and the “Mesmerizing Midori” Animated Calling Card.

[b][u]Aberration Ultra Skin[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4b63d52532ed81c7202a84869ba3ad79fd4a717f.jpg[/img]

Frighten and infect the enemy with the monstrous “Truffle” Operator Skin for Byline, featuring a skull mask, transparent and animated arms, and a fungal parasite releasing its poisonous fumes.

Suppress enemies with the “Agaric” LMG Weapon Blueprint designed with enhanced recoil control and the extended range “Mycelium” Handgun Weapon Blueprint featuring the JAK Beholder Rifle Kit Aftermarket Part. Spread the spores with the “Corpse Bloom” Large Decal, the “Shimmering Heart” Weapon Sticker, and the “Metamorphosis” Weapon Charm, and enjoy a bonus 1 Hour Double Weapon XP Token.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Vivarium Ultra Skin[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a6c900f5ea148b9d69efc7dc48c7ab323e3b81a7.jpg[/img]

Obtain symbiosis with the “Incubator” Operator Skin for Jet featuring incubated life attached to the Operator’s yellow tactical armor with purple feeding tubes running up and down the suit. Equip two Weapon Blueprints Blooming Tracers and the Mulcher Death Effect, along with a white and translucent purple design showing plant life thriving within the weapons. The “Dahlia” LMG is kitted out for snappy, controlled fire with attachments boosting its aim down sights speed and recoil control. Equip the “Wardian” SMG for a mean weapon using a 100 round drum paired with the JAK Ettin Double Barrel Kit for twice the firepower.

Show off your penchant for plant life with the “Venus Man-Trap” Large Decal, the “Resilience” Weapon Sticker, and the “Grow Light” Weapon Charm. Churn through some Battle Pass Tiers with a 1 Hour Double Battle Pass XP Token.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: The Walking Dead Michonne Operator Bundle[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f662c9871d5f7a036f5083f8e1b65b2ef9ffc696.jpg[/img]

Michonne is a warrior and a survivor. Deploy as the skilled fighter from AMC’s [i]The Walking Dead[/i] with the “Michonne” Operator Skin. Enemies beware, as this Bundle features three Weapon Blueprints with a banged up, bloodied look to them. Equip the “Lone Survivor” Assault Rifle for its brisk strafing speed or deploy with the “Walker Waster” Sniper Rifle which has been reconfigured for close engagements using a shortened tactical barrel and a folding stock for improved movement speed. Both Blueprints feature Death and Decay Tracers and the Michonne’s Specialty Death Effect.

Get up close and personal with the “Killer Kodachis,” sharp enough to sever flesh and life and featuring the Michonne’s Specialty Death Effect; show off your swordplay with the “Dead Cuts” Finishing Move. Brandish hope with the “Believe a Little Longer” Weapon Sticker and “The Ones Who Live” Large Decal, and keep a walker on hand with the “Mike” Weapon Charm.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Full Kit: Dragon: Lunar New Year[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d62f522726e915aa238f31b39fb755ee972e951e.jpg[/img]

Celebrate the Year of the Dragon with this massive Bundle headlined by the “Emperor” Operator Skin for Jabber featuring ornate dragon-themed pauldrons and helmet. Rain fire on your enemies with two Weapon Blueprints featuring Year of the Dragon Tracers: the jade and gold “Dragon Fire” Shotgun equipped with an underbarrel flamethrower and the dragon emblazoned “Heavenly Rifle” SMG designed for stealth play.

Make your presence known with the “Dragon Wall” Deployable Cover, “Fire Breather” Wheelson-HS, “Burning Dragon” Thermite, and “Thunder Dragon” Equipment Skins. Equip a variety of dragon-themed cosmetic items like the “Dragon Dance” Calling Card, “Year of the Dragon” Weapon Charm, “New Year Dragon” Large Decal, “Dragon Fire” Weapon Sticker, “Sign of the Dragon” Emblem, and “Courage of the Dragon” Loading Screen.

[b][u]Demon Glo New Weapon[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d7af929fd660eb50c26f55ab7e5fbc4f3c6efab8.jpg[/img]

Party while you fight with the “Coup” Operator Skin for Enigma featuring animated glowing graffiti over all-black tactical gear. Deploy with style using two animated graffiti Weapon Blueprints: the accurate, damage range-extended “Rebellion” SMG and the silenced “In the Dark” SMG. Extend your artistic streak with the “Twin Specters” Large Decal, “Blow in the Dark” Weapon Charm, “Blacklight” Animated Calling Card, “Neon Flash” Animated Emblem, and “Firelight Phantasm” Sticker.

Players who purchase the Demon Glo Bundle will also gain an extra Strike Team Operator Slot in Zombies along with two Rare Aether Tools.

[b][u]Zombies: Aether Worm[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/73e37a642fa492a608d91bf65a956bf1cefc1309.jpg[/img]

Terrify even the undead with the “Vanquisher” Operator Skin for Scorch, featuring armor forged from a Death Worm’s with glowing purple accents over a thorny carapace and long, sharp teeth. Take on foes with the aetherium etched “Etched Obsidian” LMG Weapon Blueprint featuring enhanced recoil control and damage range and the “Seared Obsidian” Sniper Rifle Weapon Blueprint equipped with a silencer for stealth plays from way out. Pay homage to the Death Worm with the ”Olgoi-Khorkhoi” Large Decal and the “’Bite’ Sized” Weapon Charm.

Players who purchase the Zombies: Aether Worm Bundle will also gain an extra Strike Team Operator Slot in Zombies — perfect for deploying as the “Vanquisher” right away — as well as a Refined Aetherium Crystal which can be consumed to Pack-A-Punch your weapon to Level II.

[b][u]Nova 6 Pro Pack[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/48870df28a30c3d62cc02d5591e521a18ce6d15f.jpg[/img]

The Nova 6 Pro Pack offers an insane value including 2400 COD Points along with the other Bundle items. Prepare for even the most toxic environments with the black and yellow “Airlock” Operator Skin for Raptor. Equip the “Ablution” Assault Rifle Weapon Blueprint designed with improved hip fire and Tac-Stance capabilities; opt for the “Quarantine” LMG Weapon Blueprint for its improved aim down sights and movement speed.

Enhance your menacing appeal with the “Operation Azure” Calling Card, the “Biohazard” Weapon Sticker, the “Toxic Shock” Weapon Charm, and the “Hazard” Emblem, all featuring the Operator’s iconic look.

[b][u]Tracer Pack: Trash Talk Mastercraft[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5804c70f3a4cb5994294316f389f626c0cb88f30.jpg[/img]

For those who relish the trash talk as much as the match wins. Deploy with the “Good Game” Operator Skin for BBQ, featuring ski goggles, bleach blonde hair, a thick beard, and a bad attitude.

Head into battle with two Weapon Blueprints featuring Trash Talk Tracers and the Bodied Dismemberment Death Effect: The “Orator” Assault Rifle features an animated screen on the stock and a five-attachment spread favoring handling and firing stability. The “Protoype” LMG Weapon Blueprint offers steady suppressive fire with good recoil control, gun kick control, and enhanced bullet velocity.

Laugh in the enemy’s face with the “Haters Gonna Hate” Animated Calling Card, lose it with the “Bad Manners” Large Decal, plus get the “Get Good” Weapon Charm and the “Why You Heff To Be So Mad?” Animated Emblem.

Check the in-game Store for more Bundles arriving throughout the season and for the mid-season update.

[b][i][u]Dune [/u][/i][/b][b][u]Returns[/u][/b]

In anticipation of the March 1, 2024 release of [i]Dune: Part Two[/i] in theaters, Season 2 will see the return of the [b]Dune Part Two: Sardaukar Pack[/b] and the [b]Tracer Pack: Feyd-Rautha Operator Bundle[/b].

[b][u]Play the Season 2 Free Trial[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d6d521d7d28337fba5fe96c92bf3f04694fbec2a.jpg[/img]

From February 8 through 12, invite your friends and family to play [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] for free during the free access trial. Play the new Season 2 map Stash House along with eight other Multiplayer maps across Team Deathmatch, Hardpoint, Kill Confirmed, Domination, and Team Gun Game. Plus, squad up and fight back the horde with full access to [i]Modern Warfare[/i] Zombies.

[b][u]Purchase [i]Modern Warfare III[/i][/u][/b]

[i]Modern Warfare III[/i] celebrates the 20th anniversary of [i]Call of Duty [/i]with one of the greatest collections of Multiplayer maps ever assembled, including modernized versions of all 16 launch maps from [i]Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2[/i] (2009), plus the introduction of an all-new open-world Zombies and a Campaign that finds Task Force 141 facing off against the ultimate threat in Vladimir Makarov.
