For Call of Duty Updates, follow[/i] [url=https://twitter.com/CODUpdates][i]@CODUpdates[/i][/url] [i]on X (formerly Twitter).[/i]

notes.title: Modern Warfare III Season 1: Warzone Overview
notes.notes:
[b][u]CALL OF DUTY: WARZONE OVERVIEW[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c3a736c76dfda132dd1e176cdba3912f0555164a.jpg[/img]

	[list]	[*][b]Welcome to Urzikstan. [/b]The next big map is coming to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]! Receive a topographical overview plus a host of new features and updates coming as part of the Season 1 update.[/*]	[*][b]Carry Forward [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] maps.[/b] Players can continue deploying to Ashika Island and Vondel alongside the new Urzikstan map.[/*]	[*][b]CODMAS Event. [/b]Encounter the Zombie Santa, go undead Deer Hunting, open the presents under the Holiday Trees, all while engaging in new challenges events with rewards, and more. Just don’t forget to bring Snowballs![/*][/list]
[i](This is blog 3 of 4; also make sure to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/3887232108509147191]Part 1: Modern Warfare III Overview[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/3887232108509157164]Part 2: Zombies Overview[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/3887232108509181295]Part 4: General Overview[/url].)[/i]

[b][u]Big Game, Big Map: Welcome to Urzikstan[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/113b71819ee59db0a2c7a0563dce7a328c29e22f.jpg[/img]
	
Consult the adjacent companion asset (above), then prepare to fight through the all-new Urzikstan map (below), a vast and captivating landscape with a mixture of rural, industrial, and suburban zones. Presented by Raven Software, the new big map features 11 major points of interest (named on your Tac Map), 27 additional, large-scale points of interest (named on your in-game Compass), a Drivable Train (the first mobile point of interest in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]), and numerous smaller areas to explore, giving you near limitless tactical potential!
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8939ea20a789d32c70b190d542dd8488491b24da.jpg[/img]
	
From the iconic Popov Power Plant in the north all the way to the Zaravan Suburbs in the south, Operators should be ready to engage in a mix of classic and brand-new gameplay, utilizing innovative new features like the Drivable Train, Horizontal Ziplines, and new Perks exclusive to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].

For an in-depth look at all 38 named points of interest across Urzikstan, be sure to [url=https://www.callofduty.com/guides]check out the Tac-Atlas Guide[/url]!

[b]Urzikstan Modes (Launch and In-Season)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a57c88751d5dbf964ef34c8b6252a5c87545be26.jpg[/img]
	
To celebrate the launch of Urzikstan, all modes will be set on the new big map for the first 48 hours of Season 1, including:
[list]	[*][b]Launch Modes: [/b]Battle Royale, Resurgence, and Plunder	[list]		[*]We will be introducing areas of Urzikstan to a pool of Resurgence locations across Ashika and Vondel, as part of a new Limited-Time-Mode called[b] Urzikstan Resurgence[/b], which will focus on several select Points of Interest from around the Urzikstan map:		[list]			[*]Orlov Military Base[/*]			[*]Popov Power[/*]			[*]Zaravan Suburbs[/*]		[/list]		[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*][b]In-Season Modes: [/b]Lockdown returns, and the brand new Limited-Time-Mode, Slay Ride Resurgence, makes its holiday debut![/*][/list]
All squad sizes for Battle Royale on Urzikstan will be available all season long.

[b]Return to Vondel and Ashika: Carry Forward Maps[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/725aae6c6f4c288070268f3c90c5e675127824a2.jpg[/img]

In addition to the new Urzikstan big map, after the first 48 hours Season 1 will also add Ashika Island and Vondel to the playable maps.

[b][u]Updated Gameplay: Movement, Mechanics, and More[/u][/b]

With the start of Season 1, [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] will be updated to include many of the new movement and other mechanics present in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], along with new innovations specific to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone.[/i]

[b]Movement Updates (Launch)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fe415b19575558746fc9d496504e0e69dc220cfc.jpg[/img]
	
Expect the following movement changes at launch:
[list]	[*]Slide canceling.[/*]	[*]Tac-Stance.[/*]	[*]ADS while sliding.[/*]	[*]Running while reloading[/*]	[*]A slight movement boost when using the Stim Tactical.[/*]	[*]Additional changes will be detailed [url=https://www.callofduty.com/patchnotes]in the upcoming Patch Notes[/url].[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay Updates (Launch)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d48994de348c99c11c0a7d12d6d59f9d26b3b24b.jpg[/img]
	
Expect the following improvements and updates from Raven Software at launch:
[list]	[*][b]Backup Pistol:[/b] Always have a dedicated pistol when swimming or climbing ladders or ledge hanging, no matter your Loadout.[/*]	[*][b]Improved Water Combat:[/b] Alongside the dedicated pistol, improvements have been made to water visibility such that it is now easier to see targets both when in and out of the water.[/*]	[*][b]Manual Gas Mask :[/b] You can now manually choose when to equip the Gas Mask. When looking at a Gas Mask on the ground, Players are presented with two options: Equip it, or Stow it. Equipping the Gas Mask will begin the equip animation of putting it onto their face. Stowing the Gas Mask will place it in the Backpack for Players to manually equip at a later time. As a result, the animation will no longer interrupt gameplay, and importantly Players will only hear the heavy breathing sound effect while in the Gas.[/*]	[*][b]Experimental Gas Grenade:[/b] This Tear Gas Tactical now deals gas damage, and as such can be countered with an equipped Gas Mask.[/*]	[*][b]Dedicated Ammo Slots:[/b] Specific new Backpack slots cater to ammo, allowing quick and easy access. These slots will be automatically filled as Players find ammo. Additional ammo can still be stored in the all-purpose Backpack slots.[/*]	[*][b]Loot Rarity:[/b] Weapons, equipment, killstreaks, and more will now appear with a color-coded tooltip to indicate the value and rarity of the item, as well as if a weapon is from a “Custom Loadout”.[/*]	[*][b]Contract Activation Laptop:[/b] Players will now activate Contracts by interacting with larger, more easily identifiable laptops found throughout the map.[/*]	[*][b]Updated Tac Map Icons:[/b] The entirety of the Tac Map has been updated to better serve you, with a variety of easily distinguishable new icons.[/*]	[*][b]Classic Red Dots: [/b]The classic minimap will feature within [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]; firing unsuppressed weapons causes Operators to momentarily appear as a red dot on the minimap.[/*]	[*][b]Improved Loot Spreading: [/b]Players will now notice that the loot distribution and spread when opening a Supply Box or eliminating an enemy has received improvements to minimize loot overlap and facilitate loot identification.[/*]	[*][b]Quality of Life Carry Forward:[/b] For the new Chapter of Warzone, all existing Quality of Life improvements that have been made this year will carry forward.[/*][/list]
[b][u]New Environment Elements[/u][/b]

[b]Drivable Train (Launch)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ee73603d34a69d150f2db4a3d473a72fbd585242.jpg[/img]
	
Take control of [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]’s first controllable mobile POI: Urzikstan’s new drivable train, complete with forward and backward engine controls, a Buy Station, UAV Tower, Horn, Ammo Depot, a guaranteed Legendary Supply Crate, and a handbrake in the caboose (rear carriage) for tactical braking! Read more on how this works in the forthcoming [i]Warzone[/i] Patch Notes.

[b]Horizontal Ziplines (Launch)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/00843330a3ee5436f6c78498c6c88dfb5cd0deb5.jpg[/img]
	
In addition to the vertical ascenders, expect ziplines to allow rapid horizontal navigation across Urzikstan. Look for ziplines across the map, often allowing faster travel across otherwise more challenging topography, like water or tall structures, and if you watched [i]Call of Duty: Next[/i], Quality of Life improvements have already been made to this system enabling easier on/off access for the Operator using either type of transport line.

[b]New Vehicle: Coyote (Launch)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/596eececa5fbe4cf01094e1aa57ce1656a3d6176.jpg[/img]
	
Available in Urzikstan during Battle Royale and Plunder modes is an impressive, lightly-armored new offroad vehicle, known as the Coyote. This is an open-air and agile desert vehicle designed to grip the dunes and move quickly. The mounted machine gun is more than enough to take out the opposition in your path.

[b]Returning Contract, New Public Event and Updated Strongholds[/b]
	
[b]Big Game Bounty Contract: [/b]Activate this Contract to put a Bounty on the Player with the most eliminations in the match; take them out to earn an Advanced UAV.

[b]"Fly Buy” Public Event: [/b]A new Public Event arrives in Urzikstan, where there is a chance that multiple Drones will fly-in to drop additional Buy Stations into the Warzone.

[b]Updated Strongholds: [/b]In order to make each match unique, Strongholds have now been moved to the Public Event system where there is a percentage chance of them becoming accessible to infiltrate during an Infil. As a result of this change, players may also encounter Cash Drops during Infil, and may also find Blacksite keys in ground loot allowing you the opportunity to open a Black Site in any match.

[b][u]New Perks (Launch)[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/532eae858f8ed048fc3df2ccdc428460197fb6db.jpg[/img]
	
The Perk system currently in [i]Warzone[/i] continues, with Operators choosing from either a pre-set or a Custom Perk Package consisting of four Perks which become active once your Loadout is claimed. Perk Packs can also be found in ground loot, whether dropped by an eliminated Player or found in Supply Boxes.

Movement and rotation opportunities on the new big map of Urzikstan has been a key focus of its design, so in the new chapter of Warzone Players will also find themselves with several Perks that are now simply enabled by [b][u]default[/u][/b] at all times:
[list]	[*][b]Tac Pads:[/b] Improves slide distance and allows for full ADS while sliding, along with increased stance transition speeds.[/*]	[*][b]Commando Gloves:[/b] Enables reloading while running.[/*]	[*][b]Quick-Grip Gloves:[/b] Increases your weapon swap speed.[/*]	[*][b]Climbing Boots:[/b] Increases climbing and mantling speed aspect.[/*]	[*][b]Overkill:[/b] Allows you to pick two Primary Weapons.[/*][/list]	

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b1fe24014980baa9058ed350f0601fb260ab2628.jpg[/img]
	
You should also get ready for new and returning Perks exclusive to [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]designed to create new outplay and counter opportunities[i],[/i] of which the following can be equipped as Custom Perks in your Loadout:
[list]	[*][b]Irradiated:[/b] Move faster and take less damage while in the gas.[/*]	[*][b]Tempered:[/b] Now also available as a Custom Perk, Tempered allows you to refill armor plates to full with two plates instead of three.[/*]	[*][b]Combat Scout:[/b] Bullets you fire briefly ping an enemy for you and your squad. Hitting the enemy from farther away increases the ping time.[/*][/list][list]	[*][b]Resolute:[/b] When taking damage from gunfire, this grants a short bonus to movement speed.[/*]	[*][b]Shrouded:[/b] Drop a smoke grenade when downed.[/*]	[*][b]Mountaineer:[/b] Reduces fall damage.[/*]	[*][b]Stalker:[/b] Increased strafe and aim down sight movement speed.[/*]	[*][b]Escapist:[/b] Increased downed, prone, and crouch speed.[/*]	[*][b]Primed:[/b] Accuracy and time to aim down sight is improved while jumping.[/*]	[*][b]Faculty:[/b] Delay triggered explosives while sprinting, warns of nearby enemy equipment, and reduces combat noise.[/*][/list]
These additional Perks allow for an impressive variety of playstyles and Perk Packages, as the total number of Perks now reaches over 30 with the 5 new default Perks, plus 12 Perks in Slots 1 and 2, 10 Perks in Slot 3, and 7 Perks in Slot 4.

[b][u]New Gulag (Launch)[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/51e9058aea77d6163fcc101e749a384b7a07e5d9.jpg[/img]
	
Urzikstan features a new Gulag, the perfect way to redeploy once you’ve faced down an adversary in 1v1 combat. However, this Gulag, aside from being a brand-new environment, comes with new gameplay updates too:
[list]	[*][b]Ascender Overtime Finisher: [/b]Replacing the old overtime flag, players are now provided an exfil rope that drops into the middle of the Gulag during the match allowing extraction – but, be warned! You can both shoot, and be shot at, from the Ascender![/*]	[*][b]Gulag Public Events:[/b]Several new Public Events may also occur within the Gulag, such as Go Again (an additional Gulag attempt if you lose the first fight), Cash Grab (more money on the floor with a big stack in the middle of the map) and Locked & Loaded Weapons (AMG + SMG Loadout with full armor), helping the victor by bringing back some much-needed power items into the match.[/*]	[*][b]Night Vision Gulag (In-Season):[/b]NVG has a new name, as the Gulag will occasionally go dark while equipping Operators with night-vision goggles for a fun new twist on the Gulag experience.[/*][/list]
[b]Additional Content (In-Season)[/b]

Season 1 Reloaded, available in early 2024, will bring with it a number of new features including Covert Exfil – a new secondary exfil condition – as well as the Weapon Case similar to that seen in [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] but with brand new rewards. In addition, players can expect a new Champion’s Quest with fresh rewards for those brave and strategic enough to complete it – or steal it...

[b][u]New Event: Merry CODMAS (In-Season)[/u][/b]

Krampus is back!

Just kidding. Instead, get into the festive mood with CODMAS! This Holiday Event brings new challenges and rewards (some visible, some hidden!) to the Urzikstan map in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] in the form of Deck the Halls, Zombie Santa, and Slay Ride.
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5b45c06885c130fd4dce21eb13a11e46bc91c5d3.jpg[/img]
	
[b]“Slay Ride Resurgence” Limited Time Mode[/b]: Nothing says “festivities” quite like a new Limited Time Mode: Prepare for a Holiday-themed take on Resurgence, as you’re in for a number of treats….
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/35ab5b927c4114e36f9d45c404b3980dee907711.jpg[/img]
	
[b]Deck the Halls: [/b]Santa has delivered presents across Urzikstan, via a number of holiday crates. Open the Tac Map to reveal their location in the match and get to the trees to earn the rewards in the vicinity. However, be ready to fight for your spot as a flare is sent up when Operators interact within the immediate area where the crates are found. Those who hold the point the longest will be gifted a chance to meet Santa... or at least something that used to be Santa.

[b]Zombie Santa: [/b]Once an Operator obtains a key from Deck the Halls, a “Merry” portal will appear. Take the portal to face off against a zombified Juggernaut Santa. Defeat this evil incarnation of Santa before rummaging in his massive sack for a variety of valuable loot!
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/da021b799276bced5387069a49a88263046c00a2.jpg[/img]
	
[b]Slay Ride: [/b]Santa has taken over the train in Urzikstan. Per his usual modus operandi, Santa will be handing out presents to all the well-behaved Operators he meets. Those who choose to be naughty, on the other hand, will be met with heavy resistance.
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/d6e314197dcadb3624773efaf260fd88fb726813.jpg[/img]
	
[b]Snowball Fights:[/b] As part of both the Players default Loadout as well as in ground loot represented by a snowflake icon on the Tac Map, you can find these rather lethal Snowballs all over the map.

And more....

The CODMAS event will also feature a new challenge for [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] and Multiplayer during the 12 Days of CODMAS. Complete these challenges to earn rewards.

notes.title: Modern Warfare III Season 1: Zombies Overview
notes.notes:
[b][u]MODERN WARFARE ZOMBIES OVERVIEW[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/05a80b1af17d546751cddab17f5145f618083993.jpg[/img]

	[list]	[*][b]New story Act.[/b] A massive gateway has appeared in the Exclusion Zone. Investigate the area and engage in new end-game content.[/*]	[*][b]Enter Dark Aether Rifts.[/b] A new labyrinth -like experience challenging squads to complete a series of objectives in the given time. Find Sigils to unlock the Dark Aether Rifts and earn rewards on completion.[/*]	[*][b]New Wonder Weapon, Warlord, and more.[/b] Wield the V-R11 Wonder Weapon, discover new schematics, and prepare to infiltrate the fortress of the Warlord Dokkaebi.[/*][/list]
[i](This is blog 2 of 4; also make sure to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/3887232108509147191]Part 1: Modern Warfare III Overview[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/3887232108509168737]Part 3: Warzone Overview[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/3887232108509181295]Part 4: General Overview[/url].)[/i]

[b][u]Zombies: A New Story Act Begins (Launch)[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4b0f6a7cd49a246ac4ace6474d4924c970b3e227.jpg[/img]

As Operators continue to push farther into the Exclusion Zone, a new anomaly appears. Sent to investigate, Operation Deadbolt Strike Teams are pulled through to the other side in their first major encounter inside the Dark Aether. Expect a new story mission that begins the next Act of content, with tasks that will test your abilities in the fights ahead.

The Season 1 update brings additional challenges and rewards, including new Prestige Challenges to explore, a new Warlord to battle, an exciting new Wonder Weapon, new Schematics and Acquisitions, new secrets, and introducing the deadly but lucrative Dark Aether Rifts.

[b][u]Enter the Rift (Launch)[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c5823d1f3d0135df9a418783de51344bbda1f4c4.jpg[/img]

Dark Aether Rifts bring rewards to those who brave their challenges. These otherworldly labyrinths are located inside the Dark Aether, where players and their squad have 30 minutes to complete a series of increasingly chaotic objectives to earn exceptional rewards. Find Sigils to unlock the Dark Aether Rift and face a new level of challenge!

[b][u]New Wonder Weapon:[/u][/b][b] V-R11 (Launch)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/f402b3641a5b55d30d881c7e838f9ac2403c00f8.jpg[/img]

Season 1 brings the new V-R11 Wonder Weapon. Turn enemies into allies with the powerful V-R11! Shoot zombies and transform them into humans, or blast humans to mutate them into friendly zombies. As you might expect, transformed humans join you in the fight, drawing the attention of nearby zombies, while transformed zombies will commence their ceaseless hunt for your enemy's flesh!

[b][u]New Classified Schematics[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c066bb8a691a8fe5e82b7834eca7b940e23db69a.jpg[/img]

[b]Dog Bone (Classified Schematic, Legendary, Launch)[/b]

Consume the Dog Bone to summon the strongest friendly Hell Hound companion. The pet Hellhound will follow you and attack nearby threats until its health runs out. This Season 1 item can help take off the heat when it’s really needed.

[b]Golden Armor Plate (Classified Schematic, Legendary, Launch)[/b]

Consuming the new Golden Armor Plate replaces the Armor Carrier with Plates that automatically repair over time, in addition to providing the user additional damage resistances.

[b]Aether Blade (Lethal, Classified Schematic, Launch)[/b]

The Aether Blade is a special Throwing Knife with infinite ammo and a boomerang-like combat style. After striking an enemy, the Aether Blade locates the next nearest enemy to hit before returning to its Operator.

[b][u]Warlord: Dokkaebi (Mid-Season)[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6f38138afea19a8bc8fbf1cd05af079658b9a48e.jpg[/img]

Hoping to counter Operation Deadbolt’s technological advantage in the Exclusion Zone, Jack Fletcher (the leader of Terminus Outcomes) will deploy another of his Lieutenants to the battle space in the coming weeks. South Korean born Dokkaebi will bring with her an intimate understanding of Electronic Warfare, and a fleet of self-programmed autonomous drones, ready to wreak carnage on Operation Deadbolts Operatives from the skies.

notes.title: Mondern Warfare III Season 1: General Overview
notes.notes:
[b][u]GENERAL OVERVIEW (Modern Warfare III, Zombies, Warzone)[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/bca1b42f44441ba100fe44f5aab6dd14e889d835.jpg[/img]

	[list]	[*][b]Gear up with new weapons and Aftermarket Parts. [/b]Season 1 brings five free new weapons and nine Aftermarket Parts.[/*]	[*][b]New Operators:[/b] Deploy as Nolan and Dokkaebi, the new Season 1 Operators.[/*]	[*][b]Get the Premium experience with BlackCell. [/b]Purchase the BlackCell offering to unlock the Abolisher Operator, extra Tier Skips, alternate BlackCell-exclusive Skins earned throughout the Battle Pass, and more.[/*]	[*][b]The Season 1 Battle Pass.[/b] Unlock new Operators and a variety of free and premium content across the Season 1 Battle Pass.[/*]	[*][b]New Store offerings.[/b] Deploy as Santa, grab Bundles related to Dune, and more.[/*]	[*][b]Seasonal progression. [/b]Level up past Rank 55 and enter the Prestige Ranks, with new Challenge Rewards for both Multiplayer and Zombies.[/*]	[*][b]Additional comms regarding the future of DMZ[/b][/*]	[*]CDL Announcement. Rep your love for competition with the [i]Call of Duty League™[/i] Launch Pack and earn rewards for watching the pros compete starting December 8.[/*][/list]
[i](This is blog 4 of 4; also make sure to check out [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/3887232108509147191]Part 1: Modern Warfare III Overview[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/3887232108509157164]Part 2: Zombies Overview[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/3887232108509168737]Part 3: Warzone Overview[/url].)[/i]

[b][u]Gear Up: Five New Weapons[/u][/b]

[b]XRK Stalker (Sniper Rifle — Launch, Battle Pass Sector A4)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c45070829a198018a03d95654ac60df09928c3fa.jpg[/img]
	
[i]Stalk your prey and lay them out with this tactical sniper rifle chambered in .50 Cal.[/i]

For one-hit eliminations, look no further. The XRK Stalker Sniper Rifle deals massive damage and is highly customizable to support multiple playstyles. Enhance the weapon’s velocity and stability and strike from the shadows or improve its handling capabilities to become a quick-scoping menace.

[b]RAM-7 (Assault Rifle — Launch, Battle Pass Sector A7)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1758c4293fde1474958a23eb3582bf315fc57a22.jpg[/img]

[i]Exceptionally compact, this bullpup assault rifle sports a lightweight, polymer frame and is chambered in versatile 5.56.[/i]

When you need power and mobility, the RAM-7 is a sure bet. The weapon deals solid damage at close and medium range and in controlled bursts can compete from afar. Its lightweight frame results in a quick reload and fast handling so you can stay on the offensive.

[b]Stormender (Launcher — Launch, Battle Pass Sector A12)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e2eff70ac260b925ddc4291537d74a3335f6ebc3.jpg[/img]

[i]This state-of-the-art weapon system fires a localized EMP on a slight delay. Destroys tactical and lethal equipment and temporarily disables other electronic devices.[/i]

This brand-new weapon has the power to shoot down specific Killstreaks and take out drones with its lock-on capabilities. With unlimited recharging ammo and the ability to disable and delay enemy equipment, this weapon serves as a very real shock to the system, though damage to Operators is minimal.

[b]HRM-9 (SMG — In-Season, Armory Unlock)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8715e23b12e2a635c35bb130f72ef9822501cbbd.jpg[/img]

[i]A light yet stable 9mm submachine gun for close-quarters combat and putting down enemies quickly.[/i]

Sporting a high fire rate and excellent handling and mobility, the HMR-9 is the perfect fit for aggressive run-and-gun playstyles. Aim down sights for precise fire or enter Tac-Stance and run circles around your enemies. Use Gunsmith to enhance the weapon’s midrange capabilities, improve its close-quarters performance, or a combination of the two.

[b]TAQ Evolvere (LMG — In-Season)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6840238dcf533146aabc8a35f2a5ec7c80ad6905.jpg[/img]

[i]An advanced, multi-caliber LMG capable of firing 7.62 or 5.56 with minimal adjustments to the weapon. Versatile and exceptionally lethal in the right hands.[/i]

This all-new Light Machine Gun is capable of taking down both infantry and artillery, whichever chooses to cross its path. A wide variety of Attachments are available via the Gunsmith, allowing you to tailor the TAQ Evolvere to any playstyle.

[b][u]Explore Your Attachments: New Aftermarket Parts (Launch, In-Season)[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/061cc2bd039fd8a43649d88b9fa296b11dcdccd0.jpg[/img]
	
Season 1 brings new Aftermarket Parts, including the JAK Purifier, a new flamethrower underbarrel attachment for multiple weapons, available via the Season 1 Battle Pass. Note that Aftermarket Parts usually attach to a specific weapon or class of weapon, as detailed below:
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/56b98a4290e57d4485447f19ae92eafa25f4bca6.jpg[/img]
	
[b]JAK Purifier[/b]

[b]Compatability: [/b]MCW, MTZ-556, Holger 556, DG-56, SVA 545, RAM-7, MTZ-762, BAS-B, Sidewinder, Riveter

Equip an underbarrel flamethrower. What more needs to be said? Burn it all down. The JAK Purifier AMP is compatible with several weapons, including multiple Assault Rifles, Battle Rifles, and the Riveter Shotgun.

[b]JAK Ettin Double Barrel Kit[/b]

[b]Compatability: AMR9[/b]

Available for the AMR9 SMG, this kit creates two stacked barrels that fire simultaneously. This offers twice as much down-range damage at the cost of some accuracy.

[b]JAK Thunder LMG Kit[/b]

[b]Compatability: Sidewinder (BR)[/b]

Dominate lanes and hold objectives with this LMG conversion kit for the Sidewinder Battle Rifle that brings a large capacity magazine and ramps in fire rate the longer you hold down the trigger.

[b]JAK BRB[/b]

[b]Compatability: [/b]Many Assault Rifles, Submachine Guns, Battle Rifles, Marksman Rifles, and Sniper Rifles.

Go loud. This compensator borders on excessive, offering a phenomenal reduction to recoil while significantly increasing muzzle report, resulting in an extended red dot on enemy radars.

[b]JAK Bullseye[/b]

[b]Compatability: [[REDACTED]][/b]

Very low-profile dot Optic. Limited interference from framework offers an exceptionally clear sight picture.

[b]JAK Glassless Optic[/b]

[b]Compatability: [[REDACTED]][/b]

This small, glassless reflex Optic offers a crisp and clear sight picture for snappy target acquisition.

[b]JAK Signal Burst[/b]

[b]Compatability: Holger 556[/b] (AR)

A conversion kit designed for accuracy and controllability with four-round bursts.

[b]JAK Beholder Rifle Kit[/b]

[b]Compatability: TYR[/b] (Handgun)

A long and heavy barrel that offers the best increase to range. Improves recoil control and damage range, converting this Handgun into a single-shot Rifle.

[b]JAK Headhunter Carbine Conversion[/b]

[b]Compatability: Rival-9[/b] (SMG)

Rival Assault Rifles with this three-round burst conversion kit that excels at midrange combat.

[b][u]Become Elite with BlackCell[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/959068febabae0183f0686fbf0bcd426350fabe1.jpg[/img]
	
Purchase BlackCell to gain exclusive access to premium items in Season 1 along with full access to the Season 1 Battle Pass. Enter the Season 1 Battle Map through the BlackCell Sector plus 20 Battle Token Tier Skips to help unlock valuable items more quickly. Getting BlackCell will immediately unlock the BlackCell Sector, including the new BlackCell Abolisher Operator plus the “Man o’ War” Weapon Blueprint with Tracers, the “Flexed Upon” Finishing Move, “War Horse” Vehicle Skin, and 1,100 COD Points.

Throughout the Season 1 Battle Pass, BlackCell members can earn 16 unique BlackCell rewards include 10 alternate Operator Skins and six alternate Weapon Blueprints with Tracers.

Or, if you preordered the Vault Edition of [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], you can claim all of this as part of the rewards granted at the start of Season 1.

For the players who upgrade to BlackCell after purchasing the Battle Pass will also receive 1,100 COD Points back.

[b][u]New Operators Headline the Season 1 Battle Pass[/u][/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/983ddee11979ebc04fdcb5a280204edb1ee34deb.jpg[/img]
	
Season 1 introduces Nolan and Dokkaebi as playable Operators unlocked through purchase of the Season 1 Battle Pass, and the mysterious BlackCell Operator, Abolisher. The Battle Pass itself is crammed full of unlockable content, and a deep dive into the Skins, Weapons, Operators, Blueprints and other items to obtain, will be showcased in a future blog prior to Season 1 launch.

[b]Nolan (KorTac, Launch)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5e3a3582e7962c8b10ee41f82ac708b8258d833b.jpg[/img]
	
This once distinguished soldier is a master of manipulation and close-quarters combat. Rescued by Makarov, Nolan plays an integral role in the Konni Group’s mission.

[b]Dokkaebi (KorTac, Launch)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ed512b56f3721359eb8e66788d14fa00db668572.jpg[/img]
	
A skilled spy and robotics engineer, Dokkaebi is Konni Group’s eye in the sky. Dokkaebi has been operating behind the scenes, executing drone attacks for Nolan and Makarov.

[b]Abolisher (SpecGru, Launch)[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ff2e43106f9630f997c3e64c7c0f84fb30e64ef9.jpg[/img]
	
This BlackCell Operator’s biographical information has been [REDACTED].

[b][u]New Store Offerings: Santa, Dune, and More[/u][/b]

Season 1 brings new Operators and challenges. Equip Operator Skins from certain Bundles to earn a boost toward collecting rewards in related events.
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5ca33c57159f5a130ec6eb93cb923eda38c05699.jpg[/img]
	
[b]Santa Gnaws: [/b]Bring destruction and holiday cheer in equal measure as Santa himself, paired with two Legendary Weapon Blueprints, including tracers and a Weapon Vinyl, Sticker, Charm, and Animated Emblem.
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8e91076b7f100f97acc3f0a90886b45feec7a22d.jpg[/img]
	
[b]Dune Part Two: [/b]Choose your champion with the Dune Bundles. Fulfill your destiny with the Paul Atreides Operator or show your ruthlessness as Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen.
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/04d1a723a815370585f951760252cc44fa1fc7b9.jpg[/img]
	
Other upcoming Store offerings include the [b]Tracer Pack: Echo Endo Ecstatic Entropy Mastercraft[/b], [b]Beach Boomin’[/b], the [b]Tracer Pack: Supernova[/b], the Painted Alebrijie Weapon Bundle (pictured above), and more.

[b][u]Challenges and Seasonal Progression[/u][/b]

In addition to Daily, Armory, Weapons, and Operator Challenges, there are plenty of additional unlocks to complete as you level up your Operator, weapons, and complete the Battle Pass. Here are a few highlights:

[b]Weekly Challenges[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3e699e9e696f36f5e0732b87e926b080771bee98.jpg[/img]
	
Ensure you complete all your pre-season Weekly Challenges, as a brand-new set of Weekly Challenges becomes available at the start of Season 1! This offers full flexibility in how many Challenges from each game you need to complete; allowing up to five from Multiplayer, Zombies, or Warzone to unlock the Weekly Reward (an Aftermarket Part for Week 1). Feel free to complete more five if you want more XP! Then set your sights on the “Coherence” Weapon Camo; the grand prize for completing all eight Weekly Rewards!

[b]Prestige Challenges[/b]
	
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/18a9d3b73fd2ed0b990667fdd1af1fb8b3637395.jpg[/img]
	
Following a similar system to[i] Modern Warfare II[/i], Season 1 allows you to level up past Rank 55 into Prestige Ranks that persist across seasons. Beginning in Season 1, reaching Rank 56 will unlock Prestige 1. Achieving this unlocks rewards and a set of challenges — complete those challenges to unlock multiple exclusive Calling Cards, with separate sets of Cards for both Multiplayer and Zombies.

Season 1 includes five Prestige Ranks, a total of 194 levels to rank up through, and each Prestige unlocks a new set of challenges and rewards:
[list]	[*]Prestige 1: Unlocked at Rank 56	[list]		[*]Emblem Reward[/*]		[*]MP: Four Calling Card Challenges, one Prestige 1 Mastery Calling Card Challenge.[/*]		[*]MWZ: Four Calling Card Challenges, one Prestige 1 Mastery Calling Card Challenge.[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list][list]	[*]Prestige 2: Unlocked at Rank 100	[list]		[*]Emblem Reward[/*]		[*]MP: Four Calling Card Challenges, one Prestige 1 Mastery Calling Card Challenge.[/*]		[*]MWZ: Four Calling Card Challenges, one Prestige 1 Mastery Calling Card Challenge.[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Prestige 3: Unlocked at Rank 150	[list]		[*]Emblem Reward[/*]		[*]MP: Four Calling Card Challenges, one Prestige 1 Mastery Calling Card Challenge.[/*]		[*]MWZ: Four Calling Card Challenges, one Prestige 1 Mastery Calling Card Challenge.[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Prestige 4: Unlocked at Rank 200	[list]		[*]Emblem Reward[/*]		[*]MP: Four Calling Card Challenges, one Prestige 1 Mastery Calling Card Challenge.[/*]		[*]MWZ: Four Calling Card Challenges, one Prestige 1 Mastery Calling Card Challenge.[/*]	[/list]	[/*]	[*]Prestige 5: Unlocked at Rank 250 and the level cap until the end of Season 1.	[list]		[*]Emblem Reward[/*]		[*]MP: Four Calling Card Challenges, one Prestige 1 Mastery Calling Card Challenge.[/*]		[*]MWZ: Four Calling Card Challenges, one Prestige 1 Mastery Calling Card Challenge.[/*]		[*]Blueprint Reward: “Venomous” Blueprint for the MTZ-556 AR, with a focus on ADS Speed, Sprint to Fire Speed, and Sprint Speed.[/*]	[/list]	[/*][/list]

[b][u]The Future of DMZ: Update[/u][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8f7ace38575f3400610801b06fb5ab885c718a2c.jpg[/img]

We would like to thank the entire community for their support and continued feedback on the DMZ Beta. Infinity Ward and all the development teams who contributed to the creation of DMZ are incredibly proud and delighted to see the enthusiasm and participation that you’ve shown since its release, and to see so many players pouring into the MWZ mode in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], which has many DMZ-inspired gameplay aspects within it.

Beginning with next week’s launch of Season 1, DMZ Beta players can continue the mode via the [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] section of COD HQ. The DMZ Beta will remain fully playable across all current DMZ content, including Al Mazrah, Ashika Island, the Koschei Complex, Building 21, Vondel, as well as all DMZ missions. The mode will not be available or interact directly within [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] or [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] which means that progression and any new [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] or [i]Warzone[/i] content, including Battle Pass or store bundles, will not sync or carry back into this DMZ mode. Also, DMZ progress will not apply to new Battle Passes beginning with Season 1.

We recognize that not having cross progression with [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] and [i]Warzone[/i] may be frustrating for some players, but we felt now was the time to take all the learnings from the Beta that we could apply toward future development efforts as we evolve this style of play. We also know that many players still enjoy the mode and wanted to ensure that everybody can keep playing, which is why we are keeping a variety of content available.

Going forward, development teams will continue to evolve these dynamic open world experiences into the future. We look forward to sharing updates when ready.

notes.title: RICOCHET: Anti-Cheat Progress Report
notes.notes:
Combining everything #TeamRICOCHET has developed over the course of the last three years with new Machine Learning advancements, RICOCHET: Anti-Cheat™ is preparing for the launch of [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® III[/i] with a stronger and faster process to combat cheating.

Machine Learning, in combination with client and server-side systems that continue to evolve and grow, helps advance both the speed and accuracy of our prevention techniques and detection systems.

[b][i]How Does #TeamRICOCHET Use Machine Learning?[/i][/b]

Machine Learning advancements have been integrated into our tech to help with efficiency and speed in prevention, detection, and removal of cheaters. Machine Learning advancements enhance our team’s ability by:

[list]	[*]Examining client and server data to find new cheat behaviors[/*]	[*]Issuing account challenges to validate abnormal behavior[/*]	[*]Collecting and collating problem accounts for action[/*][/list]

In short, Machine Learning helps us anticipate behavior better and operate with more effectiveness, with our team validating for accuracy.

Machine Learning works in concert with our team, providing information to make account decisions – but Machine Learning systems do not issue bans.

Machine Learning also helps enhance existing tools. One example of how we’re using Machine Learning to accelerate our anti-cheat capabilities is with the Replay tool.

[b][i]Machine Learning x Replay Investigation Tool[/i][/b]

Earlier [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2023/04/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-II-and-warzone-2-0-ricochet-anti-cheat-season-3-update]this year[/url] we announced a replay investigation tool that captured gameplay data so it could be converted into video internally, allowing our teams to review player matches for problem behavior. This tool has been beneficial since it launched, but the team wanted to drive toward a new goal: Speed.

On average, a #TeamRICOCHET teammate could review somewhere in the ballpark of 700 replay clips in any given day.

Some clips are easy: the most egregious “rage hacking” is simple to spot, but the Replay Investigation Tool was helpful to identify hackers who used tools to give them a slight advantage that was harder to spot in-game, such as wall hacks.

For the launch of [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] – and across all titles protected by RICOCHET: Anti-Cheat – the #TeamRICOCHET team is activating Machine Learning processes to increase the efficiency and strength of our anti-cheat efforts.

For the Replay Investigation Tool, a Machine Learning model is trained to identify suspicious behavior like wall hacks or raging (plus many others), and immediately prioritizes and alerts the team to review the issue for account action. A single PC running the model can review up to 1,000 clips per day – a number that grows exponentially when multiple computers are tasked with operating this specific Replay Machine Learning Investigation model.

We’re just getting started on Machine Learning integration for the Replay Investigation Tool, but we’re excited to see how it evolves over time. A major focus for this and many advancements is Ranked Play modes across our titles, combating anyone attempting to jump the ranks of the leaderboard unfairly.

This is one of the many ways Machine Learning helps identify and prioritize issues for our team, allowing Team Ricochet to develop new prevention strategies, detection techniques, and mitigations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/365071cdefaa7ea1157ffcc9bb432baa1d907c58.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Say Hello to [i]Splat[/i][/i][/b]

Often when a cheater appears in a match they are immediately kicked from the experience. Sometimes, as we’ve discussed in the past, we issue mitigations to minimize their impact [i]privately [/i]to keep them in the game so we can absorb all the information we can about the account and the machine used to cheat. Cloaking, Damage Shield and more will return in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] multiplayer and continue to exist in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i].

While we hesitate to call it an in-game Mitigation – because it’s immediately obvious when it happens – we have developed a new trick for cheaters going forward in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i]: We call it Splat.

With Splat, if a cheater is discovered, we may randomly, and for fun, disable their parachute sending them careening into the ground after they deploy.

But what if we catch them after they’ve deployed? Well, Splat can also adjust player velocity, which transforms a bunny hop into a 10,000-foot drop taking them out instantly. This is one of many new tricks we’ve developed – and we’ll talk about more in the future.

Like all mitigations, Splat won’t randomly turn on for a player that isn’t verified to be cheating. Player reporting won’t turn it on, and the game can’t accidentally activate it.

As important as it is for us to continue to fight on behalf of all our players – which includes us – we know that part of the confidence you have in our systems is when you can see them working to protect your experience in real-time. Visuals are important to our players and that’s why a few months ago we added the RICOCHET Anti-Cheat logo to the kill feed, so players could see the system protecting them in real-time. Mitigations do this too.

While it’s fun to annoy cheaters that make it into games, our aim is to prevent them from ever getting near a match. Prevention is key to the continued evolution of RICOCHET: Anti-Cheat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/38ac762b94c1854d737730b459ee4290516204cd.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Anti-Cheat Prevention Systems[/i][/b]
Cheaters are always looking for easy ways to get into the game, and stealing accounts is one of the ways they do this. Securing your account by enabling 2FA is important, as is making sure you are not reusing passwords for your Activision ID that you would for other apps or websites. Reusing passwords on other apps or websites in connection with your email can open the door to your account being stolen.

In 2023, our teams were able to identify over 110,000 player accounts on the dark web that were parsed from reused email and password combinations. We have since reset these accounts, returning them to their original owners to prevent these accounts from falling into the wrong hands.

[url=https://support.activision.com/articles/using-two-factor-authentication-with-an-activision-account]Learn how you can enable 2FA on your Activision ID[/url]

In the lead up to [i]Modern Warfare III[/i]’s launch, #TeamRICOCHET has banned over 80,000 accounts across [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]and [i]Modern Warfare II[/i], barring these accounts from accessing [i]Modern Warfare III[/i]. 

Another important piece of this prevention puzzle is our game code obfuscation and encryption. To play Call of Duty, we send each player the game code (via the game executable) to experience the game. When we send out the game executable, which contains detailed instructions for how our game works, we are essentially sending out copies of our house keys. Imagine trying to keep a bad guy who has copies of your keys from breaking into your home.

To make it harder to unlock the front door, the RICOCHET Anti-Cheat teams are constantly working on new obfuscation techniques to make the game code harder for bad actors to analyze. We then encrypt (or digitally lock) the entire Call of Duty executable, so it is much harder to tamper with. This makes it more difficult for the cheat developers to analyze and modify our code and remove our protections.

This is the ebb and flow of anti-cheat security.

When we take steps to stop cheaters, they readjust their process and look for new opportunities. The nature of multiplayer games, where our systems (the server) exchanges information with your computer (the clients) to make the multiplayer action happen, is how cheating can occur. Our anti-cheat efforts tackle each touchpoint of this trust process, from client to server-side systems and enhancing those process with Machine Learning to combat unfair play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/cc3cfac4981caeb6680155f698472e269050f40c.jpg[/img]

[b][i]How We Use [/i][/b][b][i]Player Reporting[/i][/b]

A common misconception we see is that spam reporting will result in actions being taken against accounts. For clarity, whether one player reports another once or multiple times, our system only considers the first report (throttling any additional reports from that player).

Reporting is critical but, must be used in combination with other factors before an account is actioned on. An account, for example, cannot be banned due only to reporting but if that account has also triggered other (and multiple) detections, a report can raise a red flag.

A reminder that spam reporting may be considered in violation of the updated Security and Enforcement Policy regarding “Malicious Reporting,” established [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2023/06/call-of-duty-ricochet-anti-cheat-season-04-update]earlier this year[/url].

As players of our own game – and other online multiplayer experiences – we too are disrupted by cheating issues. Our team is dedicated to using all technologies, providing our team with more data and tools, developing new prevention and detection systems, and doing anything we can to make the lives of cheaters that make it into our games as annoying as possible.

It's a continuous battle, but it’s one we’re committed to.

notes.title: Modern Warfare Zombies: Launch Content Overview
notes.notes:
Welcome to Operation Deadbolt. Your main tasks — aside from surviving hordes of Zombies and the machinations of the PMC group Terminus Outcomes — are threefold:

[b]Operation Deadbolt:[/b] Explore an open world and search for valuable Acquisitions and Schematics.

[b]A World of Opportunity: [/b]Complete Contracts to earn Essence, collect Acquisitions, and clear Missions to discover what is really happening in the Exclusion Zone.

[b]Secure and Extract: [/b]You also need to learn when the situation on the ground becomes advantageous as well as untenable. Immerse yourself and work with other players to complete the more difficult mission objectives, and extract before you’re overwhelmed.

[b]MWZ: Zombies Lobby[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/28b286e9aab4d2f288806aa5c68bb28ffcddb376.jpg[/img]

The [i]Modern Warfare [/i]Zombies Lobby features the same Global Panel access, but the Main Menu is significantly different.

[b]          The Main Menu [/b]across the top (Lobby, Gear, Strike Team, Customize, Battle Pass, Store) is meant to prepare you for your next mission to survive the undead hordes.

[b]          The Match and Progress[/b] information along the bottom of the screen allows you to launch into your next match, and quickly ascertain how much of the Zombies Story Missions you’ve completed.

[b][i]MWZ: Readying Up for a Mission[/i][/b]

[b]Strike Team Operators[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dab0033541c066aae0da6f5f88fbd9f25580a609.jpg[/img]

Recruit any unlocked Operator for your Strike Team. Each recruited Operator will have their own “On-Soldier” Gear. All Operators you’ve unlocked from both [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] and [i]Modern Warfare III [/i]are available, and two Operators — Ripper and Scorch — are unlocked after you complete specific challenges within Zombies.

Each Strike Team Operator can be chosen and comes with five different customizable Equipment Slots. The Gear you find during missions is saved here, and includes Killstreaks, Armor, Gas Masks, and Medical items.

[b]Rucksacks[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/001923e6119748ebe7f336c7a6d6470ebd3abc6d.jpg[/img]

Fill your Rucksack with essential Acquisitions that you find on the battlefield or craft via valuable Schematics. Initially there are up to five open slots on the small Rucksack. After your first mission, providing you’ve found either Acquisitions or Schematics, you can add such items to the Rucksack.

[b]Loadouts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/3ce05103928ec2a706f7e6516bf6236ec9a7cdb6.jpg[/img]

Choose two Primaries, or a Primary and Secondary Weapon, to take along with a Lethal, Tactical, and Field Upgrade. You have:

            [b]Primary and Secondary Weapons:[/b] All [i]MWII[/i] and [i]MWIII[/i] weapons are available to use in Zombies. Any that are “XP Recommended” are denoted by the small fire icon, and grant you more XP if used.

[b]Insured Slots:[/b] These are weapons you’ve leveled up, added attachments to, and come from the weapon pool of over 100 [i]MWII[/i] and [i]MWIII[/i] weapons. If you fail to exfil with an Insured Weapon, it only becomes available again after a Cooldown period. You have up to three Insured Slots, and two of them are unlocked after completing Zombies missions.

[b]Contraband Stashes:[/b] These are weapons you’ve found and exfilled with and are permanently lost if left behind during a mission. Keeping a stash of up to 20 of these weapons, which may or may not have attachments added to them, is helpful when augmenting your Loadout.

[b]Tacticals:[/b] A selection of Multiplayer Tactical and Lethal Equipment can be equipped as part of your Loadout.

[b]Tacticals: [/b]Stun Grenade, Smoke Grenade, Scatter Mine, Decoy Grenade, Shock Stick, Stim, or Experimental Gas Grenade.

[b]Lethals: [/b]Frag Grenade, Claymore, Throwing Knife, Thermite, Proximity Mine, Drill Charge, Sticky Grenade, C4, Molotov Cocktail, Breacher Drone

[b]Zombies Field Upgrades[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/392108bd1b4276f13cd8f6613c00396178df7250.jpg[/img]

Field Upgrades in MWZ are completely different from the equipment available to Multiplayer Operators. There are six Field Upgrades, five of which are unlocked as you progress through your Military Player Ranks:

[b]Energy Mine[/b]

Medium Recharge

[i]Spawn an explosive, dealing massive damage to enemies who set it off.[/i]

[b]Frenzied Guard[/b]

Slow Recharge

[i]Repair armor to full and force all enemies in the area to target you for 10 seconds. Enemy kills repair armor during this time.[/i]

[b]Healing Aura[/b]

Slow Recharge

[i]Heal all players immediately (and in last stand).[/i]

[b]Frost Blast[/b]

Medium Recharge

[i]Damage enemies with the initial blast and slow those that enter the area of effect.[/i]

[b]Aether Shroud[/b]

Medium Recharge

[i]Become invisible to zombies.[/i]

[b]Tesla Storm[/b]

Slow Recharge

[i]For 10 seconds, lightning connects to other players, stunning and damaging normal enemies.[/i]

[b][i]Adding to Your Attacks: Acquisitions and Schematics[/i][/b]

Once you return from your first few successful missions, you’re able to place Acquisitions into your Rucksack for use during subsequent outings and start to craft your own Acquisitions at the Schematic Crafting location, between drops.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6105512dabb49fcee108aab88be2222f863c85e6.jpg[/img]

[b]Acquisitions: [/b]These are single-use items that can give you an advantage on the battlefield. Acquisitions you find and exfil with in your Rucksack can be added to your Acquisition Stash, within your Rucksack Menu.

[b]Schematics: [/b]These are highly sought-after plans that permanently allow you to craft Acquisitions that you can add to your Rucksack. Schematics have a cooldown period, after which they can be brought into the Exclusion Zone.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5790b6fa21df2ed1fd529082c37a2be42150d057.jpg[/img]

The following types of Acquisitions can be found and used, or crafted if the Schematics are located, and all have a Rarity value associated with them (denoting how difficult they are to find and the level of improvements they bring to the weapon or item they affect):

[b]Aetherium[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6f5207abd285c9b81a0a9d57550d42af1e84f8cb.jpg[/img]

The Dark Aether element is used in conjunction with crafting Schematics to bolster your weaponry:

[b]Raw and Refined Aetherium Crystals: [/b]These are used to upgrade your Pack-a-Punch weapon to Levels I and II, respectively.

[b]Uncommon, Rare, Epic Aether Tools: [/b]These upgrade your currently held weapon to a rarer form. The rarer the form, the more impressive damage the weapon inflicts.

[b]Perk-a-Colas[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/aa491b66473bc9a7f980245a0342dbf9006086f3.jpg[/img]

The Vest, Gloves, Boots and Gear Perk system is not available in Zombies. Instead, receive a permanent boost (throughout a Mission, unless you fully die) to various in-game attributes by finding (or crafting) a Perk-a-Cola:

[b]Deadshot Daiquiri: [/b]ADS (aiming down sight) moves to enemy critical location. Removes scope sway.

[b]Death Perception: [/b]Obscured enemies, chests, resources, and item drops are more easily spotted.

[b]Elemental Pop: [/b]Every bullet you fire has a small chance to apply a random Ammo Mod effect.

[b]Jugger-Nog: [/b]Increases maximum health.

[b]PHD Flopper: [/b]Diving to prone triggers an explosion. The explosion increases the higher you fall. Immunity from fall damage while diving. Immunity from area-of-effect damage from weapons you are using.

[b]Quick Revive: [/b]Reduce the health regeneration delay time by 50%. Reduce the time it takes to revive an ally by 50%.

[b]Speed Cola: [/b]Drink to reload and replate armor faster.

[b]Stamin-Up: [/b]Increases run and sprint speed.

[b]Tombstone Soda: [/b]On death, you create a tombstone stash at that location, containing your backpack inventory in the next game.

[b]Ammo Mods[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/25e98ce09c79adddfb4873cb8884dd15474a4e14.jpg[/img]

The weapon you are currently holding can be further augmented with an Ammo modification. For the exact effect each Mod brings to a battle, why not test them out in the Exclusion Zone once you find or craft them?

[b]          Ammo Mods: Brain Rot, Cryo Freeze, Dead Wire,   Napalm Burst, Shatter Blast[/b]

[b]Wonder Weapons[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/469cfe3d08a8366d5fc5c5a76a4fe0c627208623.jpg[/img]

Locate the necessary (and devilishly difficult to find) Schematics, and you’re able to craft some of the most arcane and powerful weaponry ever seen. The Wonder Weapons available at game launch are currently [REDACTED].

[b][i]Missions Overview: Acts, Tiers, and Rewards[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/83275733614ae20320265262af2f8ee94fedfdb9.jpg[/img]

Begin to acclimate to the horrors of the Urzikstan Exclusion Zone and commence a multilayered storyline that focuses on a variety of Tiered Missions in three Acts. Not all missions are immediately accessible, and the mission you wish to complete (which may have one or multiple tasks) is highlighted. Mission completion rewards (including Acquisitions, cosmetic items, durable items, Double XP tokens) are also visible prior to infil.

Complete tasks within a mission (and receive unlocked missions and rewards).

Complete missions within a Tier (and receive unlocked missions and rewards).

Complete all Tiers to finish an Act (and receive unlocked missions and rewards).

Complete all three Acts (to receive a [REDACTED] and continue to uncover the mysteries plaguing the Exclusion Zone, prior the storyline continuation at Season 1).

[b][i]Mission Parameters: The Essence of Zombies[/i][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7d57f0ba107acb85b4f85652c6938d79c8adb6de.jpg[/img]

You have freedom and flexibility to explore the Exclusion Zone throughout Urzikstan, and infilling allows you to complete a wide variety of activities as well as the specific mission tasks you assigned to yourself prior to the session start.

Aside from the specific mission tasks you are undertaking, each Zombies infil enables you to:

[b]          Explore: [/b]Investigate the Low, Medium, and High Threat Zones. This can be done with a purpose, or you can simply remain in the relative safety of a Low Threat Zone as you learn how to deal with the variety of enemy threats. Weapon levelling is an excellent plan within the outer edge of the map.

[b]Complete Contracts: [/b]This allows you to earn Essence (the in-game currency, mainly gathered after zombie culling) and Acquisitions by completing contracts in the field for Operation Deadbolt.

[b]Upgrade to Progress:[/b] Spend Essence at machines across the map and upgrade your weapons and gear.

[b]Extract Acquisitions:[/b] Successful exfils allow you to keep Acquisitions to get a head start in the next deployment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1901209ce72b5a0a7abb5223aacf9458f1c17ad0.jpg[/img]

Within a deployment, your Tac-Map displays a variety of interesting game features, and some of the most important ones are detailed below so you can understand how to interact with them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1eec37c913fdb655e6c8b0d8d91c7cafcbde611c.jpg[/img]

[b]Buy Stations:[/b] Allows you to purchase a variety of helpful items, such as Killstreaks, Gas Masks, and other essentials.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b1de66bbe78ea549252972ce1aba936aa0476de3.jpg[/img]

[b]Perk-a-Cola Machine: [/b]This allows you to purchase a beverage that increases your prowess in a variety of ways (see above).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2342d52884352f5f371cb93dfd446785ac255664.jpg[/img]

[b]Pack-a-Punch Machine: [/b]This upgrades your currently carried weapon (usually in the ammunition and damage departments), for a price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1ed0aca340962bce9eb9185465375bc9fa67fadf.jpg[/img]

[b]Wall Buys:[/b] Outlines of weaponry can be found on the walls of various buildings throughout the Exclusion Zone. Interact and purchase the weapon, as needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8ab103c151976fe59df06dda31c89ebc0325858d.jpg[/img]

[b]Mystery Boxes:[/b] These offer an exciting randomly generated prize — likely a weapon of varying rarity and occasionally a Wonder Weapon!

[b]Wonder Weapons:[/b] [REDACTED].


Nothing gets in, nothing gets out.

notes.title: Modern Warfare III Weapon Camos: All the Details
notes.notes:
[b][i]Part 1: Gain Experience in Gaming Excellence: Challenges[/i][/b]

To further assist your Leveling up through the Military Ranks (and beyond during each of the forthcoming Seasons), [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] includes two challenge systems: Daily Challenges and Career Challenges. A [url=https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2023/10/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-III-launch-comms-intel#Preload]previous launch blog[/url] confirmed the six types of Challenges, while this blog dives a little deeper:

Both challenge systems are great sources of Player experience points (XP): Daily Challenges give thousands of XP every 24 hours, and Career Challenges set up milestones to work toward throughout your experiences across [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], Zombies, and [i]Call of Duty®: Warzone™[/i] (at Season 1), granting XP and Calling Cards upon completion.

[b]Daily Challenges[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4a388bf1757136171cdc3e4c7a772d4597af3c0a.jpg[/img]

Available in Multiplayer, Zombies, as well as in [i]Call of Duty: Warzone [/i]at its launch, Daily Challenges are a set of three challenges that reset on a fixed schedule — see the in-game timer for details on how long you have to complete them.

In Multiplayer, the three Daily Challenges are from three distinct categories:
[list]	[*]A general challenge that may not require much change in playstyle (e.g., get 7 headshots).[/*]	[*]A weapon challenge that focuses on a specific weapon category (e.g., get 5 headshots with LMGs)[/*]	[*]A special challenge that encourages exploration with specific conditions, Equipment, or Field Upgrades, (e.g., provide Ammo Resupplies to 5 players).[/*][/list]

[b]Career Challenges[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/184d9bca3d25bc9aa2c73d0c609816972b843852.jpg[/img]

In addition to Daily Challenges, expect an assortment of Multiplayer and [i]Modern Warfare Zombies[/i] Career Challenges at launch.

Some of these, such as match wins and kills, will come naturally by simply playing the game. Others, such as earning kills with a specific weapon category or the use of Equipment may involve changing your playstyle.

Career Challenges have several milestone steps, which award XP. You can even continue pushing to fully complete a Career Challenge, which offers additional XP and a Calling Card.

Once Season 1 (and future seasons) become available, expect additional challenges unlocked at Prestige Level milestones that offer more difficult objectives and XP rewards. Expect intel on the Prestige system closer to Season 1.

[b][i]More Ways to Unlock: Weekly Challenges and Armory Unlock Challenges[/i][/b]

[b]Weekly Challenges[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/84f3c943712c00179e74dd7d69786a2354b4c71a.jpg[/img]

Every week during the Pre-Season, and during each Season, a new set of Challenges availables. At launch, expect there to be seven Multiplayer and seven Zombies Weekly Challenges available every week. Expect something similar when Warzone launches with Season 1.

Every Weekly Challenge awards XP on completion. If you complete five Weekly Challenges for a week, you will unlock a special attachment (Aftermarket Part) or a weapon as a weekly reward. If you earn all Weekly Rewards in a Season, you unlock a Seasonal Cosmetic reward (a Camo, for example).

[b]Armory Unlock Challenges[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9d761d3db7fc30c77f957a8cd3cb461f546919c1.jpg[/img]

Armory Unlock Challenges are a new system that lets you unlock the Weapons, Equipment, Perks, Killstreaks, and Attachments that you want to utilize. This includes many attachments unlocked through Weapon Progression.

When you reach Level 25, expect to unlock the Armory Unlock Challenge System, and begin to progress and complete challenges, unlocking new items. There are a variety of items you can earn through Armory Unlock Challenges, which you can view in the Armory Unlocks Challenge Menu.

Armory Unlock Challenges are completed by Completing Daily Challenges. Each Daily Challenge completed earns you a point against your active Armory Unlock Challenge.

While you can continue to earn Armory Unlocks in order, you can also “Activate” any valid item. This will now be your Active Armory Unlock Challenge, and you will begin to earn points against it as you complete Daily and Bonus Challenges.

If you complete all your Daily Challenges, you unlock a Bonus Challenge that is unique to each game. Bonus Challenges can be completed infinitely: in Multiplayer, they require winning a match, in Zombies, they require completing Contracts.

If you change your mind mid-completion, don't worry - progress against Armory Unlock Challenges is saved when you Activate a new Challenge.

Remember: If you see an item you want at the end of a Weapon's Progression, then check the Challenges menu; you might be able to unlock it with an Armory Unlock Challenge!

[b][i]Part 2: Cosmetic Customization: Weapon Camos[/i][/b]

As with [i]Modern Warfare II[/i], you can change your weapon’s cosmetic appearance by adding a Camo, a Gun Screen, a Charm, a Decal, and up to three Stickers to your weapon. The rest of this article focuses on the hundreds of Camos available at launch in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i].

[b]Weapon Camos: Overview[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/9ad51d49baaa7d98191818d46fdeddd647ef3138.jpg[/img]

Prepare for a ramped-up Weapon Camo Mastery that integrates your legacy weaponry from [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] and adds an impressive Camo grind for Multiplayer and a customized Zombies camo grind catering to the true masters of the completionist Camo craft!

First, let’s confirm the new sets of Weapon Camos in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i]:

[b]Base Camos (MP, MWZ)[/b]

[i]Modern Warfare III[/i] introduces a magnificent selection of additional Weapon Camos for you to unlock, and all the Base camos – from either game – can be applied to any weapon in [i]MWIII[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0add11939365e72704eb8c57cfd3f62426ca9cdb.jpg[/img]

[b]Brand New Camo Sets: [/b]There are 18 different sets of [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] Weapon Camos (which you unlock by playing Multiplayer and Zombies with [i]MWIII[/i] weaponry):
[list]	[*]Confirmed Sets are: Poison Frogs, Graphical, Topographic, Glittery Flats, Retro, Neapolitan, Under the Microscope, High Contrast, Wavelength, Two Tone Brushstrokes, Perfect Symmetry, Psychedelics, Blur, Bold, Butterfly, Puzzle, Skeletal, and Glitch Milspec.[/*][/list]

[b]Returning Camo Sets (with New Variants): [/b]In addition, all 14 of the [i]Modern Warfare II [/i]camo sets return:
[list]	[*]Existing MP Camo sets carry forward from [i]MWII[/i] (which you unlocked, or can continue to unlock in [i]MWIII[/i], using [i]MWII[/i] weapons)[/*]	[*]Plus, expect to double each [i]MWII[/i] set of camos with new variants of existing Camo sets from [i]MWII[/i], which you unlock playing Zombies in [i]MWIII[/i] with [i]MWII[/i] weaponry. See below for more information.[/*]	[*][b]Confirmed returning sets are:[/b] Spray Paint, Woodland, Digital, Dragon, Geometric, Fun, Foliage, Skulls, Tiger, Stripes, Reptile, Solid Colors, Classic, and Cliffside.[/*][/list]

[b]Completionist Camos (MP, MWZ, Mastery)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1e82f1c1ce883bf8770a483cca44cfcb4aadcbec.jpg[/img]

[i]Modern Warfare III[/i] also introduces a total of 12 additional Completionist Camos to unlock (in three sets of four) as well as the four Completionist Camos from [i]MWII[/i]. These have rules regarding which weapon they can be applied to, and sets of unlock criteria which are detailed later in this article. Before we detail the full complement of camos on offer, here are the confirmed Completionist Camos:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1d4b4bc98b9e263294fc1ab28d9d12e74fe6fe40.jpg[/img]

[b]Multiplayer: Carry Forward: [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] Weapons: [/b]Gold, Platinum, Polyatomic*, Orion*.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/08551ec473d8d9519c772ccb36e298f971c1a8fc.jpg[/img]

[b]Multiplayer (NEW): [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] Weapons: [/b]Gilded, Forged, Priceless*, Interstellar*.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c30c82b19580edd436e21cc2faf168c7e16c5828.jpg[/img]

[b]Zombies (NEW): [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] Weapons: [/b]Golden Ivory, Spinel Husk, Arachnida*, Bioluminescent*.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/749072779a4e656096dfeb001dfad36ae120b238.jpg[/img]

[b]Zombies (NEW): [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] Weapons: [/b]Golden Enigma, Zircon Scale, Serpentinite*, Borelis*.

[i](*Denotes the camo is animated)[/i]

Need a deeper dive? Here’s how all of this breaks down:

[b][i][i]Modern Warfare II[/i][/i][/b][b][i] Weapons: Multiplayer Camos (MP)[/i][/b]

All of the individual Weapon Camos, Completionist Camos, and Weapon Mastery Challenges from [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] carry forward into [i]Modern Warfare III[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b555be9afe55d33fbd594ac5cba508c283d5c1e9.jpg[/img]

[b]All Camos: [/b]With the exception of the [i]MWII[/i] Completionist Camos (Gold, Platinum, Polyatomic, and Orion), every [i]MWII[/i] Base Weapon Camo can be applied to any weapon in [i]MWIII[/i], no matter which game the weapon or Camo originated in. That means you can place a [i]MWII[/i] base Camo onto a [i]MWIII[/i] weapon, and vice versa, assuming weapon and Camo have been unlocked (examples are shown in the previous screenshot).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/908dc074980ffcb42d715782f4ae6b9ab8fa104a.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Modern Warfare II[/i][/b][b] Completionist Camos: [/b]These can be placed only onto the [i]MWII[/i] weapon you have unlocked the Camo for, as the four Completionist Camos are accessible only within the Customize > Camo Category Menu. [i]MWII[/i] Completionist Camos cannot be placed onto [i]MWIII[/i] weapons, or vice versa.

[b]Example: [i]MWII[/i] player with unlocked [i]MWII[/i] weapons: [/b]If you’re a [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] player with a number of individual Weapon Camos and Completionist camos unlocked, then those will Carry Forward into [i]Modern Warfare III[/i].

[b]Specific Weapon Example:[/b] Let’s assume you’ve unlocked some or all of the following M4 AR Camos in [i]MWII[/i] (as shown above):

[b]Specific Camos: [/b]The four specific M4 Camo Unlocks (Scales, Desert Hybrid, Dark Leaves, and New Urban).

[b]Completionist Camos: [/b]The four M4 Mastery Camos that are also available for every [i]MWII[/i] weapon (Gold, Platinum, Polyatomic, and Orion).

[b]Weapon Mastery: [/b]The Gold, Platinum, Polyatomic, and Orion Mastery (Emblems and Calling Cards for each), and the Completionist Charm.

In this example, any and all unlocked content is Carried Forward into [i]Modern Warfare III[/i]. Any content you haven’t unlocked becomes available to unlock within [i]MWIII[/i] as well, so you can effectively continue your [i]MWII[/i] grind into [i]MWIII[/i].

All Camo Challenges carry over from [i]MWII[/i] to [i]MWIII[/i], so, for example, you still need to “Get 15 Kills from behind with the M4” to unlock the New Urban Camo (which, once unlocked, can be applied to the M4, or any other weapon from [i]MWII[/i] or [i]MWIII[/i]).

[b][i][i]Modern Warfare III [/i][/i][/b][b][i]Weapons: Multiplayer Camos (MP)[/i][/b]

[b][i]MWIII[/i][/b][b] Weapons — MP Individual Camos: [/b]Just like the [i]MWII[/i] Multiplayer Weapon Camos, every [i]MWIII[/i] weapon has up to four individual base Camos, all brand-new to [i]MWIII[/i], and each requires unlock challenges to obtain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0b42aec20f6af0b15195b8c879aaa56c486e9dab.jpg[/img]

[b]Camo Challenge Variation:[/b] In [i]MWII[/i], the base Camo challenges were relatively similar across the different weapon types. In [i]MWIII[/i], base Camo challenges are unique to each weapon category. For example, individual SMGs will have a different set of base challenges compared to individual Shotguns, LMGs, and so on. This promotes variety in gameplay, and the challenges have been honed to better suit the playstyle of each weapon type.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd0fc410c69593b1dd8e90aaa2602fc90936c27d.jpg[/img]

[b]Specific Weapon Example:[/b] Let’s explore this by leveling up the MCW, one of the new [i]MWIII [/i]Assault Rifles:

[b]MCW Mastery Camos: [/b]As well as four specific Zombie Camos (detailed below), there are four MCW MP-related Base Camo Unlocks (Razor Feather, Skullflagration, Abyssal Fox, Menelaus Blue).

[b]MCW Mastery Camos Unlock Criteria: [/b]Each of the four MCW Mastery Camos requires you to complete a Level challenge (e.g., “get the MCW to Level 12), as well as a Multiplayer-specific challenge (e.g., “Get 50 Kills while ADS with the MCW”).

[b]Completionist Camos for [i]MWIII[/i] Weapons: [/b]There are four additional brand-new Completionist Camos (Gilded, Forged, Priceless, Interstellar). The unlock criteria for these is detailed below.

[b]Weapon Mastery: [/b]The Gilded, Forged, Priceless, and Interstellar Camos also have Weapon Mastery challenges, allowing you to claim Emblems and Calling Cards for each, as well as the Completionist Charm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/76b017ed9fb2411b5c96876005709ada25cab584.jpg[/img]

[b][i]MWIII[/i][/b][b] MP Weapon Camo Challenges: Summary[/b]

Expect the following additional Camos, on top of the existing base and Completionist MP Camos from [i]MWII[/i]:

            + Over 140 new base Camos (examples above)

            + Four new Mastery (Completionist) Camos

            + Over 140 new Mastery Calling Cards and Emblems

            + 37 new Mastery Charms

[b][i][i]Modern Warfare II[/i][/i][/b][b][i] and [i]III[/i] Weapons: Zombies Camos (MWZ)[/i][/b]

The Camo Challenges are only just getting started: Get ready for the biggest Zombies Camo grind of all time!

Sledgehammer Games and Treyarch have added an entirely new set of Camo Challenges in [i]Modern Warfare III[/i], related to [i]both[/i] [i]MWII[/i] and [i]MWIII[/i] weaponry!

Whether you’re unlocking a [i]MWII[/i] weapon for the first time, or you’ve claimed Multiplayer Weapon Mastery for every one of the 77 [i]MWII[/i] weapons, you still have a sizeable challenge thanks to an incredible amount of Zombies Camo content across every available weapon in the game.

Let’s cover the [i]MWII[/i] weapons first:

[b][i]Modern Warfare II[/i][/b][b] Weapons: Zombies Camos (MWZ)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5028d5d837f4c9e74cb1201d31439c98d6f12ce2.jpg[/img]

[b][i]MWII[/i][/b][b] Weapons: MWZ Individual Camos: [/b]Every [i]MWII[/i] has up to four individual Zombie Camos, all brand-new to [i]MWIII[/i], and each requiring unlock challenges to obtain.

[b]Specific Weapon Example: [/b]Let’s return to the M4 from [i]MWII[/i].

[b]Specific Zombie Camos: [/b]As well as the four specific MP Camos (that can be unlocked in either game), there are four additional M4 Zombie Camo Unlocks (Rancid Venom, Dark Mist, Nightmare, and Fertilizer).

[b]Specific Zombie Camos Unlock Criteria: [/b]For each of the four Zombie Camos specific to the M4, you need to complete a level challenge (e.g., “get the M4 to Level 19”, which you’re likely to have already completed if you leveled up the weapon previously), as well as a Zombies-specific challenge (e.g., “In Zombies, get 5 Mimic kills with the M4”).

[b]Completionist Zombies Camos for [i]MWII[/i] Weapons: [/b]There are four brand-new Completionist Camos as well (Golden Ivory, Spinel Husk, Arachnida, Bioluminescent). The unlock criteria for these is the same across all [i]MWII[/i] weaponry, and is detailed below.

[b]Weapon Mastery: [/b]The Golden Ivory, Spinel Husk, Arachnida, and Bioluminescent Mastery also have Weapon Mastery challenges, allowing you to claim Emblems and Calling Cards for each, as well as the Completionist Charm.

[b][i]Modern Warfare III[/i][/b][b] Weapons: Zombies Camos (MWZ)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7d10b512ee9499e4395baf2c74366b8ded619fdf.jpg[/img]

[b][i]MWIII[/i][/b][b] Weapons: MWZ Individual Camos: [/b]Just like the [i]MWIII[/i] Multiplayer Weapon Camos, every [i]MWIII[/i] weapon also has up to four individual Zombie Camos, all brand-new to [i]MWIII[/i] and each requiring unlock challenges to obtain.

[b]Specific Weapon Example:[/b] Let’s explore this by leveling up the MCW, one of the new [i]MWIII[/i] Assault Rifles:

[b]Specific Zombie Camos: [/b]As well as the four specific MP Camos, there are four MCW Zombie Camo Unlocks (Wyvern, Vehement Rage, Tempest Shards, Toxic Spots).

[b]Specific Zombie Camos Unlock Criteria: [/b]For each of the four Zombie Camos specific to the MCW, you need to complete a level challenge (e.g., “get the MCW to Level 19), as well as a Zombies-specific challenge (e.g., “In Zombies, get 250 Hipfire Kills with the MCW”).

[b]Completionist Zombies Camos for [i]MWIII[/i] Weapons: [/b]There are four additional brand-new Completionist Camos (Golden Enigma, Zircon Scale, Serpentinite, Borealis). The unlock criteria for these is detailed below.

[b]Weapon Mastery: [/b]The Golden Enigma, Zircon Scale, Serpentinite, and Borealis Camos also have Weapon Mastery challenges, allowing you to claim Emblems and Calling Cards for each, as well as the Completionist Charm.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/98654c5c1210efd8518468a2798de2002abb4668.jpg[/img]

[b][i]MWIII[/i][/b][b] Zombie Weapon Camo Challenges: Summary[/b]

Expect the following additional Camos, which include Camo challenges for all 114 weapons across [i]MWII[/i] and [i]MWIII[/i]:

            + Over 400 new base Camos (examples above)

            + Eight new Mastery (Completionist) Camos (four for [i]MWII[/i] weapons, four for [i]MWIII[/i] weapons)

            + Over 400 new Mastery Calling Cards and Emblems

            + Over 100 new Mastery Charms

[b][i][i]Modern Warfare III[/i][/i][/b][b][i] Completionist Camos (MP, MWZ, Mastery)[/i][/b]

Last, and certainly not least, is the full reveal of all 12 of the brand-new [i]Modern Warfare III[/i] Completionist Camos, as well as the four returning Completionist Camos from MWII, and the unlock criteria for them all!

[b][i]Modern Warfare II[/i][/b] [b]Completionist Camos (MP Mastery)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/967a0d766e7000330a7ecf3a6820c7fe08ee6543.jpg[/img]

[b]Gold[/b] (available for [i]MWII[/i] weapons only).

Unlock Criteria: The same as in [i]Modern Warfare II[/i].

            Complete all four Base Camo Challenges for the specific weapon.

            Complete the Gold Camo Challenge: Usually a certain number of kills with the weapon, without dying, a certain number of times.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/e4c3ac443460e8820783c1f9a3685e8e9730611e.jpg[/img]

[b]Platinum[/b] (available for [i]MWII[/i] weapons only).

Unlock Criteria: The same as in [i]Modern Warfare II[/i].

            Complete the Gold Camo challenge for the specific weapon.

            Complete additional Gold Camo challenges for weapons in the same category.

            Complete the Platinum Camo Challenge: Usually a certain number of Longshot kills with the weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6d32181c7446573f2fce3b124d66c025b48d9bea.jpg[/img]

[b]Polyatomic[/b] (animated, available for [i]MWII[/i] weapons only).

Unlock Criteria: The same as in [i]Modern Warfare II[/i].

            Complete the Platinum Camo challenge for the specific weapon.

            Complete a total of 51 Platinum Camo challenges for MWII weapons.

            Complete the Polyatomic Camo Challenge: Usually a certain number of Headshots with the weapon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/b1be3ad9d154eb9692a3f481bbca0b26989f5893.jpg[/img]

[b]Orion[/b] (animated, available for [i]MWII[/i] weapons only).

[b]Weapon Mastery Unlock Criteria:[/b] The same as in [i]Modern Warfare II[/i].

[b]Gold Emblem and Calling Card:[/b] Unlock Gold Camo, get 100 Kills while using the Gold Camo.

[b]Platinum Emblem and Calling Card:[/b] Complete Gold Mastery, Unlock Platinum Camo, get 200 Kills while using the Platinum Camo.

[b]Note: If you’re a [/b][i]Modern Warfare II[/i] player, in [i]MWIII[/i] you can can pick up from the point you reached [i]MWII[/i] regarding the unlocking of [i]MWII[/i] weapon Completionist Camos and Mastery rewards.

[b]NEW: [/b][b][i]Modern Warfare III[/i][/b] [b]Completionist Camos (MP Mastery)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/5f209b5f74d2f5ee7aca05d4a19f5a750048299e.jpg[/img]

[b]Gilded[/b] (available for [i]MWIII[/i] weapons only).

Unlock Criteria:

Complete all Base Camo Challenges for the weapon.

Complete an individual Gilded Challenge tailored to the specific weapon (for example, “Get 3 Operator Kills with 1 Magazine 10 times,” (MCW AR).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8d42532a73975982e64b8be13fa02403fa2b7476.jpg[/img]

[b]Forged[/b] (available for [i]MWIII[/i] weapons only).

Unlock Criteria:

Complete the Gilded Camo Challenge for the weapon.

            Complete additional Gilded Camo challenges for weapons in the same category.

Complete an individual Forged Challenge tailored to the specific weapon (for example, “Get 3 Kills without dyring 10 times,” (MCW AR).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1b45a9f7e84e47d8c3ebf8cb8057024384e327dd.jpg[/img]

[b]Priceless[/b] (animated, available for [i]MWIII[/i] weapons only).

Complete an individual Forged Challenge tailored to the specific weapon (for example, “Get 5 Kills without dyring 10 times,” (MCW AR).

[b]Forged Emblem and Calling Card:[/b] Complete Gilded Mastery, Unlock Forged Camo, get 200 Operator Kills while using the Forged Camo.

[b]Completionist Charm: [/b]Complete all Mastery Challenges.

[b]NEW: [i]Modern Warfare II[/i] Completionist Camos (MWZ Mastery)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/ae88930e1e6dc4f1e2fc66649f7542eee428cc72.jpg[/img]
